parts.english:
Abdullah Ibn Imam Ahmad(عَبدُالله ابن اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ), Abdullah(عَبدالله); the son of Al Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ); he said; that he was there when his father was passing away.

And his father was going into the Sakrah(سكرة); the state of unconsciousness.

And by the way, when you are going from Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) to Akhirah(آخرة); it's a very difficult change.

You've been in this world for 60 or 70 years.

And now, you are going through a completely different world.

So that change between these two stages is difficult.

And sometimes it doesn't happen immediately.

So you'll find the person, is going back and forth in this stage of Sakrah(سكرة).

To simplify the explanation of this; think about sleep.

Because sleep is the minor death.

Sleep!

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And He Is the One, Who takes your souls when you are sleeping.

Sleep is a minor death.

When you are awake, and you're going to the different stage of sleep.

You go through interface between these two.

So you are not asleep, and you're not awake.

And then you enter into the stage of sleep.

So you're going from awakening to sleeping, and you're going through this interface between the two.

The same thing happens before death.

You are going through this interface between the two stages of life and death.

So there is moments in which you are on the other side of the world, and moments in which you are in this side of the world.

Abdullah Ibn Imam Ahmad(عَبدُالله ابن اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) says that, his father went into the stage of unconsciousness.

And then his father started saying; No; not yet!

Abdullah(عَبدالله) was worried.

Imagine! You hear your father saying; No; not yet! No; not yet!

What would you interpret it to mean?

What would you think, it means?

I don't want to die yet, right.

No; not yet! No; not yet!

You would interpret it as meaning; I do not want to die yet.

So Abdullah(عَبدالله) was very concerned.

So he asked his father; Oh my father! When his father woke up; Oh my father! Why were you saying; Not yet! Not yet!

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) was standing right next to me; biting on his fingers and saying; Oh Ahmad(اَحْمَدْ)! You have slipped out of my hands.

So I was telling him; No, not yet! Not yet! until I die.

The battle between me and you is still happening.

Not until I die; will I be saved from you.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) was biting his fingers; upset because he lost Al Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

Because Al Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) is slipping from his hands.

So Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) was so angry and upset.

He was biting his fingers and saying; Ahmad(اَحْمَدْ), you have slipped away from my hands.

Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) said; Not yet; until I die.

Look at the believer! How he keeps on fighting until the last moment.

We never give up!

If we are proud; we would say, Yes! I won against you.

But Al Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) is saying; No, until I die.

So this could happen and if it could happen; is something extremely dangerous.

The reason, why this happens is, because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) realizes that, this is his last chance with you.

If he misses it; you're gone.

If he misses you in the last moment, he missed you.

That is why, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) emphasizes and gives special attention to the last moments of your life.

So put the criteria to yourself and think about it; if you are losing to Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) now, when the battle is easy.

What would happen to you in the last moments, where it gets tough?

If you are already losing the battle now; when Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is giving you a half of his attention.

What will happen when he gives you his complete attention; when he devotes his efforts for you?

These are the Fitan(فِتَنْ). And that's why, we say in our Salah(صلوة); We seek refuge in You from the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) of life and death.

This is the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) of death.

Let's talk about Asbab Su'al Khatimah(اَسْبَابْ سُوءَالْخَاتِمَه); the reasons for evil ending.

Because the most important stage of your life is Al-Khawateem(خواتيم); the ending.

Whoever dies in something will be resurrected on it.

If you died in Hajj(حَجْ) with Ihram(احرام), making Talbiah(تلبيه), Rasool Allah ﷺ says; On the Day of Judgment, you will be resurrected saying;

And if you die as a Shaheed(شَهِيد) in the battle; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; On the Day of Judgment, you would come out of your grave with your injury bleeding;

just like it was bleeding when you died in the battlefield.

When you die on something; you will be resurrected on that same thing that you were doing.

That's why the most important stage of our life is Al-Khawateem(الخواتیم).

And  that's why, Rasool Allah ﷺ used to always says in the Hadith(حديث); Oh Allah! Make the best of my deeds; the last deeds.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says in a Hadith(حديث); One of you; would do the deeds of the people of paradise until, the only one foot is between you and Paradise,

and then in the end; you would do the deeds of the people of hellfire, and you would die, and you would enter into hellfire.

All of your life; you were doing the actions of the people of Jannah(جنة), and in the end; you messed up, and then you end up in hellfire.

And the opposite could happen too.

You could be doing the deeds of the people of hellfire, in the last moment of your life; you do something good; you die; you go to Jannah(جنة).

So the most important stage is the last stage.

What are the reasons for evil endings?

We asked Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; the good, blessed ending.

Reasons of evil ending.

Number one; Corruption and defect in the belief.

Let me give you an example, an analogy.

Let's assume; you bought a computer.

And you started working on that computer, for the first month; it's working fine, the second month it's working fine.

And then you put it through a rigorous application; and the computer failed and broke down.

You take it and you see what's the problem?

You find that there was a defect from day one.

But this defect did not show from day one, because you were treating it gently.

You were using the computer for easy and simple applications.

But when you put it through the rigorous test; a serious application; a serious program; it broke down.

Why?

Because there was a hidden defect.

This defect didn't show up on day one.

It didn't show up on day two.

It grew up fine for two months.

But when things became tough; it broke down.

Because, there was a hidden defect; You didn't see it.

You thought that the computer is brand new, and nothing is wrong with it.

But there was something hidden.

So you could be living now, thinking that your Eeman(ايمان) is perfect, and your Aqeedah(عَقِيدة) is fine.

You have a Bid'ah(بدعة) or an innovation or doubts.

You have doubts in Qur'an; doubts about the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); doubts about the laws of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

You have some doubts hidden somewhere in the corner; in the heart.

And then death approaches, and Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) puts you through the test.

Things become difficult on you in those last moments.

And that fallacy, that problem, that defect, shows up.

You find out that there was a corruption in your belief.

When you find out there's a corruption in your belief; you what do you do?

You give up your whole belief.

Because you discover there's something wrong with it; You think there's something wrong with Islam, and you would give up the whole thing, and you would lose it all.

Just like the computer, a problem happens with it nowadays; you throw the computer; you don't go and fix it.

So you can throw the whole thing; and you lose the whole battle.

And that's why, Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبنِ ألقَيِّم) says; We don't expect that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى would mislead anyone, who was on the straight path; except if that person had a hidden defect.

He said; We believe that, out of the Mercy of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; Allah would not mislead anyone, if that person was true righteous.

There must be something wrong, and that defect showed up in one moment of time.

Allah says; Say! Shall We tell you the greatest losers in respect to their deeds?

They are those, whom efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought they were acquiring good by their deeds.

Allah Is telling us about the biggest losers.

They are the ones who are thinking; they're doing well; but they're doing wrong.

You find that somebody is very righteous, very righteous; but he is doing it the wrong way.

He's not following the way of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

It's all unaccepted.

Second reason for Su'al Khatimah(سُوءَالْخَاتِمَه); Diversion from the straight path.

A person could be on the straight path, and then he decides to divert.

When he takes that short cut, or short turn, what happens is; it's like a fork.

It starts out with a small angle, but then it gets further and further and further away.

The turn in the beginning seems very small; the angle is very small.

But the further you go; the more further apart you become.

Iblees(اِبْلِيس); Ar-Rajeem(الرَّجِيْم); he was one of the righteous, but he did that small mistake.

He did that small mistake out of a great problem, which is Kibr(كبر); arrogance.

And he became the worst of the creation; Bal'aam(بلعام).

Allah says; And recite to them the story of him, to whom We gave our Ayaat(آيات), but he threw them away.

So Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) followed him up, and he became of those who went astray, and hell We built, We would surely Have elevated him therewith,

but he clung to the earth and followed his own vain desires.

This Ayah(آية) is talking about someone who received the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah, received the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah, and then he detached himself from the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah, and followed his own desires.

So Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) followed up, and he was misled and misguided.

Why?

Because he was clung and attached to this world.

Look at what this world could do.

This is a person who had the knowledge and had the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah; he lost it all and was misguided.

Why?

Because of his attachment to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), and why?

Because he followed his own desires.

Do not follow desires and do not follow this world.

Because that is contrary to the meaning of the word Islam.

Let's go back to the basics; Islam; what does it mean?

Submission to Allah.

You submit to Allah even if it's against to your own will; even if it's against your own desires.

You give up what you want, for the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We want to follow the religion according to our understandings, and according to our convenience, and to our spare time.

No! We do not custom make Islam to serve us.

We change ourselves to fit in Islam.

We do not make Islam change; we change our own characters to fit Islam.

Because this is the meaning of the world Islam; it is complete submission; submission to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

This man; he had the knowledge, and he had the Ayaat(آيات) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, he didn't do him, any good.

Because he was followed his own desires and he was mislead.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The thing that I fear most on you; is a man who memorizes Qur'an; until the light of Qur'an shows up on his face, and then he detaches himself from the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah,

and he carries the sword on his neighbour, and he accuses him of Shirk(شرك).

He accuses him, that he's a Mushrik(مشرك); a nonbeliever.

Hadifah bil Yaman(حديفه باليمان) said; Hadifah bil Yaman(حديفه باليمان) asked Rasool Allah ﷺ; Who is the Mushrik(مشرك) among them.

The accuser or the accused.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; The accuser.

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says that this is; Asna'd Jaiyid(اسناد جید).

This is a man who has Qur'an in his heart, and Qur'an is showing from his face; the light of Qur'an.

But then, he detached himself from Qur'an.

He fell into the Fitnah(فِتْنَه); a Fitnah(فِتْنَه); and he carried the sword on his neighbour; a Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

And he accuses his neighbour of Shirk(شرك).

So Rasool Allah ﷺ says that, this man; he has became a Mushrik(مشرك).

Qur'an is still in his heart; he became a Mushrik(مشرك).

In another story, and we'll close with this.

Barseesah(برسيسه); the story of Barseesah(برسيسه); this is a man from the children of Israel(اسرائيل), who was a worshipper; famous worshipper; Abid(عابد).

He had his temple, and he devoted himself to worship in his monastery.

Three men from the children of Israel(اسرائيل) wanted to go out for Jihad(جهاد); Al-Ghazwoo(الغزو).

They had a sister.

They didn't know where to leave their sister.

So they said; Where should we leave her, we can't leave her alone?

Where should we leave her?

They asked around; they said the best place to leave her is with that Abid(عابد); that worshiper.

He is the most righteous person; he is the most trustworthy; leave your sister with him; and he will take care of her.

They went to the Abid(عابد); the worshipper; Barseesah(برسيسه).

They told him; this is a situation; we want to go out for Ghazu(غزو), can you please take care of our sister?

He said; I seek refuge in Allah from you! Stay away from me.

Then Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to him and said; Who are you going to leave her with?

If you don't take care of her, an evil person may take care of her and then you know what will happen.

How come you going to leave this good slip out of your hands.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is encouraging him to do good.

So he called them back and said; Okay, I'll take care of her.

She's not going to stay with me in my monastery; she's going to stay in that home over there.

He had a house, he said; You stay there; I stay in my temple.

So she would stay in that house, in the room.

And he would carry the food for her and he would leave the food on his doorstep; he doesn't even want to go to her house.

He would leave it on the doorstep and she would have to come and pick up the food; He does not even want to see her.

And then, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to him and said; What are you doing?

Don't you know that when she walks out from her room and comes to your temple; people can see her.

You have to deliver the food to her doorstep.

He said, yes; that's true.

And Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is not speaking to him face to face, this is waswasa(وسوسه); inspirations.

He said, that's true.

He started taking that food, and he would drop it on her doorstep.

That continue for a while, and then Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) told him; She's still opening the door and coming out to take the plate, somebody can still see her.

You have to deliver the plate into her own room.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is telling him to do good things.

So he started taking the plate, and he would put it in the room, and then he would leave.

And that continued for a while, and these three brother were late.

This Ghazwa(غزوة) took a while.

So Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to him and said; You are going to leave her alone, with nobody to take care of her; nobody to speak with; she is been in there like, she is in prison; speaking to no one.

So why don't you take that responsibility, and go and speak with her, and just socialize a little bit to take care of her.

Because she could go out, and find another man, and start having a relation with him.

So he would speak from outside her room, and she would be speaking from in her room, and they would be screaming at each other to hear each other.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) told him; Why don't you make it a little bit convenient for yourself?

Instead of screaming and hollering at each other from far distances; why don't you go and sit in the same room?

So he started sitting with her in the same room, spending some time with her, and then slowly and slowly, they started spending hours together.

And they started getting closer and closer and closer until, the great Abid(عابد) committed Zina(زنا).

She became pregnant.

The story didn't end yet.

She became pregnant.

She delivered a child.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to him and said; What have you done?

Do you know what will happen when the brothers come back?

They're going to kill you.

And even if you say, this is not my son; they're going to say, Even if it's not your son, you're supposed to take care of her; it's your responsibility.

We don't care, who the father is.

We left her to you, You are the person responsible for her.

The only solution for this problem is that you kill; murder the child, and bury him.

Secret after he killed her son.

Do you think she will keep that secret?

You're a fool; if you think so.

What should I do?

You should kill her too.

So he killed her, and he buried them both in that room.

The brothers came back.

They came and said; Where is our sister?

He said; She became ill, and she died, and she is buried in that place.

And he went and showed them a fictitious grave.

So they said; They made Dua(دُعَا) for her, and they went home.

At night time, one of the brothers saw a dream.

Who came to him in that dream?

He told them; Did you believe Barseesah(برسيسه); did you believe him?

He's lying.

He committed Zina(زنا) with your sister, and then he killed her and her son.

And the evidence to prove that is that; she's not buried in the place he showed you; but she's buried in her room under the rock.

So he woke up, and he told his brothers about the dream.

They said; We saw the same dream.

It must be true.

They went the next day; they dug the fictitious grave; they found nothing.

They went into her room; they uncovered the earth; and they found their sister buried with an infant.

They grabbed Barseesah(برسيسه), and they told him; You're a liar.

This is what you have done and they took him to the king.

While they were dragging him to the king; Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to Barseesah(برسيسه).

But now Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ), didn't come in the form of inspiration.

He came in a human form.

He told him; Barseesah(برسيسه)! Do you know who I am?

I am Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ)! I am the one who caused you all of that mess, and I am the only one who can deliver you out of it.

I am the one who caused it, and I am the one who has the solution for it.

It's up to you; if you want to go and die; that's fine.

If you wants me to save you; I can.

Barseesah(برسيسه) said; Please save me.

He said; Make Sujood(سجود) for me.

Barseesah(برسيسه) make Sujood(سجود) for Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

What did Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) say?

He said; Thank you very much! It was a pleasure meeting you; and he never saw him again.

Barseesah(برسيسه) made Sujood(سجود) for Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

And that was the last thing he did in his life because shortly afterwards, he was executed.

The last thing he did in his life was Sujood(سجود) for Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

Abid(عابد) on the righteous path.

But because he chose to take a turn; even though it was a very, very, very small turn.

In the beginning, it was very insignificant in the name of Muslahah(مصلحة); in the name of the benefit.

In the name of Muslahah(مصلحة), he did it.

And it was a very small diversion that he took.

But look at, where it ended; look at the final destination.

That is the danger of following desire.

Because sometimes we feel confident because of our knowledge, and because of the Qur'an we know, and because of the Ibadah(عبادة) that we're doing.

Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله)! We should always be afraid on ourselves.

We should never be overconfident.

We should always be worried and that is the Khash'ya(خَشْية) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and that is the true knowledge.

The ones who have the Khash'ya(خَشْية) of Allah; the fear of Allah; are the scholars.

If you are scholar then you have Khash'ya(خَشْية) of Allah otherwise, it is just memorization of verses in the mind that has no meaning in the actual world.

A side note on this story; What policy was Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) using with Barseesah(برسيسه)?

If Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came to Barseesah(برسيسه) from the beginning and told him, make Sujood(سجود) to me; would Barseesah(برسيسه) have done that?

No he wouldn't.

He took the step by step policy.

Ibn Josie(ابن جوزى) says that, there was a man named, Abdul Ibn Abdul-Raheem(عبدل ابن عبدالرّحيم).

This was in year 280 or 270 Hijri.

Abdul Ibn Abdul-Raheem(عبدل ابن عبدالرّحيم); he was a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) with the Muslim armies that were fighting in the Roman Empire.

And he fought in Jihad(جهاد) for a long time.

And on one of their battles; actually, they were surrounding a Roman fortress.

They were surrounding them and while they were surrounding them; this man saw a woman.

It was a Fitnah(فِتْنَه) for him.

So he started corresponding with this woman.

This woman is a Roman woman in that city, the Muslims are surrounding them.

What he did is, he started corresponding with her.

And he asked her; How can I get in?

So she told him; Become a Christian, and I'll let you in.

So he became a Christian.

And the next day, suddenly the Muslim saw this man; this Mujahid(مُجَاهِد), he was with them; he's inside with the Romans.

This thing depressed them a lot.

Because this man has fought in Jihad(جهاد) for very long time, and he knew a lot of Qur'an, and he had a lot of knowledge.

And suddenly, now here, he gave up his religion, and he became a Christian to run after that woman.

Ten years passed, and some Muslims who knew that man, they passed next to that Roman village or Fort again.

So they saw him.

And they told him; come with us.

He said; No, I cannot come with you, that's it; I'm settled here.

I'm married, and I have children, and I have business.

I'm already settled here.

He gave up his religion; He was a Christian now, hanging the cross.

So they told him; Where did your Jihad(جهاد) go?

What happened to your Jihad(جهاد)?

What happened to your knowledge; What happened to your Qur'an?

He said; Oh! I forgot all of that.

I forgot all of Qur'an except one verse.

He said; I have forgot all of Qur'an except one verse, where Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; One day the non believers will desire that they were believers.

So let them eat and enjoy themselves, and let them follow the false hopes and desires; but soon they will know.

He forgot all the Qur'an except this.

He remembers a verse that is telling him that, one day the non believers will desire and wish that they were Muslim.

Let them eat and let them enjoy themselves.

One day, they will know.

Let the false desires fool them.

But one day, they will realize the truth.

When you diverge; when you diverge from the straight path, this is what happens.

This man; he was a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد), and he knew Qur'an, and he memorized a lot of Ayaat(آيات), and he has a lot of knowledge; but he didn't stick to the straight path.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tells Rasool Allah ﷺ; After you received the guidance; follow the straight path.

And one of the companions came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and told him; Give me an advice.

Oh Rasool Allah ﷺ! Give me the best advice.

Give me an advice that I would not have to ask anybody else for another advice.

I want you to give me one advice that will be sufficient for me.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Say; I believe in Allah, and then stay on the straight path.

Because we can say, we believe; we can say that, we're Muslims, but the important thing is to stay on the straight path.

That's where the test is, and that's where a lot of people fail.

They followed the truth for a while; but then the winds of change in this world take them from right to left.

And this is the ending that happened to him.

Why?

He missed As-Sabat(اثّبات); As-Sabat al-Haqq(اثّبات الحَقّ); staying on the straight path.

You slip and you don't know how deep that cliff is.

That is the Khash'ya(خَشْية) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; you know the truth, and you are so worried, that you're asking Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in Salah(صلوة) 17 times; in Salah(صلوۃ)

Oh Allah! We seek assistance from You, and we worship nobody except You; so guide us to the straight path.

We keep on asking Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in the fareeza(فريضه) seventeen, times, to keep us on the straight path.

And then in the Nawafil(نَوَافِلْ) we read Al-Fatihah(اَلْفَاتِحه), why are we repeating this Ayah(آية) again and again; Because, it's very important to stay on the straight path.

The third reason of evil ending; evil conclusion of one's life; Su'al Khatimah(سُوءَالْخَاتِمَه) is; Insistence on sining.

A person might be committing a small sin, but the Ulama(عُلَمَا) say; that insisting on a small sin makes it a major sin.

When you keep on doing it again and again; it becomes a major sin.

And Adh-Dhahabi(الذهبى); in his book, Al-Kabair(الكبائر); he talks about some of the evil endings.

He said; There was a man who used to be obsessed with chess.

When he was dying; They told him, say; He couldn't say it.

And then, just before he died; he kept on repeating checkmate, checkmate, checkmate, until he died.

Because he was thinking about chess.

Adh-Dhahabi(الذهبى) mentions another man; they came and told him; say; He said; Give me the bottle, give me a cup; I want to drink; Khamr(خمر) alcohol!

Because he was addicted to alcohol; That is the thought that came on his mind in the last moment.

Ar-Rabi'ah bin Saburah(الرّبيعه بن صبوره); he says that, he witnessed the death of a man, who used to work in Ad-Deewan(الدّيوان); an accountant; he's always calculating numbers.

And before he died; they were telling him; say, He would say; 10, 11, 12, and he was counting numbers until he died.

Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبنِ ألقَيِّم) mentions a story of someone who was dying; they told him say; He said; I can't!

He didn't have a problem with his tongue; he could speak fluently, but he could not say; Allah did not give him the Tawfeeq(توفيق); Allah did not allow him to say it.

Because, he did not have a life record of, Think about it, this way.

Think about Sakrat-ul-Maut(سَكْرَاةُالْمَوت) in this way.

When you go to bed; what are the things you dream about?

Most likely, they're going to be things, you are thinking about consistently during the day.

When you keep on thinking about something; there's a big chance that you could see that thing or dream about it at night.

Also another way to know what's on your mind, is when you wake up in the morning.

As soon as you wake up; what is the first thought that pops up in your mind?

Because death is similar to sleep.

Sleeping is called; The minor death.

So when you're going from sleep to the state of awakening; it is similar to that stage of Sakrat-ul-Maut(سَكْرَاةُالْمَوت).

So that's why, the thoughts that are on one's mind are most likely going to show up in the last moments of one's life.

We always think about it that; I'm going to do whatever I want, I'm going to sin the way I like, and then before I die; five minutes before I die; I'm going to say;

And I'm guaranteed Jannah(جنة).

It's not that easy.

You are making a plan; you are plotting against Allah.

This is a plot against Allah.

When you say this; you are plotting against Allah.

Why?

Because you're telling Allah; I'm not going to worship You.

You are making the intention that you're not going to worship Allah, until the last moment of your life.

What is that?

Isn't that planning against Allah.

I'm going to do what I want now when I'm young; and then I'm going to think about Tawbah(توبة) when I grow old.

You are planning against Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allah is telling you worship me every day and night in your life.

You say; No!

I'm going to try to go around this rule, and sneak around it, and then make Tawbah(توبة) in the end.

I'm going to outsmart Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

They are plotting in Allah's planning; and Allah Is The Best of Planners.

There's one scholar; just a few weeks ago, he mentioned to us a factual story that happened.

They were visiting an old man who was dying.

They came in the house, and when they came in the household; all of the household; they were listening to loud, Umme Kulthum(امّ كلثوم) music.

Umme Kulthum(امّ كلثوم) is an Arabic singer.

The man was in the last moments of his life; and the tape recorder was to the highest volume; listening to the songs of Umme Kulthum(امّ كلثوم).

This Shaikh(شيخ) came in and told them; Fear Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; the man is dying, and you're listening to songs.

So they took out that tape, and they put Qur'an instead.

When the old man started hearing Qur'an, he said; turn it off and put Umme Kulthum(امّ كلثوم) back; because she soothes my heart, and he died.

When you grow up on something, you're going to die on that thing.

If you grow up doing something most likely, the conclusion of your life will be on that thing you were doing.

Never think that you can outsmart Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

You have to have Khash'ya(خَشْية) of Allah.

The ones who are safe; feel safe and secure of the punishment of Allah are the losers.

Only, the losers are the ones who feel secure from the punishment of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Khash'ya(خَشْية) is an integral quality of the Muslim.

To be a Mo'min(مؤمن) and a believer; you have to have Khash'ya(خَشْية); fear of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in your heart.

The fourth reason of evil endings is; Za'aful Eeman(ضعف الايمان); weak faith; weak Eeman(ايمان).

Sulayman Ibn Abdul Malik(سليمان ابن عبدالملك); Al-Khalifah Al-Amvi(الخليفة الأموي); the Khalifah of the Muslim world.

He visited Makkah(مكه) and Madinah(مَدِينَه).

So he was asking; Is there anyone here, who has met the companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ?

They said; Yes, Abu Hazim(ابو حازم).

He said; Call him.

So they brought Abu Hazim(ابو حازم).

Sulayman Ibn Abdul Malik(سليمان ابن عبدالملك) asked him a question.

He said; How come we dislike death?

How come we don't want to die?

He said; He said; Because you have built and established this world, and you have destroyed your Akhirah(آخرة), so you hate to go from what is established to what is destroyed.

You have built for yourself a good life in this world.

You have established for yourself a good, pleasurable, pleasant life in this world.

And you have destroyed your hereafter.

You didn't do anything for it; You left it; Destroyed.

You didn't build anything.

So you don't want to go from what you have established to what you have destroyed.

Natural consequence.

If you're not preparing for Akhirah(آخرة), why would you want to go there?

This is due to Za'aful Eeman(ضعف الايمان) and what is the cause of Za'aful Eeman(ضعف الايمان)?

It is the love of this world; the love of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

When we love this world; we do not want to go to Akhirah(آخرة).

And the love of this world could cause a very, very destructive and dangerous thing in the end of your life.

The scholars have said; If somebody has the love of this world in his heart; then just before that person's death; when the person starts realizing that he's going to leave the lovable Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and go to Akhirah(آخرة);

the person would become attached to the thing he loves.

He would become attached to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), and then that person could start hating Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; because Allah Is The One Who wants to take him away from Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

The Ulema(علماء) say, that can happen to the person in the end of his life.

And they say, if that happens; this is Khulud Fin-Nar(خُلُود فِالنَّار).

This is a eternal punishment in hellfire.

Because you are hating to meet Allah; you dislike meeting Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, so Allah will dislike meeting you.

Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذاِبن جبل); when he was passing away, he said; Welcome to death! I've been waiting for you for a long time.

I've been waiting for the Promise of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to me.

Welcome to death! He's happy.

And then he said; Oh Death! Don't think that I ever wanted to live in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), because of the love of this world.

The reason why I wanted to live in this world; is to fast in the hot summer days, and to pray at night in the long cold winter nights.

So as long as now it's time for me to leave; I welcome you.

Take my soul.

He wants to meet Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; so Allah would want to meet him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in the Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al Bukhari(البخاريْ); Rasool Allah ﷺ says in the Hadith(حديث) narrated by Bukhari(بخاريْ);

Every prophet, before he dies is shown his place in Paradise, and then he's given the choice to stay in this world or to die.

So the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) are given the choice.

This Hadith(حديث) is narrated by Ayesha(عائشه).

She says; Rasool Allah ﷺ has said that every prophet before he passes away; he is shown his place in Paradise, and then he is given the choice to die or to live.

And when Rasool Allah ﷺ was dying; he had his head on my lap.

And then he fell unconscious, and then he woke up, and he started staring at the sky, and then he said; Oh Allah! The highest companion, Oh Allah! The highest companion.

Meaning I want to be with the highest companion, which is who?

Ayesha(عائشه) said; I knew that Rasool Allah ﷺ that moment, was being given the choice, and that he was not choosing us.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was saying; Oh Allah! the highest companion.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ was given the offer by the angel of death; he was asking him; Do you want to stay, or do you want to leave?

Rasool Allah ﷺ was saying; I want to be with Allah.

Ayesha(عائشه) said; I knew that he's not choosing us.

And that was the last word Rasool Allah ﷺ said.
parts.urdu:
وٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم حینا منامکم قل ھل ننبِّئُكُم بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسلیما کثیرا
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ اَلْوَفَاةُ الصُّغْرَى لَا بَعَدْ، لَا بَعَدْ

Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) said; إن الشيطان قائم بحذائي عاضٌّ على أنامله يقول: يا أحمد فتّني، يا أحمد فتّني، فكنت أقول له: لا بعد، لا بعد، حتى أموت

Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) said; Imam Ibn Taymiyah(امام اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه); Shaikh-al-Islam(شيخ الاسلام), Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه); he says;

اللهم إنا نعوذ بك من فتنة المحيا والممات من مات على شيء بعث عليه لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ من مات على شيء بعث عليه اللهمَّ اجعل خير أعمال خواتمها

يعمل احدكم بعمل الجنة حتى لا يكون بينها وبين الجنت ذراع، فيسبق عليه الكتاب، فيعمل بعمل أهل النار فيدخل النار نسأل الله عزوجل حسن الختام الفساد في الاعتقاد

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; الَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُوننَ صُنْعًا۝

العدول عن الاستقامة Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي آتَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا فَانسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَانسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ۝

وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ ۚ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِن تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَث ۚ

ذَّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا ۚ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ۝

أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ ۚ قَال صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ:إِنَّ مِمَّا أَتَخَوَّفُ عَلَيْكُمْ رَجُلٌ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ حَتَّى إِذَا رُئِيَتْ بَهْجَتُهُ  عَلَى وَجْهِه

وَعَلَيْهِ رِدْءًا لِلإِسْلامِ اِعْتَرَاهُ إِلَى مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، انْسَلَخَ مِنْهُ , وَنَبَذَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ , وَخَرَجَ عَلَى جَارِهِ بِالسَّيْفِ وَرَمَاهُ بِالشِّرْكِ

يا رسول الله، أيهما أولى بالشرك، المرمي أم الرامي؟

فقَال صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: بل الرامي اَعُوْذُ بِالله مِنْكُمْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ۝

إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ۝

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ فَفْتُتِنَا بِهَا رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ۝

ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْففَ يَعْلَمُونَ۝

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ۝

وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ ۖ فَاسْتَقِمْ فَاسْتَقِمْ قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ، ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ۝ ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ۝

ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ۝

الإصرار على المعاصي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

at being truly upright upon the religion of Islam, as Prophetﷺ told us.

Brother, why don't you distribute the materials you presented and help us to confront their ways by another lecture or a series of lectures?

Okay, as a versus this distribution of the material, my personal feeling is that I don't like to see this material distributed to a large body of Muslims

because it does can contain Shubhaat(شبہات) or things which might confuse the average Muslim.

And so therefore this should not be put in the hands of the Muslims.

As far as a series of lectures, one of the purposes behind this lecture is that I'm, we're working this year.

We usually have a yearly project that myself and brother “Idrees” tried to do.

And one of the yearly project this year is to try to least add something to the Islamic library regarding missionary work.

And the idea is to have a book in the English language which people can use in non Arabic speaking countries.

Because when we were in China last year on Beijing, China for the United Nations Conference on Women, we noticed that a lot of Muslim groups from the non Arab speaking world came to us and complained concerning missionary activity, that's really what started this issue.

And so therefore, but however, they do not have resources.

So the idea now is that we're hoping to gather some material which is very prevalent in Arabic language, translate it, organize it in a way which we feel which will be useful for people, and then give it to whoever wants to distribute it

and publish it in the Islamic world, so that Muslims who are incharge of organizations or incharge of Masajid(مساجد), and do not speak Arabic will have at least some resources to help them counter this missionary effort

and also to raise public awareness, as we've done this evening, or at least as we hope we do get this evening in all of this best.

Which site?

ﷺhich site on the internet can use to find the information.

The site is “http://www.aims.org” and I can write it down for the brothers here in Muntadha and whoever wants to get it from them afterwards can just copy it down.

Question number four is my aunt, who is a missionary traveling back and forth to Gambia and has adopted 105 Muslim children over the past five years in Gambia.

And it is part of the organization.

The organization stated to me that if Islam is so great, why don't we have missionaries like they do, giving practical help to the people.

I did not have an answer.

I mean, what can we do in terms of this thing?

It's a sadness that brings this, but it's a part of our division.

And also this is a punishment from Allahسبحانه وتعالى, due to our sinfulness.

When people are sinful, Allah punishes them, and one of the ways Allah punishes people is by not allowing them to worship Him, because that increases them in sin.

And as I said, by the Salaf(سلف) that a sin leads to another sin, and we can see the situation.

Okay, the brother says, Sheikh, the little booklet that you have showed about the moon guy has already reached East London.

So please remind the Muslims that Evangelization is not just in America, but it also happening here.

Yes, it's also, I'm sure was happens here.

And it's upon the Muslims of this city to see how they can see what type of arguments they are using to convince, or to try to convince Londoners, or British Muslims,

or Muslims living in the United Kingdom to become Christians.

One of the arguments they use.

The same way, it is responsibility of us in the United States to counter that in the United States, and I hope so سبحانه وتعالى to assist us all in that task.

Concerning Dawah to the Kafir(کافر), since most translations of Qur'an have in Arabic as well as in English, is it okay to give a Kafir(کافر) the Qur'an containing the Arabic?

It is merely Fiqh(فقہ) point of view, the majority of scholars say it is permissible, given that the content, the English content, is greater than the Arabic content,

so therefore they consider it like a book of Tafseer(تفسیر) or so forth.

However, though my personal feeling is that whenever we can avoid that it should be real that Christians or at least I know, in fact, the Westerners in America do strange things, like, for instance, sit on the toilet and read,

and they also sometimes will not respect our book.

And there have been incidents where we know people become Muslim because they have found, for instance, Qurans in the trash cans so forth.

And they just would take it home, and then, you know, they would read, and that was a cause for them to become Muslims.

So I always suggest that the people need to produce Qur'ans in a merely English text, without the Arabic there, in order that this can be distributed and then if a Kafir(کافر) does, throws it away or defiles it, it causes no sin engaged to us,

although I mean from just the mere point most of scholars have permitted the distribution of these Qur'an to the non Muslims.

Okay, these are going to be the last two.

Would it be possible to get a copy of the Christian statistics?

Yes, I'll leave a copy or, like one of the brothers here to photocopy, and then whoever can take it from Muntadhar Missionaries are going to schools and telling Muslim children, we will give you good houses and monies.

Can you leave your families; The school is here.

So parents should be aware of this. And I think that whoever is aware of this information should perhaps give a lecture in the conference or in the Masjid to make people aware.

I've also been asked to announce this announcement for the sake of the brothers and sisters here that Muntadah Islamic Second Annual Conference, Thoughts on Dawah(دعوۃ) Sixth and 7th of April, 1996

which I guess is next weekend.

We have “Sheikh Abu Ameenah Bilal Phillips” and “Sheikh Hashim Refai” and accommodation, meals are available.

Fees 15 pounds only meals and accommodation required.

Please bring your sleeping bag. Brothers and Sisters are welcome free crocheting, I have no idea what means the word crochet for children, and registration starts at 10 am Saturday, 6th of April,

and you can contact me later for details.

As I thank the brothers and sisters for patiently listening to us and though trouble with the sound of the audio.

parts.english:
As we all have heard، the topic which will be discussed tonight, is a topic which is from the center of our beliefs.

It is a topic rooted in the Qur'an Allah's final revelation.

It is a topic that begins with the beginning of revelation to Allah's Prophet, Ibrahim عليه السلام and continues until the day of judgment with the return of the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام,

passing through the Qur'an and the Sunnah(سنۃ) and the Seerah(سیرۃ) of our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

It is a topic which cannot be separated from our testimony of faith.

There is none worthy of worship but Allah and Muhammad ﷺ is the Messenger of Allah.

It is a topic which is part of the cancer which the Muslims suffer from today.

And it is a topic which, unless we find a cure for it, we will not find a cure for other ills that we suffer from.

The topic is great indeed.

The topic deserves a whole conference, not just merely a lecture, and the topic deserves people of knowledge and honor to discuss it.

However we ask Allah عزوجل to assist us, in order that we may perhaps convey to our brothers and sisters some knowledge regarding this topic,

even though we ourselves are not from those, who deserve to discuss a topic of this importance.

In order to understand the situation in Palestine, one must begin with the matter of our faith, the essence of our belief, Tawheed(توحيد).

For as we all know Allah عزوجل has created us for a noble purpose.

Allah has created humanity and every single human being, indeed the jinns, for a great reason.

I have not created jinns nor human beings but to worship Me.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى has sent His Messengers as ones giving glad tidings and warning for this purpose, And We have sent to every single people a messenger, ordering that messenger to preach worship Allah alone and avoid the worship of a Tagoot(طاغوت),

all that is worshiped besides Allah.

And indeed Allah's revelation is centered upon this principle.

Throughout the Qur'an, we find the command to worship Allah and to avoid the worship of others.

And worship Allah alone and avoid the worship of others with Him.

And your Lord has decreed that you worship, only but Him; and so forth and so on.

And in the Sunnah(سنۃ) likewise, we find that our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ stressing this principle over and over.

One day his companion Muaaz bin Jabal رضي الله عنه is riding behind him on a donkey and the Prophet ﷺ says, O Muaaz(معاذ)! Do you know, when Allah's right is upon the creation?

Muaaz(معاذ) says Allah and His Messenger know best.

The Prophet ﷺ responds that His right meaning, Allah is right upon His creation is that His creation worship Him alone and does not associate anything with Him.

And then the Prophet ﷺ asked Muaaz(معاذ), and do you know what is the creations right upon Allah if they do that?

Muaaz(معاذ) replies Allah and His Messenger knows best.

The Prophet ﷺ says; Their right upon Allah that Allah will not punish them, if they do that.

This message of Tawheed(توحيد) for which We have been created, for which Allah سبحانه وتعالى has sent His messengers, for which Allah has sent down His scriptures,

and upon which Allah will judge every human being on the Day of Judgment, is the issue of Palestine.

It is an issue of Tawheed(توحيد) and Shirk(شرک).

It is an issue of Eeman(ایمان) and Kufr(کفر).

It is not an issue of nationalism or one race against another race, or one political philosophy against another political philosophy, but it is an issue of truth and falsehood.

It is an issue that begins with the father of the prophets, humanity's third father, the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام continuing to our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and concluding with the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام.

And in order to understand this issue, we must understand one aspect of Tawheed(توحيد); and that is that Allah سبحانه وتعالى, like He is the creator, He also is the One, Who selects.

Allahسبحانه وتعالى in Surat-Ul-Qasas(سورۃ القصص) says; And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses, they have no choice in the matter.

Glory be to Allah and exalted from that which they associate unto Him.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى, as He is the Creator, He is also the One, Who chooses and selects from His creation.

He has selected from His creation that the angels live in the heavens above, and from the angels, He has selected Jibrail(جبرائیل) and Mikail(میکائیل) and Israfil علیہم السلام.

He has selected from the creatures, on those who are upon earth human beings, and Has selected from the human beings, the prophets.

And selected from the prophets the messengers, and selected from the messengers, those five messengers of resolute determination.

the prophets Noah عليه السلام and Ibrahim عليه السلام and Musa عليه السلام and Eesa Ibn-E-Maryam عليه السلام and our Prophet, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

And from those five messengers, He has chosen His two Khalil(خلیل)s, Ibrahim(ابراھیم) and Muhammad صلی اللہ علیہما وسلمہ.

And likewise from humanity, indeed, from everything He has chosen the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and selected him to be the master of all human beings, the leader of all humanity,

as the Prophet ﷺ has said; I am the master or the best of the children of Adam(آدم) and I say this not, out of a statement of boast.

Likewise Allah سبحانه وتعالى choses certain times.

In the week he has chosen the day of Al Jumua(جمعہ) as a day, when which we worship Him and remember His creation.

For Allah سبحانه وتعالى created the heavens and the earth in six days, the final day being the day of Jumuaa(جمعہ) And it is the day in which He has created Adam, and it is the day in which the Day of Judgment will occur.

So Allah has selected this day as the day of our weekly worship.

And likewise, He has chosen amongst the months, four months that are holy months, Muharram(محرم) and Rajab(رجب) and Zul Qada(ذوالقعدہ) and Zul Hijja(ذوالحجہ).

And He has also chosen amongst the months Ramadan(رمضان) as the month in which we fast and in the month which we worship Him, and in the month which He revealed the Qur'an.

And among nights, He chose Lelat-Ul-Qadar(لیلۃ القدر).

And likewise Allah سبحانه وتعالى has chosen places.

He has selected places in which He has honored and has set up for His worship alone.

He chose the lands of Mecca, and in Mecca, He chose a certain Valley in which His house was erected for His worship, the Ka’aba(کعبہ).

And He chose the lands of Medina.

And in Medina, He chose a certain part between its two valleys, in which the Prophet's Masjid was erected صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم.

And likewise, He chose the lands of Ash-Sham(الشام), the lands of Syria.

And from there, He chose specifically a certain city Bait-Al Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And from there He chose a certain hill, upon which Allah decreed that another Masjid(مسجد) be built, Masjid-Al-Aqsa(اقصی).

This is part of Tawheed(توحيد).

And this is why Allah سبحانه وتعالى made it part of our religion that one cannot set out in a journey for worship, except to these three Masajid(مساجد).

And the prayers in these Masajid(مساجد) are multiplied in terms of its reward, and there are certain etiquettes and certain rewards that are connected with these three Masajid(مساجد),

which are not connected with any other place on earth.

And so therefore, to separate Masjid-Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصی) from Mecca and Medina, it is as if to separate part of Islam from another part.

We are an Ummah(امۃ) of Tawheed(توحيد).

We are an Ummah(امۃ) which follows the prophets.

Do you not see that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, when he found the Jews fasting the day of Ashura (عاشورہ), he inquired what day is this?

They said, this is a noble day in which Allah سبحانه وتعالى rescued Moses from Pharaoh.

What did the Prophet ﷺ said; We are more deserving of Moses then them.

And likewise, Allah in the Qur'an has informed us, that the Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام was neither a Jew nor a Christian, nor from the pagans, but he ever, he was a Muslim, a Hanif(حنیف),

and he was not from the pagans worshiping Allah alone.

And Allah tells us that the one, who is closest to Ibrahim عليه السلام were his immediate followers, and this prophet and the believers, meaning the Ummah of Muhammad ﷺ.

And do you not see, how Eesa عليه السلام, when he returns at the end of time, he returns as a Messenger, but judging by the Qur'an and the Sunnah, not with a new Sharia(شریعہ),

not ruling by the law, which was sent down to him, of the Injeel(انجیل) or of the Torah(توراۃ), but rather, as the Prophet ﷺ said؛ As a just ruler in this Ummah(امۃ).

So the Ummah(امۃ) of Muhammad ﷺ, we are the believers in all the revelation of Allah, and we are the believers in all the prophets of Allah.

And so therefore to separate parts of the places, which Allah has honored through some of his prophets، is as if we were to believe in part of the message and disbelieve in part of the message,

or believe in some of the messengers and disbelieve in the others of the messengers.

Baitul Maqdas, is connected to Mecca and Medina and can never be separated from it.

And the evidences upon this from the Quran and the Sunnah(سنۃ) are very many, and likewise from history.

And what we will do in the next few moments is review some of those evidences.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى in the Quran in five passages informs us that these lands of Ash-Sham(الشام), these lands of Syria and Lebanon and Palestine and Jordan, are lands in which Allah سبحانه وتعالى has blessed.

And in the passage which I think most of us are most familiar with, in where Allah سبحانه وتعالى opens up, starts Surat-Ul-Isra(سورۃ الاسراء), Allah سبحانه وتعالى says;

Glory be to Allah, Who took His servant meaning the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, during a night journey from Masjid-Al-Haram from Mecca to Masjid-Al-Aqsa(مسجدالاقصی),

regarding which we have blessed the surrounding lands.

and the connection; there is also a deep lesson in this.

Not only is Allah سبحانه وتعالى teaching us, or telling us an event of the Prophet ﷺ life, but as Shaykh Ul Islam Ibn Taymiyah(شَيْخُ الإِسْلَام اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّة) has said;

This also tells us the history of the Ummah(امۃ) in this, there is a deeper meaning.

For just like the message of Islam began in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, in Mecca, it will come at the end of time and be in Jerusalem.

And just like the beginning of the Ummah(امۃ), just like Mecca is more preferred and beloved to Allah عزوجل than Jerusalem, likewise the first of the Ummah(امۃ), meaning the Prophet ﷺ, his companions are better than those, who will be at the end of time, even though they will be with the Prophet Eesa عليه السلام.

And indeed in the Prophet Sunnah(سنۃ), we find many narrations in which the Prophet ﷺ has stressed the importance of Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

For example we find that the Prophet ﷺ has said in one Hadith(حدیث).

The Hadith(حدیث) of Memoona(میمونہ), the freed slave woman of the Prophet ﷺ.

This is reported by Imam Ahmed(امام احمد); She says; Oh Messenger of Allah, give us a Fatwa(فتوی); give us an answer regarding Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

So even though Sahabah(صحابہ) used to question the Prophet ﷺ regarding Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس)'s importance.

What did the Prophet ﷺ say, as reported by Imam Ahmad (امام احمد) in the Musnad(مسند) , he says; It is the land where the people will be gathered, and the land of the resurrection.

And then the Prophet ﷺ has said, come to it and pray there.

For a prayer, there is like a thousand prayers anywhere else, and the meaning is anywhere else, outside of Mecca, Masjid Haram(مسجد الحرام), and Masjid Nabawi(مسجد النبوی) in Madina,

and then Memoona(میمونہ) said, and if I cannot reach Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس), what should I do?

The Prophet ﷺ said, then give as an offering some oil by which you might light the Masjid(مسجد).

In other words, in the old days, before the advent of electricity, they would take oil and they would burn torches in order to give light in the Masajid(مساجد).

So here the Prophet ﷺ says to Memoona(میمونہ), if you cannot reach Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس), then send some oil there, in order to beautify that house of Allah عزوجل, so the people may pray there.

The people may recite the Qur'an there.

The people may do other acts of worship there.

And then the Prophet ﷺ said; whoever does such, it is like the person, who has gone there and prayed.

And in another Hadith (حدیث) of the Prophet ﷺ; The Prophet ﷺ was asked by Abu Zarr(ابوذر) what was the first Masjid(مسجد) built on earth.?

The Prophet ﷺ says, Masjid Al Haram(مسجدالحرام).

And the Hadith(حدیث) is in Bukhari(بخاری).

And then Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, Then which Masjid(مسجد)?

The Prophet ﷺ says, Masjid Al Aqsa(مسجدالاقصی) and there was fourty years between the two.

And likewise, the Prophet ﷺ teaches us another Hadith (حدیث) reported by Muslim(المسلم) upon his companion, Anas(انس).

The Prophet ﷺ says that the Buraaq(براق) which was the beast, which he rode for his Meraaj(معراج), was brought to him, and he rode it to Bait-Al-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And so then he tied the Buraaq(براق) to the ring in which the prophets would tie their animal, their horses and camels too.

And he entered into the Masjid(مسجد), and he prayed in their two Rakaats(رکعۃ), and then was raised to the heavens.

And indeed the Prophet ﷺ when he prayed in their two Rakaats(رکعۃ), he prayed with leading all the prophets of Allah, as the prophet ﷺ tells us in other Hadith (حدیث).

The Prophet ﷺ into another narration reported by Imam Ahmed(امام احمد); one of his companions by the name of  Zil Assabe(ذلاسابع), or Zul Assabe(ذولاسابع) asked the Prophet ﷺ says;

If we are tested, in other words, if we face a disaster, to live after you, then what do you order us? What do you command us?

In other words, the Prophet's companions knew that to live after the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, was a disaster, not to be in His presence.

What should we do if we're to live after you?

The Prophet ﷺ says, it is upon you to go to the house of worship, the Masjid Al Aqsa(مسجد الاقصی) in Jerusalem, and he says, For perhaps you might, will be given children who will then go there in morning and evening worshiping Allah there.

Indeed the Prophet ﷺ said; In another Hadith(حدیث), he asked Abu Zarr(ابوذر), he says to Abu Zarr(ابوذر) , he says, Oh Abu Zarr(ابوذر), what should you do if you are forced to leave Madina?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, If I am forced to leave Madina, I will only leave Madina and I will go to Mecca, and I will be like the pigeons of Mecca,

meaning I will stick as a pigeon of Mecca always there in Masjid Al Haram(مسجد الحرام), I will be there.

So the Prophet ﷺ says to Abu Zarr(ابوذر); And what will you do if you're forced to leave Mecca?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) said; I will then go to Ash-Sham(الشام) and to Bait-Ul-Maqdas(بیت المقدس).

And the Prophet ﷺ then asked Abu Zarr(ابوذر), what will you do if you're forced to leave Ash-Sham(الشام) and Bait-Ul-Maqdas(بیت المقدس)?

Abu Zarr(ابوذر) says, I will then put my sword on my shoulder, meaning I will go and wage Jihad(جہاد) wherever it takes me in the world.

And another Hadith(حدیث) of the Prophet ﷺ, Abdullah Bin Amr Bin Al-Aas(عبداللہ بن عمرو بن العاص) tells us the Prophet ﷺ Says; There will be a Hijra(ھجرۃ) following a Hijra(ھجرۃ),

meaning that this Ummah(امۃ) will have Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijrah(ھجرۃ), leaving the lands of the unbelievers، until going to the lands of Islam, just like they left Mecca; the Prophet ﷺ his companions and went to Madina.

This is something which will continue, Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ) after Hijra(ھجرۃ), until the people finally make Hijra(ھجرۃ) to the place that Ibrahim make Hijra(ھجرۃ)

meaning the land of Palestine, meaning the city of Jerusalem and the local areas thereabouts.

In another Hadith(حدیث), the Prophet ﷺ puts his hand upon his companion, Ibn Hawal Al Azdi(ابن حوال الازدی), the Prophet ﷺ puts his hand on his head or on his forehead and says, Ibne Hawala (ابن حوالہ),

O son of Hawala(حوالہ), if you see the Khilafah(خلافہ) set up in Jerusalem, then know the days of earthquakes and tribulations and great matters have come, and Hour will be closer to you, than my hand is to your head.

And likewise, the Prophet ﷺ we know from his Seerah(سیرۃ) that while in he was Mecca, he used to face Bait-Ul- Maqdas(بیت المقدس) in prayer.

And then after he made Hijra(ھجرۃ) for 16 months, as Ibn Abbas (ابن عباس) tells us, he would face Bait-Ul- Maqdas(بیت المقدس) in prayer until the command came to him to face Mecca, the Ka'aba(کعبہ).

So the position of Palestine and these lands in the Qur'an and the Sunnah(سنۃ) cannot be denied.

منہاج النبوۃ معرِکَتنُا مع یہود سُبْحَانَکَ اللّٰھُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِکَ اَشْھَدُ اَنْ لَّآ اِلٰہَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ اَسْتَغْفِرُکَ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَیْکَ

جَزَاكُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، السلام علیکم
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدَ لِلّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَتُوْبُ اِلَيْه، وَنَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا،

مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلاَ مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلاَ هَادِىَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ،

وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ صَل اللهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلى أله وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلّمَ وَبَعْد لا اله الا الله محمد الرسول الله وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْاِنْسَ اِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُوْنِ۝

وَ لَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِیْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوْلًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَۚ وَعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ لَا تُشْرِكُوْا بِهٖ شَیْــٴًـا وَ قَضٰى رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِیَّاهُ

As Allah سبحانه وتعالى says, وَ رَبُّكَ یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ وَ یَخْتَارُؕ-مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِیَرَةُؕ-سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ۝

اُولُوا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ أنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ وَلَا فَخْرَ سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِیْۤ اَسْرٰى بِعَبْدِهٖ لَیْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَا الَّذِیْ بٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهٗ

ارض المحشر والمنشر وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ لُوْطًا یٰقَوْمِ ادْخُلُوا الْاَرْضَ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ الَّتِیْ كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْ فَاذْهَبْ اَنْتَ وَ رَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَاۤ

فَاِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَیْهِمْ اَرْبَعِیْنَ سَنَةًۚ یَتِیْهُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِؕ قُوْلُوْا حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ حِطَّةٌ حِنطَّةٌ حِنطَّةٌ

رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ وَهَبْ لِیْ مُلْكًا لَّا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِیْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ۝

اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِیْ بَطْنِیْ مُحَرَّرً نعم وَ التِّیْنِ وَ الزَّیْتُوْنِ ۝ وَ طُوْرِ سِیْنِیْنَ ۝ وَ هٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْاَمِیْنِ۝

وَطُوْرِ سِیْنِیْنَ۝

وَ هٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْاَمِیْن۝

فِیْ بُیُوْتٍ اَذِنَ اللّٰهُ اَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَ یُذْكَرَ فِیْهَا اسْمُهٗۙ فدولۃ الظلم ساعۃ ودولۃ عدل القیامۃ ساعۃ یا بلال قم فازن لا اله الا الله محمد الرسول الله

أقول قولي هذا واستغفر الله لي ولكم
