Do you want me to make this oath more than 10 times.

That going out in the Ghazoo(غزؤ) is mandatory on you.

Tayeb(طيِّب) now, is Jihad(جهاد) Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية) or Fardh Ain(فرض عين).

Now I'll read what Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: Realize that attacking the non believers in their territories is a collective duty.

So now we're talking about attacking them in their land.

Collective duty is Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية), I am translating Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية) as collective duty.

Collective duty or Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية) is something that is.... as long as some of the Ummah(امة) are doing it.

Then that relieves the others from the responsibility.

Fardh Ain(فرض عين) is something that everybody has to do.

If I pray, I don't relief you from the responsibility of praying.

For the Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية) for example, Yani(يعني) Al-Ghazali(ألغزالي) says: If there's a Muslim village and there's no physician in that village,

then it's Fardh(فرض) for at least one of them, to fulfill that post.

If they don't, then everybody's committing a sin.

But if they do appoint a physician, then everyone else is relieved, not everybody has to be a doctor, as long as somebody is doing it, that’s enough.

So it's the difference between Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية) and Fardh Ain(فرض عين).

So he says that attacking them in the territory is Fardh Kifaya(فرض كِفاية),  with the consensus of the scholars.

However, Ibn Ul-Musayib(إبن المسَّيب) and Ibn-e-Shuburma(إبن شبرمة), say that it is a duty Fardh Ain(فرض عين) on each and every individual.

But this is a minority opinion, that attacking them in their land is Fardh Ain(فرض عين).

And this is the opinion of Ibn Ul-Musayib(إبن المسَّيب) and Ibn-e-Shuburma(إبن شبرمة) that everyone able to fight must go out in the Jihad At-Talab(جهاد الطلب)

so it's Fardh Ain(فرض عين) on everybody, but again, this is a minority opinion.

The minimum participation in Jihad(جهاد) is once a year, and more is always better.

It is not allowed to have the year pass you by without any fighting, except out of necessity, like the weakness of the Muslims, the great numbers of the enemy,

fear of extermination if you attack them first, or lack of provisions or a similar excuse.

So it needs to be done at least once a year.

Otherwise, if there is no necessity, it is not allowed to delay attacking even unbelievers for more than a year.

This is according to Imam Shafie(إمام ألشافعي), the Imam(اِمَام) of Al-Haramain(ألحرمين) says: I adopt the opinion of the scholars of Asool(أصول).

So the scholars of Fiqh(فقه) say that it's once year, the scholars of Asool(أصول) say: They stated that Jihad(جهاد) is a mandatory call, and must be established according to the ability,

until none remains in the world, but a Muslim, or one, who has admitted to Muslims.

Thus Jihad(جهاد) is not limited to once a year.

It should be done more frequently, if possible.

The opinion of the scholars of Fiqh(فقه) that Jihad(جهاد) is to be able to wage once a year is because usually the time spent in preparations for combat limit the ability to wage war more than once a year.

So this Yani(يعني) Imam(اِمَام) of Al-Haramain(ألحرمين) is saying: He's commenting on the opinion of the scholars of Fiqh(فقه) that should be done once a year.

He says: The reason why the scholars of Fiqh(فقه) is limited once a year is because out of experience, having more than one Ghazwa(غزوة) in a year is difficult.

You know the time to prepare for the Ghazwa(غزوة) makes it difficult to do it once a year.

But Imam(اِمَام) of Al-Haramain(ألحرمين) says: My opinion is that, it should be done more than that, if possible.

And it's not limited to once a year. The only reason why it's limited to once a year is because of the circumstances.

Otherwise, it should be done, until the entire world has only a Muslim, or somebody who has submitted to Muslims.

Otherwise, carry on as much as possible.

The author of the Mughni(مغني) from the Hanbali(حنبلي) school states, the minimum Jihad(جهاد) is once a year.

So it is mandatory every year.

If there is a need to fight more, than once a year, it becomes mandatory on the Muslims to fulfill that need.

But if the enemy enters the Muslim land, or even approaches it and amasses on its borders, even if they do not actually enter it, and their armies are double the size of that of the Muslims are less,

than Jihad(جهاد) becomes mandatory on each and every individual.

Then the slave leaves without the permission of their master, the woman without the permission her husband, if she has the strength to fight according to the stronger opinion,

the son without the permission of their parents, and the one in debt without the permission of the lender.

So, in the case where it is the Jihad(جهاد) Fardh-Ain(فرض عين), there is no permission that is sought, all of the rules regarding permission of the wife and the husband, sons and the parents,

slave from the owner, the one in the debt from the lender are abrogated.

And also in that situation Jihad(جهاد) can be done individually, so it doesn't have to be done in Jam’aa(جماعة) or under an Ameer(أمير).

If there is a Jam’aa(جماعة) or an Ameer(أمير) then it shouldn't be done with them, otherwise, the person is on their own.

That's when it's Fardh-Ain(فرض عين).

When the Jihad(جهاد) becomes Fardh-Ain(فرض عين)?

Ibn ul Qadamah(إبن القدامة), Al-Maqdasi(ألمقدسي), gives three conditions when Jihad(جهاد) becomes Fardh-Ain(فرض عين).

Number one, when the enemy attacks your land.

Number two, when the Imam(اِمَام) calls you out for Jihad(جهاد), and number three, when the Armies meet.

So if it is a voluntary Jihad(جهاد), and you're volunteer to go out, and then the army meets, you can't change your mind.

Because then becomes Tawalini Zahaf(تولني ضحف) it becomes turning your back.

And it's one of the Kabair(كبائر).

You didn't want to join, you shouldn't have join in the first place, when the Armies meet.

It's too late to bail out, it becomes Fardh-Ain(فرض عين).

Tayeb(طيِّب), all of the above stated is the opinion of Imam Malik(إمام مالك), Ahmad(أحمد) and Abu Hanifah(ابوحنيفة).

In addition to the Mad'hab(مذهب) of the author of Shafie(شافعي), so that's the consensus of the four.

Close to your border, it becomes Fardh-Ain(فرض عين).

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

الحمدلله والصلوة وسلام على سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ ۖ

وَعَسَىٰ أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ۞

So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً ۚ

وَاللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَيَبْسُطُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ۞

فَهَزَمُوهُمْ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُودُ جَالُوتَ وَآتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَآتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ

وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَفَسَدَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ۞

فَإِذَا انسَلَخَ الأَشهُرُ الحُرُمُ فَاقتُلُوا المُشرِكينَ حَيثُ وَجَدتُموهُم وَخُذوهُم وَاحصُروهُم وَاقعُدوا لَهُم كُلَّ مَرصَدٍ ۚ فَإِن تابوا وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكاةَ فَخَلّوا سَبيلَهُم ۚ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ۞

قاتِلُوا الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلا بِاليَومِ الآخِرِ وَلا وَلا يُحَرِّمونَ ما حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسولُهُ وَلا يَدينونَ دينَ الحَقِّ مِنَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا الكِتابَ حَتّىٰ

حَتّىٰ يُعطُوا الجِزيَةَ عَن يَدٍ وَهُم صاغِرونَ۞

لا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُواْ مُؤْمِنِينَ لا اله إلَّا الله لا صدقة ولا جهاد فبِمَا تدخل الجنة إذن

إذَجاء نصرالله والفتح كذبو ألآن جاء القتال جاهدالمشركين بأموالكم وايديكم والسنتكم ٱنفِرُواْ خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا وَجَٰهِدُواْ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ

ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ۝

فَارِسُ نَطْحَةٌ , أَوْ نَطْحَتَانِ ثُمَّ لَا فَارِسَ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا , وَالرُّومُ ذَاتُ الْقُرُونِ كُلَّمَا هَلَكَ قَرْنٌ خَلَفَ مَكَانَهُ قَرْنٌ  ,

,أَهْلُ صَخْرٍ وَأَهْلُ بَحْرٍ هَيْهَاتَ لِآخِرِ الدَّهْرِ هُمْ أَصْحَابُكُمْ مَا كَانَ فِي الْعَيْشِ خَيْرٌ قُل إِن كانَ آباؤُكُم وَأَبناؤُكُم وَإِخوانُكُم وَأَزواجُكُم وَعَشيرَتُكُم وَأَموالٌ

وَأَموالٌ اقتَرَفتُموها وَتِجارَةٌ تَخشَونَ كَسادَها وَمَساكِنُ وَمَساكِنُ تَرضَونَها أَحَبَّإِلَيكُم مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّإِلَيكُم مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَجِهادٍ في سَبيلِهِ

فَتَرَبَّصوا حَتّىٰ يَأتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمرِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِي القَومَ الفاسِقينَ۞

حَتَى يَأْتِيَ اللَهُ بِأَمْرِهِ يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا ما لَكُم إِذا قيلَ لَكُمُ انفِروا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ اثّاقَلتُم إِلَى الأَرضِ ۚ أَرَضيتُم بِالحَياةِ الدُّنيا مِنَ الآخِرَةِ ۚ فَما مَتاعُ الحَياةِ الدُّنيا فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلّا قَليلٌ۞

إِلّا تَنفِروا يُعَذِّبكُم عَذابًا أَليمًا وَيَستَبدِل قَومًا غَيرَكُم وَلا تَضُرّوهُ شَيئًا ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ۞

فَرِحَ المُخَلَّفونَ بِمَقعَدِهِم خِلافَ رَسولِ اللَّهِ وَكَرِهوا أَن يُجاهِدوابِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَقالوا لا تَنفِروا فِي الحَرِّ ۗ قُل نارُ جَهَنَّمَ أَشَدُّ حَرًّا ۚ لَو كانوا يَفقَهونَ۞

فَليَضحَكوا قَليلًا وَليَبكوا كَثيرًا جَزاءً بِما كانوا يَكسِبونَ۞

إذا تبايعتم بالعِينةِ وأخذتم أذنابَ البقرِ ورضيتم بالزرعِ وتركتم الجهادَ سلط اللهُ عليكم ذُلًّا لا ينزعُه شيءٌ حتى ترجعوا إلى دينِكم حتى ترجعوا إلى دينِكم

وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ ما ضَرَّ عثمان ما عمل بعد اليوم إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ۝

وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَى أُمِّ مُوسَى أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي اليَمِّ وَلاَ تَخَافِي وَلاَ تَحْزَنِي So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says:

فَارغاً إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلا أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَى قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

ما ترك قومٌ الجهاد إلًّا عمَّ هُمُ الله بعذاب من عنده وَمَنْ كَانَتْ الدُّنْيَا هَمَّهُ، شَتَّتَ الله شَمْلَه وَجَعَلَ فَقْرَهُ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ،

وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَا كُتِبَ  لَهُ ، مَنْ كَانَ هَمُّهُ الْآخِرَةَ، ..... جَمَعَ اللهُ شَمْلَهُ، وَجَعَلَ غِنَاهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ، وَأَتَتْهُ الدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ،

مَنْ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَغْزُ وَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْ نَفْسَهُ بِهِ؛ مَاتَ عَلَى شُعْبَةٍ مِنْ نِفَاقٍ صابع الله بالقارية صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك نشهد و الله إله إلَّا أنت نستغفرك ونتوب عليك

parts.english:
The next section is the longest continuous section, where Shaikh(شيخ) Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) talks.

This is an advice to the ones, who stay behind.

It’s a wonderful Naseeha(نَصيحة) that he gives to the ones, who miss out on Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

He says: Oh, you who have neglected Jihad(جهاد) and stayed away from the path of success.

You have put yourself in the position of exclusion from the mercy of Allah.

You have deprived yourself from the greatest reward.

What is it that caused you to stay behind?

Why haven't you joined the ranks of the Mujahideen(مجاهدين)?

Why are you holding back your soul and your wealth?

It must be one of the following reasons.

1) The desire to live a long life.

2) The attachment to family, wealth, or friends.

3)The desire to do more good deeds before fighting Jihad(جهاد).

4) The love of a beautiful wife.

5) Your position of power or love of a comfortable lifestyle.

Nothing else could be holding you back.

It must be one of the above mentioned reasons that is keeping you away from Allah.

Can’t you hear the call of Allah directed at you: Oh, you have believed! What is the matter with you that, when you are told to go forth in the cause of Allah,

you adhere heavily to the earth.

Are you satisfied with the life of this world rather than the Hereafter?

But what is the enjoyment of worldly life compared to the hereafter except a very little.

Listen carefully to how I respond to each and every one of the causes, that are holding you back from Jihad(جهاد), you will then come to realize that you are deprived,

and you would learn that it is nothing but yourself and Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) that is preventing you from Jihad(جهاد); 1) Number One: The desire to live longer:

In the name of Allah fearlessness does not decrease your life.

And cowardice does not increase it.

Allah says: And for every nation is a specified term.

So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they proceed it.

This is in Al-Araf(ألأعراف) Verse 34.

And Allah says: But never will Allah delay a soul when it's time has come.

And Allah is acquainted with what you do.

And that’s in Al-Munafiqoon(ألمنافقون) verse 11.

And Allah says: Every soul will taste death, then to us, you will be returned.

And this is in Al-Ankabut(ألعنكبوت), Verse 57.

And then he says: Oh, you have deceived yourself!

Remember that during death, there's agony and pain.

And on the Day of Judgment, there's great fear.

Do you remember that a Shaheed(شَهِيد) is spared from all of this.

He does not feel the pain of death, except like a sting of an insect.

My brother, why miss out on this opportunity.

And then after death, you would be spared from the punishment of the grave.

You will not go through the questioning of the angels in the grave.

And you will be tranquil on the day of judgment, when everybody else is horrified.

After your death your soul will be in the Inside of birds flying in paradise.

Can you see the difference between dying a natural death and being a Shaheed(شَهِيد)?

2) Number two: Attachment to family: If what prevents you from Jihad(جهاد) is family, wealth and friends, Then; Allah says: And it is not your wealth or your children that brings you nearer to us in position,

but it is by being one, who has believed and done righteousness.

So these things don't really bring you closer to Allah.

Know that the life of this world is, but amusement and diversion, and adornment and boasting to one another, and competition in the increase of wealth and children.

Like the example of a rain whose plant growth pleases the tillers, then it dries and you see it turned yellow, then it becomes debris.

And in the Hereafter is a severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval.

And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

That’s Surah Al-Hadid(سورة ألحديد) verse 20.

The Messenger of Allah said: And the area under a whip, or under your foot in Paradise is better than the world and everything in it.

That's in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

So does it make sense to leave this vast Kingdom in paradise for the sake of your family, who in a short while will be among the dead.

A family that might Express towards you animosity, bad behavior or jealousy.

If you are wealthy, they love you.

If you're broke, they forsake you.

One day they are with you, and the next day against you.

In the end, on the day of judgment, they will leave you alone, and they would hold you accountable for even the size of a grain.

They would all desire that they would be saved on that day, even if it is you that is going to hell fire.

Allah سبحانه تعالى says that, on the day of judgment, a person would wish to sacrifice their wife, their children, their parents, their tribe and everyone in the earth,

if it's going to save them from hellfire.

3) Number Three: Love of wealth: If it is your wealth that is keeping you behind, then how can it do so, when you know that it will eventually leave you?

See, the problem here is that you don't want to leave your wealth, but your wealth is going to leave you.

So why not leave it and get the Ajr(أجْر), rather than be forced, for it to leave you?

And because of this wealth, you will be asked on the Day of Judgment: How did you make it and how did you spend it?

You will be asked these two questions on a day that would make a child gray headed, a day of horror.

The Messenger of Allah said: The poor Muslims will proceed the rich in Paradise by half a day, 500 years.

Allah says: Your wealth and your children are, but a trial.

And Allah has with Him a great reward.

At-Taghabagun(ألتغابن) Verse 15.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in a Hadith(حديث) that the poor are among Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون).

There are many poor among Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون), they came out from Makkah.

They had to leave everything behind them.

Some of them were originally wealthy, but they became broke.

Hijrah(هجرة) wasn't a very easy thing.

They had to leave their wealth behind.

For example, Suhaib Suhaib Al-Rumi(صهيب الرومي) is Roman, and he was a slave in Makkah.

But he did business in Makkah, and he became wealthy.

He accumulated a lot of wealth, when he was in Makkah.

He became Muslim.

And when he went out in Hijrah(هجرة), some of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) pursued him.

And he stood on a hill and he took an arrow from his quiver and he pointed towards him, and he said: You know that I'm among the best archers in Makkah.

I'm going to empty my quiver in you If you don't leave me alone.

Then he said: They said: You came to us in Makkah broke.

And you lived among us, and accumulated wealth.

Now you want to leave and take your wealth with you.

We're not going to let you go with your money.

And I think in this story is a stark warning for Muslims, who are living in the West.

Maybe one day the same thing will happen.

You'll be told you came here broke and poor, and you became wealthy among us.

You can’t just leave and take your money with you.

So they told Suhaib(صهيب): Give us your money.

He said: Fine!

You will find my money in such and such place in Makkah.

So he ransomed himself for them by giving them his wealth.

Suhaib(صهيب) arrived in Madina and as soon as Rasool Allah ﷺ saw him, he told him; What a profitable trade, Abu Yahya(أبويحيى)!” Without Suhaib(صهيب) telling him the story,

the news was already with the Rasool Allah ﷺ and he told him: That was a profitable deal.

You lost all of your money- and then he’s congratulated that it's a good deal, because it's really a good deal.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will give you more.

So there are many poor among Al-Muhajireen(مهاجرين).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: These poor Muhajireen(مهاجرين) are going to knock on the gates of Jannah(جنة).

So the angels are going to open the gates and say: What are you doing here?

Isn’t the day of judgment still going on?

The Hisab(حساب), proceedings of the Hisab(حساب) is still going on, and these Muhajireen(مهاجرين) are already knocking on the gates, they want to get in.

So the angels are telling them? Didn’t you have to go through the reckoning?

So the Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) said: We would be reckoned for what?

All what we used to do, while we were living was carrying our swords on our shoulders and fight Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), what are we going to be asked about?

We had no businesses, because you see … You are not going to move your feet, your feet are not gonna move from the tracks on the Day of Judgment, until you're asked four questions;

About your life, about your youth.

And then the other two questions are relating to what? Money.

How did you make money? And how did you spend it?

So two questions relate to money, and that's what's going to hold people behind.

That's what it's gonna delay them.

Because you're going to be asked about each and every penny that you made, and that you spent.

So these Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) said: We didn't have any money to be asked about.

We're carrying our swords… We died for the sake of Allah. So what are we going to be asked about?

So the angel will tell them: You're welcome, come in!

- while everybody else is still going to the Hisab(حساب).

4) Number four: Love of your children and caring for them: Is it because you care for them?

Well, Allah is more careful for them than you.

Didn’t He care for them while they were in the darkness of their mother's womb?

How can such a child prevent you from Jihad(جهاد), when if he is young, you are concerned.

And when they grow old, you are still concerned.

You are concerned about them when they are healthy, and you're concerned about them when they're sick.

If you discipline them, they revolt against you.

If you advise them, they hate you.

And after all of your care for them, when you grow old, they forsake you, and you still see them as a blessing.

Get them out of your mind and hand them over to the One, Who created them.

And trust Allah in their provisions as He trust them in yours.

How can you acknowledge that Allah is the One, Who manages the affairs of the heavens and earth, and you don't trust him with the provisions of your children?

I mean, don't we all acknowledge that Allah is the One, Who is running the affairs of the universe?

Don't we believe that Allah is the One, Who is providing the Rizq(رزق) for every fish in the sea and every animal on the land and every bird in the air?

Don’t we believe that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is the One, Who has created and is sustaining the universe, this huge universe?

And then we don’t trust Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ with the provisions of our children.

In the name of Allah, you have no authority over the harm or benefit that befalls them, or even yourself.

You have no control even over your own life or theirs.

You cannot even add a day to their life.

One day you would be dead and then you would leave your children, orphans behind you.

Then you would say: I wish I were with the martyrs, and the response would be, now it's too late. Allah says: Oh mankind! Fear your Lord, and fear a day when no father will avail his son,

nor will a son avail his father at all.

Indeed the promise of Allah is true, so let not the worldly life delude you, and be not deceived about Allah by the deceiver, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

And this is Luqman(لُقمان) verse 33.

Now if your child is among the successful people of paradise, then you will be reunited with them in Jannah(جنة) and if he is among the losers, then why wait?

Let the separation be from now.

If you truly care for your child, then die as a Shaheed(شَهِيد), you would  then be able to appeal for 70 of your family-members.

So what are you waiting for?

Now Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز), when he was in Sakarat-Ul-Maut(سكرات الموت), when he was dying, Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز) made things strict on his family, very strict.

So when he was dying, his relatives, you know Bannu Umayyah(بَنُواُمَيَّة) they are all living a very high class life, and now the Khalifah(خليفه) and his wife and children are living this difficult life.

You know it's like they didn't belong to the family.

Fatima Bint Abdul Malik(فاطمه بنت عبدالملك), the wife of Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز), was brought up in a house of Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

Her father was a Khalifah(خليفه), Abdul Malik Bin Marwan(عبدالملك بن مروان ), three of her brothers were Khulafa(خلفاء), Suleiman Bin Abdul Malik(سليمان بن عبدالملك), Hisham Bin Abdul Malik(هشام بن عبدالملك) and Waleed bin Abdul Malik(وليدبن عبدالملك),

and she's a wife of a Khalifah(خليفه), Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز) surrounded by Khulafa(خلفاء) from all over.

Nevertheless, he took all of her jewelry and he gave it out to Sadaqah(صدقة) and he would have her wear very simple clothes.

So Bannu Umayyah(بَنُواُمَيَّة) were, putting pressure on the Khalifah(خليفه). Why are you doing this?

So they came to him. And obviously they knew that he's not going to change his ways.

So when he was dying, they came to him to at least convince him to do something for his kids.

So they told him: You don't have anything to leave behind for your children, nothing.

At least give them something.

And it's Halal(حلال), you don't have to steal anything, give them like you're giving the rest of the Ummah(امة), I mean there is so much wealth in the Ummah(امة).

They're pay every Muslim a salary for no work.

Everybody was receiving a salary because there was so much to hand out.

So they're telling him, he needs something for his children.

Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز) said: Bring them, bring my children.

So they brought them and they were all lined up in front of him, all of them.

And you know before death, it's a very difficult time, you know, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) can come to you and make you feel sorry for them.

So they were all lined up in front of him wearing very simple clothes.

And then he looked at them and he said: My son is either is a Mo'min(مؤمن) or Fajir(فاجر), my children are either going to be a Mo'min(مؤمن) or a corrupt person.

He said: If they are a Mo'min(مؤمن), believers, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is going to give them Rizq(رزق), and if my son grows up to become corrupt, I don't want to support him in his corruption.

And he decided not to leave them anything behind, and he died without leaving them anything.

The narrator of the story said: I've  later on seen the sons of Umar Bin Abdul Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز) when they grew old.

Every one of them was a millionaire. And every one of them was Salih(صالح), everyone was righteous.

Put your trust in Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, it is better for you than what you think is right.

Put your affairs in the hands of Allah and let Him manage your affairs for you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ used to say in the Dua(دُعَا), O Allah don't put my affairs in my hands even if even a blink of an eye, even for as long as a blink of an eye, keep my affairs in your hands.

5) Your friends, Number 5): If you are unable to leave behind your friends and acquaintances, then remember the day of judgment.

On that day friends are enemies, except the righteous among them, so if your friends are not righteous then we don't want to be with them today.

Because tomorrow they will turn against you.

But if they are righteous, then Allah will unite you together in a better place, than this.

And we will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment.

So they will be brothers on thrones facing each other.

And this is Al Hijr(ألحجر) verse 47 6) Power and prestige: You might be staying behind the ranks of the Mujahideen(مجاهدين) because you fear the loss of what you have established so far in your life in terms of position, power, and prestige.

This position you're holding, how many hands did it passed through until it reached you?

So if this position left them, it would one day leave you.

Your power is temporary, and your prestige will soon be forgotten.

Your position, power and prestige are keeping you away from the path of paradise.

Now the lowest person in paradise will own 10 times the whole world  and everything in it.

This is the power and position of the lowest person in paradise.

It’s the greater than that of the greatest king of this world.

Nothing in this world is the free of contamination.

The position you are holding has its fair share of disappointments.

In order to win power and positions you will have to struggle, you will win enemies and lose friends.

You will suffer pain and defeats along the way.

Paradise is free all of that, Allah says: Gardens of  perpetual residence, they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their descendants.

And the angels will enter upon them from every gate saying: Peace be upon you for what you patiently endure.

And excellent is the final home.

Al-Ra'ad(ألرَّعد) Twenty three and Twenty four(23-24).

Now, he talks about the contamination of this world.

Jannah(جنة) is different than Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) in four areas: Number 1) This world is temporary and Akhirah(آخرة) is permanent.

Allah says about Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) And Allah says about Jannah(جنة), Akhirah(آخرة) is better and everlasting.

Number 2) There's a difference in quantity.

Number 3) There is a difference in quality.

Number 4) Everything in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is contaminated.

And everything in Akhirah(آخرة) is pure.

Number 1) Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is temporary and Akhirah(آخرة) is permanent.

How long are you going to live in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا)?

I was watching in Al-Jazeera(ألجزيرة) and in the news strip it said that the oldest man in the world has passed away in Japan at the age of 114, that's the oldest, 114.

How long will you live in Akhirah(آخرة)? Infinity.

Now if we want to make a ratio Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) to Akhirah(آخرة).

What do you do to make a ratio?

You divide Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) on Akhirah(آخرة).

So 114 divided by infinity, what's the answer?

Yani(يعني) Math tells us that it's zero. Nothing!

There isn't even a ratio.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ was more generous than that. He said: If this world was worth a wing of a mosquito, but then you can notice that Rasool Allah ﷺ said: One wing so the mosquito can't even fly.

He didn't even say two wings.

So Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is nothing. Worthless !

Number two. Quantity.

Musa عليه السّلام asked Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, what's the lowest level in Jannah(جنة) and this Hadith(حديث) is in Muslim(مسلم).

There's another Hadith(حديث). Rasool Allah ﷺ talks about the lowest level in Jannah(جنة), they're quite similar.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: The last man to come out of Hellfire, he will come out of hellfire, and just because he came out of Hellfire, he’s not in Jannah(جنة) yet, he is so happy.

He will say: Oh Allah, You have given me something that you have not given to any of Your creation.

He doesn’t what is going on in Jannah(جنة)? He just thinks that being out from hellfire is good enough, not good enough, he thinks that is the best.

But then he see a tree in the horizon.

Now this is the desolate land between Jahannum(جَهَّنَّم) and Jannah(جنة).

So he see a tree in the horizon.

So he says: O Allah, can You allow me to please go under that tree, so that I can drink from the water and eat from its fruits and enjoy its shade.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells him, You can go!

So he goes under the tree.

But then, when he get there he sees another tree.

Now he has already told Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ before that I am not going to ask for anything more.

He said: that’s all what I want! Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells him: Didn’t you promise that you don’t ask for anything else.

Because he said: I want to go next to that tree.

Allah told him: You promise that you're not going to ask for anything else.

He said: O Allah this is the last time, I promise, I am not ask for anything more.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells him: You can go. He gets there, and he sees a better tree.

He says: O Allah, Let me go under that tree, so that I can drink from its water and eats its fruit, Allah will tell him: Son of Adam(آدم), didn’t you promise that you’re not going ask for anything more?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; The man is seeing something, and he has no patience, he cannot hold back.

So he keeps on breaking his promise again and again.

The third time Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells him: You promise!

You are not going to ask for anything else.

He said: I promise this is the last time.

So he goes under another tree but then when gets under that the tree what does he see.

He sees the walls of Jannah(جنة).

He says: O Allah, I don’t want to go in. Just let me sit under that wall, just sit under that wall.

And you see the thing is, because it is getting closer to Jannah(جنة), even though he's not Jannah(جنة) yet, because we are getting closer to Jannah(جنة), even though it's outside of Jannah(جنة).

The Barakaat(بركات) of Jannah(جنة) are even influencing  this waste-land, and the further he gets away from hell fire the better it becomes.

Because hellfire kills everything and Jannah(جنة) gives life to everything.

So Allah tells him: Alright go under the walls of Jannah(جنة).

He goes under the walls of Jannah(جنة) and when he gets there. Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He starts hearing the conversion of the  people of Jannah(جنة),

And that’s when he Just cannot keep his promise.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله)! He doesn’t even  see the people of Jannah(جنة), he just hears, he just hears their conversion and that in itself drives him crazy,

just their voice.

He says: O Allah please allow me to go in, just get through the gates, just allow me to go in.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tell him: O Son of Adam(آدم) what will please you?

Would you be  pleased: If I give you the equivalent of the entire world and everything in it.

He will say: O Allah, Yes! I would be pleased.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will tell him, I will give you that, an equivalent to it, and equivalent to it, and equivalent to it. So five times the earth, and everything in it.

What about it.?

That's all.!

Try to get whatever nutrition they can and they will drink water that's it.

Living on nothing but water, and one date per day.

And while they were traveling on the coast.

Now, when they say it's Maytah(مَيتَة).

Either this was before the Maytah(مَيتَة) of the sea was allowed dead fish, or it was because it might have been there for some time, so it wasn't fresh.

So Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة) said: Don't eat from it.

But then after that, they're very hungry.

So Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) said: We are the messengers of the Messenger of Allah and we are Mujahideen(مجاهدين) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So go ahead and eat from it.

So they would go and eat from this fish.

He said: We would bring wood and put it under the just on the side, and keep it burning, and then go and grab from the meat and eat from it.

He said: We stayed there for 30 days eating from that fish.

Until we ended up gaining weight.

He said: The flesh of our stomach was folding.

Imagine for 30 days eating from this fish eating nothing but seafood, and how large was this Sariyah(سرية).?

Three hundred were eating day and night, fish.

Jabir Ibn Abdullah(جابربن عبدالله) narrates: We were sent on an expedition by the Messenger of Allah, to raid the caravan owned by Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

and he appointed Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة) as our leader, the Messenger of Allah found nothing to provide us with except leather bags filled with dates and nothing else.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) would then hand us one date each.

The narrator was asked what good would that be.

He said: We would eat it and then suck on the date seed.

In addition to drinking water that was the only food we would have for the whole day.

Then we would gather leaves of trees and soak them in water and eat them.

Then we headed for the direction of the coast.

We saw what appeared like a sand dune and to our surprise it was a whale.

Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة) at first said: It is dead, therefore it cannot be consumed.

He then said: But we are the messengers of the Messenger of Allah, and we are in the Cause of Allah, and this is a necessity, so eat from it.

We stayed there for a whole month eating from it, until we grew fat, and we were 300 in number, we would collect oil from its eyes with buckets and cut from its flesh pieces as large as a bull.

Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة) had us fit 13 men in its eye socket.

He then had one of its rib bones fixed to the ground, like an arc.

Then he had the tallest camel with us, pass from under it, without the camel touching the bone.

We then picked up, dried meat, to carry with us to Madina.

When we told the Messenger of Allah, our story.

He said: That was sustenance, Allah sent for you.

Do you have any of that meat left with you to give me some.

We sent some to him and he ate from it.

This is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح ألمسلم).

See At-Taifah(ألطائفة) is sometimes when it says Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) we misinterpret it because there's a group named Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) and the scholars of Hadith(حديث)

we misinterpret the meaning of Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) to mean scholars of Hadith(حديث).

Does that mean that scholars of Fiqh(فقه) are not Taifah(طائفة), or the Tafseer(تفسير) and how comes it's scholars Hadith(حديث).

So, that's not the right understanding of what Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) means.

Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) means the people of Hadith(حديث), the people who are following the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ and trying to emulate his way in their lives,

which makes the Mujahideen(مجاهدين), the closest to this definition, because they are the ones, who are trying their best to follow the Sunnah(سنة) Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Therefore you would find that it's very rare to find among Al-Mujahideen(مجاهدين), people have problems with Sunnah(سنة).

The whole lifestyle of Jihad(جهاد) brings you closer to the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ and wanting to be like Rasool Allah ﷺ.

If you wanted to be like Rasool Allah ﷺ and the thing that preoccupied Rasool Allah ﷺ for his entire stay in Madina, why wouldn't you want to be like him in the way he looked,

or the way he ate, or the issues that are much simpler.

So Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث) here is the people, who are trying to follow the way of Rasool Allah ﷺ in their life.

That's what is meant by Ahl-Ul-Hadith(أهل الحديث).

So it doesn't really change the time, it's same.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ اللهم الشرح الصدرك وارنا ألحق يا أرحم الراحمين ،

رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا ما لَكُم إِذا قيلَ لَكُمُ انفِروا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ اثّاقَلتُم إِلَى الأَرضِ ۚ

أَرَضيتُم بِالحَياةِ الدُّنيا مِنَ الآخِرَةِ ۚ فَما مَتاعُ الحَياةِ الدُّنيا فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلّا قَليلٌ۞

وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۖ فَإِذا جاءَ أَجَلُهُم لا يَستَأخِرونَ ساعَةً ۖ وَلا يَستَقدِمونَ۞

وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفسًا إِذا جاءَ أَجَلُها ۚ وَاللَّهُ خَبيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ۞

كُلُّ نَفسٍ ذائِقَةُ المَوتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَينا تُرجَعونَ۞

وَما أَموالُكُم وَلا أَولادُكُم بِالَّتي تُقَرِّبُكُم عِندَنا زُلفىٰ بِالَّتي تُقَرِّبُكُم عِندَنا زُلفىٰ إِلّا مَن آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صالِحًا فَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُم جَزاءُ الضِّعفِ بِما عَمِلوا وَهُم فِي الغُرُفاتِ آمِنونَ۞

اعلَموا أَنَّمَا الحَياةُ الدُّنيا لَعِبٌ وَلَهوٌ وَزينَةٌ وَتَفاخُرٌ بَينَكُم وَتَفاخُرٌ بَينَكُم وَتَكاثُرٌ فِي الأَموالِ وَالأَولادِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيثٍ أَعجَبَ الكُفّارَ نَباتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهيجُ فَتَراهُ مُصفَرًّا

ثُمَّ يَهيجُ فَتَراهُ مُصفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكونُ حُطامًا ۖ وَفِي الآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ شَديدٌ وَمَغفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضوانٌ ۚ وَمَا الحَياةُ الدُّنيا إِلّا مَتاعُ الغُرورِ۞

إِنَّما أَموالُكُم وَأَولادُكُم فِتنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجرٌ عَظيمٌ۞

Al-Rumi(صهيب الرومي).

أتَيْتَنَا سَولُوكً فَسَارَ لَكَ بَيَنَ مالً وَاَهْل ربَيهَ ألبَية أبى يحيى لا تزول قدما عبد يوم القيامة حتى يسأل عن أربع على عواتقنا حدنا وحدنا في سبيل الله

يا أَيُّهَا النّاسُ اتَّقوا رَبَّكُم وَاخشَوا يَومًا لا يَجزي والِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِ وَلا مَولودٌ هُوَ جازٍ عَن والِدِهِ شَيئًا ۚ إِنَّ وَعدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ

فَلا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الحَياةُ الدُّنيا وَلا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الغَرورُ۞

فوضع امورك الى الله اللهم لا تكلني الى نفسي طرفة عين Allah سبحانه تعالى says: وَنَزَعنا ما في صُدورِهِم مِن غِلٍّ إِخوانًا عَلىٰ سُرُرٍ مُتَقابِلينَ۞

وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰابِلِينَ۞

جَنّاتُ عَدنٍ يَدخُلونَها وَمَن صَلَحَ مِن آبائِهِم وَأَزواجِهِم وَذُرِّيّاتِهِم ۖ وَالمَلائِكَةُ يَدخُلونَ عَلَيهِم مِن كُلِّ بابٍ۞

سَلامٌ عَلَيكُم بِما صَبَرتُم ۚ فَنِعمَ عُقبَى الدّارِ۞

الدنيا فانية والجنة باقية متاع الغرور والاخرة خير وابقى وهو لأنه يرى ما لا صبرله عليه رضيتُ يا رب، رضيتُ يا رب Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells Musa(موسى).

أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ أرَدْتُ غَرَسْتُ كَرامَتَهُمْ بيَدِي، فيها مال عين الراعئة ،، وَلَا رضو سَمِعَت ، ولَمْ يَخْطُرْ علَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ مَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ في الجَنَّةِ، خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيا وما فيها،

وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ وَيَطوفُ عَلَيهِم وِلدانٌ مُخَلَّدونَ إِذا رَأَيتَهُم حَسِبتَهُم لُؤلُؤًا مَنثورًا۞

ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقاً آخَرَ يا أَيُّهَا النّاسُ إِنَّ وَعدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الحَياةُ الدُّنيا ۖ وَلا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الغَرورُ۞

إِنَّ الشَّيطانَ لَكُم عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّما يَدعو حِزبَهُ لِيَكونوا مِن أَصحابِ السَّعيرِ۞

انفِروا خِفافًا وَثِقالًا وَجاهِدوا بِأَموالِكُم وَجاهِدوا بِأَموالِكُم وَأَنفُسِكُم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذٰلِكُم خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ۞

لا يَستَوِي القاعِدونَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ غَيرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالمُجاهِدونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم ۚ فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم عَلَى القاعِدينَ دَرَجَةً ۚ

وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الحُسنىٰ ۚ وَفَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ عَلَى القاعِدينَ أَجرًا عَظيمًا۞

لا يَستَوِي القاعِدونَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ غَيرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالمُجاهِدونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم ۚ فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم عَلَى القاعِدينَ دَرَجَةً ۚ

وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الحُسنىٰ ۚ وَفَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ عَلَى القاعِدينَ أَجرًا عَظيمًا۞

دَرَجاتٍ مِنهُ وَمَغفِرَةً وَرَحمَةً ۚ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا۞

فَليُقاتِل في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذينَ يَشرونَ الحَياةَ الدُّنيا بِالآخِرَةِ ۚ وَمَن يُقاتِل في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَيُقتَل أَو يَغلِب فَسَوفَ نُؤتيهِ أَجرًا عَظيمًا۞

الَّذينَ آمَنوا وَهاجَروا وَجاهَدوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموالِهِم بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم أَعظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الفائِزونَ ۞

يُبَشِّرُهُم رَبُّهُم بِرَحمَةٍ مِنهُ وَرِضوانٍ وَجَنّاتٍ لَهُم فيها نَعيمٌ مُقيمٌ ۞

خالِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ أَجرٌ عَظيمٌ۞

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشتَرىٰ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ أَنفُسَهُم وَأَموالَهُم وَأَموالَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الجَنَّةَ ۚ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَقتُلونَ وَيُقتَلونَ ۖ

وَعدًا عَلَيهِ حَقًّا فِي التَّوراةِ وَالإِنجيلِ وَالقُرآنِ ۚ وَمَن أَوفىٰ بِعَهدِهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاستَبشِروا بِبَيعِكُمُ الَّذي بايَعتُم بِهِ ۚ

وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ۞

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَرَىٰ أشتارى منهم وأغلالهم سَمن لَكُم الجنة قَالُوا: رَبِحَ الْبَيْعُ لَا نُقِيلُ وَلَا نَسْتَقِيلُ Musa عليه السّلام يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا إِن تَنصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنصُركُم وَيُثَبِّت أَقدامَكُم۞

إِنَّمَا المُؤمِنونَ الَّذينَ آمَنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ ثُمَّ لَم يَرتابوا ثُمَّ لَم يَرتابوا وَجاهَدوا بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ

أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الصّادِقونَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا هَل أَدُلُّكُم عَلىٰ تِجارَةٍ تُنجيكُم مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ ۞

تُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَتُجاهِدونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموالِكُم وَأَنفُسِكُم ۚ ذٰلِكُم خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ۞

يَغفِر لَكُم ذُنوبَكُم وَيُدخِلكُم جَنّاتٍ تَجري مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهارُ وَمَساكِنَ طَيِّبَةً في جَنّاتِ عَدنٍ ۚ ذٰلِكَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ ۞

وَأُخرىٰ تُحِبّونَها ۖ نَصرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتحٌ قَريبٌ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ المُؤمِنينَ۞

أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُول الله أَجَعَلتُم سِقايَةَ الحاجِّ وَعِمارَةَ المَسجِدِ الحَرامِ كَمَن

كَمَن آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَاليَومِ الآخِرِ وَجاهَدَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ لا يَستَوونَ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِي القَومَ الظّالِمينَ۞

يا عبدالحرمين يا أبصرتنا۞۞۞  ألعلمتا اَنَّك باالعبادة فالعبد۞۞۞

سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الأَرضِ ۖ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا لِمَ تَقولونَ ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

كَبُرَ مَقتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ أَن تَقولوا ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ۞

لا يَستَوِي القاعِدونَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ غَيرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالمُجاهِدونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم ۚ فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم عَلَى القاعِدينَ دَرَجَةً ۚ

وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الحُسنىٰ ۚ وَفَضَّلَ اللَّهُ المُجاهِدينَ عَلَى القاعِدينَ أَجرًا عَظيمًا۞

دَرَجاتٍ مِنهُ وَمَغفِرَةً وَرَحمَةً ۚ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا۞

Siyaha(سياحة) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله عزوجل).

سَيَاحة أمَّتي الجهاد في سبيل الله ذالك رزق يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ ما كانَ لِأَهلِ المَدينَةِ وَمَن حَولَهُم مِنَ الأَعرابِ أَن

أَن يَتَخَلَّفوا عَن رَسولِ اللَّهِ وَلا يَرغَبوا بِأَنفُسِهِم عَن نَفسِهِ ۚ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم لا يُصيبُهُم ظَمَأٌ وَلا نَصَبٌ وَلا وَلا مَخمَصَةٌ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلا يَطَئونَ مَوطِئًا يَغيظُ الكُفّارَ

وَلا يَنالونَ مِن عَدُوٍّ نَيلًا إِلّا كُتِبَ لَهُم بِهِ عَمَلٌ صالِحٌ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُضيعُ أَجرَ المُحسِنينَ ۞

وَلا يُنفِقونَ نَفَقَةً صَغيرَةً وَلا كَبيرَةً وَلا وَلا يَقطَعونَ وادِيًا إِلّا كُتِبَ لَهُم لِيَجزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحسَنَ ما كانوا يَعمَلونَ۞

أنتم الفراغون أنتم الفراغون بل هم القراهون حرمنن جهاد من تلاوت كثير من القرآن فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ أذن في الناس بالحج

عليك ندا وعلينا عجابة وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ Tayeb(طيِّب), صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

مال يتم الواجب ، إلَّا به فهو واجب حيَّ على الجهاد لَا يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا

parts.english:
The virtues of encouraging Jihad(جهاد), At-Tahreez(ألتحريض).

So fight O Muhammadﷺ in the cause of Allah.

You are not held responsible except for yourself, and encourage the believers to join you, that Perhaps Allah will restrain the might of those who disbelieved,

and Allah is greater in might and stronger in punishment.

This is an An-Nisa(ألنساء) Verse 84.

So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is giving an order to Muhammadﷺ to fight, and then Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is saying that as long as you are making Tahreez(تحريض), you're encouraging others to fight,

it doesn't matter if they do go or not as long as you are doing with Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ wants you to do.

And I think this is also a reflection of the meaning, In the Hadith(حديث) of Taifah Al-Mansura(طائفة المنصورة), it says that they are not harmed by the ones, who don't go along with it.

Doesn't really hinder their progress in their path towards Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, they're going to carry on doing it.

Regardless of who is coming along and who is not.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ also says: O Prophet urged the believers to do battle.

if they are among you 20 steadfast, they will overcome 200, and if they are among you 100 steadfast, they will overcome 1000 of those who have disbelieved,

because they are people who do not understand.

This is in Al-Anfal(ألأنفال) Verse 65.

The author says, we will end this chapter, so he's talking about the chapter of Tahreez(تحريض).

He says we will end this chapter with the famous story of Umm Ibrahim(أمِّ اِبْراهِيْم).

This story was mentioned by scholars like Abu Jafar Al-Luban(أبوجعفرألبان), he narrates it is mentioned that one of the righteous woman in Basra(بصرى), was Umm-Ibrahim Al-Hashimiya(أم إبراهيم ألهاشمية).

The enemy attacked one of the Muslim towns, so people were encouraged to join Jihad(جهاد).

Abdul Wahid Bin Zaid Al-Basri(عبدالواحدبن زيد ألبصري) delivered a speech, encouraging Jihad(جهاد).

And among the audience was Umm Ibrahim(أمِّ اِبْراهِيْم).

Among the things that Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد) talked about was Al-Hoor(ألحور), the woman of paradise.

So here we have Abdul Wahid Bin Zaid(عبدالواحدبن زيد) is delivering a speech, encouraging, whoever is there to participate in Ghazoo(غزؤ).

And it's happened that her name is Umm-Ibrahim Al-Hashimiya(أم إبراهيم ألهاشمية), Hashmiyyah(هاشمية) from Banu Hashim(بنوهاشم), she was attending, in that session.

And he went on and on describing on Hoor-Ul-Ain(حورالعين).

Now I didn't translate everything he said, because a lot of it was poetry.

But there was a lot of things that he had to say about Al-Hoor(ألحور).

So Umm-Ibrahim(أم إبراهيم) heard that she stood up and said to Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد): You know my son Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), and you know that the nobility of Al-Basra(ألبصرى) wish to have him marry one of their daughters,

and I have not yet to agreed to any one of them.

But I like this girl you described, and I would be happy to marry her to my son.

Can you please describe her again.!

So Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد) goes and brings now new description, he doesn't use the old description that he had.

He had total new package present to her now, and the description of this Hooriya(حورية).

Umm-Ibrahim(أم إبراهيم) said: I want my son to marry this girl, and I would pay you 10,000 dinars, as her dowry, the dinar(دينار) is the golden coin.

So it's more than the Dirham(درهم), Dirham(درهم) is usually silver and dinar(دينار) is gold.

As her dowry and you take him with you in this army.

He might die as a Shaheed(شَهِيد), and intercede for me on the day of judgment.

And you don't have to write down the whole story. I'll give you the notes for that.

If you do so, Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد) told her: If you do so that is a great success for you and your son.

She then called her son from the audience, so Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was there so she called him up.

She said: Stand up!

So he stood up and said: Yes, my mother!

She said: Are you pleased to marry this girl with the condition of giving your soul to Allah.?

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) said: Yes!

I am very pleased.

She said: Oh Allah, you are my witness that I have married my son to this girl from paradise, with the condition, he spends his soul in Your sake.

So the witnesses is Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ of this contract of marriage.

Then she went and brought back with her, 10,000 dinars, and gave it to Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد) and said: This is her dowry, take it and use it to provide for the Mujahideen(مجاهدين).

She then purchased for her son, a good horse and she armed him.

When the army started its March Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) came out with the reciters of Qur'an surrounding him, and they were reciting.

Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties in exchange for that they will have paradise.

So whenever Umm-Ibrahim(أم إبراهيم) was greeting her son, she told him: Be careful! And don't allow any of your shortcomings to be seen by Allah.

And then she embraced him and kissed him and said: May Allah never bring us together except on the Day of Judgment.

This is a woman with Yaqeen(يقين).

She's, making Dua(دُعَا) which is greeting her son, she's saying: May Allah never bring us together until the day of judgment.

Now Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد), he said: When we reach the enemy's territory and the people were called to fight.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was in the front and he killed many of the enemy, but then they overwhelmed him and killed him.

On our way back, I told my soldiers not to tell Umm-Ibrahim(أم إبراهيم), that her son was killed until I tell her.

When we entered Al-Basra(ألبصرى), she met me and she said: Did Allah accept my gift, so that I can celebrate or did Allah rejected so that I should cry,

meaning my gift to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is my son.

Does Allah accept the gift or did he returned back?

If He accepted it, I'm going to celebrate.

If Allah is bringing him back to me, I'm going to cry.

The exact opposite of what to be expected from the mother to do.

So Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد) said: Allah did accept your gift and your son died as a Shaheed(شَهِيد).

So she prostrated to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and thanked Allah and said: Thank you Allah for accepting my gift.

The following day, she came to the Mosque and she told Abdul Wahid(عبدالواحد), she told him rejoice, Abshir(أبشر).

So he told her what good news, do you have to give me.?

She said: I saw my son Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) last night in a dream.

He was in a beautiful garden, dressed in green clothes, sitting on a throne made of Pearl, and he had the crown on his head, and he told me: Rejoice, my mother I got married to my bride.

This is an immediate Beshara(بشارة) that the mother received that her son did get married.

The next headline.

The virtue of racing towards Jihad(جهاد).

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says and the fore runners, the fore runners, those are the ones, who are close to Allah and this is in Al-Waqiah(ألواقعة) Verse 10 & 11.

There's one view that Sabiqoon(سابقون) are the Sabiqoon(سابقون) of this Ummah(امة).

The Sahabah رضي الله عنهم and the early generations.

So they have the higher status.

There's another opinion that the Sabiqoon(سابقون) are the ones, who believe from the other nations before the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

But then there's a third opinion and this is narrated by Usman bin Abi Soda(عثمان بن أبي سودة), he said: We were told that the fore runners mentioned in the verses,

are the first to go out on Jihad(جهاد) and the first to go to Salah(صلاة).

So that the fore runners, or the first in this Ayah(آية) means the first to go to the Masjid(مسجد) and the first to go out and respond to the call of

And this narration is in Musnad Ibn Abi Shaibah(مسند إبن أبي شعيبة) and it's authentic Sahih(صحيح).

Now, this Usman bin Abi Soda(عثمان بن أبي سودة), he is among the At-Taba'een(ألتابعين).

And he used to be a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) and one year, he was asked, Are you going to fight this year?

He said: Yes! I wouldn't want to miss fighting even if I were to make 10,000 dinars.

He was one of the At-Taba'een(ألتابعين), who used to go out at least once a year in Ghazoo(غزؤ).

Al-Hasan Ibn Abil Hasan(حسن إبن أبي حسن) said that, Now, in Surah Waqiyah(سورة الواقعة) you have two levels, you have a Sabiqoon(ألسابقون) and then you have As'haab-Ul-Yameen(أصحاب اليمين).

Now Sabiqoon(ألسابقون) are higher, Surah Waqiyah(سورة الواقعة) talks about three groups of people it talks about the Sabiqoon(ألسابقون) first and these are the highest levels in Jannah(جنة),

and the talks about Ahl-Ul-Yameen(أهل اليمين).

And these are the lower levels in Jannah(جنة) and then it talks about us As'hab-Ush- Shimal(ألصحاب الشمال), the people of hellfire.

So according to the Tafseer(تفسير) of Usman bin Abi Soda(عثمان بن أبي سودة), the fore runners are the ones, who go out first in Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So he says these are going to be the people in the higher levels of Jannah(جنة).

Al-Hasan Ibn Abil Hasan(حسن إبن أبي حسن) said that the Messenger of Allah sent an army, and among them was Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذاِبن جبل).

Muadh(معاذ) was late in going out with the army.

So the messenger of Allah saw him and said: I see that your company is one month ahead of you in paradise.

Now Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذاِبن جبل) did not stay behind because he had some housework to do or business to take care of.

Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذاِبن جبل) said: O Messenger of Allah!

I only stayed behind in order to catch the prayer with you.

And so that you can make Dua(دُعَا) for me, in order for me to be ahead of my company.?

The reason why, I stayed bind is to be ahead of them, not behind them.

I wanted to attend Salah(صلاة) of Jama'a(جماعة) with you, probably could have been Jumuah(جمعة) on that day.

And I wanted you to make a special Dua(دُعَا) for me and exclusive Dua(دُعَا), so that I could be ahead of everybody else, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him:

No! They are ahead of you! Go and catch up with them!

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said: A journey in the morning in the cause of Allah is better than the world and everything on it.

And a journey at the end of the day in the cause of Allah is better than the world and everything on it.

And this is narrated in a Al-Sunan Al-Bayhaqi(سنن ألبيهقي), so go out when?

Hadith(حديث) says in the morning and in the evening.

Now An-Nawwawi(ألنووِي), he comments and he says the Hadith(حديث) does not restrict rewards to the beginning or the end of the day, it is just to point out that spending a very little time in the cause of Allah carries a very great reward.

So whenever you go out there it is worth, a world and everything in it.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) narrated that the Messenger of Allah said: Whoever goes out in His cause was no objective, but fighting in His sake, and believing in Him and His messengers, Allah will guarantee for him, either to enter him into paradise,

or to return him home with rewards or booty.

In the name of whom Muhammad(محمد) soul is in His hand, whoever is injured in the path of Allah, the injury would come on the Day of Judgment, as it was in this world.

The color is that of blood, and the smell is that of musk.

In the name of whom Muhammad(محمد) Soul is in His hand.

If it wasn't for making things difficult on Muslims, I wouldn't have stayed behind any army leaving in the path of Allah.

But I'm unable to find sustenance for the Muslims, who stay behind.

So these are Muslims who weren't trying to find an excuse to stay behind.

These were Muslims who dearly wanted to go out but they couldn't, because they had no support.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ is staying behind in Jihad(جهاد) that is Fardh Kafaya(فرض كِفاية), not Farz Ain(فرض عين) this is Fardh Kafaya(فرض كِفاية), it is Ghazoo(غزؤ).

And we understand how difficult it was because Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says about them, That they're turning away with tears in their eyes because they have no money to go out in Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله)

they would go to a Rasool Ullah and they would say, Jahizna(جحزنا), finances us!

Rasool Allah ﷺ would say: I have nothing to give you, they would walked away with tears rolling down their cheeks.

There's so sorry that they're unable to fight Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So you can see the contrast between the Mumineen(مومنين) and Munafiqeen(مُنافقين).

The Munafiqeen(مُنافقين) they come to Rasool Allah ﷺ, inventing every type of excuse and when Rasool Allah ﷺ excuses them, they go away happy feeling that they have achieved something.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ says, In the name of whom Muhammad(محمد) soul is in His hand.

I wish, I could fight in the Cause of Allah, and then be killed, and then fight, and then be killed, and then fight, and then be killed, and this is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح المسلم).

Now An-Nawwawi(ألنووِي), it's either An-Nawwawi(ألنووِي) or Ibn Hajar(إبن حجَر).

It poses the question, how could Rasool Allah ﷺ desire to die, when he's guaranteed that he's not going to die, for him is Mustahih(مستحيح), dying of Rasool Allah ﷺ in the battlefield is something that is impossible,

because Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ said: Allah is going to protect you, from people.

An-Nawwawi(ألنووِي) says that this first of all shows that it's allowed to ask for something, even though you know that cannot happen to you.

And it's to show that Rasool Allah ﷺ was so keen about the issue of Shahadah(شَهَادَة) that he even desired it for himself being the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

In other words, the reason why he said it, is an encouragement to Ummah(امة) to follow this path.

But even I, who will not be able to get it because Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has guaranteed me safety in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) from the hands of men,

even I would have desired that I would die in the sake of Allah and then come again and then die and come again, and then die.

Abdullah Bin Mukhaireez(عبدالله بن محيريز) narrates that his father was sent into the army, in the army of summer.

So they had to an army of summer, and an army of winter.

So he became extremely ill.

He said: Oh, my son!

Carry me into the land of the Romans.

The battlefield, wasn't the land of the Romans, he became ill he told his son carry me further, so I carried him, And he was still traveling through the land when he said: My son go fast.

I said: Father, but you're ill.

He said: My son, I want my death to meet me in the land of the Romans.

So I continued carrying him, until he died.

The son said: I was worried how would I find anybody to pray Janazah(جنازة) on him because he died a natural death, it wasn't a Shahadah(شَهَادَة).

So he was wondering where is he gonna find anybody to pray on him, in Hims(حمص) in Syria, when there are no Muslims around this is in the depths of the land of the Romans,

so the son said: I then saw ranks of men, whom I'm never saw before, dressed in white, praying on my father.

These are must have been angels whose Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ sent to pray Janazah(جنازة).

Now this is an interesting story narrated by Ibn Asakir(إبن عساكر).

The one before also was by Ibn Asakir(إبن عساكر).

This is the story of Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني), we talked about Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني) before, do you remember, what we said about him.?

Let's see if, your memories are fresh.

What did we say about Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني)? I talked about it, I think in the previous session.

A Karamah(كرامة) happened to him. Which Karamah(كرامة) was that? Which one? The fire! the fire! the fire!

He was the one who wasn't burnt in the fire.

Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني), he then set out in Jihad(جهاد) Fee Ardh-Ir-Ar-Rome(في أرض ألروم).

Saad Ibn Abdul Aziz(سعد إبن عبدالعزيز) said: Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني) died in the territory of the Romans.

During the reign of Muawiah Bin Abi Sufiyan رضي الله عنه.

He told Bisr Bin Arta'a(بسربن أبي أرطأء), Bisr Bin Arta'a(بسربن أبي أرطأء) was the leader of the army and Bisr Bin Arta'a he has some heroic stories.

And I think that Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس), will talk about them in, in his chapter about the history of Jihad(جهاد).

Bisr Bin Arta'a(بسربن أبي أرطأء), was the head of the army.

So Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني) went to him and he said: Appoint me, Now Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبو مسلم ألخولاني) was already injured that he was on the verge of dying.

So he's dying as a Shaheed(شَهِيد).

So he goes to Bisr Bin Arta'a(بسربن أبي أرطأء) and he says: I want you to appoint me as an Ameer(أمير) over the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء), who died.

He wants him, to appoint him as an Ameer(أمير) over the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء).

And I want you to give me a banner of war.

And I want you to make my grave, the closest of all the graves of the martyrs to the enemy.

So he is asking for three things.

Number one, you appoint me as an Ameer(أمير) over the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء), the ones who died.

Number two, you give me the banner of war, Ar-Raya(ألراية).

And number three, I want my grave to be the furthest into the land of the enemy, deep, in the territory of the enemy.

Why? He said: Because on the Day of Judgment, I want to be resurrected carrying my banner and leading the martyrs on Youm-Ul-Qayamah(يوم القيامة).

So he wants to carry on, even, on the day of judgment.

He wants to come on the Day of Judgment carrying that banner of war, with all of the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء) behind him.

The virtues of the dust in the path of Allah.

The messenger of Allah said: Whoever has his feet dirty in the path of Allah, Allah will save him from hellfire.

And that's in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

And this goes back to what we were talking about.

You know, with other Ibadaat(عبادات) that the whole that has given a Fazeelah(فضيلة).

But with Jihad(جهاد) it's broken into bits and pieces and every bit and piece, carries such a big Ajr(أجْر) with it.

So here the dust, even the dust in Sabeel-Lillah(سَبيل الله) carries an Ajr(أجْر).

In Musnad Imam Ahmad(مُسنداِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ), Abu Darda(أبودرداء) narrated, the Messenger of Allah said: Allah will not combine in the lungs of His servant, the dust of the path of Allah with the smoke of hellfire

and whoever gets his feet dirty in the path of Allah, Allah will keep him away from hellfire the distance of 1000 years travel for a fast horse.

And whoever is injured in the path of Allah will receive the seal of martyrdom.

The injury comes on the Day of Judgment with the color of saffron and the smell of musk.

It is a sign that would be recognized by all the creation, the beginning and the end, they will say, he has the stamp of martyrs.

When you do something for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, Allah takes, takes care of all of the other needs that you might have.

As a human being, we have a natural instinct of wanting to show off, of wanting to be famous, wanting to be recognized.

I mean these are, these are traits in the human being, that we are created with.

Now Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ tells you to put all of that aside and do the deed, purely for Him.

So you're not showing off, you're not doing it to be recognized, you're not doing it to be praised.

You're doing it purely for the sake of Allah.

Because you did it purely for the sake of Allah, Allah will take care of all of the other needs.

So, this martyr who was doing it purely for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ on the Day of Judgment Allah will give him that badge of honor that is seen by all of the creation, not just the people of his time.

Because the Shaheed(شَهِيد), who was doing it for Riya(رِيَاء), and went to hellfire because of it, only got recognized by the soldiers that he knew.

Maybe it's not more than 10, 20, 30 people.

And he ends up going to hellfire because of it.

While the person who is doing it for the sake of Allah will end up having the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) witness that, and the other Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء) and the Saliheen(صالحين) and the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم,

all of the creation will be brought together on the day of judgment to witness that this man is the Shaheed(شَهِيد) and the Shaheed(شَهِيد) will carry that badge of honor with him wherever he goes.

But he do something for the sake of Allah, Allah will, will give you more than what you could have got, If you did something for somebody else, for another object able reason.

And whoever fights in the path of Allah for a period equivalent to the time it takes to milk a camel is guaranteed paradise.

The virtues of riding the sea in Jihad(جهاد): Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) narrated, the Messenger of Allah, would visit Umm Haram Bint Malhaan(أم حرام بنت ملحان), she would feed him.

Umm Haram(أم حرام) was the wife of Ubada Bin Samit(عبادة بن صامت).

One day when he visited her after she fed him, she sat down to comb his hair.

The Messenger of Allah fell asleep.

He then woke up laughing.

She asked him what is making you laugh.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I was presented with some of my nation, who were going out to fight in the cause of Allah, riding the sea, like kings on thrones.

Now when the Arabs of Makkah and Madina.

They were do traveling by land, and only a few of them would travel by sea and it wasn't something that was in the custom of the Arabs of Hijaz(حجاز),

some of them like Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) for example, we know that they did travel by sea, the Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) of Al-Habsha(ألحبشه) also traveled by sea,

but their business travel was done by land, they would go to Yemen and then that they would go to Syria, so it was on land.

And the Arabs didn't fight in the sea.

If they did travel in the sea, it was for business reasons but they did not fight in the sea.

It was only after Islam, that they started fighting in the sea and the one, who was is considered to be the founder of the Islamic Navy is Muavia Bin Abi Sufiyan(معاوية بن أبي سفيان).

When he was the Ameer(أمير) of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

Not when it was Khalifah(خليفه), when he was Ameer(أمير) in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

That's when he sought permission to fight in the sea, and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه was reluctant to agree.

I mean, that shows you how cautious they were when it came to this area because it was an unknown area to them.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ saw that in his dream, he saw the first Muslims, who will go out in the sea, and he said I saw them riding the sea, like kings on thrones.

When Umm Haram(أم حرام), she heard that and what was her response?

She said: Am I going to be one of them.?

That's the first thing that came on mind.

Now this is a woman.

Right!

But Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) they were so attached to this and whenever there was Khair(خير) they wanted to be part of it, she said, will I be part of it?

She said: O Messenger of Allah! Ask Allah that I be one of them, you know like in the Hadith(حديث) of the Dajjal(دجال).
