So Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) wasn't really happy that these are the two, who are flanking him in the rank.

And while he was asking for something better.

The one on his right, poked him and said: O uncle! Tell me, where is Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل)?

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: What do you want about Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل)?

Yani(يعني) who are you?

He said: What do you want from Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل)?

He said: I heard and these were Ansaar(أنصار). He said: I heard that Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), was the worst enemy of Rasool Ullah, so I don't want my body to leave his, until one of us kills the other.

So I told him, and he said: Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: And then the one on my left, poked me, and he said: O uncle, where's Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).?

So I told them: Do you see that man?

And Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) says that he was like, you could know him because of the people surrounding him, very crowded.

He said: Do you see that man over there?

That's Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

So Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: They shot off like Falcons from both sides, and attacked Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), so you know don't estimate the person by the size or by the looks, you never know what hidden insight, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله).

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) was asking for something better, he did not know, that he was flanked by the two men who will actually kill Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

They're the ones, who disabled him, but then it was Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) who finished him of.

So what were the conditions that Amir Bin Qais(عامر بن قيس) make on his group?

Look at these conditions, three conditions.

He said, that I become your servant and I don't want anybody competing with me.

My condition is that you allow me to be the servant and nobody else competes with me in serving.

Number two, I become the one who calls the Adhan(آذَان) among you and I don't want anybody to compete with me in that.

Number three, I cover your expenses according to my ability.

If they agree, he would join them.

If they ever compete with them he would depart them and move on to find another group.

So he was quite serious about it.

And this is in Ibn Ul-Mubarak(إبن المبارك).

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: The early Muslims, if they would go out in armies they would strive to serve others and to make their company happy,

they would prefer others to themselves, they will do all of that for the sake of Allah and to gain His pleasure.

The issue of service, especially among the Mujahideen(مجاهدين), is an extremely important psychological thing for the group, because it gives a whole different flavor to the entire environment,

and it closes the door on Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) because Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: Tell My servants to speak good words because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) wants to cause you disunity among them.

And what happens is, in that environment Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) tries to take advantage of the difficulty of the environment because see when everything is getting on your nerves, you tend to be a bit intolerant,

and hot tempered, and that happens in travel.

It happens when you change your diet.

It happens when the climate changes.

So, all of this gets to you, and you lose your temper.

And that's why when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) heard somebody praising another Muslim.

He said: Did you do business with him?

He said: No!

He said: Did you travel with him?

He said: No!

He said: Then how can you make a judgment on that person?

So, there are some issues that bring the truth out of a person.

Because we put up sometimes some public manners.

Right!

But if you want to dig deep into this real person.

You have to put them through a test, Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

So, in the environment of Jihad(جهاد) because of all of these restraints and difficulties, the issue of service becomes very important because it is, what develops the love among the group,

you know when your brother, who could be older than you more experienced than you, wealthier than you, he comes and he serves you and he helps you out and he brings you the food,

that is something that you would never forget, and this is what develops the love among the brothers, so the issue of Khidma(خدمة), the issue of service is an extremely important area.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) when it comes to Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), there must be love among the group because you live and die with these people, that Muhabbah(محبة) has to be there.

It's not good to die when you have some bad feelings against the person, next to you.

Tayeb(طيِّب), Next chapter is chapter four, the virtues of Ribat(رباط).

And the virtues of the one, who dies in Ribat(رباط).

We talked about the definition of Ribat(رباط).

Did we talk about Ribat(رباط)?

We did, I think. So the meaning is clear, Allah says: Then kill the ones who are associated with Allah, other gods, wherever you find them, and capture them, and the besiege them and sit and wait for them at every place of ambush,

And this is Surah At-Toba(سورةالتوبة) verse 5.

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر), he says that, this Ayah(آية) means that you not only target the Kuffar(كفار).

But you wait for them, and you ambush them, and you try to get to them.

And this is Ribat(رباط) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So it's not just you fight them when you see them, you go after them and Allah says, Ambush, and that need Sabr(صبر), and that's Ribat(رباط) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says:

O you have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed.

And fear Allah that you may be successful and this is Al-Imran(ألعمران) verse 200 .

This is the last Ayah(آية) in Surat Al-Imran(سورة ألعمران).

The Ayah(آية) starts by calling the believers to have Sabr(صبر), patience.

Now what if your enemies also patient.

What do you do then?

You could be patient and then your enemy is patient.

And that's why it says: Saabiroo(صابرو) is Seegha Al-Mufaila(صيغة ألمفاعلة) which is something that happens between two sides.

Sabr(صبر) is something that you do on your own. That doesn't really relate to anybody else.

But Mufa'ala(مفاعلة) is something that is between two sides.

Saabiroo(صابرو) means and this is what the Mufasireen(مفسرين) and early scholars say, it means that you outdo the enemy in his patience.

So you could be patient, the enemy could be patient, but you need to have Musabira(مصابرة), so you outdo them in your patience.

So you're competing with them, and who can endure more.

And this is a very important concept in war, who would break first.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) in Gazwat Ul Yarmook(غزوة اليرموك), what he did.!

The Muslims were a little over I think 30,000, while the enemy was 200,000, plus.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) wanted to lay siege to this army.

Now, how could 30,000 besiege 200,000.?

So what Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) did!

And he had, Yani(يعني) his flanks, do that for him, primarily, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص), He said: Surround them and have their backs,

see because, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), what the Romans did, and this shows you how sometimes you try to protect yourself from something and your protection ends up being your demise.

The Romans had already had.

They already had experience with fighting the Muslims.

And what happened was they would always run away.

The soldiers didn't have the will to fight, so they would run away.

So what the Romans did?

Heracul(هراقل) actually, Heracules?

He ordered his brother who was the leader of the army to place the army in a place where there is no way they can run away.

And the only option is to fight.

So what Theodore did was, he chose the valley of Yarmook(يرموك).

This is the cliff to be towards their back, so they had a cliff towards their back and they tied the soldiers in chains so every 10 soldiers are tied together in chains.

When Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) saw that even before the battle, he said: Rejoice because rarely does a person who corners himself, ever come up with any good,

they tie themselves up in chains and they have their backs towards the cliff.

So what Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said is, just surround them from three sides and let the cliff behind.

So that's what the Muslims did.

But in order to be able to cluster them together and besiege them, because the army was huge and the Muslims are only 30,000.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) had to keep on cracking the army, again and again with the Al-Qarr Wal Farr(ألكرَّوالفرَّ).

Yani(يعني) you strike and you retreat, you strike and you retreat.

And one of those strikes Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), and about Allah O Alam(ألله أعلم), a few 100 horsemen with him.

It was the horsemen who do the brunt of this Al-Qarr Wal Farr(ألكرَّوالفرَّ).

They hit the army, so strong, and in that strike about 4000 died.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: When they, when they came out, he said: We have pushed them to the limits, if you hit them again they're gonna break.

He said: And Allah O Alam(ألله أعلم), how Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) knew that maybe he looked in their eyes or their actions, but he said we have hit them to the limit.

If you hit them again they're gonna break.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), that was the case.

So what he did is he was able to surround them.

And then he told part of his army to drive a wedge between the infantry, and the cavalry, to drive a wedge between them and separate the two,

because the infantry depends on the cavalry for cover.

They drove a wedge between the two.

And then Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said, to Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص), who was surrounding the cavalry, he said: Open for them and exit gate, open for them an exit.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) knew that if you open it up, they're gonna run out.

So the exit was opened, the cavalry ran out, and that is one Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) just besieged the infantry.

And what they did is they just push them from that cliff.

They say that about 80,000 fell and died.

Because what happens is they said: If you would kill one or two soldiers from the 10 and push them, they will drag all of the rest with them.

So it was a disaster for the Romans Theodore was killed.

About half of the Roman army was wiped out.

And it was one of the greatest victories for the Muslims, Ghazwa Tul-Yarmook(غزوة اليرموك).

So this is the reason why I brought this up is the issue of Masabara(مصابرة).

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: We have pushed them to the limit, strike them again, and they're going to crack.

The story of Antara Bin Shaddad(أنتراع بن شداد), Antara(أنتراع) is a legendary figure in non Islamic Arabia, it was before Islam and Antara(أنتراع) was like Robin Hood in the English literature.

He is undefeated warrior.

So a man came to Antara(أنتراع).

This was a powerful man, he came, he came to Antara(أنتراع), he said: How come you always win against your opponents.

What's the secret?

Antara(أنتراع) said: Stick your finger in my mouth and I'll stick my finger in yours, and let's both bite.

So every one of them is biting on the finger of the other, and then they're just squeezing cracking the bone.

So this guy, he screamed.

Antara(أنتراع) said that's why I win against my opponents.

He said: What do you mean?

He said: If you would have just waited for one more moment, I would have screamed, myself.

And that's how come I win, it is because I am willing to wait for that additional moment, I'm willing to endure, one more moment.

So that's what it is, it is Musabra(مصابرة), you just wait, push it a little bit further, and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will give you the Nasr(نصر).

Remains stationed.

Al Hasan(ألحسن) said: The meaning of persevere and endure in the verse is that the Muslims were commanded to outdo the non believers in endurance and steadfastness until the non believers, end up giving up their religion.

Ibn Jarir(إبن جرير), he says: Muhammad Ibn Ka'ab Al-Quradhi(محمد إبن كعب ألقرظي) used to say about this verse.

Be stationed in the Cause of Allah, until the nonbeliever leaves his religion for yours.

So the Musabra(مصابرة) here according to Muhammad Ibn Ka'ab Al-Quradhi(محمد إبن كعب ألقرظي) is that you keep on putting pressure until this man gives up his religion and says, Alright, fine, I'll take yours.

And that is Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) exactly what happened between Rasool Allah ﷺ and Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were putting up a fight, Badr(بدر), Uhud(أحَد), Khandaq(خندق), Al-Hudaybiyah(ألحديبية).

In the end what happened!

Started hearing statements like, what have these gods done for us, or like another statement, These swords are useless they haven't done us any good.

So they were giving up, they were losing hope in their gods.

Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان), he said, these gods are worthless.

So they gave up their pagan worshipping, and they came into the fold of Islam.

How come?

Because of the Murabadha(مرابضى) and Musabra(مصابرة).

Messenger of Allah said: Being stationed for a day in the cause of Allah is better than the world and everything on it.

This is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Salman Farsi(سلمان فارسي) said, the Messenger of Allah said: Being stationed in the path of Allah for a day is greater than fasting the days of a month, and praying its nights

and if he dies the rewards of the deeds he used to do would continue, and his provisions would continue.

He would be spared the trial of the angels of the grave.

That's in Muslim(ألمسلم).

The next Hadith(حديث) is an Al-Hakim(ألحاكم) and Abu Daud(أبوداؤد).

Every dead person would have his deeds, sealed, except the ones stationed in the path of Allah, before they would have their deeds grow until the day of judgment,

and they would be spared the tribulation of the angels of the grave.

Al-Qurtubi(ألقرطبي) states: This means that Ribat(رباط) provides the greatest rewards of all after death, the Messenger of Allah says, If the son of Adam(آدم) dies his deeds will terminate, except for a charity that he leaves behind,

knowledge that benefits, or a righteous son, that would pray for him.

Alright!

Now Al-Qurtubi(ألقرطبي) says that the Ajr(أجْر) of Ribat(رباط) is greater.

How come?

You know the Hadith(حديث) of three will have their deeds carry on after them.

But the Hadith(حديث) of Ribat(رباط), let me read to you Hadith(حديث) of Ribat(رباط) again so you can compare.

The Hadith(حديث) of Ribat(رباط) is every dead person would have his deeds sealed, except the one stationed and the path of Allah, for they would have their deeds grow until the day of judgment.

The other Hadith(حديث): If the son of Adam(آدم) dies, his deeds would terminate except for a charity that he leaves behind, knowledge that benefits

our righteous son that would pray for him.

How come Al-Qurtubi(ألقرطبي) considers Ribat(رباط) to be greater than these three.?

What is that?

That's not the reason, he mentions. No!

He hasn't mentioned that.

Charity, knowledge, and a righteous son would all end one day, a son that you left behind is gonna die, money that you leave behind is gonna run out,

and knowledge that you teach will be dispersed and might not be carried until the day of judgment.

But Ribat(رباط)!!!

The Hadith(حديث) says what you were doing, will carry on until the day of judgment, it is not gonna stop.

He says: It would end when the charity runs out.

When the knowledge is left, because we know the Hadith(حديث), that the time will come when knowledge will be left.

And when his son dies, but the rewards of the one stationed in the path of Allah continue until the Day of Judgment.

That is because all good deeds, cannot be practiced except when safety from the enemy is provided, and that is done by the Mujahideen(مجاهدين) who are stationed, and guarding the Ummah(امة).

And definitely Al-Qurtubi(ألقرطبي) knows very well, what Ribat(رباط) entails, because he's a scholar of Al-Andalus(ألأندلس) he's from Qurtaba(قرطبة).

Uthman(عثمان) stood on the pulpit and said: I heard from the Messenger of Allah, a Hadith(حديث) that I didn't tell you about previously, because I feared you would all leave from Madina.

I fear that you're gonna leave me alone.

I heard him say being stationed in the path of Allah for a day is better than 1000 days, anywhere else.

So let everyone choose what they like, this is in Musanaf Ibn Abi Shaibah(مصنف إبن أبي شعيبة), At-Tirmidhi(ألتِّرمِذِيْ) and in An-Nasai(ألنسائ).

One day in Ribat(رباط) is like better than 1000 days, anywhere else, including Makkah and Madina.

Uthman(عثمان) said: I didn't tell you because I didn't want you to leave me.

Then he had to tell him because he didn't want to consume knowledge.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: The Hadith(حديث) of Uthman(عثمان) is clear evidence of being stationed in the path of Allah for a day in the land of war

is better than spending 1000 days in any other place including Makkah, Madina and Jerusalem.

That is why Uthman(عثمان) didn't tell them the Hadith(حديث) before.

It was because, he was worried that they would all leave him.

The Sahabah(صحابه) and Tabieen(تابعين), whose numbers only Allah can count, who left Makkah and Madina and headed to the coasts of a Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) being stationed there until they died as a Shaheed(شَهِيد), or died a natural death.

Al-Haris Ibn Hishaam(ألحارث بن حشام), the brother of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was leaving Makkah to Jihad(جهاد), so the people of Makkah warned him, multitudes of people followed him out of Makkah, until he reached to Al-Bat'ha(ألبطحا),

the peoples around him cried.

When he saw that he himself cried and then said: O people, I am not leaving you because you are not dear to me, nor am I leaving this town because I prefer some other place.

But this affair, started in Islam and some men went out, they were not among the most noble of us.

We then woke up, but in the name of Allah if the mountains of Makkah turned into gold, and we spend it in the cause of Allah, we won't catch up with one day of their days.

Now if they are ahead of us in this world, we are going to try to catch them up in the hereafter.

I'm traveling to Allah.

He went to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) and he died as a Shaheed(شَهِيد) in the Battle of Yarmook(يرموك).

He is saying that the early Muslims, received the greatest reward and there's nothing that we can do to catch up with them, but we're gonna try to catch up with them using the fastest means and those fastest means were

Ribat(رباط) and Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So this is how, you can make up for a life that you have wasted.

It is the consensus of all the scholars that for a man to spend time stationed in the path of Allah is better than staying in Makkah and Madina or Jerusalem.

Ibn Mundhar(أبن ألمنذر) conveyed that that Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) was asked: Which is more beloved to you, staying in Makkah, or being stationed in the path of Allah?

He said: Being stationed is more beloved to me.

Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) also said: Nothing is equivalent in our view to fighting and stationing in the path of Allah.

A man asked Imam Malik(إمام مالك), Which do you prefer for me to stay in Madina or Alexandria.?

He said: Stay in Alexandria, because it was a land of Ribat(رباط) at that time.

Also the prayer of Ribat(رباط) is multiplied, so it's fasting remembrance of Allah, Recitation of Qur'an and spending the wealth in the sake of Allah,

In Sha Allah(إن شاءالله) we will carry on.
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسليمًا كَثِيرًا Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: فَقاتِل في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ لا تُكَلَّفُ إِلّا نَفسَكَ ۚ

وَحَرِّضِ المُؤمِنينَ ۖ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَكُفَّ بَأسَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا ۚ وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأسًا وَأَشَدُّ تَنكيلًا۞

لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَلَفَهُمْ يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ المُؤمِنينَ عَلَى القِتالِ ۚ إن يَكُن مِنكُم عِشرونَ صابِرونَ يَغلِبوا مِائَتَينِ ۚ

وَإِن يَكُن مِنكُم مِائَةٌ يَغلِبوا أَلفًا مِنَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِنَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا بِأَنَّهُم قَومٌ لا يَفقَهونَ۞

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: يَٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ ۚ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُواْ مِاْئَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّاْئَةٌ يَغْلِبُوٓاْ أَلْفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ۞

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ

وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ۞ أُولَئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ۞

حيَّ علی الجهاد تَوَلَّواْ وَّأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُواْ مَا يُنفِقُونَ۝

وَاللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ هل أَتَكْفِينَا فيه صَلَاةُ يَومٍ؟ قالَ رسول الله صلى عليه وسلم : لَا، اقْدُرُوا له قَدْرَهُ، ألجزاء من جنس العمل

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: وَأَعِدّوا لَهُم مَا استَطَعتُم مِن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِباطِ الخَيلِ تُرهِبونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُم وَعَدُوَّكُم وَآخَرينَ مِن دونِهِم لا تَعلَمونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعلَمُهُم ۚ

وَما تُنفِقوا مِن شَيءٍ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيكُم وَأَنتُم لا تُظلَمونَ۞

وَأَعِدّوا لَهُم مَا استَطَعتُم مِن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِباطِ الخَيلِ تُرهِبونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُم وَلَّى مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ

وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: أتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ ۚ فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن تَكُونُواْ تَأْلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأْلَمُونَ ۖ وَتَرْجُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَرْجُونَ ۗ

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: كفَى ببارقةِ السُّيوفِ علَى رأسِهِ فتنةً Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) said: جنتي في صدري سجني عبادتي ونفعي سياحة وقتلي شهادة

فما بيفعل عدائ بي Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says, إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ

مَن ذَا الَّذي يُقرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضعافًا كَثيرَةً ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَقبِضُ وَيَبسُطُ وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ۞

مَن ذَا الَّذي يُقرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضعافًا كَثيرَةً ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَقبِضُ وَيَبسُطُ وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ۞

مَثَلُ الَّذينَ يُنفِقونَ أَموالَهُم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَت سَبعَ سَنابِلَ في كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ ۗ

وَاللَّهُ يُضاعِفُ لِمَن يَشاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَليمٌ ۞

مَثَلُ الَّذينَ يُنفِقونَ أَموالَهُم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَت سَبعَ سَنابِلَ في كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُضاعِفُ لِمَن يَشاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَليمٌ۞

بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا ۖ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا ۖ قال مدخول يعني ألإنفاق في الجهاد من الرباط الخيل وعداد السلاح وغير ذالك

ورد القرآن بأن الحسنة في جميع أعمال البر بعشر أمثالها ، واقتضت هذه الآية أن نفقة الجهاد حسنتها بسبعمائة ضعف وحضر رسول الله المسلمين على الجهادورغَّبهم فيه وامرهم بالصدقة ، فحملوا صدقات كثيرة،

وكان اول من حمل ابوبكر الصديق بماله كله أربعة آلاف درهم فقال له صلى الله عليه وسلم هل أبقيت لأهلك  شَيْئًا؟

فقال: الله ورسوله أعلم وفي رواية ما وعد الله ورسوله من الرزق خير، و في رواية أبقيت له من الله ورسوله ثم جاء عمر بنصف ماله فقال له صلى الله عليه وسلم هل أبقيت لأهلك شَيْئًا؟

قال نصف ما جئت به مَنْ لِي بِمِثْلِ مَشِّكَل الْمُدَلَّلِ تَمْشِي رُوَيْدًا وَتَجِي الْأَوَّلِ يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا لِمَ تَقولونَ ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

كَبُرَ مَقتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ أَن تَقولوا ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا لِمَ تَقولونَ ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

كَبُرَ مَقتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ أَن تَقولوا ما لا تَفعَلونَ ۞

إنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ۞

مَنْ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَغْزُ وَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْ نَفْسَهُ بِهِ؛ مَاتَ عَلَى شُعْبَةٍ مِنْ نِفَاقٍ وَلَوْ أَرَادُواْ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّواْ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً

وَمَنْ عَجَزَ عَنْ الْجِهَادِ بِبَدَنِهِ وَقَدَرَ عَلَى الْجِهَادِ بِمَالِهِ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْجِهَادُ بِمَالِهِ وَهُوَ نَصُّ أَحْمَدَ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي الْحَكَمِ

وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَطَعَ بِهِ الْقَاضِي فِي أَحْكَامِ الْقُرْآنِ فِي سُورَةِ بَرَاءَةٌ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ: {انْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالا} [التوبة: 41]

فَيَجِبُ عَلَى الْمُوسِرِينَ النَّفَقَةُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى هَذَا فَيَجِبُ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ الْجِهَادُ فِي أَمْوَالِهِنَّ إنْ كَانَ فِيهَا

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) says: انْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالا ومنها يعني فقه هذه غزوة وجوب الجهاد بالمال كما يجب جهاد بالنفس وهو إحدى الروايتين عن أحمد وهي الصواب الذي لا ريب فيه

فإن الأمر بالجهاد بالمال شقيق الأمر بالجهاد بالنفس في القرآن وقرينه بل جاء مقدما على الجهاد بالنفس في كل موضع إلا موضعا واحدا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۚ

وهذا يدل على أن الجهاد به أهم وآكد من الجهاد بالنفس ولا ريب أنه أحد الجهادين كما قال النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم : من جهز غازيا فقد غزا فيجب على القادر عليه كما يجب على القادر بالبدن

ولا يتم الجهاد بالبدن إلا ببذله ولا ينتصر إلا بالعدد والعدد فإن لم يقدر أن يكثر العدد وجب عليه أن يمد بالمال والعدة وإذا وجب الحج بالمال على العاجز بالبدن فوجوب الجهاد بالمال أولى وأحرى

قد جعب جهل يوم القيامة أنا بريء من كل مسلم يقيم بين أظهر المشركين جاهِدُوا المُشرِكينَ بِأَموالِكُمْ وأَنْفُسِكُم وأَلسِنَتِكُم ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ

إِذ جاءوكُم مِن فَوقِكُم وَمِن أَسفَلَ مِنكُم وَإِذ زاغَتِ الأَبصارُ وَبَلَغَتِ القُلوبُ الحَناجِرَ وَتَظُنّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنونا۞

وَتَظُنّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنونا هُنالِكَ ابتُلِيَ المُؤمِنونَ وَزُلزِلوا زِلزالًا شَديدًا۞

وضال على خير الكفاعلة ومن سن فيي الإسلام سنة حسنة كان له أجرها وأجر من عمل بها من بعده Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: وَأَنفِقوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلا تُلقوا بِأَيديكُم إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ

وَأَحسِنوا  إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المُحسِنينَ۞

وَأَنفِقوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلا تُلقوا بِأَيديكُم إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ  وَأَحسِنوا  إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المُحسِنينَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا إِنَّ كَثيرًا مِنَ الأَحبارِ وَالرُّهبانِ لَيَأكُلونَ أَموالَ النّاسِ بِالباطِلِ لَيَأكُلونَ أَموالَ النّاسِ بِالباطِلِ وَيَصُدّونَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ۗ

وَالَّذينَ يَكنِزونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالفِضَّةَ وَلا يُنفِقونَها في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلا يُنفِقونَها في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَبَشِّرهُم بِعَذابٍ أَليمٍ۞

يَومَ يُحمىٰ عَلَيها في نارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَتُكوىٰ بِها جِباهُهُم وَجُنوبُهُم وَظُهورُهُم ۖ هٰذا ما كَنَزتُم لِأَنفُسِكُم فَذوقوا ما كُنتُم تَكنِزونَ۞

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: وَما لَكُم أَلّا تُنفِقوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ ميراثُ السَّماواتِ وَالأَرضِ ۚ لا يَستَوي مِنكُم مَن أَنفَقَ مِن قَبلِ الفَتحِ وَقاتَلَ ۚ

أُولٰئِكَ أَعظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذينَ أَنفَقوا مِن بَعدُ وَقاتَلوا ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الحُسنىٰ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرٌ۞

تُلقوا بِأَيديه إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ وَلا تُلقوا بِأَيديكُم إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ من جهز غازي فقد غزة من جهز غازي فقد غزة وقل لعبادي يقولوا التي هي أحسن إن الشيطان ينزغ بينهم

فَإِذَا انسَلَخَ الأَشهُرُ الحُرُمُ فَاقتُلُوا المُشرِكينَ حَيثُ وَجَدتُموهُم وَخُذوهُم وَاحصُروهُم وَاقعُدوا لَهُم كُلَّ مَرصَدٍ ۚ فَإِن تابوا وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكاةَ فَخَلّوا سَبيلَهُم ۚ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ۞

وَاقعُدوا لَهُم كُلَّ مَرصَدٍ وَاقعُدوا لَهُم كُلَّ مَرصَدٍ يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنُوا اصبِروا وَصابِروا وَرابِطوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنُوا اصبِروا وَصابِروا وَرابِطوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ۞

وَصابِروا أبشِرو فقيما يعتي بمحصورٌ بخير ورابطو هذه قط سيوف قبح الله ما أغنيت عنى شيئَا Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) said: صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
We're continuing with the leftovers from the section of Ribat(رباط).

Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) said: Allah has instructed us to become Muslim and we did.

So we are the Muslims.

He then ordered us to make Hijrah(هجرة), so we did, the people of Makkah, and we are the Muhajireen(مهاجرين).

He then told us to fight Jihad(جهاد) and you did.

So you the people of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام), are the Mujahideen(مجاهدين).

Now here, it doesn't necessarily mean that people who are from Ash-Sham(ألشَّام), he is talking about the people who are based in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام)

the Sahabah(صحابه), who went to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) and settled there, for Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

Spend money on yourself and your family, and the needy around you!

Since if you go out with a single Dirham(درهم) and bought some meat with it.

And you ate it, you and your family would be rewarded as spending 700 Dirham(درهم)s.

The interesting thing here in this statement of Uthman Ibn Affan رضي الله عنه is that, he even considers the money that you would spend on your family to be multiplied by 700.

What Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) is saying that as a Murabat(مرابط), any money that you spend, even if it's for your food and the food of your family is multiplied by 700.

Because the purpose of you being there is Ribat(رباط) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So anything that you spend as long as it's spent in a Halal(حلال) way, and without Asraaf(أسراف) extravagance is multiplied by 700.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: The spending in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) is multiplied if it is during the era of Uthman(عثمان), because all of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) was the land of Ribat(رباط),

it was expected that the enemy could descend on any part of it.

But now that applies only to the frontiers of it, which are exposed to the attacks by the enemy.

The frontiers would be the northern parts of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) and also the coastal line, because the coastline of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) remained as the land of Ribat(رباط).

The Messenger of Allah said: There will be people from my nation who will protect the borders, they will fulfill their duty.

But they will not be given what is due to them.

They are from me, and I am from them.

And this is in Ibn Al-Mubarak(إبن ألمبارك) and it is Hasan(حسن).

Rasool Allah ﷺ was talking about the obscure soldier, who's manning a post he's guarding Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله عزَّوَجل).

He's very simple, nobody really knows about him, but Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying that these are the ones, who are guarding the Ummah(امة), and they are from me, and I am from them.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: Among, the best livelihoods of people is that of a man holding the rein of his horse in the path of Allah,

flying on its back, whenever he hears a call.

The Hadith(حديث) says: Now, horses don't fly, but Rasool Allah ﷺ used the word Yateer Alaa Mat'ne(يطيرعلى متن) on his back to mean that this man, whenever he hears the call of Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله),

he swiftly responds to it.

It is as if he is flying to go and fight Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), and what is he flying for...?

He flies in search of killing or being killed.

And the man on top of a mountain peak or on the bottom of a deep valley, establishing prayers paying his Zaka'at(زكوة) and worshiping his Lord, until death visits him.

People see nothing from him, but good.

And this is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح ألمسلم).

So again, this is in the time of fittan(فتن), the best way to live is either as a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) or as a person who is seeking Halal(حلال) Rizq(رزق) away from people away from the fittan(فتن),

away from the temptations.

Two men came to the companion, Abdullah Bin Al-Haris Bin Juzae Az-Zabedi(عبدالله بن ألحارث بن جزء ألزبيدي).

He said welcome, and he handed them a pillow.

So these two men are At-Taba'een(ألتابعين), they visited a Sahabi(صحابي).

But even though he was a Sahabi(صحابي).

He was the one, who was serving them, you know, they didn't have the tradition of going in and kissing the knees or the hands.

These are At-Taba'een(ألتابعين), who came in to somebody who was senior.

This is a Sahabi(صحابي) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he is old in age.

Nevertheless, when they came in he was giving them pillows to sit on.

They said: We did not come for this but we came for you to tell us something that would benefit us, a hadith(حديث).

He said: Whoever does not treat his guests with generosity does not belong to Muhammad(محمد) and Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), it's is not part of the Hadith(حديث).

He's just telling them that I need to be generous to you.

Because whoever is not generous doesn't belong to Muhammadﷺ and Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

And when it comes to generosity we consider Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), to be the father of generosity.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام, he received three angels, and he slaughtered for them, a calf, a whole calf.

And he could have presented them with something else but out of his generosity, he slaughtered for them Ijl(عجل), and this Ijl(عجل) might have meant a lot for the family of Ibrahim عليه السّلام, but he slaughtered it for them.

And the Ayah(آية) describes it, as in one Ayah(آية), Ijl Sameen(عجل سمين).

He is fat, and in the other Ayah(آية) Ijl Haneez(عجل حنيذ), it is roasted.

So we know from these two Ayaat(آيات) that it was Ijl(عجل) calf, and it was big, fat, and it was roasted.

So it was barbecued meat that he served to the angels.

But the problem was they didn't even eat it, because they were Malaikah(ملائكة).

Blessed is he, so this is the Hadith(حديث) that is telling them.

Blessed is he, who spends his night holding the rain of his horse in the path of Allah.

Having a piece of dry bread and water as his breakfast, and woe to those who are feeding like cows, saying servant, take this and servant bring that,

all of that and they don't even remember Allah.

So they just eat and eat and eat without even saying Alhamdulillah(ألحمدلله), when they finish or Bismillah(بسم الله) when they start.

What about the period of being stationed, how long should it be?

Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) was asked, is there any period for being stationed he said 40 days.

So, you should have your 40 days Khurooj(خروج) in Ribat(رباط).

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) said: For me to be stationed for one night, next to the sea, and protecting the Muslims behind me is better than spending the night of Al-Qadr(ألقدر)

in the Masjid(مسجد) of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), or the Masjid(مسجد) of the Messenger of Allah.

And spending three days of Ribat(رباط) is equal to a whole year.

And the most complete period of Ribat(رباط) is 40 days.

This is by Abdur Razzaq(عبدالرزاق).

A man from Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) came to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

So Umar(عُمَر) ask him where were you.?

He said I was in Ribat(رباط).

Umar(عُمَر) said: For how long?

He said: 30 days.

Umar(عُمَر) said: You should have completed it 40.

Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه said: If you spent three days in Ribat(رباط), then let the worshippers, worship as they wish.

Ibn-e-Abi Shaibah(إبن أبي شعيبة), and it is authentic.

What he means by that is, no one can compete with the Ajr(أجْر) of three days Ribat(رباط) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah عزَّوَجل.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: The command in Ar-Ribat(ألرباط) is for a person to station himself to a vulnerable land, where the enemy is expected to attack.

The word Ribat(رباط) comes from Rabata(ربطة), which is to tie.

The Murabit(مرابط) does that with the intention of fighting the enemy or guarding the land, or even to increase the number of Muslims in that land,

the more dangerous the land is, the more rewarding it becomes, whether it is a seaport, or otherwise.

Imam Malik(إمام مالك), does not consider Ribat(رباط) in Jeddah(جدَّة), to be Ribat(رباط), because the enemy only attacked it once.

Imam Malik(إمام مالك) was also asked his opinion on the ones who live in the land of Ribat(رباط) with their families.

He said: They are not considered Murabiteen(مرابطين), because the Murabit(مرابط) is the one, who leaves from his home with the intention of Ribat(رباط) in a land of danger.

It appears to me that the one, who is living in an area of Ribat(رباط), and the only intention, he has is staying there is the Jihad(جهاد) or guarding the land,

and this person has the ability to move to another place without difficulty.

My opinion is that such a person is Murabit(مرابط) and would be rewarded accordingly, even if he is accompanied by his family.

The Sahabah(صحابه) and At-Tabieen(تابعين) used to live in the land of Ribat(رباط) with their families, with the intention of Ribat(رباط).

Maybe what Imam Malik(إمام مالك) meant was, those who were born in the land of Ribat(رباط), and brought up there, and they lived there because it was their homeland,

and the place where their families lived, and they are not there for the purpose of Ribat(رباط).

This is also the opinion of Ibn Atiyyah(إبن عطية), He states that the ones, who live in the land of Ribat(رباط) because it is their home, and the place of their work are considered protectors of the land, but not Murabiteen(مرابطين).

So to make it simple.

Niyyah(نية) is the key issue here.

If a person is living in that place with the intention of Ribat(رباط) and Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah then he Is Murabit(مرابط).

If the intention is because of money, because of work, because this is my homeland, because I love it.

I'm attached to the land, it's a different intention.

So the ones, who lives in the land of Ribat(رباط) for a purpose that does not exist in other places, or because his family insists on living there, or for the purpose of work is not a Murabit(مرابط).

Also, If a person is in the place of Ribat(رباط) and the danger of the enemy ceases to exist.

And nevertheless, this person continues to live in that place, that is an indication that the purpose of such a person is not Jihad(جهاد) and thus the person does not qualify as a Murabit(مرابط).

Now if there is a person living in the land of Ribat(رباط) and his intention is that whenever the enemy attacks, he would run away, then such a person is living in a state of sin,

because the moment the enemy attacks, it becomes a major sin to runaway.

So such a person is better off moving from the land of Ribat(رباط), because he is accumulating sin, all the time, with such an intention.

So, In the area is that one could consider now as land of Ribat(رباط) like Afghanistan, Iraq, Kashmir, Chechnya, because whenever there's lull in fighting,

it doesn't mean that the fighting has seized, you know, the fight still carries on, because these are invaded lands or Falastine(فلسطين).

If a person is living there, and their intention is that when an attack would come I would leave, then such a person is accumulating sin and this tells us something that living in the land of Ribat(رباط) could either be a blessing or it could be a curse.

You know you can't get out of it even.

You either may come out of Hasanat(حسانات), or you lose a lot of Hasanat(حسانات) by the mere existence in that place.

Virtues of guarding in the path of Allah.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) narrated the Prophet said: Let the slave of Dinar(دينار) and Dirham(درهم) of quantify and Qameesa(قميصه) perish, as he is pleased.

If these things are given to him.

And if not, he is displeased.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is making Dua(دُعَا) on these people.

He is saying: May they perish.

If they are given, they are pleased if they are not, they're displeased.

So the matter that controls their heart feelings is wealth, whether it goes up or down.

That's the whole purpose of life.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying Taisa(تعس), Taisa(تعس) is Dua(دُعَا) against them.

May they perish and then Rasool Allah ﷺ says: And Takas(تكس) means: If you fall down, and then you try to stand up again you fall down again.

Meaning, let this person fall down and then fall down again and not be able to stand up.

And if they are hit with a thorn, let him not find anyone to take it out of him.

Because with thorns, you have a certain clip that pulls it out.

And you might need the help of somebody to do that for you.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying may these people not have anybody to help them.

Why? Because their intentions are purely for Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

This is figurative speech here, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying that a person whose sole intention is Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), and they are servants and slaves of wealth.

May these people not succeed in what they want and whenever they fall down into a problem or catastrophe, financial problem or whatever it is,

May Allah have them fall in another one again.

And whenever they get into trouble, May Allah let them find anybody to take them out of that trouble.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Paradise is for him, who holds the reins of his horse to strive in Allah’s cause with his hair unkempt and feet covered with dust.

If he is appointed in the vanguard, he is perfectly satisfied with his post of guarding.

If he is appointed to the rear ward, he accepts his post with satisfaction.

He is so simple and unambiguous, that if he asks for permission, he is not permitted.

And if he intercedes, his intercession is not accepted.

And this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

This is the personality of the Ideal Muslim soldier.

He is living a life of difficulty, first of all, because he is a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) he can't even find a barber to take care of his hair,

his hair is unkempt his feet are loaded with dust.

His clothes are simple.

Nevertheless, he's still satisfied with that.

And wherever the Ameer(أمير) would put him, he'll be happy.

So the second quality that he has is Ta’aa(طاعة), obedience, put me in the rear, I'm very pleased.

You know, I'm not gonna just take it and swallow it.

I'm happy! Put me in the front. I'm fine!

Have me guard for the entire night, I will be happy with it.

And then it's the life of commitment, he is on his horse Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Paradise is for him, who holds the reins of his horse to strive in Allah’s cause.

So he has dedicated his life to this cause.

It's not a seasonal thing for him.

And then add to that, you know, he's doing all of this to serve the Ummah(امة), but because he didn't get to establish a wide network of friendship and business relations and,

you know he's not part of that game.

Nobody knows him.

He's a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), that's ambiguous nobody knows who he is.

So if it goes to make Shafa'a(شفاعة) for someone over himself, he's turned down.

If he seeks permission to come into a place, nobody allows him, because nobody knows him.

So in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), he is obscure.

His name is not even known, but to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ,  Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ knows him very well.

And there are plenty of soldiers like this in the Ummah(امة), in every generation.

And these were the ones, who did the brunt of the fighting.

It is their blood that conveyed to us the Islam that we know and we don't even know who their names are.

And that's why when we will read that, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) once was receiving news about one of the battles, so they were telling them about all of the people who died whom were known.

But then they said then, other people that you do not know but Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) interrupted and said but Allah knows them, Allah knows them very well.

So they have humbleness, they are sincere, they are not doing it for fame.

Abdullah bin Amr(عبدالله بن عمرو) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: Two eyes will not be touched by hellfire.

An eye that cries from the fear of Allah, and an eye that spent the night in the guarding post, in the path of Allah, this is in At-Tirmidhi(ألتِّرمِذِيْ).

Abu Rehanah(أبوريحانة) narrates: We were with the Messenger of Allah, in an expedition.

During our travel, we passed over a high place, and we spent our night in that location.

The weather was very cold so I saw some people digging for themselves holes in the ground.

They will then crawling to them and cover themselves with their shields to protect themselves from the cold weather.

So imagine, digging for yourself a hole in the ground and then you crawl into it, and hide.

First of all because the ground is a bit warmer it retains more of the heat.

Plus it shields you from the wind, and Sahabah رضي الله عنهم would have a mantel one piece of cloth to wrap them but it wouldn't be sufficient.

And sometimes it could get quite cold in the desert, the temperatures, shoot up very fast during the daytime and they sink, very fast at night.

So you have both extremes.

So now they're hiding in those holes, and they're covering themselves with their shields and cover themselves with their shields to protect themselves from the cold weather.

When the Messenger of Allah, saw that he said: Who would be our guard tonight and I would pray for him.?

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ offered this incentive because of the condition was quite cold.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I will pray for you if you if you come forward.

So one of the Ansaar(أنصار) stepped forward and said: I would O Messenger of Allah!.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ told him to come close to him and then he asked him, his name.

After the man replied the Messenger of Allah made a long prayer for him.

Abu Rehana(أبوريحانة) is saying when I heard the prayer of the messenger of Allah I went to him and said: I also want to be a guard.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him come close.

And then he asked me who I was?

I said: Abu Rehana(أبوريحانة).

He then made a prayer for me and it was shorter than the earlier one.

Then he said: Hellfire is prohibited from an eye that cries from the fear of Allah and hellfire is prohibited from an eye that was awake, guarding in the path of Allah,

Ahmad(أحمد), Musannaf Ibn Shaibah(مصنف إبن شَيبة), and An-Nasai(ألنسائ) and Ibn Hakim(إبن حاكم).

Madhool(مدخول) narrates, whoever spends the night guarding in the path of Allah until the morning would have all of his sins fall away.

Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaibah(مصنف إبن أبي شَيبة).

Sahal Bin Hanzalia(سهل ابن الحنظلية) said: They were with the Messenger of Allah, on the day of Hunain(حنين), we walked that entire day.

A night he came to the Messenger of Allah and said: O Messenger of Allah, I went ahead of you until I reached, so and so mountain, and I found all of their Hawazin(هوازن) with their woman, camels and sheep, assembling at Hunain(حنين).

The Messenger of Allah, smiled and said: Those will be a booty for the Muslims tomorrow In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

Possibly Rasool Allah ﷺ could have received a promise from Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ that this would, this would happen.

But the other possibility is that this was a reflection of the personality of Rasool Ullah.

Whenever he would receive news that could be seen as demoralizing, Rasool Allah ﷺ would turn it around into good news to raise the morale of the army.

So here, this man is coming to Rasool Allah ﷺ with a bad piece of news.

Hunain(حنين) with their women, with their children.

You know when they would have their women and children with them, that's an indication that they're taking the battle very seriously.

Similar situation happened in Ghazwa Al-Khandaq(غزوة الخندق).

And by the way, Ghazwa Al-Khandaq(غزوة الخندق) was one of the worst moments for the Muslims.

You had an army of 10,000 surrounding Madina.

It was a coalition of various Arab tribes, alongside the Jews with Munafiqeen(مُنافقين) from within, assisting them.

So, it was a very, very tough time for the Muslims.

And that's, by the way when the Ayah(آية) was revealed.

They attacked you from above and from beneath and your hearts are pounding in your throats and your eyes are dizzy.

It was a Zilzal(زلزال), Zilzal(زلزال) is an earthquake.

It was an earthquake for the believers.

So that was one of the toughest moments on the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, the toughest moment of all within Al-Khandaq(ألخندق), was when the news was brought to Rasool Allah ﷺ that Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) have broken their agreement with the Rasool Allah ﷺ.

This was, the catastrophe.

Because Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) were within the city limits.

Al-Madina(ألمدينة) was surrounded by some natural production, you had Al-Harrah Sharqiyah Wal Harrah Gharbiyyah(حرَّة شرقية والحرة غربية).

These are rocky volcanic tracks.

These are not mountains, it's level plan but it has a lot of volcanic rocks and they're very sharp.

And it makes it very difficult for an army to march through it.

So that was a natural protection from Madina from the east and the west, from the south, you had the palm groves, miles and miles of palm groves.

So, the attack would come from the north.

If Madina would be attacked, it will be attacked from the North.

That's where the Sahabah(صحابه) dug the trench.

But the problem is that now Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) are within the city limits and, Rasool Allah ﷺ had an agreement with them, a peace agreement,

and the peak hour Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) break their agreement with Rasool Allah ﷺ, and join in hands with the coalition.

Rasool Allah ﷺ asked one of the Sahabah(صحابه) to go and check if the news was true because Rasool Allah ﷺ heard a rumor that Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) have betrayed, they have committed treason.

So Rasool Ullah sent two of the Sahabah(صحابه), he said: Go and investigate the matter for me.

If you found that they are still up to their word, tell me publicly.

If you find out that they have committed treason, give me a sign.

So they went, they found out that Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) have betrayed their agreement so they came back to Rasool Allah ﷺ, and they gave him a sign, without speaking that Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظة) have actually betrayed the agreement.

I think the call on the sign was I think like a slit of a throat or something, and Rasool Allah ﷺ have understood that.

What did Rasool Allah ﷺ say?

And look at the orders of Rasool Ullah, Don't make it publicly because he doesn't want to demoralize the Muslims.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Abshiru(أبشِرو)! Rejoice with the good news.

He didn't tell him what it was.

He said: Abshiru(أبشرو)! Be happy!

So he would turn everything around.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) that positiveness was also inherited by the Khalifah(خليفه) after him, khalifa-Tu-Rasul Ullah(خليفةالرسول الله), Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه would receive these news about what's happening with the Murtaddeen(مرتدين), and it would only make Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) stronger and stronger,

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was asked. He was told, The disasters that befell you, if they fell on a mountain, the mountain would break.

And if it fell on the oceans, the oceans would sink.

How were you able to handle them.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: Since I had fear with Rasool Allah ﷺ in the cave in Hijrah(هجرة).

I never had fear after that.

Why because that is when Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ revealed the Ayaat(آيات) that say, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is telling Muhammadﷺ, to tell your companion: Don't have sadness or sorrow because Allah is with you.

He said: I never felt fear after that, when he sent out the four armies to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

The army of Abu Obaidah Amr Bin Jarrah(أبوعبيدةعمروبن جرَّاح), the army of Yazeed Bin Abi Sufyaan(يزيدبن أبي سفيان), the army of Sharhabil Bin Hasana(شرحبيل بن حسنة), and the army of Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص).

Four armies into Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

The objective was to open Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

And Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) was under the control of the Romans.

The Romans took this advance quite seriously, so they assembled huge armies.

These armies that Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) sent were averaging about 4000 each.

The Romans would meet them with 50,000, 70,000, 90,000 each.

Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة) sent in a letter to Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه, telling him.

It's a long letter but two important points.

He said: Heracul(هراقل) has moved from his capital Constantinople, and set base in Antakia(أنتاكية) in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) to be close to the events.

In other words, the Romans are taking this very seriously.

The second point that he mentioned in the letter.

Is that!

That the Roman Emperor has mobilized his people from the four corners of his empire.

So basically to make it brief, the letter was an S.O.S. message to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), help me!

I need help! I need madad(مدد) and this bad news, because Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه doesn't have any soldiers to give.

He has exhausted all of his forces in Iraq, and Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) sends back a letter telling Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة).

When you say that, Heracul(هراقل) has left his capital and moved into Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

That's good news that he is moving out of his kingdom, he's leaving his kingdom, he left his capital, that's a good sign for us.

See how he turned it around and then he told Abu Obaidah(أبوعبيدة).

And when you mentioned to me that he has mobilized, his forces from the four corners of his empire.

He said: And when you tell me that they have mobilized their forces.

This is what you and I, already knew before.

Did you ever think that the people will walk out of their kingdom, and leave their dominion without a fight.

It is expected that they're going to mobilize for you.

What else do you expect.

And then he told him and I want you to depend on Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

And then on the soldiers that you have, and not to ask for anything more.

Don't ask for anything else, meaning being content with what the Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has given you, and the soldiers you have.

But then he said: In the end of the letter.

Nevertheless, I'm going to support you with reinforcements, until I make you happy.

And that's when Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) sent into  Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) to go and rescue the Muslims.

He told them to go from Iraq to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

But the thing is that the leader must have the ability to put confidence in the hearts of the followers, because if the leaders are shaking, then the entire army will just give up.

So it's very important that the soldiers, whenever they are in a moment of difficulty they look up to their leader, and that gives him tranquility and peace.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), or I think one of the Sahabah(صحابه) said: When we, when the battle gets hot.

When the battle gets hot, we would go and hide behind Rasool Allah ﷺ.

They would seek comfort from him.

That's where, they would get it, he would recharge our batteries.

That's a very important quality and that's a quality that Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) possesses.

You know whenever a soldiers have fear, all what they would have to do is go and take a look at Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

Your spirit comes back to you.

So this is a very important issue for an Ameer(أمير), in Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) to have these Amaal Al-Qalb(أعمال ألقلب),

because Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) is not just something of the limbs.

The heart is the foundation, the heart is the foundation of the whole thing, like what I told you the statement of Ibn-Al-Qayyim(إبن ألقيم) about the Romans and the Persians the hearts failed them, when they needed them most.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Those will be a booty for the Muslims tomorrow In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

He then said: Who would be our guard tonight!

Anas Bin Marsad Al-Ganavi(أنس بن مرصد ألغنوي) stepped forth and said: I would O Messenger of Allah, the Messenger of Allah said: Then, ride!

So he mounted his horse and came to the Messenger of Allah, the messenger of Allah said: Face this valley, until you reach the top of it and don't let us be ambushed from your direction.

When we prayed, our morning prayers the Messenger of Allah said: Did you see your knight.?

They said: We didn't!

The Messenger of Allah kept on looking towards the valley in his Salah(صلاة).

When he finished his prayers. He said: Rejoice!

Here comes your knight.

We continued looking through the trees in the valley, until the knight appeared, and he came and stood in front of the Messenger of Allah.

He said: I went until, I reached the top of the valley, where the Messenger of Allah told me to be, until the morning and I didn't spot anyone.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Did you leave your post.

He said: No!

Except to pray or respond to the call of nature.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: You've guaranteed yourself Paradise, and there is no harm on you, even if you don't do any good after this day.

This is in Abu Daud(أبوداؤد), Musnad Abu Uwana(مسندأبوعوانة), Al Hakim(ألحاكم) and it is Sahih(صحيح).

Ibn Umar(إبن عمر) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: Shouldn't I tell you about the night, that is better than the night of Al-Qadr(ألقدر), the night of Power?

A guard who is guarding in a land of fear, not knowing whether he would return to his family or not.

This is in Al-Musannif As-Sunnan Al-Kubra(ألمصنف ألكبرى) by Al-Bayhaqi(ألبيهقي) and in Al-Hakim(ألحاكم) and it's authentic.

Chapter five.

The rules and virtues of target shooting, the virtues of target shooting and this would apply to all modern forms of weaponry.

In Islam we take things generally, and we apply them to any similar situation, Allah says: And prepare against them whatever you are able to have power,

that's Al-Anfal(ألأنفال) verse 60.

Uqba Bin Amir(عقبة بن عامر) narrated: I heard the Messenger of Allah on the pulpit say, and prepare against them whatever you are able of power.

And you know see when, I read the name of Uqba Bin Amir(عقبة بن عامر), Yani(يعني) Uqba Bin Amir(عقبة بن عامر) was an Ameer(أمير) of Jihad(جهاد).

RACING.

It is the consensus of the scholars of the Ummah(امة) that competitions in horse racing and target shooting are not only allowed, but are Sunnah(سنة),

and the one who participates in them would be rewarded as long as the intentions is to prepare for the Jihad(جهاد).

Rules of betting on target race on horseback racing.

Number one, race needs to involve an animal that could be used in Jihad(جهاد), such as a horse or a camel, as is the consensus of the scholars, and in mules, donkeys and elephants, according to our Madh'hab(مذهب).

So these must be animals that are used for Jihad(جهاد), for example, you can't really have chicken racing or Beatles racing, or… it has to be an animal that could be used for Jihad(جهاد).

And that's why there's a difference of opinion when it comes to mules, donkeys and elephants, because some say that Muslims don't use them in Jihad(جهاد).

Number two, the existence of a clear starting and ending point.

Otherwise, the race is invalid.

Number three, the entire amount of money or at least most of it goes to the winner.

Number four, If the two racers themselves contribute the money there needs to be a third person with them, this third person would get all the money if he wins,

but if they win, he gives them nothing.

The one who wins among the two would get the money contributed by both.

Number five, there needs to be a feasibility that any one of the races could win, meaning it is not impossible for one of them to win due to disadvantage.

Otherwise the race is considered unfair, and it becomes invalid from a Shariah(شريعة) point of view.

Number six, the identification and agreement on the specific horses or camels participating prior to the race.

Number seven, the identification and agreement on the riders prior to the race.

Number eight, the distance of the race needs to be possible to finish.

Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عمر) said: The Messenger of Allah had the horses trained for racing run from Hafiyah(حافية) to Saniah Tul Wida(ثنية الوداع).

While he had the untrained horses raised from Saniah Tul Wida(ثنية الوداع) to the Masjid(مسجد) of Banu Zuraiq(بنوزريق).

The training of horses for racing at that time involved, among other things, gradual reduction of their diet for them to become slimmer and more capable of running.

Sufian(سفيان) said: The distance between Hafiyah(حافية) and Saniah Tul Wida(ثنية الوداع), is five to six miles and the distance between the Saniah Tul Wida(ثنية الوداع) and Masjid(مسجد) of Banu Zuraiq(بنوزريق) is one mile.

Number nine, the agreement on the amount of the betting money.

Number 10, The avoidance of conditions that invalidate the contract.

The rules of betting on target shooting.

Number one, the existence of a third person if both archers contribute the money.

Number two, the similarity of the equipment used for example, it is not allowed for one party to use a bow and arrow while the other is using a spear.

Number three, the target needs not to be impossible to strike nor too easy.

But should it be possible to strike.

Number four, all of the following needs to be specified before the competition, the amount of money contributed to the betting.

The number of shots to be fired, the distance in which to shoot from and the order in which the participants to shoot.

Number five, the specifications of the two competitors prior to the competition.

Number six, the starting position needs to be specified and it should be equal for both.

When it came to the other types of work like agriculture and pottery and paving the roads and whatever, this wasn't something that Sahabah(صحابه) would do.

The Sahabah(صحابه) would fight in the battlefield and live off their swords.

That was the way of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم.

They were not engineers or professors or doctors.

I am not saying anything against these professions, but we're talking about what the Sahabah(صحابه) were.

That was the way of the Sahabah(صحابه).

The best way to summarize the personality of Rasool Allah ﷺ is through his own words.

He said: I am the prophet of mercy, I am the prophet of war.

And he said: I am the smiling Prophet, but I'm also the one, who kills.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ had that pleasant personality, soft personality, mercy, but his sword was very sharp.

Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبنِ ألقَيِّم) said: Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) stated that training with your spear in places where Jihad(جهاد) is needed is greater and reward than voluntary Salah(صلاة).

Put the right thing in the right place.

You know when Napoleon rolled into Egypt, some of the Shyookh(شيوخ) of the Turk, they went into the Masjid(مسجد) and they started reading Bukhari(بخاريْ).

They said: Bukhari(بخاريْ) will save us from Napoleon, reading Bukhari(بخاريْ) has his place and picking up your sword and going to fight has its place.

Put the right thing the right place, that is Hikmah(حكمة).

Hikmah(حكمة) is to do the right thing, the Right Place the right time, the right way.

Abdullah Ibn Abi Aofa(عبدالله إبن أبي ‘وفة ) narrated that the Messenger of Allah was waiting for an enemy to attack but when the sun was setting, he said:

Don't desire meeting the enemy, but when you do be firm, and realize that Paradise is beneath the shadow of the swords.

The Muslim is not trigger happy seeking fighting, love chaos. No!

Don't ask for it. Don't ask for trouble. But when it comes you need to be fair.

Abu Bakr Bin Musa(ابوبكر بن أبي موسى) said: I heard my father say, Paradise is beneath the shadow of swords.!

A man dressed in poor clothes stood up and said: O Abu Musa(أبوموسى).

Did you hear that from the Messenger of Allah? He said: Yes!

The man went back to his companions and gave them his Salam(سلام) then he drew out his sword broke his sheath and went on to fight, until he was killed.

This is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح ألمسلم).

Question!

It's not specific to archery, it is general to every form of shooting that is involved in Jihad(جهاد).

Therefore that would exclude darts because darts is more of a thing for casinos or bars, it is not in the battle field.

Question!

Question is, is there anything in the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ that indicates that towards the end of time we'll be heading back towards horseback and arrows and swords.

The  Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ that talk about the end of time mentioned swords, spears, horses, bows and Arrows.

So the Scholars had two views.

One view is that there's literal towards the end of time, the time of Malahim(ملاحم), the time of fittan(فتن) people will be using swords, arrows, spears, riding horses.

So that's one view now, how could we understand this view.

There must be a reason that would lead the people into using these old forms of weaponry.

People not going to voluntarily drop an AK 47 and pick up a bow and arrow.

The only reason why they would do that is because of the unavailability of anything else.

And this has led to some try to find what could go wrong to end up leading to that happening.

So they would say like a an asteroid might hit the Earth and then you'll ends up losing Technology, or there would be a nuclear disaster around the world that would just wipe out all forms of technology,

or the world will run out of oil, so people end up using horses.

This is how they justify that.

These are the ones who take the wording of this specific Ahadith(احاديث) to be literal.

The other opinion is that these words are metaphorical.

The sword stands for the rifle, the horse stands for the tank or the armored vehicle or whatever.

And the ones, who would argue for this position would say that, let's even assume that an asteroid hit the world or there was a nuclear war or whatever.

Science is cumulative, and it's in the brains of men and you cannot wipe that out.

Even if, let's say all of these weapons are destroyed the capability of manufacturing them again is there.

Humanity progresses and it doesn't lose what it had.

They build upon what they had.

And they would say that the reason why the Rasool Allah ﷺ used, sword, horse, bow and arrow in the Hadith(حديث) because Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was speaking to the people according to their level of understanding, that's number one.

Number two, the vocabulary of the language doesn't include the words for these modern inventions because language is set by man.

A man can only give a name to something that he knows.

I mean you can't give a name to some to something that you have never experienced or seen in your life.

So there are limitations in language that that force the usage of some words to mean something else.

And to me this appears to be a stronger opinion.

Not to say that horses would never be used I mean even now in the 21st century there is a use for horses and mules and donkeys I mean there are some mountains where there is no way a motorized vehicle could go up,

the only way is to use a mule or horse.

I would say this is a skill that is so important it's worth traveling specifically for it.

A person cannot do it it's worth traveling just for this to learn.

Because as we've seen it's such an important skill and it's such an important Ibadah(عبادة).

So, something that every Muslim male needs to possess.

It's worth a few 1000 pounds or whatever all the time.

Just like you make time for Hajj(حَجْ) or Umrah(عمرة), you need time for this.

Let me say something Yani(يعني). It is it is rifle shooting that you want to learn more than gun more than gun because the gun tends to be more of a personal protective protection within a few meters

that's about it it's not really a weapon of Jihad(جهاد), this is a rifle.

See with parachute jumping you need to have a plan for that.

And since none of brothers have a planes, maybe it's not very relevant skill.

However, this wind whatever, gliding is maybe a skill that would be better because it might have some use.

Like Al-Bara Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك), gliding over the enemy.

See gliding, rock climbing, motorcycle riding, even surfing, surfing, as long as one stays away from the California Florida beaches and scuba diving.

These are all skills that could be beneficial.

This is where it is, this is where you'd find. You're not gonna find this anywhere else.

So Yani(يعني) there's so much that could be done by the western Muslim.
