parts.english:
Chapter 6: The virtue of injury in the sake of Allah.

Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) narrated Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Anyone who is injured in the path of Allah, And Allah knows who is injured in His sake,

He will come on the Day of Judgment with his injury bleeding.

The color is that of blood, and the smell is that of musk, Bukhari(بخاريْ) and Muslim(ألمسلم).

Ibn Daqiq Al Eid(إبن دقيق ألعيد), he says the presentation of injury on the Day of Judgment indicates two things.

Number one injury is the witness for the person.

Number two, it's a badge of honor for the person in front of all creation.

Ayesha(عائشه) said: Whenever Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه, would remember the day of Uhud(أحَد), he would say that is a day that belongs to Talha(طلحة).

I was the first to go back to the Messenger of Allah, but I found a man fighting with him and I said to myself, be Talha(طلحة) until he said,

Talha(طلحة) had run 70 injuries in his body and his hand was cut off.

Urwah Bin Zubair(عُروة بن زبير) said: Zubair(زبير) had three scars from sword wounds.

One was on his shoulder, it was so large, I would stick my fingers in it.

Two of them were from Badr(بدر), and one in the Battle of Yarmook(يرموك).

Urwah(عُروة) is, his son, who used to play with injuries of his father, the scars.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) said: Abu Dughanna(أبودغنة) throw himself behind the walls in Yamamah(يمامة) and his leg broke.

He kept on fighting with a broken leg, until he was killed, Ma'az Ibn Amr Bin Jamooh(معاذ إبن عمرو بن جموح), he said: I made the Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) my Target on the day of Badr(بدر),

when I found him I charged at him and hit him with my sword and cut his leg in two, then his son Ikrama(عكرمة) hit me on my shoulder, until he cut my arm off.

It's only remained hanging through my body by the skin of my side.

So the arm is cut is only hanging on the skin of the side.

But because fighting distracted me, I remain dragging it behind me for most of the day, he didn't even take a break.

Dragging my arm behind me annoyed me, so I placed my foot over it and pulled it off.

During the Battle of Yamamah(يمامة), you know, contrast that with, when there's a small knife cut on your finger and you put bandage on it and it's emergency at home,

during the Battle of Yamamah(يمامة), the first one to leave the Battleground was a Abu Aqeel(أبوعقيل), one of the Ansaar(أنصار).

An Arrow that hit him between his shoulder and his heart injured him.

He was then carried to the camp.

When the battle was turning against the Muslims, he heard, Ma'an Ibn Odae(معن إبن عدئ) calling the Ansaar(أنصار) to charge the enemy.

Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عمر) said: Abu Aqeel(أبوعقيل) stood up, so I asked him, What do you want to do?

He replied: They are calling my name.

I said they're not calling upon the injured.

He replied: They are calling upon the Ansaar(أنصار), and I'm one of them, and I will respond to the call, even if I would have to crawl.

He then put on his sword and went into the battle field and fought until, his left arm was cut off from the shoulder.

I said: Abu Aqeel(أبوعقيل)!

He responded with a weak tongue.

By saying: Yes!

Who won.

I said: Rejoice! The enemy of Allah was killed.

He raised his finger upwards and praised Allah and then he died.

I told my father Umar(عُمَر) about that, He said: May Allah have mercy on him, he persisted in search of martyrdom until he got it.

This is in Al-Waqedi(ألواقعدي).

Salim(سالم) the servant of Abu Hudhaifa(أبوحذيفة) was told that if he feared you wouldn't be capable of carrying the banner during the battle.

It could be transferred to someone else.

To understand the role of the Banner had, in those days, obviously without having loudspeakers and walkie talkies and internal radio between the soldiers,

they had to invent ways of sticking together, because the army needs to have some central command.

You can't just have a bunch of people fighting on their own.

There needs to be some unity and cohesion.

What happens is, the army would be split into small groups every group would have a leader.

And then the entire army or, if the army is big, it would be divided into flanks, or battalions, and each battalion would have a banner, a banner is a flag.

And if you had more than one maybe they would have different colors.

When the soldier is the midst of fighting, and he wants to know where his brother's are, he would look up and try to find where the banner is.

That's where you know where your people are.

So that is your post that you keep on looking for throughout the battle, because you know the dust is rising and swords are on top of your head, you could be disoriented.

You wouldn't know which direction is which.

So you look up to try to find where your banner is also, when you look up, you always want to see the banner there, because if it's not there, that's bad news.

It means that your army has been defeated.

The most important part of the army, is where the banner is.

And the carrier of the banner is playing the most important part.

Therefore, having that banner up and straight all the time is extremely important for the morale of the army and for the progress of fighting itself.

I mean, whenever the soldier looks up and doesn't find the banner, that's it the soldier loses hope and just runs away.

There's nothing else to fight for.

So, Salim(سالم) was, the servant of Hudhaifa(حذيفة).

He was the one charged with the responsibility of carrying the banner.

So they told him: Are up for it.

Can he do it.?

He said: I am the worst carrier of Qur'an, if that happened.

If I fail you, I am the worst carrier of Qur'an.

And this shows you that their understanding of carrying Qur'an means that you have to live by Qur'an I mean how could I be a hafiz(حافظ) of the Qur'an and then allow that banner to fall from my hands.

So his right hand was chopped he then carried the banner with his left hand.

His left hand was later cut, so he embraced the banner with what was left of his both arms, reciting, Muhammad(محمد) is not but a messenger, other messengers have passed on before him.

So if he were to die or be killed.

Would you turn your back on your heels, and who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all.

but Allah will reward the grateful, Al-Imran(ألعمران) Verse 144.

And then he recited and how many a prophet fought, and with him fight many religious scholars, But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the Cause of Allah,

nor did they weaken or submit, and Allah loves the steadfast, Al-Imran(ألعمران) verse 146.

When he was about to die, he asked his companions what happened to Abu Hudhaifa(أبوحذيفة).

They said: He was killed.

He then asked them about another person they responded that he was also killed.

He said: Then bury me between the two of them, that's narrated by Ibn Al-Mubarak(إبن المبارك).

Zaid Ibn Sabat(زيد إبن ثابت) said: On the day of Uhud the Messenger of Allah sent me to look for Saad Ibn Rabiya(سعد إبن ربيعة).

And if I find him, to deliver the Salaams(سلام) of the Messenger of Allah to him.

So I found him among the bodies of the dead pronouncing his last moments with around 70 injuries in his body.

I told him the Messenger of Allah delivers his Salaams(سلام) to you.

He said: Salaams(سلام) to the Rasool of Allah and Salaams(سلام) to you.

Tell the Messenger of Allah that I am now smelling the scent of paradise and tell my people the Ansaar(أنصار) that you have no excuse, if the Messenger of Allah is harmed while there is still an eye blinking among you.

After that he died.

This is Sahih(صحيح) narration.

Ibn Mubarak(إبن المبارك) narrates that he passed by a man on the day of the Battle of the bridge with his arms and legs cut off while he was crawling and reciting,

And whoever obeys Allah and the messenger, those will be with the ones, upon whom Allah has bestowed favor of the prophets and the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs, the righteous,

Someone asked him: Who are you? He replied, I am one of the Ansaar(ألأنْصَار).

Abu Hasan Al-Marwardi(أبوالحسن ألمروردي) narrated that Ali bin Abi Bakr(علي بن أبي بكر) said: I've seen a Muslim in a battle against the Romans, with his intestines spilled in front of him over his saddle.

He stuck them back to his stomach and tied around his turban, and he carried on fighting.

His Guts was pulling out, put them back, tied turban and carried on fighting.

And he ended up killing over 10 Roman soldiers before he fell down dead.

CHAPTER SEVEN, the virtues of killing an infidels for the sake of Allah, Allah says, Surah Muhammad(سورةمحمد).

So when you meet those, who disbelieve in battle, strike their necks.

Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: The non believer, and the one, who kills him will not be joined together and hellfire.

This is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم).

In other words, the Muslim is so rewarded for killing the non believers to the extent that Allah will never dishonor the Muslim by joining him with the Kafir(كافر) in hellfire.

I mean if you cut for him a one way ticket to Jahannum(جَهَّنَّم), be assured that you will get a one way ticket to Jannah(جنة).

He takes your place.

He takes your place in Jahannum(جَهَّنَّم).

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) he heard his brother Al-Bara(ألبراء) and Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك), and his brother were two different personalities, even though they're brothers.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك), was more of a scholar, and Al-Bara Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك) was more of… Yani(يعني) is a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) is an understatement.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) heard his brother Al-Bara(ألبراء) humming poetry, so he told him: O my brother you're humming poetry.?

What if this is the last thing you speak, if you die, and these are your last words, because for Sahabah(صحابه), the Qur'an replaced poetry.

So, Al-Bara(ألبراء) said: No!

Let me read, when Qur'an was real the Sahabah(صحابه) disliked reciting anything, by the way anything between brackets are my words, they're not Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس).

We have brackets, these are my illustrations, when Qur'an was revealed the Sahabah(صحابه) disliked reciting everything but Qur'an Anas(أنس) was warning his brother in saying that if you die, this moment and the last words you spoke were lines of poetry.

How would you face Allah.?

In another narration, he told him: To rather remember Allah.

Al-Bara(ألبراء) said: No!

A man like me won't die on his bed.

I've killed 99 of the non believers and hypocrites.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) told him: This might be the last thing you would say He said: Don't worry for somebody like me, will die in the battlefield In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

I've killed 99 Kuffar(كفار).

Umar(عُمَر) wrote to his military generals to never allow Al-Bara(ألبراء) to hold any position of leadership in the Muslim armies.

A complete bane across the board.

The reason Umar(عُمَر) said: He is too hazardous for the Muslims, During the battle against the forces of Musaylimah(مسيلمة) the liar.

He sat on a shield and asked the Muslims to carry the shield on their spears and throw him over the walls.

This was his elevator, sit on the shield, carried on the spears, to open the gates, he did open the gates but after he received over 80 injuries.

And that's in Al-Osaba(أثابة).

Anas(أنس) narrated that the Messenger of Allah said: There might be a man with disheveled hair, dusty clothes, who no one gives attention to.

But if he makes an oath, Allah will fulfill it for him.

One of them is Al-Bara Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك).

Now people would disregard this person, but if this person says Wallah(ولله) this would happen, Allah would fulfill his word, he's very close to Allah.

This is in At-Tirmidhi(ألتِّرمِذِيْ) and Al Hakim(ألحَاكِم).

So on the day of the Battle of Tastur(تستر) the Muslims asked the Al-Bara(ألبراء) to make an oath to give them victory, Al-Bara(ألبراء) said: O Allah, I make an oath that you hand us over their shoulders, and to make me follow Your prophet.

He then charged the enemy and the Muslims follow them, the Persian lost.

And the Al-Bara(ألبراء) was martyred and Allah fulfilled his oath.

Anas(أنس) narrated, when Abu Musa(أبوموسى) was appointed governor of Al-Basra(ألبصرة).

He told Al-Bara(ألبراء), to choose any position of leadership in his government, not in Jihad(جهاد), in this government, and he will be appointed to it.

Al-Bara(ألبراء) said: I don't want any.

Rather, I want you to hand me over my bow horse spear sword and shield, and then send me to Jihad(جهاد).

He sent him in an army Al-Bara(ألبراء) was the first to die.

So it's a battle Tastur(تستر).

Anas(أنس) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: On the day of the Battle of hunain(حنين).

Whoever kills a non-believer can loot him Abu Talha(أبوطلحة) killed on that day 20 of the non believers and looted them all, Abu Daud(أبوداؤد) and Al Hakim(ألحَاكِم).

CHAPTER EIGHT: The virtue of an individual or a small group, immersing themselves within a large army of non believers in search of martyrdom and causing damage to the enemy.

This chapter can be used as an evidence for what?

Amleat Ish'haadiah(عمليات ألشهادية), the whole chapter, you could reword it as the Tahseen(تحسين) legalization of Amleat Ish'haadiah(عمليات ألشهادية).

Amleat Ish'haadiah(عمليات ألشهادية), martyrdom operations, martyrdom operations.

Allah says, But those who are certain that they would meet Allah said, how many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah.

And Allah is with the patient.

Allah says, and up the people is he, who sells himself, seeking means to the approval of Allah.

And Allah is kind to his servants.

So, here you have a person who is selling himself to get the pleasure of Allah.

Mudrik Ibn Auf(مدرك إبن عوف) said: I was with Umar(عُمَر), when he received the messenger from An-Nouman Bin Makran(ألنعمان بن مقرن), Umar(عُمَر) asked him about the condition of the soldiers,

the messenger kept on mentioning to Umar(عُمَر), some of the well known people who died, and then he said: And others died, whom I don't know.

Umar(عُمَر) said: But Allah knows them.

The messenger said: And men who sold themselves to Allah, Mudrik(مدرك) said: Among those is my uncle people claim he killed himself by throwing himself into the enemy's army.

Umar(عُمَر) said: Whoever claims that, is a liar.

He is one of those, who sold this world for the next.

Thus is in Al-Musannaf(ألمصنف) and it is Sahih(صحيح).

So, here you have a man, who jumps into the army, seeking martyrdom.

Might as well just put on an explosive belt, what's the difference.

Jumping in an army of 1000s, so it's a definite death.

A battalion of non believers came from the east, and was met by a man from the Ansaar(أنصار), he charged against them alone and penetrated their ranks until they came out from the other side of the battalion.

Then he charged them from the back and broke the ranks, until it came out from the front, he repeated that two or three times zigzagging in the army.

Saad Ibn Hisham(سعد إبن هشام) mentioned that to Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة).

Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) recited: And of the people is he, who sells himself, seeking means to approval of Allah.

And Allah is kind to His servants.

Aslam Abi Amran(أسلم أبي عمران) said: We were in the army heading from Madina, heading towards Constantinople, the head of the army was Abdur Rahman Bin Khalid Bin Walid(عبدالرحمن بن خالدبن وليد).

The Romans had their backs facing the gates of the city.

One among us rushed alone towards them.

Some people said there is no God but Allah, He is throwing himself into destruction.

Abu Ayub Al-Ansari(أبو أيوب ألأنصاري) said: This verse was revealed speaking about us, the Ansaar(أنصار).

When Allah gave His Messenger victory and Islam prevailed.

We said: Let's go back to our businesses and take care of it.

Allah then revealed the verse, And spend in the way of Allah and do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction, and do good.

Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

So throwing ourselves into the destruction meant going back to our farms and businesses, leaving Jihad(جهاد).

Abu Amran(أبوعمران) said Abu Ayub(أبوأيوب) remained in Jihad(جهاد), until he was buried in Constantinople, it is in Abu Daud(أبوداؤد), At-Tirmidhi(ألتِّرمِذِيْ) and Al Hakim(ألحَاكِم).

Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) said: The Messenger of Allah sent only two men, Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) and Khabbab(خباب) as an army and he sent the Dahya(دحية) as an army alone.

He said: Dahya(دحية), as an army by himself, it's one man.

This is in Al-Sunan Al-Kubra(ألسنن ألكبرى).

As-Shafie(ألشَّافعي) said: One of the Ansaar(أنصار) was late behind when the killing of the Sahabah(صحابه) next to the well of Mauna(ماعونة) took place.

By the time he arrived vultures are already devouring his companions.

He told the Amr Bin Umayah(عمرو بن أمية).

I'm going to go alone and face the enemy, so they can kill me.

I don't want to be left behind when our companions are killed.

When our companions were killed, he did, and he was killed.

So, here you see that is Yani(يعني).

He says: I'm going to go alone and face the enemy so they can kill me.

He's going for what purpose, to die.

He made his intentions clear.

He didn't say I'm going to kill them even though that was part of his attention, but he said: I'm going to die.

And then he said: I don't want to be left behind when our companions were killed.

I want to join them.

He did, and he was killed.

When Amr Bin Umayah(عمرو بن أمية) the only survivor of the incident told the Messenger of Allah about what happened.

The Messenger of Allah said, good words about the man, and then he told Amr Bin Umayah(عمرو بن أمية).

And why didn't you go ahead with him.?

Why didn't he go ahead with him.?

See this issue of martyrdom operations has became a controversial issue when it shouldn't, because the difference between suicide and martyrdom is clear.

The difference between suicide and martyrdom is Niyah(نية).

It's the Niyah(نية) that makes it suicide or makes it martyrdom.

And the man, who was in the middle of the battlefield, Right!

The middle of the battlefield, and he stepped over his so to kill himself.

Even though he was fighting that was considered to be suicide and Rasool Allah ﷺ when he heard Shaheed(شَهِيد), he is Shaheed(شَهِيد).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He's not.

He's in An-Naar(ألنَّار).

What made him die in the battlefield, and it was considered to be suicide is because of his Niyah(نية), he couldn't have patience, because of the pain he was going through, he was injured.

He didn't have patience, he stuck a sword in the ground, and he jumped over it, and committed suicide.

This Shaheed(شَهِيد) who goes and blows himself up.

When he goes to blow himself up, is his intention to kill himself.?

His intention is to kill the enemy.

That's why he went otherwise he would blow himself up in his house.

Why didn't he have to go among the enemy.

He's doing it among the enemy to kill the enemy, and he is dying as a byproduct of that.

And his intention was to make Nikaya(نكاية) in the ranks of the enemy.

So, how come the two are confused.

It should be no room for confusion, it's very clear issue.

The difference between Shahadah(شهادة) and suicide is the Niyah(نية).

Somebody who has committed suicide, commits suicide because they're not happy with the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allah.

They're not happy with their latten life, they lost hope.

They're in the state of despair, so they take away their life.

Ash-Shaheed(ألشَهِيد) is doing it to please Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ taking away your life for a worldly reason is suicide, taking away your life for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ to please Him, is Shahadah(شَهَادَة), that's the difference between the two.

Yazid Ibn Abi Ubaid(يزيد إبن أبي عبيد) said: I asked Salmah Ibn Akwah(سلمة إبن أكوع) What was your pledge to the Messenger of Allah on the day of Hudaibiyah(حديبية)?

He said: We pledged to die, The pledge was to die and this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ) and Muslim(ألمسلم), the Messenger of Allah said: A time will come when the best of my mankind would be a man holding on to the bridle of his horse in the sake of Allah,

whenever he hears a call to battle he mounts his horse and searches for death.

So he's searching for death but he's doing it for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Ibn Masood(إبن مسعود) narrated the Messenger of Allah said: Allah is amazed with two men.

One of them is a man who woke up from his comfortable bed to pray, eager to receive the reward from Allah, and fearing His punishment.

The second man is one, who went to fight in the path of Allah, but this company turned their backs in the battlefield, he realized the punishment of turning ones back in battle,

and the reward of being steadfast.

So he went back to fight in order to have his blood spilled, Allah would say: Look at this servant of Mine, he went back to fight, eager for what I will reward him,

and fearing my punishment, until his blood was spilled, and this is in Ahmad(أحمد) and it is Sahih(صحيح).

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: If there weren't any Hadith(حديث) on the virtue of immersing oneself in the enemy's army then this Hadith(حديث), it would have been sufficient.

Before I get into the story of Salmah Ibn Akwah(سلمة إبن أكوع).

Let's make my comments after that, I'll just go through the story, it's a bit long story, but it's a very interesting one.

Salmah Ibn Akwah(سلمة إبن أكوع) narrates and he's telling his own story and this is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم).

He said: Then we moved, returning to Madina and halter at a place where there was a mountain between us and Banul-Lahyan(بنوالَّحيان), who were polytheist.

He's talking about Banul-Lahyan(بنوالَّحيان), who were polytheists, the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, asked Allah's forgiveness for one, who ascended the mountain at night

to act as a scout for the messenger of Allah ﷺ and his companions.

So, I ascended that mountain twice or thrice that night.

At last we reached Madina.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ sent his camels with his slave Rabah(رباح), and I was with him.

I also went to the pasture with the horse of Talha(طلحة), along with his camels.

See Salmah Ibn Akwah(سلمة إبن أكوع) was helping out Talha(طلحة) he was like a servant for him, so he would take his horse out to the pasture and take care of it.

So he happened to be next to the shepherd of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

When the day dawned Abdul Rahman Al-Fazari(عبدالرحمن ألفظاري) made a raid and drove away out of the camels of the Messenger of Allah, and killed the man who looked after them.

So this is a man, who came with some Bedouins from Najd(نجد) and they raided the area surrounding Madina and they stole away the camels of Rasool Allah ﷺ and killed his shepherd.

I said: Rabah(رباح) ride this horse, take it to Talha Bin Obaidillah(طلحة بن عبيدالله) and informed the Messenger of Allah, that the polytheists, have made away with his camels.

Then I stood up on a hillock.

I said: Rabah(رباح) ride this horse, take it to the Talha Bin Obaidillah(طلحة بن عبيدالله) and informed the Messenger of Allah, that the polytheists have made away with his camels.

Then I stood upon a hillock and turning my face to Madina shouted thrice, come to our help.

Then I set out in pursuit of the Raiders shooting at them with arrows and chanting poetry.

I am the son of  Al-Akwah(ألأكوع), and today is the day of defeat for the mean.

I would overtake a man from them shoot at him an arrow that would reach his shoulder.

And I would say take it, and he would recite the same verses, So this was the slogan for the entire day.

By God! I continued shooting at them and hamstringing their animals.

Whenever a horseman turned upon me, I was coming to a tree and hid myself sitting at its base, then I would shoot at him and hamstrung his horse.

At last they entered the narrow mountain gourds.

I ascended that mountain and held them at bay by throwing stones at them.

I continue to chase them in this way, until I got all the camels of the Messenger of Allah, released, and no camel was left with them.

The left me.

So they left him, but I followed them shooting at them continually until they dropped more than 30 mantle's on 30 Lance's, lighting their burden.

On everything they dropped I put a mark with the help of a piece of stone.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ and his companions might recognize them.

So he's running, whenever they drop something he would leave mark over it and continue running .

Salmah Ibn Akwah(سلمة إبن أكوع) was the fastest runner among the Sahabah(صحابه), Allah Alam(ألله اعلم), if this is an exaggeration, but they say that he would race with animals, camels horses.

He was that fast.

They went on until they came to a narrow valley.

When so and so son of Badr Al-Fazari(بدرألفظاري) he joined them.

They now sat down to take their breakfast, and I sat on top of a tapering rock.

Al-Fazari(ألفظاري) said: Who is that fellow I'm seeing.

They said: This fellow has harassed us.

By Allah, He has not left us As dusk and has been continually shooting at us, until he smashed everything from our hands.

He said: Four of you should make a dash at him, and kill him.

Accordingly, four of them ascended the mountain, coming towards me, when it became possible for me to talk to them.

I said: Do you recognize me.?

They said: No! Who are you?

I said: I am Salma son of Al-Akwah(أكوع).

By the being, Who has honored the countenance of Muhammadﷺ I can kill any of you I like, but none of you will be able to kill me.

One of them said: I think he's right!

So they returned.

I did not move from my place until I saw the Horsemen of Rasool Allah ﷺ came riding through the trees.

Low the foremost among them was Akhram Al-Asdi(أخرم ألأسدي).

Behind him was Abu Qatadah Al-Ansari(أبوقتادة ألأنصاري), and behind him was Al-Miqdad Al-Aswad Al-Kindi(ألمقداد بن ألأسود ألكندي).

I can't hold up the reign of Akhram(أخرم)'s horse seeing this, they the Raiders fled.

I said, to Akhram(أخرم), Akhram(أخرم) guard yourself against them, until Allah His Messenger and His companions join you.

He said Salamah(سلمة), if you believe in Allah and the day of judgment.

And if you know that paradise is reality and hell is reality.

You should not stand between me and martyrdom.

So I let him go Akhram(أخرم) and Abdur Rahman Al-Fazari(عبدالرحمن ألفظاري) met in combat, Akhram(أخرم) hamstrung Abdur-Rahman(عبدالرحمن)'s horse, and the ladder struck him with his lance and killed him.

So, Al-Akhram(أخرم) was killed.

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) turned about driving Akhram(أخرم)'s horse, Abu Qatadah(أبوقتادة), a horseman of the Messenger of Allah, met Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) in combat smote him with his lance and killed him.

By the being who honored the countenance of Muhammadﷺ, I followed them running on my feet, so fast that I couldn't see behind me the companions of Muhammadﷺ, nor any dust raised by their horses.

So he is running on foot, Faster than the horses behind them of Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Companions, he said: I couldn't even see them behind me.

I followed them, until before sunset so this is an entire day.

I mean from Fajr(فجر)  until sunset.

So I followed them until before sunset they reached the Valley, which had the spring of water, which was called Zuqarad(ذوقرد) so that they could have a drink, for they were thirsty.

They saw me running towards them.

I turned them out of the valley before they could drink a drop of water, they left the valley and ran down the slope.

I ran behind them over took a man from them, shot him with an arrow through the shoulder blade, and said: Take this, I'm the son of Al-Akwah(أكوع).

And today is the day of annulations for the people who are mean, the fellow who was wounded said: May his mother weep over him, Are you the Akwah(أكوع), who has been chasing us since this morning.

Are you the same Akwah(أكوع).?

This guy he is injured, he's dying but he has that question of mind.

He said: Is this the same Akwah(أكوع).?

I said: Yes! O enemy of thyself, the same Akwah(أكوع).

They'll have two horses dead tired, I mean the horses are dead tired, he's still running.

The left two horses dead tired on the hillock.

And I came dragging them along to the Messenger of Allah.

I met Amir(عامر), who had with him a container, having milk diluted with water and a container having water.

I performed Wudhoo(وضؤ) with the water and drank the milk.

Then I came to Rasool Allah ﷺ while he was at the spring of water from which I had driven them away.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had captured those camels and everything else, I had captured and all the Lancers and mantle's I had snatched from the Mushrikeen(مشركين)

and Bilal(بلال) had slaughtered the she camel from the camels, I had seized from the people, and was roasting its liver and hump for the Messenger of Allah.

I said: O Rasool Ullah. Let me select from our people 100 men, And I will follow the marauders, and I will finish them all, so that nobody is left to convey the news of their destruction to their people.

At these words of mine. Rasool Allah ﷺ laughed, so much that his molar teeth could be seen in the light of the fire, he said: Salamah(سلمة), do you think you can do this.

I said: Yes!

By the being who has honored you.

He said: Now they have reached the land of Ghatafan(غطافان) where they are being fed.

At this time a man from Ghatafan(غطافان) came along and said: So and so slaughter the camel for them, when they were exposing it skin they saw dust.

They said: They Akwah(أكوع) and his companions have come, so they went away fleeing.

When it was morning the Messenger of Allah said: Our best horseman today is Abu Qatadah(أبوقتادة), and our best footman today is Salamah(سلمة).

Then he gave me two shares of the booty.

Share meant for the horsemen, and the share meant for the footmen, and combined both of them for me.

This is in Muslim(ألمسلم) and Musnad Imam Ahmad(مَسند اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

Now Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: In the request of Salamah(سلمة) to send with him 100 of the companions, is an evidence of the immense number of the enemy.

Otherwise he wouldn't request such a number.

So Salamah(سلمة) was pursuing an entire army on foot, alone, and he gave him such a hard time.

This is another interesting story.

Abul-Ala Bin Hazrami(أبوالأعلى بن حض) said: Bisr Bin Artaa(بسر بن أرطأة) attacked the land of the Romans.

Do you remember Bisr Bin Artaa(بسر بن أرطأة)?

He was the Ameer(أمير) of the army, when Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبومسلم ألخولاني) went to him and asked him, to appoint him as the leader of the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء).

It was Bisr Bin Artaa(بسر بن أرطأة) who was the leader of that army.

So but the rear of his army was constantly attacked and whenever he would prepare a trap for the attackers, his soldiers would be attacked instead.

So he decided to stay behind with 100 of his soldiers to figure out who was ambushing them.

One day he went alone in one of the valleys and found 30 horses, tied next to a monastery with the Knights inside it, he realized that this was the group who were ambushing his army.

So he tied his horse next to the monastery and went in and close the door behind him, preventing them from leaving.

He then started fighting them single handedly.

And by the time they were able to lay their hands on their weapons he had already killed three of them.

When Bisr(بسر)'s Soldiers discovered his absence, they went searching for him and came by the monastery and found his horse.

They also heard the noise coming from inside the monastery, so they tried getting in, but the door was closed.

So they had to break off some panels from the roof and then descended into the monastery.

They found him fighting the knights, with his sword in one hand and the other hand was holding some of his intestines that had spilled out.

He then fell down unconscious.

His soldiers continued the fight killing some and capturing the rest.

The captured, ask the soldiers.

We ask you in the name of God, who is that man.

They said: He is Bisr Bin Artaa(بسر بن أرطأة), the Roman knights said: In the name of God, no woman has ever given birth to anyone like him.

The soldiers then put the hanging intestines back into his stomach, since none of them was punctured.

They tied his stomach with some of their turbans and they carried him back, then his stomach was stitched and he was cured.

There's a difference of opinion on whether Bisr(بسر) was a companion or a Tabae(تابعي).

He was one of the most courageous of this nation.

Al-Bara Bin Aazib(ألبراءبن عازب) narrates, Allah's apostle sent Abdullah Bin Atiq(عبدالله بن عتيق) and Abdullah Bin Utbah(عبدالله بن عتبة) the group of men to Abu Rafia(أبورافع) to kill him.

They proceeded till they approached his castles, so this was an assassination mission, appointed by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ appointed Abdullah Bin Atiq(عبدالله بن عتيق) to assassinate, Abi Rafia(أبي رافع), Abi Rafia(أبي رافع) was a wealthy trader in Hijaz(حجاز), causing the Muslims, so much trouble.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ sanctioned his assassination and he appointed Abdullah Bin Atiq(عبدالله بن عتيق) and some of the other Ansaar(أنصار) to this special operation.

So they proceeded till they approached his castle where upon Abdullah Bin Atiq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said to them, wait here!

And in the meantime I will go and see.

Abdullah(عبدالله) said: Later on, I played a trick, in order to enter the castle.

By chance they lost the donkey of theirs and came out carrying a flaming light to search for it.

I was afraid that they would recognize me, so I covered my head and legs and pretended that I was answering the call to nature.

So you know, this is castle, everybody is known in there.

And these castles close at night, they close at night.

So he covered his head, and sat down pretending that he's responding to the call of nature, so that when they come back they think that he is somebody from the castle who came out to respond, the call of nature,

you don't have toilets in there, you have to go out.

So, this is the trick he used.

So the gatekeeper called, whoever wants to come in should come in before I close the gate.

So I went in and hid myself in the stall of a donkey, near the gate of the castle.

They took their supper with Abu Rafia(أبورافع) and had a chat till late night.

Then they went back to their homes, when the voices vanished, and I no longer detected any movement I came out.

I had seen where the gatekeeper had kept the key of the castle in a hole in the wall.

So I took it and unlocked the gate of the castle, saying to myself, if these people should notice me I will run away easily.

Then I locked all the doors of their houses from outside, while they're inside.

So, he locked them up and ascended to Abu Rafia(أبورافع) via staircase.

I saw the house in complete darkness with its lights, with its lights off.

Now listen to this!

So the lights are off.

And he is inside the house of Abu Rafia(أبورافع), he wants to know, where Abu Rafia(أبورافع) is?

and I could not know where the man was, so I called O Abu Rafia(أبورافع).!

He replied, who is it?

I proceeded towards the voice and hit him.

He cried loudly, but my blow was futile.

Then look at this, Then I came to him pretending to help him, saying with a different tone of voice, now he changed his voice as if he's the guard he is going to help him.

What is wrong with you, Abu Rafia(أبورافع).

He said: Are you not surprised, woe onto your mother, a man has come to me and hit me with a sword.

So again I aimed at him and hit him.

But the blow proved futile again.

And on that Abu Rafia(أبورافع) cried loudly and his wife got up.

I came again and change my voice as if I were a helper, and I found Abu Rafia(أبورافع) laying straight on his back.

So I drove the sword into his belly and bent on it, till I heard the sound of his spine break.

So he cracked the spine with the sword, that's it, it's certain death.

Then I came out, filled with astonishment and went to the staircase to descend, but I fell down from it and got my leg, dislocated.

I bandage it and went to my companions limping, I said to them: Go and tell Allah's Apostle of this good news, but I will not leave this place till I hear the news of his death.

Now you know the pain of a dislocated foot, extremely painful.

He wrapped it with his turban, and he refused to leave.

He wanted to stay behind, so that he would actually hear the announcement that Abu Rafia(أبورافع) is dead.

Even if there's a wrong Ijtihad(إجتهاد) and innocent people, or people who shouldn't have died, did die, but it was based on an Ijtihad(إجتهاد), for the right reasons,

then they're still Ajr(أجْر) in that because the two men shouldn't have been killed.

They're not civilians, but they shouldn't have been killed.

The Sahabah(صحابه) who were rewarded for that operation, They should expect to get the mercy of the Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

We need to end this session.
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ Alam Al-Nabola(أعلام ألنبلاء).

وَما مُحَمَّدٌ إِلّا رَسولٌ قَد خَلَت مِن قَبلِهِ الرُّسُلُ ۚ أَفَإِن ماتَ أَو قُتِلَ انقَلَبتُم عَلىٰ أَعقابِكُم ۚ وَمَن يَنقَلِب عَلىٰ عَقِبَيهِ فَلَن يَضُرَّ اللَّهَ شَيئًا ۗ

وَسَيَجزِي اللَّهُ الشّاكِرينَ۞

وَما كانَ لِنَفسٍ أَن تَموتَ إِلّا بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ كِتابًا مُؤَجَّلًا ۗ وَمَن يُرِد ثَوابَ الدُّنيا نُؤتِهِ مِنها وَمَن يُرِد ثَوابَ الآخِرَةِ نُؤتِهِ مِنها ۚ

وَسَنَجزِي الشّاكِرينَ۞

وَكَأَيِّن مِن نَبِيٍّ قاتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيّونَ كَثيرٌ فَما وَهَنوا فَما وَهَنوا لِما أَصابَهُم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَما ضَعُفوا وَمَا استَكانوا ۗ

وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الصّابِرينَ۞

وَكَأَيِّن مِن نَبِيٍّ قاتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيّونَ كَثيرٌ فَما وَهَنوا لِما أَصابَهُم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَما ضَعُفوا وَمَا استَكانوا وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسولَ فَأُولٰئِكَ مَعَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم

مَعَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم مِنَ النَّبِيّينَ وَالصِّدّيقينَ وَالشُّهَداءِ وَالصّالِحينَ ۚ وَحَسُنَ أُولٰئِكَ رَفيقًا۞

مِنَ النَّبِيّينَ وَالصِّدّيقينَ وَالشُّهَداءِ وَالصّالِحينَ ۚ وَحَسُنَ أُولٰئِكَ رَفيقًا۞

فَإِذا لَقيتُمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَضَربَ الرِّقابِ حَتّىٰ إِذا أَثخَنتُموهُم فَشُدُّوا الوَثاقَ فَإِمّا مَنًّا بَعدُ وَإِمّا فِداءً حَتّىٰ تَضَعَ الحَربُ أَوزارَها ۚ

ذٰلِكَ وَلَو يَشاءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنهُم وَلٰكِن لِيَبلُوَ بَعضَكُم بِبَعضٍ ۗ وَالَّذينَ قُتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعمالَهُم۞

لا يجمع الله بين كافر وقاتلهم مهلك من المهال فَلَمّا فَصَلَ طالوتُ بِالجُنودِ قالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مُبتَليكُم بِنَهَرٍ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنهُ فَلَيسَ مِنّي وَمَن لَم يَطعَمهُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنّي

إِلّا مَنِ اغتَرَفَ غُرفَةً بِيَدِهِ ۚ فَشَرِبوا مِنهُ إِلّا قَليلًا مِنهُم ۚ فَلَمّا جاوَزَهُ هُوَ وَالَّذينَ آمَنوا مَعَهُ قالو قالوا لا طاقَةَ لَنَا اليَومَ بِجالوتَ وَجُنودِهِ ۚ

قالَ الَّذينَ يَظُنّونَ أَنَّهُم مُلاقُو اللَّهِ كَم مِن فِئَةٍ قَليلَةٍ غَلَبَت كَم مِن فِئَةٍ قَليلَةٍ غَلَبَت فِئَةً كَثيرَةً بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ ۗ

وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصّابِرينَ۞

فِئَةٍ قَليلَةٍ غَلَبَت فِئَةً كَثيرَةً بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصّابِرينَ۞

وَمِنَ النّاسِ مَن يَشري نَفسَهُ ابتِغاءَ مَرضاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ رَءوفٌ بِالعِبادِ۞

وَمِنَ النّاسِ مَن يَشري نَفسَهُ ابتِغاءَ مَرضاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ تُلقوا بِأَيديكُم إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ ۛ وَأَنفِقوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلا تُلقوا بِأَيديكُم إِلَى التَّهلُكَةِ ۛ

وَأَحسِنوا ۛ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المُحسِنينَ۞

تبيعنا على الموت خُذْهَا وَاَنَا اِبْنِ الْاَكْوَعْ                       وَالْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ خُذْهَا وَاَنَا اِبْنِ الْاَكْوَعْ                       وَالْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ

وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُم أَحرَصَ النّاسِ عَلىٰ حَياةٍ وَمِنَ الَّذينَ أَشرَكوا ۚ إلقاء نفسي في غمرات القتال وقد تفقو على جواز تغرير بالنفس في الجهاد في المبارزه في غيرها

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ وَإِن عاقَبتُم فَعاقِبوا بِمِثلِ ما عوقِبتُم بِهِ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرتُم لَهُوَ خَيرٌ لِلصّابِرينَ۞

ولا تُمثِّل محمد يَنْهَا عَنْ فَسَادِ ثُمَّ يُفْسِدُو فِى الاَرضْ مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ۞

مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ محمد يعتيكي في الشهر الحرام يَسأَلونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهرِ الحَرامِ قِتالٍ فيهِ ۖ

قُل قِتالٌ فيهِ كَبيرٌ ۖ وَصَدٌّ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَكُفرٌ بِهِ وَالمَسجِدِ الحَرامِ وَالمَسجِدِ الحَرامِ وَإِخراجُ أَهلِهِ مِنهُ أَكبَرُ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ

وَالفِتنَةُ أَكبَرُ مِنَ القَتلِ ۗ وَلا يَزالونَ يُقاتِلونَكُم حَتّىٰ يَرُدّوكُم عَن دينِكُم إِنِ استَطاعوا ۚ وَمَن يَرتَدِد مِنكُم عَن دينِهِ فَيَمُت وَهُوَ كافِرٌ فَأُولٰئِكَ

فَأُولٰئِكَ حَبِطَت أَعمالُهُم فِي الدُّنيا وَالآخِرَةِ ۖ وَأُولٰئِكَ أَصحابُ النّارِ ۖ هُم فيها خالِدونَ۞

يَسأَلونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهرِ الحَرامِ قِتالٍ فيهِ ۖ قُل قِتالٌ فيهِ كَبيرٌ ۖ يَسأَلونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهرِ الحَرامِ قِتالٍ فيهِ ۖقُل قِتالٌ فيهِ كَبيرٌ ۖ

وَصَدٌّ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَكُفرٌ بِهِ وَالمَسجِدِ الحَرامِ وَإِخراجُ أَهلِهِ مِنهُ أَكبَرُ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالفِتنَةُ أَكبَرُ مِنَ القَتلِ ۗ

إِنَّ الَّذينَ آمَنوا وَالَّذينَ هاجَروا وَجاهَدوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ يَرجونَ رَحمَتَ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ۞

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك نشهد و الله إله إلَّا أنت نستغفرك ونتوب عليك

parts.english:
Chapter Nine: On Dueling, translating Mubariza(مُبَارزَة), as dueling, which is pretty much the closest translation you can get for the word Mubariza(مُبَارزَة),

the way it(Dueling) used to happen in the old days is that, this(Dueling) is before the actual battle starts.

Someone who is well known with a reputation of being good fighter, he would come ahead before the battle starts, while the armies are still meeting,

and would ask for a challenge for one man to come out and challenge him.

This is sort of like the ceremony to open the celebration of the actual battle.

And we know what happened in the Battle of Badr(بدر), in fact Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) does talk about that, where three of the Mushrikeen(مشركين) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

Ut'ba Bin Rabiyah(عُتْبَة بن ربيعة), Shaibah(شيبة) and Al-Walid Bin Ut'ba(ألوليدبن عُتْبَة) three of them set out for Mubariza(مُبَارزَة).

And this also existed even in the era of firearms.

Where, you had the duels in the wild, wild west, where people will do those 10 steps and then you turn around and shoot your opponent, stuff that is not only in the movies, it's absolutely bad that happened.

One of the US presidents was or president candidate was killed in a duel.

So Mubariza(مُبَارزَة) is something that carried on until quite recently.

Dueling is allowed according to the consensus of the scholars, accepting the invitation to duel by an non-believers is recommended.

Asking for a duel is neither recommended nor discouraged, according to the Maz'hab(مذهب) of As-Shafie(ألشَّافعي), it is appropriate for the experienced, and is discouraged for the weak, doesn't have sufficient confidence in himself.

You don't went to go out, bravado and just ask for duel, when you don't have the ability to stand up to the opponent.

Why? Because that demoralizes the army.

The Mubariza(مُبَارزَة) that happened before the Battle of Badr(بدر), played a very important role in demoralizing the army of the disbelievers

because all of their three men who came up with Mubariza(مُبَارزَة) were killed.

So it is Makroh(مكروع) for the one, who is not capable.

In fact, it is said that it is prohibited for such a person to ask for duel, it is Sunnah(سنة) get the permission of the Ameer(أمير), but it is still allowed without his knowledge,

because duels don't only happen before the battle, but within the battle you could call on somebody, you see, for a duel.

Imam Malik(امام مالك) was asked about the ones, who stand out in front of the army and asked for a duel, he said: It depends on his intentions, if he's doing it for the sake of Allah, I do not see a problem with that,

since that was the tradition of the ones before us.

Imam As-Shafie(إمام ألشَّافعي) said: I don't see a problem with duels.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: Know that duels during wars and accepting the invitation to it is the way of the heroes.

It is a badge of honor for the brave men and it has been their pride, after Islam and before it.

Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود), one of the greatest fighters of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) During the Battle of Al-Khandaq(ألخندق), the trench came out asking for a duel.

Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود) was quite a formidable opponent.

He was an old man at that time.

I think it's a bit of an exaggeration but some say that he was over 80 years of age or something.

But sometimes, you know, not all of these, details, tend to be authentic.

Anyway, he was famous as being a very brave man and a very strong fighter.

So he comes out and he asks for duel.

So, Ali(علي) veiled in iron armory stood up and said: I would!

Rasool Allah ﷺ refused to allow him and said: This is Amr(عمرو).

Sit down!

So Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود) called again, Isn't there a man among you, where's your paradise that you claim whoever dies among you will enter it?

He is mocking now.

Isn't there a man among you, who can stand up and face me.

You claim that Jannah(جنة) is...

come ahead and I'll send you in Jannah(جنة).

So, it was Ali(علي) who stood up again and said: I would!

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him, Sit down! This is Amr(عمر)!

You're too young for that.

Now Amr(عمرو) calls again for a third time and he's reciting some lines of poetry, challenging the Muslims so Ali(علي) stood for the third time and said: I would!

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: It is Amr(عمرو), Ali(علي) responded, And what if it is Amr(عمرو).?

So what!

So Rasool Allah ﷺ this time allowed them after refusing three times.

So Amr(عمرو) told him: Who are you?

Now, he cannot see the face of Ali(علي), because Ali(علي) is covered in Chain male, and so was Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود), so he wants to know who's this man who was coming forth.

So he said who are you?

He said: I am Ali(علي), the son of Abu Talib(ابوطالب).

Amr(عمرو) said: Have someone senior to you step forward instead, I wouldn't want to spell your blood, my son.

So he is having mercy on this young man, he said: Son, I don't want to kill you.

Send someone else who's senior to you.

Ali(علي) didn't responded by saying, but I would be very happy to spell yours.

So Amr(عمرو) was quite furious with that statement.

So he walked towards Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), and he pulled out his sword violently from his Sheath, as if it was a blaze of fire that's how it was described when Amr(عمرو) pulled out his sword.

It was as if he was pulling out the blaze of fire, he pulled it out, very violently.

And the battle started between the two.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not want to look at it, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not want to even watch.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was not watching what was happening, Rasool Allah ﷺ was concerned for his, relative Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب).

So he wasn't watching.

So these two men are fighting and the Muslims are surrounding and watching what's happening.

And you have now a cloud of dust is erupting.

And it was quite a violent fight, you just barely see them, in this cloud of dust.

So Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود), he struck, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), but Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) protect himself with his shield.

So the sword of Amr Bin Abd Wud(عمروبن عبدود) got stuck in the shield of Ali(علي), and that's when Ali(علي) hit him, and killed him, and the Muslims made Takbir(تكبير).

And that's when Rasool Allah ﷺ knew the results of the fight, the Messenger of Allah, then heard the thunderous Takbir(تكبير) of the Muslims,

and this is mentioned by Ibn-e-Hisham(إبن هشام), while Khalid(خالد) was laying siege to a town, one of their fighters came out of the gates with a sword in his right hand,

and a shield in his left, and he asked for a duel.

By the way, this thought just came up to my mind.

You know, usually, because most people are right handed so you would carry the sword with the right hand and the shield with your left, now there's this Muslim fortress in Tarifa(طريفة), Spain.

And I just happened to visit a few weeks ago.

And by the way this is a port city it's now more of a tourist town and most of the tourists come from this country they just go there to party, it's a Mediterranean resort.

It's called Tarifa(طريفة), and it's named after the first Muslims clan there.

Now contrary to common understanding that Tariq Bin Ziad(طارق بن زياد) is the first one, to get into Spain, he actually wasn't.

Tariq Bin Ziad(طارق بن زياد) was the second army to go to Spain.

The first was a reconnaissance army led by Tareef(طريف), by Imam Bin Tareef(إمام بن طريف), he is from Al-Berber(ألبربر).

And he was sent by Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير) to go into Spain.

The way this whole thing happened is, you know the Muslims were not thinking about the crossing into Europe.

Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير), and the Muslim armies were going through Africa and they didn't have on mind crossing to the European continent,

you know, in those days you don't have any maps you don't have any satellite images, so it's an unknown land, to them.

They never been there, they don't have any reports coming to them, so they have no idea what's behind the sea, they could see it, you could see, Spain from Morocco,

but you need to know what's going on there.

So what happened was that, there was one fortress on the African coast, only one fortress that was still under Roman command.

The General who was leading that fortress, his name is Julian, the tradition was that they would send their children to the Spanish court to be educated.

And the king of Spain at that time was in the Arabic literature he's named Radreeq(رزريق), but the Spanish name is Rodriguez.

So they would send their children to be educated in the Spanish court.

So Julian he sent his daughter to Spain.

Now, apparently she was attractive so Rodriguez attacked her.

When Julian knew about that, he went to the Muslims, and asked them to help him and invade Spain.

So, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), you see how this dispute that happened among them was the reason that brought the Muslims into Spain, to start up this huge Islamic civilization for eight centuries in the Iberian Peninsula.

So Julian went to Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير) and he said: I can lead you into Spain.

Now, Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير) was a very cautious leader.

He felt that this might be a plot by the Christians to drag in the Muslims and the defeat them.

So he said: To prove, that you're honest, I want you to go in and you fight against Rodriguez.

So, that I can know that now you cut your ties with him.

Julian did go in and he fought inside Spain and then he came out he said: Now send an army.

Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير) were still reluctant so what he did, he sent a small army of 700, led by Tareef(طريف) to go into Spain.

So these were the first Muslims sent into Spain, they went they landed in this port city of Tareef(طريف).

They raided the area around them they took some Ghanaem(غنائم), and they came back.

So now he has a report, in addition to the Ghanaem(غنائم), to give to Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير).

Musa Bin Nusair(موسى بن نصير) still does not want to risk going by himself, so he sends Tariq Bin Ziad(طارق بن زياد) in an army of 7000.

And that's when the Fath(فتح), starts.

Anyway, the reason why I'm mentioning this, the castle Tarif(طريف) that the Muslims built.

In case the lines of defense are broken and some enemy soldiers are able to get into the castle.

The stairs wind up in very sharp curves.

And all of these curves are right hand curves all of them.

So you're climbing up the stairs, you have to take a right turn, and then another right turn, and then the right turn.

Do you know why?

Just like a quiz, question.

Because you have no protection in your right side.

That was some kind of genius Muslim architecture that even if somebody breaks in.

They could be attacked very easily because you have protections from the left.

So in every turn, they could be ambushed.

So, when Khalid(خالد) was laying siege to a town one of their fighters came out of the gates with a sword in his right hand and a shield in his left, and he asked for a duel.

So a Muslim volunteered to fight him and he killed him.

Then the Muslim asked for a duel.

So they sent out to him the greatest fighter, the Muslim then killed him.

He asked for a third duel.

This time they told him, let the devil fight you.

Go and fight with Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ)!

Ali(علي) said. Ut'ba Bin Rabiyah(عُتْبَة بن ربيعة), his son Al-Walid(ألوليد), and his brother Shaibah(شيبة) came out in Badr(بدر) asking for duels,

three young men from Ansaar(ألأنْصَار) went to face them Ut'ba(عُتْبَة), ask them who they were?

If my son is righteous, then Allah will give them Rizq(رزق) because of their righteousness, and if my son is corrupt, then I don't want to support them on their corruption.

I don't want to be part of that I'm not gonna leave anything behind.

For them to use it for evil.

So take care of the commands of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will take care of your family.

Obviously that doesn't mean neglecting them, see neglect is something, and doing what needs to be done is something else.

Sometimes, you end up neglecting the family because of more of a priority of duties that you have towards Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

This is when Allah will, take care of them, but when we have nothing to do, and you're still neglecting the family, then.

That's a different situation.

So that's one way Allah will take care of you.

A third way you take care of the commands of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, Allah will take care of you in two of the most difficult situations you could run through in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا),

most dangerous situations on you Deen(دِيْن).

And that is Ash-Shahwat(ألشهوات) and Ash-Shubuhat(شبهات).

Ash-Shubuhat(شبهات) are doubts, Ash-Shahwat(ألشهوات) are desires.

You run into situations where Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) puts doubts in your heart, these doubts can come in different forms either doubts in Allah, the existence of Allah,

doubts in the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, doubts in some parts of Shariah(شريعة), doubts in Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

Doubts could lead to anything.

And you wonder why, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has ordered us to do this.

Why did the Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ say that, or why did Rasool Allah ﷺ do this.?

These are very dangerous because they could take a person from Eeman(ايمان) to Kuffr(كفر).

And then you have Ash-Shahwat(ألشهوات), the desires, lust, love of power and money.

If you take care of the commands of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and you are put in one of these two situations Allah will take care of you.

When Yusuf عليه السّلام was put in that extreme position of Fitnah(فِتْنَه), a very handsome young man, unmarried and in front is a beautiful woman, who he owes a lot to,

because he was a servant for them, he was a slave owned by them.

And she has power and authority and wealth and she has all of the means to coerce him into Fitnah(فِتْنَه), Zina(زنا).

And he was put in this old situation that man could rarely, or in fact we would say that maybe nobody could pass that situation, except if Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ gives them Burhan(برهان) which He gave to Yousaf عليه السّلام.

So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ saved him through a Burhan(برهان), certain secret of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ which will give to him.

And it saved him in that position.

Why?

Because of the deeds that he used to do before.

Yunus عليه السّلام when he was stuck in that stomach of the whale, he was in deep trouble.

Under the three layers of darkness, what saved him.?

It is tasbiha(تسبح).

If it wasn't because he used to make the Tasbih(تسبيح) before, he would have remained in the stomach of whale until the day of judgment.

Now, just a note to the parents, brothers over here who are fathers.

Notice that Rasool Allah ﷺ here is speaking to Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) who was less than 13 years of age at the time.

Because when Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) was 13 years old.

So Allah Alam(ألله أعلم) he might be 13 or 12 or 11 or 10 when Rasool Ullah, telling this Hadith(حديث).

What is the Hadith(حديث) concentrating on.?

It is concentrating on Amaal Ul Qulub(أعمال القلوب), the deeds of the heart.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is planting these deeds of the heart in the heart of Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) at this early age, and that's what, you want to convey it to your children.

Take care of Allah, Allah will take care of you.

Be mindful of Allah, Allah will be with you.

And then he's telling him ask ALLAH, seek refuge in Allah.

And then he's telling him that everything is Muqaddar(مقدر), everything is destined, whatever you do.

No one can harm you, except if that harm is destined by Allah, and nobody can benefit you except if that was destined by Allah, so don't worry about it.

These are very important meanings to deliver to our youngsters, because it develops and then the strong Islamic personality, otherwise they grew up to be weak, feeble, they might be praying and fasting, but their hearts are weak.

It could be a frail body, but it has a heart of a lion.

Abdullah Bin Masood رضي الله عنه was once climbing a palm tree.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) was very short and slim, very skinny.

So a wind gust hit Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), when he was on top of the palm tree, so he was shaking.

And that uncovered his legs.

So the Sahabah(صحابه) saw these thin legs and they laughed, they laughed at his legs.

Look at those legs!

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Are you laughing because of the thinness of his legs.

In the Name of Allah, on the Day of Judgment they are heavier on the scale than the mountain of Uhud(أحَد).

Now brothers! This frail body and weak body of Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), that weak hand, or thin hand was the hand that cut off the head of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل),

the Firaun(فرعون) of this Ummah(امة).

It wasn't a big, muscular wrestler who killed the Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

It was Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود).

He is the one, after a Muawiz(معوذ) and Ma'az Bin Afrah(معاذ بن أفراح), who fought with Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) and the Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was laying down and he wasn't dead yet, he was in his last moments.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), he climbed over the chest of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), when he was lying on his back, he climbed over him, and he held the sword, and he wanted to cut off the head of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) not only was he short and slim, but he was also seen as being from a humble family in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

He was a shepherd of goats.

So Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) told him, You're climbing a very high peak you shepherd of goats.

When he climbed on his chest, he said: You're climbing a very high peak, you shepherd of goats.

I mean it's not even appropriate for you to be sitting on my chest, and that's when Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) cut off his head.

So it's not really the body, it is not the physical strength, it is the heart.

That's what you want to plant in the youth, Amal Qalb(أعمال ألقلب), strong hearts.

The early Mujahideen(مجاهدين) were very cautious from committing sins because they knew the effect that had on their Jihad(جهاد).

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) mentions in his history book, that one of the Muslims during the era of Sultan Az-Zahar Bin Bars(سلطان الزهر بن برص)

used to make Jihad(جهاد) on his horse, which was a strong and fast horse, but one day his horse was acting very different, it was slow and disobedient,

so he was astonished by the reaction of his horse, but then he realized the reason why, and remembered that he has fed his horse food purchased with a counterfeit coin.

So he could feel the resistance of the horse because of the Haram(حرام) food, that he gave it.

O Mujahid(مُجَاهِد), beware of disobeying Allah, sins would weaken your heart and defeat your will, purify your heart from contaminations and spark in, its darkness, the light of Tawakkul(توكل) and Yaqeen(يقين)

and have courage of the One, Who is certain, that death is inevitable and that nothing can protect you from it.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says: Wherever you are, that will find you out.

Even if you are in towers, built up strong and high.

There's no way to get away from death.

And if Allah has destined for someone to be killed.

Nothing can change that faith.

Allah says, They say to themselves, if we had anything, if we had had anything to do with this affair, we should not have been in this laughter here,

say, even if you had remained in your homes, those for whom death was decreed, would certainly have gone forth to the place of their death.

That's Al-Imran(ألعمران) Verse 154.

There's a story of a man who fell down.

Apparently, it's told that story happened in Saudia(سعودية).

A man fell down from the seventh floor or something very high, landed on the pavement and he didn't die.

All of the reasons for dying were there and he didn't die.

So he was very amazed that he was actually alive so he stands up and he's so happy and people gather around him, and he is just celebrating that Allah has given him a new life.

And he's telling to the people I'm gonna buy you some Pepsi(بيبسي), you know in Arabic you don't have a P.

I'm gonna get you some Bebsi(بيبسي).

So he crosses the street to go and buy them some Bebsi(بيبسي) and car rolls over him and he died.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has made an appointment with him, with the angel of death in the middle of the road, it wasn't on the pavement.

And Allah brought him down from the building, down to the pavement and come to the exact place where he was destined to meet the angel of death.

That's where he died.

You cannot get away from it.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) was looking for death, looking for it.

You know, and you can see it in his letters to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and in his statements.

In one of his letters to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he said: And I have thrown myself in situations where I lost hope in living.

Because in one of these battles.

He got married after the battle was over, he got married, after the Battle of Yamamah(يمامة), he got married to the daughter Muja'ah(مجاعة) one of the leaders from Banu Hanifa(بنوحنيفة), he got married to his daughter.

So Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was very upset that he got married and he sends him a very harsh letter he says: You're getting married and you're enjoying a women,

when you have in your court, the bodies of 700 Muslims, I forgot the number who and their blood has not even dried yet.

How could you do that?

Because many Muslims died in the battle of Yamamah(يمامة).

So Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) sends a letter back he's saying: I only got married after victory was complete.

And then he's telling Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) and I have thrown myself in situations in battle, where I have lost hope of living.

And then he told him: And if my sadness, would revive the dead, they would have been revived.

But this is the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and nothing would change it.

In other words, it was the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allah that these die men die, and if my love for them would make them live they would have lived.

Because they are so dear to me.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) when he is dying, he said, there's not a single part of my body that was not struck by a sword, a spear, or an arrow,

and here I am dying on my bed.

So may the eyes of the cowards never get any sleep.

He is saying that I've thrown myself in all these situations one after another.

I have injuries all of all over my body and here I am dying on my bed.

Being cautious will not choose the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

O you who runs away from the battlefield, Realize that running away will not extend your life and being steadfast wouldn't shorten it.

And remember that you have committed the grave sin, and you have clothed yourself with a cloak of humiliation.

Aren't you worried that you might be taken as a prisoner and tortured until you give up your religion, so you end up losing this world and the last.

Aren't you afraid that you might be taken, and then eventually killed.

Whoever has any intelligence would realize that facing death when it's time, has approached is better than turning your back towards it.

If your time of death is now, it's better for you to face it with your chest than to face it with your back.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says, Facing Shahadah(شَهَادَة) not running away from it.

O you who runs away!

Aren't you concerned that while you are running away a stray arrow might strike you and kill you.

So you would end up being in hellfire.

The stories of those who lost their religion because they did not fight, and were taken as prisoners are many.

Al-Bayhaqi(ألبيهقي) narrates from Abdu Bin Abdur Rahim(عبدو بن عبدالرحيم).

This is an interesting story, Abdu Bin Abdur Rahim(عبدو بن عبدالرحيم) narrates that we were in an army in the land of the Romans.

And we had with us, a young man.

Abdu Bin Abdur Rahim(عبدو بن عبدالرحيم) says: There was none among us who used to recite Qur'an better than him.

And he was the most knowledgeable among us, and he would spend his day fasting and his night praying.

He said: While we were passing next to one of the Roman fortresses, he saw this Christian woman and he fell in love with her.

That's it!

From one side, he was hooked to this woman, so he went to the fortress and he started speaking to her.

He said: How can I get access to you?

She said: Simple become Christian, and will open for you the gates.

He became Christian and they open the gates for him.

Abdu Bin Abdur Rahim(عبدو بن عبدالرحيم) said: When we left, we were extremely disheartened and saddened by what happened.

He said: Then a long time passed, and we came back and we passed next to the same fortress.

And we saw this young man standing up on one of the observation posts, along with Roman soldiers guarding the fortress.

So he went to him and said, Oh, so and so! What happened to your Qur'an, what's happened to your good deeds, what's happened to your fasting?

What's happened to your prayer.?

He said: In the name of Allah, I remember nothing from Qur'an except one verse.

And He recited to them the verse that he remembers.

He says: He said: I remember nothing from Qur'an but one verse, Again and again, will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed in Islam.

Leave them alone to enjoy the good things of this life, and to please themselves, let false hope amuse them, soon will knowledge undeceive them,

look at the particular Ayah(آية) that he remembered.

Maybe one day the disbelievers would desire that they would be believers.

Let them enjoy this life, the pleasures of this life and the false hope, because they will come to know the truth.

I give this story, so that you can only ask the Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ to give you Thabat(ثبات).

However, when a Muslim fights sincerely, but then falls into captivity, and his enemy tried to mislead him, Allah would protect him and be on his side.

An example would be the story of Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة), the companion of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Did we talked about his story.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) was captured by the Romans.

The Romans were quite happy to have one of the Sahabah(صحابه), you know for them was the Sahabah(صحابه) was a legendary figure.

Sahabah(صحابه), they would hear about them, all these strange legends, Sahabah(صحابه)!

So the Roman king, he wanted to meet this man, so they brought him Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة).

He told him I want you to become Christian.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) refused.

He said: If you don't, this is what will happen to you.

They had this huge pot with boiling water.

So they brought one of the Muslim prisoners of war and they threw him in the water.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) said: As soon as he landed in that water his flesh started just falling off the bones.

It's so hot, it just separates the flesh from the bones.

They said: If you don't become Christian, this is what we'll do.?

He said: I won't!

So they picked him up in order to throw him in the container.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) started to cry.

So the king said: We got him, he has softened.

Now he is going to become Christian.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) said: Don't think that the reason, why I cried, is because I feared death.

The reason why I cried, is because I realized that I only have one soul.

And I would have desire that Allah would give me souls, the number of hair that I have in my head, so that I could give them one after another, in the path of Allah.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), you see somebody boil in front of you and you see his flesh separating from the bone and then you wish that that happens to you, not once but 100 times,

a 100 times!!!

It's that I wish that I had as many souls as hair on my head, to give them in Sabeel-Lillah(سَبيل الله) one after another.

The king was very impressed by that.

He said: Listen!

If you become Christian, I will marry you to my daughter and give you half of my kingdom, half of my kingdom!!!

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) said: No way!

Now the king wanted to get just anything from Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة).

He is trying everything and he's not getting anywhere.

He says: Alright! If you kiss my forehead, I'm gonna release you.

Just kiss my forehead!!!

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) thought about that and he said: Only if you're gonna release all of the Muslim prisoners of war with me.

The King said: I agree!

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة), he kisses him, and the king releases, all of the Muslim prisoners of war, all of them.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة) gets to Al-Madina, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) hears the news.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) stands up on the Mimber(ممبر) and says, It's a duty on every Muslim in Madina to go and kiss the forehead of Abdullah Bin Hudhafa(عبدالله بن حذافة).

So Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ gave him Sabat(ثبات).

This was narrated by Ibn Al- Athir(اِبْنِ ألأثِيْر).

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) says: It is not allowed for a Muslim to flee death.

If there was no virtue and martyrdom, other than being spared the agony of death, that would have been sufficient enough to make a person refuse to retreat from the battlefield,

Saqrat-Ul-Moat(سكرات الموت).

Ali رضي الله عنه would encourage the Muslims to fight by saying: If you are not killed, you would die.

In the Name of Allah 1000 strikes of a sword are less painful than dying on your bed.

Saqrat-Ul-Moat(سكرات الموت) are very painful.

The agony of death is very painful, and Ali(علي) is saying that 1000 strikes of a sword are gonna hurt you less than dying on your bed.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) is saying this is sufficient enough to make you wanted as Shaheed(شَهِيد).

But then he says, in addition to that, the one who dies on his bed will suffer from the agony of death and after that the darkness and the horror of the grave,

the questioning of the angels, the resurrection, the reckoning the weighing of deeds, and the crossing of the bridge, Shadad Bin Aus(شداد بن الأوس) would say death is the worst experience of this world, or the afterlife.

It is worse than being cut by saws or scissors or boiling water.

So which is better for you, dying in the path of Allah or dying on your bed, you decide for yourself, O mankind Fear your Lord!

For the convulsion of the Hour of judgment will be a terrible thing.

The day you shall see it.

Every mother giving suck shall forget her suckling baby, and every pregnant female she'll drop her load, thou shall see mankind as in a drunken riot,

yet not drunk, but dreadful would be the Wrath of Allah, and then compare this to what the Allah says about the Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء).

Think not of those who are slain in the Allah’s way and dead, Nay they live, finding their sustenance in the presence of their Lord.

They rejoice in the bounty provided by Allah and with regard to those left behind, who have not yet joined them in their bliss.

The martyrs glory in the fact that on them has no fear, nor have they cause to grief, and this is Al-Imran(ألعمران) Verse 169 and 170.

These martyrs are saved from the greatest fears and their abode is paradise.

Their souls are in the insides of green birds.

I guess some of you are tired so might need to take a break.
