اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسليمًا كثيرا مُقْبِلٌ غَيْرُ مُدْبِرٍ Abdullah Bin Amr Bin Al-Aas(عبدالله بن عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said:

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشتَرىٰ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ أَنفُسَهُم وَأَموالَهُم وَأَموالَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الجَنَّةَ ۚ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَقتُلونَ وَيُقتَلونَ

ۖ وَعدًا عَلَيهِ حَقًّا فِي التَّوراةِ وَالإِنجيلِ وَالقُرآنِ ۚ وَمَن أَوفىٰ بِعَهدِهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاستَبشِروا بِبَيعِكُمُ الَّذي بايَعتُم بِهِ

ۚ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ۞

فَإِذا لَقيتُمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَضَربَ الرِّقابِ حَتّىٰ إِذا أَثخَنتُموهُم فَشُدُّوا الوَثاقَ فَإِمّا مَنًّا بَعدُ وَإِمّا فِداءً حَتّىٰ تَضَعَ الحَربُ أَوزارَها ۚ

ذٰلِكَ وَلَو يَشاءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنهُم وَلٰكِن لِيَبلُوَ بَعضَكُم بِبَعضٍۗ وَالَّذينَ قُتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعمالَهُم۞

سَيَهديهِم وَيُصلِحُ بالَهُم ۞

وَيُدخِلُهُمُ الجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَها لَهُم ۞

أهابلتي وَلا تَحسَبَنَّ الَّذينَ قُتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ أَمواتًا ۚ بَل أَحياءٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِم يُرزَقونَ۞

وَلا تَحسَبَنَّ الَّذينَ قُتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ أَمواتًا ۚ بَل أَحياءٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِم يُرزَقونَ۞

إلَّا ما شاء ربك Al Hakim(ألحَاكِم).

يومًا يجعل الولدان شيبا يا أَيُّهَا النّاسُ اتَّقوا رَبَّكُم ۚ إِنَّ زَلزَلَةَ السّاعَةِ شَيءٌ عَظيمٌ۞

يَومَ تَرَونَها تَذهَلُ كُلُّ مُرضِعَةٍ عَمّا أَرضَعَت وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذاتِ حَملٍ حَملَها وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذاتِ حَملٍ حَملَها وَتَرَى النّاسَ سُكارىٰ وَما هُم بِسُكارىٰ

وَما هُم بِسُكارىٰ وَلٰكِنَّ عَذابَ اللَّهِ شَديدٌ۞

إِنَّ زَلزَلَةَ السّاعَةِ شَيءٌ عَظيمٌ۞

يَومَ تَرَونَها تَذهَلُ كُلُّ مُرضِعَةٍ عَمّا أَرضَعَت وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذاتِ حَملٍ حَملَها وَتَرَى النّاسَ سُكارىٰ وَما هُم بِسُكارىٰ وَلٰكِنَّ عَذابَ اللَّهِ شَديدٌ۞

اللهم اجعل خير أعمالنا خواتمها ، وخير أعمارنا أواخرها ، وخير أيامنا يوم ألقاك فيه، وَالسَّلامُ عَلَيَّ يَومَ وُلِدتُ وَيَومَ أَموتُ وَيَومَ أُبعَثُ حَيًّا۞

أنت هجرة ومعاصي فزت ورب الكعبه فزت ورب الكعبه وَحورٌ عينٌ۞ كَأَمثالِ اللُّؤلُؤِ المَكنونِ۞

جَزاءً بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ۞

وَما لَكُم لا تُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَالمُستَضعَفينَ مِنَ الرِّجالِ وَالنِّساءِ وَالوِلدانِ الَّذينَ يَقولونَ الَّذينَ يَقولونَ رَبَّنا أَخرِجنا مِن هٰذِهِ القَريَةِ الظّالِمِ أَهلُها

وَاجعَل لَنا مِن لَدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجعَل لَنا مِن لَدُنكَ نَصيرًا۞

وَما لَكُم لا تُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَالمُستَضعَفينَ مِنَ الرِّجالِ وَالنِّساءِ وَالوِلدانِ الَّذينَ يَقولونَ رَبَّنا أَخرِجنا مِن هٰذِهِ القَريَةِ الظّالِمِ أَهلُها وَاجعَل لَنا مِن لَدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجعَل لَنا مِن لَدُنكَ نَصيرًا۞

فك الآن إِنَّ الَّذينَ آمَنوا وَهاجَروا وَجاهَدوا بِأَموالِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذينَ آوَوا وَنَصَروا أُولٰئِكَ بَعضُهُم أَولِياءُ بَعضٍ ۚ

وَالَّذينَ آمَنوا وَلَم يُهاجِروا ما لَكُم مِن وَلايَتِهِم مِن شَيءٍ حَتّىٰ يُهاجِروا ۚ وَإِنِ استَنصَروكُم فِي الدّينِ فَعَلَيكُمُ النَّصرُ إِلّا

إِلّا عَلىٰ قَومٍ بَينَكُم وَبَينَهُم ميثاقٌ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرٌ۞

وا معتصما يا أَيُّهَا المُدَّثِّرُ۞ قُم فَأَنذِر۞

وَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَاهجُرهُم هَجرًا جَميلًا۞

وَمَن يُهاجِر في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ يَجِد فِي الأَرضِ مُراغَمًا كَثيرًا وَسَعَةً ۚ وَمَن يَخرُج مِن بَيتِهِ مُهاجِرًا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ ثُمَّ يُدرِكهُ المَوتُ

ثُمَّ يُدرِكهُ المَوتُ فَقَد وَقَعَ أَجرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۗ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا۞

أُذِنَ لِلَّذينَ يُقاتَلونَ بِأَنَّهُم ظُلِموا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ نَصرِهِم لَقَديرٌ۞

وَقاتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَكُم وَلا تَعتَدوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ المُعتَدينَ۞

وَقاتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَكُم وَلا تَعتَدوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ المُعتَدينَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا قاتِلُوا الَّذينَ يَلونَكُم مِنَ الكُفّارِ وَليَجِدوا فيكُم غِلظَةً ۚ وَاعلَموا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ المُتَّقينَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا قاتِلُوا الَّذينَ يَلونَكُم مِنَ الكُفّارِ وَليَجِدوا فيكُم غِلظَةً ۚ كُتِبَ عَلَيكُمُ القِتالُ وَهُوَ كُرهٌ لَكُم ۖ وَعَسىٰ أَن تَكرَهوا شَيئًا وَهُوَ خَيرٌ لَكُم ۖ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشتَرىٰ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ أَنفُسَهُم وَأَموالَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الجَنَّةَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَ في سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيانٌ مَرصوصٌ۞

إستو يا سواد يا سواد ما حملك على ما صنعتك لقد حضر ما ترى من القتال أبشر يا أبا بكر إِذ يوحي رَبُّكَ إِلَى المَلائِكَةِ أَنّي مَعَكُم فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذينَ آمَنوا ۚ

سَأُلقي في قُلوبِ الَّذينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعبَ فَاضرِبوا فَوقَ الأَعناقِ وَاضرِبوا مِنهُم كُلَّ بَنانٍ۞

إِذ يوحي رَبُّكَ إِلَى المَلائِكَةِ أَنّي مَعَكُم فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذينَ آمَنوا ۚ سَأُلقي في قُلوبِ الَّذينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعبَ فَاضرِبوا فَوقَ الأَعناقِ وَاضرِبوا مِنهُم كُلَّ بَنانٍ۞

وَلَقَد نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدرٍ وَأَنتُم أَذِلَّةٌ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ۞

أحسن في موالي أرسلني ويحك أرسلني هم لك وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُم شُهَداءَ ۗ والله لأدينَّهما يا محمد كنت تنها عن الفساد في الأرض والآن تفسد في الأرض

ما قَطَعتُم مِن لينَةٍ أَو تَرَكتُموها قائِمَةً عَلىٰ أُصولِها فَبِإِذنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخزِيَ الفاسِقينَ۞

وَظَنّوا أَنَّهُم مانِعَتُهُم حُصونُهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says, وَقَذَفَ في قُلوبِهِمُ الرُّعبَ ۚ وَقاتِلوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذينَ يُقاتِلونَكُم وَلا تَعتَدوا ۚ

parts.english:
We talked about the battles of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Al-Ghazawaat(ألغزوات).

Now we'll talk about the Sarayah(سراية) and the greatest Sariyah(سرية) at all is called Ghazawa Mu'tah(غزوة مَؤتَة).

So, it's given the title of Ghazwa(غزوة), Ghazawa Mu'tah(غزوة مَؤتَة) I mean.

Ibn Nihass(ابن نحاس) says, it occurred in Jamada Al- Ula(جمادی الاولی) the eight of Hijrah(هجرة).

It was an army of 3000 headed by Zaid Ibn Harisa(زید ابن حارثه), they headed for Al-Balkaa(ألبلقاء) in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

The Messenger of Allah gave his instructions to the army.

If Zaid(زيد) is killed then Jafar Ibn Abi Talib(جعفرابن ابی طالب) takes charge.

And if he is killed, then Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبداللہ بن رواحة) leads.

When they reached Ma'an(معان) in present day Jordan, they heard that the Roman Emperor has mobilized an army of 100,000 Roman soldiers, in addition to another 100,000 Arab tribesmen.

Due to the sheer numbers of the enemies, some Muslims suggested writing to the Messenger of Allah to maybe send them reinforcements, or give them a different order.

But Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) said: Oh, people, what you are fearing is what you came for in the first place, martyrdom.

We do not fight our enemy with our numbers or our equipment, but we fight them with this religion, which Allah honored us with.

So let's fight! Both our options are great.

It is either going to be victory or martyrdom.

This encouraged the Muslims and they decided to go ahead - and meet the army, 3000 faced 200,000.

Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) said: When the enemy's army approached, we saw what none of us could imagine in numbers and arms my eyes quivered.

They never saw an army like this in their life.

So Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) said: My eyes just quivered when I saw, what I saw in front of me.

Sabit Ibn Arqam(ثابت إبن أرقم) told me: Abu Hurairah(ابوهريره) it seems that you are staring at a huge army.

I said: Yes! He said: You were not with us at Badr(بدر) we did not win due to our numbers.

He is giving him to Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) a lessons, see Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) became a Muslim, around the time of Khaybar(خَيْبَر), so he did not witness badr(بدر), Uhud(أحَد), Al-Khandaq(خندق).

So Sabit(ثابت) is telling him that in Badr(بدر) we were very small army, 314.

Nevertheless, we went against our enemy.

A violent battle erupted the head of the Muslim armies Zaid(زيد) was killed.

The leader of following him was Jafar(جعفر).

His right hand carrying the banner was cut off, so he carried it with his left hand, which was then cut off.

He then hugged it with what was left of both arms, until he was killed.

The third leader Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة) took charge a cousin of his, gave him a piece of dried meat to eat, and told him, Strengthen yourself with this.

You have went through a lot this day, he grabbed it and he took a bite.

Then he told himself, you are still in this world.

And he threw the piece of meat away and fought, until he was killed.

The three successive leaders appointed by the Messenger of Allah fell dead.

So Zaid Bin Arqam(زید ابن ارقم) held the banner and told the Muslims to agree on a leader.

They said: You! He said: No!

Find someone else.

They chose Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

He fought for a while and then planned the retreat and decided to go back to Madina.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) was a new Muslim then.

While the battle was still running hundreds of miles away, the Messenger of Allah said: Zaid(زيد) held the banner and was killed.

Then the banner was carried by Jafar(جعفر), who was also killed.

And then, it was carried by Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة), who was also killed.

Then the banner was carried by a sword from Allah and opening would occur on his hands.

And that's when Rasool Allah ﷺ gave Khalid(خالد) the title, of Sword of Allah.

Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) poses the question, Was Mu'tah(مَؤتَة) defeat or victory?

He says: Some considered it to be a defeat.

Some consider it to be neither defeat nor victory.

While many scholars considered Mu'tah(مَؤتَة) to be a victory for the Muslims, among these are Al-Waqdi(ألواقعدي), Al-Bayhaqi(ألبيهقي) and Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر).

Al-Waqdi(ألواقعدي) says: When Khalid(خالد) became the leader, he fought for the rest of the day and then during their rest at night, - he had the Muslim army reconfigure.

So he had the left flank move to the right, and vice versa.

So the next day when the Romans saw the change, they thought that the Muslims had received reinforcements.

What Khalid(خالد) did, all what he did was, he switched the flanks.

So the Romans wake up in the next day in the morning, they find new faces in front of them.

They said: Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) we have a new army.

So they retreated, and when they retreated, Khalid(خالد) also retreated.

In Bukhari(بخاريْ) Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) says: During the Battle of Mu'tah(مَؤتَة) nine swords broke in my hand, only a Yemeni firm sword I had survived on that day.

Imagine breaking nine swords, these are solid pieces of steel - they were breaking.

In Topkapi museum in Istanbul They have a lot of the relics of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم and they have a sword that they claim, - belongs to Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

Now Allah Ho Alam(الله أعلم)  how valid of these claims are, because they have a tooth, they said: It belong to Rasool Ullah, a hair, it belongs to Rasool Ullah,

they had a few different swords of Al-Abbas(العباس), Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد), but anyway, I remember one of those swords, I think it belonged to Al-Abbas(العباس),

It was this huge piece of quill Yani(يعني) very long and thick.

I mean, just carrying it with would be an effort in itself, let alone fighting with it for an entire day.

They must have had some serious physical strength, to be able to fight with such a sword for a whole day.

Tayeb(طيِّب) other armies, the Messenger of Allah sent, headed by his companions and I'll just go through these.

These are Sarayah(سراية) to show you how active the military scene was, you know when that guy said that when Rasool Allah ﷺ only fought for 19 days in Madina,

just look at how many Sarayah(سراية) there were and I've translated Sariyah(سرية) as detachment.

I will just use the word Sariyah(سرية).

2. The Sariyah(سرية) of Obaidah Bin Al Harith (عبیدہ بن الحارث) of 60 Muhajireen(مهاجرين) to Rabigh(رابغ).

3. The Sariyah(سرية) of Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعد إبن أبي وقاص).

4. The Sariyah(سرية) of Abdullah Bin Jahsh(عبداللہ بن جحش)  to Badr(بدر).

5. The Sariyah(سرية) of Amr Bin Udae(عمروبن عديئ).

6. The Sariyah(سرية) of Salim Bin Umair(سالم بن عمیر).

7. The Sariyah(سرية) sent to assassinate Kaab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف).

8. The Sariyah(سرية) of Zaid Bin Harisa(زید ابن حارثه)  to Al-Qurfah(ألقرفة).

Umar(عُمَر) said: Tamanoo(تمنوا)! Make a wish.

The other one said: I wish that this room would be filled with pearls and jewels, so I can spend them in the path of Allah.

Umar(عُمَر) said: Tamanoo(تمنوا)! Make a wish.

They said: What else can we say?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه said.

I wish if Allah will fill up this room with men like Abu Obaidah Amr Bin Jarrah(أبوعبيدةعمروبن جرَّاح).

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not leave behind gold, he did not leave behind pearls.

That's what he did!

Rasool Allah ﷺ left behind men.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, the harvest of his effort of 23 years was men.

The palaces that are built in Al-Hamra(ألحمراء), and Damascus and Baghdad and the wealth that the Ummah(امة) had and has today is all a fruit of the effort of all Rasool Allah ﷺ those 10,000 men that he left behind.

Every blessing and every Barakah(بركة), that we have, we're living off what Rasool Allah ﷺ left us.

He left behind the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم.

That it is, this religion changes the heart of men.

We were people who were humiliated before Islam and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ honored us through Islam.

Our honor comes because of Islam.

In year 20 the battle of Tastur(تستر) happened.

They entered the city and Majza'ah(مجزعة) traveled through it, until he learned its map.

So, Majza'ah(مجزعة) was swimming through this underground stream.

He surfaces in the city walks around the city and he makes a mental map of the entire city.

The Persian man also pointed out to him the Persian general Hurmuzan(ألهرمزان).

Majza'ah(مجزعة) returned and was sent along with 35 men to conquer the city.

Chapter 15, COURAGE AND FEAR.

Abu Hurairah(أبوهريرة) narrated: The strong believer is more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.

And that's in Sahih Al-Muslim(صحيح ألمسلم).

Rasool Allah ﷺ used to say: O Allah I seek refuge in you from gloom and Sorrow, from inaction and laziness, and from cowardice, stinginess and old age,

and I seek refuge in you from the punishment of the grave.

Very important Dua(دُعَا) to make because you are human and fear is a natural human thing.

Everyone has fear, it's just a matter of degree.

Some people have more fear than others.

Your fear needs to be channeled to the right direction rather than fearing the creation, you fear Allah.

Al-Izza Bin Abdul Salam(ألعزَّة بن عبدالسلام) when he went to visit a tyrant, one of Mangol.

He was company by his students.

So he started giving him Naseeha(نَصيحة), and he was becoming louder and louder and suddenly he was pointing fingers towards this tyrant.

So the students were very, very afraid, worried.

He could just chop off your head.

So when they came out they said: How did you dare to speak to the tyrant in such confidence and strong way.

He said: When I saw him and then I imagined the greatness of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, he became smaller in my eyes than a cat.

I saw him smaller than a cat.

But that's only when I started thinking about the Azamah(عظمى) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) was accompanying a delegation from Damascus to go and meet the head of a ta’tarr(تتار) and ta’tar(تتار) were like a swarm of locusts that was destroying everything that comes in its path.

So they wanted to go and visit this king and to try to convince him.

And by the way at the time that the tat’arr(تتار) were already Muslim, See, they became Muslim but they carried on with their tyranny.

It took them some time, time for Islam to sink in and for them to get it.

This, this ta’tarr(تتار) king, he actually had the mobile Mimber(ممبر) and Mehrab(محراب) with him, that he would carry along and then hired Imam(اِمَام) to lead Salah(صلاة) and to make Adhan(آذَان).

So, Yani(يعني) once Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) was walking with his students and they saw them drinking.

They saw these Mangol drinking.

So the students they wanted to make, They wanted to stop them.

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) said: Let them drink.

Let them carry on, if they're sober, they're going to be killing Muslims, if they're drunk, they would leave the Muslims alone.

So let them carry on and drink.

So they went and in this delegation and you know in delegations you supposed to follow the etiquettes there's another protocol.

You need to follow the protocol of how to speak and how to act and what should be said.

So they go in there and obviously the Shaikh(شيخ) among them is Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) and everybody had something to say.

So now this king said, requested Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) to make a Dua(دُعَا).

Make a Dua(دُعَا) for us O Shaikh(شيخ).

So Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) started making a Dua(دُعَا).

And then he started making Dua(دُعَا) against the king and the king is saying Ameen(آمين), Ameen(آمين).

Everyone in the delegation their knees started cracking shaking, trembling.

It is said that they started wrapping up the clothes because they expected the sword to chop off his head at any moment.

And they didn't want the blood to splash all over them.

But it was a Hifz(حفظ) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ  that this king has no clue what Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) is saying: He's just saying, Ameen(آمين).

As soon as they left the quarters of the king.

The delegation came to Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) and said: Are you crazy, what have you done!

And they started blaming him and yelling at them and then they said: Listen, we never want you to accompany us again.

You go your way, we're gonna go ours, he said fine, you go your way, I'm gonna go mine.

He and his students, alone, went one way and the entire delegation went another way.

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) gets into Damascus and is waiting for this delegation to arrive what happens is they got raided.

They got raided by some armed burglars who stole everything they have, and Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) reaches the town safely and securely.

It is the Hifz(حفظ) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

They have feared the creation, and they have not feared Allah.

So, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ put them through this punishment, while Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) because he feared Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, Allah protected him.

Notice that Rasool Allah ﷺ combined between seeking refuge in Allah from gloom and sorrow.

For gloom is the fear of what is coming, while sorrow is sadness on what has already passed.

Al-Hum(هَمِّ) is concerned for something that is coming.

Actually the whole reason why we learn this Dua(دُعَا) is because Rasool Allah ﷺ came into the Masjid(مسجد).

And he saw one of the Sahabah(صحابه) laying on his back in the Masjid(مسجد) during business hours.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: Don't you have any work to do.?

He said: O Messenger of Allah, I'm in debt.

I have concerns about all of the debts that I have accumulated, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: Say this Dua(دُعَا), So this man was fearing for the future, how is he gonna pay all of these debts?

So the Muslim should not feel sorry for the past nor fear the future.

And he combined between inaction and laziness for inaction is the state of the heart, while laziness is the state of the body.

Ajaz(عجز) is in heart and Kasal(كسل) is in the body.

He combined between stinginess and cowardice, For stinginess is the unwillingness to give wealth for Allah, while cowardice is the unwillingness to give the soul for Allah.

How to overcome fear?

Cowardice is the opposite of courage.

And courage is the firmness of the heart.

The heart is the essence of every good deed.

The heart cannot be firm if the mind isn’t sound.

If the heart is weak it leads to cowardice, and if the heart is too strong it leads to recklessness.

The coward needs to cure cowardice by eliminating its cause.

If it is caused by ignorance then ignorance is cured by learning.

The cause could be fear of the unknown and that is cured by experiencing situations.

We find that the beginner in public speaking experiences fear in the beginning but after experience this fear is overcome.

We find that when a person first meets a king they might fear the occasion and their tongue would be tied and their posture would change.

That is due to the anxiety of facing a new experience.

But if that occasion is repeated many times the fear is eliminated.

Original nature can be changed.

It is sufficient as proof to see a Hawa(هوَّا) child, children trained to care for snakes, they had these children, who would care for snakes.

Grabbing a large snake that would make a brave man tremble, while this same child could fear a frog because he is not exposed to frogs.

Taming animals is a process of changing their original nature and it is done through training.

A wolf could play with a sheep, a cat with a mouse, and a dog with a cat, if they are conditioned to do so, even though that is contrary to their original nature.

Now if animals can change their characteristics can’t humans do the same?

Having a strong heart leads to victory.

Ali(علي) was asked: "How do you defeat your enemies?" He said: When I would meet my enemy I would believe with firm conviction that I would defeat him, while he believes that I would defeat him.

So, both myself and his self support me against him.

I mean Ali(علي) starts with confidence that he would defeat the enemy and the enemy when he hears the name of Ali(علي), he is sure that he's going to lose.

So, Ali(علي)'s heart and the heart of his enemy are both against the enemy.

Half of the battle is already won.

And that's why a Muslim who's willing to die, who's willing to become a Shaheed(شَهِيد), he has already won half of the battle.

And that's why again the Kuffar(كفار) they hate this issue of martyrdom, they hate it, they can't stand it.

They want to change the Fiqh(فقه) of it, they want to change the opinions of the scholars on it.

They don't want any Muslim to do it, at all.

Because that's the one thing that they cannot replicate, they can meet your weapons with better weapons, they can meet your numbers with more numbers,

they can meet your training with better training, but they cannot meet a Muslim heart, that is willing to die for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

That is one thing that their best academies, their best training their most advanced weapons cannot deal with.

Some have advised, believe in victory, you will be victorious, Others say: "If you fear your enemy you have allowed an army to be sent against your heart".

Al-Tartooshi(ألترتوشي) says: Courage is of three types: Number 1) A man who stands in front of the army asking for a challenger from the enemy to come out and face him, dueling.

Number 2) A man who remains calm, concentrating, tranquil while the battle is ragging.

And when others are succumbing to fear he has not lost his orientation and is not confused and acts in a way that proves he has control over himself.

Number 3) A man when everyone else is defeated and is retreating remains firm calling them, and encouraging them to continue the fight.

Al-Tartooshi(ألترتوشي) says that the third man possesses the greatest form of courage.

He is so courageous that even when everybody else is retreating, he is still firm.

And he's encouraging others to fight.

Then Ibn Nuhas(إبن نُحاس) goes through some of the courageous of the Ummah(امة).

I don't think I translated the stories of all of them, those who whatever, I have here.

He had the strongest heart of all.

He faced the toughest of situations.

Heroes would scatter from around him while he is firm.

The Messenger of Allah never turned his back in battle.

Rasool Allah ﷺ picked up a spear and threw it at Obaeye(اُبَيئ), who was covered in iron armor from head to toe.

Muhammad(محمد) claimed he would kill me, so even if he would have spit on me I would have died.

Obaeye(اُبَيئ) later died on his way back to Makkah, just died out of fear.

There is long story about him.

A man who was a believer in that environment of Kuffr(كفر), and he concealed his Eeman(ايمان).

So, the status of this man was so great, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ devoted Ayaat(آيات) and Ayaat(آيات) talking about his story.

So Ali(علي) is asking who is greater, the believer of the family of Firaun(فرعون), or Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).?

The people remained quite.

He said: Why don’t you answer?

In the name of Allah, one moment in the life of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is greater than the entire earth full of the likes of the believer of the family of Firaun(فرعون)!

The believer of the family of Firaun(فرعون) was a man who concealed his faith, while Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was a man who proclaimed his faith and then Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه cried.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is the bravest man of this Ummah(امة) after Rasool Allah ﷺ.

One can note the strength of his heart during the battle of Badr(بدر), Uhud(أحَد), Khandaq(خندق), Hudaybiyah(حديبية), and Hunain(حنين).

It is enough to note his steadfastness, firmness, and strengthening of the entire Ummah(امة) when the greatest disaster of all befell us, is the death of Muhammadﷺ.

That was when the hearts deviated, and the nation was shaken.

When all the hearts where trembling the heart of As-Sidique(ألصديق) was firm.

If the heart of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was placed on one side of the scale and the hearts of all the Ummah(امة) on the other, his heart would outweigh them all.

The courage of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) in his decision to fight the apostates, if distributed over the hearts of the cowards on the entire face of the earth, it would be sufficient to make them brave.

So you can see that the issue with courage is in the heart, because Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), in terms of his physical stature, was extremely, he was very thin.

He was so thin that he went to Rasool Allah ﷺ complaining that his Izaar(إزار) wouldn't hold on to his waist.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ said that you should have your Izaar(إزار) above the ankle.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and he said: My Izaar(إزار) wouldn't hold on to my waist he was so slim, that his Izaar(إزار) would keep on falling.

So, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) had to keep on pulling it up.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Bakr(ابوبكر): You're not one of those who are doing it out of pride.

He was so slim, it says: You could see the bones on his face.

That's enough!

The reason is Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) knows it's a waste of time, to try to deal with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

You can't change anything in him.

So he fears him so much and he is frustrated with him so much and he just gave up on him, he would leave him alone and go another way.

The Messenger of Allah told Umar(عُمَر): O son of Khattab(خطاب), In the name of whom my soul is in His hands whenever Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) sees you taking a route,

he would take another.

That’s in Bukhari(بخاريْ) and Muslim(ألمسلم).

His Islam brought strength to the Muslims.

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said: We used to not be able to pray next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) publicly until Umar(عُمَر) became Muslim.

Number 3: Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب): He was the lion of this Ummah(امة), he never missed a battle with Rasool Allah ﷺ except Tabook(تبوک)

because Rasool Allah ﷺ appointed him over Madina in his absence.

During the battle of Khaybar(خَيْبَر), Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Tomorrow I will give the banner to a man who loves Allah and His Messenger, and Allah and His Messenger love him.

He does not turn his back away in battle and Allah will make opening occur on his hands.

All of the Sahabah(صحابه) desired that honor.

The next day, so the Sahabah(صحابه) woke up very early in the morning and they started walking in front of Rasool Ullah, so that he will choose them.

The next day the Messenger of Allah called Ali(علي).

They told them Ali(علي), Ali(علي) was suffering, his eyes were suffering and couldn't see that day.

So he told Rasool Allah ﷺ that he cannot see.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Call him, and Rasool Allah ﷺ spit in his eyes and he was immediately cured, and he gave him the banner.

Musab Ibn Zubair(مصعب إبن زبير) said: Ali(علي) was very cautious in battle.

Even though Ali(علي) was courageous but his courage, doesn't mean that you're not cautious, courage doesn't mean that you become reckless.

Musab Ibn Zubair(مصعب إبن زبير) said: Ali(علي) was very cautious in battle.

He was swerve terrifically from his enemy and whenever he charges his enemy he would protect all his sides and when he retreats back from his charge he would be even more protective of himself.

No one could get to him.

His shield was one sided.

It only protected him from the front.

When asked: Don’t you fear an attack from behind?

He replied: I never give my enemy the chance to attack me from my back.

So he didn't really needed a shield from behind.

Number 4) Talha Bin Ubaidellah(طلحة بن عبيدالله): He is one of the ten given the glad tidings of Paradise.

During Uhud(أحَد), he shielded Rasool Allah ﷺ with his own body causing over 70 injuries in his body.

Whenever Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to look at the disbelievers, Talha(طلحة) would plead with him not to do so and would shield him with his body.

Number 5) Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام): He is also one of the ten given the glad tidings of Paradise.

He was the first Muslim to draw out a sword.

During the early days of Islam in Makkah a rumor spread that Rasool Allah ﷺ was kidnapped.

Zubair(زبير) drew out his sword and went looking for him.

He ran into Rasool Allah ﷺ who asked him: What’s wrong with you Zubair?

He said: I heard that you were kidnapped so I came out to fight them!

Rasool Allah ﷺ prayed for him.

And we talked about the story with the spear, when he bent the blade, and did I say when he chopped the, the Kafir(كافر) with the sword and it split the saddle.

In one of the battles, Az-Zubair(ألزبير) hits this enemy soldier who was on his horse.

He hit him so hard that he split him into two.

Not only that but the sword went down a bit further, and cut the saddle.

So the saddle fell from both sides.

Sahabah(صحابه), they saw that and they were so impressed they said: This is a very, very sharp sword.

This is a powerful sword.

He said: It's not the sword, but it's the arm that's carrying the sword.

Don't give credit to my sword.

Number 6) Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص): He is one of ten given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ prayed for him: O Allah make his arrow hit its target and make his prayer accepted.

Umar(عُمَر) appointed him to lead the army at Qadisiyah(قادسية).

The Muslims won and he continued leading them in Persia until he opened most of it and entered the capital, Al-Mada'in(ألمدائن).

Saad(سعد) is the one who founded the two cities of Kufa(كوفة) and Basra(بصرى).

He is the one who founded them.

When he was dying he requested his body be rapped and buried in an old wool cloth.

He said: This was what I had on me, during the battle of Badr(بدر) and I’ve reserved it for this day.

Number 7. Abu Obaidah Bin Jarrah(أبوعبيدة بن جرَّاح): He is one of the ten given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

Umar(عُمَر) appointed him over the army opening Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

He was the leader of the army during the great battle of Yarmuk(يرموك).

He died in the plague of Amawas(عمواس) in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

Number 8) Hamza Bin AbdulMutalib(حمزة بن عبدالمطلب): He is the lion of Allah and His Messenger.

After the battle of Badr(بدر), Umayyah Bin Khalaf(أمية بن خلف), who was captured asked Abdul Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف), Who was the man in your army marked with an ostrich feather on his chest?

Abdul Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: That is Hamza(حمزه).

Umayyah(أمية) said: He is the one, who brought ruin to us!

He was killed during the battle of Uhud(أحَد).

Number 9): Jafar Ibn Abi Talib(جعفرإبن أبي طالب): He was ten years older than his brother Ali(علي).

He was the second leader in line at the battle of Mu'tah(مَؤتَة).

When he took over after Zaid(زيد), he carried the banner with his right hand which was cut off so he carried it with his left, which was in turn also cut off so he embraced the banner and continued fighting until he fell.

They found in the front of his body over 90 injuries.

10. Muadh Bin Amr Bin Jamooh(معاذبن عمرو بن جموح): He was the slayer of the Pharaoh of this Ummah(امة) Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

He said: I made Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) my target on the day of Badr(بدر).

When I found him I charged at him and struck him with my sword and cut his leg in two.

It only remained hanging to my body by the skin of my side.

But because fighting distracted me, I remained dragging it behind me for most of the day.

When it annoyed me I placed my foot over it and pulled it off.

11) Al-Baraa Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك): He is the brother of Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) the servant of Rasool Ullah, he was one of heroes of this Ummah(امة).

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) heard his brother Al-Baraa(ألبراء) humming poetry so he told him: O my brother! Are you are humming poetry?

What if this is the last thing you speak?

Sunan Ibn Abi Shaiba(مصنف إبن أبي شيبة).

Umar(عُمَر) wrote to his military generals to never allow Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) to hold any position of leadership in the Muslim armies.

The reason: Umar(عُمَر) said: He is too hazardous for the Muslims!

That's in Al-Hakim(ألحَاكِم).

During the battle against the forces of Musailima(مسيلمة), the liar, he sat on a shield and asked the Muslims to carry the shield on their spears

That’s in Asabah(أثابة).

On the day of the battle of Tastur(تستر) the Muslims asked Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) to make an oath to give them victory.

Because Al-Bara'a(ألبراء), was one of the men intended by the Hadith(حديث), There is a man with untidy hair, and very dusty clothes.

But if he makes an oath, Allah will fulfill it.

A very simple man, poor, but Allah loves that man so much, if that man makes an oath, Allah will make it happen.

So they told Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) ask Allah to give us victory.

He said: O Allah! I make an oath that you hand us over their shoulders and to make me follow your prophet.

He charged the enemy and the Muslims followed him.

The Persians lost, and Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) was martyred, Allah fulfilled his oath.

Anas(أنس) narrated: When Abu Musa(أبوموسى) was appointed governor over Basra(ألبصرى), he told Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) to choose any position of leadership in his government, and he will be appointed to it.

Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) said: I don’t want any.

Rather I want you to hand me over my bow, horse, spear, sword, and shield and then sent me to Jihad(جهاد).

He sent him in an army Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) was the first to die.

12. Samaak Bin Kharshah Abu Dujana(سماك بن خرشة ابودجانة), Before the battle of Uhud(أحَد) started the Messenger of Allah held a sword in his hand and said:

Who would fight with this sword and give it its due right?

Abu Dujana(أبودجانة) said: I will take it, O Rasool Ullah, he gave it to him.

Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام) said: I felt saddened that I, the cousin of Rasool Allah ﷺ, would ask for the sword and would not get it

but Abu Dujana(أبودجانة) would.

So I decided to follow Abu Dujana(أبودجانة) and see what he would do with it.

Abu Dujana(أبودجانة) pulled out a Red Bandana and tied it around his head.

The Ansaar(أنصار) said: Abu Dujana(أبودجانة) has pulled out his Bandana of death!

He then attacked enemy and whenever he would face anyone he would kill him!

Before the battle he marched with pride before the enemy.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This is a walk despised by Allah, because he walked with pride.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This is the walk despised by Allah except in this situation.

This is stiking fear in the hearts of the enemy.

During the battle of Al-Yamamah(أليمامة), he threw himself over the wall surrounding the city and broke his leg.

He continued fighting with a broken leg until he became Shaheed(شهيد).

As soon as he became Muslim, Rasool Allah ﷺ was sending him to fight the enemies of Allah.

Khalid(خالد) never in his life lost a battle.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: If I were to marry a beautiful woman whom I love, or if I were given the good news of having a newborn son,

is less beloved and dear to my heart then to be in a cold icy night, in an army waiting to meet my enemy the next morning.

I advise you to go on Jihad(جهاد).

These were the last words of Khalid(خالد).

The best of our foot soldiers today is Salamah Bin Akwa(سلمةبن أكوع).

Two men riding on a camel struck them with the spear and killed both.

I am going to cross the bridge, if you follow me after a time equivalent to the time it takes to slaughter a camel.

You would find me with my sword in my hand fighting whoever is in front of me with the enemy surrounding me and I am standing between them.

If you come later than that you would find me dead.

He then crossed the bridge over the river towards the enemy’s camp.

A while later his people said: O sons of Zabid(زبيد)!

Are we going to leave our man alone?

We might not even catch him alive.

So they crossed the bridge and found him without his horse, while he was holding both back legs of an enemy’s horse and the horse failed to move.

The fighter on the horse was trying to reach Amr(عمرو) behind him, with his sword with no avail.

I mean, you can imagine, he is frantically trying to hit Amr(عمرو) who's holding the horse and the horse cannot move.

When the fighter saw us attacking he came down from his horse and ran away.

Amr(عمرو) then mounted the horse, he told us, you almost were almost going to miss me.

They asked him: Where is your horse? He said: It was hit by an arrow that killed it and I fell off its back.

Now you want me to take caution when I am fighting for Allah and His Messenger!

Al-Harith Bin Hisham(ألحارث بن هشام), Dhirar bin al Azwar(ضرارإبن أزور) along with 400 of the brave gave their pledge.

They attacked the Romans and disappeared in their ranks.

Ikrimah(عكرمة) never came out.

His body was found with more than seventy injuries.

These are 400, who pledged martyrdom, in a martyrdom operation.

Umar(عُمَر) replied: I have sent you 2000 men.

Amr Bin Madi Yakrib(عمروبن معديكرب) and Tulaiha Al-Azdi(طليحةألأسدي).

Each one of them counts as a thousand.

Tulaiha(طليحة), Amr(عمرو), and Qais Bin Makshooh(قيس بن مكشوح) went on a reconnaissance mission to the enemy’s army.

Both Amr(عمرو) and Qais(قيس) kidnapped some Persian soldiers and brought them back to the Muslim camp for interrogation.

Tulaiha(طليحة) went further, so now these were three men, two of them came back with prisoners and Tulaiha(طليحة) is carrying on.

Tulaiha(طليحة) went further until he was in the camp of the army’s commander.

He hid until nightfall and then went straight to the tent of the commander and took away his horse, which was tied to the tent and ran away.

A Persian horseman saw that and he followed him.

Tulaiha(طليحة) killed him and took his horse along with his and the commander’s horse.

Another horseman pursued him and Tulaiha(طليحة) also killed him and took his horse.

A third horseman attacked him but then surrendered.

Tulaiha(طليحة) captured him and carried him away, along with a total of four horses in addition to his.

The Muslim leaders gathered to question the Persian who turned out to be one of their leaders.

He said: I have fought numerous battles but I have never seen anything like this man!

He crossed our camps until he made it to where even the bravest of men would not dare, the camp of our army’s commander, which had over 70,000 soldiers.

As if that wasn’t enough he went ahead and took the commander’s horse!

The first of us to follow him was considered among us to be equal to a thousand men and he killed him!

The second to follow him was killed and then I pursued him and I don’t think that there is anyone in the army equal to myself in strength and courage.

But I saw death on his hands and surrendered!

The man then accepted Islam and fought alongside the Muslims.

This is Da'wah(دعوة)!!!

Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان), at the time was the Khalifah(خليفه), and he was a businessman, he was wealthy, but he accepted the money of Abdul Rahman Bin Auf(عبدالرحمن بن عوف) because he said:

It is 100% Halal(حلال), it's coming from Ghanaem(غنائم).

It's coming from Ghanaem(غنائم) that he invests.

The second issue, taking Ghanimah(غنيمه) from Dar Ul-Harb(دارالحرب) and whether these areas would be classified as Dar Ul-Harb(دارالحرب).

I think that, for us, the issue should be beyond having second thoughts on whether this is Dar Ul-Harb(دارالحرب) or not.

And I don't think it's even time for us to discuss the evidences for that.

It's an issue that is beyond discussion, it shouldn't be clear, and it should be common knowledge, and the straw that broke the camel's back is Iraq, but that's just a straw.

So from a Fiqh(فقه) point of view, there's no issue here was the legality of taking Ghanaem(غنائم), from strictly Shariah(شريعة) point of view.

However, there are some statement needs to be studied, from Fiqh Al-Waqiah(فقه الواقع) point of view and a strategic point of view, you have two concerns.

Number one, money and Uraz(عراض).

these three issues, blood wealth, and Urraz(عرض), women.

Because there's room for corruption in these three areas.

Islam has placed restrictions, so that these three areas are not handled on an individual basis, but they are handled on a collective basis.

So only a Jama'ah(جماعة) can take a decision in these areas.

When it comes to the demaa(دماء), the blood of people, when it comes to the wealth of people, and when it comes to Al-Uraz(ألعراض), woman, it must be done in a collective way

through the permission of an Ameer(أمير) and Shurah(شورى).

It is not an issue that is taken into individual hands.

And this is very clear from Shariah(شريعة) point of view, the role that is given to the Ameer(أمير) in applying Hadd(حدّ).

These issues were given to Amara(أمارة), why?

Because there's room for a lot of corruption in these areas.

These areas are open for people to take matters into their own hands, there will be Fasad Fil Ardh(فساد فى الأرض), there will be corruption on land.

And it will lead to a chaotic stage.

So when it comes to these issues, the decision is made through a Jama'ah(جماعة) and through an Ameer(أمير).

The second concern, the reputation of Muslims is a valid concern.

The reputation of Muslims is a valid concern.

It is not good for the Muslims to have a reputation of being burglars of being rapists and Rasool Allah ﷺ did take such matters in consideration.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was told by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to kill Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَيئ), who was the head of Munafiqeen(مُنافقين) and he deserved to be executed.

What did Rasool Allah ﷺ say?

He said: I don't want people to go around saying that Muhammad(محمد) is killing his followers.

So he didn't disagree with the fact that he deserves to die.

But he said that it's not good for the reputation of Muslims.

That's the only reason I'm not going to kill him because I don't want people to say that Muhammad(محمد) is killing his followers.

That will turn people away from Islam, they're gonna say we're not going to follow a man who will end up killing us.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ withheld that decision and did not execute Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَيئ) who has called has caused so much Fitnah(فِتْنَه), and so much disunity, and so much Fasad(فساد) in the Muslim community.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had patience in that regard.

So the reputation is important.

If the Muslims still have a good reputation in such areas, they should be careful.

If the reputation is already tarnished and gone, then that is not a concern anymore.

The third concern regarding, this issue is, in my view, and I've heard Yani(يعني) two other opinions that I heard are contrary to this.

All of such money needs to be dealt with as faye(فيئ) and not Ghanimah(غنيمه), it should be dealt as if it is Faye(فيئ) and not Ghanimah(غنيمه).

Therefore, none of it, goes to the individual, the entire amount goes to the Jama'at(جماعة).

And that's also a safety valve to make sure that people are not going to start doing things for their own personal gain and benefit.

And that is Fasad(فساد), and also from Fiqh(فقه) point of view, it looks like faye(فيئ), there is no fighting involved.

So how can it be Ghanimah(غنيمه)?

How can a person take four fifth of it or half or whatever, if there is no fighting involved.

So it should be dealt with as faye(فيئ) and not Ghanimah(غنيمه), and when it's faye(فيئ), all of it goes to the Jama'ah(جماعة).

And then it's up to the discretion of the Ameer(أمير) to give the concerned individuals part of it, as a pay for their efforts, if they have gone through some risk.

Because there could be some risk and they could end up paying hefty the price for it.

So they need to be compensated for that.

But this is up to the discretion of the Ameer(أمير).

The Ameer(أمير) doesn't want to give anything, then he doesn't have to.

Now I don’t know on what basis, these other Duat(دعوات) have said that it's Ghanimah(غنيمه) but Allah Alam(ألله أعلم) they have to say it, it's faye(فيئ).

The issue of women.

Slavery is a practice that has been abolished around the world.

So is it the practice that the Muslims should reintroduce again?

To answer this question we need to look at if slavery was something instituted by the Muslim armies, because it is something that the enemy is to do, so it's Ta'amul Al-Misl(تعامل المثل),

treating them in the same way, or whether it was an institution that was accepted, in its essence, and made Halal(حلال) by Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, independently of what the enemy does.

And there's two views regarding that.

There's one view that states that no, it was only allowed, because if the Muslims did not allow it, it would put them at a greatest disadvantage compared to the enemy,

the enemy is taking away your people as slaves, and your freeing them.

So that puts the Muslims at a disadvantage.

Therefore they were allowed to do what the enemy was doing slavery was an international thing in those days.

The other view is that, No!

There is something that is independently allowed in Islam, regardless of what the enemy would do.

Therefore, if the Muslim wants to do it, again, they can.

However, this is something that is not promoted or recommended, it is something up to, again, the Ameer(أمير) of the Jama'ah(جماعة), to do but in this case, I will say that it's not in the Ameer(أمير) of the Jama'ah(جماعة) that does not have law enforcement authority.

Because slavery is an institution that needs to be backed by law enforcement.

And that ability does not exist with Jama'ah(جماعة) living in non Muslim environment.

Jama'ah(جماعة) living in non Muslim environment can take decisions regarding money, only if they can guarantee that they have at least the ability to discipline the members

and to enforce among the members, the decisions.

And they have the loyalty of the members to ensure that otherwise, again, that would open up a door of Fasad(فساد) that will only have bad consequences on the Ummah(امة)

and it's not worth the money that you're gonna get.

And to have disputes among the Muslims on financial issues, and to have the reputation of the Muslims destroyed and tarnished because of that,

it's not worth it, for the petty cash that you can get.

So unless with the issue of woman, I don't see that that is allowed at all, with Jama'ah(جماعة) today unless they have law enforcement ability, which means they rule.

When it comes to money, there needs to be strong loyalty among the Jama'ah(جماعة) and it needs to be very much restricted and securely dealt with

and the issue of Demah(دماء), the same thing would also apply.

Allah Alam(الله أعلم).

Again, these are thoughts scattered here and there, not in an organized way.

But more research needs to be done on this area because of, it's a very critical issue.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ ۞ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۞

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسليمًا كثيرا فغضّ الطّرف إنك من نميرٍ ... فلا كعباً بلغت ولا كلابا

مَنْ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ الْأَشْرَفِ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ آذَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ؟

فَأْذَنْ لِي أَنْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا ألخداع الى الحرب، ألحرب وخداع ابوعبيدة لوقالها غيرك تمنوا أتمنى لو أن لي هذه الدار مملوءة ذهبا أنفقه في سبيل الله

أمَّا أنَا فاتمنى لو أنِّي هذا الغرفة رجال مثل أبي عبيدة بن الجراح نحن قوم أعزَّنا الله بالإسلام فمهما ابتغينا العزَّة في غيره أذلَّنا الله اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ،

وأَعُوذُ بِكَ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وأَعُوذُ بِكَ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ ، وأَعُوذُ بِكَ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ أمربالمعروف ونهي عن المنكر

الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ يا رسول الله ديونٌ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ

يا عمر جبَّار في الجاهلية خوارٌ في الإسلام فأما الحرب المجلية أو الخطة المخزية أن تقتلون رجل أن يقول ربي الله إنَّا إزاري لا تمسك على حقوي لست منهم

ما لَقِيَكَ الشَّيْطانُ قَطُّ سالِكًا فَجًّا إلَّا سَلَكَ فَجًّا غيرَ فَجِّكَ رب أشعث أغبر لو أقسم على الله لَأَبَرَّهُ والأرْواحُ جُنُودٌ مُجَنَّدَةٌ، فَما تَعارَفَ مِنْها ائْتَلَفَ، وما تَناكَرَ مِنْها اخْتَلَفَ

21. Al Qa'qaa Bin Amr(ألقعقاع بن عمرو), 21. Al Qa'qaa Bin Amr(ألقعقاع بن عمرو), ما بلغنا أنه كان في الإسلام ولا في الجاهلية مثله ورواة أبن ذهبي الحافظ في تهذيب

وَما كانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَغُلَّ ۚ وَمَن يَغلُل يَأتِ بِما غَلَّ يَومَ القِيامَةِ ۚ ثُمَّ تُوَفّىٰ كُلُّ نَفسٍ ما كَسَبَت وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ۞

Yani(يعني) يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا إِذا لَقيتُم فِئَةً فَاثبُتوا وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ۞

يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا إِذا لَقيتُم فِئَةً فَاثبُتوا وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ۞

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says, وَلَقَد كَرَّمنا بَني آدَمَ وَحَمَلناهُم فِي البَرِّ وَالبَحرِ وَرَزَقناهُم مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ وَرَزَقناهُم مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ وَفَضَّلناهُم عَلىٰ كَثيرٍ مِمَّن خَلَقنا تَفضيلًا۞

وَلَقَد كَرَّمنا بَني آدَمَ يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا إِذا لَقيتُم فِئَةً فَاثبُتوا وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ۞

وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَلا تَنازَعوا فَتَفشَلوا وَتَذهَبَ ريحُكُم ۖ وَاصبِروا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصّابِرينَ۞

(فَاثبُتوا) (وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ).

(وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ).

(وَلا تَنازَعوا فَتَفشَلوا وَتَذهَبَ ريحُكُم ۖ وَاصبِروا) (إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصّابِرينَ).

(فَاثبُتوا) وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَلا تَنازَعوا (وَاصبِروا) فَاثبُتوا وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ

وَلا تَنازَعوا Patience(وَاصبِروا).

ألحرب خدعة ان نسعل الله عزوجل ان يجعلنا من هاديين مهديين ومهديبنا، ان نسعل الله عزوجل ان يجعلنا من المجاهدين في سبيلك وفي اموالهم وانفسهم ، ونسعل الله عزوجل ان يرزقنا اجمعين شهادة

رَبَّنا آتِنا فِي الدُّنيا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنا عَذابَ النّارِ وصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

نسعلك اللهم ان تتقبل مِنَّا هذا الدرس يا الرحم الراحمين نسعلك يا الرحم الراحمين ان تتقبل منَّا يا ذالجمال والكمال والإكرام اللهم جعلنا ممَّن يستمعون القول فيتبعون احسن

اللهم جعلنا ممن يستمعون قول فيتبعون احسن يا ذالجمال والكمال والإكرام ونسعلك ان تجاعلنا من المجاهدين في سبيل الله باموالهم وانفسهم اللهم انَّ نسعلك ان ترزقنا شهادة

صابرين محتسبين مقبلين غير مدبرين ثابتين وغفر علينا صبرا وثبت اقدامنا ونصرنا على القوم الكافرين رَبَّنا آتِنا فِي الدُّنيا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنا ووالدين عَذابَ القبر النّارِ يا عزيزو يا غفار

وصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسليمًا كثيرَا جُعِل رزقي تحت ظل رمحي حلال طيبة جُعِل رزقي تحت ظل رمحي

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says, وَلا تُؤتُوا السُّفَهاءَ أَموالَكُمُ الَّتي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُم قِيامًا ألمال والعرض ودم لا أريد ان يقول لي حد بالناس من محمدٍ يقتل اصحابه

parts.english:
14, Zaat-Ur-Riqa(ذات الرقاع), it occurred in Jamada Al-Oula(جمادى ألأولى) Fourth of Hijrah(هجرة).

It was named Zaat-Ur-Riqa(ذات الرقاع), which means the Battle of the rags.

Why it was called that, why it was given that name?

Because because the shoes of the Muslims were tearing apart and their feet were bleeding so they ended up wrapping pieces of their clothes over their feet.

Rasool Allah ﷺ attacked the land of Najd(نجد) but no fighting occurred.

15, the minor battle of Badr(بدر) it happened in Sha'ban(شعبان) year four.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went to Badr(بدر) to meet Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) and Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) at an appointed time.

He went with 1500 fighters.

Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) made it halfway but then decided to go back to Makkah.

Number 16, Domat-Ul-Jandal(دومة الجندل), Domat-Ul-Jandal(دومة الجندل), is at the extreme southern tip of Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

Domat-Ul-Jandal(دومة الجندل), is the borders between the Arabian Peninsula and Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

It is a town surrounded by an impregnable wall.

Rasool Allah ﷺ attacked it, when he heard that the non believers are gathering an army to invade Madina.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ would not wait for an enemy to come to him, he would go out and meet them.

He heard that they're mobilizing an army he went out all the way to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

He marched towards them, in an army of 1000, he would move at night and hide during the day.

When the enemy heard of his move.

They feared him and ended up dispersing.

So when Rasool Allah ﷺ arrived in their territory, none of them came out to fight.

He attacked their shepherds and confiscated some of their cattle and sent out detachments to different areas and then returned.

Number 17, Al-Khandaq(ألخندق), the Battle of the Trench occurred in Shawal(شوال), fifth of Hijrah(هجرة).

Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) came headed by Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان), Banu Fuzara(بنوفزارة) were headed by Oyena Bin Hasan(عيينة بن حصن), Bano Murrah(بنومرَّة) headed by Haris Bin Aof(حارث بن عوف),

In addition to Ghatafan(غطافان) and Ash'jah(أشجاع), and they all converged on Madina in an army of 5000.

Allah O Alam(ألله أعلم), this number is underestimate, should be more than 5000.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ receive news of the armies.

He consulted with the Sahabah(صحابه), and that is one Salman Farsi(سلمان فارسي) suggested digging the trench, which was a novel idea to Arab warfare.

The trench was completed with a little over 10 days, the Muslims were 3000.

So this was a coalition that attacked Madina.

It was made up of Quraish(قريش), Ghatafan(غطافان), Ash'jah(أشجاع) some other tribes, alongside, Al-Munafiqoon(ألمنافقون) from within Madina.

And later on, Banu Quraidha(بنوقريظه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ heard the news of this advance, and the army was large, the army of the Kuffar(كفار).

So, Salman Farsi(سلمان فارسي) suggested this idea, he said: This is something that we do in Persia, so this was an imported idea.

This was an idea that was not known to the Arabs.

Salman Farsi(سلمان فارسي) said: Let's dig a trench.

The Trench was dug, north of Madina.

Even though Makkah is towards the south, Why was it to the north of Madina.?

Because Madina had natural defenses from the three other sides, from the eastern and the west it was defended by a volcanic rocky track, very sharp rocks.

It's very difficult for an army to march through, and then you have the palm groves, towards the south, which also makes it very difficult for a large army.

So the trench was built, was dug towards the north of Madina, an interesting event occurred, the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم came across this boulder that refused to move out of their way.

They tried to break it, but it would end up breaking their axes.

So they went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and they complained to him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went there he asked for an axe they give it to him he said: Allah o Akbar(ألله أكبر) and he struck the Boulder, and it cracked and the spark of light came out of it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ made Takbir(تكبير).

And then he did it again, it's cracked a second time and light came out, the third time he hit it, it just broke into pieces.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ made Takbir(تكبير).

Sahabah رضي الله عنهم  said: Why did you make Takbir(تكبير)?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Because the first time I saw the palaces of Syria.

And Allah told me that my Ummah(امة) would enter the land of the Romans.

And I made Takbir(تكبير) the second time because Allah showed me the white palaces of Madaen(مدائن), the capital of Persia, and Allah told me that my nation will enter the land of Persia,

and the third time I said Allah O Akbar(ألله أكبر) because Allah showed me the gates of San'a(صنعاء) in Yemen, and told me that my nation will enter into Yemen.

When was Rasool Allah ﷺ giving this promise, you've noticed that the greatest promises to this Ummah(امة) were delivered to the Ummah(امة) when the Ummah(امة) was at its lowest point.

Because these promises were a test of faith, Al-Munafiqoon(ألمنافقون) they were laughing so much and mocking at this, they said: One of us doesn't even feel secure to respond to the call of nature,

and Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling us that we're gonna open Persia and the Roman Empire, and Yemen.

What is he talking about.?

But the believers said: Believers say: This is what the Allah and His messenger  promised us, it's gonna happen.

Another promise that was given by Rasool Allah ﷺ, another incident to show you when the promises are given, when Rasool Ullah and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) are running away from Makkah, they're on the run

and Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), are pursuing them.

And they place a bounty on the head of Muhammadﷺ One hundred camels.

Suraqah Bin Malik Al-Ashjae(سراقه بن مالك ألأشجاعي) one of the Bedouins, he was sitting among his people he's not from Makkah but the news is going around that there's ransom on Muhammadﷺ, Dead or Alive.

So somebody came in to the gathering and said: I've seen two men walking in the desert, they might be Muhammadﷺ and his companions.

Suraqah(سراقه) said: No, no, no it's not them. I was there, and I saw them.

But then Suraqah(سراقه) sneaked out of that meeting, he went to his house, called his horse and ran out in pursuit of the two men, because he thought these might be Muhammad(محمد) and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he wanted 100, camels.

So, he's pursuing them, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is looking behind, he is looking behind and Rasool Allah ﷺ is reciting Qur'an, he's not even looking behind

and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is very worried, staring behind.

And whenever one of the Muslims soldier will pass next to him.

He would say: Please kill me! Please kill me!

And they would all leave him.

Until one of the Muslims passed next to him, he said: Please kill me!

He said: Alright! Fine, I'll kill you.

He killed him.

And then he said: When I saw his leg laying next to him, I regretted that I killed him.

He didn't know that he was bleeding.

So, this does happen, in battle.

But see with the sharpening the sword.

That's for execution.

The execution is different executions should be done in the most compassionate way unless, again, these specific people need to be brutally killed.

But in battle that's different.
