He was telling the Khalifah(خليفه), I need reinforcements Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه first of all, he wants to deal with the anxiety, that any Muslim would have.

So, he wants to give Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) confidence. Don't worry.

The second thing he wants to set some rules which are laws of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

So, he responds back by saying, I read your letter, you mentioned that the Roman Emperor moved out of his capital and set based in Antioch.

And that is good news for us, because that means that he is losing his empire.

He left his capital means, he left his empire, good omen.

That's what Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) is saying.

So, he turned the threat into good news in order to instill confidence in his soldiers.

Don't worry, that's good news. You should be happy.

What's so bad about it?

Why are you mentioning it as if it is something negative?

You should be happy.

It means, they are so concerned about what's happening that's the end for them.

And then he said: And you mentioned to me, that he is recruiting soldiers from the four corners of his empire, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) said: And what would you expect?

That is what I and you already know that a people would not walk out of their kingdom and give up their sovereignty without a fight.

We are occupying their land. What do you think you want them just walk out?

He said: It's expected that they will mobilize their soldiers to fight us.

So, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) is saying was so new about it.

This is something that is expected.

People are not going to hand over their sovereignty and their kingdom and their land and we talked about the jewels of the Roman Empire Syria and Jerusalem, the holy city, the Holy Land.

What do you think that they just hand it over for you?

They're not going to give it, except if you fight them.

So, now he has given a Sakeena(سكينة) to Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and then he said; And I don't want you to look forward to receiving any reinforcements from me

and I want you to depend on Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and then on the soldiers that you have under your leadership.

Don't keep asking for reinforcements.

Depends on Allah and the soldiers that you have, at the end of the letter, he writes one line. He said: And even then I am going to send you men until, you will ask for no more.

I'm going to help you but I just want to make a point first of all what you're saying, should be seen as good news be optimistic.

Number two you should depend on Allah not depend on reinforcements.

However, I'm going to give you reinforcement, I'm gonna send you reinforcement.

So, the Roman Emperor moved into Syria.

When Jerusalem fell, Roman Emperor packed up his belongings and left and he said; Farewell to Syria, we will never meet again.

And he left and he was talking to one of his soldiers who was captured by the Muslims, a POW.

He said, Tell me about these Muslims. He said; I've lived with them, and I saw them with my own eyes.

I've lived among them and I saw them with my own eyes the Muslims are Knights during the day and monks during the night.

During the day they're carrying their weapons fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) and at night they're standing in front of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ praying.

They turned into monks at night and they turn into fighters in the day that was the way of the early Muslims رضي الله عنهم.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he went to visit Abu Obaidah Amr Bin Jarrah(أبوعبيدةعمروبن جراح).

So, they told Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is outside and he wants to visit you.

Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) said: He wants nothing but to inspect my house that's the only reason why is visiting me.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) came in, he sat with Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) looked around and there was no furniture nothing, all what he saw, was a sword, a spear, a bow and arrows.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Bring us some food.

Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) brought a basket that had pieces of dry bread in it.

He said: This is our food.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه wept and he said: Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), this world has changed us all, except you Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة).

Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) has taken a toll on every one of us, except for you Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) did not change you.

And that's why Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) has so much trust in Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة), so much love for him because he was the Ameen(أمين) of this Ummah(امة),

he was this trust worthy of this Ummah(امة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) is the Ameen(أمين) of this Ummah(امة), anyone would change except Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة).

Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) would affect everyone but about Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and that's why Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; When he asked the men with him to make a wish

some of them said, we want this room full of gold, other said, we want this room full of pearls to spend it in the sake of Allah.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I want this room to be filled of the likes of Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة).

So, that I can send them Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

That's the most valuable thing, I have.

It is men like Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) not my money, but men like Abu Obaidah Amr Bin Jarrah رضي الله عنه one of the 10 given the glad tidings Jannah(جنة).

One incident worth mentioning is the Muslims opened the town of HIMS the people of HIMS surrendered, they agreed to pay the Jizya(جزية).

The Romans were assembling the new army, See the Romans as Rasool Allah ﷺ said: They're not going to give up easily.

As we mentioned last night, he says, the Persian Empire is one knock or two knocks, and then there's no Persian Empire.

But the Roman Empire, whenever you break a horn of them, another horn would grow in it's place, and they will carry on fighting you until the day of judgment.

And they are people who can fight in mountains and on land and in sea, Meaning they can fight in any terrain.

And whenever one horn is broken, another horn or grow in its place, and Amr Bin Aas رضي الله عنه said: They have four qualities.

And this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ) and Muslim(مسلم). He said; They are the fastest people to wake up after they are struck.

Take a look at Germany, for example, it built a superpower army and lead the world into World War One.

And it was destroyed.

Within 20 years, Germany was leading the war into World War Two.

Within 20 years they were struck and destroyed, and within 20 years, they're standing on their feet and fighting again.

They are fastest, they are the fastest to wake up after they are struck.

Number two And they are the fastest to make a second comeback.

So, if they attack, they would attack again soon.

And the third one; And they handle their problems with the tranquility.

I don't know if that's right translation, they are they are able to manage chaos well, they can take the lead in situations of chaos, and then he said;

And they are the Most Merciful people and compassionate toward their weak, and poor.

So, you'd find that Western societies tend to take care of the poor among them, and the needy among them, welfare system, look at the welfare system in the Western world.

It's the best on the planet, while another country is the poor people would die of hunger and nobody would take care of them.

But the thing is that they focus among their own people, they would take care of their own needy.

It doesn't matter if 1 million people die in Iraq.

But if there's one poor person among us, we'll take care of them.

And then he said; And the fifth quality and it's a good quality, they do not accept oppression from their kings.

And that is something that the western history attest to, they fought against the oppression of their kings, until they achieved systems that are democratic.

And these are characteristics that Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) spoke about 1400 years ago.

So, the Romans were mobilizing again against the Muslims, even though they're Emperor has already left.

So the Muslims went to the people of HIMS because they were mobilizing the forces close to HIMS.

And the Muslims felt that maybe they could take over HIMS again.

so the Muslims went to the people of HIMS and said: We took away Jizya(جزية) from you with the promise of protecting you and now, since we are unsure

that we would be able to protect you from the Romans, if they attack.

Here is your Jizya(جزية) take it back.

The people of HIMS were so impressed by that.

They said if it was the Romans, they would take it away from us and never give it back.

We pray to Allah to bring you back to us.

So, now the people of Syria were asking for the Muslims to come back and rule them because they saw their justice.

So, the Muslims were not willing to fill up their coffers by abusing the people - No, It was a contract, we will protect you, you pay us Jizya(جزية) we pay you back by offering you with security.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) immediately, after Jerusalem was opened, receives orders from Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to march across, to Africa.

They had some letters going on between them that Egypt will be easily accessible for us.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه allowed Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) to cross over into Africa and to carry on with the Fatuhaat(فتوحات).

So, he crosses from Ash-Sham(ألشام) into Egypt and he doesn't get a lot of resistance.

Now, Egypt was under Roman rule, and he doesn't get a lot of resistance until, he reaches to the Nile River and a few battles occur there.

In one of those battles the Muslims opened the town and they capture the daughter of Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس).

Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) was the Egyptian King so they captured his daughter.

Now, the rule of war in those days is, prisoners of war become your slaves.

That was an international law, it was not something that only Muslims did.

That was the international law of the day, prisoners of war automatically become slaves.

So, they captured the daughter of Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس), according to the norm of the day, she becomes a slave and she's owned by anyone of the Muslims.

However, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said: Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) has sent Muhammadﷺ a gift, Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) has received a letter from Muhammadﷺ, calling him to Islam.

Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) knew that this was the truth but because of his love of power, he's not become Muslim, but because he believed it was the truth.

He sent a gift to Muhammadﷺ.

He sent him some Egyptian clothes and he sent him two slave girls.

One of them is Mariya(ماريه), whom Rasool Allah ﷺ freed and then he married her, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said: Since Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) sent our Prophet a gift.

Why don't we send him his daughter back.

His daughter was forcibly married by her father to the son of the Roman Emperor, and she didn't want to marry him.

So, now she is sent back to her father, and she was talking to her servant, she said: I feel more secure and safe, under these Arabs than I would feel in my father's palace.

Because he forced her into marriage to the son of the Roman emperor and the Muslim sent her back to her father, and Al-Muqauqas(ألمقوقس) appreciated that very much.

That's one event that happened.

The army carried on and they surrounded a very strategic fortress.

They try to forcibly open it, they couldn't.

So, Amr Bin Aas رضي الله عنه, sent a letter to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) asking for reinforcement.

He was asking for a very large army.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) sent him an army and he sends a letter with that army telling Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) that I've sent you an army of 12000 and 12 thousand can never be defeated due to numbers.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says that 12,000 cannot be defeated due to numbers.

If they're defeated, they are defeated because of other reasons, lack of Taqwa(تقوى) or sins or something else.

If you have an army of 12,000 it can never lose because they don't have enough numbers.

That's why some of the Fuqahaa(فقهآء) say that you're only allowed to retreat in Qur'an it says that if a Muslim is facing twice their size,

if a Muslim army is facing more than twice the size then they're allowed to retreat However, this scholar say: If the Muslim army is over 12,000, no matter how large the enemy is,

they're not allowed to retreat.

Even if you're facing a million that rule only applies to armies less than 12,000, that's according to some scholars, it's one view.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) counts he only has 4000 soldiers, where are the 12,000?

He actually had more because Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) sent him in the letter saying; I sent you 4000 soldiers each thousand is headed by a man who is equal to 1000.

I've sent you Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام), Al-Miqdad Ibn Amr(ألمقدادإبن عمرو), Maslimma Bin Makhlad(مسلمةبن مخلد) and Ubadah Bin Samit(عبادة بن الصامت).

Each one of these men is equal to 1000.

Therefore, you have 12,000.

That's the calculation of Umar(عُمَر), Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) is counting how many as 4000 but now he has to change the figure to 12,000 because of these four men.

Again Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام), Al-Miqdad Ibn Amr(ألمقدادإبن عمرو), Maslimma Bin Makhlad(مسلمةبن مخلد) and Ubadah Bin Samit(عبادة بن الصامت),

they opened that fortress, how did they open it?

You can see that really one man, can he be equal to 1000?

Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام), who's leading 1000 men advances against this fortress, he asks his men to prepare a ladder for him to climb,

he climbs on the highest tower of the fortress alone and he raises up his sword and he makes Takbeer(تكبير), when the enemy saw that they thought that the Muslims already broke in

because how could he be standing on that tower and if he's standing alone, he must be surrounded by Guards from every direction.

So, they immediately gave up, that was it.

One man opened this fortress.

This was Az-Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام), you know there's a story they say that once he struck one of the enemy soldiers on his shoulder, this enemy soldier was on his horse,

his sword went through until, the man fell from both sides and it went down a bit further and cut the saddle, the saddle of the horse.

So, the saddle fell.

So the Sahabah(صحابه) said: Allah Ho Akbar(الله أكبر) your sword is powerful.

He said: It's not the sword, it's my arm, don't give credit to the sword, it's my arm.

But it took them seven months to open that fortress.

And now, they move on to the most important town in Egypt and that's Alexandria.

Cairo didn't exist yet.

Cairo was rebuilt later by the Muslims.

The major town was Alexandria.

So, they lay siege to Alexandria, and it was taking some time, and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was losing patience.

So, he sends a letter to Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص), he said; He said: I am surprised because of the slow action in Egypt.

You've been fighting them for two years and you didn't open it yet.

That must be because of your sins.

And because you are now loving Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) just like your enemy.

He said: How come it's taking two years?

Why is it so slow?

It's because you are loving Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) just like your enemy and then he said; And Allah will never give you victory, except if you have pure intentions.

And I have sent you for men each man as equal to 1000 according to my knowledge, except if they have changed like the rest of you.

When you receive this letter of mine, stand up and give a speech your people and encourage them to the to fight in the path of Allah and encourage them to have patience

and good intentions and make those four men ahead of everybody else.

And order your army to attack like one man, all at once.

And let that attack be in the time of Salaat-Ul-Jumu'ah(صلاة الجمعة) because that is a time, when Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ accepts the Dua(دُعَا) and you should all be making Dua(دُعَا) to Allah to give you victory.

You should do it in the time of Khutba-Jumu'ah(خطبة الجمعة) when the people are praying and making Dua(دُعَا) for you.

Alexandria was opened, and Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) immediately, dispatches Muawiya Bin Hadeej(معاوية بن حديج) to go to Madina to deliver the good news to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Muawiya Bin Hadeej(معاوية بن حديج) arrives into Madina at the time of Zuhar(الظهر) .

Now I've narrated it to you, I think the story before and I attributed it to Abu Muslim Al-Khaulani(أبومسلم ألخولاني), sometimes you would have narrations

and an attribute to different people, this story is a bit different.

It might be the same story or it might be a separate one.

Muawiya Bin Hadeej(معاوية بن حديج) arrives into Madina at noon.

So, he goes to the Masjid(مسجد) because he thought that the Khalifah(خليفه) is asleep, in the time of noon, siesta, everybody sleeps in Madina.

There's nothing could do it, it's too hot, no Air Conditions, so you stay indoors, Muawiya Bin Hadeej(معاوية بن حديج) he gets to the Masjid(مسجد)

and he talks to the people about the good news.

And he was walking in the street, so a slave girl saw him.

She belongs to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), she saw his clothes, and she realized that this is a man who just came back from travel.

So, she went to Umar(عُمَر) and she said, that there's a man outside and just came back from travel.

He said: Bring him in.

So, she called him and Muawiya Bin Hadeej(معاوية بن حديج) entered.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him; What news do you have?

He said: I have good news, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ gave us victory and we opened Alexandria, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Come with me.

He took me to the Masjid(مسجد). He said; He invited all of the people to come to the Masjid(مسجد).

And then he had Muawiya(معاويه) deliver the good news.

And then he takes Muawiya(معاويه) back with him to his house.

Muawiya(معاويه) said: Umar(عُمَر) entered the house, he faced Qibla(قبله).

And he started making Dua(دُعَا) thanking Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

And then he said: You are a traveler, you are in need of eating.

So, he bought me bread and oil.

So, I was dipping their bread and oil and eating it, I didn't have much because I was shy, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) be told me to eat because you are a traveler.

When I finished my meal. He said: Muawiya(معاويه)! What did you do in the Masjid(مسجد)?

He said: Well, I told the people about what happened.?

He said: Why didn't you come to me first?

You know, it's inappropriate to go and talk to the people before you talk to the Ameer(أمير).

The news needs to be delivered to Ameer(أمير).

He said: I thought that you were asleep.

He said: Woe to you. How can I sleep?

If I sleep during the day, I would not fulfill my responsibilities towards my people.

And if I sleep at night, I would not be fulfilling my duties towards Allah, when can I sleep.?

He was cutting his sleeping time short because he wanted to fulfill his duties towards Allah and towards his people.

Ask yourself the question, how many moments or hours or days or months or years are you wasting from your valuable time.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) didn't even have time to sleep?

Do not waste your time because there's so much that needs to be done.

The duties are more than our time.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) sends a letter to Umar(عُمَر) giving him some other good news.

He said: O Umar(عمر), we've built for you a house in Egypt Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) sent him back a letter, he said; What would the man living in Hijaaz(حجاز) do with a house in Egypt?

Turn it into a marketplace for Muslims, turn it into shops?

Why are you building a house for me in Egypt?

I'm not like other kings or emperors who have a palace, in each and every town, give it to the Muslims.

Finally, the last thing Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص), now the head of the army in Egypt was appointed as governor of Egypt and he would remain the governor of Egypt until the end of his life.

But Egypt is a land of blessings, it's very fertile land and it's wealthy, it's rich.

The Romans were using it as a milking cow not to feed its people but to feed them.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) is aware of this and he is coming in with people from the Arabian Peninsula from the desert and the food in Egypt can make you fat, you'd gain weight,

unlike what the Arabs were brought up within Hijaaz(حجاز) or in Najd(نجد).

So, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) told his soldiers; I do not want to see any of you gaining weight while your horse is losing weight.

And then he said; And I'm going to have your parade in front of me, and I'm going to have your horses parade in front of me.

And if I see any of your horses losing weight, you will have your salary cut.

We are soldiers Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) our life, is a life of a soldier, a military lifestyle, that is who we are! And that is who we will be!

And we will remain following this tough regimen.

If I see you gaining weight in Egypt and if I see your horses being neglected.

I will reduce your salaries, your salaries will be cut.

So, stay fit and take care of your horses.

This was the Ibadah(عبادة) this was the understanding of the Sahabah(صحابه) in Islam.

It was not just, you do your Salah(صلاة) and grow a big belly and grow a big beard and that's it, you're an excellent Muslim.

He said: You will be paraded in front of me you on your horses and I'm going to hold you accountable and see how fit you are.

This is how Sahabah رضي الله عنه lived their lives.

One of the Sahabah(صحابه) at old age he was so old and he would still run between the targets when he is practicing archery.

They told him: Why don't you stop, your are old in age.

He said: I'm running in a garden in paradise.

that was Ibadah(عبادة) for them, he was worshipping Allah.

In fact, in another Hadith(حديث) it says that while the Sahabah(صحابه) were practicing in Madina, target shooting.

It was time for Salah(صلاة), so Rasool Allah ﷺ said: They are in a Salah(صلاة).

So, that was the life of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم that was the ideal and perfect way of living.

We ask Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ to guide us to the truth.

We're almost done with the Ghazawat(غزوات), pretty much done.

We just have a few bits and pieces miscellaneous stuff left that will take maybe half a session or one session and then we'll be talking about the last moments in the life of a Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ الله

and Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص).

خالد إبن وليد أَمَّارَهْ نَفْسَه، لَقَدْ كَانَ أبوبكر أَعْلَمْ بِرِّجَالِ مِنِّيْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ عَائَزَّنَ اللهُ بِا لْإِسْلَامْ وَإِنِّ بْتَغَيْرَالْعِزَّتَ فِيْ غَيْرِه أَذَّنْ الله

لا إله إلّا الله إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ بِالْعِيْنَةَ، وَأَخَذْتُمْ أَذْنَابَ الْبَقَرْ وَرَضِيْتُمْ بِالزَّرْعَ، وَتَرَكْتُمُ الْجَهَادَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ الله

سَلَّطَ اللهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ذُلًّا لَّا يَنْزِعَه’ عَنْكُمْ حَتَّى تَرْجِعُوْا إِلَى دِيْنِكُمْ "تبايعتم بالعينة" وتبعتم أذناب البقر وشُغِلتم بالزرع

أشهد وأنّ محمد الرسول الله إنْ لَّمْ يَكُنْ بِكَ اِلَيَّ غَضَبٌ فَلَا اُبَالِي وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَكَمْتَهْ فَعَدَلْتَا فَاَمِنْتَافَنِمْتَ

ادْخُلُوا فِي السِّلْمِ كَافَّةً مَا كَانَ قَوْمٌ لِّيَخْرُجُ مِنْ مُلْكِ مُعَيْدَه’سُلْطَانَه’ بِغَيْرِ قِتَالْ وَدَاعًا يَا سُوْرِيَا اِنَّهُمْ فُرْسَانْ بِنَّهَارْ رُهْبَانْ بِلَّيْلِ

"أهل سخرٍوبحر" اَنَّهُم اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ So, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said: "اَنَّهُم اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ"

اّسْرَ النَّاسِ اِفَاقَ بَعْدَ ضَرْبَ وأوشكهم كرة بعد فرة وَاَكْثَرُهُم حِلْمً عِنْدَ فِتْنَةَ اشد الناس حلمًا عند الفتنة وَاَكْثَرُهُمْ اَطْفً عَلَى لمِسْكِيْنِهِمْ وَضَعِيْفِهِمْ

وخامسة حسنة جميلة Maria Al-Qibtiyyah(ماريه ألقِبْطِيَهْ).

أَمَّا بَعْدَ، فَقَدْ عَجِبْتُ لِإِبْطَائِكُمْ عَنْ فَتْحِ مصر إِنَّكُمْ تُقَاتِلُوْنَهُمْ مُنْذُ سَنَتَيْنَ مَا ذَلِكَ إِلَّا لِمَا أَحْدَثْتُمْ، وَأَحْبَبْتُمْ مِنَّ الدُنْيَا مَا أَحَبَّ عَدُوَّكُمْ

وَإِنَّ الله تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالى لَا يَنْصُرُ قَوْمًاإِلَّابِصِدْقٍ نِّيَّاتِهِمْ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ وَجَّهْتَ إِلَيْكَ أَرْبَعَةُ نَفَرٍ وَأَعْلَمْتُكَ أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ مَقَامَ أَلْفِ رَجُلٍ

عَلى مَا كُنْتُ أَعْرِفْ،إِلَّاأَنْ يَّكُوْنَ غَيَّرَ هُمْ مَا غَيَّرَ غَيْرَهُمْ فَإِذَا أَتَاكَ كِتَابِيْ هَذَا فَاخْطُبِ النَّاسْ وَحُضَّهُمْ عَلى قِتَالِ عَدُّوِّهِمْ وَرَغِّبْهُمْ فِيْ الصَّبْرِ وَالنِّيَهْ

وَقَدِّمْ أُوْلَئِكَ الأَرْبَعَةْفِيْ صُدُوْرِ النَّاسْ وَمُرِ النَّاسَ جَمِيْعًا أَنْ يَكُوْنَ لَهُمْ صَدْمَةْ كَصَدْمَةْ رَجُلْ وَاحِدْ، وَلْيَكُنْ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ الزَّوَّالْ يَوْمَ الْجُمْعَةْ، فَإِنَّهَا سَاعَةٌ تَنَزَّلُ فِيْهَا الرَّحْمَةْ

وَوَقْتُ الْإِجَابَةْ،وَلِيُعَجَّ النَّاسْ إِلَى الله وَيَسْأَلُوْهُ النَّصْرَ عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ "ما ورآعك" "ألصّلاة الجامع" أَيْحَاتَ، أَيْحَاتَ أَنَا نَعَمْ

أَلْوَاجِبَاتُ أَكْثَرْ مِنْ أَوْقَاتْ وَلَا أَعْلَمَنَّا مَا أَتَا رَجُلْ قَدْ أَسْمَنَ جِسْمَه’ وَأَهْذَلَ فَرَسَ وَعْلَمُوْ أَنِّيْ مُعْرِزُوْنَلْ خَيْلَ كَعَاتِرَاذِلرِّجَاْل

فَمَنْ أَهْزَلَ فَرَسَه’ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّهْ حَطَّتُ مِنْ فَرِيْضَتَه’ قَدَرَ ذَلِكْ

docs.title: UMAR IBN KHATTAB PART 15 VIDEO SUBTITLES

parts.english:
Sa’ad Ibn Abi Waqas رضي الله عنه sent a representative, to speak with Rustum(رستم), the army general of the Persian Empire.

Rabie Ibn Amir رضي الله عنه was one the chosen by the Sa'ad(سعد) to go and meet with Rustum(رستم).

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) he was very poor man, so he was riding a short-legged, hairy horse and his sword was wrapped in an old piece of cloth.

He didn’t even have a proper sheath for his sword.

And his spear, the blade was tight to the stick with also some cloth.

So, his whole assortment of weapons was messed up.

And he was wearing clothes that are very inexpensive, modest.

Now, the Persians have prepared for this meeting.

It’s a high level meeting between Rustum(رُسْتُم) and representatives of the Muslim army.

So, they had Persian rugs, they had the throne set for Rustum(رُسْتُم) and this throne was gold plated or possibly it was even pure gold and he had a dress of brocade on, and it was threaded with gold threads all over.

And they had the royal guards on both sides of the carpet, which Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) was suppose to walk over.

It’s the proper protocol of such a high level meeting and Romans were used to this, and Persians were used to this, and these two nations were at each other's throats.

So, it was something, that was customary for them to do and now since, they were dealing with Muslims they thought that protocols shouldn’t change.

So, the proper way of coming in, is that Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) should come on a very nice handsome horse, dressed in very expensive clothes.

He should be accompanied by guards or at least group of advisors with him.

He should then come down of his horse and walk on this carpet in a formal way, and then he come and sit under Rustum(رُسْتُم).

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) is coming on his short legged horse, and he goes straight onto the rugs riding his horse so they stopped him he carried on, he didn’t listen,

he carried on and then he goes and tears apart two pillows that were there, and he ties his horse to those pillows and then he is walking with his weapons.

So the guards stopped him at the entrance, to the place where Rustum(رُسْتُم) was sitting.

They said: You're not allowed to go in, with your arms.

He said: Well, I didn’t come here on my own but you are the ones, who invited me, so you either you let me in, with my arms or I am going to leave.

They went and told Rustum(رُسْتُم), he said, let him come in.

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) is walking with confidence and he is holding his spear with the blade pointing downwards and he is poking the rugs and he is making holes in them.

So, you can imagine that he is walking towards Rustum(رُسْتُم) and Rustum is seeing this and Rabie(ربيع) is stabbing his special Persian rug with every step that he takes.

Because Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) didn’t want all of this pump, he didn’t want this show, and he was uncomfortable being there.

They have done all those preparations to meet him.

And here is the guest poking through the rugs with his spear.

So, that was the initial shock.

Rustum(رُسْتُم) said; Why did you come to our land?

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) said; There is more, to what the eye can see, don’t make an impression on Rabie(ربيع) because of the clothes that he has on

or his short legged horse but wait until, you see him speak.

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) said: Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has sent us to deliver you, from worshiping the creation, to worshiping the Creator of the creation,

and to deliver you from the constriction of this world, to the vastness of this world and the afterlife and from the oppression of religions, to the justice of Islam.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has sent us to save you from worshiping each others.

What you are doing now, this servitude that exist among you, Rustum(رُسْتُم) is sitting up on the throne rest of you sitting on the floor, the slavery, the servitude.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has sent us to deliver you out of that, to save you from this, from worshiping creation, whether this creation is a man or a stone,

whether it is an animal or a planet, Allah has sent us to save people deliver them from that to worshiping the Creator of everything, and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has sent us to deliver you from the constriction of this life.

This Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is narrow, to the vastness of this life and the afterlife.

As a Muslim, you have a broad perspective, you start seeing things in a different light.

See without Qur’an, you are living for today, you eat to live and you live to eat.

But when you recite Qur'an, it starts from the time of Adam(آدم) and it ends with people entering into Jannah(جنة) and Naar(ألنار).

You have the entire time span, of the creation in front of your eyes.

It starts in fact, from before the creation of Adam(آدم).

It starts with the Khalaq(خلق) of Assamawaat Wal-Ardh(السموات والارض) and then you go to the story of Adam(آدم), then you move to the story of Idrees(إدريس) and Noah(نوح)

and then you go on to the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Bani Israel(بني اسرائيل), and before that Ibrahim عليه الاسلام and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), Ishaq(إسحاق).

It tells you about the nations of before, Firaun(فرعون), it tell's you about Qaum Salih(قوم الصالح), Qaum Hood(قوم هود), Qaum Shoaib(الشّعيب قوم)

and then it tells you about the time Muhammad ﷺ and then it talks about the future.

It talks about the Day of Judgment, death, Al-Hissab(الحساب), the accounting the reckoning and then it talks about Jannah(جنة) and Naar(ألنار), so you know everything.

Just look at how broad your perspective is compare to somebody who doesn’t know Qur’an, somebody who is not a Muslim.

So, Islam delivers person out of narrowness of this world, Ibn Taymiah(إبن تيمية), when they were threatening him with jail and one time threatening him with execution, and….

Ibn Taymiah(إبن تيمية) said: What can you do with me?

My Jannah(جنة) is in my heart, if you take me to jail, I will make Zikr(زكر) of Allah, if you exile me out of my land, I will make Tafakkur(تفكّر), contemplate in the creation of Allah,

if you execute me, I would be a Shaheed(شهيد).

What can you do with me?

What can you do?

Because I am not limited to this Duniyah(دنيا) I am living for Al-Akhirah(الآخرة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying: "I am amazed with the situation of the believer, if something good happens to him, he thanks Allah and that's good for him,

if something bad happens to him, he is patient and that’s good for him and that happens to no one but to the believer".

It’s a win, win situation, you can never lose.

Something good you say Alhamdulillah(ألحمدلله) you rewarded for that.

You are enjoying the good and you are being rewarded for that.

If something bad happens, you say Alhamdulillah(ألحمدلله) and you are patient and you accept the Qadha(قضى) of Allah.

You accept it as something being ordained by Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and you say: And you move on and you will be rewarded for that patience.

However, somebody who doesn’t have Eeman(ايمان) if something good will happen, they will say because I am very intelligent, I am skilled, I am knowledgeable and I know how to do things right.

If something bad happens, I have bad luck.

This is because of you, you did it to me.

So, it’s a lose, lose situation.

"From oppression of religions to the justice of Islam" Rabie(ربيع) is saying that every other religion is oppressive.

Now, ask Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) about the names of the religions of the earth, he wouldn’t known them.

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر), the Bedouin coming out of Arabia, he doesn’t know about other religions, he wasn’t a student of comparative religion.

But he has Eeman(ايمان) and Trust in Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and that Islam is the truth, and that Muhammadﷺ is the seal of Prophets, so he is speaking on behalf of every religion,

every religion is oppressive except Islam.

So, we are here, to deliver you that into the religion of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Rustum(رُسْتُم) said: You use to eat dead animals, you were so hungry, you use to run after dogs in desert".

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) said; We offer you three options, if you become Muslim, we will leave you and your land and people alone.

If you refuse then you pay us Jizya(جزية), in a state of submission, if you refuse then the sword is between us and you.

Rustum(رُسْتُم) said: You need to give us time, to think about it.

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) said: We will give you three days.

Rustum(رُسْتُم) said: No! We need more than that.

Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) said: "The Sunnah(سنة), the way of Muhammadﷺ is that, we give our enemy three days to think about it and we will visit you during those three days, on the fourth day, we will start fighting.

Rustum(رُسْتُم) wanted more time to send letters to the Emperor to seek advice, from the noble men and elders of their Empire but he had only three days.

So, on the second day, Al-Mugheera Bin Sho'ba(ألّمغيره بن شعبة) went to met with Rustum(رُسْتُم), and he came in straight, and he sat, on the throne.

The throne was big, so he sat next to Rustum(رُسْتُم), so the guards came to pull him down, you are not suppose to sit on the same level as Rustum(رُسْتُم).

Al-Mugheera(ألمغيرة) said: That is because, you are the people, who worship each other but that is not how we Muslims treat each other, we treat each other with equality.

See the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم are giving the Kuffar(كفار) lessons because they are living those meanings.

See the Sahabah(صحابه) were not just talking talks, they were talking about things that, they were practicing.

They were practicing, what they are preaching and that’s, why?

Their words had such a strong influence on the listeners.

You know, At-Tabri(ألطبري) talks about how the words of Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) and Al-Mugheera Bin Sho'ba(ألّمغيره بن شعبة) affected, the low class,

who were there, the servants and the soldiers and security guards, when they heard the statements of Muslims and how the Muslims treat each other with equality

and the fact, that there are not here invade the lands of others, just for love of power, they are doing it for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, to save people from darkness to light.

That left a strong impression on them.

They were thinking about Islam even before the battle started.

Why? Because when you practice something it has a stronger influence, then when you preach something, that you are not practicing.

It is said that one of the Salaf(سلف), one of the early scholars, people came up to him and said: That people are owning too many slaves and it's becoming problem so, we want you to encourage freeing slaves.

So, first Jumu'ah(جمعه) came he didn’t talk about it, second Juma’ah(جمعه) he didn’t talk about it, third Jumu'ah(جمعه) he didn’t talk about it.

They said: May be he forgot.

But before they go and visit him, on fourth Jumu'ah(جمعه) he did talked about it.

And he encouraged people to free slaves and they say the people left the Masjid(مسجد) and they were freeing the slaves left and right.

So, they told him, how come you waited for four Jumu'ah(جمعه) to give this Khutba(خطبة)?

He said: Because I didn’t want to ask the people to do something that I am not doing myself.

So, I gathered enough money to buy a slave myself and then I freed that slave and that’s, when I stood on the pulpit and told people to do it,

because I don’t want to be of those who, Do you command others to do good, while you forget doing it yourselves.

I want to be of those who do what they ask others to do.

The battle of Al-Qadisiyyah(ألقادسية) began and it was a long battle.

Remember that the reputation of the Persians was that of, very strong fighters.

And they were putting up a very stiff resistance in front of the Muslim forces. .

So, the battle of Al-Qadisiyyah(ألقادسية) lasted for few days, four days actually.

They start fighting in the morning and carries on fighting until darkness and they stop when it's dark.

The First day was called Yaum Armaas(يوم أرماث) and Sa'ad Bin Abi Waqas(سعدبن أبي وقاص) had some injuries and he had a back problem.

He had a severe back pain, so he was unable to participate himself in the fighting, even though he was Ameer(أمير) of the army, so he had to stay in a high place where he can oversee the battleground

and give instructions but he himself wasn't able to participate.

He told the Muslims to make four Takbiraat(تكبيرات) and to charge at the fourth Takbira(تكبيرة).

Before that he had the Qari(قارى), the Qari(قارى) of the army, every army would have a Qari(قارى), a reciter of the Qur’an and this Qari(قارى) would go around reciting Surat-Ul Anfaal(سورة ألأنفال).

Surat-Ul Anfaal(سورة ألأنفال) is a Surat-Ul Qitaal(سورة القتال).

So, he would go around reciting the Surah(سورة) to everybody, obviously this was a large army, so one person cannot recite it, at the same time to everybody.

They would not be able to hear him, so he would have to go around and recite the Surah(سورة) and this would inspire the fighters to fight.

Because this is the Surah(سورة) of Qitaal(قتال), Surat-Ul Anfaal(سورة ألأنفال).

So, that prepared them emotionally, it talks about Shahadah(شهادة), it talks about fighting, it talks about the sin of retreating, it talks about the Ghanaem(غنائم),

it talks about the victories of the time Muslims in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ, in Ghazwa-Badr(غزوةالبدر) and the fighting started.

What the army of Faris(فارس) did was that they sent fourteen elephants to charge against one segment of the Muslim army.

So, they didn’t attack Muslim army at once, what they did is, they focused on one segment and they sent fourteen elephants.

And with each elephant you have four thousand soldiers, because each four thousand soldier would have on elephant with them, so we are talking about huge number

and they charged against Bajeela(بجيلة).

Now, the Muslim army was divided according to their tribes.

So you had Banu Asad(بنوأسد), Banu Tamim(بنوأسد), Bajeela(بجيلة), An-Nakha’a(ألنخة), every tribe would be separate.

The reason why they were separated according to their tribes is because, this will inspire them to fight.

When they are separated according to their tribes, whenever there is weakness, you could tell, where it's coming from?

So, you will know that the weakness is coming from that tribe.

This particular tribe are not doing their job and this way people could be held accountable.

However, when you have the infantry or cavalry is mixed, then who could you hold accountable for the weakness that occurs?

But when its according to the tribes, every tribes doesn’t want reputation to be destroyed.

So, they would make sure that Muslims are not defeated because of them.

However, here we have a huge army attacking one small tribe.

And it was such a powerful strike that it just completely pushed them back.

So, Sa’ad bin Abi Waqas(سعدبن أبي وقاص) asked some of the other tribes to rush to the support and rescue, of their brothers, so Bannu Asad(بنوأسد) jumped in.

One of the leading members of Bannu Asad(بنوأسد), Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) and look at how things turnaround was Tulaiha Al-Asdi(طليحة ألأسدي).

Tulaiha Al-Asdi(طليحة ألأسدي) was a well-known fighter in the time of Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) he was a strong fighter in the pre Islamic era.

However, out of nationalistic pride, he claimed to be Prophet in the time of Muhammadﷺ, he claimed to be a Prophet.

And he was the leader of the one of the armies of Al-Murtadeen(ألمرتدين).

However, when he was defeated by Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he became a Muslim again and later on, he would play a vital role in the Ghazwat(غزوات) in time of Umar Ibn Khattab رضي الله عنه.

So, here we have somebody who claims to be a Prophet but then turns around makes Tauba(توبة) and helps the Muslims.

And this tells you the Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ can forgive any sin.

I mean, what sin can be greater than claiming to be a Prophet?

Tulaiha Al-Asdi(طليحة ألأسدي) encouraged his men and told them, you are called Asd(أسد), Asd(أسد) mean lion, it mean lion.

He said: You were given this name, so that you would be like lions.

And he would speak to them and encouraging them and they were very helpful infact, five hundred of them were killed.

The day of Armaas(أرماس) was over, the dead and the injured were carried, to the camp.

And who is taking care of the hospital, if we would call it so?

The women.

The women were the ones, taking care of the injured all of the casualties, they were the ones, who would administer the healing procedure, they are the ones, who would feed them, they are the one who would nurse the injured,

and also the women did something else and that is bury the dead.

So, they would be, the ones digging the graves, and burying the dead.

So, the women in those days played an important role with the Muslim Ummah(امة).

They were not excluded completely put on standby.

No! They played a very important role, and it even involve physical work, I mean digging graves and carrying the bodies, and putting them, it's not something that is, easy to do.

But that role was delegated to the woman whether they were Sahabiyat(صحابيات) or Tabi'aat(تابيعات).

The second day was Yaum Aghwaas(يوم أغواث), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had asked for reinforcements to come from Ash-Sham(ألشام).

He wanted the army of Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) that went from Iraq to Ash-Sham(ألشام) to go back.

For those of you, who attended our series of talks on Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) you would remember we talked about a story of Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد)

rushing from Iraq to Syria to rescue the Muslims, before the Battle of Yarmook(يرموك).

Now, however, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was asking Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) to send that army back and that army was about twelve thousand soldiers.

Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) did send the army back he kept Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) with him.

He wants Khalid(خالد) to stay.

And that army was sent and it was lead by Hishaam Ibn Abi Waqas(هشام إبن أبي وقاص), the brother of Sa’ad Bin Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص) and was accompanied by a man, whom Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه said;

His voice alone is equal to a thousand soldiers, and this man is the great Sahabi(صحابي) Al-Qa'qaa Ibn Amr(ألقعقاع إبن عمرو).

Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) he had a very deep and loud voice, his voice in battle, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) says, it's worth of one thousand soldiers.

Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) was the first one to arrive.

He arrived in a small group hundred or so.

So, what he did in order to encourage the Muslims and raise their moral, he didn’t come with his hundred men at once, he split them into groups of ten

and told them to go one after another, so the Muslims keep on seeing those groups coming and they would think that we are getting an endless flow of reinforcements.

So, Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) arrives and he just enters into the battleground and he is playing around with his spear, in his hand.

He just immediately, arrives goes into the battleground without taking any rest even though he came all the way from Syria to Iraq.

He arrives there when the battle was already ragging.

And he enters into the battleground dancing with his spear in front of the Muslims.

And then he challenges the enemy to send out a Mubariz(مبارز), it's called Mubariza(مبارزة), dueling.

It is one against one, one on one.

So Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) stands in front of the Muslim army and he calls the enemy to send out Mubariz(ألمبارز).

So, they sent out one of the five leaders because Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) is an important leader among the Muslim army, they sent out to him somebody of his equivalent status.

Al-Qa'qaa(ألقعقاع) killed him, they sent the second one, he killed him again, so he killed two of the five major leaders of the army.

Al-Qa'qaa Ibn Amr(ألقعقاع إبن عمرو) carried on that day and he played a very important role as an individual not with his reinforcement, as an individual in weakening the enemy, on the second day.

Albaa Bin Jahash Al-Ajli(علباء بن جحش العجلي) he also asked for Al-Mubariza(ألمبارزة) so both he and his opponent struck each other, he hit his opponent and open his chest then he cut his lungs.

So, the man fell down dead, while he was hit in the stomach, so his intestines came out, his gut just spilled out.

So, he fell down and he tried to put his intestines back.

So, he called one of the Muslim soldiers, and he told him can you put my intestine back into my stomach please.

So, he put them in his stomach and then he wraps something around his stomach and he stood up because he wanted to carry on fighting.

He barely made thirty steps before he fell down dead.

But Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) even though he is in that extreme pain and just imagine, you know! I think some of you, now having a nausea, just because, I mentioned that.

It's, you know! Imagine you have your stomach, your guts, just spilling in front of you, you would want to be rescued, to the nearest hospital as soon as possible.

He said: Just put them back, I want to carry on.

That tells you how attached they were to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and how attached they were to Shahadah(شهادة).

That's why we keep on saying these men were on different level.

Al-Khansaa(ألخنساء) was the one of the greatest women poetess, she called her four sons, all of them men of fighting age and she started narrating to them poetry encouraging them

to give their lives for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ at the end of the day, none of them came back.

All of the four died and she was so happy making poetry praising them.

The third day Amwass(عمواس), the elephants, the only cure that Muslims has against them to cut down, the ropes that were holding the saddles,

if we can call it a saddle.

So, the elephants would be left without anybody on top of them.

So, what the enemy did is.

Now, they surrounded the elephants with security.

Security guards, to protect the elephants, because the elephants were playing a major role in the Persian army.

So, now since, they were surrounded with guards, it's becoming very difficult for the Muslims to cut down the ropes.

So Sa’ad Bin Abi Waqas(سعدبن أبي وقاص), he went to Bannu Tamim(بني تميم) and he said: O Bannu Tamim(بني تميم) do you have a solution for this?

Is there anything that you could do?

And he is going to the different tribes and telling them somebody come up with suggestion to get rid of this danger.

We have been crushed because of these elephants.

They are just rolling over the soldiers, crushing them under their feet.

So, one man said: "If you want to stop the elephants then strike their eyes and cut their trunks and lips that would completely neutralize these elephants".

So, they decided to give it a try, and they started attacking the elephants.

The way they would do it is.

A group of them would attack, some of them would get the security guards busy and then two of them would attack, with their spears and hit the elephant in his eye.

They tried that and it did work.

The elephant obviously, is blind now and it doesn’t know in which direction to go, so some of these elephants carried on killing Muslims and some of them carried on killing enemy soldiers.

So, the elephants just went crazy but at least now, it wasn’t all directed against the Muslims.

Amr Bin Maadi-Akrab(عمرو بن معديكرب) another one who committed, Riddah(ردة) and was now allowed to join in the armies, he told his people, he said: Listen Bannu Zabeed(بنوزبيد)! I am going to leave right now,

if you wait the time it takes to slaughter a camel, you will find me dead, if you come before that you might find me alive fighting the enemy.

He is saying, that I am going to go straight into the heart of the enemy army.

So, he went alone, after a short while, they said: We need to go and see our man and if he is still alive?

They went and they were amazed to see, Amr Bin Maadi-Akrab(عمرو بن معديكرب), Wallahu Alam(والله أعلم) it's from At-Tabri(ألطبري), it's amazing story but I am going to mention it.

They said, that he had a horse and his horse was killed, so what he did, the man who was fighting against him killed his horse and he pursued him

and he grabbed the legs of his horse and the horse couldn’t move.

So, Amr Bin Maadi-Akrab(عمرو بن معديكرب) is holding the back legs, of this horse and soldier on the top it is trying to hit the Ma'adi Akrib(معديكرب) from behind but he cannot reach him.

And when he saw reinforcement coming to help him, so this soldier just ran away.

So, Amr Bin Maadi-Akrab(عمرو بن معديكرب) took away his horse and carried on fighting.

But to have one man hold a horse and horse cannot move its quite, it's some power.

Then we have Lailat Al-Hareer(ليلة الهرير) this is the fourth day, the fighting carried on, until night time, the fighting carried on until midnight.

And it was the toughest day of Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية) and that is when the enemy was putting up a last attempt.

And at the end, Al-Qa'qa' Ibn Amr(ألقعقاع بن عمرو) felt that they are pushing themselves to the limits and that they are almost going to break.

So, he and a group of strong men, decided to charge and just slice the enemy and go straight to the camp of Rustum(رُسْتُم).

They did that and they reached to the camp of Rustum(رُسْتُم), the actual camp and when Rustum(رُسْتُم) saw them, he ran away but then one of the Muslim soldiers pursued him and was able to kill him,

and that was the end of the Battle of Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية).

The enemy was Hundred and Twenty Thousand strong, the Muslim army was Thirty Thousand, and out of those 30,000, Eight Thousand Five Hundred died as Shaheed(شهيد).

So, you had huge number of Shuhadaa(شهداء) in Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية).

It was one of the toughest battles that the Muslims fought.

Sa'ad Ibn Abi Waqas رضي الله عنه sent a letter to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) giving him a good news.

He said: Now than Allah, granted us victory over the Persians and treated them in the way in which he had treated their co-religionist, who preceded them.

Victory came after a long fight and violent upheaval, they confronted the Muslims with an army such as, had never been seen before.

Allah didn’t allowed them to benefit from this but rather, He deprived them of it and gave it over to the Muslims.

The Muslims pursued them on the canals, on the edge of the thicket and on the roads.

Sa'ad Bin Obaid(سعدبن عبيد) the Qur’an reader and so and so and so and so were killed from among the Muslims.

The Qur'an reader, the Qari(قاري) was killed, also killed were Muslims whom we do not know, but Allah knows them.

When night fell they were whispering the Qur'an humming like bees, they were lions among men and the real lions did not resemble them.

Those who died from among them were not superior, to those who survived except by the virtue of martyrdom which had not been decreed for the later."

The Muslims immediately after that went for Al-Madain(ألمدائن),  Al-Madain(ألمدائن) was the capital Al-Madain(ألمدائن) was opened they carried on and they fought in the battle of Jalola(جلولاء)

and then they went to Tastur(تستر), and they opened Tastur(تستر).

The battle of Tastur(تستر) was a tough battle.

So, the Muslims went to Al-Bara'a Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك), and they told him to make a Dua(دُعَا) for them because Al-Bara'a Bin Malik(ألبراء بن مالك) was Mustajaab-Ud-Dawah(مستجاب الدعوة)

his Dua(دُعَا) was accepted.

Al-Bara’a(ألبراء) was companion of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he was a very poor man, very simple.

But he was very decent, truthful and honest and had so much love for Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and His Messenger, Rasool Allah ﷺ said; "There is a man with unkempt hair and he has dust over his clothes

but when he makes an oath Allah would fulfill that oath." So, for example, if he says in the name of Allah, this is going to happen, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will make that thing happen because He loves him so much.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And One of these men is Al-Bara'a(ألبراء).

Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) was such a strong fighter with no fear in his heart.

However, he had so much courage that it became dangerous.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), when he would send Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) to join an army, he would sent would with him letter to the leader of the army and he would say;

I am sending you Al-Bara'a Ibn Aazib(ألبراءإبن عازب) but I am telling you do not appoint him as a leader over anyone because he would destroy them.

They would perish under his leadership, if you appoint him on anyone he is gonna, they are all dead.

In the Battle of Al-Hadeeqa(ألحديقه) against Musailmah Al-Kazzab(مسيلمة الكذاب) the Muslims were surrounding this fortress and they were unable to get in

and the enemy was hitting them from above, the archers were striking Muslims, Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) said: Just throw me in! Throw me! throw me in.

So, they put him on a shield and he was sitting on the shield or standing on the shield and then they raised him up with their spears, until he reached over the wall and he just jumped

and what he is jumping over?

An ocean of soldiers as far as you can see.

But Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) when he came down, when they looked up they saw a bird falling down from the sky, they just ran away.

He succeeded in opening the gates, he opened the gates and Muslims came in and that is how they won.

That was how they won.

But he came out with eighty injuries in his body, eighty injuries.

So, Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) was a man that nothing could stop him.

So, Muslims went to him on the day of Tastur(تستر) and they said: Ask Allah to give us victory.

So, it was getting so tight and difficult that they wanted Allah to give them victory.

So, they went to Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) and said: Make Dua(دُعَا) for us.

Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) said: "O Allaah! Grant us victory and give me Shahada(شهادة), Grant us victory and give me Shahadaa(شهادة) and Allah accepted both".

They were given victory and he was granted Shahada(شهادة).

The Persian Empire had an emperor Kisra(كسرى) and then under him, were kings.

So, he had different states, this was a huge empire.

And each state was ruled by a king.

One of these states or kingdoms was ruled by Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان).

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) was captured after the battle of Tastur(تستر).

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) before he gave himself up, placed a condition on the Muslims that only Umar(عُمَر) decides his fate.

Otherwise, I am not going to give myself up.

So, they agreed.

They carried him to Madina and they had him wear clothes that he would wear as a king.

So, they take him into Madina with his crown full of jewelry, gold and they go and looking for Umar(عُمَر).

They said: Where is Umar(عُمَر)?

They said: He was in the Masjid(مسجد) meeting with a delegation that came from Kufa(كوفه).

They went to the Masjid(مسجد) they didn’t see anyone, so they came out.

And they went around looking, so some kids playing in the streets of Madina said; "What's wrong with you, looking right and left as if you are lost?"

They said: Where is Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب)?

They said he is in the Masjid(مسجد) sleeping.

They go back to the Masjid(مسجد) and they find him sleeping in a corner of the Masjid(مسجد) alone wrapped in his Thaub(ثوب).

So, they walked up to Umar(عُمَر), Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) said: Where is Umar(عُمَر)?

They said this is Umar(عُمَر).

And they said: Be quiet because he is a sleep.

He couldn’t hold back, he said: Where are his guards?

They said: He doesn’t have any guards.

He said: He doesn’t have any clerics the chamberlains, no one, advisors, they said: No.

And by now people were gathering in the Masjid(مسجد) not to see Umar(عُمَر) but to see Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان).

Because of the clothes that he was wearing, a king from Persia came.

While Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) the Khalifah(خليفه) is sleepingin the Masjid(مسجد) nobody goes there the kids are playing in the streets.

So, they all came in and because of the commotion, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) woke up.

And when he saw the Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان).

He said: Is that the Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان)? They said: Yes!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; O Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان), what made you do what you did?

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) would make an agreement, and then break it.

Make an agreement, then break it.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: What made you do what you did?

Deceiving us one time after another.

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) responded by saying: O Umar(عُمَر), Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين).

I fear, if I speak you would kill me.

He said: No! I won’t, carry on speaking.

He said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), I am very thirsty.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Bring him some water.

So, they brought him water in a cup.

He held the cup in his hand and said; Even if I were to die because of thirst, I wouldn’t drink out of that thing?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Bring him a better cup..

So, they brought him a better vessel.

They brought him Allah Ho Alam(ألله أعلم), what it was made up of Wood or something.?

It was something that he saw, it's very cheap and how could you drink out of this, I'd rather die to drink out of this thing.

So, they brought him a better container or cup or whatever.

They said: Alright drink from this.

He held in his hand and his hand was shaking.

He said: Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), I fear that you would kill me, If I drink this water.

He said: Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), I fear that you would kill me.

He said: I am not going to kill you, until you drink that water.

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) held the cup and he spilled all the water in it.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Bring him some more water.

He said: Don’t bring me any water because I am going to drink any.

O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) you have given me, your word of peace, you have granted me security.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "No! I didn’t".

He said: Yes! you did! He said: You are not going to kill me, until I drink the water and I am not going to drink it.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You tricked me, But I am not going to be tricked by a non-Muslim.

Anas Ibn Malik رضي الله عنه said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين).

Actually Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: No! I will kill you, I will kill you.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) said: No! Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) you did grant him security.

You did say that you are not going to kill him, until he talks And you said: You are not going to kill him until he drinks, so you did actually give him security."

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I am not going to be deceived by him, this is the man, who killed Al-Bara'a(ألبراء) and killed Al-Majda’ah(مجزأة).

The Muslims said: Well Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) you have granted him peace.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab said: I am not going to be the one, who is tricked by non-Muslim.

Al-Hurmozan(ألهرمزان) said: Then I am gonna become a Muslim, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You are free and he lived in Madina and he was receiving a salary of two thousand Dirhams(درهم) from the Khalifah(خليفه).

This was one of the kings of Persia, who has deceived the Muslims killed many of them played games with them but they kept to their word and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had to let him go.

The Persians were now gathering in another location in Al-Nahwand(ألنهوند).

Now Nahwand(ألنهوند) is not a plan land, it is a city surrounded by mountains.

So, it's very well protected.

But now they are mobilizing an army similar to the army of Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية).

An-Nauman Bin Maqran(النعمان بن مقرن) was appointed by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) as his governor over Cuscar(كسكر).

An-Nauman Bin Maqran(النعمان بن مقرن) sends a letter to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) saying; There is a young man standing next to the prostitute, who is very beautiful

and she is putting on perfume and she is trying to seduce this man to commit Zina(زنا).

That young man is myself and the prostitute is Cuscar(كسكر).

What he meant by that is, you have put me in a situation, a governor over this place it is a Fitnah(فِتْنَه), it is a Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and I don’t want to have anything to do with it.

And he said in the letter, please remove me from my post and sent me out Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) to fight in Jihad(جهاد).

Now I hope that what he said was clear, you don’t get wrong understanding of what he meant.

And this was an analogy that he was giving, this town Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is like a prostitute and you have a young man and this woman is trying to seduce him,

so he is saying to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), remove me out of Cuscar(كسكر), I don’t want to be part of this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), a leader over people and power,

he doesn’t want all of that send me Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), appointed him to lead the army that will fight in An-Nahwand(ألنهوند), you want to go Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) here,

you are the leader of the army that would fight against the Persians in Nahwand(ألنهوند).

The Muslims fought that battle and they won, and An-Nauman Bin Maqran(النعمان بن مقرن), because of his sincerity Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, chose him and make him to die as a Shaheed(شهيد).

Because Shahadah(شهادة) is not that something that you can easily get, it is something that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ chooses, "He chooses among you"

it’s a selection process and it is Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ who selects because it’s a such a great honor.

They sent a letter to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) saying that Shuhada(شهداء) are so and so and the others, that you do not know.

The said: There are some others who died you do not know them.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) cried and he said: Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ knew them so well, that He choose them to die as Shuhada(شهداء), so what does it matter if Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), doesn’t know them.

Why would they need Umar(عُمَر) to know them?

If Allahعَزَّوَجَل knew them so well and love them so much that He choose them for this.

This was the battle of Nahwand(ألنهوند).

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ says, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: With Persian Empire it would be one knock or two knocks and then there would be no empire after that, but with the Romans,

whenever you break one of their horns another horn will grow in its place.

Whenever you break one of their horns another horn will grow in its place.

They are people who can fight on land and on sea and in mountains and they will carry on fighting you until the Day of Judgment.

According to this Hadith(حديث) with the Persian Empire there will be two knocks two major battles, there are many other skirmishes other battles two major battles

Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية) and Nahwand(ألنهوند) and then the Empire is over.

So, even though the fighting carried on before Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية) and after Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية) and after Nahwand(ألنهوند) but the Empire fell apart.

It was Al-Qadissiya(ألقادسية) then Nahwand(ألنهوند) and then Empire ceased to exist.

And it ceased to exist until the day of Judgment.

However, with Roman Empire as we will see whenever, Muslims defeat them in one place they would show up in another and that’s why battle with the Romans carries on until the Day of Judgment.

So, after Nahwand(ألنهوند) what happened was Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) allowed his armies to go into the lands of Persian Empire.

Now, when we talk about Persian Empires it's not All Persian people.

The Persian Empire was an empire that included many nationalities, the Kurd(كرد) lived under it, the Turks lived under it and the Turks are different nations.

So, it was very vast empire.

And probably some of the nations of India lived under Persian Empire.

So, now it's called The spreading in the land of Al-Ajam(ألعجم) and a you have battles like Hamdhan(همدان) and this was the first time Muslims fight at Addaylum(أدّيلم),

Addaylum(أدّيلم) was also famous for tough fighters.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was so eager to hear the news.

He received a letter saying that we are fighting against Addaylum(أدّيلم).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was so worried about that he was waiting for some news, so when a messenger came Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) asked him Abasheer(أباشير).

Are you coming with good news?

Now, are you Basheer(بشير)?

Alright! Basheer(بشير) means good news, that’s what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "Are you Basheer(بشير)?" but the thing is, Basheer(بشير) can also be a name of person.

So, the man said: No I am not Basheer(بشير) and he mentions his name.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; Are you coming with good news?

And then the man goes straight and said: Yes, yes, yes!

I am here with a good news, we won against them.

But it shows that Umar(عُمَر) was so eager to know what was happening?

And then Khurasan(خراسان), Khurasan(خراسان) was opened.

Khurasan(خراسان) is also a great land.

Hirat(هرات), and Hirat(هرات) is in Afghanistan and then, Bilaad Al-Akraad(بلاد الأكراد), the land of Kurd(كرد)s.

So, all of those lands were opened as a result of battle of Nahwand(ألنهوند).

Final lessons, I want to go back to Rabie Bin Aamir(ربيع بن عامر) and the whole approach of the Muslims to Da'wah(دعوة) and Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله),

you see I received a few questions asking about whether Islam spread by the sword?

And there is this other question.

If there is no compulsion in religion then why were the battles fought?

I think that, this is the issue that you need to have a clear understanding, because, you know the Non-Muslim say, that Islam spread by the sword, Is that's true or not?

إِنْ أصَابَتْه’ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَتْ خَيْرَا لَّهْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبرَ، فَكَانَتْ خَيْرًا لَّهْ وَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ لِأَحَدٍ إِلَّا لِمُؤْمِنِ

ألحمدالله رب العلمين وَمِنْ جَوْرِالْأَدْيَانْ إِلَىِ عَدْلِ الْإِسْلَام أَتَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبِرِّ وَتَنْسَوْنَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ رُبَّ أَشْعَثْ أَغْبَرْإِذَا أَقْسَمَ عَلى الله لَأ أبَرَّهْ

فَإِنَّ هُمْ اَهْلَكَ مِنَّ الْمَهَلِكْ "خَدَعْتَنِيْ" ‘أشهد الله اله الا الله و أشهد أن محمد رسول الله ويتخذا منكم شهداء Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says, in Al-Imran(ألعمران)

فَارِسُ نَطْحَةٌ , أَوْ نَطْحَتَانِ ثُمَّ لا فَارِسَ بَعْدَ, "الانسياح في بلاد العجم" "ابشيرٌا انت" أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلِ النَّاسْ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوْا أَن لا إله إلا الله

اَشْهَدُوْا أَن لا إله إلا الله وَأَنَّ محمدا رسول الله "لا اله الا الله" "لا اله الا الله تفلحوا" "يهدي من يشاء" Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; "وَلا تَجَسَّسُوا"

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; "وَلا تَجَسَّسُوا" إِنَّ لْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَلْعَقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ۝

وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا۝

"وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِينُ" صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
We'll move on to the next section and that is the Ghazawat(غزوأت), the Fatoohaat(فتوحات ).

The conquests that occurred in the time of Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه .

In our books of history, these would be called a Ghazawat(غزوأت).

What does the word Ghazwa(غزوة) mean.?

Now, the word has a specific meaning in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ and then it has a more general meaning after that.

In the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ, battles would be called either Ghazwa(غزوة) or Sariyyah(سرية).

Now, originally the word Ghazoo(غزؤ) linguistically means to raid, to attack, that's the meaning of Ghazoo(غزؤ).

However, in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ this word was used to specifically mean a battle in which Rasool Allah ﷺ led.

A battle in Which Rasool Allah ﷺ did not lead is called Sariyyah(سرية).

So, when Rasool Allah ﷺ would send the Sahabah(صحابه) it would be called Sariyyah(سرية).

When he would lead the army himself, it would be called Ghazwa(غزوة).

With one exception and that is Ghazwat Maota(غزوة موته).

Rasool Allah ﷺ was not involved in Maota(موته), he appointed Zaid Ibn Harisa(زيدبن حارثه) to be the leader and if he is killed then Jafar Ibn Abi Talib(جعفرإبن أبي طالب)

and if he is killed Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة).

But it was called Ghazwa(غزوة) because of the great importance of that battle.

Since, this was a confrontation between the Muslims and the Romans.

It was a large army of about 3000.

So, it was given the classification of a Ghazwa(غزوة).

Later on, after Rasool Allah ﷺ, in the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), and after that any battle whatsoever would be called a Ghazwa(غزوة).

So, we're now talking about the Ghazawat(غزوات) that occurred in the time of Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه.

In the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) the fronts that were opened in the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) carried on.

Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه opened up two new fronts, the Persian front and the Roman front and it's quite interesting to see that Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه who ruled for a little over two years

did all of that within this short span.

He is the one, who led the wars against Al-Murtadden(ألمرتدين), the apostates.

He is the one, who finished it, and then immediately he opened up consciously, by choice, he is the one, who provoked both the Persian and the Roman Empires simultaneously.

The Roman Empire was in Ash-Sham(ألشام), the Persian Empire was in Al-Iraq.

Abubakar Siddique رضي الله عنه decides that he's going to attack both of them, and he will do it in the same time.

He started with Al-Iraq which was part of the Persian Empire, and then he moved in to As-Sham(ألشام).

However, these battles were not completed, in the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), death took him away.

So Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه carried on, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) finished with the opening of Iraq and Ash-Sham(ألشام).

He's the one who opened Jerusalem and then he carried on to further lands.

So, he crossed over to Africa and opened Egypt and parts of Libya.

And also Iran was opened during the era of Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه .

So, we'll start with the Iraqi front.

And this was very concerning to Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) and in his Wasiah(وصية), before he died, he gave him Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) specific instructions

on carrying on the Jihad Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله ) in the land of Iraq.

The Persians had a reputation of being tough fighters, they're very strong.

So, Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه was mobilizing the Muslims of Madina and all over the Muslim world to volunteer for this Ghazoo(غزؤ), because at that time Ghazoo(غزؤ) was a voluntary

and there wasn't any mandatory recruiting.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه is calling upon the Muslims to join the ranks of the army the first day, nobody shows up and we're talking about, and we say nobody showed up, we're talking about leaders,

because in those days, people were clans, they were tribes.

So, and these people would usually move together, the bonding was very strong family ties.

So, an entire tribe would come forth, you know, he didn't really have a lot of individuals coming on their own, the tribal leader would make a decision, all of his people would follow him.

You'd have obviously some individuals here and there, stepping in but in general, it was tribes moving along in cohesion.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is calling for these leaders to come forth the first day nobody showed up, second day no one shows up, the third day nobody shows up.

Finally Abu Obaid As-Saqafi(أبوعبيدألثَّقفي) who's from At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف) and he's not a companion he steps forth and he volunteers.

After him one of Al-Ansaar, Sulait Bin Qais(سليت بن قيس) he comes forth and he also volunteers and then some of the other Ansaar(أنْصَار) joined in.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) appointed Abu Obaid As-Saqafi(أبوعبيدألثَّقفي) to lead the army that would go to Iraq.

The Sahabah(صحابه) were in the army, they said: why don't you appoint one of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) or Al-Ansaar(ألأنْصَار)?

Why don't you appoint one of these Sahabah(صحابه) to lead this army?

How come you're appointing a Tabiee(تابعي)?.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه said; He said: I'm going to appoint the one who came first, you are ahead of everyone else because you became Muslim first,

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is telling the Sahabah(صحابه).

The reason why you have a special status is because you became Muslim before everyone else.

Because this man, he came first to lead this army, I will appoint him to lead the army.

Since, he is the first one to volunteer.

And therefore you can see the importance of As-Saabiqa(أسّابقه).

As-Saabiqa(أسّابقه) is hastening towards good.

They used to hasten towards good.

And Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; The forerunners, the forerunners, they are the ones, who will be close to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

So, the time of your commitment to the truth is important.

Therefore, those who are planning to take advantage of their young years, and commit everything sin under the sun and then after that we're going to go on Hajj(حَجْ)

and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will forgive everything.

We will grow a beard and go in the Masjid(مسجد), retire in the Masjid(مسجد) and that's it.

It doesn't work that way.

Yes, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ excepts the toba(توبة) as long as it is before the Sakaraat-Ul-Maot(سكراةالموت) before the soul is coming out of the body.

But, obviously the status of such a person is way different than somebody, who grew into Islam and who practice Islam day in and day out.

Rasool Allah ﷺ talks about the seven, who would be provided with shade under the throne of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ on the Day of Judgment.

One of them is, A young man, who was practicing Islam from a young age.

Such a person will be provided with shade under the throne of Allah on a day that is 50,000 years long.

Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه is the first to enter into Jannah(جنة), after the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) on the Day of Judgment.

Because he was the first to respond to the call of Muhammad ﷺ he is the Sabiq(سابق).

Now, with Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق), the amazing thing is that not only was he first in becoming Muslim, he was ahead in everything.

And the Sahabah(صحابه) who came in later on, would  try to compete with Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) try to get the gold medal at least in one thing,

and they never succeeded in doing so.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; In the name of Allah, I'm never going to try to compete with him, again.

Ali Bin Abi Talib رضي الله عنه says; He was ahead of us in everything that is good, he was the first in everything, first place.

And we talked about the Sahabi(صحابي) who saw Rasool Allah ﷺ and Khadijah(خديجه) and Ali Bin Abi Talib praying and he never really took that seriously and then years later, he became Muslim.

And he said, If I became Muslim on that day, and he regretted the fact that he didn't become Muslim early on, and they only became Muslim after the Fath(فتح) of At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف).

And that holds true today, the earlier you start practicing, the better off you are, the earlier you try to study Ilm(علم), the better off you are,

the earlier you start to incorporate Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام الّيل) into your life, the better off you are.

And when you do such things in young age, when you're still like a soft branch on a tree.

When that branch becomes hard, the wood becomes hard.

All of those things that you were doing becomes second natured to you, and you carry on doing them for the rest of your life.

But when the branches already stiff, it's very difficult to move it.

So, trying to change yourself when you're old is not as easy as when you're young.

Somebody who tries to memorize Qur'an when they're old would find it much more difficult than if they do it when they're young.

Somebody who tries to study Islam when they are old would find it very difficult.

I'm not saying that you shouldn't do it, you should carry on because you are rewarded for the effort you put into it.

But the thing is, anything that you do the earlier you do it, the better off you are.

And this gives you Barakah(بركة) for the rest of your life.

You know, don't be like the brothers of Yousaf(يوسف) who plotted against him.

See, the brothers of Yousaf, they said: we're gonna kill Yousaf(يوسف) and then make Toba(توبة) that was their plan.

Let's kill him and make Toba(توبة) later on.

Well, they did make Toba(توبة) eventually, but look at the difference in status between them and Yousaf(يوسف), they were never ever able to catch up.

So, you miss out on a lot of things when you join in late and that is the case also in joining any It is also true with any revivalist movement or revivalist call.

The people who join in early are the ones who leave away with the most Ajr(أجْر).

Take for example, and this is something from the future but we can use it as an example with Al-Mahdi(ألمهدي) how many people will give Bay'ah(بيعه) to Al-Mahdi(ألمهدي) initially,

a little over 300.

Out of all of the Ummah(امة) and only Allah knows what the population of the Muslim Ummah(امة) will be then.

And now, we are a billion and a quarter.

Out of the entire Muslim Ummah(امة) only little over 300 will give him Bay'ah(بيعه) and these are the ones, whom Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will grant the highest Ajr(أجْر).

Later on, a miracle will happen with Al-Mahdi(ألمهدي) because an army will try to attack him from Iraq.

And Al-Mahdi(ألمهدي) and his followers are in Makkah.

This army when it's on its way to attack and Al-Mahdi(ألمهدي), the Earth would swallow it.

The Earth would just swallow up the entire army because this is a supernatural event.

It's a miracle and it is mentioned in the Ahadith(احاديث), then everyone will know that this man is the Mahdi(ألمهدي).

And everyone will go and give him Bay'ah(بيعة).

But if it's done then, we're not saying that it's too late.

But it's too late to get the great Ajr(أجْر), then it's a public thing everybody knows about it, everybody is doing it.

So, it's the early 300, who would leave away with the highest levels in the eyes of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

also with Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال).
