Rasool Allah ﷺ says when Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) comes out publicly with his invitation to falsehood Rasool Allah ﷺ says; A person who doesn't already have Emaan(إيمان) will not be able to attain it then.

If you're not prepared in advance you will not be able to prepare when he comes out.

So, you have to have prior preparation to be saved from the Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) because his Fitnah(فِتْنَه) is so great no one will be able to attain Emaan(إيمان) when he comes out.

So, you can see the value of being ahead, being ahead in everything and I'm saying this because of our tendency to have procrastination, we delay things.

Ibn Qayyim(إبن قيم) in fact he says; If one would go through the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an which narrate what the people of Hellfire are saying one would find that the majority of their complaints are?

How come we delayed it?

Why did we wait?

Why did we procrastinate?

O Allah Take me back, so that I can do good.

In another Ayah(آية) it says: O Allah take me back to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), so that I can make Infaaq(إنفاق) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

In another Ayah(آية) it says: O Allah take me back to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

I will believe in you and in the messenger and on and on.

They delayed it, until it was too late.

Abu Obaidah As-Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) he came first, he was appointed even though he had less experience in war.

He was a Tabaee(تابعي) and not a Sahabi(صحابي).

So in terms of status is lower than the Sahabah(صحابه), the Sahabah(صحابه) are higher But because he came first, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) appointed him.

Sulait(سُلَيت) who is from Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I would have appointed him but this Ansari(أنصاري) was in a rush.

He wasn't a person who takes issues calmly, he rushes into things.

He is very bold and aggressive and strong.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) didn't mind the person having such characteristics but he did not want such a person to lead an army.

So, Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه told Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي), he said: Listen to the advice of the Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ and

take Shura(شورى) from them, take their advice.

And do not be in a hurry and take it easy and slow down because this is war and only a man whose unrushed is appropriate to lead in a battle.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is saying that when it comes to war, the person who is leading the army needs to be a person who is unrushed, not in a hurry,

who deliberates and looks at things from every and each angle and doesn't rush into affairs.

Why?

Because the lives of the Muslims are under your hands.

And he said; The only reason why I'm not pointing Sulait(سُلَيت) is because he rushes things and Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Hastening things is from Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ)

because when you do things in a rush, you're prone to make mistakes.

And Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) uses these mistakes against you.

Now, this doesn't mean that you should be so slow that you don't get anything done.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he says; A man who's unrushed but takes advantage of opportunities.

So, when you see an opportunity you take it you go for it, you don't wait and think about it and no you go and take advantage of it.

Abu Obaidah Assaqafi رضي الله عنه leads this army of about 7000 in the end he was able to mobilize the force of 10,000 before he met with the enemy

and he travelled towards Al-Iraq.

They reached to a river and the enemy is across the river, the other side and now they're prepared to fight.

So the enemy's General, he told Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي), Are you going to cross to us?

Or shall we cross over to you?

The Muslims told Abu Obaid(أبوعبيد); Let them cross over to us.

Abu Obaid(أبوعبيد) Said: No.

They are not more willing to die than we are.

So, let's cross over to them.

So, they crossed over this bridge and they reached to the other side of the river.

But the problem is that they were in a very narrow area, the enemy did not give them sufficient room to move in.

So, they were constrained, they were constricted and the battle started and the Persians employed a weapon, which was unfamiliar to the Arabs

and that was the elephant.

They used elephants to fight and these were well trained elephants.

And you would have soldiers on top of these elephants and they attached to the elephants bells that would make a very raging, ringing sound very loud

and that spooked the horses.

So, now the entire Muslim cavalry was neutralized, none of the horses was willing to attack because of this violent sound that they would hear coming from the elephants.

So, you have the entire cavalry is now out of the battle.

So, now only the Muslim infantry was involved, and the archers were hitting them from every direction.

So, the Muslims were dropping.

Abu Obaidah Assaqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) realize the difficulty of the situation.

He said: We have to get rid of these elephants, otherwise, we'll be massacred our horses are not able to attack and we are on foot and we are facing the elephants.

We are facing their cavalry and we are facing their foot soldiers.

And the Muslim cavalry was the most important portion of the army.

That's where the Fursaan(فرسان) are, the fighters are.

So, Abu Obaidah Assaqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) gave his commands; Go and cut the ropes that are holding the saddles, because every elephant has a saddle on top of it,

and there are group of soldiers on top of the elephant.

So, Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) thought, if we're able to bring down those soldiers from on top of the elephants, then the elephants would be without anyone to lead them.

So, they went around cutting the saddles, until they drop them from on top of the elephants.

But that did not solve the problem because these were trained elephants, and they were just stumbling across the army, stepping over Muslims and crushing them under their feet.

Abu Obaidah Assaqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) said: We must then kill these elephants.

But these are huge animals.

How can you kill the elephant with the sword or a spear or an arrow?

Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) asked: How can we get rid of them?

They said: Cut the trunk, if you cut the trunk of the elephant, it would die.

That's what they, that's the advice he was given.

Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) himself, even though he's the leader of the army, he went ahead in order to cut off the trunk of this elephant.

But when he attempted to reach to the trunk of the elephant, the elephant struck Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيد) with his foot and stepped over Abu Obaid(ابوعبيد) and crushed him,

Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي), the Ameer(أمير) of the Muslim army died, Shaheed(شهيد).

His brother took over and he went to attack the same elephant, and was again crushed.

So, his brother, Al-Hakam Bin Masood(ألحكم بن مسعود) died.

They carried on.

Now, Abu Obaid(ابوعبيد) appointed seven of his family members as Umaraa(أمرآء) in case he dies.

So, if he died, it's his brother and his brother died, then it's his son, if his son dies, then his other son anyway, seven of his family members to assume leadership in case he dies.

All of the seven were killed, all of the seven from the same family of Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) were killed.

At the end of the day Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Shaibaani(ألْمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني), he assumed the Imara(عمارة) of the army and he asked the Muslims to retreat.

Al-Musanna(ألمثنى) saw that in this situation, we have a justified reason for retreating we should not carry on fighting, so he asked the Muslims to retreat.

So, the Muslims are going on this bridge, Abdullah bin Marsad As-Saqqafi(عبدالله بن مرصد الثقفي) he went to the bridge and he told the Muslims;

We should die just like our leaders died, do not retreat.

Maybe this was before Musanna(مثنى) gave his instructions but anyway, the Muslims were already retreating even before the instructions of Al-Musanna(ألمثنى).

So, the Muslims were retreating and Abdullah Bin Marsad(عبدالله بن مرصد) went to the bridge and he was telling the Muslims do not retreat, we should fight and die like our leaders did.

And what did he do?

He cut the bridge.

You know this was a rope bridge, so he cut it down he was brought to Al-Musanna(ألمثنى).

Al-Musanna(ألمثنى) beaten him so badly and, he said; Why did you do that?

Abdullah(عبدالله) said: I did so that they would carry on fighting.

Al-Musanna Bin Harisa(ألمثنى بن حارثه) gave his instructions that the bridge should be tied again.

And that the Muslims should retreat, he saw it as a fatal thing to do.

We have no chance of winning this battle, we need to retreat the elephants were just massacring the Muslims.

The cavalry was not involved in the fighting, he asked the Muslims to retreat and Al-Musanna(ألمثنى) told them; "I want you to retreat peacefully and I am going to protect you

until you all reach to the other side and then I will cross over." So, Al-Musanna Bin Harisa(ألمثنى بن حارثه), he is the leader but he wants to ensure that he leaves the last.

By the way, Abdullah Bin Marsad(عبدالله بن مرصد) when it cut down the bridge, what happened is there are many Muslims already on their way to crossing the bridge.

So, they were very close to the river and because the army of the enemy was so close to them and was pushing them many of them fell in the river and died,

they drowned in the river.

4000 Muslims were killed in that battle it's called the Battle of the bridge, 4000 many of them were Sahabah(صحابه).

Now, when you say 4000, in those days that's a very high number.

6000 Persians were killed.

Musanna Bin Harisa(ألمثنى بن حارثه) retreated with the army and he went back to Madina.

FEW THINGS RELATING TO THIS BATTLE, THE BATTLE OF AL-JISR(ألجسر) Number one; The wife of Abu Obaidah As-Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي), her name is Daoma(دومه)

she saw a dream.

She saw someone come from the heavens with a vessel in his hand and her husband Abu Obaid(ابوعبيد) came to drink from that vessel and then his son came to drink and his brother came to drink

and she mentioned, the names of seven of his relatives.

Abu Obaid As-Saqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) said: This indicates Shahadah(شهادة) the interpretation of this dream is Shahadah(شهادة).

And that's why, he appointed these seven men to lead the army after him.

Because he felt that these would die as Shuhada(شهداء).

So, when he appointed them as leaders it's not as an honoring or a special status it is to put them in the front line, in the line of fire.

To put them in the most risky post and his interpretation was true all of them died as a Shaheed(شهيد).

When it comes to dreams brothers and sisters dreams are not interpreted equally so for example here, this means Shahadah(شهادة) that's not the only way

Shahadah(شهادة) presents itself in a dream.

With Tufail Bin Amr(طفيل بن عمرو) for example he saw that birds were eating from his head and that he was swallowed into a womb of a woman.

He said: The interpretation of this dream is that my head will be chopped off and I will die as a Shaheed(شهيد) and the womb swallowing him is the earth swallowing his body, in his grave.

So, that was Shahadah(شهادة).

The way some people see Shahadah(شهادة) is they see themselves talking to Al-Hoor Ul Ain(حورالعين) before they die.

With some, for example with Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان), Rasool Allah ﷺ came to him and his dream and he said; Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) was fasting that day.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ came to him in his dream and said: You're going to have Aftar(أفطار) with me and he died that day.

So, Shahadah(شهادة) can come in different forms.

So, the interpretation of dreams is more of  a gift from Allah than it is a science.

We can also see that dreams played an important role in their lives.

I mean, they would see dreams, they would interpret the dreams because this is the only thing remaining from Prophet hood.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: That all of the Prophethood will end with him and the only thing that will remain is, Is the true dream that a believer would see.

So, this is the only form of revelation or inspiration that remains.

Jibril عليه السّلام will never come down and deliver revelation to anyone.

So, the only way in which we receive some of the ilm(علم) of the unseen is through dreams that are seen by Al-Momineen(ألمؤمنين) and these are Bisharat(بشارات).

I think we talked earlier that there is no Halal(حلال) and Haram(حرام) that comes through a dream.

The dream is only a Bishara(بشارة) it's good news, it's an indication of what will happen you cannot take a dream and use it to drive Ahkam(أحكام).

The Ahkam(أحكام) are in Qur'an, and Sunnah(سنة).

Number two, there were two mistakes committed, Number one: Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) not listening to the advice of his generals.

When they said: Do not cross over to them, let them cross over to us.

Abu Obaidah Saqqafi(أبوعبيد ألثقفي) was eager to go and fight, he saw it as an inappropriate for them to come to us because we want to die more than them

and the Persians surrounded them because of that.

Number two: The second mistake was Abdullah Bin Marsad(عبدالله بن مرصد), cutting the bridge and that was putting the Muslims in a very difficult situation.

They're unable to retreat and it was too difficult for them to fight because the ranks were not organized and because of the elephants.

So, bravery is good it's encouraged virtue, however, too much of that turns into recklessness.

In fact, sometimes a person could be reckless even if they're a coward.

A Muslim is supposed to have courage but they're not supposed to be reckless.

A Muslim is supposed to think out things approach affairs with wisdom and not rush into anything because again, being in a hurry is from Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

Number three; The ones who have Taqwa(تقوى) in Allah, Allah will provide a way out for them.

The Muslims were in a very, very difficult situation.

Yes they retreated but they were still in the land of the enemy and the enemy could take advantage of that and just wipe them out, massacre them all,

because 4000 Muslims were killed you only had a few thousand left and the enemy was 10s of thousands, they could recruit more.

But Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, when He wants to save His followers Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ creates the circumstances that facilitate saving them.

You see Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ is the One, Who controls everything in the heavens and earth.

You might look at it in the beginning and say if you're looking at it from an approach of one plus one equals two logically.

It's impossible the Muslims will be wiped out.

But keep in mind that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has promised that He would give assistance and help to Muttaqeen(ألمتقين).

Yes, the Muslims have lost in this battle.

They couldn't find the cure for the elephants issue but Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ created for them a climate that made it impossible on the Persians to look at the Islamic invasion of their land,

and that is a dispute that broke out between Rustum(رستم) and Feroze(فيروز).

Rustum(رستم) and Feroze(فيروز), were the highest two military leaders in Persia.

A war or a fight, a dispute broke out between the two of them and that preoccupied them from looking into the Muslim army.

So, even though the Muslim army was weak and was battered in that war, many of them are injured, they lost some of their best fighters but nobody attack them.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ saved them through this dispute.

Just like a Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has prepared the grounds for the Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Right before Muhammad ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina, one of the worst battles between Al-Aus(ألأوس) and Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) occurred and it was called the Youm-Ul-Buaas(أليوم بعاث).

Ayesha رضي الله عنها said: Yaoum Buaas(أليوم بعاث) was a day of preparation for the Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ because that is when the majority of the leaders of both camps were killed.

So, the people were left without leaders and that enhanced their willingness to bring in a leader from outside - Muhammad ﷺ.

If the people of Madina were living in a peaceful state, they wouldn't have wanted to bring in somebody from outside to lead them.

Why would anyone want to bring a leader, a foreign leader from outside and appoint him over them if everything is going on alright?

But because they have been in this cycle of violence for a very long time Al-Aus(ألأوس) Wal-Khazraj(وألخزرج) at each other's necks for years and years

because of the Battle of Buaas(بعاث) many of the leaders were killed.

When they went to Muhammad ﷺ they said: Maybe Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will unify us and end the bloodshed that is happening among us, through you.

So, that war of Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) that was going on between Al-Aus(ألأوس) Wal-Khazraj(وألخزرج) was a preparation for the Hijrah(هجرة) of Muhammad ﷺ.

It was also another preparation because it made the men of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) the most ideal group to given nusra(نصرة) to Muhammad ﷺ.

They were seasoned fighters, what they would do?

Is wake up in the morning go and fight until night time and they would go back to bed, on a daily basis.

The training was part of their life the fighting was part of their life.

It was a prepared and ready army for Rasool Allah ﷺ, to take over.

It was an honor that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ has preserved for them, even though it happened through hardship.

They suffered for years and years but that was a preparation for them to be the Ansaar(ألأنصار) of this religion.

The ones who would give this religion a victory.

Therefore, the Muslim should never give up, the Muslim should never fear the creation and say that the creation is stronger than me, is more better equipment than me,

has more technology than me, I have no hope that's not how you should look at it, the way you should look at it is.

If I have Taqwa(تقوى) Allah will give me victory no matter how strong the enemy is.!

If I  don't have Taqwa(تقوى) Allah will humiliate me, no matter how weak my enemy is.

It all goes back to Taqwa(تقوى).

And in the future when Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will see that this Ummah(امة) deserves victory, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will prepare the circumstances that will facilitate that,

No matter how wide the gap in technology is, no matter how wide the financial gap is, all of these issues are irrelevant, when it comes to the issue of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ giving victory to the ones who He loves.

There is no way to compare between the strength of Musa عليه السّلام and Firaun(فرعون), no way.

What are you going to compare Musa alone, عليه السّلام, against Firaun(فرعون).

Firaun(فرعون) says; Rivers are flowing under me.

He was the superpower of the Earth at that time, he had the most powerful army in the world, he had all of the wealth you could ask for, he had the powerful security force, he had it all,

but Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ made him commit mistakes that ended with his demise.

Even though Firaun(فرعون) was intelligent leader, he was a wise man, with very strong abilities.

He had the powerful army, he had the resources, he had the advisors to tell him how to plan and how to approach the problem of Musa(موسى) and Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل).

And on the other hand, you had Musa(موسى) and Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل) are without any arms without any wealth, they were slaves, they were weak.

But Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ made firaoun(فرعون), commit mistakes and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ guided Musa(موسى).

When Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل) said: O Musa(موسى) give up that's it, they're gonna kill us we have no chance, sea is in front of us and Firaun(فرعون) is behind us. What  can we do?

We are without any weapons you promised us and you lied.

You said, that Allah is going to save us and here we are, the sea in front of us, Firaun(فرعون) behind us, you tricked us, you fooled us.

And they were going on, and on, and on and on… What did Musa(موسى) say?

No! Allah is with me and He will guide me, Allah will find a way out for me.

Even though his eyes were telling him otherwise and his ears were telling him otherwise, his eyes tell him it's impossible.

The sea and the army, his ears are telling him, it's impossible.

Because of all of the whispering of Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل) but his heart is telling him no!

His heart is telling him believe in Allah.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ split the sea for Musa(موسى) and destroyed Firaun(فرعون).

Therefore Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will find a way out for you and to apply this on an individual basis we talked about it on the society level on an individual basis,

if you have Taqwa(تقوى) in Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will provide a way out for you, in case you get into trouble, or in case you are poor, on in case you are in need,

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will find a way out for you.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will help you, have that Yaqeen(يقين) in Allah Rizq(رزق) will come to you.

Younus عليه السّلام was stuck in the stomach of the whale, under three levels of darkness Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ delivered him to safety, because of his Taqwa(تقوى).

Abdullah Bin Zaid Al-Ansari(عبدالله بن زيد ألأنصاري) travelled to Madina to deliver the news to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was delivering Khutba(خطبه) on the Mimber(ممبر), on the pulpit and he saw Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) coming in.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was, by the way, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would be extremely concerned with, what is happening on the front lines

and he would sometimes be so excited to know the news.

He would go outside of Madina in order to meet the messengers and he cannot sleep, he would spend his sleepless nights thinking about what's happening with the Muslims on the front line and it would be making Dua(دُعَا) for them.

So, as soon as this Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) coming in and he is on the Mimber(ممبر) he said: What's the news?

He cut the Khutba(خطبه) and he said: "What's the news?" Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) was very wise, he did not answer he said; News is on its way to you Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين),

until he crossed the lines and he came to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) and he whispered the news into his ears.

He did not want to give the news publicly until the Khalifah(خليفه) delivers it himself because it's not good news.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه  said; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I am the Fea(فِئَةَ) of every Muslim.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says in Qur'an; You are not allowed to retreat from the battle.

You are not allowed to retreat from the battle.

And we know that retreating from the battle is one of the seven major sins.

You are not allowed to retreat from the battle except in two situations.

Number one, you are making a tactical retreat in order to attack again or Number two, you are retreating to join with another Muslim force or group.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I am that force for every Muslim.

May Allah have mercy on Abu Obaid(أبوعبيد)! Why didn't he come back to me?

Why did he have to carry on fighting?

Why didn't he come back to me and I would be the force in which he could fall back on, and I would give him reinforcements to go back and fight.

See, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was thinking about it from the approach of the leader, Abu Obaid(أبوعبيد) might have been thinking about it from another approach.

There are two options dying as a shaheed or victory.

And these are called.

The two goods, the two virtues, one is dying as a shaheed(شهيد) and the other one is being victorious.

From a strictly reward point of view it is more rewarding to die as the shaheed(شهيد) than it is to win.

Therefore on an individual basis the Sahabah(صحابه) would want to die because it carries more Ajr(أجْر).

However, the leader Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) since he is the Khalifah(خليفه) he is more concerned with having Islam spread, being victorious, winning.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was very careful and he did not want the Muslims to fall into destruction and perish.

And that was the concern of the Khulafaa(خلفاء).

Umar Bin Abdel Aziz رضي الله عنه, the first thing he did as soon as it became Khalifah(خليفه).

He gave orders to have the army that is laying siege to Constantinople to come back.

Why? Because that army was suffering the cold weather and hunger and they were dying.

The only reason why the previous Khalifah(خليفه) had them there, is out of stubbornness.

He wanted Constantinople to fall.

And even though he was receiving news that the Muslims were dying because of hunger, disease and cold weather.

He had the army carry on laying that siege.

Umar Bin Abdel Aziz(عمربن عبدالعزيز) immediately, called the Muslims back.

Even though everyone who was dying, was dying as a Shaheed(شهيد).

Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Ash-Shaibani(ألمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني) is now the leader again.

He has assume leadership in many different battles he was also the leader in the time of Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه.

So, now he became the leader he asked for reinforcements.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) sent him some reinforcements.

Same thing happens because Iraq is the land of rivers.

He was on the river and the enemy was across him.

And they said: Do you want to cross over to us or shall we cross over to you.

He said: "No you cross over to us".

We are not crossing over to you, you come to us.

They  cross over, Al-Musanna(ألمثنى) gives his instructions to the Muslims, you make Takbeer(تكبير), first Takbeer(تكبير), second Takbeer(تكبير), third Takbeer(تكبير), fourth Takbeer(تكبير) and then you charge.

But the Persian army did not give them that chance.

they attacked immediately after the first Takbeer(تكبير).

Al-Musanna(مثنى) has told his army previously, this was Ramadan(رمضان).

He said: You are fasting and fasting weakens your body.

My advice is that you break your fast.

They followed his advice, and they broke their fast.

He told them, that food will strengthen you.

So, they had their meal middle of the day, even though this was Ramadan(رمضان).

So, they are allowed to break their fast if, it is Harb(حرب), if it is war that is established in the Shariah(شريعة), because at that particular moment,

the fighting is more virtuous than the fasting.

So, it takes precedence over fasting, and even if somebody wants to combine between fighting and fasting, it is better that they don't, because fasting weakens you.

And you need to have all of the stamina and strength that you can.

So, he had them break their fasting.

Also in this particular Battle of Boweb(ألبُوَيب).

After the Muslims won, they won this battle.

Al-Muthanna(مثنى) sent food to the women's camp.

These are the families that accompany their husbands.

So, they were not close to the battle ground there were far away to keep them safe, Al-Musanna(مثنى) he sent a Christian man to take that food to the woman.

He's an Arab Christian and he had a group of men with him and they're taking the food to the women and children when the women saw them coming,

they didn't know who they were.

So, they all armed themselves with poles and sticks and went out to fight, when this man saw that, he said: "This is how women should be" and then he gave them the news of victory.

He said: I am here just to give you this food and not here to fight, but this shows us that the woman in those days were strong and they were stronger than the men today.

The Sahabiaat(صحابيات) and Tabiaat(تابيعات) would be willing to fight, if they had to, not only if they had to but some of them volunteered in fighting like Nusaiba Bint Ka'abرضي الله عنها,

and some of the other Ansaar(أنْصَار), Ansaariaat(أنصاريات) especially the woman of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) were strong, don't you remember the what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said;

We used to have the upper hand over our women in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) in Makkah.

And we come here and we find women, who had the upper hand over their husbands.

So, the women of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) were strong, not only at their homes, but also in the battlefield.

Nusaiba Bint Ka'ab(نُصيبه بنت كعب) was involved in fighting and she said: I had 12 injuries in my body on the day of Yarmook(يرموك), Khalid Bin Waleed رضي الله عنه sent me a physician to take care of me

because he was a man who took great care of us.

And then she said, she had 12 injuries in her body.

And the way they would heal those injuries in those days is, what would they do?

Would they bring any anti bacteria, medicine and antibiotics.

What they would do, is they would pour over the injury, boiling oil, they would pour over the injury, boiling oil.

What that does is, it kills the germs.

So, it prevents infections and it also stops the bleeding and it burns the surface of the injury and that helps the healing.

So, it seals it.

It burnt, it sealed, no infections can get in.

She said, that the healing process was more painful than the injuries themselves.

So, this tells you that these were very strong women, these were very strong women, for her to have patience to endure all of that pain - voluntarily.

I mean, she chose to go into it and because it's not fardh(فرض) on them.

She chose to, it tells you something about their love of Allah because remember, in those days there was no anesthesia.

The next battle or series of raids really, commanded by Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Ash-Shaibani(ألمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني) were against economical targets of the enemy.

He attacked their markets, they had these markets, where all of the businessmen would come.

It's like a fairground or tradeshow, you'd name it, whatever you want.

So, they would bring all of their items merchandise to this market.

And they would have more than one market, Al-Muthanna(ألمثنى) targeted these markets and he told his men to take nothing but gold and silver,

you leave the food behind you leave the clothes behind, you just go after the gold and silver.

And you only take other items, you take as much as your camel can carry, don't take more.

But you should devote the effort to targeting the gold and silver.

The reasoning behind that is Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Ash-Shaibani(ألمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني) wants to finance his campaigns against the enemy from his enemies own pocket.

Number two, the Muslims were in need.

And Number three, it is to weaken the enemy.

So, it was an economical war against the Persian Empire.

So, they raided these markets and they did it with lightening speed headed by Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Ash-Shaibani(ألمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني).

They used the best horses that they had, the Arabian horses very fast and they're on their way back and it all happened within one day.

And they covered the distance of more than 60 miles, which is quite significant.

Talking about their form of transportation in those days.

You travelled, you attacked, you come back.

On their way back, they heard some noise.

So, one of the soldiers said: This must be an army attacking us.

Al-Musanna Bin Harisa Ash-Shaibani(ألمثنى بن حارثه ألشيباني), he said; Don't speak evil but speak good.

Think about you say before you say it.

Think about it, assess the situation make the right judgment and then speak, don't speak first.

Their army didn't even received the warning yet.

Not only is the army not following us, they didn't even know about what happened our attack was so swift and fast the news didn't even reached the army

and then he said: And if it did, fear will prevent them from following you because these raids throw fear in the hearts of the enemy and this fear can last for an entire day, these swift ambushes,

they cast fear in the hearts of the enemy as Musanna Bin Harisa(مثنى بن حارثه) said; It will make them terrified, it would put them in a state of shock for 24 hours,

don't worry they're not going to come.

And if they do come, so What?

We'll fight them for two reasons to get the Ajr(أجْر) the from Allah and to get victory.

I'm doing this because the Khalifah(خليفه) of Rasool Ullah, Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه told me to be very swift and fast in my raids.

This was the advice of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) that he gave to Musanna(مثنى) to be very fast.

It's pretty much similar to what is called today the guerrilla warfare method.

Which is based on small groups attacking swiftly and retreating after ambushing the enemy.

What was the response of the people of Faris.

What happened to them was because of what Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ created among them.

The disunity that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ created among them.

So, the people are Faris(فارس), Persia came to Rustum(رستم) and Feroze(فيروز) and they said; This disunity of yours has weakened the people of Persia.

And you made the enemy greedy in our land.

This defeat that we are suffering now is because of you our leaders.

What is left after Baghdad(بغداد), Sabaat(سبات) and Tikrit(تكريت) except Al-Madaen(ألمدائن)?

So, they mentioned the names of some of the major towns that fell.

They said: Tikrit(تكريت), Baghdad(بغداد) and Sabaat(سبات) have fell under the Muslims.

All what is left is our capital Al-Madaen(ألمدائن).

So, they said; You either unify our ranks or we're going to kill you first.

If it wasn't that killing, you will weaken us further, we would have killed you first.

And if you don't unify now, we will kill you even if we're going to end up losing.

So, that when we lose, we would at least have taken revenge from you.

Because this is happening because of you.

These were very serious threats from the people of Persia.

They're waken up to the threat knocking on their doors.

The Muslims were now way into Iraq.

So, what they did is, This was a kingdom, it was ruled by Royal Family, and you had to have royal blood to be the king.

However, one of their earlier kings, what he did was, he gathered all of his brothers and their sons and he executed them all.

The reason why he did that is he doesn't want anyone to compete with him in the future.

So, He wanted the royal blood to dry out.

So, that he ensures that he will carry on.

What he really did was he shot himself in the foot, he died, and there was nobody to take over after him.

So, the kingdom was transferred to a woman from the royal family, and then she was killed.

So, another woman took over, and she was incapable of leading the Empire, and that is when Rustam(رستم) and Feroze(فيروز) who are not from the royal family

but they are military generals.

They started taking affairs in their own hands.

They didn't claim to be kings, but they were the actual runners of the affairs of Persia.

They were the administrators but since there was no figurehead to lead them.

These two men Feroze(فيروز) and Rustam(رستم) started clashing.

So, what they did, they gathered all of the women from the royal family of Sassan(ساسان) and they had them tortured, they were torturing the women from the royal family,

and telling them, trying to extract from them any information.

If there is a surviving male member in the family, and they were torturing them to get that information.

One of them did in fact claim that there is one man from the royal family, who is in this faraway area.

And the reason, why he is there is, because his mother feared for his death.

So, she smuggled him away before the king killed all of the male members of the family, they investigated that story and found it to be true.

So, they called in this young man.

He was 21 years old, his name is Yastajard(يزدجرد) and they appointed him as Emperor over them.

He was 21 years old, he is Yastajard Al thalith (يزدجردالثالث) the third, and he now succeeded in unifying the people of the Persian Empire so now things were different.

Now, the Muslims will be facing a unified foe.

They would be facing the entire Sassaani Empire.

They started mobilizing their forces from the four corners of the Empire, and news was reaching to Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه that the Persian Empire is ready to face us with the largest army, they have assembled so far.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) decided to go out himself and meet the Persian army, all of the Sahabah(صحابه) agreed to that suggestion except one Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف).

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: If you are killed, then the Muslims will have no one to go back to, but why don't you send someone in your place and you stay behind in Madina.

So, if the Muslims lose, then you would be able to lead another campaign against them and Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) insisted on his opinion,

and he succeeded in convincing, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to stay behind.

But now, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: So, who can I appoint for this major battle?

Who is the person who could take care of this major affair?

And he was thinking about it for days, who should I appoint?

And then one of the Sahabah(صحابه) came to him and said: I found it, I found it, I found the person.

He said: Who is it?

He said: It's the lion in his den.

He said, Who is it?

The man is getting Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) excited.

He said: It's a lion in his den!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Who is it?

Who is that lion?

He said: Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعد إبن أبي وقاص).

One of the 10 who are given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

A relative of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You have found him.

And he appointed him to lead the army that would end up fighting one of The most famous battles in our Muslim history.

One of The most important battles ever in the time of Al-Khulafaa(ألْخلفاء).

In fact, it only has one competitor, and that is Ghazwa Al-Yarmook(غزوة اليرموك).

That's the only battle to compete with the importance of this battle.

And what's the name of this battle…?

Al-Qaadsiyaa(ألقادسیة), Maarikat-Qadisiyyah(معركة القادسية) This issue was so important Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) overruled a order that was or a law that was legislated by Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه

and that is that none of the men, who joined in the armies of Ridda(ردة), against the Muslims should participate in Jihad(جهاد).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) refused to accept the former murtaddeen(مرتدين) into the Muslim army.

Many of these murtaddeen(مرتدين) or all of them, the ones that at least survived all of them, they came back to Islam.

But Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) didn't want them, to join the Muslim army.

You stay out.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was so short of men, he had to recruit the former Murtaddeen(مرتدين).

And now he opened up the gates of recruitment, anyone is welcomed we need any help that we can get.

So, many of the former Murtaddeen(مرتدين), now they are Muslim they joined in.

Not only that, but Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) when he did not get enough, when he opened up the doors of recruitment or voluntary, he didn't received enough soldiers.

He started mandatory military service.

So, the first one to start mandatory military service was Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه.

He sent out letters to the Muslim states saying that any man, who has weapons and is able to fight must join in the armies.

Why? Because now, we have the major battle of Qaadsiya(قادسية) and we also have the Roman front which was still going on.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) needed anyone that could offer help to step forward and come and join the Armies.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه asked Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعد بن أبي وقاص) to send a delegation to meet with the Persian Emperor.

So, they sent a delegation of 14 men many of them Sahabah(صحابه) like Mugheerah Bin Shoba(مغيرة بن شعبه), Noman Bin Makran(نعمان بن مقرن) and others,

they went to Yastajard(يزدجرد) and they delivered to him the message from the Khalifah(خليفه).

We are inviting you to Islam, we were people who were misguided and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ guided us through Muhammad ﷺ, and now we are delivering to you the same invitation that He gave to us.

An-Noman Ibn Makran(نعمان بن مقرن) closed his speech by saying We give you three options.

Number one: You  become Muslim if you do, we would leave you and your land alone.

Number two: If you refuse to become Muslim then we give you the option of paying Jizya(جزية).

If you refused to pay us Jizya(جزية).

Than it is the sword.

Yastajard(يزدجرد) wasn't happy to hear somebody speaking to him like that, how do you speak to the Emperor in such a way.?

You're not following the protocols.

He said: You were men who were humbled, and never dreamt of attacking our empire.

So, what has happened to you, if the reason why you are here in our land is beacuse you're hungry, we will feed you.

We will give you back money to go back to your desert.

Noman Bin Makran(نعمان بن مقرن) said; Number one: You become Muslim if you don't, you pay us Jizya(جزية).

If you don't, then we will fight you.

Yastajard(يزدجرد) said: If it wasn't because messengers are not killed, I would have killed you all.

Leave!....

So, they left.

That was the first delegation that was sent.

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص) sent another delegation to the leader of the army which is Rustum(رُستم).

Rustum(رُستم) is now going to lead the battle in Al-Qadsiya(ألقادسية).

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص) sent Rab'ee Ibn Amir رضي الله عنه to meet with him.

And that is when an interesting conversation took place.

We'll talk about that In Sha Allah ho Ta'Allah(إن شاء الله تعالى) tomorrow night.

You might have time for a question or two?

You mentioned in one of your previous sessions if a Muslim leaves Islam than he should be executed.

Is there any Qur'an Ayah(آية) or it's from Sunnah(سنة)?

It's from Sunnah.

Whoever changes his religion, then execute him.

However, any punishment can only be carried out by the Sultan(سلطان), by the leader.

Law is not taken into individuals hands.

It has to be done through the Muslim government.

You said that Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعد إبن أبي وقاص) made Dua(دُعَا) against the man that slandered him, however we as Muslims should we not make Dua(دُعَا) for them rather than against them?

Which evil against them? Well, we are allowed to make Dua(دُعَا) against the person if the person oppresses us, but don’t make Dua(دُعَا) against somebody who, who just hurt you in a very insignificant way.

Don't make Dua(دُعَا) is somebody who is otherwise righteous and good, just because they made a mistake once.

You make the Dua(دُعَا) against Zalama(ظلماء) the people to whom oppression is part of their life, the tyrants you make Dua(دُعَا) against these.

That’s what Musa عليه السّلام did against Firaun(فرعون).

O Allah seal their hearts and destroy their wealth, until they see the punishment from You.

Meaning don't give them a chance to make Toba(توبة).

O Allah don't leave any disbelieving soul alive on the face of the earth, he made Dua(دُعَا) against all of the Kafara(كفارا).

Rasool Allah ﷺ made Dua(دُعَا) against Raqal(رقل) and Aquaan(أقعان) and Urana(عرنة), he made Dua(دُعَا) against some of the Arab tribes who betrayed him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه made Dua(دعا) against the People of the Book who are fighting him.

So Dua(دُعَا) against someone is allowed.

But this should not be interpreted to mean that somebody walked next to you and just hit you and didn't say excuse me.

So, you start, you raise your hands and you make Dua(دُعَا) him.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً إِنَّمَا أُأَمِّرِوْ أَوَّلَ مَنِ السَّتَجَابَ

إِنَّكُمْ إِنَّمَا سَبَقْتُمْ النَّاسَ بِنُصْرَتِ هَذَالدِّيْنَ Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ

وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ أُولَئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ۝

شَابُ نَّشَاءْ فِيْ طَاعَتِ الله وَاللهِ لَا أُسَابِقُوْ أَبِيْ بَكَرْ أَبَدًا وَكَانَ سَبَّاقًا فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرَ أَمْرابِالّْمَعْرُوْفَ وَنَهِيْ اَلْمُنْكَرْ

لَا يَنْفَعُوْ نَفْسٌ إِيْمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكًنْ أَمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلَ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِيْ إِيْمَانِهَا خَيْرًا رَبّ ارْجِعُونِ لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ

إِسْمِعْ لِأَصْحَابِ رَسُوْلِ الله وَشِّرِكْهُمْ فِى الّأَمْر وَلَا تَجْتَعِدْ مُسْرِعًا بَلِتَّعِدْفَإِنَّهَا الّحَرْبَ لَا يُصْلِحُوْهَا إِلَّا رَجُلٌ مَقِيْسَ أَلَّذِيْ يَعْرِفُ الّفُرْسَا

وَلَا يَمْنَعَنِيْ أَنْ أَأُمِّرْ صُلَيْتًّا إِلَّا سّْرَتَه’ الّحَرْبَ "أَلْأَجَلَ مِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ" "وَيَتَحَيَّرُالّفُرْسَا" إِنَّهُمْ لَيْسُ بِأَجْرَأَلّْمَوْتِ مِنَّا

أَلرُّوْيَهْ أَلصَّادِقَهْ يَرَاهَلْ عَبْدَ الْمُؤمِنَ ألعجل من الشّيطان "وَمَنْ يَتَّقِلَ الله يَجْعَلْ لَه’ مَخْرَجَا " أَلَّذِيْ تَجْرِى لّْأَنْهَارُ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا

Musa عليه السّلام said; كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ

أَتَاكَ الّْخَبَرْ يا أمير الّمومنين أَللَّهُمَّ كُلَّ مُسْلِمٍ فِيْ حِلٍّ مِنِّيْ أَنَا فِئَةْ كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ مَنْ لَّقِيَ الّعَدُوْ فَفُظِعَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ أَمْرِهِ فَأَناَ لَه’ فِئَةَ

يَرْحَمُ اللهُ أَبَا عُبَيْد، لَوْ كَانَ إِنْحَازَإِلَيَّ لَكُنْتُ لَه’ فِئَة إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍۢ

وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍۢ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ

إِمَّاالّقَتْلَ وَإِمَّا الشَّهَادَةْ "إِهْدَالّحُسْنَيَيْنَ" تَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَلَا تَنَاجَوْ بِالْإ ثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانَ أُنْظُرُوْا فِي الّأُمُوْرِ وَقَدِّرُوْهَاأحسبوها ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمُوْا

إِنَّه’ لَمْ يَبْلُغَ ألْتَدَّبِرْمَدِيْنَتَهُمْ بَعْدْ وَلَوْبَلَغَهُمْ لَحَالَ الرُّعْبَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ طَلَبِكُمْ إِنَّ لِلْغَارَاتِ رَوْعَاتْ تَنْتَشِرُ عَلَيْهَا يَوْمًا إِلَى الَّيْلَ

وَلَوْ أَدْرَكُوْكُمْ لَقَا تَلْنَهُمْ لِاثْنَتَيْنَ، إِلْتَمَاسَ الْأَجْرَ وَرَجَاءًالنَّصَرْ إِنَّ خليفة رسول الله أَبَا بَكْر أَوْصَانَا أَنْ نُقَلِّلَ ألْعَرْجِّةْ

وَنُسْرِعَ ألْكَرَّةَّ فِيْ الّغَارَاتَ وَنُسْرِعَ فِيْ غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ أَيْنَ يَذْهَبْ بِكُمُا الْإِخْتِلَافَ حَتَّى وَهَنْتُمَا أَهْلِ فَارِس

وَأَطْمَاتُمَا فِيْهِمْ عَدُوَّهُمْ وَالله مَا جَرَّ هَذَا أَلّوَهَنْ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَكُمْ يَا مَعْشَرَالْقُوَّادَ لَقَدْ فَرَّقْتُّمْ بَيْنَ أَهَل لْفَارِس وَثَبَّطّتُمُوْهُمْ عَنْ عَدُوِّهِمْ

مَا بَعْدَ بَغْدَادْ وَسَابَاطْ وَتَكْرِيْتَ إِلَّا الْمَدَائِنْ وَالله لَتَجْتَمِعَانْ أَوْلَنَبْدِأَنَّ بِكُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَشْمَتَ بِنَا شَامِتْ

وَالله لَوْ لَا أَنَّ فِيْ قَتْلِكُمْ هَلَاكُنَا لَعَجَّلْنَا لَكُمُ الْقَتْلَ السَّاعَة وَلَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهُوْا لَنُهْلِكَنَّكُمْ ثُمَّ نَهْلَكْ  وَقَدْ أَشْتَفَيْنَا مِنْكُمْ

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ "مَنْ بَدَّلَ دِيْنَه’ فَاقْتُلُوْهْ" رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَىٰ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ۝

And Noah عليه السّلام said; لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا۝

إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا۝

parts.english:
Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, as we mentioned, would constantly meet, with the people to get feedback on their leaders.

He wanted to know how the Wulaa(ولآه) were doing.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه would meet with the people to get feedback, on the Umara'a(أمرآء), and he would take their concerns seriously, and he would act upon it.

And I'll give examples of some of the complaints that were raised against some of the wulaa(ولآه) Some men from Bannu Asad(بنوأسد) from Kufa(كوفه).

They came to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, and they complained about Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص).

Saad Bin Abi Waqas رضي الله عنه, is  one of the 10 given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

One of the first believers and they came and complained about him, and they chose an interesting timing.

It happened while the Muslims and the Persians were preparing for war.

The Muslims were preparing and the Persians were preparing for the great battle of Nahwand(النہوند).

So, these men knew very well that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) especially before a battle would start, he wanted to make sure of Wahdat-As-Saff(الوحدت الصف), the unity of the Muslims,

because the last thing you don't want to do, is go to battle when you have the disunity.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) as very, very keen on ensuring, that the Muslims Jama'at(جماعة) is unified and one.

There's no dissent, there's no division, there's no Fitnah(فِتْنَه), there's no gossip.

He wanted to make sure that the Muslims are on one heart.

So, for them to choose that timing right before the Battle of Nahwand(نهوند) tells you something.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب),when he heard their complaints. He said; It is evident that you have evil intentions in your complaints because you chose this timing when you know that we are preparing to meet the enemy

and the enemy is preparing to meet us.

Nevertheless, that won't prevent me from looking into your concerns.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) again, his Farasah(فراسه) is never wrong.

He said: I believe that you're lying and you are choosing this time to cause Fitnah(فِتْنَه) because you know that we are in dire need of having unity now.

So, you know that I'm going to take your concerns very seriously and that's why you chose this timing.

But he said: Nevertheless, I'm not gonna drop this complaint I'm going to look into it.

So, he sent Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه), Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه), was the Sahabi(صحابي), who was entrusted with the responsibility of investigating in these issues.

Muhammad Bin Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) is one of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) and by the way, he was the head of the special operations team that assassinated Ka'ab Ibn-e-Ashraf(كعب إبن ألأشرف),

under the commands Rasool Allah ﷺ, he's very famous name in the books of Seerah(سيرة) and the Hadith(حديث), that talks about this special mission is in Al-Bukhari(بخاريْ).

So, Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) was one of the well known Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه), he goes to Al-Kufa(ألكوفه).

And At-Tabri(ألطبري) says: He would take Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص), to each Masjid(مسجد) and they would hold an assembly with the people, open public meeting

and in front of everyone publicly Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) will say, Do you have anything against your Ameer(أمير) Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص).

And At-Tabri(ألطبري) said; Because in those days private investigations or investigations in secret, were something that they wouldn't do.

All of their investigations were done in public, public inquiry.

It's not like you go and give the Naseeha(نصيحه) in secretly and silently and not herd know, when it came to the Wulaa(ولآه), doesn't matter if their feelings are going to be hurt

it's done in public.

Everybody comes in Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) is there Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) is there.

If they have anything good, they would say, if they have anything bad they would say it and Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه), is going to report everything back to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين).

At-Tabri(ألطبري) say; They wouldn't do these inquiries privately or secretly, it was public.

They went to each Masjid(مسجد) one by one.

No one had anything bad to say about Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) nothing negative and these men from Bannu Asad(بنوأسد) would stay quiet

because they wouldn't dare to speak against him publicly.

It's a lie and it would be exposed.

Until, they went to the Masjid(مسجد) of Bannu Abs(بنوعبس).

You have different clans in Al-Kufa(ألكوفه).

Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) is saying; In the name of Allah, I asked you.

If you have anything negative to say about Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) to stand up and say it.

So, one man his name is Usama Bin Qatada(أسامه بن قتادة), he stood up and said; This man Osama Bin Qatadah(أسامه بن قتادة), he stood up and said;

If you are asking us in the name of Allah to speak the truth then, this is the truth.

Saad(سعد) is a man, who abuses our wealth and he is unjust in his ruling - and he does not join the Armies.

"He's a coward he stays behind".

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) Said: O Allah if he is lying and he is making these statements to boast and to show off.

Then O Allah blind his eyes and fill his house with dependence and make him face, the misleading Fittan(فتن).

This man just stands up bluntly and makes such a lie against Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) in his face.

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) was so angry and there's nothing you can respond back to this man it's fabricated lie, it's a lie.

So, he made this Dua(دُعَا) against him, because it's an outright lie, "slander".

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), this man he lost his sight and when he grew old he had 10 daughters in his house and he had to take care of them.

And he would chase women in the streets, when he was an old man.

An old man with his eyebrows, covering his eyes and he is blind.

He would go around the streets chasing women.

And when they would come and prevent him from doing that and tell him; You should have Taqwa(تقوى) in Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ and stop what you're doing,

look at you, you're an old man. What are you doing?

He would say: I was hit, I was struck by the Dua(دُعَا) of a blessed man, Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص).

With other men from Bannu Asad(بنوسعد).

Saad Bin Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) made a Dua(دُعَا) against them. And Said; "O Allah make their lives difficult." These men were all killed in a violent death.

One of them was tore into pieces by swords.

The other one was stabbed with the butts of the swords, with the handles of the swords, until he died and on and on.... with the rest.

All of them were received the wrath of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ because of the Dua(دُعَا) of Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص).

To add to their slander they said that Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص), doesn't know, how to pray and he is preoccupied with hunting.

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص), he said; I'm the first man in Islam to spell the blood of a Mushrik(مشرك), the disbeliever and I'm the only one whom Rasool Allah ﷺ, sacrificed his father and mother for both.

In Ghazwa of Uhud(غزوةأحَد), Rasool Allah ﷺ would say; O Saad(سعد) shoot them, may my mother and father be sacrifice for you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was telling Sa'ad(سعد) may my father and mother be sacrificed for you.

Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص) said; Never did Rasool Allah ﷺ combined both his father and mother for anyone but me and then he said: And there was a time, when I was one fifth of Islam.

He was the fifth man to become Muslim.

And then Bannu Asad(بنوأسد) claim that I cannot pray.

One of the earliest Muslims given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة) and I cannot pray.

Something to learn from this, is beware of the Dua(دُعَا) of the oppressed.

Nothing stands between it and Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Allah responds to the prayers of the oppressed even if he is a nonbeliever.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Nothing stands between the Dua(دُعَا) of the oppressed and Allah.

It climbs through the heavens like a spark of lightning.

Nothing stands between it and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Also you want to be especially careful, that none of the Aoulea(أوليآء) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, the righteous make a Dua(دُعَا) against you, nor should we slander the Aoulea(أوليآء) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ,

be careful, beware of speaking against the Friends of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Sometimes that is done to appease the Kuffar(كفار) or it is done because of jealousy or it's done because we don't agree with their method of work but be very careful.

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ loves some of His servants and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ does not allow anyone to put them down.

So, be careful in the way you use your tongue.

Rasool Allah ﷺ  said: People are thrown in Hellfire on their faces because of what their tongues reap.

It might be one of the smallest muscles in the body but it's the most dangerous.

Abu Bakr Siddiqueرضي الله عنه would hold his tongue and pull it out and say; This is, what is getting me in trouble.

They used to say that no one deserves, a long imprisonment term, than your tongue.

Arrest it, and put it in jail and leave it there, give it a life sentence.

Because a word when it comes out of your mouth, it can never be retrieved again.

That's it! It goes out it cannot go back again.

If it said it's a done deal.

So, we need to make sure that we use our tongue wisely.

These men lost their lives because of slandering Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن ابي وقاص).

Osama Bin Qatada(أسامه بن قتادة), it took him a few seconds to make that statement in the Masjid(مسجد), he lost his entire life towards the end of his life an old man running down the street, he is saying;

I was struck by the Dua(دُعَا) of a blessed man.

So, if you ever slandered a righteous man or woman.

If you ever spoke against any of the Aoulea(أوليآء) of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, make sure that you make Istaghfar(إستغفار).

And make sure that you compensate for talking against them, by talking for them, by praising them.

The way you do that if you spoke against the person in a meeting of 20 people, try to find a similar meeting of 20 people and speak good about such a person.

Try to make up for the sin by a similar good deed.

Hasanaat(حسانات) wipe out the sayyiaat(سَيِّئَات), the good deeds would wipe out the evil ones.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه received a complaint from one of the soldiers in Egypt.

He told Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه that Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) accused him of being a Munafiq(منافق).

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه summoneds Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص).

It is established in the court of justice of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

That Amr(عمرو) in fact, did accuse this Muslim soldier of being Munafiq(منافق).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) gave the soldier a stick and he told him to discipline Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) for what he has said, against you.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) is sitting down.

So, the soldier, now this is one of Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص)'s soldiers.

Very low rank and he's now holding the stick ready to hit his leader.

So, he asks, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) he said: Can anyone protect you from me now?

He said: No, go ahead and do what you're commanded to do.

The man said: I forgive you, for the sake of Allah, I forgive you for the sake of Allah.

And he let him go.

So, the honor of people in Islam is protected.

Islam protects five things.

Your Deen(دين), Your life, Your mind and intellect, Your wealth and Your Irz(عِرْضَ) your honor.

These are the five things that Shariah(شريعة) protects.

And there's a special Hadd(حدّ), called Hadd-el- Qadh( حد القض ).

The Hadd(حدّ) of slandering and this is specific for punishing anyone who accuses a righteous Muslim women, of committing Zina(زنا).

However, it would also apply to a man who was accused with the same sin and also, you would find similar punishment although, it might not exactly be the Qadh(قض) .

It would be a lesser form of punishment.

If a person is dishonored or if somebody was slandered, also in such situation a person would be punished.

So, Islam takes the honor of a person very seriously and it's protected and this soldier, he received justice from Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه

even though it was relating to his own leader, Amr bin Aas رضي الله عنه.

Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) and we find that all of these Wulaa(ولآه) are great Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

But people can make mistakes and it also shows that no one was above the law.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would treat everyone equally, he could have found justification to say that the Sahabah(صحابه) are above the law

and they should be treated different than everybody else.

Because you people, you became Muslim through them and you owe it to them.

Therefore, they should not be treated equally as you, you owe it to them.

It is a favor that they have done to you.

They have sacrificed their lives and their wealth for your sake, to bring religion to you.

But that's not what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did.

A new Muslim who just became Muslim can come in and seek justice against a Sahabi(صحابي) who was a Muslim from day one.

Not only that a non Muslim can come in and go to court like we talked about the case when a JEW was sitting in court with Ali Ibn Talib رضي الله عنه

and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he ruled for the JEW against Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب).

Abdullah Ibn Umar  رضي الله عنه, he said; We were accompanying my father, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) we were riding our camels.

When my father spotted someone who was running towards us.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه said: This is someone who wants to talk to us.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) stopped.

And this man came and as soon as he saw Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, he started crying, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him, what's the matter?

The Man said; I drank alcohol and your Waali(وآلي), Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) flogged me.

But then he humiliated me, by driving me around town exposing me to everyone.

And he told everyone not to eat with me, not to sit with me, not to talk to me.

So, everyone boycotted me, and I was so depressed, I was thinking about assassinating Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) or coming to you and asking you to relocate me to another town

where I wouldn't be known.

Or I was thinking about going away from the land of a Islam to land of Kuffr(كفر).

When Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه heard that he started crying.

He said, I would rather sacrifice this, and this, then have you go to the land of disbelief.

And then he wrote a letter to Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) and he said; If you have drove him around the people to expose him and humiliate him,

and you have punished him in public, than I want you to sit down in public and be punished.

and if you did that in private, than I would want you to be punished in private.

And then he told Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) and if you want to know how serious I am about that, try doing what you've done again, and you would see what my response would be.

He then gave this man some clothes and 200 Dirham and he told him to go back.

So, brothers and sisters, Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, he was strict in his rule.

But he had so much mercy in his heart towards the sinners.

This man he drank alcohol.

He should have been flogged and that was it.

Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) carried the punishment further and drove him around exposing him and humiliating him in front of everyone, asking the people to boycott him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not want the punishment to go beyond the punishment of Sharia(شريعة) and Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه told the man

if you drank alcohol, people in the time of Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) used to drink it.

You're not the only person to drink alcohol people in Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) used to drink it, you've been punished, that's the end of the story.

The punishment should not carry further than that.

So, when a person commits a sin the punishment is Sharia(شريعة) should be implemented and that's it.

When a man in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ committed adultery, he was stoned to death.

After they stoned him and he was dead.

Some of the Sahabah(صحابه) said; This man could not stay quiet and conceal his sin and he went and talked about it, until he was stoned like a dog.

Rasool Allah ﷺ heard that comment and stayed quiet.

But then he came across a dead animal, decomposed body, foul smell, stench and he ﷺ told these men to go and eat from it.

They said: O Rasool Ullah can this be eaten.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: What you have said about your brother earlier is worse than eating from this dead body.

In the name of Allah, the man that you talked about has made a Toba(توبة), if it was distributed on the people of Madina, it would be sufficient for them.

And he's now swimming in the rivers of paradise.

He has made a Toba(توبة) he was punished and now he is in Jannah(جنة) and Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ forgave him just because he committed adultery, it does not give you a free allowance to say whatever you want against that person,

he was punished in Shariah(شرية), that was it.!

Another man, he was a man with very loud voice.

So, his voice was helpful in war.

Because of his loud voice, he could rally the army.

And he was also very good in fighting.

He came to Abu Musa(أبوموسى) to claim his portion of the Ghanimah(غنيمه), the spoils of war, the booty.

Abu Musa(أبوموسى) gave him part of it.

He didn't give him the whole thing.

The man said: I don't want it, either give me all of it or nothing.

Abu Musa(أبوموسى) was angry by the way the man handled this.

So, he flogged him.

So, this man went to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and also Abu Musa(أبوموسى) shaved his head.

So, the man gathered collected all of his hair.

By the way, shaving the head was a punishment in those days, it was a sign of humiliation.

Shaving the head was a sign of humiliation, it's not stylish.

People only used to shave their heads in Hajj(حَجْ) or Umrah(عمرة) or if they were punished.

It was not Sunnah(سنة) to shave their head in those days.

So, this man his head was shaved as a punishment, he collected this hair and he went to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) and he came in to see Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب)

and he threw the hair on the chest of Umar رضي الله عنه and he said; If it wasn't for Allah and Hellfire.

Meaning if, it wasn't for Allah and my fear of Hellfire, I would have done so and so.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him, what happened?

So, the man said: I came to claim my share of the booty.

Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) refused to give it to me and then when I argued with him, he lashed me.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه had Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري), come to him, and he gave the whip to this man and told him, take revenge for what he has done against you.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), these were not men of hatred and evil hearts they just wanted justice.

So, when he received justice when it was it his hands.

He told Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) go! I have forgiven you for the sake of Allah.

Same thing that happened with Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) happens here again.

But they wanted to make a point.

They wanted to prove that we are going to get justice and we are going to forgive when we have the capability of forgiving.

So, it makes a difference when you forgive and you're able to forgive.

And when you think that you're forgiving when really you only forgiving because there's nothing else you could do.

There's a difference between both situations.

You get the Ajar(أجر) of forgiving when you are in a position of strength and you are able to take revenge and then you forgive that is the forgiveness in which you are rewarded

but when you're the underdog, the weaker one and then you say, no I forgave him for the sake of Allah and trying to claim credit for it, to justify your weakness that's something else.

So, over here he had a whip in his hand and he could have disciplined Abu Musa Al Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري), but he told him: I forgive you for the sake of Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

Go you are free!

Saeed Ibn Aamir(سعيدإبن عامر), one of the Zuhaad(زهاد) of the Sahabah(صحابه), he was appointed over HIMS(حمص) in Syria.

When Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه met with the delegation of Syria, or the people of Syria from HIMS he asked them about Saeed Ibn Aamir(سعيدإبن عامر),

How is he?

They said: We have no complaints against him except for four things.

Number 1) He shows up to work late.

Number 2) We would never see him at night, we might have an emergency need, we would knock on his door they didn't really have doors in those days, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) we'll talk about that.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) banned his governors from having doors.

So, they will come and call them actually, from their name.

He would never come out at night.

Number 3) One day per week, he would disappear, we have no idea where he goes.

Number 4) Sometimes he would be sitting in court and he would just fall unconscious, he would just drop.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was worried because his Farasah(فراسہ), his intuition about Saeed Ibn Aamir(سعيدإبن عامر), was that he was one of the best.

So, he was very concerned when he heard these accusations.

In fact, he said when he heard the first one, he shows up late to work, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; This is a great fatal mistake.

How come he's going to work late.?

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him; to come and to face his accusers in court.

So, he asked them first what complaints do you have?

They said: Number one, he shows up late to work.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Answer, respond!

Saeed(سعيد) said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), Please forgive me!.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You must answer.

He said: I don't like to but I will.

The reason why I come out late is because I don't have a servant to take care of my needs.

So, I have to cook my own breakfast and when it's done.

"He has to prepare the dough and then bake it and cook it and that's why I come out late".

I have to cook my meal by myself.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: What is the second count.

They said: Number two, he would never come out at night.

Answer Saeed(سعيد); Saeed(سعيد) Said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), I have devoted my day for them and I have devoted night for Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ.

They get half of my 24 hours and the other half goes to Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ, I have to pray, I have to recite Qur'an, I have to make Zikr(زكر).

The third count.

He doesn't show up one day per week, he disappears.

He said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) because I don't have a servant and I only have one set of clothes, I go out to wash my clothes and then I have to wait until they are dry and then I go back.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: What about the forth count.

They said: He would sometimes fall unconscious, in court.

He said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), when I was young and a Mushrik(مشرك) in Makkah.

I witnessed the execution of Khubaib Al Ansari(خبيب ألأنصاري).

Khubaib Al Ansari(خبيب ألأنصاري) was one of the companions  of Rasool Allah ﷺ from Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار).

He was captured by the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and they took him to Makkah and they executed him.

Saeed Ibn Aamir(سعيدإبن عامر) witnessed the execution.

Saeed(سعيد) Said: They were cutting off the flesh from the body of Khubaib(خبيب).

They were cutting it off, to make him suffer and die a slow death.

And then they crucified him and they asked him?.

They said: Khubaib(خبيب) would you rather have Rasool Allah ﷺ in your place?

Khubaib(خبيب) said: I would not want to be with my family with my kids in the comfort and security of my house.

And have Rasool Allah ﷺ hit with a thorn.

Saeed(سعيد) said: When I remembered that day, when he was executed, and I did nothing to help him.

When I remembered that I feel that Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will never forgive me.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) that was done when he was a Mushrik(مشرك) that happened when he was not held accountable for what he was doing that was before Islam.

Nevertheless, he was so hurt and affected by what he saw, and the fact that he did nothing to help Khubaib(خبيب) not because it's his brother, and he wasn't a Muslim yet.

But as a human being, who has a dignity and believes in rights for others.

I should have done something on that day to help Khubaib Al-Ansari(خبيب ألأنصاري).

I kind of wonder how, they have such high sensitivity.

And then when you compare it to the Muslims today, when we see in front of our eyes and in our own locality, we're not talking about Muslims and faraway lands.

Muslims in our own locality could be abused, could be arrested, could be slandered and we do nothing about it, we don't speak about it, we don't act to prevent it.

We just sit down, duck down as if that will protect us.

Brothers or sisters Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ holds us accountable as an Ummah(امة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: The example of this Ummah(امة) is like a body, if one part of the body is injured, the whole body would feel the suffering and pain.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: The entire body would feel fever and loss of sleep.

Do you lose any sleep over your brothers?

Do you feel any pain when they are harmed?

If the answer is no, then you need to question your Eeman(ايمان).

If you don't feel anything, then you need to ask yourself a question.

Are you really a member of the Ummah(امة) of Muhammad ﷺ?

If you are only concerned with your own personal safety and the safety of your direct relatives your family, that is not the Islam that the Sahaba رضي الله عنهم believed in.

Saeed Ibn Aamir(سعيدإبن عامر) used to get these flashbacks and he would fall down unconscious because he witnessed the execution of Khubaib(خبيب) but he did nothing

and now our brothers are falling down, one after another and some Muslims are in fact not only are they doing nothing.

When that happens they're so terrified and afraid.

They do less then, they what they were doing before as if that's going to protect them and save them.

That won't because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; If you forsake a Muslim brother when he is in need of help Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ will forsake you when you are in need of help.

It's going to come back to you and you have to pay for it.

If you forsake a Muslim brother when he is in need of help and you have ability to help him.

Then when you face trouble, it's going to get to you.

So, if you want to protect yourself, you need to do something to protect the Muslim brother that goes down before you.

That's the only way in which you could protect your own self we're not now talking about helping them.

Your help your own self.

Do it for the sake of yourself and your family.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه would discipline, his Wulaa(ولآه), he would punish them.

He sent one of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) to be a governor, in Al-Heira(ألحيرة).

So, he arrives in Al-Heira(ألحيرة) and he was invited to the house of the chief of Al-Heira(ألحيرة), the tribal leader of Al-Heira(ألحيرة), very noble, well known man in his town.

The Ansari(أنصاري) starts joking and after he finished his food, you know, playing around.

He called the host and he wipes his hands on beard of his host.

He was joking, playing around, He wasn't serious.

This man went to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and he said; I have served Kisra(كسرى) and Qaiser(قيصر), the Roman emperor and the Persian Emperor,

but I have never been humiliated, like, I've been humiliated by your governor.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: What did he do?

He said: He came to my house, and after I feed him, I served him he wipes his hands on my beard.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) calls the Ansari(أنصاري) and said; If it wasn't going to be Sunnah(سنة) after me.

I would have plucked out every hair in your own beard.

But go away, you will never ever assume any responsibility in my life.

He fired him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would not tolerate making fun of others, even if it's a joke.

And that's a problem with joking, sometimes it gets overboard.

You know, you become very light headed when you laugh a lot, and you do things that you're not supposed to do, and you could insult your Muslim brother.

So, Islam doesn't say that you're not allowed to have fun.

Everything should be done in moderation, Israaf(اِسراف) is something that is not accepted in Islam, doing anything in excess is not proper.

And, some people, they have this nature of their fun loving, and they joke a lot.

And sometimes these people would be dealing with people who tend to be serious, and they take things seriously, and they could insult them.

When all what they meant was a joke.

Be careful, don't do that, because not everybody takes it the way you do.

And this man didn't take it as a joke, he took it as an insult and a very great insult.

He said: I've never been humiliated in my life like this.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would not allow his governors to get involved in things that are none of their business.

He once appointed someone to lead an army.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم) why he did that.

But this man, he gathered the soldiers, and he said; Tell me about every sin that you have committed.

So, every one of them was going down the list, the sins that they have committed.

Maybe that soldier wanted them to make Toba(توبة).

The leader wanted them to make Toba(توبة) or something.

Anyway, when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) heard that. He said; Woe to him, why is he doing that, this is none of his business to ask about the sins of others.

He is exposing sins which Allah has made private and he fired him and said: I will never appoint him to lead any army after this.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) heard that Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدإبن أبي وقاص) has fitted his house with a door.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he sends Muhammad Ibn Maslimma(محمدإبن مسلمه) specifically, to go to Al-Kufa(ألكوفه).

He told him you gather some wood and you go and burn the door of Saad(سعد).

They go, they evacuated the house and they burned the door.

The reason why Saad(سعد) had that door is because his house was close to the market and the market was very loud.

So, as an insulator he had that door that was it.

It wasn't to prevent the people from coming in.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) didn't want his governors, to have gate in compounds.

They need to be accessible.

The people need to feel that you're very close by, all what they have to do is, go next to your house and call you and you would definitely hear them and come out.

Imagine the house of the governor is without a door.

Just open, you just walk in, after you seek permission, given.

Mojasha Bin Masood(مجاشه بن مسعود) was appointed as a governor.

So, he relocated obviously, and his wife accompanied him.

So, when they reached to their new house.

The wife wanted to renovate the house.

You Know, usually sisters, they would move into a new house and they wanted to be according to their taste.

So, in those days, mud houses didn't have any paint.

What they would do is they would cover it with cloth because it's mud.

And you would be kneeling on the wall and you would have all of this dirt on your back, dust because it's a mad house.

So, what they would do is, they would cover it with cloth.

So, the wife of Mojasha(مجاشه) is now, remodeling the house and she's putting all of these pieces of cloth in there.

And it was very simple it's not like today you know, I want to have hardwood floor, but the kitchen, the title is to be white and you know everything is down to the exact details,

I mean I don't even know how to express it because I don't know the lingo for it.

There Masha Allah(ماشاء الله) Ya'ani(يعني), There could have very specific details and they would mention colors that I never heard in my life,

but it wasn't that sophisticated all what the wife of Mojasha(مجاشه) wanted is to have the wall covered with a piece of cloth.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) heard about that he sends a letter.

Mojasha(مجاشه) receives the letter when he was meeting with some men, and his face changed and they sensed that.
