They said: What happened?

He said: Come with me.

So, all of these men come with Mojasha(مجاشه) and they go to his house.

His wife comes out.

He said: Move out of my way.

You have put me in trouble and he gets her out of the house, and it tells the Men to tear down, every single piece of cloth, just tear it down.

And that's why many of the women in that era never wanted their husbands to be involved with the work with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

The wife of my Muaadh Ibn Jabal(معاذبن جبل), the wife of Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة), the wife of Mojasha(مجاشه) because of the restrictions that he would placed on them.

You could live an easier life, if you're not employed with the government of Umar bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, you would be better off going and doing business.

Also Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) sometimes would just drop in suddenly and visit his Wulaa(ولآه).

So, he would have somebody asked for permission and he would say; Do you permit me and the men with me, to come in because Umar(عُمَر) did not want his name to be mentioned.

He knows that they would do some last minute changes to the furniture.

So, they would seek permission, Me and the ones accompanying me and then suddenly they would find Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) inside their house.

So, he landed inside the house of Yazeed Ibn Abi Sufiaan(يزيدإبن أبي سفيان).

And he saw the walls covered with cloth, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) with his own hands, he is tearing those pieces of cloth in front of Yazeed(يزيد)

and telling him; This cloth which you are covering your walls with, could cover the naked bodies of many Muslims and save them from hot weather and cold weather.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would go as far as disciplining them physically with his famous stick Ad-Durra(ألدّره), he did that a couple of times

not only did he use a durra(درَّة) but once when he went to Ash-Sham(ألشام), Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة), Yazeed Ibn Abi Sufiaan(يزيدإبن أبي سفيان) and Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد)

they came to meet, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه and they had some nice clothes on.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) saw them he came down from this camel.

Picked up some rocks and started throwing at them, pelting Yazeed(يزيد), Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and Khalid(خالد) imagine throwing rocks at them.

And then he said; How fast have you changed your ways?

How dare you meet me with these clothes?

You only knew wealth two years ago.

In the name of Allah. If you did this after 200 years from now, I wouldn't have accepted it.

He is telling them two years ago, you are poor.

And now you tasted wealth and you already changed within two years.

Even if you are wealthy for 200 years, I wouldn't have allowed this change to show on you.

You're working with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), you're gonna have to carry on with the old ways, even if it's going to last for 200 years.

He reduced the status of one of his governors from being a governor, to being a shepherd Ayaaz Bin Ghanam(أياز بن غنم), he appointed him as a governor.

So, Ayaaz(أياز) he built a new house and he built himself a bath and he also had a special group which he would spend his night with and talk with exclusive group.

And this was not accessible for the rest of the people, special group that are close to the Ameer(أمير).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) call him to Madina, he comes in, he brings 300 sheep.

He gives it to him and he gives him a wool rough Thaub(ثوب), he tells him wear this.

And then he tells him: Take these goats or sheep.

So, he would walk away and when he is far from Umar(عُمَر), Umar(عُمَر) would tell him: Come back, come back.

And he's next to Umar(عُمَر), go away. You go away, come back.

And you would have him go back and forth with the 300 sheep until, he started sweating.

And then he said: Go and take them out to the pasture land and then come back.

He would go out to the pasture land and come back, go and water them and he would have him go back and forth for two months.

After two months, he told him: Do you still want a bath in your house?

Do you still want to have an exclusive group around you?

He said: No Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), that's it, I don't want that anymore.

Toba(توبة)! I repent to Allah.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), this disciplining made Ayaaz Bin Ghanam(أياز بن غنم) one of the best governors of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

He would ask them to split their wealth in half, after they leave their job.

We said earlier that he would take the difference.

Over here it's contradicting narration.

It says that for example, they started, so he would hold an account for them before they assume the job.

Let's say they had 1000 Dinar(دينار).

After he removes them from the job.

Let's say they had 2000 Dinar(دينار).

So, the difference is a 1000 Dinar(دينار).

They made a 1000 Dinar(دينار) within that period.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would ask them to split it in half.

Allah Ho Alam(ألله أعلم) which narration is stronger.

But I'm mentioning to you both.

That's what he did with Khalid Ibn Waleed رضي الله عنه.

Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) said: He split everything in half, even my shoes.

He would take one pair, he would take one and we give me one.

He would reprimand them verbally and he would write letters to them.

When he went to meet with Muawiya Bin Abi Sufiyan(معاويه بن أبي سفيان).

Muawiya(معاويه) came to meet him in an entourage.

Muawiya(معاويه) is the new governor in Syria and he comes to meet Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه and he is surrounded by guards.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was riding his camel.

Muawiya(معاويه) came down out of respect to greet the Khalifah(خليفه).

The Khalifah(خليفه) ignores him and he is walking away on his camel and Muawiya(معاويه) is now running on foot after the Khalifah(خليفه), trying to get his attention, and Muawiya(معاويه) was a heavy man.

So, he was catching his breath, he was gasping and Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه is ignoring him.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدالرحمن إبن عوف) felt pity for Muawiya(معاويه).

He said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), He is exhausted.

Please talk to him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) turns around and said; Who does this entourage belong to?

He said: It belongs to me.

He said: It belongs to you and in addition to that, I hear that you have an officer who stands between you and men.

When people want to meet you?

You had a secretary, now Muawiya(معاويه) had a secretary, if you want to meet Muawiya(معاويه) you have to come through his secretary.

Muawiya(معاويه) said: Yes.

He said: Woe to you. Why did you do that?

Muawiya(معاويه) said: O Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) in this land of ours, there are plenty of spies planted by our enemy.

If they see us moving around without heavy security.

They might take advantage of that and attack us and the reason, why I have a secretary is because I don't want the people to take advantage of us.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه said: O Muawiya(معاويه), whenever, I ask you about something you have a justification for it.

If what you're saying is true.

That is very intelligent of you and if what you're saying is a lie, that's a very clever lie.

I do not approve or disapprove what you're doing.

He left it at that.

because Muawiya(معاويه) told him after he mentioned his justification is he said; And after that I am only your servant.

If you tell me to go on with it, I would, - if you tell me to stop, I would.

So, Umar(عُمَر) said: You know how to get out of trouble.

Tayeb(طيب) In Sha Allah Ho Ta'ala(إن شاء الله تعالى) tomorrow night, we will either move on to the section on the Ghazawaat(غزوات) , the battles,

or we will jump ahead and talk about the death of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and then talk about the battles, after that.

So, we're done with the section relating to the Wulaa(وُلأء) of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً إِنَّا لدَّلِيْلَ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَ كُمْ مِنَّ الشَّرْ،نَحُوْضَاكُمْ فِيْ هَذَالْاَمْرِ، وَإِنِ سّتَعَدَّلَكُمْ مَنِ سّتَعَدُّوْ وَإَيْمُالله

لَا يَمْنَعَنِيْ ذَالِكَ مِنَ النَّظَرِ فِيْ مَا لَدَيْكُمْ وَإِنْ نَظَرُبِكُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَلّعَمَلْ بِسِّرْمِنْ شَائْنِهِمْ يَوْمَ إِذٍ

أَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ نَشَدْتَّنَا فَإِنَّه’ لَا يَقْسِمُ بِسَّوِيَّا، وَلَا يَعْدِلُوْ فِيْ الرَّيْعَه، وَلَا يَغْضُوْفِيْ السَّرِيْعَهَ أَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ قَالَهَا كَذِبًا،

وَرِيَاعًا، وَسُمْعَةً،فَأَعْمِيْ بَصَرَ، وَأَكْثِرْعِيَالَ،وَعَرِّضْه’‘ لِمُذِّلَّآتِلْفِتَنْْ اَللَّهُمَّ أَرِّضْهُمْ لِجَهْدِالّبَلَى إِنِّيْ لَاَوَّلْ رَجُلْ أَحْرَقَ دَمًّا مِنْ الَّمُشْرِكِيْنَ

إِرْمِيْ سَعْد فِدَاكَ أَبِيْ وَأُمِّيْ أَصَابَتْنِيْ دَعْوَةٌ الرَّجُلٌ المُبَارَكْ إِنَّ الْحَسَانَاتْ يُذْهِبْنَى السَّيِّئَاتْ Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) comes in.

"إِنَّهَاالّعَظِيْمَهْ" يا سعيد أجب تَدَاعَلَه’ سَائِرِلّجَسَدِ بِسَّائِرِوَلْهُمَّةْ "لِيْ وَلِمَنْ مَعِيْ" مَا أَسْرَأَ مَا رَجَعْتُمْ أَنْ رَّيْكُمْ،إِيَّايَ تَسْتَقْبِلُوْنَ فِيْ هَذَا ذِّي

وَإِنَّمَا شَبِئْتُمْ مُنْزُ سَنَتَيْنَ وَبِاللهِ وَلَوْ فَعَلْتُمْ هَذَا عَلَى رَئْسِلْ مِئَتَيْنِ لَسْتَبْدِلْ بِكُمْ غَيْرَكُمْ "أَتَعَبْتَ الرَّجُلْ"

parts.english:
We talked about the, attention Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه  gave to a Ibadaat(عبادات), we talked about the importance he gave to Salaat(صلاة)

and we missed the part on Taraweh(تراويح), we start with that.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه came into the Masjid(مسجد) in Ramadan(رمضان), and he found them scattered around the Masjid(مسجد).

This man is praying on his own, this man is leading a Jama'at(جماعة) of  three or four or five.

This one is leading a Jama'at(جماعة) of 10, this one is alone, all over the Masjid(مسجد).

And there Qira'at(قرأة ) was confusing each other.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه said: "I will combine them all, behind one Imam(اِمَام)." Rather than have everyone do their own thing, let them all pray together.

So, he appointed Obaeye Bin Ka'abرضي الله عنه, the scholar of Qur'an, the Sahabi(صحابي) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, from the people of Madina to lead Salaat-Ut-Taraweeh(صلاة التراويح).

He came the next day and he saw the Muslims praying in Jama'at(جماعة) in cohesion, so he said; This is a good Bid'ah( بدعة), this is a good Bid'ah( بدعة).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was happy to see that the Muslims are now praying together rather than the disorganized way, it was happening before in the Masjid(مسجد)

and this quote by Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه , is mentioned frequently and it's always brought up as an evidence to support, whenever someone or somebody would do something new in religion.

So, is it truly a Bid'ah( بدعة)?

Did Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) really innovate?

Or he was speaking in a figurative sense, that this is something good that's what he meant.

Well let's look at the history of Salah-At-Taraweeh(صلاة التراويح).

Is Salah-At-Taraweeh(صلاة التراويح) something that was started by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) or did it exist before?

In the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ some would pray at home and some would pray in the Masjid(مسجد).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ came into the Masjid(مسجد) in Ramadan(رمضان) and he started praying.

The Sahabah(صحابه) who were there obviously joined Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, it was a Jama'at(جماعة) of Salah-At-Taraweeh(صلاة التراويح), in the Masjid(مسجد), the next day more people poured in.

The third day more people, the fourth day the Masjid(مسجد) was packed.

Rasool Allah ﷺ on the fifth day didn't show up.

And then he told the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم and this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

I did not want this to become a mandatory Salah(صلاة) on you.

What will happen, if Rasool Allah ﷺ keeps praying it in the Masjid(مسجد) as a Jama'at(جماعة) and Sahabah(صحابه) are joining him all the time?

It would turn into something that is mandatory and Rasool Allah ﷺ wants Taraweeh(التراويح) to remain as a voluntary act.

So, he said that's why I stopped leading the Salah(صلاة) in the Masjid(مسجد) not because leading it in Jama'ah(جماعة) was wrong but because I don't want it to become mandatory on you.

Therefore, Salah-At-Taraweeh(صلاة التراويح) existed in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, what Umar(عُمَر) did was, revived something that was already there.

He just revived, something that was already done by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Because even in the time Umar(عُمَر) Jama'aat(جماعات) were happening but there were more than one Jama'ah(جماعة), they were scattered around.

So, he wanted to bring them, so basically what Umar(عُمَر) did was combined the Jama'aat(جماعات) into one Jama'ah(جماعة), that's all.

So, this cannot be used as evidence that you're allowed to invent things in Sharia(شريعة) but you are allowed to improve the way things are happening,

within the boundaries of the Sharia(شريعة), not to change anything in Shariah(شريعة).

But to improve the way, you practice it.

For example, we are praying in our Masajid(مساجد) Salaat-Ul-Jama'at(صلاة جماعة).

All right, we added an improvement to that and that's now we're using loudspeakers something that they didn't use in the old days, we have the Mics, we have the speakers,

it is to improve our Salah(صلاة) of Jama'at(جماعة) to make it easier to make it more beneficial for the people.

We didn't really change anything in the format of the Salah(صلاة) itself.

We just added something to it that is not actually a part of the Ibadah(عبادة) and that is something that is absolutely legal and allowed.

You can call it an innovation, but it's not an innovation in religion.

So, I hope that the concept is clear.

We'll move on to the next section, and that is the economic crisis that occurred during the time of  Umar Bin  Khattab رضي الله عنه .

And this is called Aam-Er-Ramadah(عام الرمادة), the year of the Ramadah(الرمادة), the Ashes.

And this was the 18th year of Hijrah(هجرة), a few years into the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of  Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, the sky withheld its rain, and the Arabian Peninsula sunk into a famine.

They were dependent on the scars rain that they receive.

And they didn't receive anything that year.

So, it was said that wild beasts were so hungry they started attacking humans, the cattle that the Arabs or the tribes owned were dying.

They would say a man would have this goat and it is so skinny, so he would slaughter it, and would barely be able to eat it, because it's so disgusting.

And the Bedouins started coming in flocks to Madina to come to Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه asking him for help,

and Umar(عُمَر) has nothing to give them.

So, you have these refugees in Madina, thousands of them, the count was 60,000, Bedouins who flocked to Madina.

And when we say 60,000 in those days, that's a huge number.

Keep in mind that the population of the earth at that time was very low.

Possibly didn't reached the billion mark yet.

So, the population was very scars.

So, you have 60,000 in those days, it means a lot, in today's terms.

And all of these refugees were coming to Madina thinking that the Khalifah(خليفه) has a solution for them.

And the Khalifah(خليفه) was as hungry as they are… Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه was having this meal with a Bedouin.

He had for him crushed bread in butter.

So, he is eating with this Bedouin.

So, the Bedouin would take the piece of bread and he would pass it on the rim of the plate, to wipe all of the butter that is stuck to the plate

and he would eat.

He would take the next piece of bread and pass it along the rim to absorb all of the butter in there and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is watching him.

And then he said: It seems that you haven't had any butter for some time.

The man said: Yes, Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين), I never had butter or oil.

And I never saw anybody eat it for a very, very long time.

He was so hungry…. and, and butter was part of their diet, see animal shortening, or oil that comes from vegetable or vegetable sources, such as

olives, or other seed, that they would grind, Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم) what type of oil that they would have in that time.

But definitely, they had olive oil, which was an integral part of their diet because of poverty and because the amount that they would eat was so low, your body needs fat, you know, now

because we eat so much, everybody tells us that fat is not good for you, fat is not good for you, you're not supposed to have any fat.

However, you're supposed to have about 20% fat in your diet.

That's the right amount of fat that you should have in your diet.

The thing is, because we're having so much of it, the physicians are telling us to stay away from it.

In those days, because they were having so less of it, they had to eat more their bodies needed that fat because you have to have fat in your body.

So, for them olive oil and fat was an important part of their diet.

This man is saying that I haven't seen fat or oil in a very, very long time.

When Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه saw that, he made an oath that he is not going to taste meat, butter.

He's not gonna taste it, until the Ummah(امة) eats it and the historian say; Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, stuck to his word and fulfilled his oath.

And until he made sure that the Ummah(امة) are having sufficient amount of food that is when he started eating it again.

He used to say; How can I be concerned with my people, if I don't go through what they're going, I need to feel their pain, I need to feel their suffering.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) stopped the application of the punishment of stealing.

So, no hands were amputated during that year.

Some people say that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) what he has done, is he stopped applying the Hadd(حدّ).

It wasn't really that he stopped applying it.

What happened was, there was never a case, where it qualified for punishment because Rasool Allah ﷺ says, and this Hadith(حديث) is in Musnad Abdur-Razzaq(مسند عبدالرزاق)

You do not amputate when there is famine, You do not apply the Hadd(حدّ) of As-Sarqah(السرقة), of stealing when there is famine.

If people are stealing to live their hand are not amputated.

The hands of burglar is amputated when they can live, but they are still stealing.

But if somebody is, stealing for the sole purpose of just surviving, then in this situation, even though it is Haram(حرام), but the Hadd(حدّ) of amputation is not applied.

And that is what happened during the time Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه.
