Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) called the first time, no response second time, no response third time, no response, he left.

Later on, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) came out and he said, I thought I heard, the calls of Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) They said: Yes! He was here but he left.

He said: Why did he leave?

They said: Because you are supposed to take permission three times, if you don't hear back you leave, that's Sunnah(سنة), you knock three times or call three times no response you leave.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Did he claimed that Rasool Allah ﷺ said that?

They said: Yes! He said: Bring him in, they brought Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري), He said: What did you say?

He said: Rasool Allah ﷺ said: You ask permission three times otherwise you leave, he said: You're going to bring me a witness on that.

So he's not taking his word for it he said: You're going to bring me a witness for that, Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) went to Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار)

who were in a gathering and his face was pale.

They said: What happened?

He told them this story, Obaiye Ibn Ka'ab(أبئي ابن كعب ) said: Let the youngest among us go with you.

Meaning that, this is common knowledge that everybody knows about it, everyone in here knows about it.

Let the youngest among us go and give Shahadah(شهادة) about that, I mean everybody knows about it.

So Abu Saeed Al-Khudri(ابوسعيد الخدري) said: They appointed me to go, since I was youngest, so I went to Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألأشعري) and I said;

Yes! That's what, I heard that Hadith(حديث) from Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Umar(عُمَر) said: You heard that, he said: Yes! I did.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: And I didn't know about it?

Yes! Because I was busy doing business in the market place.

And what kept me from hearing these Ahadith(احاديث) is trade "business".

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) blamed himself for not knowing this, even though everybody else knew it.

But this is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم) and also in a Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ).

But this shows you something that, the Ahadith(احاديث) were not all known by all of the Sahabah(صحابه), this Sahabi(صحابي) would know some Ahadith(احاديث), another Sahabi(صحابي) would know some Ahadith(احاديث).

So, their knowledge complements each other.

Number two, it shows you that the way of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was strict in the narration of Hadith(حديث).

He didn't want people narrating a Hadith(حديث) unless there's a confirmation, there's a witness because you could forget, you can make a mistake,

you think that it was said, when it wasn't.

That's the nature of the human mind.

I mean Adam عليه السّلام, you know the story between him and Dawood(داؤد), Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Adam عليه السّلام was presented with his children, all of them.

Adam عليه السّلام saw all of his children and they had light on them, according to their righteousness, so he saw one of his children and he liked him, he said: Who is he?

They said: This is Nabi Ullah(نبي الله) Dawood(داؤد)!

Now all of these are his children.

So, they said, this is Nabi Ullah(نبي الله) Dawood(داؤد), Adam عليه السّلام said: How long will Dawood(داؤد) live?

They said: He's gonna live 60 years.

Adam عليه السّلام said: Why don't you give him 40 years from my life.

So, that he would have hundred years to live.

So, they said: It's Maktoob(مكتبوب), It's written that you are giving him 40 years of your life.

Tayyeb(طيب), when the angel of death came to Adam عليه السّلام claiming his Soul.

Adam عليه السّلام said: No! It's not my time yet, I still have 40 years in my life because he was told that he's going to live for this time he gave 40 years to Dawood(داؤد).

So, the angel of death was 40 years early.

He said: No! I didn't say that.

I didn't give Dawood(داؤد) anything.

The angel said: Yes! You did.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And this Hadith(حديث) is Sahih(صحيح).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said:  Adam(آدم) Forgot, and that's why his children forget.

And Adam(آدم) refused and that's why his children of refuse.

He refused to accept the fact that he has actually, he did actually give Dawood 40 years of his life.

He refused to accept that.

Why? Because he forgot.

And that's the nature in us, we forget, you could forget.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was asking the Sahabah(صحابه): what should one do, when the lose the major Taharah(طهارة) and there's no water around?

You know, it's not the Wadhoo(وضؤ) that you lost, you lost the major Taharah(طهارة).

Ammar Bin Yasir(عماربن ياسر) said: You, make Tayammum(تيمم).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Where did you get that from?

Ammar Bin Yasir(عماربن ياسر) Said: You forgot when me and you were traveling together?

And I lost my Taharah(طهارة).

And there was no water, so I rolled my body in the dirt like an animal would.

And then we went back to Rasool Allah ﷺ me and you, and we asked him about it.

He said: It was enough and sufficient for you to make Tayammum(تيمم).

Do you remember that? Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: No! I forgot about it.

This was a Hadith(حديث) that was mentioned in front of Umar(عُمَر) and he forgot about it.

Ammar Bin Yasir(عماربن ياسر) Said: Well, if you don't want me to mention this Hadith(حديث), I won't mention it.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: No! Go ahead and mention it.

But after there was a witness to say that, this actually happened.

Therefore brothers, we learn from this, we should be careful in narrating Ahadith(احاديث) and we should make sure that, the Ahadith(احاديث) that we're following are authentic,

you know, we don't want to be fooled by following Ahadith(احاديث) that Rasool Allah ﷺ did not say.

I mean, why should I do something, when Rasool Allah ﷺ did not tell me to do it and I'm wasting my time doing something that is not expected from me.

I could use that time wisely by doing something that Allah wants me to do.

Don't think that you're a good Muslim by following everything you hear.

You need to make sure that the information that you're following is verified and true, he said; He said: Learn before you're put in positions of leadership

because then your pride will prevent you from learning.

So, you will live the rest of your life in a state of ignorance.

Learn when you're young, learn when you're young, don't wait.

because the older you become, the more senior you become, the more you are seen in a high level and you are seen as a leader and when you are seen as a leader,

you wouldn't go and sit under the knees of the scholars to learn, and you wouldn't go around asking the people who are younger than you about knowledge

that's not the case with everyone many people are humbled throughout their life and that's how we should be.

But that sometimes is a disease that could come to the heart, and then Umar said: Then you will live the rest of your life in the state of ignorance.

Learn when you're young.

Plus learning when you're young is better for you because that's when you have a stronger memory and memory is very important when it comes to Islamic knowledge

because it depends on memorization. He also said: Islam will be destroyed by a mistake of a scholar, by the arguments from Qur'an, by a Munafiq(منافق)

and by the misguided Imam(اِمَام)s.

Why do these destroy Islam because people follow their words, a scholar who makes a mistake.

When Imam Ahmad Bin Humbal(إمام أحمد بن حنبل), was asked to say that Quran was created.

That was the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) that was the Bid'ah(بدعة) of Al-Moa Tazillah(معتزله).

They claim that Quran is not the word of Allah, but it's created.

But that was a very dangerous Bid'ah(بدعة).

Ahmad Bin Humbal رضي الله عنه stood firm and he refused to give in.

In his prison cell, one of the scholars came to him and said; You are coerced to say that, you are being tortured.

So, you are allowed to speak out publicly, even if you don't believe in it.

Because you are under a state of coercion under duress.

So, you can say that it's created.

Ahmad Bin Humbal(أحمد بن حنبل) pulls the man and he opens the window and he said: Do you see all of these people, the people of Baghdad(بغداد)? He said: Yes.

He said: If I say that, they will say it too.

People take my word, the people of Baghdad(بغداد) follow what I say.

Not just the people Baghdad(بغداد), but the people of the Muslim world.

If I say it, they will all accept it from me and I know that it's false but they won't, so he refused to give in.

So, a mistake of a scholar can mislead an Ummah(امة) and A Munafiq(منافق) who has knowledge of Quran and he's arguing with you using Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, when he's a Munafiq(منافق),

that's very dangerous because he's using the evidence against you and he's using Qur'an, so you accept that argument but he's twisting it.

He is playing around with it, He is playing around with the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an.

Munafiq Alaiem Bil Lisaaan(منافق عليهم بلسان) , A Munafiq(منافق) who has a  sweet tongue and Aaemma Muzilloon(آئمَّه مُزلون), the Imam(اِمَام) is a leader,

Muzilloon(مُزلون) are the ones who deceive others, so they are Imam(اِمَام)s who deceive the Ummah(امة).

And Imam(اِمَام) here could mean a political leader or a religious leader but maybe it's talking about political leaders because the Ulema(علماء) are mentioned in the beginning of the statements,

so we would assume that Aimma(آئمه) here is talking about the political leaders, who deceive others.

So, it's the Imam(اِمَام)s and the Ulema(علماء) who could deceive others and they are also the ones who benefit the most, so a person in that position could either benefit a lot or harm a lot.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اِتَّقِى اللهَ وَ اَحْسَنِ اِلَى هَذِا اصَّبِيْحََ الله اتقى, يا عمر اِتَّقِى اللهَ كَمْ قَتَلْتَ مِنْ اَطْفَالِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ تَطَاوَلَ هَذَالَّيْلَ تَسْرِيْ كَوَاكِبْه

وَأَرَّقَنِيْ أَلَّا ضَجِيْحٌ أُلَاعِبُه وَلَكِنَنِيْ أَخْشَى رَقِيْبًأ مُوْكَلًا بِأَنْفُسِنَا لَا يَفْتُرْ اَلدَّهَرْ كَاتِبُه "يرحمك الله"

هَلْ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ إِلَى خَمْرٍ فَأَشْرَبُهَا هَلْ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ إِلَى نَصَرْ بِنْ حَجَّاجِ "ألسلام عليكم، يا اهل الضوء" يَتَوَلَّى اَمْرَنَا ثُمَّ يَتْرُكُنَا

وَيْحَكْ أَأَنْتَ تَحْمِلُ أَنِّيْ وِزْرِيْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةْ أَنْتَ  اَحَقّ بِهَذَا الْأَمَرْ مِنْ عمر بن خطاب لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا

هَلَّكِيْ فِيْ خَيْرٍسَاقَهَ اللهُ إِلَيْكِيْ هَلَّكِي فِيْ أَجَرْسَاقَهُ اللهَ إِلَيْكِ وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كُلَّ آيَةٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَا وَجَحَدُوا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; وَمَنْ يُبَدِّلْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ۝

وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ۝

والله مَا كُنْتُ لِأُطِيَعَه’ فِي الْأَلَنْ وَأَعْصِيْهِ فِي الْخَلَا لَا طَاعَةَ لِمَخْلُوْقٍ فِيْ مَعْصِيَةِالْخَالِقْ لي زوجه لَا زَوْجَتَلِيْ وَزَوَّجْنِيْ

أَلَّا اتَّقَيْتُمُ اللهَ فِيْ رِكَائِبِكُمْ هَذِه؟

أَلَّاخَلَّيْتُمْ عَنْهَا فَأَكَلَتْ مِنْ نَبَتِ الْأرْضَ؟

إِنِّيْ لَخَائِفٌ أَنْ أُسْأَلَ عَنْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةْ وَنُسِّيَ آدَمُ فَنُسِّيَتْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُ 'فَجَحَدَ آدَمُ ، فَجَحَدَتْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُ ، وَخَطِئَ آدَمُ فَخَطِئَتْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُ

تَفَكَّه’ قَبْلَ اَنْتَ سُوْدُوْفَتَمْنَعَكُمْ اَنَفَ مِنَّ التَّعَّلُّمْ فَتَعِيْشُوْجُهَالَه’ يَهْدِيْمُ الْإِسْلَامَ ذَلَّةُ عَالِمٍ وَجَدَالُ مُنَافِقٍ بِالْقُرْآنِ وَ آئِمَّهْ مُزِّلُوْنْ

وجدال منافق بالقرآن

parts.english:
We will start with, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) and how he would deal with innovations in religion, Al-Biddah(ألبدعة) and this is still relating to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) and the society.

Basically we'll spend a lot of time talking about the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) how he approaches the society and how he dealt with them.

And then after that we will talk about the Ghazawat(غزوات) that occurred in the time of Umar(عُمَر) and that would be the end of these sessions.

Towards the end of the sessions, we will talk about the Ghazawat(غزوات).

The people of Egypt went to Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص), their Governor.

He was appointed governor over them by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

So, they went to Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) and they said; This river, the Nile does not flow unless we sacrifice for it.

He said: Every year we have a young lady, we would go to her father and take her from him we give him back some money and we would put the best clothes on her and the best jewelry

and then we would throw her into the river.

These are traditions of Shirk(شرك) that existed in Egypt and they believed that it makes the river flow.

So, they sacrifice this poor woman for the river and it makes it flow.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) said: "Islam erases everything before it, and you are not allowed to practice such traditions as Muslims."

So, he issued a ban on such a practice.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) it was a Qadar(قدر) of Allah, a test, that the water level went down.

So, everybody started to saying, see because we didn’t sacrifice this woman, the river is not flowing.

And Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) insisted on this prevention and ban and it got so bad the water level went so low that, the people were about to move, they were about to evacuate.

Because you know the people in Egypt their lifeline is the Nile River.

Egypt doesn’t really receive sufficient rain for agriculture.

So, it is the lifeline for the people, that's how they live, it's water from the Nile river.

So, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) sends a letter to Ameer ul Mo'mineen(أمير المؤمنين), he said; This is the tradition that they had, and I banned it,

and I told them that it is in Islam, it is Haram(خرام), so Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) sends him a letter back.

He said: What you have done is the right thing and I am sending along with this letter a card, or piece of paper and I want you to throw it in the river.

In that card Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wrote: From the servant of Allah, the Ameer of Al-Mo'mineen(أمير المؤمنين), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) to the Nile of the people of Egypt.

He is writing the river a letter.

If you are running of your own accord, then stop running because we don’t need you anymore.

And if you are running because Allahعَزّوجَلّ is the one making you run and flow then we ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to make you flow.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) takes this card and he throws it into the Nile River, within one day the Nile River went up sixteen diraa(درعا), within one day.

Receiving a letter from Ameer ul Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين) it went up sixteen diraa(درعا).

Diraa(درعا) is about foot long, actually more than a foot long.

So, apparently, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wasn't only the Ameer of Momineen(أمير المؤمنين), he was also the Ameer(أمير) of the Rivers.

And this story was mentioned by Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) in Al-Bidaya Wan Nihayah(البداية ونهاية).

So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) stopped this evil tradition of sacrifice for the religion, this Shirk(شرك) in Allahعَزّوجَلّ, he made it Haram(حرام).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) when he kissed the black stone he said; I know that you are rock, that cannot harm or benefit and if it wasn’t for Rasool Allah ﷺ kissing you, I wouldn’t have done so.

At-Tabri(ألطبري) says; The reason why Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) made such a statement is because people were new to Islam and they were close to Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة).

So he wanted to make sure that people will not revert back to the habits of Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) when a rock or a stone is being kissed, so he wanted to make sure that they understand the reason, why he is doing that?

Ibn Hajar(إبن حجر), he comments on this because this statement of Umar(عُمَر) is in Bukhari(البخاري).

Ibn  Hajar(إبن حجر)  said: "And  this presents to us very important principle and that is the fact that we submit to Allahعَزّوجَلّ and we follow the way of Rasool Allah ﷺ, the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ,

even if we don’t understand the wisdom behind it." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is saying; You are a stone you don’t harm you don’t benefit

and the reason why I am kissing you is not because, I know why? I should be doing that it is because Rasool Allah ﷺ did that.

So, you do it and then you ask the questions later.

If you want to know the hikmah( حكمة) you are more than welcome to go and search for the hikmah( حكمة) but you need to do it even though you don’t know the wisdom behind it,

and that is the ultimate level of submission.

You submit to Allahعَزّوجَلّ even if something doesn't make a sense to you even if you don’t understand it, even if you don’t feel like it, even if you don’t like it,

you do it because Allah wants you do it, and because Rasool Allah ﷺ did it.

In fact, a lot of things are done in Hajj(حَجْ) are done without knowing the wisdom behind them and may be this is the reason why Hajj(حَجْ) is so special

because really Hajj(حَجْ) is the ultimate level of submitting to Allah.

You're doing things and you don’t know the hikmah( حكمة) behind them but you do them, because Rasool Allah ﷺ did them and Ibrahim عليه السّلام did before him.

Going around a building, seven times, why you are going around the Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه)?

You know now we might have these wonderful explanations that you go around in counter clock wise and that’s really the direction every planet revolves

it is counter clock wise which is true.

You would find that all of the movements in universe is counter clock wise, the only one, who got it wrong, is the one, who made the watch.

They made it clock wise.

While to be in harmony with the rest of the universe, it should be going counter clock wise.

And that shows you that the Fitrah(فطرة) is messed up even by the one who made the watch.

If it was a Muslim who it, they would have made it in the right direction.

But everything in the universe is going counter clock wise and that is the direction you go in Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) you go counter clock wise.

But how come you do it seven times?

And by the way, with this explanation, the Sahabah(صحابه) didn’t know it.

The Sahabah(صحابه) didn’t know that the planets go counter clock wise they did it they did it because Rasool Allah ﷺ did it.

How come it's seven times?

How come it's not ten or six?

How come seven?

You are running up and down Saffa wal Marwa(اَلصَّفَاوَلْامَروة)  just because Hajar عليها السّلام did it.

Why is Arafah(العرفة) the greatest day?

What is Arafah(العرفة), Arafah(العرفة) is a waste land.

It's an empty piece of land, destitude nothing grows there and that is the greatest day of Hajj(حَجْ), and we are just standing in land?

Over land, it's just like any other piece of land. No different.!

What's special about Mina(مناء), what's so special about Muzdalifah(مُذدلفه)?

Everything that you do in Hajj(حَجْ) you doing it why?

Just because Allah told me to do so, because Rasool Allah ﷺ did so.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was telling the Sahabah(صحابه).

Follow me in these rituals because you are following the way of your father Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), this is the inheritance that Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) left behind.

Kissing the black stone same thing, so what's the hikmah(حكمة) behind kissing the black stone?

It is submission, that's what it is about.

Submitting to Allahعَزّوجَلّ doing it, because Allah wants you to do so.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was very aware of the tendency of the humans to go astray and that’s why he was and that's why Islam is strict when it comes to following the right way.

And you know sometimes brothers would complain when they hear the word Bida'a( بدعة) and you are saying everything is Bida'a( بدعة), and that is Bida'a( بدعة),

and this is Bida'a( بدعة), no leave us alone.

You don’t have two hearts in your breast, you have one heart.

You can only focus on one thing at a time.

That’s why now you have pay fine of Thirty Pounds if you drive with your mobile phone, because you cannot concentrate on two things the same time.

Unless these two things are second nature to you.

So he said; UMAR IBN KHATTAB WAS A MAN OF Dua(دُعَا) It's narrated that when the news of the armies would be late, he would make Qunoot(قنوت).

And when the armies  would be late in coming back, he would make Qunoot(قنوت).

Qunoot(قنوت) is Dua(دُعَا).

He was very concerned, he was very concerned with the state of the Ummah(امة) especially the Ghazu(غزؤ) that concerned him a lot.

The Ghazu(غزؤ) and the Financial situation of the Muslims.

With all of this Khushu(خشوع) that Umar(عُمَر) had it is narrated that he once,  woke up to pray Salaat At-Tahajjud(صلاة التهجد) and he couldn’t have concentration in the Salah(صلاة).

So, he went to sleep, he couldn’t sleep.

And then he said; When I pray, I cannot pray and when I try to sleep, I cannot sleep.

So, they asked him why, He said: Because I am concerned about my people.

He is thinking so much about the Muslims, he couldn’t pray and he couldn’t sleep.

So, he was very concerned with the Ummah(امة).

We ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to give us leaders who are concerned, who have care for the Ummah(امة).

And the Ummah(امة) is now like a flock without a Sheppard, surrounded with wolves from every direction.

He used to pray to make Dua(دُعَا) for the Mujahideen(مجاهدين) in his Salah(صلاة) and he would make Dua(دُعَا) Al-Qunoot(قنوت) for that, and when he fought against the people of the Book

he would make a Dua(دُعَا) against the people of the Book he would say; O Allah, O Allah! Destroy the disbelievers, of the people of the Book.

And this is when he is fighting against the Roman Empire.

And he used to make Qunoot(قنوت) against them in Salah(صلاة) of Fard(فرض), in Fajr(فجر), Dhuhar(ظهر), Asr(عصر), Maghrib(مغرب) and Ishaa(عشاء).

He would make the Dua(دُعَا) against the people of the Book.

AND JUMAA(جمعه), KHALIFA(خليفه) WANTED PEOPLE TO BE ON TIME; He started giving Khutbah(خطبه) and here comes Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان),

walking into the Masjid(مسجد).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) in front of everyone he stops his Khutbah(خطبه) and he said; Is this, when you show up?

Uthman Ibn Affan رضى الله عنه said: I was so busy and I only went back home now and I made Wudu(وضؤ) and came and he said: And you are also telling me that, you only made Wudu(وضؤ),

when you know that Rasool Allah ﷺ use to tell us that we need to make Ghusal(غسل).

So, he wanted people to be on time and follow the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Don’t be late to Salaat-Ul-Juma(صلاة الجمعه), you need to be there before Imam(اِمَام) starts the Khuttab(خطبه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) even though he didn’t want his wives to pray in the Masjid(مسجد) but he didn’t prevent them, because of the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Don’t prevent the women servants of Allah, from praying in the Houses of Allah.

So, he told his wife, You know my preference, she said: "I am not going to stop going to the Masjid(مسجد) until you tell me to do so".

She knows that he won’t and she carried on praying in the Masjid(مسجد) and in Bukhari(بخاريْ) it says that, when he was stabbed in Salah(صلاة) and killed,

she was in the Masjid(مسجد).

When Umar(عُمَر) was assassinated in the Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاة الفجر), she was in the Masjid(مسجد), so she carried on praying until he died in the Masjid(مسجد).

He didn’t prevent her.

NOW I NEED TO MAKE A COMMENT ON THAT; In those days it would be alright to tell the woman to pray at home because in Madina, they would find benefit at home, they would find benefit on the streets

they would find benefit in the Masjid(مسجد), I mean it's all an Islamic Society.

However, now a days, for those brothers, who do not want their women to pray in the Masjid(مسجد) and you tell them that, that’s your preference

first of you can say that it's your preference but you cannot prevent them.

You do not have the right to prevent them.

Because of the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ do not prevent them from going to the Masjid(مسجد).

And if you make that your preference known to them and they agree to stay, you are responsible you need to provide them with an alternative.

You need to provide them with the services that they would get in the Masjid(مسجد).

You can’t just tell your wife or daughter to stay home alright and then leave her with the TV Set to be her Shaikh(شيخ).

You have to offer her an alternative.

Preventing women from going to the Masajid(مساجد) today, if there is Ilm(علم) and Islamic Activities that they would learn from the Masjid(مسجد)

is not a wise idea if you are not going to offer them with a viable Islamic program.

So may be the recommendation now should be that for benefit, if there is benefit in the Masjid(مسجد) because in some Masajid(مساجد) there is no benefit, you just do the Salah(صلاة) and leave.

I mean the Masjid(مسجد) is dead.

You know, you finish the Salah(صلاة) and then the person who has the keys, the care-taker of the Masjid(مسجد) he is shaking the keys next to you, it's time to leave brother.!

Time to leave! And he is ringing those keys and turning off the lights. Yullah, Yullah out!.

So, the Masjid(مسجد) is dead but if there is an activity going on there is Halaqat(حلقات) of Ilm(علم) there is something that would benefit our Muslim sister

then she should go and she should be encouraged to go to Masajid(مساجد).

It doesn’t make a sense to allow her everywhere except the Masjid(مسجد), you can go to school, you can go to university, you can go shopping, you can here and there,

you can go visit your family but you are not allowed to go to Masjid(مسجد).

No the Masjid(مسجد) is for men.

Sister leave the Takbir(تكبير) to the brothers. I guess!!

Brothers you should do the Takbir(تكبير) for the sisters! Do the Takbir(تكبير) for them, Audience: Takbir(تكبير)!! Allah Akbar(الله اكبر), Takbir(تكبير)!! Allah Akbar(الله اكبر), Takbir(تكبير)!!

Allah Akbar(الله اكبر), Takbir(تكبير)!! Allah Akbar(الله اكبر) , Takbir(تكبير)!! Allah Akbar(الله اكبر).

So sisters, should be very happy that this is the first time ever that we have Five Takbir(تكبير)'s.

So, ya’ni(يعني), this brother must be a champion of women rights Ma sha Allah(ماشاءالله) Ma sha Allah(ماشاءالله), Jazakallahu khairun(جزاك الله خيرًا ) brother.

I am sure that's not the case you are just a bachelor trying to develop a good reputation for yourself.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه would sometimes go to his friend Abu Musa Al-Ashari(أبو موسى ألأشعري) all of them were friends, the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, brothers.

You know this is one thing, if you never experience brotherhood it's something that cannot be expressed in words.

Al-Akhuwah Fillah(الاخواةفى الله) brotherhood for the sake of Allah is such a wonderful blessing of Allah in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) it cannot be described in words,

it’s a blessings straight out of Jannah(جنة).

And these Sahabah(صحابه) had it, and this brotherhood is not something that you develop through casual relationships.

Usually this is a relationship that develops when they go through similar experiences of hardship.

So, the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم had it because they were tortured together.

They fought in the same Trench together, they suffered hunger together.

You know you remember the story, when Rasool Allah ﷺ went out of his house and he meets Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), and he said: Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) why are you walking in the streets at this late hour?

He said, O Rasool Ullah because I am hungry, I am going to search for food.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This is the same reason why, I am out and then they met Umar(عُمَر) and the same thing he said.

So, they suffered together.

And that’s how they develop the strong bonding.

And then because of the battles that, they fought being soldiers who are together that also develops the special relationship between them.

You would even find that between the soldiers who are non Muslims.

You know that experience of being together at that moment of danger develops a special bonding.

So, the Sahabah(صحابه) in addition to having that, they also had Akhuwah Fillah(الاخواةفى الله) the brotherhood for the sake of Allahعَزّوجَلّ

you know it's not just the experience of fighting together but it's also the love for the sake of Allah, Emaan(إيمان) having the same goals in life,

working for the same cause, their relationshipwas very tight, very tight.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه, sometimes, would come to Abu Musa Al-Asha'ri(أبو موسى ألأشعري) and he would tell him Abu Musa(أبوموسى) start reciting for us.

So, Abu Musa Al-Asha'ri(أبو موسى ألأشعري) would recite Ayaat(آيات) from Qur’an and then they would all cry, they would all cry together.

Once the servant of Usayd(أسيد) his slave, he is the one narrating this, he said: He said: Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) used to patrol at night, and we'll talk about his patrols

tomorrow night In Sha Allah Ta'ala(إن شاء لله تعالى), his nightly patrols.

So, he would go to the Masjid(مسجد) and he would prevent anyone from staying in the Masjid(مسجد) except the ones who are praying.

He didn’t want people hanging around the Masjid(مسجد) after Ishaa(عشاء).

After Ishaa(عشاء) you go back home unless you are praying.

Don’t just sit around in Masjid(مسجد), talking.

So, he was going around Masjid(مسجد) he came and he saw this Halaqah(حلقه) he said, who are they? They said: It is your family.

Actually there were none of the relatives of Umar(عُمَر) there.

These were some his close Sahabah(صحابه) his brothers, he said, Ah-luk(أهلُك) your family.

I mean your family.

So, he goes there and he sits down with them, and he said, why are you staying behind the Salah(صلاة)? They said: We are sitting to remember Allahعزوجل.

So, he sat down with them.

When he knew that he is making Zikr(ذكر) of Allah, he sat down with them.

and then he told the one next to him: The one, who is right next to him, He said; Make Dua(دُعَا) for us.

So, the man started making Dua(دُعَا) and then Umar(عُمَر) would go around asking everyone to make Dua(دُعَا) for the group and they would say Ameen(آمين).

Until he gets, to this servant, the slave, and he said: You make Dua(دُعَا) for us now and I was the last one before him, He said; I couldn't speak,

And I was shaking.

This is an unlearned man, he is not used to speaking in front of people and he didn't know what to say.

So, he couldn’t speak.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him say anything even if you say, O Allaah! Forgive us O Allaah! Have a mercy on us.

Just say something, make a Dua(دُعَا) for us anything.

It doesn’t have to be a long sophisticated Dua(دُعَا) that you memorize out of a book, anything, make any Dua(دُعَا).

And I'll come back to this.

So, he said: I said those words, and then it was Umar(عُمَر)’s turn to make Dua(دُعَا) and he made Dua(دُعَا) and he was the one, who was crying the most among us and then he said:

Now everybody go home.

With the word of Umar(عُمَر) make any Dua(دُعَا), you know you see people in Tawaf(طواف), if you have been to Hajj(حَجْ) or Umrah(عمرة) reading form these booklets.

There is Dua(دُعَا) that you say in first Tawaf(طواف), Dua(دُعَا) that you say that in second, Dua(دُعَا) that you say in third, Dua(دُعَا) in the fourth,

then they have the book for Saffa(ألصفا) and Marwa(مروة), they have book for everything.

And they are reading for this book and they are bumping into people because they cannot see.

I mean these are the people, who should be paying Thirty Pound Fine.

They are bumping into everyone causing traffic hazards because they are so concentrating in that book of Dua(دُعَا).

And they are causing harm to the Muslims, in Tawaf(طواف).

A brother was just telling me that he was reading a book on Hajj(حَجْ) and the author was saying again and again, Do not harm the Muslims, Do not harm the Muslims, Do not harm the Muslims.

Don’t cause them hardship because you want to finish your book.

Now, this man may be he doesn’t understand that Dua(دُعَا) it's in Arabic and probably this person doesn’t speak Arabic, many Arabs do also reads those Dua(دُعَا) and may be they don’t understand what is in it.

So, they don’t have khushu(خشوع) and everybody around them, is having a problem because of this, that’s not a Dua(دُعَا).

Make any Dua(دُعَا) can’t you say O Allaah forgive me!

Can’t you say O Allaah have a mercy on me, Can’t you say O Allaah grant me Jannah(جنة), Does it take a scholar to make such a Dua(دُعَا).

Anybody can make it.

If that book, the Dua(دُعَا) in it wasn’t written by Rasool Allahﷺ, why is it binding on you to read it?

It is preferring symbols over substance, no I have to finish this book.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ does not want to hear a Dua(دُعَا) from you that you don’t understand.

How will Allaah respond to a Dua(دُعَا) that you making it if you don’t know what you are asking for?

You know Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) it doesn’t make any sense at all.

The essence of Dua(دُعَا) is that your heart should be connected to your tongue when you make the Dua(دُعَا) and you should have khushu(خشوع)

and you should humble yourself and ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ and beg Allahعَزّوجَلّ to accept your Dua(دُعَا).

That’s one of the reasons why Dua(دُعَا) is accepted, when you persists in Dua(دُعَا).

That persistence means that you repeat it again and again you do it with enthusiasm with commitment and with humbleness and you are begging Allahعَزّوجَلّ to give you that.

So, you can make any Dhikar(زكر) you can make any Dua(دُعَا) it doesn’t have to be from that book.

Al-Hajj(حَجْ); He was also concerned with the Muslims who were not making Hajj(حَجْ). He said, I was thinking about, I was considering sending men to different Muslim States

to see the Muslims who are able to make Hajj(حَجْ) and didn’t make Hajj(حَجْ) and to have them pay Jizya(جزية) because they are not Muslim, They are not Muslim! They are not Muslim.

According to many of the scholars, Hajj(حَجْ) is mandatory immediately, this year if you are able to make it.

If you have the financial ability you are strong and you can make time for it and you didn’t make Hajj(حَجْ) that’s a sin, according to many of the scholars.

According to Ash-Shafi'e(الشافعى), it is mandatory but any time you can make it, however, Ash-Shafi'e(الشافعى) says if you die and you didn’t make it

and there was a year in which you were able to make it, then you are dying in the state of sin.

So, even though he says that you can make it later but he said; If death comes to you and you didn’t do it then you will be held accountable for that.

And this is talking about anyone who is above the age of puberty.

If you are able to make Hajj(حَجْ) you have the financial resources to Hajj(حَجْ) and you don’t do it, you have to pay Jizyah(جزية), according to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

So, make sure that you do Hajj(حَجْ), plan for it this year, if you can if you have still time, well it's getting close but don’t delay Hajj(حَجْ).

Do not delay Hajj(حَجْ) it's one of the Five Pillars of Islam and Hajj(حَجْ) is so great, it will forgive for you all of your past sins, all of them.

Amr Bin Al-Aas رضي الله عنه, he came to give the Pledge of Allegiance to Rasool Allah ﷺ when he wanted to become a Muslim, he came to Rasool Ullah and said,

O Rasool Ullah: I want to become a Muslim.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ extended his hand, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) pulled his hand away.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him what's wrong?

Now, Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) was a diplomat, he was the man Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) would send around to negotiate with the leaders.

So he wanted to negotiate his Islam with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

You know he was evening thinking about negotiations when he wanted to become a Muslim رضى الله عنه.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him why did you hold your hand back?

He said: Because I have some conditions to make.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: What conditions?

He said, that you pardon me, for my sins.

That my sins are pardoned.

Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) knew that he has been such an enemy of Islam, that he deserves to be executed because of what he has done.

So, he wants to make sure that Rasool Ullah will give him clemency, and he is not going to be held accountable for what he did in the past.

Rasool Allah ﷺ smiled and said; O Amr(عمرو) didn’t you know that Islam erases everything before it, and Hijrah(هجرة) erases everything before it, and Hajj(حَجْ) erases everything before it.

Hajj(حَجْ) will erase everything that you did before and you will come back as if you are day born.

So, make Hajj(حَجْ).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) himself, he would lead the Hajj(حَجْ) every year, so they said, he made Hajj(حَجْ) when he was Khalifah(خليفه) Nine or Ten Times.

He would lead the Hajj(حَجْ) himself.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه would give a lot of attention to the Financial Aspects of the Khilafah(خِلَافَه), the business, the commerce, Anas bin Malik رضى الله عنه  said:

I saw Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wearing an Izaar(إزار) and it had twelve patches in it and he didn’t have any Qamees(قميص) on him and he was wearing his turban and carrying his stick

and he would go around the market of Madina, inspecting the market.

He would go and inspect the market and he would tell the Businessmen in the market of Madina: You are not allowed to sell in our market place unless you have Fiqh(فقه)

otherwise, you will deal with interest, Riba(رباء) whether you like it or not.

So, he said: You have to learn the Fiqh(فقه) of business before you sell in our markets, like you have to have certificate that you have studied the Fiqh(فقه) of business before you come in and do trade.

So, just like now you are not allowed to work unless you have a certificate unless you graduated in that field same thing Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted to know that they were qualified to practice in the market

and that applies to you today, if you are physician you need to study the Fiqh(فقه) relating to your field you need to study the aspects of Daa(داء) and Dawa(دوا), the illness and the medicine in Islam.

What is the Islamic Medicine?

What is considered to be an illness?

How to cure in Islam?

That will help in your field, you need to know rules regarding, for example abortion when it is allowed and when it is not allowed, contraception all of these issues that would relate to a specific field

you need to learn about them.

If you are a farmer you need to learn the rules regarding farming.

If you are a businessman depending upon the field of your business, you need to learn the Ahkam(أحكام) relating to that.

And if you real estate agent you need to know, what is Halal(حلال) in that field and what is Haram(حرام)?

What involves Riba(ربا) and what doesn’t?

Not only in your field of profession but as a husband you need to know what your responsibilities are?

As a wife you need to know what your responsibilities are?

Notice here that I am saying, RESPONSIBILITIES not RIGHTS.

In the West you are always told to fight for your Rights, so the man and woman come into marriage with the will to fight for their rights.

The man is fighting for his rights, the woman is fighting for her rights and it's like, you are in a bull ring.

A Muslim asks about their responsibilities not rights.

You are asked about your responsibilities towards others.

If the wife takes care of her responsibilities and the husband take care of his responsibilities there will be no problems.

You get problems when you start fighting for your rights it's not a boxing arena marriage is a cooperation, it is a ibadaa(عبادة) you are serving Allah through that relationship.

The parents needs to learn their responsibilities and the children need to learn their responsibilities all of this is Fiqh(فقه) that needs to be studied.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted the people to work, He said; Having a work that is of low reputation is better than begging people.

Working in a particular field that has a bad reputation, low reputation.

I am not talking about something Haram(حرام) but there are some things that are Halal(حلال) that are viewed as lowly, as humble, as humiliating but they are Halal(حلال).

Umar(عُمَر) is saying that is better than begging people.

Living on welfare is worse than working in something that is belittled by people.

Now, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would go to the poor and would say; O you the poor! Raise up your heads and go and do business because the path is clear

and don’t be dependent on people.

You know, sometimes you cannot blame poor for not working because they are put in such a depressed state and they have nowhere to start from that they lose hope

and they become down, you know they just give up.

Umar(عمر) is trying to encourage them, he said, riseup, look up raise your heads up and go and trade, start somewhere, and then he said, that is better than being dependent on others.

So, the poor needs to be given encouragement because when you are poor and all the doors of opportunities are shutting on your face that is very difficult psychological state.

You lose hope.

So, Umar(عمر) is trying to encourage them.

You know, sometimes we talk about working and working and working the brother comes and says I have been trying to do work but there is no work to do.

So, such a brother needs to be encouraged.

You know keep on trying keep on trying ask Allah it’s a test from Allahعَزّوجَلّ for you, keep on trying.

Umar Bin Khattab رضي الله عنه saw some people who were not working, they were in the Masjid(مسجد), you now they were just sitting in the Masjid(مسجد)

and they were sitting in the Masjid(مسجد) during the business hours.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) goes in and said: What are you doing in the Masjid(مسجد), it's not a time for Salah(صلاة)?

They said: We put our trust in Allah, Allah is going to give us Rizq(رزق).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: He said: Don’t sit down without doing any work, and then say, "O Allah give me Rizq(رزق)!" because you know that the sky does not rain gold and silver

and then he recited the Ayah(آية) in Qur’an "when Salah(صلاة) is over, Salaat ul Jumu'a(صلاة الجمعه) is over, go out and disperse in the land

and seek the bounties of Allah.

"Go out and work." And then he said, Because Allah gives the people Rizq(رزق) from each other.

Your Rizq(رزق) is coming from me and my Rizq(رزق) is coming from that person we work for each other, we serve each other.

See this money that you have in your pocket it has passed through how many hands before it reaches you.

so our Rizq(رزق) comes from each other.

It's rotating among us.

The money is going around.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ الله

مِنْ عَبْدِالله امير المومنين عمر بن الخطاب اِلى نِيْلِ اَهْلِ الْمِصْر اِنْ كُنْتَ تَجْرِيْ بِأَمْرِكَ وَمِنْ قِبَلِكَ فَلَا تَجْرِيْ فَلَا حَاجَتَ لَنَا فِيْكْ

وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَجْرِيْ بِأَمْرِالله وَاللهُ هُوَّالَّذِيْ يُجْرِيْكَ، فَنَسْئَلُ اللهَ عَزُّوْجَلْ اَنْ يٌجْرِيْكَ اِنِّيْ لَا أَعْلَمُوْ أَنَّكَ حَجَرْ لَا تَنْفَعْ وَلَا تَضُرْ

وَلَوْلَا أَنِّيْ رَاَيْتُ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَبِّلُكْ مَا قَبَّلْتُكَ وَاَقِفُوْاعَلى مَشَاعِرِ كُمْ فَاِنَّكُمْ عَلى اِرْثٍ مِنْ اِرِثِ اَبِيْكُمْ مِثْلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ

قَالُوْا تَبَا يَعْنَ عَلى الْمَوْتَ لَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنِ الْمُؤمِنِيْنَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُوْنَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَر اِنَّ اللهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَى الْاَرْضَ، اَنْ تَأْكُلَ اَجْسَا دَالْاَنْبِيَاءََ

لَا يَنَامْ وَلَايَتْرُكْ اَحَدًا يَنَامْ اِنِّيْ لَمْ اَعْزِلْ خالد ابن وليد اَنْ سَخْطَه وَلَا خِيَانَةْ وَلَكِنَّ النَاَسَ فُتِنُوْا بِهِ فَاَحْبَبْتُ اَنْ يَعْلَمُوْ اَنَّ الله هُوَّالثَّانِعْء

هَااُؤلآءِ الْمُتَّوَكِلُوْنَ بَلْ هُمْ اَلْمُتَوَا كِلُوْنَ اَمِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ هُوَ؟

وَلَوْكُنْتَ فَظَّاغَلِيْظَ الْقَلْبِ لَا نْفَضُّوْ امِنْ حَوْلِكْ الر ۝ تِلْكَ آيَات الْكِتَاب الْمُبِين ۝

إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ ۝

نَحْنُ نَقُصّ عَلَيْك أَحْسَن الْقَصَص بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْك هَذَا الْقُرْآن ۝

وَإِنْ كُنْت مِنْ قَبْله لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ۝

اَنَّمَا اَهْلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ اَنَّهُمْ اَقْبَلُ عَلى كُتُبِهِ عُلَمَائِهِمْ وَعَصَاكِفَتِهِمْ وَتَرَكُ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلَ حَتَّى  دَرَسَ وَذَهَبَ مَا فِيْهَا مِنَّ الْعِلْمْ

أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا اِنَّ  أَهَمَّ عُمْرَ كُمْ عِنْدِيْ اَلصَّلَوةْ فَمَنْ حَفِظَهَا وَحَافِظَ عَلَيِهَا

حَفِظَ اللهُ دِيْنَه’ وَمَنْضَيَّآئْهَافَهُوَلِمَا سِوَآءَ اَضْيَاءَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ عمرفَسَمِعْتُ هَنِيْنَهُمْ مِنْ وَرَآءِالثَلَاثَ الصُّفُوْفَ

مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ ۚ "لَوْ خَشِعَ قَلْبَ هَذَا لَخَشِعَتْ جَوَارِهُ" إِذَااَبْطَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ جُيُوْشَ قَنَتْ

Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) says; وَكَانَ يَدْعُوْ الِلْمُجَاهِدِيْنَ فِيْ صَلَوتِهِ وَيَقْنُتْ لِيْ ذَلِكْ فَاعِنْدَ مَا قَتَلَ اَهْلِ الْكِتَابْ قَنَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي الصَّلَوةِ  الْمَكْتُوْبَةَ

اَللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِالْكَفَرَ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتَابْ أَفِيْ هَذِهِ سَّاعَةْ؟

لَا تَمْنَعُ عِمَا اللهَ مَسَاجِدَاللهَ "إِنَّمَا هُمْ اَهْلُكْ" جَلَسْنَا نَذْكُرَالله عزًوْجل ادنهم له خُذْ فِى الدُّعَاء "فَأُحْصِرْتْ" وَأَخَذْتُ اَفْقُلَ

اَللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْلَنَا اَللَّهُمَ اَرْحَمْ لَنَا اَلْآنَ فَتَفَرَّقُو اَلْاِلْحَافْ فِي الدُّعَا لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ اَنْ اَبْعَثَ رِجَالًا اِلَى هَذِهِ الْاَمْسَارْ

فَيَنْظُرُاِلَى كُلِّ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَه’ جِدَّ فَلَمْ يَحُجَّ فَيَضْرِبُوْا عَلَيْهِمُ الْجِزْيَهْ وَمَا هُمْ بِمُسْلِمِيْنَ! مَا هُمْ بِمُسْلِمِيْنْ! مَا هُمْ بِمُسْلِمِيْن

اَلْحَجْ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى الْفَوْرَ ياعمرو عَمَا تَعْلَمْ ؟اَنَّالْاِسْلَامَ يَجُبُّ مَا قَبْلَهَا، وَاَنَّ الْهِجْرَ ةَ تَجُبُّ مَا قَبْلَهَا، وَاَنَّ الْحَجَّ يَجُبُّ مَا قَبْلَهَا

رَجَعَكَ يَوْمِ وَلَدَتْه’ اُمُّ رَأَيْتُ عَلى عمر ابن الخطاب لَايَبِعْ فِيْ سُوْقِنَااِلَّا مَنْ تَفَقَّهَا وَاِلَّا اَكَلَ الرِّبَا اشَاءًاَبَا

مَكْسَبَ فِيْهَا بَعْدَ الدَّنَاءْ خَيْرًا مِّنْ مَسْئَلَه’ خَيْرًامِّنْ مَّسْئَلَةْ النَّاْس إرفعوايامعشرالفقراء ارفعوا رءوسكم و تجرو افقد وضعك طريق ولاتكونواايالاالناس

لا يقعداحدكم انت طلب الرزق ويقول اللهم الرزقني وقد علم ان السمآء لا تمطرالذهب ولا فضة وانالله يرزق الناس بعضهم من بعض وتل قول الله تعالى عزوجل

فإذا قضيت الصلاة فانتشروافي الارض وبتغوا من فضل الله واذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون۝

كاولئك دولة بين الاغني منكم

parts.english:
UMAR(عُمَر) AND HIS PEOPLE, We start first with Umar(عُمَر) and the women citizens, especially the women of Madina.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه was walking down a road in Madina accompanied with some of his advisors or followers.

And a woman comes up to Umar(عُمَر) and she stops him and she said: O Umar(عُمَر)!

I remember one day, you would be called Umair(عمير).

Umair(عمير) is small Umar(عُمَر).

It's Seeghat Tasgheera(صيغه تصغيرة) in Arabic, if you want to make something smaller you add that Ya(ي) to it, so Umar(عُمَر), Umair(عمير), Asad(اسد) Usaid(اُسيد).

So, she said, I remember a day, when you were young, you would be called Umair(عمیر) and you would be carrying your stick with you, terrorizing the kids.

He would go around beating the kids when you was young, with a stick.

He was a tough man since his young days, he would go around the streets of Makkah fighting the kids with his stick.

He became a wrestler after that.

So, he was that type of street boy, when he was a young.

Umair(عمير) and then after that, you were called Umar(عُمَر) and then the days passed and you are called Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

So, fear Allah! And fear Allah with your people and remember the day of Judgment.

And she went on giving him Naseeha(نصيحه).

And Umar(عُمَر) just stood there listening to her without any interruption.

So, the man with Umar(عُمَر) stopped her and he said, Stop speaking like that to Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: You stop.

If this woman would continue talking, I would continue listening and I would only leave her to go and make Salah(صلاة) and come back.

Why shouldn’t I listen to a woman whom Allahعَزّوجَلّ listened to her complains from above seven heavens.

This was Khawlah(خوله), who went to complain about her husband to Rasool Allah ﷺ and Ayesha(عائشه) said; I was in the next room and I could barely

hear the conversation between Rasool Allah ﷺ and her but Allahعَزّوجَلّ heard her and revealed Ayaat(آيات): Allahعَزّوجَلّ heard the conversation of the woman,

who was complaining to you about her husband and Allahعَزّوجَلّ heard that conversation.

Khawlah(خوله) was giving Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه a Naseeha(نصيحه) and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was listening to it, attentively

and she was reminding him of his humble origins.

Al-Khansa(الخنصه), one of the woman of Al-Ansaar(الانصار), four of her sons were killed in the Battle of Al-Yarmook(اليرموك), four.

When Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه heard the news he ordered the treasurer to carry on paying their salaries to their mother, all four.

As a reward to this patient woman, who was the reason behind the Shahadah(شهادة) of her sons because of her encouragement for them and the way she brought them up.

She was a poetess and her poetry was so, encouraging and that was not only encouraging for her sons but it was also encouraging for all other Muslims.

Once Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is walking in Madina, so a young woman came to him - (اِمْرَأةْ شَاْبَةْ), a Woman in her youthful years.

She came to Umar(عُمَر) and she said: O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)!

My husband died and he left behind young children and he left us no land and he left us no cattle and he left us with nothing.

And my father is Imam Ar-Rukhsa Al-Ghaffari(امام الرخصه الغفاري), who witnessed Sulha-Al-Hadaybiyyah(صلح حديبيه) with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: Welcome, her father was Imam(اِمَام) of his people Ghifaar(غفار).

The people of Abu Dhar(ابو زر), her father was their Imam(اِمَام).

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) when he heard that she is the daughter of this man, this Sahabi(صحابي) of Rasool Allah ﷺ he said: Welcome, come with me.

So, this young lady goes with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), - so he finds a very strong camel, strong back, good for carrying and he loads two huge sacks,

he fills them up with money, food and clothes and he packs on the top of this camel and he handles the bridle to this woman and he says; Take the camel and everything on top of it, it's all yours.

And then he told her, by the time this runs out, Allahعَزّوجَلّ would have provided for you with something.

So, the man who was with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)! You have given her too much.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: May your mother be bereaved of you!

I can still remember her father and her brother fighting next to a fortress until, they opened it and now we are enjoying the fruits of their deeds.

These men died Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), these men died, so that we can live!

We are now enjoying now the blessings of their efforts.

What is in Bait-Ul-Maal(بيت المال), what is in treasury is because of the efforts of these Sahabah(صحابه), who fought for this Deen(دِيْن) and now you are telling me, that it's too much to give this woman what I gave her?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would take care of the families of the Shuhada(شهداء).

He was grateful towards the ones, who gave their lives for the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The one, who finances a fighter has fought,

and the one, who takes care of the family of the fighter has fought.

You get the same Ajr(أجْر) if you take care of their families.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is receiving the Ajr(أجْر) of Ghazo(غزو) even though he is sitting in Madina because he was taking care of the needs of these families.

And that was the expected thing to do, that was the right thing to do.

So, in those days, the Mujahid(مجاهد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) would go out and he is satisfied.

He has tranquility in his heart because he knows that his family would have something to fall back on and they will have somebody to take care of them.

But today things are very different.

So, the ones that are Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) today may Allahعَزّوجَلّ reward them and help them because the days are now different, the times are different.

One brother was telling me about a sister in Yemen.

He is telling me about the actual situation.

He said: He knows a wife of a Shaheed(شهيد), who had to go around the houses of the neighborhood, knocking on their doors begging for second hand clothes.

So, that she could put on her children for the day of Eid.

Imagine sister, if you would be in that situation and you have to go around begging not for new clothes but for second hand clothes, to put on your little ones for Eid.

And why are you doing that because your husband did not die for himself but he died for the Ummah(امة).

Wallah(والله) Brothers and Sisters, that’s the ultimate level of betrayal that we allow this to happen today.

We have forsaken our brothers, the Ummah(امة) has forsaken them because they died Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) for the sake of Ummah(امة).

Why are they doing that? They are not doing that for their own benefits.

This person could otherwise be a successful doctor, or engineer or business man, he could be making living for himself and family but he went out for the sake of YOU and then this is how he is treated.

He is betrayed, his wife is betrayed, their children are betrayed and not only that people will go on the media talking against him.

Muslims are going to go on Media talking against him.

when he has given his life for the sake of Ummah(امة).

Nothing goes for free, we will be held accountable for that on the day of judgment.

You will be held accountable for what is happening today, if you don’t do a thing about it.

And when you see your brothers wherever they are, being harassed, being arrested, being abused, and you do nothing about it beware and realize that you will be next

and in addition to paying for that sin in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) Allahعَزّوجَلّ will make you pay hefty price on the day of judgment.

If you allow this to happen to your brothers, be assured that the punishment is on its way.

It will happen in your health, or in your family or in your wealth.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ is going to make you pay for that.

Why? Because we are an Ummah(امة) and this membership is not a free membership that is giving to you without any duties.

Being a member of the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ carries with it, responsibility because it's an honor.

It is such a great honor that Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) would wish to be member of Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

Musa عليه السلام he would wish to be a member of Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ and Allahعَزّوجَلّ has gave you that virtue, Allahعَزّوجَلّ gave you that honor

to make you part of greatest Ummah(امة) that ever existed, But that honor is not free there are some duties and responsibilities that are tied to it.

And those duties are that you are responsible towards the welfare of every member of this Ummah(امة).

And if there is something that you could do to help a brother or sister, who is in need, and then you do nothing about it, be assured that Allahعَزّوجَلّ will hold you accountable for that.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ said: this Ummah(امة) is like a body, if one part of it feels a pain, the whole body joins in the pain and fever and suffering.

You cannot separate your finger from rest of the body.

Even if that small finger is injured the whole body will feel the pain.

With other family issues Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would also deal with them.

For example, a man said, I want to divorce my wife.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Why do you want to divorce her?

He said: Because I don’t love her.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; And since when have all the houses been established on love?

Where is the care?

What Umar(عُمَر) is saying رضي الله عنه is that not every husband and wife love each other and that’s not the sole purpose of marriage.

He is saying there are many families that are established on other reasons, yes may be they use to love each other before but hearts can change, things can go wrong,

does that mean that family now should separate, just because you don’t love your wife anymore, Where is care?

Allahعَزّوجَلّ put between male and female Muwaddah(مودة) is love and Rahmah(رحمه) is mercy.

If there is no love there still should be mercy, there is care, there is compassion.

A husband should still take care of his wife, even though he might not love her and vice versa.

And for Muslims who are living for the sake of Akhirah(آخرة) a family is a nucleus to build, to raise up children.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم), we might get into that later on.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Sometime I force myself to sleep with my wife even though I don’t want to.

He doesn’t feel that desire at that moment but he would force himself to sleep with his wife.

Why? So that may be Allahعَزّوجَلّ produce, Because may be out of that Allahعَزّوجَلّ will create a soul, "that will glorify Allah".

So, there are other objectives that the religion would be carried on that there will be people who will raise this religion and protect it and fight for it, and worship Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was telling the man hold on to your wife.

Romance is not everything and sometimes, it could be elusive.

You know in the beginning they are day dreaming Twenty-Four-Seven(24/7) about each other.

But then when they get married, you know, things get, you start taking things for granted.

When you have something you don’t really have that attachment to it, as when it's not in your hand.

And then problem happens, and each problem might leave behind a scar, so you have dents and scars in heart that keep on accumulating and eventually may be hearts change.

That happens a lot.

But the Ma’roof(معروف) should remain.

The good treatment should remain, the mercy should remain.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) since, the female was created from the male each one fulfills something in the soul of the other.

You see Hawwa(حوّا) wasn’t created independently.

She was created out of the rib of Adam(آدم).

So, she was created from him.

And that is why Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) you would find that this relationship between husband and wife is special and unique relationship.

There is no relationship similar to it.

The relationship that you have with your friends is different, with your parents is different, with your children is different.

This relationship between husband and wife is different, it is unique.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) nothing seems to be able to exist independently.

Allah has created everything in pairs.

Glory be to, He, Who created things in pairs, He created you in pairs and created plants in pairs and created things that you don’t know in pairs.

Only Allahعَزّوجَلّ is independent and doesn’t need a partner.

Allah(الله) is Al-Fard As-Samad(فَرْدَا الصَّمَدْ), He doesn’t need a partner but this is reflection of our human deficiency that we need a pair, we need spouse,

it's part of your Deen(دِيْن), because it's part of your humanity, it's part of your human make up.

You are deficient until, that missing piece of the puzzle comes into your life.

And this need even exist when there is no love between the couple, that is still needed.

Similarly, this time a woman came, complaining about her husband.

She came to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and she said about her husband; "His good is little and his evil is a lot".

The good that comes from my husband is little and the evil that comes from him, is a lot.

He said: Who is your husband?

She said, Abu Salamah(ابو سلمه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) asked the ones with him, he said, all we know about Abu Salamah(ابو سلمه) is, he a very nice man.

He is one of the Sahaba رضي الله عنهم.

So, Umar(عُمَر) was kind of shocked to hear this statement by his wife.

So, he said: Bring the husband in.

So, they brought the husband, he said: Do you know this woman he said: Yes, my wife.

What is she saying?

He said: She claims that your good is very little and your evil is a lot.

He said: She is lying.

I am treating her in the best way a husband could treat his wife and I am providing for her very well but He was old, and Baqi(بقي) means a camel or a goat that is running out of milk.

He was figuratively speaking to refer to impotence.

He was becoming impotent, and that’s why his wife was complaining.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; O you enemy of yourself! He was carrying his stick obviously.

He said: You consumed his youthful years and you lived off his wealth, and now when he becomes old, you come and complain about him?

And lie against him.

She said: O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)! I am sorry you're never going to see me here again.

Even though Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was delivering this harsh statement to her, he still gave her a gift.

He gave her Thalatha Al-Thwab(ثلاثة الاثواب) three pieces of cloth.

So, the narrator said: I saw her grabbing them and run away.

And then he told her: Be good company of this old man.

Be of good company of this old man.

And then when she Left, he came to the husband and said; Don’t think because I gave her those stern words that I am going to let you off the hook.

You have to be good with your wife and then he left.

So, over here, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not see valid ground for this woman to complain about the husband, if it was a problem that came up early on in the marriage when they were still young

and the husband was unable to fulfill these natural needs of his wife then those would be grounds for divorce.

But that's not how the man was, when he man was young.

This was the problem that came him when he was old.

So, Umar(عُمَر) told the woman you spent all of these years with him and now, when he is old, you want to desert him and leave him.

Hind Bint Ut'bah(هند بنت عتبعه) was known as being very intelligent and beautiful woman in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

She was initially married to the uncle of Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) but then he divorced her and she married Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان).

And she stayed with him for the majority of her life but then eventually Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) divorced her.

So, she went to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and she borrowed money from him.

Because since she's on her own, she wanted to do some business.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) agreed and he gave her some money, so she went to Iraq and she started investing and she became very successful in running her business.

And the reason that why I am bringing this up, is to show you that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would take care the needs of these women  in their young age, in their old age.

He gave her the money from the treasury in order to invest and that was something that was accommodated by the Muslims in those days.

Woman could go and trade and do business and make money and that’s what Hind Bint Ut'bah(هند بنت عتبعه) did.

To sum it up.

I think this statement tells it all.

It shows you the concern that Umar(عُمَر) had for women.

You know some of the statements that were previously mentioned might give you an impression that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was harsh on women

that's not true that’s furthest from the truth.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not want women intervening in his business.

But he was very soft hearted and kind when it came to women.

He was their protector, he was their leader, he was their caretaker.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه said; He said: In the name of Allah, if Allah gives me life, I am not going to allow any of the widows of Iraq, in need of the help of anyone after me.

If Allah just grants me life, I am going to make the women of Iraq and that was the farthest part of his Empire.

I am going to make the women of Iraq, the widows, I am going to make them so content, and happy, and pleased that, they are not going to need the help of anyone who comes after me.

That is how he viewed his responsibility towards the women of the Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, one day he was on a camel and it was very hot.

It was noon time in Madina very hot and he is running on the top of his camel in the hot sun, sand blowing in his face.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said: Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين) where are you heading?

He said: A camel of a Sadaqah(صدقه) ran away and I am pursuing it.

This was something that a slave could do, a servant could do, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said; You are making it difficult on anyone, who will come after you.

The standard that you are setting for the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) is so high, you are making it difficult on all of the Khulafah(خلافاء) after you.

He was setting the bar so high.

Ali(علي) was worried about whoever will assume this responsibilty after Umar(عُمَر) will he be able to live up, to the standards set by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه .

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he would give the right assessment of people and he would honor the people that deserved to be honored and

He would put the people in the right level, and he was careful in his judgments of others.

Once he needed somebody to give reference to someone, "Shahadah(شهادة)" so, someone said, I will give him reference Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Based on what?

Are you his neighbor?

He said: No, He said: Did you live with him?

He said: No, He said: Did you do business with him?

He said: No, He said: Did you travel with him?

Because travelling is the test, is the real test of men.

He said: No, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Well may be you then met him in the Masjid(مسجد) and you saw him praying, He said: Yes,

He said: Go! because you don’t really know him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You don’t judge the person based on seeing him in the Masjid(مسجد).

Are you his neighbor?

Did you live with him, Were you his room-mate?

That's how you get to know people, did you do business with him?

When money comes in you know a certain aspect of the personality of the person.

A person could be a sweet tongue, they could be a wonderful brothers, but when it comes to money the dark side comes out.

And then he said: Did you travelled with him?.

That’s the true test of men.

When you travel, when you leave behind routine of your life, the comforts of your life, things start getting on your nerves and the real you comes out.

Your sleep schedule changes, you are sleeping on a different bed, you are eating different food, you know you are used to food of your mom now you are eating the food of someone else different country.

There's not enough spices in the food, the routine changes and you are always close to your travel companions this is how Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) assesses people.

So, he said, you are not qualified to give him a reference.

And he has some other statements, he said: I am not really worried about the Mo’min(مؤمن) whose Eeman(ايمان) is clear and the Kafir(كافر) whose Kuffr(كفر) is clear

but I am worried about the Munafiq(منافق), who shows Eeman(ايمان) and conceals Kuffr(كفر).

And he has some statements about, Don’t be fooled by the worship that you see of people, because what is in their hearts could be different and all of these statements are true.

It's not the Salah(صلاة) of the person, it's not the ibadah(عبادة) that, they show to others, there could be some diseases of heart that are still lingering behind

and you don’t really see them but Allah sees them.

Some of the first people turned down the Daw'ah(دعوة) of Eesaعليه السلام were the scholars of Bannu Israel(بنواسرائيل).

They were the first the Muftees(مفتي) of the Banni Israel(بني اسرائيل), the Ulama(علماء) of Banni Israel(بني اسرائيل) they were the first to turn down Eesa عليه السلام they and the Umara(امراء).

The Umara(امراء) and the Ulama(علماء) were the first to betray Eesa عليه السلام.

The political leaders and the religious leaders and the ones, who followed the Eesaعليه السلام were some fishermen and some simple lay men, the ignorant, simple minded people

they were the ones whom Allah choose to follow Eesa عليه السلام and they were his Hawariyeen(حوارين).

So, don’t be fooled by the tongue and by the appearance because only Allah can see what is inside.

Let's all make Dua(دُعَا) "that Allahعَزّوجَلّ make the inside of us better than the outside".

Odae bin Haatim(عديئ ابن حاتم), one of the noble men of his people, one of the Sahabah of Rasool Allah ﷺ, He said: I came with a delegation of my people about two thousand

and we came to Umar(عُمَر) and he started choosing some men from my people and he would give them, so I stood in front of him he ignored me, he turned the other side.

So, I went in front of him and he again ignored me and it happened few times.

And then I went straight to him and I said: O Umar(عُمَر)! You don’t know me?

You don’t remember me?

Odae(عديئ) said: Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) laughed, so much that he fell on his back.

And he said: No! Odae(عديئ) I know you very well.

You are the one, who believed when people disbelieved, You are the one who came, when people deserted, and you are the one, who was true to his words, when people betrayed,

and you are the one, who came with the Sadaqah(صدقه) of Tai(طيئ), and that was the Sadaqah(صدقه) that made Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Sahabah(صحابه) happy.

And he apologized to me and then he said: The reason, why I am giving these men that you see is because these are leaders among their people

and they are the men, whom people go to in their times of need and that’s why I am giving them.

Odae bin Haatim(عديئ ابن حاتم) said; I am happy then, if that’s the case.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب)  recognizes the status of Odae(عديئ) and he also recognized the status of the leaders of his people and the reason why he was giving them, is because through their hands others would benefit.

He was giving them because these are the men whom their people come to in moments of need.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ gives some people money because these wealthy men distributes that money to the needy.

The moment the start holding back Allahعَزّوجَلّ will take that wealth and give it to somebody else.

In battle with Romans some Muslims were taken as prisoners of war.

So, the Roman King when he heard that one of them was a Sahabi(صحابي), he was so happy.

He said: Bring me, I want to meet him.

The Sahabah(صحابه) by now so many legends were surrounding them and news going around the globe about these special men, SAHABAH(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ

so, they were just fascinated, they just wanted to see a Sahabi(صحابي).

So, the Roman King said: Bring him to me.

Because these Sahabah(صحابه) one counts them as an Ummah(امة).

One man is equal to an Ummah(امة).

That was the product that Rasool Allah ﷺ left behind.

So, they brought Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه).

And this Roman King is now thinking, and he's thinking about how to capitalize on the Sahabi(صحابي).

So, he said: I want you to marry my daughter.

Apparently he use to think, there is special about the genes of the Sahabah(صحابه).

He wants that to be carried down the line by him, marrying him to his daughter.

So, this is the daughter of a Roman King, she is going to marry this Sahabi(صحابي), their children are going to be a superman.

But he set a condition that you became a Christian. He said: I won’t, he said: Listen, you marry my daughter and I will give you half of my kingdom.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) said: No way, I am not giving up my religion.

Brothers don’t take it as a tale, think about it, Half the kingdom, some Muslims are selling out today for a miser salary, for peanuts.

They are betraying the Ummah(امة), they are spying on the Muslims for nothing.

They are selling their religion for a very miser price for nothing.

They are giving up Islam, they are committing Ridda(ردة) - and this Sahabi(صحابي) is offered half the kingdom, half of the kingdom and he says, No!

You know when you say, no to these people how much it hurts them?

I am offering you my daughter, I am king, nobody ever said no to me, in my life and I never offered my daughter to anyone in my kingdom before and you say, No?

And then I give you half of my kingdom and you say, No?

the people of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) they have fought so much to get the Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) when they see someone, who is not attached to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), it drives them crazy.

It is as if you are insulting me and telling me that I wasted my life for something that is wrong.

As if you are telling me that this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) is not worth it.

What do you mean?

You are refusing half of my kingdom, I am offering you my daughter and you say, No.

So it just drive him crazy, it makes him angry.

So, he said: Bring the Al-Bakara(البكرة), Al-Bakara(البكرة) is apparently this huge container, bowl, that looks like a cow.

And it is used for burning alive.

They would fill it with oil and they would just set fire to it and the oil would boil.

Imagine that oil, with smokes coming out of it.

Because they set it on fire for so long that it was boiling.

And then they bring a Muslim and they throw him in that boiling oil.

The narrator said; "It wasn’t very long after that Muslim was thrown in the boiling water that his bones started to sticking out." It is so hot that his flesh was fried, the bones came out.

You know when you fry, if you take for an example a chicken and you fry it, the bones sticks out because the flesh shrinks.

It loses all of the water vapor in it, and it shrinks, so the bones sticks out.

That is what happened to this Muslim prisoner of war and that was occurring in front of the eyes of Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه).

So, the king told him: Are you going to give up your religion now?

Otherwise we are going to throw you in that boiling oil.

He said: I am not going to give up my religion.

So, they said throw him in that oil.

They picked him up, Abdullah(عبدالله) started to cry.

They went to the king and said: He is crying.

The king said: Bring him back.

He is crying and he has weakened, he has weakened we got him, we struck fear in his heart.

Bring him to me He said, alright. Are you ready to give up your religion?

Abdullah(عبدالله) said: Don’t think that I cried because of fear of death but the reason I cried, is because I remembered, that I only have one soul

and my soul is going to leave now.

So, the reason I cried is because I wanted Allah to give me a hundred souls, so that I could die this death hundred times for the sake of Allah.

I wasn’t crying because I was afraid of death, I was crying because I wanted to die as a shaheed(شهيد) a hundred times.

In another narration he said, I wanted to have souls, as the number of hair that I have on my skin.

So, that I could give them for the sake of Allah one after another.

I think that’s the level of Eeman(ايمان), that we can’t think about, we can't even comprehend.

Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) and that tells you brothers and sisters this religion is not a religion of talk it's not a religion of showing off how much knowledge you have,

this religion is about your willingness to sacrifice for Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Abdullah Ibn Hudhaifah As-Sahmi(عبدالله بن حدافه السهمي) proved his Eeman(ايمان), at that particular moment.

It’s a Mawaqif(مؤاقف) that show who you are?

Mawqaf(مؤقف) is a standing point in your life at moments of ease everybody could be equal and you don’t really know what's going on but when the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) hits that’s when truth comes out of the heart.

So, when the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) hit Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه), the true Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) was revealed.

Nobody knew Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) or anybody else nobody knew, who Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) was.

They knew him as a Sahabi(صحابي) but they didn’t really know what was inside of him, but this Mawqif(مؤقف) this standing point revealed the reality, of what was lingering in his heart, Al-Eeman(الايمان).

It was the willingness to sacrifice for Allahعَزّوجَلّ and to give his soul one after another.

You know this makes Sahabah(صحابه) special and that was something the people around them couldn’t comprehend.

I mean with for example with this, delegation of Qura’(قراء) memorizers of Qur’an, which Rasool Allah ﷺ sent out to Najd(نجد), that were betrayed.

You know when one of the Sahabah(صحابه) came in to meet with the leader of the tribe.

The leader of the tribe gave his signal, so a man came with a spear and stabbed the Sahabi(صحابي) from behind him, so the blade came out from the front.

So, imagine this Sahabi(صحابي) he was attacked, he was caught off guard.

He didn’t know that somebody was planning to kill him.

It was a surprise to him and then he sees a spear sticking out of his stomach.

What did he say?

A big smile on his face and he said; I have won in the name of Allah, I won.

One man, who was present, he said, I couldn’t forget that.

That statement stayed in my mind how could somebody say I won when they are dying.

And since he didn’t know anything about Islam he went asking about this and then he became Muslim.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), the Sahabah(صحابه) are even giving Daw'ah(دعوة) when they are dying.

So, the king when he saw Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) and his determination he was embarrassed.

You know, he wanted to get out something of Abdullah(عبدالله) he can kill him but he felt that, his pride was insulted.

So, now the issue with the king was not of killing of Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه), his issue was I want to get something out of this man.

He has to give in, he has to give me something.

So, he told Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه), I am going to free you if you just going to kiss my forehead.

Look at this, just kiss my forehead and I will let you go, "Give me something." He is begging Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه), the Roman king,

Give me something! Kiss me on my forehead.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) thought about it and then he said, only if you going to set me free and also set all the Muslim prisoners of war free.

The King said: I agree.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) kissed him and he got all of the Muslims free.

Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) goes back to Madina Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) hears the story.

he goes to the Masjid(مسجد) Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) is there all of the Muslims are there.

He stands up Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; It is an obligation on every Muslim to kiss the forehead of Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه)

and I am going to be the first and he kisses the forehead of Abdullah Bin Hudhafah(عبدالله ابن حدافه) because he saved the Muslims, he saved the Muslim prisoners of war.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) went to meet the reinforcement that was coming from Yemen.

Armies were coming out of Yemen Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) to go and fight and they would pass through Madina on their way to Iraq and Ash-Sham(الشام).

So, Umar(عُمَر) went to greet them and he said; Is Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر) among you?
