So, they were directing him, and Umar(عُمَر) was asking and he was getting closer until he reached to this man.

And he told him; Are you Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر)? He said; "Yes I am." Are you from Muraad(مراد) and then, from Qarn(قرن)?

So, the clan is Muraad(مراد), and the tribe is Qarn(قرن). He said; Yes!

Umar(عُمَر) said; Were you suffering from Leprosy, and then Allah healed you except for a size of a coin?

He said; Yes!

he said: Do you have a mother?

Is your mother alive? He said; Yes!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; I heard Rasool Allah ﷺ say; Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر) is gonna come to you with reinforcements coming from Yemen

and he is from Muraad(مراد) and then from Qarn(قرن), and he used to suffer from Leprosy, and then Allah healed him except the size of a coin.

And he is very kind towards his mother, if you ever meet him, ask him to make Dua(دُعَا) that Allah forgives you.

This is a man, who is not a Sahabi(صحابي).

Even though, he lived in the times of Rasool Allah ﷺ but he could not meet Rasool Allah ﷺ because he had to stay with his mother.

And to be a Sahabi(صحابي) you have to see Rasool Allah ﷺ, you just can’t be a contemporary of Rasool Ullah, you have to see Rasool Ullah.

So, he lost, the opportunity of being a Sahabi(صحابي), why?

Because of his mother, he wanted to stay with his mother.

He lost the opportunity of Fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) because he stayed behind with his mother.

And this is the Hukum(حكم) only with fighting that is offensive not the defensive one obviously.

So, it is quite strange to hear a statement Rasool Allah ﷺ asking the Sahabah(صحابه) to ask somebody, who's not a Sahabi(صحابي) to make Dua(دُعَا) for them,

to ask Allah to forgive them.

But this narration is in Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم).

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), the Khalifah(خليفه), the Ameer-Ul-Mo'mineen(امير المؤمنين) is telling Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر),

Ask Allah to forgive me.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is asking Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر) to make Dua(دُعَا) for him that Allah forgives him.

Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر) is one of the Awliya(اولياء) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Owais Bin Aamir(أويس بن عامر) makes Istighfaar(اِسْتَغْفَار) for Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه and Umar(عُمَر) is the Khalifah(خليفه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "So where do you want to go?" Owais(اويس) said: "I want to go to Al-Koofa(الكوفه).

Umar(عُمَر) said: "Let me write a letter, to the Governor of Kufa(كوفه) to take good care of you." The Khalifah(خليفه), he loves Owais(اويس), he wants to take good care of him.

Owais(اويس) said: "Please don’t! Because I want to live in obscurity, among the layman." I don’t want to be known, I don’t want any special treatment.

I want to be a unknown person Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) and to live with the layman, with the common people.

This is an example of somebody who is Abd(عبد), Taqi(تقي), Khafi(خفي).

Somebody, who has Taqwa(تقوى) and is hidden, nobody knows him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Allahعَزّوجَلّ knows the one, who is not known but has Taqwa(تقوى).

So, he goes to Al-Kufa(الكوفه) and he settles there and nobody knows about him for a year.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) meets with one of the noble men of the tribe of Owais Al-Qarni(اويس القرني), who are with him in Iraq in Kufa(كوفه).

He meets him in Madina, the following year.

So, Umar(عُمَر) is asking him about Owais Al-Qarni(اويس القرني) and nobody knows the special status of Owais(اويس).

So, Umar(عُمَر), the Khalifah(خليفه) is now asking about Owais Al-Qarni(اويس القرني) how is he doing?

So, this man said: I left him in a state of poverty and his house is without furniture, why are you asking about this man, he is a poor man and he has no furniture in his house Allah O Akbar(الله اكبر), he wants to live in obscurity.

If he had that letter from Ameer-Ul-Mo'mineen(امير المؤمنين) he would be living a very comfortable life in Halal(حلال).

But he was happy with, what Allahعَزّوجَلّ has destined for him, he was happy.

He was happy with what Allah gave him, content.

So, now Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) tells the man if you meet him tell him to make a Dua(دُعَا) for you because this is what Rasool Allah ﷺ said about him.

So, the man go back to Owais(اويس) and he said; Ask Allah to forgive me.

Owais(اويس) said: You ask Allah for forgiveness, you just came back from travelling and the Dua(دُعَا) of the traveler is accepted.

He said; No! No! No! I want you to make Istaghfaar(استغفار) for me.

Owais(اويس) thought about and then he said: Did you meet Umar(عُمَر)?

He said; Yes I did.

Owais(اويس) made Istaghfaar(استغفار) for him and the news spread.

Suddenly, they tried, looking for Owais Al-Qarni(اويس القرني) he was nowhere to be found.

He disappeared in order to go and live in obscurity somewhere else.

Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) running away from fame, from recognition.

He didn’t want people to know his Taqwa(تقوي), he didn’t want people to know his status, he just disappeared to live for the sake of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, to fight in Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله)

and to do it for Allah and Allahعَزّوجَلّ to recognize what I have done.

I don’t want recognition from anyone.

We ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to give us Ikhlaas(اخلاص) in everything that we do and in everything that we say.

Another group of Mujahideen(مجاهدين) from Yemen on their way back from Ash-Sham(الشام) to Yemen, they passed through Madina.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه after the early prayer, he would bring out plates of food for the public to eat, for the travelers, for the needy.

This was a public service that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was offering and he would do that and just present the food and, he would serve it to the people

and stand over them to make sure that they are being served well, the Khalifah(خليفه) himself.

So, he sees this man from this group and they are travelling back to Yemen, so they are in Madina, travelers, so he comes and he eats.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him: Eat with your right hand.

He was eating with his left hand, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is doing; And serving, you know so many good deeds at once.

Eat with your right hand, the man ignored Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Umar(عُمَر) told him: Eat with your right hand.

The man said: "O Ameer-Ul-Mo'mineen(امير المؤمنين) my right hand is busy".

So, Umar(عُمَر) left him and when he finished his meal Umar(عُمَر) went to the man and said: "What do you mean your right hand is busy?" So, the man pulls out his right arm and there was no right hand.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "مَا هَذَا؟" "What is this?" The man said: "I lost my right hand, when I was fighting in the Battle of Yarmook(يرموك)."

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), the man didn’t want to show off, in front of people that he has lost his arm in Jihad(جهاد).

And he only did it, when the Khalifah(خليفه) insisted.

The Khalifah(خليفه) asked him first time, he ignored, second time, he said my right hand is busy, third time he just pulls out his arm and shows it to the Khalifah(خليفه).

Look at the Ikhlaas(اخلاص) this man had.

But then look at the question of Umar(عُمَر).

What would you expect Umar(عُمَر) to ask?

You know! It shows you what was on the mind of the Sahabah(صحابه).

He said: "So, do you make a Wudhu(وضؤ)?" Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Ya'ani(يعني) you know, that’s the first thing that is triggered in the mind of Umar(عُمَر).

How you make Wudhu(وضؤ)?

How do you prepare for the Salah(صلاة)?

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was talking to the Sahabah(صحابه) about Ad-Dajjal(الدجال) and he said: That one day is equal to a year and next day is equal to a month,

the third day is equal to a week and then the other days are like your regular days.

What did the Sahabah(صحابه) say?

O Rasool Allah ﷺ how come it's equal to a year?

Is it because of the rotation of the globe, did it stopped?

Can you give us a scientific explanation for that, how will the weather be?

What did the Sahabah(صحابه) say?

What was their concern? Look at the question, that the Sahabah(صحابه) asked. They said; O Rasool Ullah that day which is as long as a year, is it enough to pray the five daily prayers as if it is a one day?

So, the first thing that came to their minds was Salah(صلاة).

How will we pray when that day is a yearlong?

So, Umar(عُمَر) now when he saw his right hand missing he said, how do you make your Wudhu(وضؤ)?

And it also shows you the care that Umar(عُمَر) had.

The man said: I make Wudhu(وضؤ) with my left hand.

And Allah is the One, Who gives help.

He said: "So where are you going to?" He said: "I am going back to Yemen!

to visit my mother because I haven’t seen her for few years.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "And you are also so kind towards your mother." Come with me.!

And he gives him a servant and he gives him five camels and he tells him, you now, welcome to leave.

This is the care that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه had, for the ones, who sacrificed for the sake of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) knew what was most worthy and most valuable.

And he wanted to give the Sahabah(صحابه) a lesson.

So, they were sitting in a room and he said, Taman'nao(تَمَنَّوْا), Make a wish?

One of the Sahabah(صحابه) said: "I wish that this room would be filled with gold, so that I can spend it in the path of Allah".

He said: Taman'nao(تَمَنَّوْا), Make a wish?

Another Sahabi(صحابي) he said: "I wish this room would be filled with jewels and gems, so that I can spend it in the path of Allah".

He said: "Make a wish?" They said: "O Ameer-Ul-Mo'mineen(امير المؤمنين) we don’t know what to say?" Filled this room with what?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "My wish is that Allahعَزّوجَلّ fills this room with the likes of Abu Obaidah Amr Ibn Jarrah(ابو عبيدة عمرو بن جراح),

so that I can send them Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله)".

I wish this room is full of men like Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and in another narration Abu Obaidah(ابوعبيدة) and Mua’dh Ibn Jabal(معاذ ابن جبل),

so that I can send them in path of Allah.

Umar(عُمَر) is telling us, and telling them that your human resources are more important than your financial resources.

They are more important than your bricks and mortar.

They are more important than everything that you have.

It is your human resources that count.

Rasool Allah ﷺ when he passed away, he didn’t leave behind any glamorous buildings.

The Masjid(مسجد) of Madina was mud, and the floor was sand, and the roof was palm leaves, and it would drip water on them when it rained.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not paved any roads.

He didn’t established a financial network of business, he didn’t leave behind books.

All what Rasool Allah ﷺ left behind was Qur’an and he left it behind not in Mus'haf(مصحف), not in books but he left it behind ingrained in the hearts of Sahabah رضي الله عنهم .

That was the product that Rasool Allah ﷺ left behind.

That was the effort of the Daw'ah(دعوة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he left behind the Sahabah(صحابه).

And every blessing that we enjoy today is a result of that.

The religion didn’t spread that much in the times of Rasool Allah ﷺ it spread in the times of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and Umar(عُمَر).

It spread in the Khalifah(خليفه) of Bannu Umayyah(بَنُو اُمَيَّه) and Bannu Abbas(بنو عباس).

In the times of Rasool Allah ﷺ Islam was limited to the Arabian Peninsula.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, the Sahabah(صحابه) that he trained in the Madina or in Makkah were not many a Hundred or Hundred plus.

The ones, who gave Bay’ah(بيعة) to him, in Bay’ah-Tur-Ridhwan(بيعة الرضوان) Fourteen Hundred (1’400).

The ones who made a Hajj(حَجْ) Wada’a(وداع) with him, were Ninety Thousand(90,000).

So, these are the ones, who are close to the Rasool Allah ﷺ but then the last year of the life of Rasool Allah ﷺ the tribes were becoming Muslim

but they didn’t really study much under Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, the Hundred and Twenty Four Thousand (124’000) that prayed Janazah(جنازه) on Rasool Allah ﷺ not all of them very close to him.

Really the core group was about a Hundred.

These were the ones, who started off with him in Makkah.

But every one of these men you could just throw them anywhere in this world and just leave them, leave them alone, they would take care of their religion.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is saying, I want such men like Abu Obaidah(ابو عبيدة) and Mua’dh Ibn Jabal(معاذ ابن جبل), so that I can send them out Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

So, the Tarbiyya(تربيعة) is the most important thing, it's more important than your buildings, your institutions, the most important thing is the Tarbiyya(تربيعة) and that is how Islam will carry on.

In Al-Andalus(الاندلس) they had the greatest buildings.

They had the greatest Mosques, fabulous, Jami’a-Al-Qurtabah(جامع قرطبه) was the largest Masjid(مسجد) in the Muslim World until recently.

Until the final expansion of Masjid-An-Nabawi(مسجدالنبوي), the Jami’a-Al-Qurtabah(جامع قرطبه) was the largest Masjid(مسجد) in the Islamic World.

But the Muslims left it, they have left it behind why?

Because their hearts were weak.

They had strong buildings, the buildings stayed behind Spain is making a lot of money out of those buildings today, but the hearts were weak.

The Muslims lost it on the moral front.

Al-Ikhlaaq(الاخلاق), in the Eeman(ايمان) front before they lost it in the battle field.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) again, he used to give the appropriate status to people.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان), Suhail-Ibn-Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو) two leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and Sohaib(صهيب) and Bilal(بلال) two former slaves from the Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Sohaib(صهيب) the Roman and Bilal(بلال) the Abyssinian, the African, were standing outside the office of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) seeking permission to get in.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) allows Sohaib(صهيب) and Bilal(بلال) the slaves to come in Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) and Suhail(سهيل) to wait outside until he finishes with Bilal(بلال) and Sohaib(صهيب) first.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) complained, he said: "I have never seen a day like this.

He allows these slaves to go in before us?" Suhail(سهيل) said: "I can see your anger but you should be angry with no one but your own self, their own selves.

Rasool Allah ﷺ invited you and invited them and they came fast but you were slow.

And what will you do on the day of judgment?

When they will be invited before you and you will be waiting." This is not really a big deal now, we are standing outside the office of a Khalifah(خليفه),

what will happen on the day of Judgment, when these men would be invited to Jannah(جنة) before you?

You ought to cry because of your joining the caravan too late.

And that holds true all the time, that holds true all the time.

If you are joining in too late you are missing a lot, you are missing a lot.

So, don’t miss the train. Don’t let the caravan leave without you.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was in the court and Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) and another man came to him, they had a dispute.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had Ali(علي) and that other man sit down.

And then he said, to Ali(علي), "Ya Abal-Hassan(يا اباالحسن)"  O father of Al-Hassan(الحسن), go ahead with your side of the story and Kuniya(كنية) is a way of respect.

He said: Abal-Hassan(اباالحسن), he is giving him his Kuniya(كنية).

And then he asked the other man for his opinion.

The face of Ali(علي) changed.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: It seems that you are upset because I have equaled you to this man?

And Wallahu ‘Alam(ولله اعلم) as I have heard but it's not in the references that I have looked up that this other man was a Jew.

He said: "O Ali(علي), it seems that you are upset.

Because I am putting you on the same footing as this man.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) relative of Rasool Allah ﷺ, the husband of Fatima(فاطمه), the father of Al-Hassan wal Hussain(الحسن ولحسين).

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said: "No that’s not why I am upset.

I am upset because you called me with my Kuniya(كنية) and you didn’t call him by his Kuniya(كنية)." I am upset because you actually preferred me over him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; I ask Allah, never to allow me to live in a land, if Abal-Hassan(اباالحسن) is not around.

I ask Allah not to allow me to live in a land, if Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) is not next to me.

He was grateful to Ali(علي) that he had this sense of justice, he doesn’t even want to be given that preference.

It's not really preference, it doesn’t affect the ruling at all but he doesn’t want to be spoken to in a different tone then this other man.

We are talking about justice that to us is just an imaginary world because we don’t have anything to relate to now.

We are living in systems that are so far away from ‘Adl(عدل) that we find it hard to grasp, what we're talking about.

THE NEXT SECTION Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) again had this reverence, dignity, presence, his presence was felt by everybody around him.

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) says, that the barber of Umar(عُمَر) was cutting his hair and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) coughed, so the man did it on himself.

He was so afraid, because of the coughing of Umar(عُمَر).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), when he knew that he gave him Forty Dinar.

People used to have fear from Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Since, he was young he used to beat the kids with his stick and we talked about this woman who had a miscarriage.

There are two version of that narration, I already mentioned to you one right?

Did I mentioned about the woman, who had a miscarriage?

The other version of this is that, there was this woman and the men were talking about her Allah O Alam(الله اعلم) what that exactly meant?

But Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wanted to investigate the matter, how come men are talking about this woman.

So, he calls her in, when they told her that Umar(عُمَر) wants to meet you, she said: "Woe to me! What does Umar(عُمَر) want to talk to me about?"

She was so terrified that she is going to go and meet the Khalifah(خليفه) and when she was walking, she had a miscarriage and the child came out

and he cried in the beginning and then he died.

And he had to pay blood money because of that.

So, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان), Zubair Bin Awwam(ألزبير بن عوام), Talha Bin Obaidallah(طلحه بن عبيدالله),

Sa’ad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدابن ابي وقاص) and Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) they all came together for meeting. What were they discussing?

They said: Somebody needs to go and talk to the Khalifah(خليفه) and tell him that people are terrified.

And the boldest among them, in talking with Umar(عُمَر) was Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف), he was the boldest among the group.

So, they sent him, they said you go and talk to him.

Now, it wasn’t easy, Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) said; I had a question to ask Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and I waited for an entire year.

I couldn’t have the courage to go ahead and ask him, for entire year I was waiting.

So, Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) he went to Umar(عُمَر) and he told him that people are afraid of you, people fear you.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Tell me the truth Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن).

Did Uthman(عثمان), Ali(علي), Sa’ad(سعد), Az-Zubair(الزبير) were some of them send you here to talk to me about this?

He said: Yes they did.

Umar(عُمَر) had a feeling.

Then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "O Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) In the name of Allah, I try to be so soft with them until, I felt that Allah will punish me because of that softness

and then I became harsh until, I was afraid that Allah would punish me for my harshness.

O Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن)! Tell me what to do.

Tell me what to do, I am doing my best" I am trying to be soft but then I am afraid Allah will punish me for that, I am trying to be harsh and straight and I am afraid that Allah will punish me for that,

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) started crying and then he walked out and he was saying; "Woe to them after you! Woe to them after you! Woe to them after you!"

Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) was crying so hard, he was saying who will take care of this Ummah(امة) after you leave?

Who will have a heart like you after you leave?

Who will be so concerned about the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ like you, after you leave?

And he left and he was crying.

Because he felt the sincerity of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he felt how sincere Umar(عُمَر) was.

Umar(عُمَر) was telling him, tell me what to do, I am trying my best.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would see how people would fear him, he would say: "O Allah, You know that I fear You more than they fear me".

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was so concerned with the welfare of his people.

He told one of his employees: O Hani(هاني)! Be soft with the Muslims and beware of the Dua(دُعَا) of a oppressed because Allah will accept it and he said,

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) took over some pasture land, this pasture land belonged to some Arab Tribes but he took it over why? Because he wanted to be a common pasture land for everyone.

And he would have the camels and horses of Jihad(جهاد) also feed from that pasture land.

"So, he told his servant and I want you to make sure that the Camels of Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and the Camels of Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) do not feed from that pasture land,

because if there camels die they have something to fall back on, they have farms that will be enough for them but the poor man, who has one camel or one sheep if their cattle die,

then they are going to come to me with their children and say woe to you?

Who do you want me to leave these children to?

Who will take care of these children and it is easier for me to provide them with grass and water then for me to provide them with gold and silver."

Umar(عُمَر) is saying, is this land it is easier for me to provide them with pasture land and water, right?

But if, you prevent them from that pasture land from their grass and water their cattle would die and then they would come and ask me for gold and silver to feed their children

and it is easier for me to have their cattle graze than to have me to take care of  their children.

And he is saying keep the camels of Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) away because these were the millionaires.

They can go back to their farm lands, so don't let them use this common pasture land.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ has blessed the wealth of Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان), so much Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله).

Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) he comes from Makkah to Madina broke, he has nothing and then he was put into brotherhood, you know the Akhuwah(اخوة)

that was between Muhajireen(مهاجرين) and Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار), him and Sa'ad Bin 'Ubadah(سعد ابن عبادة).

So, Sa'ad Bin 'Ubadah(سعد ابن عبادة) told him, O Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن)! I have two wives and I am a wealthy businessman, I will give you half of my wealth and you choose whichever of my two wives

you want, I will divorce her and you can marry her, amazing sacrifice!.

Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) said, May Allah bless your wives and your wealth, I do not need either.

All that I want from you is to show me market place of Madina.

Where is the market place?

He gives him the directions and Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) starts from scratch.

A short while later Rasool Allah ﷺ sees Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف).

In those days the women would use this yellow powder for a make-up.

In Arabic it's called horud(هُرُدْ), I don't remember the translation of it in English, it's actually a spice but it's yellowish in color and they would use it as make-up.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ sees Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) with this make-up on his face, it's not for men, this is for a women.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ tells him what's this on your face?

Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) said: I got married.

You know, it's like a lipstick proof.

So he had that make-up on his face, so Rasool Allah ﷺ said: What is this? He said: I got married.

So, he said: What did you pay her as a Mahr(مهر)?

Because he know that Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) came broke, he had nothing.

Rasool Ullah wanted to get to know how did he get married?

He said: Yes I had paid her Mahr(مهر), this amount of gold.

He has already made enough money that he was giving Mahr(مهر) in gold.

So, he was a man, who could put his hand on rocks and they would turn into gold, blessed.

Allah has blessed the Rizq(رزق) of Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and so was the case with Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان).

So, Umar(عُمَر) is saying keep their camels away Allah has blessed their wealth don't worry about them.

And then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; And he is talking about this poor man, who would come with his goat and camel and he said;

In the name of Allah, they think that, I have oppressed them, this was their land, they fought over this land in Jahiliyah(جاهليه) and when they became Muslim they became Muslim over this land

and now I have took away from them and in the name of Allah, if it wasn't because of the money that I am getting for it to send out the armies to fight in the path of Allahعَزّوجَلّ,

I wouldn't have taken an inch of their land.

If it wasn't because I want to send out the armies Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) I wouldn't have taken away that land, it belongs to them.

And this shows you the importance that Umar(عُمَر) was placing on Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

He was investing for that.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would teach the leaders lessons, he would teach the leaders lesson.

Umar(عُمَر) received a complaint from the people in Makkah that Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) is building a house and he is preventing the passage of water to come to us.

So, Umar(عُمَر) goes to him, this is in Makkah and Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) is standing there and they are building this house for him.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) with his stick he points to this rock and he says, take away that rock, so he takes away, take this one away,

take this one, and Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) is bending down and taking it away.

Then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Al-Hamdolillah(الحمدلله), who put Umar(عُمَر) in a position to give orders to Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان)

in Makkah and Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) obeys him.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) at one point of time was a leader of Makkah.

The indisputable leader of Makkah.

He was the leader of the armies, against Rasool Allah ﷺ he comes from the noble family of Bannu Umayyah(بَنُواُمَيَّه).

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was Umair(عمير), he comes from the small clane of Bannu Odaey(بنو عديئ).

He couldn't have dreamt of becoming one day a leader.

And now, Umar(عُمَر) is giving instructions to Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان). Do this, do that.

He said: Al-Hamdolillah(الحمدلله), Who put me in this position to bring justice.

Oyainah bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن) again, this man, this Bedouin leader.

He was sitting with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and there was a commoner, a lay man, poor man, Bedouin sitting there and he is talking so Oyainah(عيينه) makes fun of him and ridicules that man.

So, the man starts responding back, Oyainah(عيينه) cuts him off and says: Who are you to talk to me in such manner?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) interrupted Oyainah(عيينه) and said; "That you need to be humble in Islam and in the name of Allah I am not going to allow you out

until, this man makes Shafa'a(شفاع) for you.

You're going to have to please him and make him appeal for you, so that I will be please with you.

Now, Oyainah(عيينه) has to beg this man for forgiveness and ask him to make an appeal for him with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

He said: You need to be humble in Islam, don't have this pride, don't be arrogant you are Muslim now, throw this arrogance away.

SOME OF THE AMR BIL-MAROOF WA NAHI ANIL MUNKAR(امر بالمعروف ونهي عن المنكر) OF UMAR BIN KHATTAB رضي الله عنه Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw a man and woman talking,

it was at night talking in the public in street of Madina.

He came with a stick and hit the man.

So, the man said: What did I do wrong?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: Why are you talking with this woman in the street?

The man said: This is my wife.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; You shouldn't be talking to her like that when there is nobody around because this is going to make people slander you.

She is in Hijab(حجاب) people cannot see her, they don't know who she is.

So, people are going to slander you.

Yes she is your wife, and you have absolutely the right to talk to her, where ever you want.

However, is going to cause people to slander you.

Let me continue then we will talk about the lessons.

So, the man said: O Ameer-Ul-Mo'mineen(امير المؤمنين)! We just arrived to Madina, these were foreigners and we were discussing, where to stay?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) gave him the stick and said: Hit me, hit me back.

The man said: I won't, he said hit me back three times and the man said: No! I forgive you.

Number 1.

We shouldn't put ourselves in positions that would give people an excuse to talk about us.

It is absolutely fine for him to do that.

Rasool Allah ﷺ he was once it was night and he was speaking to Safiyah(صفيه), his wife and there was nobody around.

So, two Sahabah(صحابه) were passing by and Rasool Ullah stopped them and He said: Come here! This is my wife Safiyah(صفيه).

They said; O messenger of Allah we wouldn't have any doubts in you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I don’t want Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) to come to you.

So, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) plays games.

A person could be absolutely innocent but because you see them in certain posture, place, condition, you become suspicious, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) comes to you and builds up a scenario

and then you go and tell it to somebody and they add some salt and pepper to it.

And then it goes to the next person, and they load it with spices.

And then it goes to the next person and suddenly the story is blown out of proportion, Chinese whisper, that’s a game of Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

It is wrong for the people to slander you.

It is wrong! Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was not saying that the people have the right to make a Gheebah(غيبه) but Umar(عُمَر) is saying, these are people.

People are people and they are going to commit these sins don't put yourself in that situation.

The second thing, look at the innocence and the purity of Madina, Allah!!! what if Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would see for example London underground

and how people behave there as if they are their private bedroom.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw a man talking to a woman in the street and he didn't like that.

We have become desensitized.

You know we see the haram(حرام) and it doesn't affect us anymore.

Umar(عُمَر) didn't like what he saw.

We see all of this haram(حرام) around us.

Billboards, TV, newspapers, you see it on the streets, and it's going to get worse, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; " A time will come when a man and woman would commit a Zinah(زناء) on the street

and the best of people would be, the one to tell them, can you please move a side".

Not telling them to stop the Haram(حرام) but just move a side.

These are the times of Fittan(فتن) but it is not that much different in some western countries.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) it's leaving a bad effect on us.

We ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to pure our hearts from this Fahisha(فاحشه) and to keep us away from the Fitnah(فتنه)." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw a man begging

and he had some sacks of food hanging to his shoulders.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) grab the food and he gave it to the camel of Sadaqah(صدقه) and said: Go and beg if you want.

You are begging and you already have food with you.

Why are you begging?

He takes it away from him.

So, next time you see the beggar take that plate with all the coins in it and tell them to beg not, don't do that.

Becareful don’t do that.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw a man walking lazily with pride.

His hands and feet are swinging around.

I can may imagine like rappers would walk.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he uses his Durrah(دُرَّة).

Stop walking like that.

The man said: I can't! He said: You can't?

He teaches him a second lesson, so he changes the way he walks and then he came back and he said, Alhamdulillah(الحمدلله) to you Umar(عُمَر), that was a Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) that left me.

He said: I changed my ways.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw another man who was pretending to be a good Muslim.

Pretending to be a Abid(عابد).

You know some people, they could be full of energy, explosive, active, hyper active, when they are not practicing, on the street, street boys,

and then they start practicing Islam, and somehow they get into some brands of Islam, that teach them that, you need to be passive, you need to cool down.

So, they start dressing differently, and when they walk now, they walk as if they are dead.

Like Zombies coming out of graves, and they dangle their hands, and their eyes become very dizzy, and they talk softly, and when they come and give you Salam(سلام),

and they bend over like that and fall down and they become very, very, very, soft and they think that, that is Zuhd(زهد).

So, a woman saw such men after the times of Umar(عُمَر), when Umar(عُمَر) has already passed away.

She said: Who are these? They said: These are Nastik(ناستك) they were walking like this and dressed in different clothes and walkingdown the streets lazily.

She said: These are Nustak(نستاك) these are people, who devoted themselves to worshipping Allah.

She said: No they are not.

The real Nasik(ناسك) was Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

And Umar(عُمَر) when he would walk he would walk fast, and when he would talk you would definitely hear him, and when he strikes, he strikes hard.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) actually in his life time he saw one of these men, walking down the street.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he didn't even talk to him he went straight up to him started beating him and said; Do not make our religion dead, may Allah give you death.

You are killing our religion, you are making our religion a religion of passiveness, religion of laziness.

What is this way of walking?

You know pretending to be humble.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted this Ummah(امة) to be strong.

He wanted the Ummah(امة) to be an Ummah(امة) of fighters Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) people who would spread the religion Fee-Sabeel-Lillah عَزّوجَلّ.

He didn't want to deal with people who are chicken, who are weak, who are feeble, he wanted a strong Ummah(امة) and that is the teaching of Islam.

The strong believer is better in the eyes of Allah then the weak believer.

So, this is a religion of strength.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ tells Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); "Take what we have given you with strength".

Take what we have given you Al-Kitab(الكتاب) with strength.

So, this is not a religion of weakness.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would encourage exercise and he didn't like obesity.

He was against obesity, in fact he said, O people beware of over eating.

Because it makes you lazy in your Salah(صلاة).

It makes your body weak.

And it makes you un healthy.

And Allah dislikes the obese man.

And you should be modest in your food.

Because that is closer to righteousness and further from access.

And it makes you stronger in worshipping Allah.

And you will perish when your desires become more likable to you then Allahعَزّوجَلّ or your religion.

When your desires become dearer to you then your religion that is when you would perish.

When we talk about obesity we're talking about obesity caused by over eating not by health reasons.

Some people genetically have that, this is not talking about that.

I don’t want anybody to assume that because Allah created them like that Allah does not like them.

This is talking about obesity that is caused by over eating and that is unhealthy.

If you are overweight even if it is caused by genetic reasons try to lose weight.

Try to lose weight and exercise.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) saw a man with a big belly.

You know they say, don't take this saying for granted, they say the signs of dignity and wisdom are three.

The moustache, the bald head and a big belly.

Obviously that’s not true.!

It say that you need to have a belly as big as when you want to scratch it, you have to extend your hand as far as you can.

That's a big belly.

In our old books in Al-Mustazraf(المستذرف) it says that, they asked a Bedouin when do you know, when you are full?

When you do you know, when you have eaten enough?

He said: When I can't tell the difference between the heavens and earth, and I can't tell the difference between Nafl(نفل) and Fard(فرض), and I can't tell the difference between length and height that is when I had enough food.

So, a man came to Umar(عُمَر) and he had a big belly, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) told him what is this?

He said: This is بركة من الله، this is a blessings from Allah, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: No! It’s a punishment from Allah.

This is not a blessing this a punishment What are you doing dragging that thing, in front of you?

So, obviously this is something for the brothers, they are the ones who tend to have big bellies, try to exercise brothers.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) says; Teach your children swimming and Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) swimming is the best exercise for toning your muscles,

swimming, target shooting and riding horses.

REPEAT PLZ DELETE IT Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) by the way he had some amazing teachings.

He sent a letter to the Sahabah(صحابه), up north in Azerbaijan.

He got a sense that may be they are getting into comfortable life.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was developing, no he wasn't developing he was carrying on, the military tradition that was started by Rasool Allah ﷺ

men are suppose to be soldiers and live a military life.

That was the life of Sahaba رضي الله عنهم it wasn't a civilian life.

It was a life a soldier, a life of a military.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was getting a sense that may be some of them are settling down to civilian life.

They were leaving the life of Murabiteen(مرابطين) so, Umar(عُمَر) sends them a letter. He says, Be rough, and tough, and follow the way of your father.

Follow the way of your forefathers.

Therefore, fathers even though they were living in the time of Jahiliyah(جاهليه) but they were the men of desert, and he said: Wear the clothes of your father Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل),

the Izaar(ازار) and stay away from the clothes of Al-'Ajam(العجم), stay away from the clothes of non-Arabs.

The non-Arabs in those days were the people of the civilization, the Roman and Persian Empire.

So, they have very comfortable, expensive, luxurious clothes.

While the Arabs were the poor people of the world they came from the desert.

He said: Stay away from the clothes of the non-Muslims and wear that clothes of your fathers.

And then he said, and I want you to go with a bare top.

They use to have two pieces of Izaar(ازار) one to cover the top and one to cover the bottom.

He said: Go with the bare top. Take the one on the top off.

And I  want you to walk bare foot, take your shoes off and walk bare foot and And stand under the sun because it is the bathing of the Arabs and he said,

And I want you to walk fast and run between the targets.

In those days the target shooting practice, the Archery.

They would set two targets, alright!

They would stand next to the first target and they would shoot their arrows at this target and then they would walk to the second target, pick up their arrows and shoot the first target.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: I want you to walk fast between the targets.

Not only, are you training but I also want you to exercise walk fast.

So, Hudhaifah Bin Yaman(حذيفه بن يمان), he would run and then he said; And I want you to jump on the horses while the horses are running.

These are lessons that he is sending it to his Military Generals.

The generals with the stars, who tends to develop big belly this is how, I want you to live.

When he says, you walk bare foot, it doesn't mean that you walk bare foot all the time but sometimes to get that training.

To not always be under the shade, go under the sun, you are already dark you will going to become darker that’s alright.

You will get married don't worry.

You will find a wife, it's alright.

Maybe the sister won't believe us but sometimes brothers would intentionally stay indoors, so that they wouldn't develop a tan.

Stand under the sun because it is Humaam Al-Arab(حمام العرب) this is the bath of Arabs.

You know the other have these luxurious baths, the Greek, the Roman.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is saying our bath is the sun.

These were the strict orders to keep the military tradition alive.

So he wanted them to be active.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was told about a man of strength strong man, who helps against the enemies of Allahعَزّوجَلّ but he had a problem.

He used to be an alcoholic, a Muslim in the times of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), loves Islam but he is addicted to alcohol.

So, they came to the Khalifah(خليفه) and said: What should we do?

He said, Give me the pen and paper.

He with his own hands, he writes a letter to him.

He says: Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) to so and so, peace be upon you, Salaam Alaika(سلام عليك).

I praise Allah to you that there is no god but He, and then he writes down to him first three Ayats of Surah Ghafir(سورة الغافر).

Ha Meem "حم" The revelation of this book is from Allah, Exalted in Power full of knowledge.

Who forgives sins, accepts repentance, He is strict in punishment and has a long reach in all things there is no god but He to Him is the final goal.

So, the man reads these Ayaat(آيات), the Ayaat(آيات) are saying Allah is forgiving and it also says that Allah has a severe punishment.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) gave this letter and said; Make sure that when you deliver it to him he is sober because he was drunk most of the times.

Make sure when you deliver it to him he is sober.

So, they go to him and they gave him the letter and he reads it and he says, Allah-O-Akbar(الله اكبر).

Allah is forgiving, Allah is merciful but Allah's punishment is severe and he cries and he makes Tawbah(توبه).

When Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wrote the letter he asked everyone present to make Dua(دُعَا) for that man and Allahعَزّوجَلّ accepted their Dua(دُعَا) and he repented.

When the news was brought back to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, he said; He said: This is how you treat one of you when they make a mistake

and you should make a Dua(دُعَا) for them and you should not assist Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) against them.

"Don't Assist Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) against your Brothers".

By boycotting them, by being harsh against them, you are only turning them away from Islam.

And I think that and I am going to close it with this, I think that this is very important story for the Muslims in the West.

There are Muslims who are on drugs, there are Muslims who drink.

There are Muslims who commit Zina(زنا).

Some of them want to get out of it and they are sincere but they are stuck because of the addiction it takes over and they are unable to break free.

If you are harsh with them, you are only going to make it worse, you have to lend them a helping hand.

And you have to be accommodating and don't be idealistic.

Don't say that because this is haram(حرام), these are Fusaaq(فساك), these are sinners, these are corrupt keep them away from our Masajid(مساجد), stay away from them,

don't talk to them, if you don't then Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) will talk to them.

So, hold your brothers and sisters by the hand and deliver them out of their misery.

They don't like it, many of them don't, who love! Who would love drugs?

When they know how it messes up their lives.

How it takes them out of their humanity, who would love to live like that?

But you need to help them.

We are talking about the time of Sahabah(صحابه) and they were understanding, they were understanding, and that is "The Best Generation".

They weren't idealistic, they didn't say, No! this man, he should be punished and throw him in jail, boycott him, No! He said: Lets help him.

So, please help your brothers and sisters because they are in great need.

We ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to help us all, we ask Allah to grant us Tawbah(توبه), to accept our deeds, to forgive us, to reward us with Jannah(جنة), we seek refuge in Him from Hellfire.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ الله

قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا مَنْ جهَّزَ غَازِيًا في سبيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ غَزَا، ومنْ خَلَفَ غَازيًا في أَهْلِهِ بخَيْر فَقَدْ غزَا

كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِمَا تُطَلِّقُهَا؟

اَوَ كُلْ اَلْبُيُوْتَ بُنِيَتَ عَلَى الْحُبَّ؟

فَاَيْنَ رِّعَائِيَةْ ؟

"فَاَيْنَ رِّعَائِيَةْ ؟" مُوَّدَّةْ وَ رَحْمَةَ نَثَّمَا تُسَّبِحُ الله سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

قَلَّا خَيْرُه’ وَ كَثُرَ شَرُّهُُ اَنَا رَجُلٌ بَقِيْ يَا عَدُّوَتْ نَفْسَهَا اَحْسَنِيْ صُحْبَتْ هَذَا الشَّيْخ وَاللهِ لَا اِنْ سَلَّمَنِيَّ الله لَا اَدَعَنَّ اَرَامِ لَا اَهْلِ الّاعراق لَا يَحْتَجْنَ اِلَى اَحَدٍ بَعْدِيْ

لَقَدْ اَطَعَّبْتَ مَنْ جَاءَ بَعْدَكْ يُنْزِلَ االنَّاسْ مَنَازِلَهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ مَحَقِّ الرِّجَالْ لَعَلَّكَ الرَاَيْتَه’ يُصَلِّيْ قَائِمًا وَ قَاعِدَةْ

فَاِنَّ اسَفَرْ وَالْاِغْتٍرَابْ مَحَقِّ الرِجَالْ اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ سَرِيْرَتَنَا خَيْرًا مِنْ عَلى نِيَّتِنَا فَلَا اُبَالِيْ اِذَنْ يَبِيْعُوْنَا دِيْنَهُمْ بِعَرْضِ مِّنَّ الدُّنْيَاء قَلِيْلَ

فُزْتُ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةْ أَفِيْكُمْ اويس ابن عامر ؟

مِنْ مُرَادْ ثُمَّ مِنْ قَرْن؟

يَأْتِيْكُمْ اَويس بن عامر فِيْ اَمْدَادِ الْيَمَنْ، مِنْ مُرَادْ ثُمَّ مِنْ قَرْنََ فَاِذَا فَاِنِ اسْتَطَعَّتْ فَسْئَلْه’ اَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَهْ لَكْ

اَسْتَغْفِرْلِي Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله).

اِنَّ اللهَ يُحِبَّ الْعَبْدِ تَّقِيْ اَلْخَفِيْ تَرَكْتُه’ رَفْثِ الْبَيْت، قَلِيْلَ الْاَثَاثْ اويس اِسْتَغْفِرْلِيْ اَمَرْ بِالْمَعْرُوْفَ، وَنَهِي الْمُنْكَرْ

يا رسول الله ذَالِكَ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِيْ كَسَنَعَتَكْ فِيْنَا فِيْه الصَلوةَ اليَوْمَ؟

وَالله! هُوَ الْمُعِيْنْ لَا اَبَقَانِيَ  اللهُ بِاَرْضٍ لَيْسَ فِيْهَا اَبَا الْحَسَنْ يَاهَنِيْ اُضْمُمْ جَنَاحَكَ عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَتَّقِيْ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُوْمِ  فَاِنَّهَا مُسْتَجَابَ

وَإِيَّايَ وَنَعَمْ اِبْن عَوْف وَاِبْنِ عَفَّان، فَاِنَّهُمَا اِنْ تَهْلَكْ مَاشِئَتَ هُمَا  يَرْجِعَانِيْ اِلَى زَرْعٍ وَ نَخْلٍ وَاِنَّ رَبَّ سُّرَيْمَ وَالْغُنَيْمَ اِنْ تَهْلَكْ مَاشِئَتُهُمَا يَأْتِيْنِيْ بِبَنِيْهِ فَيَقُوْلُ يا امير المؤمنين

اَفَاتَارِكْهُمْ اَنَا لَا اَبَالَكْ، فَلْمَا وَلْكَلَا اَيْسَرا عَلَيَ مِنَّ لذَّهْبِ وَالْفِضَّةْ بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِيْ مَالِكَ وَ اَهْلِكْ

دُلَّنِيْ عَلى سُوْقِ الْمَدِيْنَةَ ؟

وَاَيْمُ الله؟ اِنَّهُمْ لَا يَرَوْنَ، اَنِّيْ ظَلَمْتَهُمْ اِنَّهَا لَا بِلَادُهُمْ قَاتَلُوْ عَلَيْهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةْ وَاَسْلَمُوْا عَلَيْهَا فِي الْاِسْلَامْ

اَلْحَمْدُ لله اَلَّذِيْ جَعَلَ عُمر يَأْمُرُ اَبَى سُفِيَان بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةْ فَيُطِيْعُوْا ؛ (اعوذ بالله) لَا تُمِتْ عَلَيْنَا دِيْنَنَا اَمَاتَكَ الله

اَلْمُؤمِنَ الْقَوِّيْ خَيْرُا اَحَبِّ اِلَى الله مِنَ الْمُؤمِنَ الضَّعِيْفْ خُذُوْا مَا آتَيْنَكُمْ بِقُوَّةْ And Allahعَزّوجَلّ tells Yahyaعليه السّلام,

يَا يَحْيى خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةْ اَيُّهَا النَّاسْ اِيَّاكُمْ وَالْبِطْنَهْ عَنِ الطَعَامْ فَاِنَّهَا مَكْسَلَةٌ عَنَّ الصَّلوةْ مَفْسَدَهْ الِلْجِسْمْ

وَمُوْرِثَ الِسَّقَمْ وَاِنَّ الله يَبْغَضُ الْحَبْرَصَ ثَمِيْنْ وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقَصْدِ فِيْ قُوْتِكُمْ فَاِنَّه’ اَدْنَى مِنَّ الصَّلَاحِ وَ بَعْدَ عَنِ السَّرَفْ

وَاَقْوَى عَلى عِبَادَةِ الله عزوجل وَلَنْ يَهْلَكَ عَبْدٌ حَتى يُئْثِرَةْ شَهْوَاتُه’ عَلى دِيْنِه حِيْنَ لَا اُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَ السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضْ، وَطُّوْلِ مِنَ الّعَرْضْ، وَالنَّفْلِ مِنَّ الْفَرْضَ

عَلِّمُ اَوْلَادَكُمُ السِّبَاحْ وَرِمَايَا وَرَكُوْبِ الْخَيْلَ "إِخْشَوْشَنُوْا" "وَتَمَعْدَدُوْا" عَلَيْكُمْ بِالشَّمْسِ فَاِنَّ حَمَامٌ العَرَبْ

وَسْعَوْا بَيْنَ الْاَغْرَاضْ غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ۝

هَكَذَا فَسْمَعُ اِذَا رَاَيْتُمْ اَحَدُكُمْ ذَلَّةْ فَصَدِدُه’ وَدْعُوْلَه’ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْ اَعْوَانً لِّشَّيَاطِيْنِ عَلَيْه وَصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

parts.english:
This is beginning of our second week In Sha Allah Ta'ala(إن شاءالله تعالى) on the series of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

On Friday we were talking about some of the freedoms that were granted by the Khalifah(خليفه).

We move on to the freedom of property or Hurriyyat-Tamalluk(حريةالتملك) but in English we would call it, Property Rights.

It's more of right then freedom(of property), it's rights.

And the Khilafah(خلافة) granted the Muslims  property rights and not only that but sometimes, it would give out, hand out to the citizens, property.

Such was the case with Rasool Allah ﷺ who gave Bilal Ibn Rabah رضي الله عنه a large piece of land, very large piece of land.

Now, since the population was expanding, and the size of the Khilafah(خلافة) was expanding and number of Muslims was going up, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, he went to Bilal Ibn Rabah(بلال ابن رباح), and he told him,

Rasool Allah ﷺ has given you a large piece of land and you are unable to cultivate it all, it was either pasture land or it was agricultural land,

and Bilal(بلال) wasn't able to invest all of that land, so part of the land was still wasted.

So Bilal Ibn Rabah(بلال ابن رباح) said: "Yes".

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: Then, I want you to hand me over, the land, which you are not cultivating.

Bilal(بلال) responded and said: "I am not gonna give you something that was given to me by Rasool Allah ﷺ, No way! I am going to give you this land back.!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "Yes you will"!

And he took away from him the part that was not cultivated and he distributed it, among the Muslims.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) did not want people to hold up these pieces of land, when they could be given to other Muslims, who will cultivate them.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted the benefit of the whole.

While Bilal Ibn Rabah(بلال ابن رباح) was looking at it that, this was the piece of land that was given to me by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, anyway, he took it away, and distributed it to the Muslims.

So, the point to learn here is that "property needs to be invested." it needs to be cultivated and not just left like that.

and this shows you the interest that the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) had in promoting trade and commerce.

FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND SPEAKING.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is the Khalifah(خليفه) and he meets a man, who just came out of a court.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) use to judge in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he was a Qadhi(قاضي).

So this man came out and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) told him; What was the ruling of Ali(علي) and Zayd(زيد)?

" So, the man said: "so and so." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "If it was me, I would have ruled otherwise".

So, the man said: "What prevents you from doing so, if you are the Ameer(امير) of the Believers?" Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "If this was an issue that straight goes to the book of Allah

or the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ I would enforce my ruling but this is my opinion and my opinion is as good as opinion of Zayd(زيد) and Ali(علي)."

So, he went along with the ruling of Zayd(زيد) and Ali Ibn Abi Talibرضي الله عنهما, even though it is contrary to what he thinks, is the right ruling,

and that shows you the freedom of expression that existed in the time of Khalifah(خليفه) he didn’t enforce his opinion on Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه and Zayd(زيد).

He was once giving Khutba(خطبه) and he told the Muslims, If you see any crookedness in me, then I want you to fix it, to make it straight.

So a man stood up and he said: If we see any crookedness in you, we will straighten it with our swords".

This was the very outspoken member of the society.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), did he call in, his security guards and say, this is terrorism against the state and this man must be thrown in jail,

and we need to keep him away, he is harm to society?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "Alhamdulillah(الحمد لله)! Praise be to Allah!

Who has made in the Muslims someone, who will fix Umar(عمر), with his sword, if umar(عمر) goes wrong.

Al-Hamdolillah(ألحمدلله)! That Allah has granted me followers, that will straighten me up if I go wrong." Umar(عُمَر) was happy, Umar(عُمَر) was happy that, this was the state of Ummah(امة) at that time.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wasn’t looking for submissive followers, who would say this is Wali Al-Amr(ولى الامر), we'll just do, whatever he wants,

he can take away our wealth, and lash, flog our backs and we will just say, We listen and obey!

He could do right, we will follow him, he could do wrong we will follow him, we are just blind followers.

No, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted to make sure that, this wasn't the condition of the Ummah(امة).

He wanted to make sure that the Ummah(امة) are only going to follow him, if he is right and they will stand up and correct him, if he is wrong.

And he was very happy when he saw that, somebody willing to use force to do that.

Obviously this is something that Ummah(امة) needs to learn today.

Because the Ummah(امة) have became blind followers, submissive and they have given into to Zulm(ظلم).

They have accepted Zulm(ظلم) on themselves and others.

And they have accepted this state of humiliation that the Ummah(امة) is going through.

The Ummah(امة) needs to stand up and fight for its rights.

If you don’t fight for it, you're not going to get it, Amazing condition of the society.! Once he was giving the khutba(خطبة) and he said: Is'mioo(اسمعو) Wa' Ati'oo(وأطيعو). Listen and Obey!

One man stood and said: We are not going to listen and we are not going to obey.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "why?

He said: Because, you have given us each, one piece of cloth and I see you wearing two pieces.

This was some pieces of fabric that came into Madina, he gave it out and he gave everybody one piece.

And now, this man is seeing Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is wearing two pieces, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "Call Abdullah(عبدالله)", his son Abdullah(عبدالله).

Umar(عُمَر) said: "I am not going to answer this, Abdullah(عبدالله) will".

So, he calls in his son Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله بن عمر) and he tells him; "Tell them, how come I am wearing two pieces of cloth?" Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله بن عمر) said;

My father is a very tall man, with wide shoulders, so one piece of cloth is not enough for him, so I gave him mine.

I gave him mine.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) did not take an additional piece from the Muslim Treasury.

This shows you, how delicate the justice of Umar(عُمَر) was, and it shows you how delicate the standard of the Muslims was.

They did not even accept for the Khalifah(خليفه) to have an additional piece of cloth, that they don't have.

Very, very, very different standards than we have now.

Some Muslims are even willing to be owned by the king or president.

They see it as a rightful claim for the government to just take away your wealth, abuse the wealth of the Ummah(امة).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) another time was talking, giving a Khutba(خطبه) and he was angry that the Mahr(مهر) was going up.

Mahr(مهر) is the dowry and Umar(عُمَر) wanted the dowry to be reasonable and he was quite upset that the prices were going up.

So, he gives a Khutba(خطبه) and says the Mahr(مهر) should not go above this amount and if I hear that any Mahr(مهر) is over this amount, I am going to take the additional amount and put it in the treasury.

So, a woman stood up and old woman stood up and said: "It's not up to you to do that." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "Why?" She said: because Allahعَزّوجَلّ says:

It mentions in Qur’an that "You give the woman a Qintaar(قنطار)" Allahعَزّوجَلّ was referring to some issues of marriage and it mentions in the Ayah(آية) and Qintaar(قنطار) is a large amount of Gold.

So, this woman used this as a Daleel(دليل) as an evidence that you can give Mahr(مهر) as much as a Qintaar(قنطار).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "A man was wrong and a woman was right." In another narrations, it says: A woman was right and Umar(عُمَر) was wrong.

In a third narration, it says; that he said: "Everyone has more Fiqh(فقه) than me".

And these are the examples to show the, also not just the justice, but it also shows the humbleness of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), you know

for somebody to stand up and just correct him in public, his pride didn’t take over, he accepted it.

and he said, everybody has more Fiqh(فقه) than me.

There are exception to this rule Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) just didn’t give a blanket freedom of expression to anyone and everyone to say whatever they want.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) placed restrictions just like we saw, he place restriction on property rights, he also placed restrictions on freedom of expression.

He was, once giving a Khutba(خطبه), and in the beginning of the Khutba(خطبه), he make the opening of the Khutba(خطبه), and it says: Whomever, Allah guides nobody can misguide him and whoever, Allah misguides nobody can guide him.

So, this man stands up and Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم), if he was Muslim or not, any way he said; Allahعَزّوجَلّ does not misguide anyone, because it says;

And whoever Allah misguides, nobody can guide him.

So, now he is bringing up a controversial issue in Qadar(قَدَر).

And Qadar(قَدَر), Dear brothers and sisters is one area where we should belief, we should not try to delve into and try to comprehend, it's one area that should be taken as Eeman(ايمان) in Al-Ghaeb(الغيب).

Belief in the unseen.

Why?

Because some aspects of Qadar(قَدَر) are beyond human comprehension.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ has taught us the knowledge that we need to know, He didn’t teach us everything.

Allah taught us in Qur’an things that we need to know.

There are some things that, there are many aspects of knowledge that are not mentioned in the Qur'an because we don’t need them, we don't need them for Hidaya(هداية).

So for example in Surat-Ul-Kahf(سورة الكهف).

Some were debating, and this was mentioned in some of the books.

They were debating on the Issue of the Dog.

You know the dog of the people of the cave.

People of the cave, they had a dog and this dog is mentioned in the Qur'an, So, they were debating, what color is this dog?

Is it black or white or is it black and white or is it red or yellow.?

What's the benefit of such knowledge?

What will you gain by knowing the color of the dog? NOTHING.!

This is knowledge that does not benefit.

Therefore, it wasn’t mentioned to us.

You find that Qur’an does not mention the details of time, of names, of locations, you would have entire story and no location would be mentioned, no time would be mentioned.

In some stories you would have a time line, some stories you would have locations but its for a benefit.

But these details are left out there is clear difference when you read a story in the Bible and when you read a story in Qur’an it could be the same story but they are very different.

The Bible gets into the name of the man, and his wife, and their fathers, and their relatives and their tribes and who did this and who did that!

But the Qur’an goes straight into the story and mentions to you the just of it Al-Ibra(العبرة).

"In those stories are reminders", benefits.

So, issues that are irrelevant are not mentioned in the Qur’an because this Qur’an is the Book of Guidance.

You are not going to find chemistry in Qur’an, you are not going to find physics in Qur’an, Why?

Because these are the issues that are not really important for our guidance.

Qur’an has mentioned every single thing we need to know in order to we get into Jannah(جنة) and save ourselves from hellfire, all that is mentioned in the Qur’an.

So, the issue of Qadar(قَدَر) we know of Qadar(قَدَر) what we need to know - but there are some parts of Qadar(قَدَر) we don’t need to know,

so we are not told about them and our minds cannot comprehend them.

So, this man is talking about How can Allah misguide us? Allah does not misguide.!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him; "If you ever say that again, I am going to execute you".

You know Umar(عُمَر) does not play around, I am going to execute you.

He goes straight to the point and he knows how to deliver the medicine.

In another example, there is, this man who is within the Muslim army a soldier Fi Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله) fighting and then he will go around, you know, because in camps you have a lot of free time

you are not fighting all the time, there is time of Ribaat(رباط) when people are waiting and you are guarding your outpost.

So, the Mujahid(مجاهد), who knows his benefit would use that time to learn, to study Shari’ah(شريعة), to make Ibaadah(عبادة), you know like Al-Murabitoon(المرابطون)

there was this great Islamic Emarat(عمارة) in the North Africa in our history, called Al-Murabitoon(المرابطون).

These were scholars and their students, who would set base in the frontier between the Muslim land and the non Muslim land.

And they would fight Fi Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله) to spread the religion and when they are not fighting they are studying.

The Shoyukh(شيوخ) are teaching them the ‘ilm(علم).

So, there time was spent in fighting Fi Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله), Ribaat(رباط), Daw'ah(دعوة) and ‘ilm(علم).

The best things that you could ask for.!!

However, there was this man Yani(يعني) in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), this man was in the army.

He would go around asking about the Ayaat(آيات) Al-Mutashabihaat(المتشابهات) the Ayaat(آيات) that the meaning is not clear.

There are some Ayah(آية) in Qur'an, That are Muh'kam(محكم) and some Ayah(آية) are Mutashabiha(متشابهة).

The Muh'kam(محكم) is very clear, the meaning is direct.

And there is Mutashabiha(متشابهة), it is unknown and it takes time for the Ta'aweel(تعويل) to be known with the some Ayaat(آيات) the final Ta'aweel(تعويل) will only be known on the day of Judgment.

So, this man was going around and he would say, And he goes around these soldiers and asking them these controversial questions.

And nobody has an answer and he was causing so much gossip.

So, the Ameer(امير) of the army was quiet concerned because you know, we have a lot of new Muslims and why raise these issues?

And some people are up to not that level of knowledge.

So, you don’t talk about everything.!

So, he came to the Ameer(امير) and said I have these questions for you, what does this mean, what does this mean...?

So, the Ameer(امير) of the army, he sends a letter to Umar(عُمَر) and telling him about this situation.

Umar(عُمَر) said: Sends him to me, bring him over.

So, they send this guy down to Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن خطاب) Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن خطاب) wraps him, in a rug.

And then he celts that rug and then he starts beating him with a stick and he had some of the Sahabah(صحابه) joined him.

Actually before that, No! we go back.

The man comes in and Umar(عمر) meets him, and he says: How can I help you?

The man said: I want to know what does - (والذاريات ذروا) mean?

And what does, - (فالحملات وقرا) - mean?

And Umar(عُمَر) is telling him go on, go on, go on!!!

And he is getting all these questions from him, he said: "I will give you all the answer".

So, he wraps him up into this rug and then he beats him up so bad, and then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "You understand now?" He said: "Yes Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين), I do! I know the answer! I know the answer now".

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: I never want you to ask these questions again.

They said, he left and he behaved himself until Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) died and then he starting to asking the questions again.

Umar(عُمَر) was the one, who would stand between the Ummah(امة) and Fitnah(فِتْنَه), He was the wall that stood between the Ummah(امة) and the Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

So, Islam does give freedom of expression but it does not allow to fool around with the religion.

It’s a serious issue the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ is serious.

He wouldn’t also allow to slander.

Al-Hatiyya(الحطيه) and Arab poet, his poetry was slandering others.

He was a wonderful poet but he use to slander other people.

So, one of the target of his slander came to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and complained.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) brought Al-Hatiyya(الحطيه) and threw him in jail.

Al-Hatiyya(الحطيه) made some poetry, talking about his daughters and how Umar(عُمَر) has left them without care taker, now and very sad line of poetry.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) released him until, he had him pay three thousand Dinar(دينار) as a compensation to those, whom he slandered and he said, you never slander again.

So, he prevented him, from slandering others.

And this is a serious problem in free societies today, or so called free societies today for example in the west that freedom of expression over spills, and it turns into slandering people.

I mean the media now, had a free hand in slandering people.

Look at how the Muslims are been slandered left and right.

HOW THE KHALIFAH(خليفه) LIVE?

You know some people have an impression as long as you are doing something for Islam, you should do it Fi-Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله) and don’t get paid for it, but that’s impracticable.

Somebody going to give all his time for the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ they need to make a living.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه told the Sahabah(صحابه), how much you are going to pay me?

And there is a Qa’ida(قاعدة) of Fiqh(فقه) it says; "Anybody who is dedicated for a cause that cause need to pay their expenses." This is a the rule of Fiqh(فقه) and they give examples for that the judge,

like the Mufti(مفتى), and the Waali(والى) Waali(والى) is the governor, Mufti(مفتي) is the scholar, and the judge.

Since, they have dedicated their time for a certain cause that cause need to pay their expenses.

With Rasool Allah ﷺ his expenses were paid through the Fai(فيئ), the spoils of the war that are gained without fighting.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; "My Rizq(رزق) comes from beneath my spear." So, Rasool Allah ﷺ contrary to common misconceptions, wasn’t a businessman, after he became a Prophet?

He stopped practicing business and went Daw'ah(دعوة) full time.

Business and shepherding were things of the past.

After Rasool Allah ﷺ became a Nabi(نَبِي), he stopped working in any profession and all what he would do is devote his time to the Daw'ah(دعوة) Fi-Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله).

In Madina a new door of Rizq(رزق) opened up to Rasool Allah ﷺ and that is the Ghaneema(غنيمه) or the Fai(فيئ).

When Rasool Allah ﷺ would send an army and no fighting would occur that Fai(فيئ) would go into the hands of Rasool Allah ﷺ and he claims a portion of it.

Now, since that is specific to Rasool Allah ﷺ the one who took the responsibility of the affairs of the Muslims after him, was Abu Bakr(ابو بكر).

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) is not Rasool Allah ﷺ to take the Fai(فيئ), so how can he live?

We talked about this, during the lecture series on Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) but just briefly after Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) became Khalifah(خليفه), they saw him in the market place buying and selling.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and Abu Obaidah(ابو عبيدة) told him what are you doing?

He said, what you mean what I am doing? I am making a living for me and my family.

They said, well there is some women waiting for you at your office and you need to be working, you're the Khalifah(خليفه).

He said; I have to make a living, how am I going to feed myself and my family?

They said, alright we will give you a salary.

And they gave him half a sheep, a day and they also gave him a stipend some money.

And then later on they found Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) again in the market place, they told him what's wrong?

He told him, what you gave me is not enough.

So, they said, alright we will give you the whole sheep and will also raise your salary and then he was satisfied and content.

Because Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) was a businessman he used to make sufficient money for him and his family.

So, at least his expenses need to be paid now.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he went to the Sahabah(صحابه) and he said: What salary are you going to give me?

They said, well Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين) you know better.

He said; I'll tell you what I'll take, what I see as Halal(حلال) for me from the Treasury.

"Transportation for my Hajj(حَجْ) and Umrah(عمرة)".

Since, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is not gonna leave Madina, and he now doesn't need transportation in Madina.

So, he said, I want  transportation for Hajj(حَجْ) and Umrah(عمرة) otherwise, in Madina he is going to walk.

"And set of clothes in summer and set of clothes in winter" just one set.

"And sufficient food for me and my family, I want them to be full." "And my share of the booty " "Because I am still a Muslim like you." I am one of you, so I want to get my share of the booty, As-Sahm(السهم).

That was the salary of Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه.

Which is quiet modest.

A man came to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and said, this is an agreement between me and my brother, that he borrowed some money from me, so he needs to pay me back

and he gives Umar(عُمَر) the agreement, and this man was saying that it's long overdue.

What does it say in the agreement, it says, that the debt should be paid back in Sha’ban(شعبان) now the Arabs didn’t have a calendar.

They didn’t have a calendar to count the years, they had a calendar for months.

The twelve lunar months but they did not have a calendar for the years.

And the way Arabs would remember years is by the important event that happened that year so you have Aamil Feil(عام الفيل) the Year of the Elephants.

Why was it call year of the Elephant?

Because that’s when Abraha(ابراهة) sent his army and it was destroyed.

You have ‘Aam ar-Ramada(عام الرمادة), the year of Famine and you have Aam Al-Ghala(عام الغلاء), the year of Expensive Prices.

Because that was the important event that happened then.

But they didn’t have a numbering system for the years, they didn’t have a true calendar.

So, this man is telling Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) this money is long overdue.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) reads it and it said, Sha’ban(شعبان) he said, which Sha’ban(شعبان)?

This Sha’ban(شعبان), Sha’ban(شعبان) last year, Sha’ban(شعبان) next year?

So, he gathered the Sahabah(صحابه), and now see things are getting more complicated because now we have a Khilfah(خلافه) and it's expanding its not like family affairs like it was before and you could work things out.

And they did not have these sophisticated rules.

Now, you're having all these disputes happening.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said to the Sahabah(صحابه) we have to have a calendar.

And he was soliciting advice from them, some said let's use the calendar of Romans, some said let's use the calendar of Persians, some said let's use this and let's use that.

And then Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said; Our calendar should start from the time Rasool Allah ﷺmade Hijrah(هجرة) from the land of Shirk(شرك) to the land of Islam, the Hijrah(هجرة).

So, it's interesting to see that, the Sahabah(صحابه) did not use for example, the birth of Rasool Allah ﷺ or his death or the date of his Prophet hood, they used Hijrah(هجرة).

Why Hijrah(هجرة)?

Why did they specifically choose Hijrah(هجرة), and didn’t choose his death or his birth.

Well for his death Ibn Hajar(ابن حجَر) says, because that would bring bad memories.

But then why didn’t they choose the date of his Prophet hood or the date of his birth?

Why did they specifically choose date of Hijrah(الهجرة)?

The Sahabah(صحابه) use to see the Hijrah(هجرة) is a turning point in Islam.

That is the beginning of Islamic State.

That is the beginning of living a Islamic life.

Before that we were a minority in Makkah.

But now, we have an Ummah(امة) a nation and that’s why the Islamic Calendar should start from the Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, that’s the year but the month, Rasool Allah ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة) in Rabia al-Awwal(ربيع الاول) however, the Islamic calendar starts with which month?

What's the first month of the year?

Muharram(محرم), Why did they choose Muharram(محرم)?

One of the opinion and this is the opinion of Ibn Hajar(ابن حجَر) is because Muharram(محرم) was the beginning of the intention of Rasool Allah ﷺ to make Hijrah(هجرة).

Because Bai’at-Al-Aqabaa As-Saniya(بيعة العقبة الثانية), occurred in Zulhijah(ذوالحجة) and the first Hilal(هلال) after Zulhijah(ذوالحجة), the next month after Zulhijjah(ذوتاحجة) is Muharram(محرم).

The other opinion is that it's good to start the year, after people come back from Hajj(حَجْ).

So, people come back from Hajj(حَجْ) in Zulhijah(ذوالحجة) make that, the last month of the year and the people start off, the new year when they come back from Hajj(حَجْ).

It could make a sense, Hajj(حَجْ) forgives for you, your sins and Umrah(عمرة) forgives the sins between Umrah(عمرة) and the next scenario starting again, in new month of Muharram(محرم).

So, that’s how the Islamic Calendar started, it wasn’t something that was done in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ or the time of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر),

it was something that was started by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

So, you can see that when Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Follow my Sunnah(سنة) and the Sunnah(سنة) of the guided Caliphs after me.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that new affairs or circumstances would occur in the time of the Khulafah(خلافاء) and there will be some new rulings given by the Khulafah(خلافاء) and that needs to be taken as Sunnah(سنة).

And many of these things occurred in the times of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

There was another dilemma what to name the Khalifah(خليفه), what name to give him?

With Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) he was given the name of, What?

Khalifat(خليفة).

Khalifat(خليفة) who?

The successor of who?

Khalifat(خليفة) who?

Rasool Allah ﷺ, Khalifatu Rasool Allah(خليفة الرسول الله), that was the title of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) , Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said;

You cannot call me Khalifah(خليفه) of Rasool Ullah, I am not the Khalifah(خليفه) of Rasool Ullah, I am Khalifah(خليفه) of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر).

I am the successor of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر).

So, if you give me the name Khalifat Khalifah(خليفه) tu Rasool Ullah, What about the ones who come after me?

It going to become very, very long.

Khalifat(خليفة), khalifat, khalifat ……. Rasool Ullah.

So, they were thinking about a title to give the Khalifah(خليفه) and they couldn’t come up with one?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: He wants two competent men come down from Iraq, so that he can ask them about Iraq and its people.

He wants to hold a meeting with men from Iraq to ask them about the conditions in Iraq.

Iraq was a frontier land, there was a lot of fighting happening.

So, he wanted to know the latest news.

So, they brought him the Lubaid Bin Rabi’a(لبيد ابن ربيعه) and Oda’e Bin Hatim(عدي بن حاتم).

They came and they met Amro Bin Aas(عمرو بن العاص) and they told Amro Bin Aas(عمرو بن العاص) can you please ask permission for us from Amir Ul Momineen(أميرالمؤمنين).

Amro Bin Aas(عمرو بن العاص) he went to Umar(عُمَر) and he said; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said, where did you get that from?

Amro Bin Aas(عمرو بن العاص) told him; Lubaid Bin Rabi’a(لبيد ابن ربيعه) and Oda’e Bin Hatim(عدي بن حاتم) are outside and they said; we want permission to meet Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)

and I liked that name because we are the believers and you are our Ameer(امير).

You are our Ameer(امير)!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "that would be the title" and since then Khulafah(خلافاء) were given the title of Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

SOME OF THE QUALITIES OF AMEER UL-MOMINEEN(امير المؤمنين), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab Al Farooq رضي الله عنه, He had such great fear of Allah in his heart,

he had Khashiya Allah(خشية الله) and that's the fruit of knowledge, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; "The ones, who have fear of Allah are the Ulema(علماء)",

so that’s the fruit of knowledge.

Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) responded and said; "He has the fruit of knowledge," the fear of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

He already has the fruit of knowledge that is actually what you want knowledge to do for you, to have the fear of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and he had that.

Anyway, with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) he had the Khashiya(خشية) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Once a man came to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) and he said, O Umar(عُمَر)! I want you to solve this dispute happening between me and this man.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) became upset and he said, "When I come to you offering my help in my free time you don’t come forth and when you see me busy with the affairs of the Muslims, you rush to me

and he hit him with his stick.

The Durra(درة), the famous stick of Umar(عمر) this is very famous stick, this is called Ad-Durra(ألدرة), the Durra(درة) of Umar(عمر).

The man left and he was upset, he was complaining and he walked away.

Sometimes, it happens that when you are free nobody comes to you and when all the paper work is piling up and you are so busy everybody comes in with these urgent demands.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Call the man back.

So, they called him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) gave him the stick and he said; "I want you to hit me, like I hit you!" The man said: "For the sake of Allah and for your sake I won’t".

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: "No".

You either do it, for the sake of Allah or you hit me back.

Then the man said: I will do it, for the sake of Allah alone.

Al-Ah'naf bin Qais(الاحنف بن قيس) said: "I was with Umar(عُمَر) when that happened.

And he went into his house and we went with him and then he prayed and after he finished his Salah(صلاة), he said; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said, O son of Khattab(خطاب), he is speaking to himself!

He said: O son of Khattab(خطاب), You were low and Allah raised you, you were lost and Allah guided you, you were humble and Allah made you noble
