How will you answer to Allah on the Day you meet Him?

What will you do and you will stand in front of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, how will you answer Allah for what you have done?

Al-Ah'naf bin Qais(الاحنف بن قيس) said: When I saw that I knew the Umar(عُمَر) was the best of the men.

This is the fear that he had, he regretted what he did with this man.

Even though he was busy Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not see that he had the legitimate reason for doing what he did.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) used to say; "Hold yourselves accountable before you will be held accountable." "And weigh yourselves on the scale, before you would be weighed."

"And prepare yourselves for the great exposition." "The day you will be exposed and nothing will be hidden, prepare for that time, prepare for that day."

Once Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) with his stick again, he hit men and women, who were making Wudhu(وضؤ) in a pool next to Al-Ka’aba(الكعبة) in Al-Haram(الحرم).

So he hit them with his stick, he told them to go away.

And then he called one of his employees, so the employee came and said; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب)" said: No lubayka(لبيك), No Sa’daiyka(سعديك)!"

Didn’t I tell you to make separate pools for men and separate pools for women?

Because they were making Wudhu(وضؤ) from the same pool and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) didn’t want that mixing to occur next to the House of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, he pushed them away.

And then he told his employee why didn’t you follow my instructions?

And then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he went to Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) and he said: "I perished!".

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said: "Why did you say that?" He said: "I hit men and women in the House of Allah in the Haram(حرم)".

Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه said: "You are a shepherd and if the shepherd disciplines his flock then that is justice but if the shepherd disciplines his flock wrongly then that is oppression!"

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) is saying you are a shepherd and you have a right to discipline your flock when you see them doing wrong.

Al-Hassan al-Basari(الحسن البصري) said, that one night while Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمربن الخطاب) was walking in the streets of Madina, he remembered the Ayah(آية).

The one's who harm, the believing men and the believing women, so he goes and visits Obaey Ibn Ka’aba(ابيئ ابن كعب), Obaey Ibn Ka’aba(ابيئ ابن كعب) was a scholar of Qur’an.

He was one of the scribes, he was one of the memorizers of Book of Allah, he was one of the Mufassireen(مفسرين), so Umar(عُمَر) visits him.

And as soon as he comes in to his house, Obaey Ibn Ka’aba(ابيئ ابن كعب) pulls down a pillow from beneath him and his gives it to the Khalifah(خليفه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) kicks the pillow away and he sits down on the floor.

And then he said: "Obaey(ابيئ) I fear that I am one of those, who are harming the believing men and the believing women." Obaey Ibn Ka’aba رضي الله عنه told him.

O Umar(عُمَر)! You cannot but discipline your subjects and tell them what is right and what is wrong.

"You have said the right thing, you have said the right thing"!

So Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن خطاب) said: You said the right thing.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was outstanding in his Zuhd(زهد), in his austerity.

And he went on, and on mentioning examples to her until, Hafsa(حفصه) started to cry and then Umar(عُمَر) said; "I have two companions, who preceded me and I am going to follow this way of hardship,

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was not living for Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), he is living for the sake of being reunited with his most beloved Rasool Allah ﷺ and Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he was once walking with his companions, advisors, deputies, came next to a dumpster, a garbage and he just stopped.

But Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was trying to teach them a lesson.

He said: This is your world, which you are fighting over and crying for.

This is Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), this is what you are fighting over, this is it, it’s a stinking dumpster.

And that is how Umar(عُمَر) saw this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), his interest was in Al-Akhirah(آخرة).

TAWADHIA(تواضع) OF UMAR IBN KHATTAB(عمر ابن الخطاب) Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was once approached by Al-Ahnaf Bin Qais(الاحنف بن قيس),

Al-Ahnaf Bin Qais(الاحنف بن قيس) is one of the leaders of his people.

A very dignified man, noble man he was respected by his community was loved and respected by Rasool Allah ﷺ, he was a chief of a tribe.

So, he came and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), what was Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) doing?

The same thing he was doing when he was visited by Oyaiyna Bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن) applying Tor to his camel.

Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن خطاب) was applying Tor to his camel.

And this is difficult job to do and it is something that is done by the slaves.

You know, somebody who is well off he wouldn’t do that.

You are applying this Tor to the camel to clear it from the flees.

It's not something that should be done by somebody, who is a noble man let alone the Khalifah(خليفه).

But that’s what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was doing.

And it's very difficult thing to do, so you have to take your clothes off.

So, Al-Ahnaf(الاحنف) came, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him: O Ahnaf(احنف) take your clothes off and come and join me.

Obviously when he said, take your clothes off, it means the outer garment, you have your inner clothes that would cover your body on.

But your clean clothes that you wear when you outside take those out because you are dealing with Tor, Qataraan(قطران).

So, there is one man with them he said: O Umar(عُمَر) Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)!

Why don’t you have, a slave do that? Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) responded by saying; "And who is more of a slave then me and Al-Ahnaf(الاحنف)?"

"And who is more of a slave then me and Al-Ahnaf(الاحنف)?

Anyone who assumes responsibility over the Muslims is accountable just like the slave is accountable to his master." And he is talking about the fact that he is accountable to Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

He is a slave and Al-Ahnaf(الاحنف) is a slave and they are appointed over the Muslims, so they need to be accountable to their Master, Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Just because I am your leader shouldn’t make you forget that I am still a slave and that I have a Master above me, Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

In a gathering some man said, They said: We had never seen anyone, who is more just and who says, speaks the truth and who is more severe on the Munafiqeen(منافقين) then you?

Auf Bin Malik(عوف بن مالك) who was sitting there he said: No! that's not true.

Kazabtu(كذبت), you are lying.

And then he said, we know of somebody, who came after Rasool Allah ﷺ who is better than Umar(عُمَر).

And this was said in front of Umar(عُمَر).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: "Who are you talking about?" He said: "I am talking about Abu Bakr(ابوبكر)", Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You are right.!

There was a time when Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابوبكر الصديق) was more pure then musk(مسك) and I was more mislead then the camel of my parents.

I was in a worse condition then the camel of my family.

While Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه his smell was better than musk(مسك).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was saying that Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) became Muslim before me and he was pure and clean like musk(مسك), while I was a disbeliever and I was worse than the camel of my family.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wasn't insulted by what this man said, when he said that you are not the best after Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Umar(عُمَر) wanted the people to know who he really is?

And that he is in lower status than Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

He didn’t allow the people to tempt him, to believe that he is better like people, the deceptive people do today to leaders.

They deceive the leaders and make them think that they are better than everybody else.

You are the best king that ever existed in history, you are the best leader that ever lived.

You are the best president, whatever!

And they pumped them up and it gets to you, after a while it gets into your brains, and you really think that I am the best.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not allow that.

And he had, in his presence people, who would not allow that, like ‘Awf bin Malik(عوف بن مالك).

And HE WAS ALSO FOREBEARING: Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه even though he had that strong personality but he had Helm(حلم).

Oyaiyna Bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن) again, his name comes up, he is the Bedouin leader whom Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) tore the document that was given by Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), he tore it apart.

Oyaiyna Bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن) wanted permission to meet with Umar(عُمَر) because Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) would surround himself as Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) says;

With the scholars of Qur’an.

These would be his advisors let's say.

They were friends and also advisors.

These are the people with whom he would surround himself with the Bataana(بطانه).

And Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) said, it doesn’t matter whether they were old or young as long as they were scholars in Qur’an they understood Qur’an they would accompany Umar(عُمَر).

So, one of them is Al-Hurr Bin Qais(الحر بن قيس).

Oyaiyna Bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن) was his uncle.

So, Oyaiyna(عيينه) is coming to Al-Hurr(الحر) and said: I want you to arrange a meeting between me and Umar(عُمَر), I want to meet him.

So, Al-Hurr Bin Qais(الحر بن قيس), because he is very close to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he asked Umar(عُمَر) for permission to have ‘Oyaiyna(عيينه) come in.

So, Umar(عُمَر) allowed him in.

Oyaiyna(عيينه) comes in and Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) look at what he said; He said; "O son of Khattab(خطاب)! You are not giving us enough and you are not judging among us with justice.

"You are being oppressive and you are not giving us enough.

And you really need to look at the first statement, you are not giving us enough that’s what it really means.

And Umar(عُمَر) is oppressive because he is not giving him enough.

So, you know sometimes people their standard of justice is how good you are to them.

That is, they see the world, they are the centre of universe.

If you treat them well then you are the best, if you treat them bad, you are the worst.

Doesn’t really make a difference whether they have merits or not.

They judge according to how they are treated.

And this is a statement that is false, so Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wanted to respond back.

Al-Hurr Bin Qais(الحر بن قيس) interrupted and he said, Allahعَزّوجَلّ has told Muhammad  ﷺ, "Stay away from the ignorant and this man is one of them."

He is saying that about his uncle, but Al-Hurr Bin Qais(الحر بن قيس) defends Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه because he is defending the truth.

Even if that leads to him insulting his own uncle.

This man is among Al-Jahiliyeen(الجاهلين) and the Ayah(آية) says, stay away from them. Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) said, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) didn’t go beyond that as soon as the verse was revealed.

"Because Umar(عُمَر) was a person who would stop at the Book of Allah." When he would hear a Ayah(آية) he would stop.

He would follow the rule of Allahعَزّوجَلّ he would not go ahead with what he intended because now he heard a Naseeha(نصيحه) the Ayah(آية) of the Book of Allahعَزّوجَلّ telling him to ignore.

So, he ignored Oyaiyna Bin Hassan(عيينه بن حصن).

Lets move on to the  other section, HIS LIFE WITH HIS FAMILY: Rasool Allah ﷺ was in a gathering with the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم and Rasool Allah ﷺ would use various instructional methods to deliver the message to the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم.

For example, sometimes he would draw a diagram on the sand, sometimes he would ask a question, sometimes he would make a statement like an oath to make them attentive, to what he's going to say

and the statements of Rasool Allah ﷺ were very short and concise, so that they could be remembered.

So, all of these show you the Hikmah(حكمة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ as a Teacher.

Once Rasool Allah ﷺ was with the Sahabah(صحابه), so he asked them a question.

He said: "Tell me what tree is similar to the Mo’min(مؤمن), to the believer?

" Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) said; I was with the Sahabah(صحابه).

And the Sahabah(صحابه) got lost in the trees of the desert.

The Sahabah(صحابه), their minds tuned in to the desert and they started mentioning names of tree from the desert.

While the tree Rasool Allah ﷺ was referring to right to, was right around the corner.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was referring to An-Nakhla(النخلة), the palm tree.

Since, the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم went around mentioning one tree after another, none of them knew the answer.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told them the answer. He said: It is An-Nakhla(النخلة), the palm tree.

Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) he went back home and he told his father, O my father! I knew the answer.

Umar(عُمَر) told him, "why didn’t you answer it then?" Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) said: "Because I was the youngest in the gathering

and there were people like you and Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), so I was shy, embarrassed.

I didn’t feel it right to answer in their presence." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) didn’t like that answer, and he said; "It would have been better if you have answered

and I would rather, that have you answer that question Bikadhaa(بكذا) Wa-kadhaa(وكذاء), this was a statement what they would say meaning, "Whatever you could sacrifice, it would have been better for me, if you mentioned the answer then."

What Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is teaching his son Abdullah(عبدالله) is that you should have courage.

You should speak up, when you know the truth.

You shouldn’t just stay there quietly because you are shy, because you don’t want to talk in front of the gathering and this is very important message to deliver it to your children.

Don’t be shy, don’t be ashamed if you know the right answer, you know the truth, answer it.

So, he is teaching his son Abdullah(عبدالله) to have courage and this is an important thing that we need to teach our children.

In fact, sometimes parents would teach their children fear, not courage, fear.

Stay away from trouble, don’t answer, don’t talk, don’t speak up, don’t go to the Masjid(مسجد), don’t do this, don’t do that.

You should tell them, that they should uphold the truth no matter what the consequences are.

You should stand up for what is right no matter what the consequences are.

Parents do not make your children grow up to be chicken.

You need to raise them up having the Ikhlaq(اخلاق) of Islam, courage, sacrifice.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام is telling his son I want to slaughter you?

What do you say? Because he was brought up by Ibrahim عليه السّلام, he said, O my father do what you are commanded to do.

He was ready, Ismailعليه السلام was ready to die for the sake of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) use to care for, the Akhirah(آخرة) benefit for his children.

When Hafsa(حفصه), her husband died.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted her to marry the best.

So, he goes to Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان).

I want fathers, I want parents in general, fathers and mothers to think about this.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) goes to Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) and he tells him, my daughter Hafsa(حفصه), I am offering her to you in marriage.

This is no, no to parents today, you don’t go offering your daughter around.

You wait until somebody comes, and if nobody comes you have her sit at home, until she dies.

No Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) he wants the best for his daughter.

He is not thinking about shame, embarrassment and he doesn’t think about these things.

I want her benefit, I want what is good for her, so he goes to Uthman(عثمان) and he says; "I am offering you my daughter in marriage".

Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) comes back to Umar(عُمَر) and says; I am not interested in marrying, at this particular time.

Umar(عُمَر) didn’t like that answer.

Obviously, but you cannot force him.

Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) turned him down, it's very difficult.

but Uthman(عثمان) wasn’t interested in getting married at that particular time.

So, then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he goes to Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and he offers Hafsa(حفصه) to him.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابوبكر الصديق) did not respond back, he did not say, yes or no. He just left.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; And I was even more upset with Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), at least Uthman(عثمان) told me the answer.

He said, No!. Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) just ignored me.

So Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن ألخطاب) was very angry with Abu Bakr(أبوبكر), very angry.

A short while later, Rasool Allah ﷺ asks for Hafsa(حفصه) and he marries her, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله).

So, Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) comes back to Umar(عُمَر) and he said: "I think you were upset with me?

" Umar(عُمَر) said: "Yes".

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) said: The reason why I didn’t answer back is because I heard Rasool Allah ﷺ mention her name, and I am not going to be the one, to expose the secret of Rasool Allah ﷺ

and if Rasool Allah ﷺ did not get marry to her, I would have married her.

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said; It was something I heard in private, and I wouldn't tell anybody about it.

Rasool Ullah mentioned her name, so I wanted to wait and see if Rasool Allah ﷺ would marry her.

And if he didn’t, I would have married her.

But Allahعَزّوجَلّ chose for her the best, Muhammadﷺ.

But the thing here is, we are talking about how he is dealing with his family.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is eager to get the best husband for his daughter and he is willing to go and offer her.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was strict with his family members.

And when he was a Khalifah(خليفه), he wanted to make sure that there is no favoritism going on, and he was very strict about it.

Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) said; I purchased some camels that were very weak because of fever.

These camels were sick, so they became very weak, skinny Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) purchased them and then he took them to Al-Hima(الهِما).

Al-Hima(الهِما) is a guarded area that is open for all, it is a common pasture.

So, the land doesn’t belong to any particular person.

It is guarded and any Muslim can take their flock there to feed.

So, Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) he took his camels to this Hima(الهِما) and they grew fat and then Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) took them to the market place to sell.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he used to inspect the markets of Madina.

So, during one of his inspections tours, he sees these fat healthy camels.

He said, who did these belongs to?

They said; They belonged to Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر).

So, he calls Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) and he said; O Abdullah(عبدالله) what is this?

Abdullah(عبدالله) said; These are some camels I bought, they were very skinny and I took them to Hima(الهِما) and now I want to sell them.

Umar(عُمَر) said; Yes!. You took them to Hima(الهِما) and the Muslims over there said; Move away let the camels of the son of Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين) eat and they would bring them water

and say take good care of the camels of the son of Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين), until they grew fat.

Sell these camels, you take your capital and every single Dinar(دينار), you made in profit goes back to the treasury.

Because Umar(عُمَر) said that, because you are the son of the Khalifah(خليفه), the Muslims were giving you preferred treatment and that’s why your camels became fat.

So, he said, you take your capital the money that you have invested and don’t make money any money out of this.

Abdullah Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه, he made some money from the Ghanaem(غنائم) of the Jalolah(جوالاء) this was the battle in Iraq.

So, Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) being one of the fighter in the army, he got portion of the spoils of war.

So, he brought it to Madina and he wanted to sell it.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; "Yes". You going to sell it, you are going to make a lot of money off, of it.

Actually, it cost him 40,000 and he sold it for four hundred thousand (400,000), so he made a lot of money.

It was a very good deal.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه said; O my son Abdullah(عبدالله)!

Would you sacrifice any thing for me, if you know that you are father is going to hellfire?

Abdullah(عبدالله) said; O my father! I would sacrifice anything for you, anything.

Umar(عُمَر) said, well this merchandise of yours, which you want to sell, the Muslims are going to say, he is the Sahabi(صحابي) of Rasool Ullah and he is the son of Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين)

and he the most beloved of his sons to him and then Umar(عُمَر) said, and that is true.

Umar(عُمَر) was saying, that you are the most beloved of my children to me.

So, the Muslims are going to give you the best deal.

They are going to sell you with the lower prices and they will buy from you with the highest prices.

So, let me tell you my son, I am going to give you best profit a man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) can make.

For every Dirham(درهم) that you have invested I am going to give you a Dirham(درهم).

So, after it was sold for four hundred thousand, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) gave Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) Eighty Thousand(80,000)

all of the rest went to Bait-Ul-Maal(بيت المال), the treasury.

Now, this is a legitimate deal but Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was very sensitive, very sensitive to the way, his son would be treated.

In fact Abdullah(عبدالله) and Ubaidillah Bin Umar(عبيدالله بن عمر) were in Iraq, they were with Abu Musa Al-Asha’ari(ابوموسى العشعري) and Abu Musa Al-Asha’ari(ابوموسى العشعري) is appointed as a Governor by Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

So Abu Musa(ابوموسى) told Abdullah(عبدالله) and Ubaidillah(عبيدالله ), he said; I want to send some money to the Khalifah(خليفه).

I want to send some money to Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

However, I am going to give you this money, you buy some items from Iraq, using this money and you can take it to Madina and sell it and give the money back to Umar(عُمَر) and you keep the profit.

So, you see the deal here?

So, Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عُمَر) took the money that belongs to Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين), should go back to the treasury and they bought some items from Iraq,

they carried the items and they wanted to sell them in Madina.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) when he knew about this deal he said: No.

He said, all of the money goes to the treasury.

Abdullah(عبدالله) said, I stayed, quiet and Ubaidillah(عبيدالله) argued with my father.

He said; But my father, if we lost in this deal we would have guaranteed the return of the money.

So, how come now when we made money you want to take it away from us?

Because if this turned out to be a sour deal, we would have paid you money out of our pockets because this was a trust given by Abu Musa(ابوموسى).

Umar(عُمَر) said; Give the money back.

So, one of the Sahabah(صحابه) was sitting there he argued on behalf of Abdullah(عبدالله) and Ubaidillah(عبيدالله) and he said, O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين) how about you give them half of the profit and you take half?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he remained silent, so that's what happened.

His son Asim(عاصم) was in Iraq and he came with some plates and jewelry, and some items that he brought them from Iraq.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) called Mo’aiqeeb(موعيقيب) his servant and he said; Mo’aiqeeb(موعيقيب) take everything you see with Asim(عاصم) and deposit it in the treasury.

Asim(عاصم) said: But it belongs to me. Umar(عُمَر) said: No! You went to Iraq and you asked them to give you this.

Asim(عاصم) said; But I asked my family.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told Mo'aiqeeb(موعيقيب) take it, and leave it in treasury, take it all.

And he Stripped Asim(عاصم) of all of the items that he brought with him from Iraq and he put it in the treasury.

Abu Musa Al-Asha’ari(ابوموسى العشعري) he came from Iraq and he gave the wife of Umar(عُمَر) a gift.

Small item, he gave to her as a gift to wife of Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

Umar(عُمَر) comes in and he sees this gift with his wife he said; where did you get it from?

She said; Abu Musa Al-Asha’ari(ابوموسى العشعري) gave it to me, as a gift.

Umar(عُمَر) picked up that item and he hit her on the head, he banged her on her head and he said; and why are you getting gifts from Abu Musa(ابوموسى)?

And then he said; call Abu Musa(ابوموسى).

Abu Musa(ابوموسى) came in and he was breathing, because they had dragged him and he had to run he said; O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين), Don’t hasten in your judgment against me.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told him, and who told you give my wife gifts?

He took that item and he hit Abu Musa(ابوموسى) on the head.

And he said: Take it back to Bait-Ul-Maal(بيت المال).

I want to make a comment here Abu Musa Al-Asha’ari(ابوموسى العشعري) has no blood relations with whatsoever, with the wife of Umar(عُمَر).

They are foreign to each other, Non-Mahram(محرم) and Abu Musa(ابوموسى) is giving her a gift.

If that were the conduct of the Sahabah(صحابه) it shows you how tight they were?

Ya’ani(يعني) for somebody to come and give the wife of his friend a gift shows you how tight and close the relationship was.

And how close Abu Musa(ابوموسى) was to Umar(عُمَر) and how close Sahabah(صحابه) were, they were like one family.

Because, why would Abu Musa(ابوموسى) give the wife of Umar(عُمَر) a gift?

But it shows that they had extremely close, and loyal, and brotherly relationship to the extent that Abu Musa(ابوموسى) can give the wife of Umar(عُمَر) a gift.

Now, Umar(عُمَر) did not agree with that because he felt that this is a preferred treatment just because she is the wife of Umar(عُمَر) doesn't entitle her to get gifts.

Because as he sees it, as a conflict of interest.

He is the Khalifah(خليفه), he shouldn't be getting gifts.

Especially from someone who is appointed by him, as a Governor.

Money shouldn't be used in such a way, by the way its the money of Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari(أبوموسى ألعشعري) and he gave it to the wife of umar(عمر) as a gift.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was very strict with his wives, he didn’t want them to intervene in the affairs of state.

Once he was writing a letter reprimanding one of his governors, so the wife of Umar(عُمَر) came and she said: Why are you being so harsh on him?

He said: You stay quiet go and do your stitching and stay away from the affairs of government.

Sometimes, the comments of Umar(عُمَر) were bit harsh and rough, and and I hope that sisters will still going to show up tomorrow.

and you are not going to say that we wouldn't accept such statements.

Ya’ni(يعني) Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he was disciplining his wives and that was the way of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he didn't want his women to involve in the affairs of government.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would seek the advice of his wives.

Like for example, with Umm Salamah(ام سلمه) in Sulah-Hudaybiya(صلح الحديبيه), she was the one who gave him the Nasihaa(نصيحه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, going himself and shaving his head slaughtering his animals.

But Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he didn’t want his women to involve in the affairs of state.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) received some money, so Hafsa(حفصه), Umm-Ul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين) came to Umar(عُمَر) and said, Don’t forget your relatives, you need to give to your relatives, you need to make, Sula-Tur-Rahem(صلحةالرحم)

you need to be kind to your kinship, and she was telling him about your rights and duties towards your family - the clan of Bannu Udae(بنوعدي).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), he stopped her and he said: You have cheated your father by being nice and well to your family.

He said; This money belongs to the Muslims.

I would give my relatives from my own personal money not from the money that belongs to the Muslims.

So, he said; you cheated your father, meaning, you are not doing your father good by giving me this Naseeha(نصيحه), even though you are benefiting your relatives.

So, he was very strict with his house hold.

Now, how would Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) treat the house hold of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Ahlul-Bait(اهل البيت).?

He used to take special care of Ummahatul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين), he used to love Al-Hassan wal-Hussain(الحسن ولحسين), Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), Al-Abbas(العباس) and his son Abdullah(عبدالله)

and he used to put them in a very high status.

When he would send money to the house hold of Rasool Allah ﷺ he would give them, so much and incase there is any shortage, the shortage would be in the share of his own daughter, Hafsa(حفصه)

that’s where the shortage would be.

In what he gives to Hafsa(حفصه) the wife of Rasool Allah ﷺ why?

Because she is his daughter.

Once he gave Zaynab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش), so much money, huge pile of coins, so when Zaynab(زينب) saw that she said; "May Allah forgive Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

There are other wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ, who would do a better job in distributing this money.

" He told her, no, no , no this is not for distribution, this is yours.

She thought that, he is bringing her the money to distribute among the rest of Ummahatul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين) but she was told that all of this is your portion.

She was so terrified, by the amount of it, she told her servants to cover it with a cloth.

It was so much for her.

And then she told her servants to put her hand under the cloth and take out from it and go and give it to orphans, to widows, to Miskeen(مسكين) to the needy

and the pile was decreasing going down, going down going down, until her servant said: "O Umm-Ul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين), Zaynab(زينب)! Why don’t you leave some for us? We have a right in it."

So, then Zaynab(زينب) said, alright take what is under that cloth.

They uncovered it and there were more than Eighty Dirham(درهم) left.

Zaynab(زينب) she was so, terrified with this amount of money, the whole concept of all of this wealth coming in.

You know, in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ they were so poor.

A month would pass by without ever having a hot meal.

Zaynab(زينب) raised her hands up and said: "O Allah!

Don’t allow me to live until, the next time Umar(عُمَر) gives me At'ta(عطاء)." And she died soon after that.

She felt that this wealth is a Fitnah(فِتْنَه) I don’t want to see this again.

So O Allah! take me away before this happens.

And Allahعَزّوجَلّ accepted her Dua(دُعَا) and she died.

She was the first of the wife of Rasool Allah ﷺ to pass away.

The wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ Ummahatul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين) were urging Umar(عُمَر) to allow them to make Hajj(حَجْ) and he was refusing but when they insisted, he agreed.

And he told Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and Sa’ad Bin Abi Waqas(سعد بن ابي وقاص) to accompany them and he said; One of you be in front and one of you should be in back and don’t walk with them.

Because they are non Mahram(محرم).

So, he said; Don’t walk with them.

You walk one ahead and one behind.

And he said; Whenever they spend the night you have them stay in a protected area and you stand and guard them.

And in Tawaf(طواف) do not allow any man to make Tawaf(طواف) with them, Only woman can make Tawaf(طواف) with them.

He was giving special care to Ummahatul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين).

Nobody would ever be prevented from Tawaf(طواف).

The only exception was when Ummahatul-Mo’mineen(امهات المؤمنين) are making Tawaf(طواف) no men are allowed there, so only women can make Tawaf(طواف) with them.

These were exceptional rules that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had for Ummahatul-Mo’mineen رضي الله عنهن.

And as I have said; he was very close to Ali(علي), he was one of his senior advisors, and he used to love Al-Hassan wal Hussain(الحسن ولحسين).

Al-Hussain Ibn Ali(الحسين ابن علي) said and Al-Hussain(الحسين) was young, very young at that time, he said; Umar(عُمَر) saw me once and he told me, O my son! Why don’t you visit me?

How come you are not visiting me?

So, Al-Hussain(الحسين) said; I will Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين).

Al-Hussain(الحسين) said: I went to visit Umar(عُمَر) and he was having a private session with Muawiya Ibn Abi Sufiyan(معاويه ابن ابي سفيان).

And Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عمر) was standing at the door and he wasn’t even giving permission to come in.

Even Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عمر) wasn’t allowed to enter the room - because Umar(عُمَر) was meeting privately with Muawiya(معاويه).

Al-Hussain(الحسين) said: When I saw Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله ابن عمر) himself walking away, I didn’t bother asking for permission to go in, so I left.

A while later Umar(عُمَر) meets me and he says, O my son! How come you didn’t visit me?

Al-Hussain(الحسين) said: Well I did visit you but you were meeting with Muawiya(معاويه) and Abdullah(عبدالله) wasn’t even given the permission to go in,

so I didn’t ask for permission.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said: O my son!

I would give you priority over my own son, Abdullah(عبدالله) because you are in my head.

Umar(عُمَر) placed his hand on the head of Al-Hussain(الحسين) and he said; It is Allah and then you.

For me, it is Allah and then you.

That was the love that he had to Al-Hussain(الحسين) and Al-Hassan(الحسن) the sons of Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه.

Al-Abbas(العباس) and Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنهم had a financial dispute Ali(علي) and his uncle Abbas(العباس).

So, they came in to meet with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) and Umar(عُمَر) had Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف), Az-Zubair Bin Al-Awam(الزبير بن عوام), Sa’ad bin Abi Waqas(سعد بن ابي وقاص), some other Sahabah(صحابه), Uthman(عثمان).

So, Uthman(عثمان) said; O Ameer-Ul-Mo’mineen(امير المؤمنين) why don’t you judge between these two men and get it over with.

The dispute has been going on for some time.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Slow down, Didn’t you know that Rasool Allah ﷺ said that the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) do not leave behind any inheritance.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says that we the prophets do not leave behind inheritance.

What we leave behind is charity, is Sadaqah(صدقه).

So, this is an exception from the rule of inheritance.

Inheritance usually goes to the family members but the exception are with the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

They said; Yes! Umar(عُمَر) asked Ali(علي) and Abbas(عباس), he said: Don't you know that Rasool Allah ﷺ  said that?

They said: Yes!." Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: And you know that Rasool Allah ﷺ in his days, he used to live off the Fai(فيئ), the spoils of war that came from Bannu Nadhir(بنو نضير).

What he used to do is he use to take from it, enough to support his family for a year and then the rest would give it out in Sadaqah(صدقه), isn’t that true?

They said; Yes!, that’s true.

Umar(عُمَر) said; And when Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away, Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) held on to that land and he would give you enough for a year and he would spend the rest in Sadaqah(صدقه), isn’t that true?

Ali(علي) and Abbas(عباس) said; "Yes!".

Umar(عُمَر) said: And then when I became Khalifah(خليفه) for the first two years of my life that's was what I was doing.

I would take what Rasool Allah ﷺ used to take and would give it to you, Ali(علي) your portion goes to your wife Fatima(فاطمه) because she is daughter of Rasool Allah ﷺ

and Al-Abbas(العباس), because you were asking for your portion from Muhammadﷺ being his uncle and I used to give you that isn’t that true?

They said: Yes!.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: And then I gave it to you because you asked me for it.

And you said, that you will follow the same way that I was following, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was following and Rasool Allah ﷺ was following in distributing the harvest of this land

and you agreed to that and you took it from me.

And now you are coming and complaining that you are having a dispute among you.

I am not going to make any ruling among you.

You either follow the same way or you give it back to me and I will take care of it.

So, when it came to following the rules, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would follow the rules strictly, and even though he had the love of the house hold of Rasool Allah ﷺ but in this particular situation,

he told Al-Abbas(العباس) and Ali(علي) either you are up to it, and you can take care of that land yourself and not fight among you or you give it back to me and I will be the one to manage it.

Tayeb(طيب), IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله رَبِّ الْعَلَمِيْنَ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً

اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ الله سمعناواطعنا لَئَنَّ أَبِيْ رَجُلٌ طَوِيْلَ الْقَامَةْ العَرِيْضَ الْمُنْكَبَيْنْ وَآتَيْتُمْ اِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنْطَارَا

أَصَابَتْ اِمْرَأَةْ وَأَخْطَاءْ عُمر كُلُّ اَحَدْ اَفْقَهْ مِنْ عمر مَنْ يَهْدِالله فَلَا مُضِّلَّ لَهْ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ لله فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهْ

وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ لله فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهْ وَكَلْبُهُمْ بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ ۚ عِلْم لَا يَنْفَعْ لَقَدْ كَانَ فِيْ قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةْ

What does (وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا) - Mean?

what does, (الْحَمِلَاتِ وُقْرَا) mean?

فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرَا اِنَّ كُلَّ مَحْبُوْسِ لِمَنْفَعَةْ غَيْرِهِ تَلْزَمَه’ نَفَقَتَه’ جُعِلَ رِزْقِيْ تَحْتَ ظِلْ رُمْحِيْ مَنْ أَحُجُّ وَأَعْتَمِرُوْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَّ الظَّهْرِيْ

وَحُلَّتِيْ فِى الشِّتَآءِ وَالصَّيْفَ وَقُوْتُ عَيَالِيْ اُشْبِعُهُمْ وَسَهْمِيْ فِيءَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ فَإِنَّمَا اَنَا رَجُلٌ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ

مُنْذُوْ نُوْأَرِّخُ مُنْذُوْ أَنْ خَرَجَ النَّبِيْ مِنْ الاَرْضِ شِّرْكْ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِسُنَّتِي وَسُنَّةِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ الْمَهْدِيينَ، عَضُّوا عَلَيْهَا بِالنَّوَاجِذِ،

السلام و عليك يا امير المؤمنين السلام وعليكم يا امير المؤمنين إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ ۗ تَتْرُكُوْنَ عُمر وَهُوَ مُقْبِلٌ عَلَيْكُمْ حَتَّى اِذَاا شّتَغَلَ بِاَمُوْرِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ اَتَيْتُمُوْهَ

يَا اِبْنِ الُخَطَابْ! كُنْتَ وَضِيْعًا فَرَفَعَكَ الله، وَكُنْتَ ضَالًا فَهَدَاـكَ الله ، وَكَنْتَ ذَلِيْلاً فَاعَزَّكَ الله، ثُمَّ حَمَلَكَ عَلى رِقَابِ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ فَجَاءَكَ رَجُلٌ يَسْتَعْدِيْكَ فَضَرَبْتَه،

مَاَ تَقُوْلُ لِرَبِّكَ غَدًا اِذَا اَتَيْتُه؟

حَاسِبُ اَنْفُسَكُمْ قَبْلَ اَنْ تُحَاسِبُ وَزِنُوْهَا قَبْلَ اَنْ تُوْزَنُوْا وَتَزَيَّنُوْا وَتَهَيَّئُوْ الِلْعَرْضِ الْأَكْبَرْ يَوْمَ تُعْرَضُوْنَ لَا تَخْفَى مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةْ

لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكََ هَلَكْت وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْذُوْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتْ لَا تَسْتَطِيْعَ إِلَّا اَنْ تُعَاهِدْ رَعَيَّتَكْ فَتَأْمُرْ وَتَنْهَى

قَدْ قُلْتَ وَاللهُ أَعْلَمْ، قَدْ قُلْتَ وَاللهُ أَعْلَمْ، اِنَّ الله اَكْثَرَ الْخَيْرَ وَ اَوْسَعَ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الرِّزْقَ، فَلَوْأَكَلْتَ طَعَامًا أَطْيَبَ مِنْ ذَلِكْ وَلَبِسْتَ ثِيَابًاأَلْيَنَ مِنْ ثَوْبِكْ

فَكَأَنَّ اَصْحَابَه’ تَأَاذَّ وْا بِهَا وَاللهِ مَا كَانَ عُمر ابن الخطاب بِأَقْدَمِنَا هِجْرَةْ وَقَدْ عَرَفْتُ بِأَيِّ شَيْئٍ فَضَلَنَا كَانَأَازْهَدُنَا فِي الدُّنْيَاء

وَأَيُّ عَبْدٍ هُوَّ أَعْبَدْ مِنِّيْ وَمِنَّ الْأحنف؟

إِنَّه’ مَنْ وَلِيَ اَمْرُالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، يَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ لَهُمْ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ لِسَيِّدِهْ فِيْ فِى النَّصِيْحَةْ وَأَدَاءِالْأَمَانَهْ

مَا رَأَيْنَا رَجًلً أَقْضَى بِلْحَقِّ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَاأَاقْوَلَ لِلْحَقِّ وَلَاأَاشَّدَّ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ مِنْكَ يا امير المؤمنين فَأَنْتَ خَيْرُا النَّاسِ بَعْدَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

هِيْ يا ابن الخطاب فَوَالله مَا تُعْطِيْنَا الْجَزْلَ وَلَا تَحْكُمْ فِيْنَا بِالْعَدْلَ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِيْنِ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِيْنِ

فَمَا تَجَاوَزَهَا حِيْنَ تَلَاهَا فَاِنَّه’ كَانَ وَقَافًا عِنْدَ كِتَابِ الله يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ قَدْ بَدَلِيْ اَلَّا تَزَوَّجَ فِيْ يَوْمِ هَذَا اَوْ يَوْمِ هَذَا

لَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيَّا يا امير المؤمنين غَشَشْتِيْ أَبَاكِيْ، وَ نَصَحْتِيْ أَقَارِبِكْ إِنَّا مَعْشَرَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ لَا نُوْرَثْ مَا تَرَكْنَاه’ صَدَقَهْ

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

parts.english:
When Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه was feeling, death approaching him he told the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, I want you, to choose for yourselves a Khalifah(خليفه) after me

your Baiy’ah(بيعة) to me is over, and I am not incharge of your affairs anymore because I am leaving this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

And he wanted this affair to be settled before he dies.

So, Sahabah رضي الله عنهم discussed the matter but then they came back to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and they said: We trust your advice, so we put it back in your hands you choose for us.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: Then give me some time to decide.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه called Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) and he asked him, he said: "Inform me about Umar(عُمَر)?" Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf رضي الله عنه said:

"You don’t ask me about anything but you have better knowledge than me." Anything that you ask me about, you know it better than I do.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: "Even though, I want to hear your opinion?" So, Abdur Rahman Ibn Awf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف) Said: Umar(عُمَر) is better than what you think of him!

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: Keep this conversation private, he left.

And then Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) invited Uthman Ibn Affan( عثمان ابن عفان), he said: "Tell me about Umar(عُمَر)?" Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) said: You know him

basically he said the same thing, "Anything you ask me about, you know it better than I do!" The Sahabah رضي الله عنهم  gave it to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), that he was most scholarly and knowledgeable among them.

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said: I still want to hear your opinion on Umar(عُمَر), he said: I know what I know of Umar(عُمَر), and Allah is my witness.

Is that, his inside is better than his outside and there is none among us, like him.

There is none of us equal to Umar(عُمَر) and what we see of Umar(عُمَر) in the outside and think is good and what is inside is even better.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه told Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان), "If I am going to by pass him, it's not going beyond you!" If I am not going to choose Umar(عُمَر), you will be my next choice.

And then he make Naseeha(نصيحه) with some of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم for example, Usayed Ibn Khuzair(اُسَيْد اِبن خضير), one of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

He was asked about Umar(عُمَر).

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه asked him, Usayed Ibn Khuzair(اُسَيْد اِبن خضير) said: "He is pleased, with what pleases the ummah(امة), and he is displeased with what displeases the Ummah(امة).

And there is none among us, who is more competent, stronger for this affair, then him.

He is the most competent among us, to run this affair.

So, basically all of the Sahabah(صحابه) were giving Umar(عُمَر), the same council but there was the concern of some of the Sahabah(صحابه) for example, Talha(طلحه)

that Umar(عُمَر) is rough and Talha(طلحه) was quite stern in the Naseeha(نصيحه) that he gave Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) he told him, O Abu Bakr(ابو بكر)! How will you answer Allah on the Day of Judgment?

When He tells you, you appointed over the Muslims a man, who is harsh and rough.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابوبكرالصديق) was ill and he was on his bed and he sat up straight and he said: Are you threatening me with Allah?

I will respond to Allah on the Day of Judgment by saying; "I have chosen the best among them to lead them.

he is the best among you.

So, the opinion of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was settling on Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه and he wrote a document of his appointment of Umar(عُمَر).

And he gave that document to Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) and he said: "You go and read it in the Masjid(مسجد) and you take a Baiy’ah(بيعة) from the people."

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) wanted to make sure that this issue is settled before he dies.

So, Uthman(عثمان) goes to the Masjid(مسجد) and, he tells the people, Do you give Baiy’ah(بيعة) to, who is in this document? And they all gave Baiy’ah(بيعة)."

So, Baiy’ah(بيعة) was given to Umar(عُمَر) during the time of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه before he passes away.

Ibn Masood رضي الله عنه, he says; Ibn Masood(ابن مسعود) says; "The three with the greatest intuitions among mankind are the woman or the wife of Musa(موسى)

and the Master of Yousuf(يوسف) and Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابو بكر الصديق), when he appointed Umar(عمر).

What are these three incidence?

Ibn Masood(ابن مسعود) is saying, that these three have the greatest Farasah(فراسة), intuition that ever existed among humanity.

The wife of Musa(موسى), when Musaعليه السلام left Egypt, he was running away from the Egypt to save his life that was before he became a Nabi(نَبِي) because they wanted to execute him,

so he left Egypt and he went to the land of Mad'yan(مدائن), he left alone and he didn’t have any transportation and he was travelling and his shoes were torn apart,

and then his skin on his feet was tearing apart and he was so hungry he had to eat the leaves of trees until, his lips were cracking and the color was turning green.

Because these are not edible, they not suitable for human consumption.

And Musa عليه السلام is going through that difficult journey and then he reaches to the land of Mad'yan(مدائن) and even though he is exhausted and tired and hungry.

He sees these two women waiting on the side of this well, while all are the men are fighting to get water.

Musa عليه السلام is still practicing, Even though, he is in that exhausted state This was the personality of Musa(موسى) he cannot hold back "enjoining good and forbidding evil"

even if he is extremely tired and exhausted.

He is in a foreign land he doesn’t know anybody there but he still cannot stand seeing wrong happening in front of his eyes.

So, he goes in and asks these women, these two women, they're sisters that how come you are not quenching the thirst of your animals?

They said: We cannot go in and fight with the men.

These men had no honor, they're fighting over the water and have these women waiting, they are not standing in queue They're just fighting to get the water and the poor ladies are waiting.

Musa عليه السلام jumps in and fights his way through, and he gets them water.

And he's even fighting, when he's in that exhausted state, he gets some water and then he goes under a tree and he throws himself under the tree, completely exhausted.

He has no where to stay, no food to eat, no supporter no helper.

So, he just lays down, and he says "O Allah whatever good, you bring down on me, I need it." I have reached, a state where anything would do, O Allah! Anything,

He is begging Allahعَزّ وجَلّ for anything.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) the Dua(دُعَا) of Musa(موسى) was immediately accepted.

And this tells you brothers and sisters, the consequences of doing good.

Musa عليه السلام has every excuse in the world to be passive at that moment.

And just sit down under the tree and forget about what those people are doing?

Those two women they went back home, and one of them went to her father and said: O my father! Why don’t you hire that man?

Because the best man to hire is the man, who is trust worthy and strong.

That action of Musa(موسى), that action of Musa(موسى) look at the consequences of it.

The woman goes back home and tells her old father, hire this man.

So, she comes back and she calls Musa(موسى).

Musa(موسى) goes there and he gets a job, he finds a wife because this woman marries him.

and he was given a guarantee of work up to eight or ten years.

So, he signed a contract to work for this man for eight to ten years as a result of that small action of good that he did Rasool Allah ﷺ says; "Never belittle anything good that you do." Anything!

You don’t know what will be the act that will make it or break it.

Whether on the side of good or side of evil.

A person could go up levels in Jannah(جنة) because of one good word and they good go down levels in Hell fire because of one evil word.

And they're not even paying attention to those words.

One small deed can tilt the scales and you will enter into Jannah(جنة) one evil deed can tilt the scales and you end up going to Hell fire.

"Do not belittle anything good that you do." And in the same time, don't see any sin as being insignificant So, Ibn Masood(ابن مسعود) says; This woman had great Farasa(فراسه), is very intuitive.

THE SECOND SAHIB YUSUF(صاحب يوسُف): When Yusuf(يوسف) was found in the well, he was sold as a slave in Egypt.

The man, who purchased him, we would say the Prime Minister or Treasurer of Egypt He is the one who, purchased Yusuf(يوسف), when he took this young boy home, he told his wife:

Make his stay with us honorable.

He is a slave, but he told his wife make his stay among us all honorable because one day, he might be of great benefit for us or we might adopt him as a son.

So, this man saw some marks of intelligence and wisdom in Yusuf عليه السلام so he gave special instructions to his wife to treat him well.

He didn’t know that one day this man will grow up and be one of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

AND THE THIRD: Ibn Masood(ابن مسعود) says; Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), when he appointed Umar(عُمَر) to be the Khalifah(خليفه).

May be one of the greatest deeds of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه is that before he died, he appointed Umar(عُمَر) to be the Khalifah(خليفه).

Because everything that Umar(عُمَر) did after that, goes into the scales of Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابو بكر الصديق).

And that’s why Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابو بكر الصديق) is higher than everybody including Umar(عُمَر) because Umar(عُمَر) his Khilafah(خِلَافَه) becomes one of the Hasanat(حسنات) of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

It was a choice that had a Toufique(توفيق) of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ Allahعَزّ وجَلّ gave Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) success in that choice of leaving behind Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was passing away he came and he gave him, some words to comfort the Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه

among those words he said; No two men disputed, your Khilafah(خِلَافَه) which means that the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Umar(عُمَر) was the consensus of the Sahabah(صحابه)

and we know that consensus, in this Ummah(امة) is Hujjah(حجة), is an evidence and here we just don’t have consensus of the Ummah(امة), we have consensus of Greatest Generation of the Ummah(امة), the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم.

We know in Fiqh(فقه) that the evidence is the Ayah(آية) of the Qur’an or the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ or Ijma’ah(اجماع), the consensus.

So, it was the consensus of Sahabah رضي الله عنهم that the Umar(عُمَر) is the Khalifah(خليفه) and that he is the most deserving of that position.

So, who can dare, after that to doubt in the validity of the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه?

Among the generations, where there's evil and Bida’a(بدعة).

If the greatest generation, the pure generation of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم agreed that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is the Khalifah(خليفه),

who can dare to say after that no it should have been somebody else?

When Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه became Khalifah(خليفه) there are few different speeches, that were attributed to him, one of them was, he says;

"O people! Know that I have been appointed to govern your affairs" So realize now, that my roughness is now weaker, that roughness has been weakened.

But I will still be rough and harsh on the people of oppression and transgression.

"And I am not going to see anybody who oppresses others, but I am going to put one of their cheeks in the dirt and I will step with my foot over the other cheek,

until they give the people what is due to them.

And then he said: "But I will put my cheek, on the floor to the people of piety and  righteousness. " I will be so humble towards these people, it is as if, I am placing my cheek on the earth for them.

And I will promise you a few things which you can hold me accountable to.

"I promise you that I will take nothing of your Kharaj(خراج), Kharaj(خراج) is what your land produces.

And I will take nothing from the spoils of war, that you get except that which is rightfully taken.

Which I am allowed to take, according to the Book of Allah Then he also said: And that money I will only spend it, in accordance to law of Allah.

So, I will not going to take anything except if the Book of Allah allows it, and I will only spend it, in a way that pleases Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And I promise you that I will increase your salaries, and your provisions and I promise you that I will protect your borders." "And I promise you not to throw you into destruction."

"And I will not keep the soldiers away from their families, for extended periods of time." And when I send you out in Jihad(جهاد) I will be the father of your children, until you come back.

So, have Taqwa(تقوي), O servants of Allah!" A FEW POINTS REGARDING THIS SPEECH First of all Umar(عُمَر) is changing his personality Umar(عُمَر) is saying, that roughness is now turning into softness.

Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه has said, when some of the Sahabah(صحابه) told him; How will you appoint a man, who is tough?

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said: Umar(عُمَر) was tough, because he saw that I was weak but when I pass away, he will leave behind much of that behavior

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said about himself, Rasool Allah ﷺ had a very great heart that was open for everyone so I had to be a sword in his presence.

And Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابو بكر الصديق) was very soft man, so I had to be tough in his presence.

But now, since I have assumed responsibility of you, that harshness will be turned into softness.

It shows you something about Umar(عُمَر) that he had control over himself to the extent that he can change his personality.

And he could be the man of the moment and act according to, what those times need.

So, in the times of Rasool Allah ﷺ he was carrying the certain character, in times of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) a certain character, and in the time of his Khilafah(خِلَافَه), he change his ways

So, that he could modify his personality to be appropriate for those circumstances And this is great ability, don’t be a slave of yourself.

You need to take control of yourself and you need to tame your Nafs(نفس).

Number two: You can see the importance of financial justice.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is saying that I am not going to take your money, and I am not going to spend your money, except in the rightful way.

A Muslim leader is not a Muslim leader if he is taking money in an un rightful way, and spending it in a wrong way.

Part of being an Ameer(امير) over Muslims is that you are accountable financially and you spend the money and you take it way, in a way that pleases Allahعَزّوجَلّ

So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is mentioning this as one of the points that people need to hold him accountable to.

Number three: What an amazing government was that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is paying, his citizens salaries and this is not for any work that they are doing.

Every citizen of the Islamic Khilafah(خِلَافَه) would get a salary, a payment.

These were not government employees, everyone has a right to money of the Islamic Treasury.

This is money that belongs to the Muslims, so Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was giving it back to them.

This is not something that, he invented this is something that existed in times of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and in the times of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Umar(عُمَر) just promised to increase it.

I am going to increase your payments.

So, those were very blessed times.

Number four: In offensive Jihad(جهاد), the safety of the Muslims is paramount Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is saying that I am promise you, not to throw you into the destruction.

He would only send out the army, if there was sufficient reconnaissance done and if there is not great risk and there is not great risk.

So, there is difference between Defensive Jihad(جهاد) and Offensive Jihad(جهاد).

In Defensive Jihad(جهاد), the Muslims takes greater risk and they sacrifice their lives and their wealth and their family.

But when we are talking about Offensive Jihad(جهاد), which is for the sake of Daw'ah(دعوة) the risk that, they take is less.

And their safety is taken into consideration by the Khulafah(خلفاء), that was something that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) instituted and it was something also that we find with Umar Bin Abdul-Aziz رضي الله عنه he recalled the army

that was laying siege on Constantinople(قسطنطنية) because he said, that the Muslims are dying.

Number five: The role of the leader is to protect the people not to protect himself.

Now, the leaders they are concerned about their personal safety, they don’t care about the Ummah(امة).

Let the Ummah(امة) die!

As long as I am safe, I am going to use the entire army and police force to protect myself Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was concerned about the safety of the Ummah(امة).

So, he said, I am not going to throw you in destruction.

I am going to take care of you, I am going to take care of your families.

While, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) would go around without any security guards.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) did not have even one bodyguard to accompany him but he use to pay a lot of attention to the security of Muslims.

In fact, in one of his letter, he said; You do not sent out reconnaissance mission unless they are properly secured and defended.

Number six; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is telling his army in your absence I will be the father to your children and care taker of your wives.

Just think about how much psychological comfort that would give to a soldier when he is fighting.

When he is in the front line, he will realize that if something happens to him, my family would be taken care of.

The Khalifah(خليفه) would be their father, he will be there for them.

So, this motivates the army, it’s a morale boost for them and this is the concerned that the leader should have for his people.

And that’s why? Rasool Allah ﷺ said; "That every Prophet has been a shepherd of sheep".

They said: "what about you, Rasool Allah ﷺ ?" He said: Even me!

How come all of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) were shepherds of sheep? Specifically sheep.

because a shepherd of sheep is dealing with a weak animals, these are not camels these are sheep see the camel is an arrogant proud animal but the sheep are weak and they are vulnerable

they could be attacked at any moment, by a wolf or a wild animal.

So, the shepherd learns responsibility and is always guarding his flock.

And the shepherd has a lot of mercy towards these weak animals.

So, that is the training for the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), so when they start giving Daw'ah(دعوة) to the people they carry on those characteristics with them.

They see themselves as responsible for the security of their followers, they see themselves as care takers of their followers.

And a shepherd since he is standing, has a vantage point, that the sheep do not have.

The shepherd is the first to see danger approaching, but the sheep cannot see that coming.

So, the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allah has that ability to see the danger when it's on its way before his followers.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying; The analogy of me and you is like somebody who's sitting next to the bonfire.

And all of these flying insects are trying to jump into the fire, thinking that it’s a light and they don’t know that it will burn them.

And I am pulling you away from fire while you are forcing yourselves into it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying I want to save you from the fire and you don’t know that you are a heading towards it.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) is now treating the Ummah(امة) as if he is the shepherd, caring for them.

AN ISSUE RELATING TO BAY'AH(بيعة): Number one: The Bay’ah(بيعة) that was given to the Khulafah(خُلَافَاء) was given only by the people of Madina.

It wasn’t given by everybody.

As long as the people of Madina gave Bay’ah(بيعة) to the Khalifah(خليفه) that was seen as sufficient.

They didn’t get the Bay’ah(بيعة) from each and every Muslim living in the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) because it is impossible to do that.

It would take months and months if they are going to solicit Bay’ah(بيعة) from each and every individual living in Islamic Khilafah(خِلَافَه).

So, as long as the people of Madina gave Bay’ah(بيعة) that was seen as sufficient and after that all of the people follow.

So, Al-Madina had It had the people, who make the decision.

That’s number one.

2. Number two: We don’t find it anywhere in our old references that, they took Bay’ah(بيعة) from women It was only the men, who were giving the Bay’ah(بيعة)

women never gave Bay’ah(بيعة) to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) or Umar(عُمَر) or Uthman(عثمان) or Ali(علي) or any of the Khulfah(خلافاء) after that.

And that was seen as a natural thing to the extent that none of our classical scholars ever talked about that issue in their books of Fiqh(فقه).

It was seen as natural or normal for the men to give the Bay’ah(بيعة) and the women not to give the Bay’ah(بيعة).

But on the other hand, there is nothing in Qur’an or Sunnah(سنة) that says that the women are not allowed to give Baiy’ah(بيعة).

So, the issue is left open.

Women never gave Bay’ah(بيعة) before however, there is nothing in Qur’an or Sunnah(سنة) that prohibits them from giving Baiy’ah(بيعة).

And this is like many of the other issues that relate to politics.

The general guide lines were given in Qur’an and Sunnah(سنة) but the details were left open for the people to formulate according to the need of their times.

Even when it came to the appointment of the Khalifah(خليفه), we find that it happened in different ways Rasool Allah ﷺ did not appoint anyone even though he gave many implicit indications

that Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) should be the Khalifah(خليفه).

He was the Imam(اِمَام) of Salah(صلاة).

He was Ameer(امير) on Hajj(حَجْ).

When women came to Rasool Allah ﷺ he said, She asked for something from Rasool Allahﷺ told her to come later she said: What if I don’t find you? He said: "Go to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر)"

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling this woman that if you don’t find me the next in line is Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

While Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) appointed Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) specifically.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) appointed a council of six to choose.

So, it was done in different ways.

The general guidelines are Al-Adl(العدل) justice, Shoora(شورى) consultation Baiy’ah(بيعة) giving pledge of allegiance but other areas are left open for the Mujtahideen(مجتهدين) to decide according to the needs of the time.

Now, women were consulted in terms of Shoora(شورى), women are consulted it is just the Baiy’ah(بيعة) that, they didn’t give the Baiy’ah(بيعة) to Khulafah(خلافاء)

They did however, give Bay’ah(بيعة) to Rasool Allah ﷺ which was the Baiy’ah(بيعة) Of Islam.

WE WILL TALK ABOUT THE GOVERNMENT OF UMAR IBN KHATTAB رضي الله عنه.

Number one: Shoora(شورى) it was a government of Shoora(شورى).

"It is part of the mercy of Allah that you do deal gently with them where if you were severe or harsh hearted, they would have broken away from about you.

So, pass over their faults and ask for Allah’s forgiveness for them and consult them in their affairs.

Then when you have taken a decision put your trust in Allah for Allah love those who put their trust in Him." Al-Imran(ألعمران) verse 159.

Umar Ibn Khattab(عمرإبن ألخطاب) said; There is no good in an affair, that was decided without consultation.

There is no Barakah(بركة) in it.

So, if you want to have Barakah(بركة) in your affairs make Shoora(شورى) He also says; Consult in your affairs the ones, who fear Allah.

And this is an important teaching, you need to consult the people of Taqwa(تقوي) the people of righteousness.

If you consult a Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ), he will not do you any good.

It doesn’t say that you go and make a Shoora(شورى) with everyone including Iblees(ابليس) you ask him for his opinions.

and it also means that you don’t go and ask the opinion of his followers.

So, you don’t go around asking for advice from people, who do not have the concern for the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

You need to seek the Shoora(شورى) from the people who have Taqwa(تقوى) of Allah and they also need to be experts in that particular area that you are asking them.

Not everybody who has Taqwa(تقوى) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ knows about everything So, when you seek Shoora(شورى), consultation you look for Taqwa(تقوى) and you also look for competence in that particular area.

They have to know what they are talking about?

So, these two qualities are the two elements that are needed when you are looking for advice.

There are many people, who have understanding but they don’t have Taqwa(تقوى) and there are many people of Taqwa(تقوى) but they don’t have the understanding.

So, you have to go to the right people and ask them for Shoora(شورى).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) not only would he make Shoora(شورى) but he would make sure that, his governors, and generals would make Shoora(شورى).

For example, when he appointed Abi Obaid Thaqafi(اَبِي عُبَيْداَلثَّقَفِيْ) to lead an army he said; "He told him, listen and obey to the Companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ

because he wasn’t Companion, he was a Taba’ee(تابعي), he said listen and obey to the companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ especially those who have attended Badr(بدر)."

And he told Utbah Bin Ghazwan(عتبه ابن غزوان), who he also appointed as an army general, he told him, I have written a letter to Abi Al-Ala Hadrami(ابو الاعلى حضرمى)

to send with you ‘Arfajah Ibn Harshama(عرفجه ابن هرشمه), "I told Abu Al-Ala Hadrami(ابو الاعلى حضرمى) to send with you this man Arfajah(عرفجه)

and Umar(عُمَر) told him this man is good, in his fighting the enemy and their plans." He knows how to fight the enemy and to fight the plans of the enemy.

So, he needs to be with you and he said; "Seek his advice and make him close to you, Waqraba'a(وقربه).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) for example, he placed a travel ban on the senior Sahabah(صحابه), he told them you are not allowed to leave the Madina

You know Umar(عُمَر) have some strict rules.

He told all of these senior Sahabah(صحابه), you are not allowed to leave Madina, you have to stick to me here.

One reason was he wanted them to be his Shoora(شورى) Council another reason was Umar(عُمَر) was afraid that if these senior men spread around

that could be a reason for contention and divisions among the Muslims.

Because all of these men are strong leaders so people are going to coming around them and then you will have various points of influence among the Ummah(امة).

And he was afraid that everyone of these men would lead the people in different direction so he wanted to make sure that they are under his watchful eye.

So, he told them that you have to stick with me here in Madina SOME OF HIS CLOSE ADVISORS, Al-Abbas Bin Abdul-Muttalib(العباس ابن عبدالمطلب) the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ and his son Abdullah(عبدالله)

Now Abdullah(عبدالله) was young, he is very young.

Abdullah Ibn Abbas(عبدالله ابن عباس) was thirteen years old when Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

So, here we are talking about someone who was in his early twenties And you would always find him, next to Umar(عُمَر).

He would accompany him, where ever Umar(عُمَر) would go.

So some of the elder Sahabah(صحابه) were wondering how come?

This young man was sitting on this Shoora(شورى) body.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wanted them to know the reason.

So, he asked him, he said: "Tell me what's the meaning of; "When the victory of Allah approaches and people enter into Islam in multitudes then ask Allah for forgiveness because Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

what does this Surah(سورة) mean?

So, the Sahabah(صحابه) mentioned some few different views and then he asked Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) what does it mean?

He said: "This Surah(سورة) is the obituary of Rasool Allah ﷺ, it was telling him that your death is near.

Because when you finish a deed Allah tells you to ask for forgiveness.

So, since Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling Muhammadﷺ to ask Allah for forgiveness, it means that he has completed his mission.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said, that’s why Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) is with me.

He was the only one, who knew the answer.

Some of his advisors are, Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) and Abdur Rahman Ibn Aauf(عبدالرحمن ابن عوف), and Ali Ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه, and Ubae Ibn Ka'ab(ابيئ بن كعب), scholar of Quran

Zayd Ibn Thabit(زيد ابن ثابت), the one, who compiled Al-Mus'haf(المصحف).
