It was Umar(عُمَر), who was doing the talking, so Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) got bit closer to Umar(عُمَر) and he said: I ask you in the name of Allah, Umar(عُمَر) did we kill Muhammad(محمد)?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: In the name of Allah! No! And he is right now, listening to you talking.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) said: You are more truthful to me, and righteous than Ibn Abi Qamia’h(ابن ابي قميه).

I would believe you and not believe Ibn Abi Qamia’h(ابن ابي قميه).

In the battle of Ghazwat Bani Al-Mutalaq(غزوة بني اَلْمُصْطَلَقْ), one of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين), he kicked one of the Ansaar(أنْصَار), so the Ansaari(أنْصَاري) said:

He is calling the Ansaar(أنْصَار), to gang up on the Muhajiri(مهاجري) and the Muhajiri(مهاجري) said: He is now calling for the Muhajireen(مهاجرين).

And a fight was about to start between the Companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ for such a small affair.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Are you calling to the slogans of Jahiliyah(جاهليه) and I am still living among you?

You are calling for this Nationalism, this Tribalism, while I am still here?

And then he said: Stay away from it, because it has evil smell.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is talking about, the perils, the evils of nationalism and tribalism.

He is telling them, to stay away from it, because it has an evil smell.

Now, Abdullah Ibn Ubae(عبدالله إبن أبي), who was the head of the Munafiqeen(منافقين).

When he heard about this incidence, he said: That’s what they have done, when we go back to Madina, the noble one, will drive out the lowly one.

What Abdullah Ibn Ubae(عبدالله إبن أبي) was referring to, is that.

He, the noble one, is gonna drive out Muhammadﷺ, the lowly one.

These were the words of the head of the Munafiqeen(منافقين).

His son Abdullah(عبدالله) heard about this statements of his father.

He stood on the entrance to Madina and he said to his father, I am not going to allow you in, he is holding his sword in his hand, he said: I am not gonna allow you in, until Rasool Allah ﷺ allows you in.

That shows you the loyalty that Islam has built that he was willing to kill his father.

If Rasool Allah ﷺ does not give him permission to come in.

Now Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه said: O Rasool Ullah, let me behead this Munafiq(منافق).

What did Rasool Allah ﷺ say?

He said: I don’t want people to say that Muhammad(محمد) is killing his followers.

Over here Rasool Allah ﷺ is not disputing the fact, that Abdullah Ibn Ubae(عبدالله إبن أبي) deserves to die, for what he said, that was Kuffr(كفر), it was Riddah(ردة).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is not disputing the fact, that he deserved to be executed.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying the reason, why I am not going to implement that punishment against Abdullah Ibn Ubae(عبدالله إبن أبي), is because I don’t want people to say that Muhammad(محمد) is killing his followers.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was concerned about the reputation of the Muslims.

Rasool Allah ﷺ has given a reputation of strength and unity, he has given reputation of loyalty that the Muslims stick together that, they do not allow any of the enemy to come between them.

And this has been witnessed by visitors who come to Madina from among the ranks, of the disbelievers.

For example one of them said: I've visited the Roman Emperor in his palace, I've visited Persian Emperor in his palace, I've visited An-Najashi(النجاشي) in his palace,

and I have seen how these kings and emperors were treated but I am telling you that, I have never, ever seen a people who respect and love their leader

like the Sahabah(صحابه) love Muhammadﷺ.

He would be making Wudu(وضؤ) and they would be jumping to grab the droplets of water, falling of his body and then, they would rub their bodies with it.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not want the people to say, that Muhammadﷺ is killing his followers because that would turn people away from Islam.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying I don’t want people to say that Muhammad(محمد) is killing his followers.

Some lessons here,  N0: 1 The perils of nationalism, this is a disease which Rasool Allah ﷺ said, will carry on in my Ummah(امة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Two things of Jahiliyah(جاهليه) will remain in you, this Asabiyyah(عصبية), this nationalism or tribalism and Niyahaa(نِيَاحَةْ) on the Mo'ta(مَوْتَى) the wailing on the dead.

This is very dangerous disease and it's one of most important gateways of Shaytan(شيطان).

So, Allahعزُّوَجل is warning us, Tell My servants to speak good words because Shaytan(شيطان) causes disunity or rifts between them.

You could say one word that would be misinterpreted by your brother and that could cause a war.

All what Shaytan(شيطان) needs is you to make a slip of a tongue or a wrong word and then he plays in the heart of your brother by giving him a feeling of bad suspicion in what you have said

and after this he just picks up from there and flares up.

All what cause this problem was for one of the Al-Muhajireen(المهاجرين) to kick one of the Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

Allah-Ho-Alam( الله اعلم) if it was accidental or it was intended, Allah-Ho-Alam( الله اعلم).

Anyway that was the reason, why they were about to fight each other.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying; this is the call to Jahiliyyah(جاهليه).

And this disease still exist among the Ummah(امة) today.

There is racism, there is discrimination you would rarely find any two neighbouring Muslim countries who don’t have bickering between them.

They don’t have to be neighbouring, Pakistan and Bangladesh are not neighbouring.

So, it's all over the Muslim world.

Look at the Middle East, every country has problems with every country that is adjacent to it, that's bordering it.

And then within the country you have different tribes and then within tribes, you've different clans that’s all Asabiyyah(عصبية) of Jahiliyyah(جاهليه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: That belongs to the time of Ignorance, pre-Islamic Ignorance.

So, we need to stay away from it.

Everybody is equal and Allahعزُّوَجل differentiates between you, in your status according to your Taqwa(تقوى), The closest to Allahعزُّوَجل among you are the ones, who have Taqwa(تقوى).

IN SULHA-AL-HUDAYBIYYAH(صلح الحديبية) Umrah-Tul-Qadha(عمرة القضاء) and Sulha-Al-Hudaybiyya(صلح حديبة) we will talk about them together, Rasool Allah ﷺ went with Sahabah رضي الله عنهم with the intention of making Umrah(عمرة)

but people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) prevented them from entering into Makkah.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ wants to send one of his Sahabah(صحابه) to negotiate with the leaders of Makkah.

So he proposed to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه that, he should go and negotiate with the people of Makkah.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: O Messenger of Allah there is nobody of Bannu Udae(بنو عُدَي) in Makkah who, I can count on to give me protection.

His clan, the clan of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was small and there wasn’t anybody in there, who was strong at the moment to offer Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) with protection.

That was the system in those days every clan offer protection to his followers.

If the clan is weak or small then you don’t get their protection.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Why don’t you tell Uthman(عثمان) to go, because his family can offer him with protection, Bannu Ummayah(بنوامية).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ agrees with the suggestion of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and he sent Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) to go into Makkah.

Anyways, things developed from there, they were not allowed to go in and they ended up signing up an agreement called Sulha-Al-Hudaybiyyah(صلح الحديبه),

the Peace Pact of Al-Hudaybiyyah(الحديبه).

The terms in there, were not appealing to the Muslims and Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wasn't happy at all.

Some of the terms in that Agreement.

Number one, You don’t make Umrah(عمرة) and you go back.

And they all came with the intention of Umrah(عمرة).

Number two, If a Muslim comes from Makkah to Madina, after the signing of the Agreement he is turned away.

But if a Muslim Apostates and leave from Madina to Makkah he is not turned away.

So, this seems to be a double standard here.

We turn away our people but you don’t turn away the people, who leave from among us.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه he went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and argued with him.

He said: Aren’t you the Messenger of Allah?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Balaa(بَلَى) Yes, Aren’t we the Muslims?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes!

Aren’t these the Mushrikeen(مشركين), the disbelievers Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Why should we then agree to this compromise.?

Why should we agree to these terms.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ responded by saying: I am the Messenger of Allah and I am not going to disobey the commands of Allah and Allah will give me victory.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wasn’t satisfied, he went to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر).

Umar(عمر) now went to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and told him.

Isn’t he the Messenger of Allah? Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said: Yes!

Aren’t we the Muslims?

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said: Yes, Aren’t these the disbelievers?

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) said: Yes, Umar(عُمَر) said: Why should we then agree to such an Agreement.

Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه said: stick to his stirrups, the stirrups of where you put your feet in when you are riding the horse.

Stick to them, meaning stick to whatever he does, don’t move an inch from the way of Rasool Allah ﷺ because I witnessed that he is Messenger of Allah

and that what Allah tells him is the truth and that Allahعَزّ وَجَلّ will not forsake His Messenger.

That was the Yaqeen(يقين) of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

Yes, may be these terms doesn’t make any sense to us however, what he does is right.

And if it's a command of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ then it's right and true and Allahعَزّ وجَلّ has promised to give His Prophet victory He will give it to him.

One of the concerns that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had, is about Umrah(عمرة) Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) told Rasool Allah ﷺ in the earlier conversation.

Didn’t you promise us that we will make an Umrah(عمرة)?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes, I did, But did I promise you that you will make it this year.

Umar(عُمَر) said: No, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Then you will make Umrah(عمرة), you will make Tawaf(طواف) around the house of Allah.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), it was his zeal, that drove him into this conversation.

But after he heard the response of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) you know at times of difficulty the Sahabah(صحابه) would go to Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) was the Sheikh(شيخ) of Sahabah(صحابه)

and his response would put an end to their arguments, and would give them tranquility in their hearts.

It happened when Rasool Allah ﷺ died, it happened when they disputed on the Khilafah(خِلَافَه), it happened on the issue of Army of Usamah(اسامه),

it happened on the appointment of Usamah(اسامه) as the leader of the Army.

Every time it was Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه, who would give them peace.

When Umar(عُمَر) heard the response of Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) he felt that he has done something wrong, he shouldn’t have argued with Rasool Allah ﷺ back and forth.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) says; After that I would give Sadaqah(صدقه) I would fast I would free slaves and I would pray because of the words that I have spoken on that day.

And this is very important lesson for us, when you commit a sin if you want to wipe out that sin, what you do is, do good deeds.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) felt that he has commited a mistake therefore, he was fasting, praying , freeing slaves, giving Sadaqah(صدقه)

not just once of each, he was doing it more than once.

So, that Allahعَزّ وجَلّ will forgive him for what he did.

Good deeds wipes out the evil deeds.

So, to wash away your sins, to cleanse your body, do good deeds.

Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه he says, he had a statement but briefly he said: People have short vision and they fail to see that Allahعَزّ وجَلّ has a plan

and that plan takes its time.

He was talking about Sulha-Al-Hudaybiyyah(صلح الحديبه).

He said: They failed to see the wisdom behind this Sulha(صلح).

He said: A short while later, I saw Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو), Suhail Ibn Amr (سهيل ابن عمرو) was the one who represented the Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) in signing the Agreement with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And he was very argumentative, for example, when Rasool Allah ﷺ was dictating to Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) what to write.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, write so, Ali(علي) wrote Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو) said: No, We don’t know Ar-Rahman(الرحمن) Ar-Raheem(الرحيم) write; Bismekallah Hum(بسمك اللهم), In the name of God, you have to be neutral.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This is an agreement between Muhammad Rasool Ullah, Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو) interrupts and says: No!

If we agree that you are Messenger of Allah, we wouldn’t be negotiating with you to start with, but write your name and your father.

Muhammad Ibn Abdullah(محمد ابن عبدالله) Rasool Allah ﷺ told Ali(علي) wipe it out, erase it.

Ali(علي) didn’t want to erase it, Rasool Allah ﷺ told Ali(علي) show me, where it is.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was illiterate, show me where it is.

So, Ali(علي) pointed to it, Rasool Allah ﷺ erased it, with his own hand.

Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو), who was representing the Kuffar(كفار) in this Agreement.

A year later Abu Bakr As-Siddique(ابو بكر الصديق) said: I saw him with my own eyes bringing the camels to Rasool Allah ﷺ after his Umrah(عمرة),

for Rasool Allah ﷺ to sacrifice them.

And then I saw when the barber of Rasool Allah ﷺ was shaving his head I saw Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو) going down on his knees and picking the clipping of Rasool Allah ﷺ

and putting them on his eyes, to get Barakah(بركة) from him.

Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) is saying, people have a short vision this was a short while later, look at how the hearts changed.

Suhail Ibn Amr(سهيل ابن عمرو) was now a Muslim.

Islam spread like a wild fire when there was peace.

Before Fateh Makkah(فتح المكة) Rasool Allah ﷺ was preparing his army but he made his destination secret.

Rasool Allah ﷺ didn’t want to give the people of Makkah time to prepare to fight.

Why?

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ didn’t want to cause bloodshed in Makkah.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to ambush them within over whelming force, so that they give up and don’t fight.

So, he didn’t want anyone to know that he is going to Makkah, so that the people of Makkah wouldn’t prepare.

He knew their nature, they are stubborn, they are gonna try to fight.

So, he wanted to make sure that he assembles a large army overwhelming force not to give them even a chance.

However, one of the Sahabah(صحابه), Haatib Ibn Abi Balta’ah(حاطب ابن ابى بلتعة) he writes a letter, to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), telling them, that Muhammad(محمد) plans to attack you.

And he sends it with a woman, who is traveling to Makkah and he pays her.

Rasool Allah ﷺ receives revelation.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) comes to Rasool Allah ﷺ and tells him about what happened.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ sends Ali(علي), Al-Miqdad(المقداد) and Az-Zubair(الزبير) to pursue this woman.

So, they go to a place called Rawdhat Khakh(روضة الخاخ) and they approached the woman and they tell her, give us the message that you have.

She said: I don’t have anything.

They said: Either you hand it over to us otherwise we are gonna take off your clothes.

And this shows you that you could rough up, a person in interrogation, to certain extent.

And exposing the Awrah(عورة), is allowed in such situations.

They threatened her that they are going to take off her clothes.

Hand us over the message!

When she saw that they are serious, she pulled it out from her braids.

It was hidden very well and they carried the letter back to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ calls in, Haatib(حاطب) and he tells him, why did you do that?

Haatib(حاطب) he said: O Rasool Ullah! Don’t rush to Judgment about me.

O Rasool Ullah I was a man didn’t belong to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), While rest of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين), have families back in Makkah, who take care of their interest, their family, their wealth,

So, I wanted to do them a favor so that they would do me a favor and protect my family in Makkah.

I didn’t do that because I have apostated or because I prefer Kuffr(كفر) over Eeman(ايمان).

So, Haatib(حاطب) is explaining why he did that.

I didn’t do it, because I want to betray Allahعَزّ وجَلّ and His Messenger.

I didn’t do it, because I have apostated, because I loved Kuffr(كفر).

I did it because, I was worried about safety of my family in Makkah.

And since rest of the Companions have relatives to take care of their families, I wanted to do this for the Kuffar(كفار), so they would in exchange protect my family.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He is telling us the truth.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: O Rasool Ullah! Allow me to behead this Munafiq(منافق).

He is a hypocrite, and he needs to be beheaded!

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He has witnessed Badr(بدر) and you never know may be Allah has looked upon the people of Badr(بدر) and said: Do whatever you want, because I have forgiven you.

You are forgiven, your sins are forgiven and this is in Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ).

A FEW LESSONS TO LEARN FROM THIS HADITH(حديث): Number One, The Hukum(حكم), the Ruling regarding the SPY, the one who spies, against Muslims, is execution.

That’s ruling regarding the one, who spies against the Muslims.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ didn’t dispute what Umar(عُمَر) said, when he said: He should be beheaded.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: It is because he witnessed Badr(بدر) and Allah has granted them forgiveness that’s why he shouldn’t be beheaded.

If it was somebody else, he would be executed.

So, this is a stern warning for those, who betray Allahعَزّ وجَلّ and His Messenger and spy against the Muslims.

Their Hukum(حكم) is execution and if a person is doing it, and they are agreeing with what they are doing, they think that what they are doing is right,

no matter who they are doing it for, that is Ridda(ردّة), that is Kuffr(كفر).

And if they are doing it for a reason such as Haatib(حاطب), because of fear because of love of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), love of money, then that is a major sin,

but the punishment is still the same.

So, this thing of working for the enemies of Allah in order to spy against the Muslims, no matter who this Muslim is, as long as they are still a Muslim, regardless of what they are doing.

Even if what they are doing, is something you disagree with, even if what they are doing something that is against your methodology or the way or the movement of the ideology that you follow

as long as they are Muslims, who testify that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad(محمد) is the Messenger of Allah spying against them is Ridda(ردّة) if you agree with, what you are doing.

You have left the folds of Islam.

The Second lesson, this is a sin to be exposed, we know that the sins of a Muslims should be concealed, they should not be made public.

For example, A Muslim drinks and they don’t want anybody to know about it.

Don’t go around, saying that this person drinks.

If a brother is using drugs and they are ashamed of what they are doing and they are doing it in a secret, they don’t want anybody to know, and you happen to know.

You don’t go around exposing that sin.

Allahعَزّ وجَلّ loves the sins of a believers to be concealed, Sittr(ستر).

Allah loves the sins to be concealed, not made public.

However, with this particular sin it should be made public and exposed, And we see if from the Hadith(حديث), it was exposed.

Rasool Allah ﷺ brought Haatib(حاطب) in front of everyone.

When we know in other occasions Rasool Allah will tell a person, for example in adultery, go back, don’t speak about this, or the man, who came and said: I was drinking, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him to leave.

An-Nawwawi(النووي) says: Sins are only exposed if there is benefit in exposing them.

So this sin because it's against the community, it needs to be exposed and people need to know that, this person has betrayed Allah and His Messenger.

And Ya'ani(يعني) I hope that I have driven the point and made it very clear as long as the person is a Muslim no matter what they are doing,

no matter what, you do not spy against them.

Finally the third lesson, - the virtues of the people of Badr(بدر).

These selected few, who have witnessed the Battle of Badr(بدر), Allahعَزّ وجَلّ has granted them forgiveness.

Even though Haatib(حاطب) committed such a major sin Rasool Allah ﷺ lets him go, without punishment.

Why?

Because he attended Badr(بدر).

So, Allah granted them forgiveness that extends to the future.

It's not just the past sins but it also extends to the future.

It’s a Maghfirah(مغفرة) of the past and the future.

The ones who attended Badr(بدر) are The Best of Muslims and Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) comes to Muhammadﷺ and says: The ones, who attended The Badr(بدر) from among the angels are also the Best of Angels.

Its not just for the humans, it's also for the angels.

When the army of Rasool Allah ﷺ came closer to Makkah.

Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) came to see the army.

So Al-Abbas(العباس) told him: If you are seen like that, you are going to be killed.

So Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) said: What should I do?

Now Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) is lost, that’s it.

Everything is gone, his leadership in Makkah is gone.

Makkah will be conquered by the Muslims, Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) doesn’t know what to do.

He is in state of loss.

Al-Abbas(العباس), the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: You ride with me on the Mount of Rasool Ullah, whether it was his camel or donkey and when people see you riding the donkey of Rasool Allah ﷺ they are going to leave you alone.

So, he was riding and whenever he passed next to a camp fire of Muslims they will say who is it.

But when they see the donkey of Rasool Allah ﷺ they let him go, without even asking who is on it.

That’s it, it is the donkey of Rasool Ullah whoever is it, he is granted a free pass.

Until they passed to the camp fire of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Umar(عُمَر) said: The Enemy of Allah! Allah has brought you to us and you don’t have any Agreement of Peace with us, in other words you are gonna be dead.

So, he rushes to Rasool Allah ﷺ and says: O Messenger of Allah! The enemy of Allah is here and we don’t have any peace agreement with him, so let's execute him.

Al-Abbas(العباس) said: I am giving him protection O Messenger of Allah, I have granted him protection.

Umar(عُمَر) argued with Al-Abbas(العباس) and they went on arguing and then Al-Abbas(العباس) said: Slow down Umar(عُمَر) if he was one of Bannu Ada'e(بنو عدى) you wouldn’t have say, what you are saying.

But just because he is from Bannu Abd Manaf(بنو عبد مناف) its not from your clan, you want him executed.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Slow down Al-Abbas(العباس) your Islam was more beloved to me, than if my father would have become a Muslim.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) does not make his decision based on relationship, based on his clan or his tribe.

Umar(عُمَر) is saying that the Islam of Al-Abbas(العباس), the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ was dearer to him, then if his father would have became Muslim.

His own father! He would rather have Al-Abbas(العباس) become a Muslim and then Umar(عُمَر) said: Because I know that that pleases Rasool Ullah.

Because your Islam would be to please Rasool Allah ﷺ, I am happier that you have become Muslim, then if my father became Muslim.

Because Al-Abbas(العباس) granted Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) protection, Rasool Allah ﷺ set him free.

But you see that Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had this clear understanding of Al-Wala Wal-Bara(الولاء والبراء) who he gives his loyalty to, and who he is against, he would not follow his emotions in that.

He would go with what pleases Allahعَزّوجَلّ and pleases, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

UMAR IBN KHATTAB(عمرابن الخطاب) IN MADINA: In Sahih Al-Muslim(صحيح المسلم), Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه said; We were sitting with Rasool Allah ﷺ among us were Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and Umar(عُمَر) and then Rasool Allah ﷺ left.

And he didn’t come back, so we were afraid that, may be something happened to him.

And this shows the deep concern that the Sahabah(صحابه) had for Rasool Allah ﷺ whenever he would be delayed or late they would worry.

They loved him more than their wives, and their children and their parents.

In fact the common terms they would use with Rasool Allah ﷺ, Means!

I would sacrifice my father and my mother for you.

That’s a statement, you always read that in the Hadith(حديث).

So, Abu Hurairah(ابوهرير) said: I was the first to go and look for him.

So I came to this farm there was a wall surrounding it and I went around the farm and I didn’t find any entrance, any gate.

But I saw a small crack in which water was flowing into or out of the farm.

So, I squeezed myself in like a fox would.

You know, you'd see a big fox and in a small hole, but still she is able to go through it.

So, Abu Hurairah(ابوهرير) said: I squeezed myself through like a fox would.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Aba Hurairah(اَبَا هريرة) Are you Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ)? Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) said: Yes!

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Ya Aba Hurairah(يا ابا هريره), O Abu Hurairah(اَبوهريرة): Take these sandals of mine, this shoes, take them and whomever you meet behind this wall, who says,

with Yaqeen(يقين) in their heart give them the glad tidings of the Jannah(جنة), Abu Hurairah(ابوهرير) took the sandals of Rasool Ullah.

Now the sandals are symbolic or an evidence that he is carrying a message from Rasool Ullah, I have something from Rasool Allah with me.

The first one he meets was Umar(عُمَر).

He says: Rasool Allah sent me, with his sandals and told me to give the glad tidings to anyone I meet, who testifies that there is no god but Allah with Yaqeen(يقين) in their heart

give them the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

What do you expect the response of Umar(عُمَر) was?

Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) Al-Hamdolillah(الحمدلله), I am so happy go and tell the people about it.?

It was a strange response.

Umar(عُمَر) punches Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) in his chest until, Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) falls on his back.

It was such a rough punch, Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) flew and fell on his back.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) said: I stood up and I went to Rasool Allah ﷺ crying, I was crying.

Now, obviously he had to cry nobody fights with Umar(عُمَر), you don’t fight with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

You swallow, you swallow it, He goes to Rasool Allah ﷺ and he said: Umar(عُمَر) followed me.

And he came in and he was crying, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: what happened Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ)?

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) said: You sent me to give glad tidings to the people and I give him glad tidings, he punches me, until I fall on my back.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Umar(عُمَر): why did you do that?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرإبن الخطاب) said: Did you tell him to go and give glad tidings to the people, that they are granted Jannah(جنة) if they say,

with Yaqeen(يقين).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Yes Umar(عُمَر) said: Don’t do that, because people will take that for granted, so let them work for it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Then we will let them work for it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would go with the opinion of Umar(عُمَر).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had that relationship with Rasool Allah ﷺ that he could tell him do and don’t.

Their relationship was so close and it also shows you the humbleness of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) comes and tells him don’t do that and Rasool Allah ﷺ accepts the opinion of Umar(عُمَر) with an open heart, and says; Then let them work.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wanted to ear on the side of caution and not have people take things for granted.

Don’t tell them that, let them work for it, even though they are going to Jannah(جنة) let them work for it.

So, it tells you something about the personality of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) he was concerned for the Ummah(امة).

You know, if it would have somebody else who was selfish alright fine I have glad tidings of Jannah(جنة) that’s it, I am happy.

I don’t really care what will happen to the rest of the people.

No! Umar(عُمَر) was thinking about what would happen, when Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرۃ) is going and telling the people this.

Even though that was an occasion for him to be happy and satisfied no his mind immediately jumped to what is gonna happen with the Ummah(امة)?

How are people are gonna take this?

And that’s why we keep on saying that Umar(عُمَر) was the man for the Ummah(امة).

In the beginning because Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه was a learned man, he was literate, he wanted to swallow as much information as he could, so now he is in Madina there are Jewish neighbors.

So why don’t I learn from their Books.?

And Qur’an has said that they have received the Torah(تورات) and the Christians have received the Injeel(إنجيل).

So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wants to learn more about the religions of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ, So he is reading from a scroll of Torah(تورات).

Rasool Allah ﷺ  sees it with him and the face of Rasool Allah ﷺ changes.

And he can see that he was upset, and he said: Are you rushing into the things without thinking them true, son of Al-Khattab(ألخطاب) In the name of Allah, Whom my soul, is in His hands.

I have brought you with the religion that is so clear, it’s like a white cloth.

And if Musa(موسى) was alive today he would have to follow me.

If Musa(موسى) was alive he would have to follow me.

You don’t need to go back to the old scripture everything that you need is in the Qur’an.

It over rules everything before, it stands above everything else all of the truth that you need, all of the guidance that you need.

The Book has not over looked anything.

Everything that you need, you will find it in Qur’an.

And this was an important lesson that was given to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and he learned the lesson very well.

So later on when the Ummah(امة) was expanding and entering into the lands of learned men, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was very aware about the fact that they could bring in their former knowledge

which could be tainted into Islam.

So, he made sure that the people learned their knowledge from Qur’an and not from anything else.

And we would see that in the Khilafah(خِلَافَه) of Umar(عُمَر), how he would design rules implemented to enforce the fact that your ilm(علم) should come from Qur’an and nothing else.

UMAR(عُمَر) AND THE WIVES OF RASOOL ALLAH ﷺ, Ibn Abbasرضي الله عنه and this Hadith(حديث) is in Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ) and Muslim(مسلم) and Masnad Imam Ahmad(مسنداِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) said: There was something, that I wanted to ask Umar(عُمَر) and I waited for an entire year, until I asked him.

He was afraid to ask Umar(عُمَر) the question.

However, Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) because he was a scholar, given an inquisitive mind, he had to ask the question.

I was given an inquisitive tongue.

So one day they were traveling and he was pouring water on Umar(عُمَر) for his Wudu(وضؤ).

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) said: Who are the, two wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ whom Allaah talked about in Qur’an, If you two turn in repentance to him your heart are indeed so inclined

but if you back up each other against him, against Rasool Allah ﷺ, truly Allah is his protector and Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) and every righteous one, among those, who believe

and further more the Angels will back him up.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Umar(عُمَر) wasn’t happy that Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) asked him this question, but he gave him the answer.

He said: We the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were men, who had the upper hands over their women Our men had the upper hands over our women, our say goes.

We came to Madina We found people in Madina their woman had the upper hand.

So, our women started learning from their women.

Umar(عُمَر) is saying that in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) the men had the upper hand.

In Madina, the women were quiet strong, so our women were learning from them.

He said: One day I went back home and I was angry with my wife and she answered back to me.

He said: So I was surprised what happened, how come, she is answering back.?

She said: What you surprised that I am answering back to you?

The wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ answer back to him.

Not only that some would boycott him from morning to night.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) for him, this was News.

So he rushes to his daughter Hafsa(حفصه), who was the wife of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Umm Mo'mineen(ام المؤمنين), Hafsa رضي الله عنها - and he says: Do you answer back to Rasool Allah ﷺ, do you argue with him.?

She said: Yes And sometimes we would boycott him from morning to night.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: You have lost! You are losers, Aren’t you afraid that Allah will become angry with you, because of the anger of His Messenger

and then he said: Do not ever argue with Rasool Allah ﷺ or answer back to him, - and don’t ask him for anything and ask me whatever you want.

And then he said: And don’t think that because Ayesha(عائشه) is doing it, you could do it.

Ayesha(عائشه) is more beautiful than you and she is more beloved to Rasool Allah ﷺ then you.

Because, the conspiracy was done by Ayesha(عائشه) and Hafsa(حفصه).

So he is telling her that Ayesha(عائشه) may be could afford to do that, but you can’t, don’t do that!

And then Umar(عُمَر) said: We heard that Ghassan(غسان), Ghassan(غسان) was a Arab Tribe loyal to the Romans, they were putting the horse shoes on, to attack us.

We had that information already and we were waiting for that.

He said: I was home when my Ansaari(انصاري) partner came to me and he said: Something big happened! I said: Did Ghassan (غسان) come.?

He said: No something worse than that.

I told him what happened. He said: Rasool Allah ﷺ has divorced his wives.

I said: That is what, I was afraid would happen.

So I rushed to Madina, he was living on the out skirts of Madina I rushed to Hafsa(حفصه) and I saw her crying, she was sitting down crying.

I told her: Did Rasool Allah ﷺ divorced you, She said: I don’t know!

But he has boycotted us and he is in that room.

So, I saw a servant of Rasool Ullah and I told him to ask for permission, for me to visit Rasool Ullah.

He went in and came out and he said: I've mentioned your name to him and he didn’t answer.

So, I left, I came back.

I sought permission again the servant said: I mentioned your name, he didn’t answer, the third time, the same thing happened.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) walked away the servant then called him back.

So, Umar(عُمَر) came in and he saw Rasool Allah ﷺ sitting and he was visibly upset.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه said: Did you divorce your wives?

Rasool Allah ﷺ looked up to me and he said: No!

I said: Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) now wants to put Rasool Allah ﷺ at ease.

So he is trying to start the conversation, he said: O Messenger of Allah, We the men of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) used to have upper hand over our women

and we come here to Madina, where the women are stronger then the men.

So now our women are learning from their women and my wife is now talking back to me.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ smiled.

He said: I then went to Hafsa(حفصه) and I asked her is that what you do to Rasool Allah ﷺ and she said: Yes!

We answer back to him, and sometimes we boycott him from morning to night.

Rasool Allah ﷺ smiled again.

So now Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: Can I sit down?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Go ahead!

And then Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said: I looked around the house of Rasool Allah ﷺ I couldn’t see anything that pleases the eye, there was nothing, no furniture

and Rasool Allah ﷺ was sitting on a mattress of Haseer(حصير), Haseer(حصير) is Palm Leaves it's very harsh so it was leaving markings on the skin of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So I said: O Rasool Ullah, why don’t we ask Allah to give us like he is giving the Persians and the Romans, when they don’t even believe in Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ answered Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and said: Are you having, any doubts O son of Khattab(الخطاب)?

Those are people whom Allah is hastening their rewards in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

Allah is giving them rewards in this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) because in Akhira(آخرة) they will have nothing left.

So I said: Ask Allah to forgive me, O Messenger of Allah.

SOME LESSONS FROM THIS STORY: Number One, cultural differences exist in the demeanor of men and women.

Men and women would have a different conduct of behavior in different cultures, so we saw how women were in Makkah more submissive, while in Madina they were stronger, you could even see that on the battle field.

Nusayba Bint Ka'ab(انصيبة بنت كعب) for example an Ansaariya(انصاريه), was a fighter.

That was the case with some of the other woman of Madina, they were tough, strong women.

Similar could be said about some of the Bedouin women, they are strong by nature.

So, cultural differences do exists.

However, there are some Common Constant Islamic behaviors that should be applied cross culturally.

That the husband is the head of the household.

That is something that shouldn’t change from one culture to another.

That the husband is to be obeyed by the wife, that is something that shouldn't changed from one culture to another.

That the parents are to be respected, by their children, Shouldn’t change.

That the young respect, the old that is something Islamic.

So, these are things that are cross cultural and if a culture does not have them that culture should change.

So, Islam does have some common teachings that are constant and should be applied by everyone.

Over here we are just talking about difference in behavior but they are equally following the orders of Islam.

I Don’t want sisters or brothers to get wrong message from this and they start arguing at home and say that’s how it was happening in Madina

and wife start slapping her husband's around and all of that, and saying thing because that’s how the women of Madina were.

Unless the husband is okay with that it's something else.

Definitely Umar(عُمَر) wasn't okay with that.

Tayyeb(طيب) In Sha Allah Ta'ala(إن شاء الله تعالى) We will carry on few minutes In Sha Allah Ta'ala(إن شاء الله تعالى).

Some of the Fadhail of Umar(عُمَر), the next section is.

THE FAZAIL(فضائل) OF UMAR BIN KHATTAB(عمرابن الخطاب), Some of his virtues: HIS KNOWLEDGE!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was knowledgeable, he was a scholar.

In fact Rasool Allah ﷺ saw that in a dream, in Bukhari(بخاريْ) and Muslim(مسلم) Rasool Allah ﷺ  said: Rasool Allah ﷺ said: While I was asleep, I saw in my dream that I was drinking milk

and I drank so much of it that it started to flow from beneath my nails and then I gave the rest of the cup to Umar(عُمَر).

They said: What do you interpret that, he said: Milk is knowledge.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ drank some much of that knowledge it was coming out of his fingers.

And then he gave the rest to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب), Knowledge of Prophet hood.

So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) had knowledge of Nabuwa(نبوة), of Prophet hood.

The left overs the bottom of the cup was given to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

A note here on interpretations of dreams, even the dreams of Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) needs to be interpreted because they asked Rasool Allah ﷺ about the interpretation of the dream.

He said: Milk. Ibn Hajar As-Qalani(ابن حجر العسقلاني) says: He said: The reason why milk is knowledge is because of their benefit.

Milk benefits the body and knowledge benefits the soul.

So, that’s why milk represents the knowledge in this dream.

And he also says and this is very important and interesting point. Ibn Hajar(ابن حجَر) says: And what is meant by knowledge here is the knowledge of the administration of the people

in accordance to the Book of Allah and Sunnah(سنة) of His Messenger.

We have developed a certain concept of what Sharia’ah(شريعه) knowledge is.

If you are able to quote the narrations off hand from the top of your head easily this man is a Sheikh(شيخ) If you are able to speak very eloquently you are a scholar,

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) what a scholar.

Ibn Hajar(ابن حجَر) is saying, the ilm(علم) here is the ability of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to administer the Ummah(امة) by the Book of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ and Sunnah(سنة) of Muhammad ﷺ.

It was referring to the ability of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) as a statesman, when he was Khalifah(خليفه) and that is the knowledge that benefited the Ummah(امة).

There could be someone who has a lot of knowledge, wrote memorization, they memorize all the books but they have no clue how to use it, how to apply it?

They don’t have the Fiqh(فقه) of Al-Waqia(الواقع) the understanding of the reality of the world today.

They are not in the field, and that's why Ibn Khaldoon(ابن خلدون) says; That many of the people, who are called scholars tend to be very far away and unable to deal with the realities of people,

in their political life, in the political realities of life.

Because they are only living with their books.

But with the knowledge of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) it was a knowledge that was applied in the field.

He wasn’t just sitting in the institute studying and giving off Fatawa(فتاوى) on the phone or on the Mic.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was living with the Ummah(امة).

He was leading the Ummah(امة), he was suffering with the Ummah(امة).

He was pleased what pleases them and displeased what would displease them, so be careful in using this word Ilm(علم) don’t throw it around carelessly, such person is a Mufti(مفتي), such person is scholar.

The Ulama(علماء) are the ones who know how to benefit the people through the Ilm(علم) of Allah in Qur’an and in the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And these could be people who don’t memorize a lot of opinions of Fiqh(فقه).

You would ask them what did Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه)  say on this, or what did Ashafi'e(شافعي) say on that?

Or what did Qadhi Iyyadh(قاضي عياض) say, or what did Al-izza Bin Abdussalam(العزة بن عبدالسلام) say, they wouldn’t know that.

But they know what is needed for that situation, they know it very well.

They know how to apply the Ayaat(آيات) and the Ahadith(احاديث) that they've learned.

They know how to apply them in the reality of people.

And that’s why Allahعَزّ وجَلّ says about for example Daud(داؤد) We have given him Hukm(حكم) and Ilm(علم).

Ilm(علم) and Hukm(حكم), Hukm(حكم) is the good Judgment.

A judge could have the information right there but he doesn’t know how to use it.

The ability to use it, is Hukm(حكم), the good Judgment.

Once a woman came to the Halaqah(حلقه) of Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه).

Al-Imam Abu Haneefa(امام ابو حنيفه), she asked a question she didn’t ask the question to Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه), she asked it to a scholar of Hadith(حديث) who was sitting in that circle.

Because the Majlis(مجلس) the circle of Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه) was a circle of scholars.

He had scholars sitting with him.

It was more of a council of Fiqh(فقه) than a study circle.

That's one of the unique things with Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه), you don’t call his students, students you call them As-Haab(اصحاب) friends, companions

because they were scholars like him.

He had scholars in language, scholars in Hadith(حديث),  scholars in Fiqh(فقه), so they would consult each other.

So, this woman comes to one of the scholars and she asks him a question, he didn’t know the answer.

Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه) said: I know the answer, he gave her the answer.

So the scholar of Hadith(حديث) said: How did you know the answer?

He said: I knew it by the Hadith(حديث) you just quoted a while ago.

You are the one who quoted the Daleel(دليل) for me I didn’t know the evidence for it, until you quoted it.

But he didn’t know how to use it.

Imam(اِمَام) Abu Haneefa(ابو حنيفه) knew how to use it.

Tayyib(طيب) we will carry on In sha Allah(اِن شاء الله) tomorrow night with the rest of the Fadhail(فضائل) of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab رضي الله عنه.

IT SHUDDERS IN PAIN FREELY, MY CHASITY, MY MODESTY!

OH MUSLIM, YOU SAW, MY INJURY AND THE INJURY OF MY PRIDE.

parts.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا أَ فِي الْقَوْمِ محمد ؟

أَ فِي الْقَوْمِ محمد ؟

لَا تُجِيْبُوْا أَ فِي الْقَوْمِ اِبْنِ اَبِىْ قُحَافَهْ ؟

لَا تُجِيْبُوْا أَ فِي الْقَوْمِ عمرابن الخطاب ؟

اِنَّ هَؤلآءِ قُتِلُوْا فَلَوْ كَانُوْا اَحْيَاء لَأَجَابُوْا Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) and Umar رضي الله عنهما.

كَذَّبْتَ يَا عَدُوْاَلله اَبْقَى الله عَلَيْكَ مَا  يُخْزِيْكَ أُعْلُوْا هُبَلْ أَلَا تُجِيْبُوْا؟

اَلله اَعْلى وَ اَجَلْ اَلْعُزَّى لَنَا وَلَاعُزَّى لَكُمْ أَلَا تُجِيْبُوْا؟

اَللهُ مَوْلَانَا، وَلَامَوْلَى لَكُمْ يَوْمٌ بِيَوْمِ بَدْرَ وَلَأ يَّامُ دُوَّلْ وَالْحَرْبُ سَجَالْ وَسَتِجَدُوْنَ مُثْلَةْ لَمْ آمُرْبِهَا وَلَمْ تَسُوْنِيْ

وَسَتِجَدُوْنَ مُثْلَةْ لَمْ آمُرْبِهَا وَلَمْ تَسُوْنِيْ أَلَا تُجِيْبُوْا؟

لَا سَوَاء قَتْلَانَا فِي الْجَنَّةْ وَ قَتْلَاكُمْ  فِى النَّارَ أُنْشِدُكَ الله ياعمر أَقَتَلْنَا محمد اَللَّهُمَّ لَا وَإِنَّه’ لَيَسْمَعُ كَلَامَكَ اَلْآنْ

اَنْتَ اَصْدَقَ عِنْدِيْ وَأَبَرْ، اَنْتَ اَصْدَقْ عِنْدِيْ مِنْ اِبْنِ أَبِىْ قَمِئَةَ وَاَبَرْ يا لِلْاَ نْصَار يا لِلْمُهَاجِرِيْن اَبِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةْ وَأَنَا بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ

دَعُوْهَا فَإِنَّهَا نَتِنَهْ أَفَعَلُوْهَاأَمَا وَالله لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا اِلَى الْمَدِيْنَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزَّ مِنْهَا الّأَذَلْ دَاعْنِيْ أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقْ

لَا يَتَّحَدَّثُ النَّاس، اَنَّ محمدًا يَقْتُلُ اَصْحَابَهْ لَا يَتَّحَدَّثُ النَّاس، اَنَّ محمدًا يَقْتُلُ اَصْحَابَهْ وَقُلْ لِعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنْزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ

اَبِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةْ وَأَنَا بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ ۚ أَلَسْتَ بِرَسُوْلِ الله؟

أَلَسْنَا بِالْمُسْلِمِيْن؟

أَلَيْسُوْا بِالْمُشْرِكِيْنَ؟

فَعَلَامَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا إِنِّيْ رَسُوْلُ الله وَلَسْتُ أَعْصِيْهِ وَهُوَ نَاصِرِيْ أَلَيْسَ بِرَسُوْلِ الله؟

أَلَسْنَ بِالْمُسْلِمِيْن؟

أَلَيْسُوْا بِالْمُشْرِكِيْنَ؟

"فَعَلَامَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا" (اِلْزَمْ غَرْزَةْ) مَا زِلْتُ أَتَصَدَّقْ وَأَصُوْم وَ أَعْتِقْ وَاُصَلِّى مِنَّ الَّذِيْ صَنَعْتُ يَوْمَئِذٍ مَخَافَةْ كَلَامِى الَّذِيْ تَكَلَّمْتُ بِهْ

Allahعَزّ وجَلّ says; إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هَذَا مَا صَالِحَ عَلَيْهِ محمد رسول الله

يا رسول الله لَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْ اِنِّيْ كُنْتُ اِمْرَأً مُلْصَقًا فِيْ قُرَيْشْ وَلَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهَا وَكَانَ مَنْ مَّعَكَ مِنَّ الْمُهَاجِرِيْنَ مَنْ لَّهُمْ قَرَابَاتٍ يَحْمُوْنَ بِهَا اَهْلِهِمْ وَاَمْوَالَهُمْ

فَاَحْبَبْتُ إِذَ فَاتَنِيْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ النَّسَبِ فِيْهِمْ أَنْ أَتَّخِذَ عِنْدَهُمْ يَدَا يَحْمُوْنَ قَرَابتيْ وَلَمْ أَفْعَلْ ذَالِكَ اِرْتِدَادًا عَنْ دِيْنِى وَلَا رِضًا بِكُفْرِبَعْدَ الْإِسْلَامْ

اَمَا اِنَّه’ قَدْ صَدَقَكُمْ يا رسول الله ،دَعْنِي أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقْ إِنَّه’ قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا وَمَا يَدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّ الله إِطَّلَعَ عَلى مَنْ شَهِدَا بَدَرْ فَقَالْ

إعْمَلُوْا مَا شِـئْتُمْ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ عَدُوَّا الله قَدْ اَمْكَنَ الله مِنْكَ بِغَيْرِ عَهْدٍ وَلَا ذِ مَّةْ بِأبِيْ أنْتَ وَاُمِّي،ِأبِيْ أنْتَ وَاُمِّي

بِأبِيْ أنْتَ وَاُمِّي يا رسول الله فَإحْتَفَزْتُ كَمَا يَحْتَفَزَالثَّعْلَبْ لا اله الا الله مَلْ لَقِيْتَهْ يَشْهَدُ ألَّا الله إِلَّا الله مُسْتَيْقَنَا بِهَا قَلْبُهْ فَبَشِّرْه’ بِالْجَنَّةً

اشهد ان لا اله الا الله أَمُتَهَوِّكُوْنَ فِيْهَا يا اِبْنَ الخطاب؟

وَالَّذِيْ نَفْسِيْ بِيَدِهْ لَقَدْ جِـئْتُكُمْ بِهَا بِيْضَا نَقِيَّةْ وَلَوْكَانَ مُوْسَى حَيًّا مَا وَسِعَه’ إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَّبِعَنِيْ مُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْه

مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ لِسَانًا سَؤُوْلَأ إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَاهَالَّكَ يَا اِبْنِ عَبَّاسْ

"كُنَّا مَعْشَرَقُرَيْشْ قَوْمًا نَغْلِبٌ نِّسَآء " فَجِئْنَا قَوْمًا فَوَجَدْنَا قَوْمًا يَغْلِبُهُمْ نِسَأؤُهُمْ فَطَفِقَ نِسَاؤُنَا يَتَعَلِّمْنَ مِنْ نِسَأئِهِمْ

فَأَنْكَرْتُ ذَلِكْ اَجَاءَتْ غَسَّانْ أَطَّلَّقْتَ نِسَآءَ "أَفِيْ شَكٍّ أَنْتَ يَا ابن الخطاب؟" أُوْلئِكَ قَوْمٌ عُجِّلَتْ لَهُمْ طَيِّبَاتُهُمْ فِيْ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا

اِسْتَغْفِرْلِيْ يارسول الله بَيْنَا أنَا نَائمٌ شَرِبْتُ يَعنِي اللَبَنٍ حَتَّى أَنظر ألى الرِّيَّ يَجْرِيْ فِيْ ظُهرِيْ ثُمَّ  نَاوَلْت ُعُمَرَ فَقَالُوا: فَمَا أَوَّلْتَهُ قَالَ: الْعِلْمَ

وَجْه’ التَّعْبِيْرِ فِيْ الْحَدِيْثِ بِذَلِكَ مِنْ جِهَةِ اِشْتَرَاكِ الْلَبِنْ وَالْعِلْمْ فِيْ كَثْرَةٍ النَّفَعْ وَكَوْنَهُمَا سَبَبَا لِّلْصَلَاحْ، فَالْلَبَنُ لِلْغِذَاءِ الْبَدَنِيْ،وَالْعِلْمُ الِلّغِذَاءِ المَعْنَوِيْ

وَالْمُرَادُ بِالْعِلْمِ هُنَا اَلْعِلْمِ بِسِيَاسَةِ النَّاسِ بِكِتَابِ الله وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّه صلى الله عليه وسلم واتيناهم حكم وعلماً صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

parts.english:
This is session number two, we'll carry on In Sha Allah Ta'ala(اِنْ شَاء الله تعالى) with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) in Makkah, we are still in Makkah.

We talked about his Islam in the last session and the Dua(دُعَا) of Rasool Allah ﷺ for him, O Allah! Give Islam strength, and power through the most beloved of the two men to You,

Amr Ibn Hisham(عمرو بن هشام) or Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and Allahعزُّوْجل chose Umar(عمر).

So, Umar(عمر) became Muslim and he grew into Islam to become the second greatest after Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه, while Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) chose the other course

and that is to be the Fir’auon(فرعون), of this Ummah(امة).

Everyone chooses a path.

Now, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) being the man he is, he didn’t want the event of his Islam to go un-noticed.

You know, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was a man for the Ummah(اُمَة).

Some people; you know, they want to do their Salah(صلاة) and do their small individual Ibadaat(عبادات) and stay out of trouble, stay out of Islamic work, don’t do anything, just pray, and do your fasting and be calm, and don’t be noticed,

that's not Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Some people they just care about themselves, and their family, as long as I am alright, and my family is alright, then everything is good, everything is okay.

But Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wasn't such a person.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) saw that Muslims were been tortured, he wants to be like them.

He saw that, they are being persecuted, he wants to be like them.

He cared for the Ummah(امة) and that's why Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was a statesman by nature.

He had the virtues of a Khalifah(خليفه).

Because he was very, very concerned with the Ummah(امة) he was a man for the Ummah(امة), what pleases them, pleased him and what displeases them, displeased him.

And that's why, when Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه appointed him Khalifah(خليفه), that's in fact, that's the statement that Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) made.

He said: He is a man who is pleased when the Ummah(امة) is pleased and he is displeased when the Ummah(امة) is displeased.

Umar(عمر) wasn't a selfish person, who is only caring about himself and his direct family, like many of the Muslims today are.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرإبن الخطاب) wanted to join the Ummah(امة) in their happiness and in their pain.

When he saw Rasool Allah ﷺ and Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) crying, he came and he said: Tell me, why are you crying?

If it makes me cry otherwise, I will force myself to cry.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not want his Islam to go un-noticed.

So, where does he go, which house does he choose to go to?

The house of Abu Jahal(ابوجهل).

He goes to the house of Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) and knocks his door.

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) opens the door and says; Welcome Ibn Al-Khattab(ابن الخطاب)! Welcome!

Because he didn't know that he became Muslim yet.

And they used to love Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) because of his dedication to the persecution of the Muslims.

So, he said: Welcome Son of Al-Khattab(ألخطاب), Umar Ibn Khattab(عمربن خطاب) said: I became a Muslim, for your information.

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) said: What! He said: I have became Muslim.

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) said: Don’t do so!

Umar(عمر) said: Well I did!

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) slammed the door in his face.

Umar(عمر) said: This is nothing, this is not, what I am looking for?

Because Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) wanted to be like the rest of the Ummah(امة) but no one in their sane Mind in Quraish(قريش), no matter how much they hate Islam

was willing to take over the task of torturing Umar(عُمَر) even Abu Jahal(ابوجهل).

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) did not want to deal with it, so he just closed the door.

Umar(عمر) went to another house, knocking the door, welcome son of Al-Khattab(الخطاب) I became a Muslim.

He said: Don’t do so!

I did so, he closes the door.

So, there was somebody, who was watching what Umar(عمر) was doing.

He went to Umar(عمر) and he said: It seems that you want people to know that you have became a Muslim?

He said: Yes!

He said: Do you see that man over there?

Go to him and tell him that you have became Muslim and that's all what you need.

He was pointing towards Jameel Bin Mu'ammar Al-Jum'hi(جميل بن معمر الجمهي) Jameel Bin Mu’ammr(جميل بن معمر) is a man, who cannot hold any water in his mouth,

he was a mobile transmitter, a living broadcasting station.

So, he goes to him, and he says: O Jameel(جميل), I have became a Muslim.

Abdullah Bin Umar(عبدالله بن عمر), said: I was watching my father.

He Said: When he told Jameel(جميل) that he became Muslim, Jameel(جميل) immediately, stood up, without saying anything, he just stood up, sprang up,

dragged his Izaar(إزار) and walking briskly towards Al-Ka’aba(ألكعبه), where everybody is meeting, and then he says: Ya Quraish(يا قريش)! O people of Quraish(قريش)!

Umar(عمر) embraced Islam, Umar(عمر) embraced Islam, Umar(عمر) embrace Islam.

The news was all over, breaking news all over Makkah.

That's all, what Umar(عمر) needed to do, is to tell Jameel(جميل).

In fact, the narration says, that Jameel(جميل) wasn’t saying that Umar(عُمَر) was Muslim.

He was saying Saba'a(صبأ)’ and Saba'a(صبأ) was a derogatory term, the people of Quraish(قريش) used to use when somebody would become Muslim.

So, Umar(عمر) was following the Jameel(جميل) trying to correct the information but when it gets on the front page of a newspaper, it's too late.

Jameel(جميل) was just running all over, saying Saba'a Umar(صبا عمر), Saba'a Umar(صبا عمر) and Umar(عمر) is trying to correct the information, he's saying,

but there is nothing you could do.

Now, Jameel(جميل) did it for Umar(عمر).

The mobs just attacked from every direction and Umar(عمر) is, in between them fighting for himself and they are attacking him and he is getting hits from every side.

What does, Umar(عمر) do?

He grabs Ut'bah Bin Rabiya(عتبة بن ربيعه), who is one of their noble men throws him to the ground sits on top of him and then he sticks his fingers in his eyes.

So, Utba’ah(عتبة) screams and then everybody backs off.

Abdullah(عبدالله) said: So when he released Utba’ah(عتبه) and he walked away the mob attacked him again.

Abdullah Ibn Umar(عبدالله إبن عمر) says; Whenever, the mob would attack him, he would grab the most noble man, he sees in front of him and stick his fingers in his eyes, until they back off.

And that kept on happening again and again.

He said: Eventually Umar(عمر) could not fight any further.

People are attacking him from every direction.

So, he just sat down, while people were hitting him and then he said: If we were but three hundred strong, you would either leave it for us, or we would leave it for you!

And this was a very Prophetic Statement.

What Umar(عمر) was saying is, if we were three hundred strong, if the Muslims were three hundred strong, we would fight you and either you leave Makkah or we leave it for you.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), the order of Jihad(جهاد) was given, Qitaal(قتال), and the first army to meet Al-Kuffr(الكفر) was three hundred and thirteen, in Badr(بدر).

So, as if Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) was waiting for it, but the numbers were not ready yet.

We are gonna fight you, but we were few.

And the narration says that Muslims were about forty in Makkah, when Umar(عمر) became Muslim.

Allah o Alam(الله اعلم), if that includes the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) of Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه) or not.

Because the majority of Muslim actually made Hijrah(حجرة) to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه).

Umar(عمر) went to Daar-Ul-Arqam(دار الارقم) and he asked Rasool Allah ﷺ, he says; Aren’t we on the right path, whether we live or die?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر إبن الخطاب) said: Then why, should we hide?

Why should our Islam be, underground, why are we hiding?

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ agrees with Umar(عمر) and he arranges the Muslims in two ranks and Rasool Allah ﷺ is standing between these two ranks, and one rank is headed by Umar(عُمَر) and the other by Hamza(حمزه).

And they marched down the streets of Makkah declaring, That was the public declaration of Islam in Makkah and it happened when Umar(عمر) and Hamza(حمزه) became Muslims.

And the difference in time between their Islam according to one narration was three days.

The narrator says; When they reached to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and the people of Quraish(قريش) saw Umar(عمر) and Hamza(حمزه), They were depressed, like never before.

Because now, they've seen strength that Allah has given to Islam through Hamza(حمزه) and Umar(عُمَر).

You do your part according to what Allah has given you, the gifts that you have and to the best of your human ability.

That's what you need to do; Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم).
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله  وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراً اَلَلَّهُمَّ اَعِزَّ الْاِسْلَامَ بِأحَبِّ الرَّجُلَيْنِ اِلَيْكََ

لِكُلٍّ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيْها مَا هَذَا بِشَيْ لَاتَفْعَلْ ، فَعَلْتْ يَا جَمِيْل لَقَدْ اَسْلَمْتُ بَلْ اَسْلَمْت، بَلْ اَسْلَمْتُ فَجَعَلَ كُلَّمَا

وَاللهِ لَوْ كُنَّا ثَلَاثَ مِائَة لَتَرَكْنَهَا لَكُمْ اَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوْهَالَنَا أ لَسْنَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ اِنْ حَيِيْنَا وَاِنْ مِتْنَا فَلِمَ الْإخْتِفَاءُ اِذَاً؟

أشْهَدُاَنْ لَّأ اِلَهَ اِلَّا الله وَ أشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُوْلَ الله اَصَابَتْهُمْ كَآبَة لَمْ تُصِبْهُمْ قَطْ مَا زِلْنَا اَعِزَّةْ مُنْذُ اَسْلَمَ عمر وَلَقَدْ رَأيْتَنَا وَمَا نَسْتَطِيْعُ اَنْ نَطُوْفَ بِالْبَيْتِ

حَتَّى اَسْلَمَا عمر فَلَمَّا اَسْلَمَ قَاتَلْنَاهٌمْ حَتَى تَرَكُوْنَ فَصَّلَّيْنْا وَطُفْنَا كَانَ الاِسْلَامُ عمر فَتْحاً وَهجْرَتُه’ نَصْراً وَإمَارَتُه رَحْمَهَ

وَلَقَدْ رَاَيْتَنَا وَمَا نَسْتَطِيْعُ أن نصَلِّى وَنَطُوْفَ بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى اَسْلَمَ عمر فَلَمَّا اَسْلَمَ قَاتَلْنَاهُمْ حَتَّى تَرَكُوْنَا نُصَلِّى

لَمَّا اَسْلَمَ عمر ابن الخطاب رضى الله عنه ظَهْرَالْاِسْلَامْ وَدُعِيَ إلِيْهِ عَلَانِيَّةَ وَجَلَسْنَا حَوْلَ الْبَيْتِ حِلَقًّا وَطُفْنَا بِالْبَيْتِ وَانْتَصَفْنَا مِمَّنْ غَلَظَ عَلَيْنَا وَرَدَدْنَا عَلَيْهَ

مُتَمَكِّنا فَطَافَ مُتَّمَكِّنًاَ شَاهَتُ الْوُجُوْهَ وَلَا يُرْغِمُ اللهُ إلَّا هَذِهِ الْمَعَاطِسْ هَذِهِ الْمَعَاطِسْ مَنْ اَرَادَ أَنْ يُثْكِلَ اُمَّهّْ

فُتِنَ فَافْتُتِنْ فَرَّقَّ لَهَا لَسْتُ بِالْخِبْ وَلَاالخِبْ يَخْدَعْنِي قُلْ يعِبَادِىَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُواْ عَلَى أَنفُسِهِمْ لاَ تَقْنَطُواْ مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ َ۞

وَأَنِـيبُواْ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُواْ لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لاَ تُنصَرُونَ َ۞

وَاتَّبِعُـواْ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُـمْ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُـمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لاَ تَشْعُرُونَ۞

أَمرٌ بِالمَعرُوفِ وَنَهيٌ عَنِ المُنكَرِ قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ۞

قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ الْكذبين۞

إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَا شُعَيْبُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَكَ مِنْ قَرْيَتِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا

قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ۞

وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَآلِهَتَكَ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَاهِرُونَ۞

وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّ الْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَاخْرُجْ إِنِّي لَكَ مِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ۞

بَلْ مَكْرُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَار وَإِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَعْدَائِكُمْ Allahعَزّ وجَلّ says;

وَدَّت طائِفَةٌ مِن أَهلِ الكِتابِ لَو يُضِلّونَكُم Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: وَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ كَمَا كَفَرُوا فَتَكُونُونَ سَوَاءً۞

وَلَنْ تَرْضَىٰ عَنْكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ مَا يُرِيْدُوْ اِلَّا لِيَفْتِنُوْكَ عَنْ دِيْنِكْ فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ۞

وَافَقْتُ رَبِّي فِي ثَلَاثْ فَقُلْتُ: يا رسول الله، لَوْ اَتَّخَذْنَا مِنْ مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ مُصَلّى فَأنَزَلَتْ: وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ مُصَلّى

وَآيَةُ الْحِجَابِ، قُلْتُ: يا رسول الله، لَوْ أَمَرْتَ نِسَاءَكَ أَنْ يَحْتَجِبْنَ فَإِنَه’ يُكَلِّمُهُنَّ اَلْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرْ، فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةَ الْحِجَابْ،

وَاجْتَمَعَ نِسَاءُ النَّبِي صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيْ الْغِيْرَةْ عَلِيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُنَّ: عَسَى رَبُّه’ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ، أَنْ يُبْدِلَه’أَزْوَاجَا خَيْرَا مِّنْكُنْ، فَانَزَلَتِ هَذِهِ الّآيَةْ

عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا۞

اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِ ۖ

إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ۞

حَتَى يَرَى الله اِنَّه’ لَيْسَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِنَا هَوَادَةْ عَلَى الْكُفَّارْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُلِينُ قُلُوبَ رِجَالٍ فِيهِ ، حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَلْيَنَ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ

وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَشُدُّ قُلُوبَ رِجَالٍ فِيهِ ، حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ وَإِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَمَثَلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام

قَالَ : فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي ، وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ۞

قالَ: إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ۞

وَاِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يا عمر كَمَثَلِ نُوْحْ وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا۞

رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَىٰ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ۞

مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۞

لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيم۞

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِيَسْتَأْذِنْكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنْكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ

مِنْ قَبْلِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُمْ مِنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَكُمْ لَا أُمَثِّلُ بِه فَيُمَثِّلُ الله بِيْ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ نَبِيَّا، وَعَسَى أَنْ يَقُوْمَ مَقَامًا لَا تَذُمُّه

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) هذا كلب عدوالله أَرْسِله يا عمر مَا جَـاءَبِكُمْ اَنْعِمْ صَبَاحًا السلام و عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته مَا جَاءَبِكَ يا عمير

قَبَّحَهَا الله مِنْ سُيُوْفِ وَهَلْ أَغْنَت عَنَّا شَيْئَا؟

اللهم بين لنا في الخمر بيانا شافيا هذا الكلب عدُّوْ الله لاَ يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لآئِمٍ ان لم یكن بك علي غضبٌ فلا أبالي وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ۞

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ سُبحانك اللهم وبحمدك نشهد الله اله الا انت نستغفرك ونتوب عليك

parts.english:
O you, who believe do not let death approach you, except in state of Taqwa(تَقوى).

We ask Allahعَزّ وجَلّ to give us all, Taqwa(تقوى).

In Sunan Al-Baghawi(سُنَنْ اَلْبَغْوِيْ), Abdullah Ibn Masood رضي الله عنه says; Abdullah Ibn Masood رضي الله عنه says; Whoever, is gonna follow a path, should follow the path of the ones, who died,

Because the living could fail in their trials, Those are the companions of Muhammadﷺ, Abdullah Ibn Masood رضي الله عنه is telling the Taba'een(تَا بَعِيْن),

who are the second greatest generation, he is telling them: Don’t follow the living among you, even though some of these might be Aouleaa(أؤلِيآء) of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ

some of them might be Virtuous, Mujahideen(مجاهدين), Ulema(علماء), Ubbaad(عُبَّاد).

Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), is telling them: Don’t follow the living among you, but follow the dead, the companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Why?

Because there is no guarantee, this person, who is living, wouldn’t fail in some of his trials.

But with Sahabahرضي الله عنهم, they have been given the stamp of approval.

See, with anyone, who is living, you never know, what the outcome would be?

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says: There are some people, who would be on the track of people of Jannah(جنة), in their Ibadah(عبادة), in their action.

They are doing what people of Jannah(جنة) do, but before they die, they commit the actions of people of Hell Fire and then they end up going to Hell fire.

Why? They failed in Fitnah(فِتْنَه), Trials.

Everyone is going be faced with the trials and nobody knows what the outcome of that will be?

And that is why Rasool Allah ﷺ used to say: O the One, Who changes the hearts, make our hearts steadfast on Islam.

The heart, the word Qalb(قلب), in Arabic means "something that changes", overturns, goes up and down.

So, Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) is saying: Follow the companions of Rasool Ullah.

He was saying this, in time of Taba'een(تَابَعِيْن), which were the second best generation.

What should, we say today?

No one has the guarantee, no one, that they are going to go to Jannah(جنة). Nobody!

But the ones, who were with Rasool Allah ﷺ, the ones, who were in Ghazwat Al-Badr(غزوة البدر), the ones, who gave him Bay'ah(بيعة) under, Ar-Ridwan(الرضوان),

the ones, who fought with him, the one, who had patience with him, the ones whom, when Rasool Allah ﷺ died, Rasool Allah ﷺ was pleased with them, these are the ones, we should follow.

And then he gives us some other reasons, why should, we should follow them.? He says; They were the best of this Ummah(امة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: The best of generations, is my generation.

These are the best!

And they had the most pious hearts.

Their hearts had the most Taqwa(تَقْوى).

No one can compete with the Sahabah(صحابه) in their Taqwa(تَقْوى).

They've achieved the highest limits.

And they had the deepest knowledge.

Now, notice here the choice of words.

Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) didn’t say, He didn’t say, they had the most knowledge, he said: They had, the deepest knowledge.

Because there are the people, who came after the Sahabah(صحابه).

Who know things that, the Sahabah(صحابه), may, not, have known.

For example Al-Bukhari(ألبخاريْ), he knew more Ahadith(احاديث) then many of the Sahabah(صحابه).

Why? Because, he knew the Ahadith(احاديث), that Umar(عُمَر) had, he knew the Ahadith(احاديث) that Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) had, he knew the Ahadith(احاديث) that Uthman(عثمان) had,

he was an encyclopaedia of Hadith(حديث).

When it comes to the opinion of Fiqh(فقه), some of the great Imam(إمام)s of this Ummah(امة) not only combines the Fiqh(فقه) of one Sahabi(صحابي) but they combine the Fiqh(فقه) of many.
