And then, Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is testing me to see; whether I am grateful or ungrateful.

Whatever Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given you; and we talked about this a lot.

Whatever Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given you; is a test from Allah for you to see; if you will be grateful or not.

And then, he said; And whoever is grateful, truly his gratitude is for who?

For his own self.

You're not going to benefit Allahسُبحانه وتعالى at all, by being grateful to him; you're benefiting yourself.

Whoever is ungrateful; certainly my lord is rich; free of all needs and bountiful.

If you are not grateful; believe me; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى does not need you.

We need to tell ourselves this; because sometimes we feel that the money we pay; we're doing a favour to the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Whatever we donate of our time, or effort to the religion of Allah, sometimes we brag about it.

The religion of Allah does not need me; it does not need you; it does not need anyone.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is sufficient of all means.

We are doing this for our own benefit.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام said; He said; Disguise her throne for her; change the outlook of the throne a little bit.

Make some alterations to it.

Why?

To see; will she be one of those, who recognize it, or she would be one of those, who won't?

So they made some alterations to her throne; change the way it looks; a little bit.

But the essence of it, was the same.

The uniqueness and the greatness of that throne was untouched.

So when she came; it was said to her; Is your throne like this?

This is a straightforward question.

Yes or no; question.

Is this your throne?

What should the answer be?

Yes or no.

Now she said; Yes!

It looks like our throne, but it's a little bit different.

And if she said; No!

It's true that there is some alterations to it, but it's very, very similar to my throne.

So, she avoided the yes or no answer, and she said; A very diplomatic answer.

She said; It is as though, it were the very same.

So, it's not a yes answer, and it's not a no answer.

And this is part of her wisdom and Hikmah(حكمة).

She didn't give a straight answer of yes or no, and she made her answer right in between.

Because; it looks like her throne but it's a little bit different.

Sulaimanعليه السلام said; Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we were submitting to Allah.

And that what she used to worship besides Allah, has prevented her from Islam, for she was of a disbelieving people.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is saying; What prevented her from being a Muslim is, because the way; she was brought up.

Refusing the gift was one step for her towards Islam.

Bringing the throne was a second step for her, towards Islam.

It was said to her, Enter As-Sarkh(اَلصَّرْح).

What is As-Sarkh(اَلصَّرْح).?

As-Sarkh(اَلصَّرْح) is a special palace that was built for Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

This palace had very amazing things in it.

One of which was the flooring of this palace.

The floor was made out of glass; transparent glass, and under that glass was a flowing river.

So this palace is erected on water, and the floor was glass.

Glass was something that the people in that time might not have known; this transparent material.

So when, Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام told her to enter into this palace.

When she saw it; what did she think?

She thought it was water; so she raised up her skirt.

But when she saw it; she thought it was a pool, and she tucked up her clothes uncovering her legs.

Something very embarrassing.

Why is it embarrassing?

Because, it shows her ignorance.

It shows that, she's backward considering the advanced age that Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was at.

She doesn't know about this technology.

She was raising up her skirt, trying to walk into that water.

So it was embarrassing for her.

Why did Sulaiman(سليمان) do all of this?

Again to show her, what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given him?

It's part of the miracle of what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given him, to show to her, the truth of His message.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام told her; He said; Verily it is a glass surface with water underneath it.

In that moment, that was the third step towards Islam for her.

Finally, finally Bilqees(بلقيس) submitted and said; She said; My Lord!

Verily, I have wronged myself, and I submit to Allah; the Lord of Al-Alameen(اَلْعَٰلَمِينَ); the Lord of the world and she became a Muslim.

That's the end of the story in Qur'an.

And again, we don't go beyond that.

Because, there's many fairy tales about; what happened after that.

And there is no proof of the authenticity of any of these stories.

They say that Sulaimanعليه السلام married Bilqees(بلقيس) and it is turned into a romantic story.

And we do not again, get in this, because if it's not true, it is being very disrespectful with the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So we avoid it completely.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى again; whatever has been mentioned in Qur'an is for us to learn the lessons from, Al-Ibrah(العبرة).

And whatever has not been mentioned in Qur'an; has not been mentioned because, there's no Ibrah(عبرة) in it, there's no lesson in it.

And we need to be practical and learn what will benefit us, Al-Ilm an-Nafia(اَلْعِلْمَ النّافِعَ); the beneficial knowledge.

And get away from the knowledge; that doesn't do us any good, and doesn't have any practicality or applications for it.

Essence of the story is that; at the end, Bilqees(بلقيس) became a Muslim, after she saw; what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given Sulaimanعليه السلام.

We move on to another part of the story of Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

In the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ and until now, a lot of things have been attributed to Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام, which are untrue.

One of which, is magic.

There are some of Al-Yahood(اليهود); the Jews, who attribute magic to Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان), and the whole story of the temple also, is attributed to Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

For example, the Jews, or the people of the book.

They associate Sulaimanعليه السلام with someone called; Asmodeus.

A S M O D E U S And this Asmodeus was the chief of the devils.

And they associate him with Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام, and they say that this devil; chief of the devils was the one who assisted Sulaiman(سليمان) in building and constructing.

And he is the one, who used to tutor and teach Sulaiman(سليمان) magic.

And to teach him many of the skills that they say, Sulaiman(سليمان) had.

And you would find that many quotes and movements; they attach themselves to Sulaiman(سليمان).

Many of these secret orders; they claim that they go back to Sulaiman(سليمان).

And the most famous of them, is the Masonic movement; Al-Masoniyyah(الماسونيه); the Freemasons.

You would find that the concept of the temple; the Temple of Solomon, is something that is central or it is very influential, and the ideology of the Freemasons.

Also movements like the Kabalah(كباله) and some of these other, a mystical Jewish cults; they practice magic which they claim, they have learned from Sulaiman(سليمان) and they claim that the lineage goes back to Sulaiman(سليمان).

Now there is some truth that, there is magic, that goes back in lineage to some very early Jews; but it does not go back to Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

It all goes back to where?

Where did the Jews learned this magic, that some of which still exists until now?

And it's very powerful magic, we're not talking about tricks; where you hide a coin, and you bring it out from somewhere, or you bring something out of the hat.

We're not talking about those tricks which they fool the kids with.

We're talking about some serious magic that could do some serious harm.

Where was that learned from?

We know that, in the time of Firaun(فرعون), there was some magic.

But Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ)! Even though, it was very powerful magic.

But it was limited to the field of optical illusion.

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; They have committed magic to the eyes of people.

But we're talking about some other magic; that could influence the psychology and the spirit of people.

Where was that learned?

In Babel?

And how did they get it from Babel?

We know from the history that the kingdom of the Jews was destroyed by who?

Nabukhal-Nasr(نبوخل نصر); The Babylonian kingdom; they defeated the Jews in the Holy Land, and they broke up their kingdom.

Not only that, they took them as slaves back to Iraq in Babel; in Babylon.

They took them back to Babel.

And the Jews were cut off from the true religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

They were cut off from the scripture for quite a while.

And they were under the influence, and the dictatorship, and the oppression, and the tyranny of the Babylonians.

And that is where, a lot of the distortion, that happened to the religion of Judaism, that is where, it occurred; it occurred in Babel.

Where was the Talmud(تلمود) written, and Who wrote it?

It was written by the 70 rabbis who were in; Babylon.

And now, that is the law and the centre of focus of the Yahood( يهود) now.

They have left the Torah(توراة), and they're following the Talmud(تلمود).

And the Talmud(تلمود) was written by the rabbis, who were influenced by the regime and the environment in Babylon.

So if you read about this history; you find that Babylon is associated to it, all.

There's a lot of association with Babylon.

At-Talmud(التّلمود) came out of there, and magic, and these secret orders; they came from Babylon, rather than from Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

Even though, they attribute it to Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

The other point; issue of the temple.

This temple of Sulaiman(سليمان) is a myth.

There is no such thing called Temple of Sulaiman(سليمان).

The one who built the Masjid(مسجد) was who?

By the Nus(نص), by the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ Abu Dhar رضي الله عنه came to Rasool Allah ﷺ, and said; What was the first house established for the worship of Allah?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Al-Masjid Al-Haram(المسجد الحرام); Al-Qa'bah(الكعبه).

And then he said; And then what? Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Then, the Masjid(مسجد) of Al-Aqsa(الاقصى); Jerusalem and between them was 40 years.

40 years is the time between Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Yaqoobعليه السلام.

So, Yaqoob(يعقوب) is the one who built the Masjid(مسجد), or established it.

What was the role of Sulaiman(سليمان)?

Sulaimanعليه السلام; he is the one who expanded the Masjid(مسجد), and built it in its great form.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) is the one, who erected the Masjid(مسجد) and expanded it during his kingdom.

It was not a temple; it was a Masjid(مسجد); established for the worship of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

It's a Masjid(مسجد); the Mosque.

So this myth of the Temple of Sulaiman(سليمان), and all of this mythology is attached to it, and superstition and power; it's unreal.

There was a Masjid(مسجد).

Now, let's read from Surat-ul-Baqarah(سورةالبقره), Ayah(آية); which is 101; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And when they are came to them; a messenger from Allah, came to who?

This talking about Al-Yahood(اليهود); the Jews.

And when there came to them; a messenger from Allah; confirming what was sent to them; a party of those who were given the Scripture; threw away the book of Allah behind their backs, as if they did not know.

So they threw away the book of Allah.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ came, because they don't want to follow him.

And what did they follow?

And they followed what the devils gave out in the lifetime of Sulaiman(سليمان).

What is this talking about?

The devils were teaching the people magic.

Ash-Shayateen(الشَّيَاطِين); the devils were teaching the people magic; before the time of Sulaiman(سليمان) and during the kingdom of Sulaiman(سليمان).

As-suddi(السّدّى); in his Tafseer(تفسير) of this Ayah(آية), he says; Sulaiman(سليمان) came to know; that the devils are teaching people magic.

So he gathered all of their manuals and books.

He took them away from the people.

Because the people used to record, what they would learn from the devils.

Sulaiman(سليمان) took away all of those manuals and books.

And he made a law that, whoever learns magic, or practices Magic, or teaches magic will be executed.

And he took away all of these books and manuals and he buried them.

As the story goes, under his throne; he buried them.

To get rid of them; he buried them.

And he made a law in his time that nobody should learn, or teach, or practice magic.

This is from Shayateen(شَيَاطِين).

What happened, when Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) passed away, Ash-Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ); Iblees(ابليس) came to the people in the form of a human being, and he said;

Do you know, where Sulaiman(سليمان) used to get his power from?

The devils are the ones, who used to teach him, and I'll show you the proof.

Go and dig under his throne, and see what you will find.

They were to dig into the throne; they saw the manuals and the books of magic.

So they made a rumor, and they said that; Sulaiman(سليمان); this is how he used to control the Jinn(جِن), and this is how he achieved all of that power; it is through magic.

And that's how, they propagated this false rumor against Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

So, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى responds to this claim, and says; Sulaiman(سليمان) has not committed Kuffr(كفر); Sulaiman(سليمان) did not disbelief.

This part of the Ayah(آية) tells us two things.

First of all it tells us that, Sulaiman(سليمان) did not commit disbelief, and it tells us that, Sahar(سَحَر); magic; what is it considered?

It's considered to be Kuffr(كفر); is considered to be disbelief.

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Sulaiman(سليمان) did not disbelief.

This magic is not from him; because magic is disbelief, and Sulaimanعليه السلام did not disbelief.

But the devils are the ones, who disbelieved.

Teaching men magic.

Who are the ones, who are teaching magic?

The devils.

And what was revealed to the two angels.

And we'll Get into this In Sha' Allah(ان شاء الله)!

Now, in Qur'an; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى rarely mentions places.

Unless, there is a reason for mentioning a locality or a place.

The Book of Allah is a book of guidance.

So you don't find a lot of dates, and numbers, and chronological order of events, and places, and like you would find in the old testament or new testament.

Where?

In Babil(بَابِل).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى mentioned the place over here in the Ayah(آية).

And Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ)! The reason is because all of this magic, or secret orders, or distorted teachings came out of Babil(بَابِل).

And we know that, through history, and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wanted to record that in Qur'an; so that, we would learn.

Where the source of all of this came from?

It came from Babil(بَابِل).

Because; without reading Qur'an, by just reading the history, and books that deal with this; you would be able to see, the association with Babil(بَابِل).

So when you read it in Qur'an, it's an amazing thing to see; how Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tie this into Babil(بَابِل).

And that, then gives us the complete picture of what happened.

Because you could do readings; the secular reading on one side on the history and what was happening.

And then when you read Qur'an; it would put everything in perspective for you.

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; What was revealed to the angels in Babil(بَابِل).

Harut(هاروت) and Marut(ماروت).

The Mufassireen(مفسرين) have a few opinions, and they could be contradictory to each other.

I'll mention one; that was mentioned by a few of the Mufassireen(مفسرين) and seems to fit the Ayah(آية) most.

And that is; that Harut(هاروت) and Marut(ماروت) were two angels, who descended to Babil(بَابِل), and they were teaching people magic.

These two angels were teaching people magic.

And they were doing it with the permission of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى by the will of Allah.

We will read the Ayah(آية) and then, elaborate on this a little bit.

But the devils disbelieved; teaching men magic, and such things that came down at Babylon to the two angels Harut(هاروت) and Marut(ماروت); but neither of these two angels taught anyone such things until, they said;

We are only for a trial, so disbelieve not.

These two Angels descended to Babil(بَابِل), and they knew about magic; they knew this knowledge of magic.

And people would come to them to learn.

The angels would tell them; This knowledge that we are offering is Kuffr(كفر).

So do not learn it; because this is Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wanted this to be a test.

Knowledge; that is offered for you, but you shouldn't learn it.

That's, what it's about.

It's a test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Here is knowledge; you're not supposed to learn it.

And this is knowledge that will make you disbelieve in Allah.

And it's offered; This is the address; you want to go and learn it.

But the angels would not offer it to anyone until, they would tell him; This is a Fitnah(فِتْنَه); so do not disbelief.

The other stories, that are mentioned in the book of Tafseer(تفسیر) is that, these two angels; actually, the test was for them.

They say that, these two angels said; How come these people are sinning?

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; go down to earth and Allah put in them the shahawat(شهوات) of a human being; the desires of a human being.

And when Allah put in them the desires of the human being; they committed sins, and they started practicing magic.

But this does not seem to make sense.

Because we know that the angels; The angels did not disobey the orders of Allah, and they do what Allah has ordered them.

So it doesn't seem to make sense, especially that there is no evidence to support it.

If we would go with the literal meaning of the Ayah(آية); it would mean that, these are two angels who came down with the permission of Allah;

to test the people, and to offer them something that is Kuffr(كفر), and they should not learn it.

This knowledge was learned by a faction of Al-Yahood(اليهود); the Jews, and it has been inherited from generation to generation through secret orders, and part of that magic still exists until now.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has told us one effect of such brand or type of magic.

They learn from these angels; what could cause separation between man and his wife.

This is a kind of magic.

It's a magic spell; that is cast on the husband or the wife.

And it would cause hatred in the heart of the husband or the wife.

And it would make it unbearable.

And eventually it would cause divorce, separation.

And this exists, and I personally happen to know a few cases; firsthand knowledge of some cases where this happened.

It is true that this exists, but also, it is true that many people take it out of context.

And whenever there's a problem between husband and wife, they hang it on magic.

They said; There's magic between them, and that's not true.

There are a few cases and we should not always say that there's magic between them, and that's why there's a problem; No!

Sometimes, it's magic, sometimes it's uncompatibility of two persons.

But this type of magic is not only limited to putting these differences between husband and wife, it could cause some other harm.

And the way it's done, they have to have a part of your body; a hair, a nail with the assistance of the Jinn(جِن) would wrap it in what is Uqda(عقده), Al-Aqd(العقد).

And they would wrap it with that part of your body in it.

And that is what would cause this problem or magic to take effect.

And they would throw it somewhere.

And when this type of magic was done on Rasool Allah ﷺ according to the authentic Ahadith(احاديث); one of the Yahood(يهود) has done a magic spell on Rasool Allah ﷺ.

He threw it; where did he throw it?

He threw it in a well.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ was suffering from that magic.

Jibreel عليه السلام came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; that it is in this well, so they retrieved that out of the well, and they opened it up and the magic was released.

So that Uqdah(عقده); Uqdah(عقده) means a knot, that knot has to be released for the magic to be released.

Sometimes they throw it in the ocean, or they bury it in the desert.

That's how difficult it could be.

But because this seems to be power, that is in the hands of the magician, and seems to be supernatural abilities.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling us; And they would not harm anyone except by Allah's leave.

So Allah Is telling us that, this is not power in the hands of the magicians that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is not able to control.

Allah Is telling us that everything that is happening is, by His Mashee'ah(مشيه) by His will, as a test.

And for us it is a test because; we need to read Al-Mu'awwidhat(معوذات), and we need to read Ayat-Al-Kursi(آيت الكرسى), and we need to read what will save us, from such things.

So it is just like any other disease that exists.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى created the illness, and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى created the cure.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Every illness Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has created the cure for.

So, there's a cure for cancer; there's a cure for AIDS; there is a cure for everything.

Some people would know it, and some people won't.

It's knowledge that needs to be investigated.

This is a disease or an illness; this issue of magic; and there is a cure for it. And the cure is; And; And the other types of Isti'adha(استعاذه) that Rasool Allah ﷺ would do, and Ayat-Al-Kursi(آيت الكرسى).

And that's why, we need to always practice repeating these Adiyyah(ادعیۃ).

The Magician would think that by learning this knowledge; they could benefit.

Person goes to the magician thinks that the magician could benefit them.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And they learn; what harms them, and profits them not.

So, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tells us that; magic is purely harm and there is no benefit in it, whatsoever.

Whatsoever there's no benefit in it.

And when Ibn-Taymiyyah(ابن تيميه) talks about the suffering and the misery; the magicians go through when they follow this path; you would be amazed.

Don't think that the devils teach them this knowledge for free.

They pay for it.

And they pay for it, in the worst ways.

And when Ibn-Taymiyyah(ابن تيميه) talks about the rituals; the magicians go through, before they are incepted in the ranks of the magicians;

it is things, that would make the hair on your body stand.

They would make them drink the blood of menstrual.

They would make them eat frogs, and snakes, and insects.

They would make them right Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an with blood and step over it.

They would make them make Istinja(استنجا) with pages of Qur'an.

They would make them make Sujood(سجود) to the devils.

They would make them make Sujood(سجود) to idols.

These are rituals that the magicians have to go through, before they get the assistance of the Jinn(جِن).

They do not offer their services for free.

Jinn(جِن) do not offer their services for free.

The right way to heal is by reading Qur'an.

And by the Shuyukh who read Qur'an, that is a valid way because; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; In Qur'an is healing.

And indeed, they knew that the buyers of it; magic, would have no share in the here after, and how bad indeed was that, for which they sold their own selves.

Because the magician sells himself, if they but knew.

And if they had believed and guarded themselves from evil, and kept their duty to Allah; far better would have been the reward from their Lord if they but knew.

So from these Ayaat(آيات); the Sahabahرضى الله عنهم and also the Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Ullah; the Sahabahرضى الله عنهم reached to the conclusion that, magic is;

It is an act that will take a person out of the fold of Islam.

And that is why, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب); he sent out messages to the Islamic States or the governance through Wilayat(ولايات) saying;

Kill any magician.

And one of the Sahabah(صحابه) said; we found three magicians and we executed them.

So the Ulama(عُلَمَا) say that, this is the Hadd(حدّ) of magic, it is execution.

Because wallahi(ولله) you know stories of how magicians harm people.

You would say that this is a little punishment for them.

I mean, they have destroyed, they have broken houses, and they have caused harm.

The amazing thing that nowadays, this particular type of knowledge; where is it most widespread, in the Muslim world.?

It does exist everywhere else, but it's quite widespread in the Muslim world.

And obviously reason is; work of Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

That is where he wants to break up families.

Because, we know from the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ that; Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) sets his throne on water, and then the devils come and report to him, and everyone brings in a report

and Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) tells him; sit down! Sit down! Sit down!

And then eventually, one would come and say; I have good news for you.

I did not leave the husband and wife, until I separated them.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) would say; You are the one, come and sit next to me.

Breaking up the families is Amal-Ash-Shaytan(عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانْ).

And that is why, Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) tries to cause all of these fitan(فتن) among the Muslims in General.

Tell my servants; the Muslims to say a good word.

Why?

Because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) tries to plant disunity among them.

So one of the solutions to counter that, is to say good word.

Because, our words, or arms, or weapon in the hands of Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

He takes that word, and he makes Su'adh-Dhan(سؤذن) in the heart of the other person; bad suspicion.

And that's how problems starts.

Usually problems start because of what?

Words.

Tell my servants to say the good word.

If we would just monitor our words; believe me all of these problems would cease to exist.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has fulfilled his Dua(دُعَا) when he said; He said; Oh Allah! Give me a kingdom that will occur to nobody, after me.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gave him a unique kingdom.

And part of the uniqueness of the kingdom of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) is; he has control over Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين).

And Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام would put Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين) under slave labour.

They would work for him in what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has called; He would have them work, and serves him, and he would command them to do very difficult tasks.

This is what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has given Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) the ability to do.

So, it's a service for Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) and in the same time, it's a punishment for Shayateen(شَيَاطِين).

They had to do the slave labour for him.

But Al-Yahood(اليهود); they accused Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) of being influenced by Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين), and being controlled by Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين).

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام; he had this control over Al-Jinn(الجِن).

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام; when he passed away; the Jinn(جِن) continued working for him and the Shayateen(شَيَاطِين); even though, he was already dead.

Because he was kneeling on his cane, and he was dead.

But the Shayateen(شَيَاطِين) used to think that he was alive.

Even though, he already passed away.

And termites were eating from his cane from the inside, and the cane was going hollow, but he was still supported by his cane, sitting on his throne.

And then when the termites kept on drilling through the cane and the cane broke down; then Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام fell down.

Only then did the Jinn(جِن), and Shayateen(شَيَاطِين) realize that Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام was dead.

But before that, they continued serving and going through that slave labour.

Because, they were still seeing Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) sitting on his Arsh(عرش); on his throne.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Has mentioned this in Qur'an; to refute the claims of Al-Yahood(اليهود) that Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was controlled or influenced by the Jinn(جِن).

Then when We decreed death for him; Sulaiman(سليمان); nothing informed them the Jinn(جِن) of his death except a little worm of the earth, which kept slowly knowing away at his stick.

So when he fell down the Jinn(جِن) saw clearly, that if they had known the unseen they would not have stayed in the humiliating torment.

This Ayah(آية) response the two things.

First of all, it is to respond to the claim that the Jinn(جِن) were influencing Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

And number two; it responds to the claim that the Jinn(جِن) know Al-Ghaib(الغيب).

The Jinn(جِن); they do not know Al-Ghaib(الغيب).

And Al-Kahanah (الكهنه) and As-Saharah(السّحره); the magician's, and the fortune tellers; they depend on a Al-Jin(الجِن) and they claim that Jinn(جِن) know the future.

And since we have connection with the Jinn(جِن); We can know, until what will happen in the future.

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; If the Jinn(جِن) knew Al-Ghaib(الغيب); if they knew the unseen; they wouldn't have remained in this punishment.

Because the kind of tasks that Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was putting them through; was a form of punishment and humiliation for Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين) and Al-Jinn(الجِن).

And they kept on doing it even though Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was dead.

And this is a proof that Al-Jinn(الجِن) and Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين); they do not know Al-Ghaib(الغيب).

They do not know the unseen.

The Jinn(جِن); they do not have any knowledge, whatsoever about the unseen except what they steal from the conversation.

When the eavesdrop on the angels, that's the only information that they have.

And they mix one piece of truth with 99 lies.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام passed away.

And that's when the Jinn(جِن) realized that they have been working, overtime.

And they know that he's the only human being who has control over us.

So as soon as Sulaimanعليه السلام passed away; they went to their normal jobs of the pre Sulaimanic era, and that is to deviate people.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام did not have control over all of the Jinn(جِن) and Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى put under his control some of Al-Jinn(الجِن) and Ash-Shayateen(اَلشَّيَاطِين).

This is the story of Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.
parts.urdu: صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسلیما کثیرا
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ وَقَالُواْ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ الْجَحِيم۝

قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُاْ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ۝

قَالُواْ نَحْنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةٍۢ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ۝

ما خيربين أمرين إلا أختار أيسرهما قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ۝

وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ۝

وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍۢ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ۝

فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ۝

فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ۝

ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ۝

قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُاْ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ۝

هَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ

وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ۝

الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ

فَلَمَّا رَآهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ

وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ۝

قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ۝

فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ۝

وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍۢ كَٰفِرِينَ۝

قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ

قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

وَسَحَرُوٓاْ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ Yaqoobعليه السلام.

اَلْمَسْجِدْ الْاَقْصى وَبَيْنَهُمَا اَرْبَعِيْنَ عَاماً لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا

يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ

Bi'Babila(بِبَابِلَ); وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَى الْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ

وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has created Ad-Da'(الدّاء), and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى created Ad-Dawa'(الدَّواء).

ما من داء الا له دواء علمه من علمه وجهله من جهله قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ۝

قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ فِيْهِ شِفَاء Allahسُبحانه وتعالى then says; وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا لَمَنِ اشْتَرَاهُ مَا لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلاقٍ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا بِهِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ كفر مخرج عن الملة اقتلوا كل ساحر يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُواْ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُواْ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ

هَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ

فَلَمَّاا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُواْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

parts.english:
I want you to listen to these Ahadith(احاديث) and keep in mind that, Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) was a king.

He was an a Nabi(نَبِي), and he was a king.

He was busy with establishing a kingdom, with fighting his enemies, with establishing justice, with establishing services for his people.

And then look at! What else he is doing.

Even though, he's doing all of this; look at what else Rasool Allah ﷺ says he was doing; The best fasting, is the fasting of my brother; Dawood(داؤد).

He would fast one day and break the next.

So he would alternate between fasting.

He would alternate between fasting throughout his life.

This is the king; whatever types of food or drink he wants; he can just point and they would approach him.

But he would fast.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ tells us something else about this Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; He would never run away from battle.

If he's in the battlefield; Dawood(داؤد) would never show the enemy his back; brave and strong.

Rasool Allah ﷺ also says about Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد); Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The best fasting is the fasting of Dawood(داؤد); and the best prayers are the prayers of Dawood(داؤد).

He used to sleep the first half of the night; and then he would wake up and pray for one third of the night; and then he would sleep for the remaining one sixth of the night.

So every night, he would pray one third of the night.

He had time for Ibadah(عبادة).

You have to find time for Ibadah(عبادة).

You might say; well, he's busy, he's king, he's is busy with running the affairs of his kingdom, how could he find time for this Ibadah(عبادة).

We need to understand that we cannot be good in whatever we're doing, and be successful in applying the law of Allah and making Da'wah(دعوة);

If we are not having these moments of deep worship with Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

In the depth of the night, and the Dhikr(ذكر), and the fasting are important for any Muslim who's in the field of Da'wah(دعوة), or in the field of politics, or in the field of jihad or whatever.

This Ibadah(عبادة) is what prepares you for the work of the day.

Because one of the worst things, that could erode your heart and put permanent scars in it is; the political work.

I mean; working in politics can really wear down the heart and destroy it, and take the Taqwa(تقوى) out of the heart like a drainage; it just take it out.

So anyone; who's working in that field which is political, whether it is a king like, Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد); or a Khalifah(خليفه) like, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب); or a military general like, Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

You need that worship; you need that prayer of Qiyam-Al-Layl(قيام اليل) and Dhikr(ذكر), to keep you always on the right track.

So that is the energy, that they use to go ahead.

With the Kafir(كافر); Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is giving them energy to continue.

Because this is very difficult work.

But for the believer, if you do not have this Qiyam-Al-Layl(قيام اليل) and Dhikr(ذكر) of Allah and fasting; you could easily be misled and misguided.

Because these are very difficult field to work in; you're dealing with many conflicting ideas and things, and it could take the concentration away from one's mind and heart.

So that's why, they need this Ibadah(عبادة).

And Sayidina Dawoodعليه السلام would pray one third of the night.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب); I remind you once again with the story.

When Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani(ابو مسلم ال-خولانى) came to deliver the news to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) that certain area in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) was opened.

Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani(ابو مسلم ال-خولانى) came into Madinah(مَدِينَه) when it was the time of noon.

And it was the tradition of the Arabs to sleep at noon.

Because it was very hot.

Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani(ابو مسلم ال-خولانى) did not want to go and disturb Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

So he went to the Masjid(مسجد).

He felt that, maybe Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) is sleeping; so I'll go to the Masjid(مسجد).

He went to the Masjid(مسجد) and he gave out the news; he spread the news to the people that; We won! We were victorious.

Somehow, the news reached to Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) called Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani(ابو مسلم ال-خولانى), he told him; How come you didn't come and tell me first?

Who should you report to?

To the Khalifah(خليفه)!

You go and tell the people in the Masjid(مسجد).?

You should come and tell me first.

Why didn't you come and let me know?

Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani(ابو مسلم ال-خولانى) said; Oh Ameer Ul-Mo'mineen(أميرالمؤمنين)! I came into Madinah(مَدِينَه) when it was time of noon; so I did not want to disturb you.

Because I thought that you were asleep.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) said; He said; How can I sleep!

If I sleep during the daytime, I would not fulfill my duties toward the people; toward my nation.

And if I sleep at night, I would not be able to fulfill my duties towards Allah.

If I sleep at the daytime; I would not fulfill my duties towards the creation.

And if I sleep at night; I would not be able to fill my duties towards the Creator.

They said that, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب); when he became Khalifah(خليفه), he never slept the traditional way of sleeping on a bed with a blanket.

He would sleep sitting down, or leaning on a wall, or take a nap here and there, and keep on moving, keep on working; Mujahideen(مجاهدين); these were the graduates from the training of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Dawoodعليه السلام was very protective of his family.

He would not allow any man to see his wives.

And this is mentioned in a Hadith(حديث), so when he would leave his home, or palace, or whatever; he would close all the doors, and not allow any man to get in.

Suddenly one day; the wife of Dawood(داؤد) sees a man in the middle of the house.

There's a man in our home.

She said; If Dawood(داؤد) knows about this; we're in big trouble.

How did this man get in?

Dawoodعليه السلام did come.

And he saw this man.

And he said; Who are you?

The man said; He said; I am the one who never fears the kings; and nothing can run away from me.

I'm the one, who does not fear the kings, and nothing can run away from me.

In the name of Allah! You must be the angel of death; welcome with the decree of Allah.

A king; he has everything, a person would want in this life.

I mean; we are holding to this world; holding so tight to this world for a few bucks, that we make here and there.

We don't really have much, none of us are kings.

We don't have that much; and we're holding so tight to this world.

For the small part of the world which is allocated for us, we became servants to it.

And Dawoodعليه السلام is the king of the strongest nation of its time, and the Muslim ummah(امة) of that time; Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

And when he saw the angel of death, he said; Welcome!

Welcome with the decree of Allah, I'm ready! I'm ready to die!

Because, I wasn't the king for the kingdom; I wasn't the king for the gold and silver; I wasn't the king to love this world; I was a king to serve Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

I was doing this as a service for Allah.

I'm doing it for you Oh Allah! If you want me to leave, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى I want to meet You.

The Angel of Death took away the soul of Dawoodعليه السلام on the spot.

Sulaimanعليه السلام; his son, ordered the birds to cover the body of Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد), and to provide shade for him from the sun, until they would finish the process of death.

And when night-time came; Sulaiman(سليمان) ordered the birds to Protect him, and come closer to him, and to protect them with their wings, until they finish the process of making Dafan(دفن) of Sayidina Dawoodعليه السلام.

And this shows you that, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made the birds servants for them.

The one who worships Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and he's righteous towards Allah; Allah can make steel; iron soft in his hands; Dawoodعليه السلام.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى can have the birds serve him.

This is the story of our beloved prophet of Allah, David; Dawoodعليه السلام.

We start with the story of Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

And remember Dawood(داؤد) and Sulaiman(سليمان); when they gave judgment in the case of the field, in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night, and We were witnesses to their judgment.

There are two neighbours.

One of them had a farm, and the other one had sheep.

The owner of the sheep forgot to lock his gate at night-time.

So the sheep, they went into the farm, and they enjoyed themselves.

And they destroyed everything in the farm.

The owner of the farm wakes up in the morning and sees that his farm is eaten and by his neighbour's goats or sheep.

They went to Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد), to ask him to give his Hukum(حكم); his judgment.

Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) listen to both sides, and his Hukum(حكم) was; his judgment was that; the owner of the farm takes over the sheep.

Because it was due to the carelessness of the owner of the sheep.

The owner of the sheep should give up his sheep to the owner of the farm; as a compensation.

You damaged his farm, give up the sheep; give it to him.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام was outside of the court.

When they came out; he asked them; What happened?

They told him; What was the Hukum(حكم).?

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان), he took them back and he told his father; I have another Hukum(حكم).

My Hukum(حكم) is that; the owner of the sheep, should give the owner of the farm; the sheep.

The owner of the farm will keep the sheep with him, and make use of their milk; will drink from the milk.

While, the owner of the sheep fixes the farm.

And as soon as the farm is fixed and returned to its to its normal state that it was in, then the owner of the sheep takes back his sheep again.

So the Fatwa(فتوى) of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) is that; the sheep are given to the owner of the farm for a while, so that he can live off the milk of the sheep.

While, the owner of the sheep fixes the problems caused by his sheep.

As soon as the problem is fixed, and the farm is back to the state it was before; then he takes his sheep, and the owner of the farm goes back to his farm.

And Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) realize that this is the right Hukum(حكم), so he approved it.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Qur'an; We gave the right understanding to Sulaiman(سليمان).

Judgment in court; Al-Qadha(ال قضا); it's not a matter of only knowing the law.

Because both Dawood(داؤد) and Sulaiman(سليمان), they know the law.

We cannot say that, Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) did not know the Hukum(حكم); did not know the law; did not know the Shariah(شريعة).

They both knew the law. But to apply the law; to apply the law in situations that is where people are different according to their understanding.

Now Allahسُبحانه وتعالى makes it clear to us that both of them had the understanding in applying the Shariah(شريعة) of Allah.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى after he said; We gave them both; knowledge and the right judgment.

Both Dawood(داؤد) and Sulaiman(سليمان) had the knowledge, and had the right judgment.

It is just that, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gave this understanding to Sulaiman(سليمان) in these situations.

And where was Sulaiman(سليمان) learning anyway; Who was training him?

It was his father.

I mean; he was learning from his father.

But sometimes, the son can be better than the father in some things.

But both of them, Dawood(داؤد) and Sulaiman(سليمان); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى blessed them with the law of Allah, and the ability to apply it.

At this point I mentioned it again; not everyone who has the understanding of the law; know how to apply it.

You could have memorized all of the laws; all of the books of Fiqh(فقه); all of the books of Hadith(حديث), but you might not know how to apply it.

This is a Mowhibah(مؤهبه); it's a gift from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to some people, that they have the ability to apply the law in real situations.

And this is something, that some of the Sahabahرضى الله عنهم were better than others in.

And they excel like, for example; Sayidina Ali Ibn Abi Talib(سيدنا علي ابن ابي طالب) was famous among the Sahabah(صحابه) as being a very wise judge.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) used to get assistance from Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), and he would appoint him as a judge.

This is an understanding that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gives to the people.

There is another case that was presented to Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد).

And this is in a Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ).

Two women disputed, what happened is; these two women were shepherds.

So they went out with their sheep and they had their infants; the infants were the same age.

And they left their infant somewhere, and they went talking or maybe shepherding; a wolf came and ate one of the infants.

When the women came back, and they found that one of the infants is eaten.

Both of them claim that, the infant who is alive belongs to them.

Every one of them is saying; He's my son.

And they fought with each other, and they couldn't solve the problem.

They went to Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد).

Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد); he listened to both sides of the story.

He made the judgment that; the child should go to the eldest of them; Al-Kubra(الكبرى).

When they were leaving from the court; Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) asked them; What happened?

They told them what happened.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Get me the child.

And he said; Bring me a knife.

So the woman said; What do you want to do with a knife?

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; If you're not able to solve the problem, and know who this child belongs to; I'm going to split the child in two, between you.

The youngest woman immediately said; No! It belongs to her.

It's her son.

Sulaimanعليه السلام used this surprise against these two women.

Because he knew that the mother would not want this to happen to her child, and reaction would immediately show on her.

So Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) by this, was able to tell that the youngest one is the mother.

The one who said; No, it belongs to the eldest one.

Because she wanted to save her son.

So she said; No, it belongs to her.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Then you take the child.

And he gave it back to the youngest among them.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام inherited his father Dawood(داؤد).

We have given knowledge to David and Sulaiman(سليمان).

Knowledge is one of the things that, we could become proud with and it is similar to money.

We always tend to give credit to our hard work.

I am successful because, I studied hard; or I'm rich because, I worked hard.

But with anything; whether it is money, wealth or knowledge; all; all of the credit goes back to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

It is Allah who made it possible for you to study.

It is Allah who made it possible for you to work hard.

Allah could have inflicted you with the disease, and no matter how hard worker you are; you wouldn't be able to do anything.

So it's a Tawfeeq(توفيق) from Allah; Allah is the one who made it possible for you to do this.

Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) and Sulaiman(سليمان); who were at the highest levels of knowledge in their time.

Nobody else had more knowledge than they did.

Nobody had more understanding than they did.

They were the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى say that; We gave them knowledge; What was their response?

They said; They said; All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who has preferred us above many of His believing slaves.

So the blessing is from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who is thanked.

And the issue of thanking, is a very, very important Ibadah(عبادة).

Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبنِ ألقَيِّم) says that, There are two wings for the bird; one of them is Shukr(شكر) and one of them is Sabr(صبر).

We have to have these two wings.

On one side we have thanks; and on one side we have patience.

If anything good happens to us; we think Allah.

If anything bad happens to us; we have patience.

And Sulaiman(سليمان) inherited David.

What did Sulaiman(سليمان) inherit from his father?

He Inherited from him; An-Nabuwwah(اَلنَّبُوَّة); Prophet-hood and Kingdom.

It is not the wealth; because Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); they do not leave behind wealth.

What they leave behind is; Sadaqah(صدقة), but it is the kingdom and it is the Nabuwwah(نبُوَّة) the Prophethood.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tested Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام with some tests.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; When there were displayed before him in the afternoon; well trained horses of the highest breed.

This was like an army parade in front of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان), to show his army.

So they were marching the horses in front of him, and he was inspecting the horses.

When he was inspecting the horses, he got busy with that.

And the time of Salah(صلوة) passed, and he missed the Salah(صلوة).

And he said; Alas! I did love the good, instead of remembering my Lord in my Asr(عصر) prayer, this is in Paranthesis; till the time was over, and the sun had hidden in the veil of night.

Sulaiman(سليمان) was inspecting these horses, and the time of Maghrib(مغرب) came before he prayed Asr(عصر); So, he missed Asr(عصر).

The next Ayah(آية) says; Then he said; Bring these horses back to me, and he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks.

There are two opinions, given in the Tafseer(تفسير) of this Ayah(آية).

And both of them are nothing more than opinions.

There's no strong Hadith(حديث) or evidence, that either one of them is right, or maybe if both of them could be wrong.

The two opinions are; one of them is that; Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); he passed his hands over the horses, as an honoring for these horses of Jihad(جهاد).

The other opinion is that; Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) who was upset; because the horses were the cause of distracting him from Salah(صلوة).

So he cut off their necks, and killed them.

Ibn Jarir At-Tabari(ابن جرير ألطبري) refuses to accept the second opinion, because he says; How come Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) would blame the horses, who are innocent, for this.

So there's no way to choose any one of the opinions.

And then the first opinion; what does it mean by passing his hand over them?

But the lesson that we learn from the Ayah(آية) is clear.

And first of all, we believe in the Ayaat(آيات) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And the lesson is clear that, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى was testing him.

And this test did also happen to Rasool Allah ﷺ in one of the battles.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was busy with fighting, and they missed the Salah(صلوة), and Rasool Allah ﷺ says; May Allah curse them! or May Allah fight them! They have distracted us from Salah(صلوة).

And Rasool Allah ﷺ could not pray until, the sun has already set.

Some of the Ulama(عُلَمَا) derive a Hukum(حكم) from this؛ that If the battle ground allows you to pray Salat-ul-Khauf(صلوةالخوف), then pray Salat-ul-Khauf(صلوةالخوف).

In case, the fighting is so vicious and tough, and you're not even able to pray Salat-ul-Khauf(صلوةالخوف); then you can delay it and pray it when the battle is over.

This is the Hukum(حكم) of some of the Ulama(عُلَمَا) derived from this Hadith(حديث).

Another test happened to Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان). Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And We indeed, did try Solomon, and he placed on his throne; Jasadan(جَسَدًا), but he did return to Allah with obedience and repentance.

There is a Hadith(حديث) that is Sahih(صحيح), which could explain what this Ayah(آية) means.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام in this Hadith(حديث); Rasool Allah ﷺ says; He said that, he will pass by all of his 70 wives.

Another Hadith(حديث), it is 90, and this Hadith(حديث) is Sahih(صحيح) in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

So he's going to sleep with every one of his wives.

And he did that with the intention of; all of the children that will be born, they will fight in the sake of Allah.

He wants to have Mujahideen(مجاهدين); so he decided that, he will sleep with every one of his wife; So that, she could give birth to a Mujahid(مُجَاهِد) in the sake of Allah.

His associates told him; In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله)! Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) did not say, In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

And he went ahead, and slept with every one of the wives.

None of them became pregnant except, one of them.

And then; she delivered half a child.

Somehow, it was mutilated, and only half of the child was remaining; and it was a dead body.

And this is the meaning of the Ayah(آية); We tested Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); It's a trial from Allah.

We threw on his throne, a dead body.

Then, he returned to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

It's a test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for him; to say, In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله)!

And therefore, whenever we want to do something in the future; we always need to tie it to the will of Allah.

Because nothing can happen, if Allah does not will.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام; as Allah says; Returned to Allah.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Oh Allah! Forgive me.

And after he asked Allah for forgiveness, he made a Dua(دُعَا).

He said; Oh Allah! Give me a kingdom that will occur to nobody else after me.

My Lord! Forgive me; and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me; verily You are the bestower.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) is not asking kingdom, for the sake of kingdom; that is not the acture of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) is asking for a kingdom, that would be a miracle; that would be his miracle.

So the miracle of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) would be his kingdom.

Because every Nabi(نَبِي) Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gives him a miracle.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) asked Allah to give him a kingdom that will be unique; different from any other.

And that would be the miracle of Sulaiman(سليمان); and we will see that it was truly a miracle.

And Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); no other person, Nabi(نَبِي) or not a Nabi(نَبِي), was given a kingdom similar to Sulaiman(سليمان).

The kingdom of Sulaiman(سليمان) was unique.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى accepted the Dua(دُعَا) of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان). Allah says; So We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently to his order, wherever he willed.

And we're going to talk about some other things in this kingdom.

But first, let me read to you this Ayah(آية); Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Oh mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things.

What does all things mean?

Some of these things that the Ayah(آية) talked about is; Number one; Wind.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) had control over the wind for distance of a month.

So he can use wind to travel for him, and accomplish things, a distance of a month.

That's the span, that Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) had control over; distance of a month; that is the area of his control.

Number one; control over wind.

And also the devils from the Jinn(جِن), every kind of builder and diver.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made the Shayateen(شَيَاطِين); the Devils, servants with Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

And he would command them, with whatever order he want.

Some of them would dive in the oceans, and some of them would build for him.

And there's other Ayaat(آيات) that talk about this.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى also taught him the language of birds.

And we also know from another Ayah(آية); that he knew the language of; the ants.

And the other Ayah(آية); And We made a fountain of brass to flow for him.

This was a fountain Allah-u-Aa'lam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ) how; but it would flow with brass.

We know that his father, Dawoodعليه السلام had the ability to mold iron; steel.

With Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى provided him with a fountain of brass.

This brass would come out molten; he can mold it in whatever form he wants.

And there were Jinn(جِن), that worked in front of him, by the leave of his Lord, and whomsoever of them turned aside from our command; we shall cause him to taste the torment of the blazing fire.

Anyone of these Jinn(جِن), who would go against the order of Sulaiman(سليمان); would be punished.

They worked for him what he desired; making high rooms, images, basins, as large as resolvers, and cooking cauldrons fixed in their places.

These are things that the Jinn(جِن) would do for Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

And then, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allah here, is commanding the family of Dawood(داؤد); Dawood(داؤد) and his son, to give thanks.

But notice here, an important word in the Ayah(آية).

What does the Ayah(آية) says; We always think of thanks as a word, to say; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله)!

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is saying in the Ayah(آية); and act with thanks.

So thanking Allah is not only through the word; it is also through the actions.

Act with gratitude, and thanks to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So Shukr(شكر) needs action.

You thank Allahسُبحانه وتعالى through your actions.

And then, Allah says; Only a few of my servants are thankful and grateful.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was praying, and he started making moves in a Salah(صلوة).

So the Sahabahرضى الله عنهم asked Rasool Allah ﷺ; What were you doing?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Ash-Shaytan(الشَّيْطَانْ) came in front of my face; and he wanted to distract me from my Salah(صلوة).

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) was trying to confuse Rasool Allah ﷺ and his Qirah(قراة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ pushed him first, he came back; push him a second time, he came back; pushed him a third time, the Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) came back;

Rasool Allah ﷺ grabbed him and chocked him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I felt his saliva dripping on my hand.

He choked him so hard.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And I was about to bring him forward, and tie him to a pillar in the Masjid(مسجد) so that the kids could play with.

Throw things at him, and he's tied to a pillar.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; But I didn't do so; because I remember the Dua(دُعَا) of my brother Sulaiman(سليمان), when he said; Oh Allah! Give me a kingdom that will occur to no one else.

What does this mean?

Rasool Allah ﷺ was about to take control of this Jinn(جِن); this Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ), and tie it to the Masjid(مسجد).

But the reason, why he didn't do so، is because; he remembered that this is something that was unique with Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

The control over Jinn(جِن) was something unique given to Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

Nobody else had the control over the Jinn(جِن).

And that's why, Rasool Allah ﷺ released the Jinn(جِن); because he knew that, that's something that belongs to the uniqueness of the Kingdom of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

The control of the wind; the control of the Jinn(جِن); the ability to speak the language of the bird and the ant; these are some things that were unique with Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

And he made a Dua(دُعَا) to Allah and Allah promised him that your kingdom will be unique.

And that's the uniqueness of the kingdom of Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

We talk about the Dua(دُعَا) of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

We would talk about one of the major events or the accomplishments of Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام, and that was the rebuilding and expansion of Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصى); the furthest mosque.

Contrary to the belief of Jews; it is not Sulaiman(سليمان) who established the so called temple; they call it the temple.

It's not a temple; it’s a Masjid(مسجد).

They say; Sulaiman(سليمان) is the one, who built the temple.

They call it; Solomon's temple.

No!

The Masjid Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصى) was not established by Sulaiman(سليمان).

Who's the one who built it?

Sayidina Yaqubعليه السلام.

Because in the Hadith(حديث), Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling Abu Dhar(ابو زر); that the first Masjid(مسجد) that was built is; Al-Masjid Al-Haram(المسجد الحرام); Al-Ka'bah(الكعبه).

That was the first house that was built.

Abu Dhar(ابو زر) said; And then what next?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; The furthest mosque; Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى); Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And then the furthest mosque, and that was built by Sayidina Isra'il; Yaqubعليه السلام,

and between the time of building Al-Ka'bah(الكعبه) and the furthest mosque is 40 years, and that's mentioned in the Hadith(حديث).

What Sulaiman(سليمان) did is that; he expanded it or rebuilt it.

After he finished the building of a Masjid Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصى); he made a Dua(دُعَا) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and he asked Allah for three things.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Sulaiman(سليمان) asked Allah for three things, Allah has given him two; Allah granted him two.

And we hope that Allah has granted him the third.

Sulaiman(سليمان) asked Allah, number one; To give him a Hukm(حکم) To give him judgment that will be the same as the judgment of Allah.

Meaning that; Sulaiman(سليمان) asked Allah to make his judgment according to what Allah wants; what pleases Allah.

So whatever I would judge, that would be the right judgment.

That is what Allah is pleased with.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Allah has given him that; He was granted that Dua(دُعَا).

The second Dua(دُعَا); And he asked Allah to give him a kingdom that will occur to nobody else; a unique kingdom.

Rasool Ullah says; And Allah has given Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); granted him that Dua(دُعَا).

The third Dua(دُعَا); Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And the third Dua(دُعَا) of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was that; If any man leaves his home with no intention other than praying in Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى); the furthest mosque,

than Oh Allah! Take him out of the Masjid(مسجد), as if he has left out with no sins just like the day he was born.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And we ask Allah that He has given him that Dua(دُعَا).

So this Dua(دُعَا) was done by Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) and it was repeated by Sayidina Rasool Allah ﷺ; and we expect that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will accept that Dua(دُعَا).

Therefore, the Ulama(عُلَمَا) say, that if you leave from your home with no intention other than praying in Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى);

if you go there and pray two Raka'ah(ركعه) with the sincerity, by the time you leave the door of the Masjid(مسجد); you would be leaving as if you were born with no sins.

So we ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to grant us a Salah(صلوة) in Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(المسجد الاقصى) and to free it from al Al-Yahood(ال يهود); the Jewish terrorists who have taken over the third holy site of Islam; Masjid Al-Aqsa(مسجد الاقصى).

We ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to free it from their hands and to give it back to the Ummah(امة) of Islam; the ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

Allah says and these Ayaat(آيات) are from Surat-ul Namal(سورة النمل).

Surat-ul Namal(سورة النمل) mentions a portion of the story of Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان).

And there were gathered before Sulaiman(سليمان); Solomon, his soldiers of Jinn(جِن), and men, and birds, and they were all set in battle order.

Hushira(حُشِرَ) means; assembled and gathered in one place.

Hushira(حُشِرَ); when you have things in different areas and you bring them together that's called Hashar(حَشَر).

That's why the Day of Judgment is called yaum-al-hashr(يوم الحشر).

Because you have people all over the world, and you're bringing them to one place; you're assembling them together.

Over here Sayidina Sulaiman علیہ السلام is gathering his army.

And the Ayah(آية) says that, he has a battalion of men; soldiers, and a battalion of Jinn(جِن), and the squadron of birds.

Imagine that army, that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى put under his command and control, creation, which nobody else had control over.

So Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام had control over the Jinn(جِن) or at least part of them or maybe all, Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ).

And he also had control over this, army of birds, that would join him in his army.

Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ)! What uses he would find for them?

But they were part of his army.

Yuzaoon(يُوزَعُونَ) Because the army is so large, and so huge and vast, and contains thousands or maybe millions of soldiers.

They had to have security guards to monitor the army, and to make sure that all the army is there and we're not leaving anybody behind.

So they have to have the security around the army to make sure that everyone is moving together because it's like an ocean moving.

They were marching, and they came into a valley.

This Valley was occupied by ants.

There are many ants in this valley.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى called it wadiy namal(وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ); the valley of ants.

There were so many ants living in that valley; it was called the Valley of ants.

They found residents in that valley and there were millions of them living in it.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام doesn't know that, this is the valley of ants, he was passing through it; his army was marching.

And when they came across the valley of ants.

One of the ants saw the army approaching; it was the first and to see the army coming.

What would be a natural reaction?

When you see an army of humans, and Jinn(جِن), and birds in the air marching towards you, and you are the small creation; an insect, what would be the natural reaction in such a situation?

To run; you would run; run away from danger.

This was not the reaction of the ant.

We would expect the natural reaction is that, you would immediately run away from this approaching danger.

But the ant didn't do that, and Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله)! We find a lesson.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى doesn't mention anything in Qur'an except for a reason.

We can have a whole talk about ants, and learn lessons from it, and find that we are lacking in things which this and it's kingdom had.

This ants knew that if it runs away, it's not gonna survive.

Because it's part of an ummah; it's part of a nation.

And the survival of that ant depends on the survival of its ummah(امة).

Because if the ummah(امة) is destroyed; it wouldn't do the ant any good even if it's alive; it's going to end up dying in the end.

And this is something that every Muslim should learn and realize, that your survival is based on the survival of your ummah(امة).

Never think that you can make it alone.

You have to have the support of the ummah(امة), and you need to take care of the ummah(امة), and you need to be concerned about the ummah(امة).

If you are not concerned about the ummah(امة), then realize that you're dead.

If you do not have the concern that this ant had for its ummah(امة), then know that you are already dead before you even die.

This ant said; Oh you ants! Enter into your dwellings.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And one of the ants said; Oh ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaiman(سليمان) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not.

They might crush you.

So it gave the advice to the whole ummah(امة) of ants, to go down in your dwellings.

So it fulfilled its responsibility towards his ummah(امة).

There's also something else we notice in the end of the Ayah(آية); The ant said; that Sulaiman(سليمان) and his army would crush you.

And what's worse than killing; I mean, the whole ummah(امة) of the ant could be dead.

Nevertheless, the ant found an excuse for Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) and said; And they don't proceed so; they don't know.

It didn't say that, they're intentionally going to kill us and get rid of us; It said; Even though, it's a matter of life and death; We are going to die; if we don't move from this place.

Even though, we're going to lose our life; we're still going to give them an excuse.

And we're going to say that, he's doing so; he doesn't intend to do so.

The ant is finding an excuse for Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) in something that has so importance, in the issue of life and death.

Sometimes very minor things could happen between us, very minor things and we wouldn't find an excuse.

In fact, we would try to indict a person, and to accuse a person.

We, instead of trying to find 70 excuses for the person; we would try to find 70 ways to accuse a person.

Over here, it's an issue of life and death, and the ant is still find an excuse for Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان), and saying; They don't perceive so; they don't know.

These are important things that we can learn from An-Namlah(اَلنَّمْلَة); the ant.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام understands the language of the ants.

And he heard what the ant said.

So he smiled.

When he heard this announcement from the ants; he smiled.

So he; Solomon smiled; amused at her speech.

This is a skill that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); the ability to understand the language of the birds, and the ants.

He attributed the credit and the thanks to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

He said; Oh Allah! Gives me the ability to thank you and be grateful, for what you have given me.

We; the ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ are the followers of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

And we inherited all of the valid teachings of the prophets of Allah; in the form of the stories of Qur'an and the stories of Hadith(حديث).

And all of the falsifications; that were attributed to the prophets and they are free from.

Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله)! In the religion of Islam; we, with the protection of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for the book of Islam; none of these crept in to the religion.

So the valid teachings of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); whether we're talking about Eesa(عيسى), or Musa(موسى), or Dawood(داؤد), or Sulaiman(سليمان), or Nuh(نوح), or Hud(هود), or Saleh(صالح);

their teachings are given to us through Qur'an.

And we follow the Sunan(سنن) of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

We just talked about, for example; in Hajj(حَجْ); Rasool Allah ﷺ was standing in Hajj(حَجْ) and said; Stand on your Masha'ir(مشاعِر).

Masha'ir(مشاعِر) are the places of worship.

Because you are on the inheritance of your father Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

These are things we inherited from Sayidina Ibrahimعليه السلام.

Over here, we find an important Sunnah(سنة).

Whenever, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى blesses you with a skill; or blesses you with any Ni'mah(نعمة); whether it is wealth, or intelligence, or any ability.

Whenever, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gives you this Ni'mah(نعمة); always thank Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for it.

And whenever something good happens to you, due to that skill, then immediately follow it with Hamd(حَمد).

For example; when you pass an exam; the first reaction should not be jumping up and down in happiness.

Your first reaction should be Alhamdulillah(الحمدللہ)!

If your business goes well; the first reaction should be not to say MashaAllah(ماشاالله); I'm a very intelligent and wise businessman.

The first reaction which should be what?

If Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given you knowledge, and you are able to benefit someone with this knowledge, and you noticed that knowledge that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given you, and you notice the fruits of that knowledge on somebody else,

say; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله)!

If Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given you money and you have given away that money in the form of Sadaqah(صدقة).

Immediately, after you give this Sadaqah(صدقة) say; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله)!

Follow up every Ni'mah(نعمة) that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given you with Shukr(شكر).

That is the least that we could do to be grateful to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for what He has given us.

He said; My Lord!

Inspire me, and bestow upon me the power and ability, that I may be grateful for Your favours, which You have bestowed on me and on my parents,

and that I may do righteous good deeds, that would please You and admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous slaves.

A beautiful Dua(دُعَا) that we could remember.

Let's go back to the Ayah(آية) we talked about earlier.

And the army of Sulaiman(سليمان) was assembled; the humans, the soldiers, the men, and the Jinn(جِن), and the birds; huge army.

Keep this in mind and then let's look at the next Ayah(آية); He inspected the birds and said; What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe or is he among the absentees?

Al-Hudhud(الهدهد) is a bird; hoopoe.

We call it a bird.

Sulaiman(سليمان) was inspecting his army.

His army of thousands, or maybe millions.

This huge army, which Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; And he noticed the absence of one bird.

We find an important tip for leaders in this.

Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was a king.

He could spend his time in a palace.

But he was there, in the battlefield, inspecting the army and he was able to notice the absence of one bird.

One bird out of many.

So as I said; this might be a good tip or important lesson, for anybody who's in a position of leadership; to be able to realize their responsibility that they have towards their followers.

He didn't find Al-Hudhud(الهدهد). So he said; I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or even slaughter him, unless, he brings me a clear reason.

The Hudhud(هدهد) was absent, Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; Number one; I would punish him, a severe punishment, or slaughter him, if the sin is greater than I would slaughter him; the bird is dead,

unless the bird presents me with a clear reason for being absent.

You find here that the rule is very strict.

Sulaiman(سليمان) didn't say I would let the bird go.

It's either as punishment, and then he said; It's not only punishment but severe.

The second option is execution.

Unless, the bird brings me with a clear reason.

The reason why the law over here is strict, is because; here we're dealing with what?

We're dealing with a military situation; This is army.

And if we look at the Seerah(سيرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, we would find when Rasool Allah ﷺ is in the battlefield and going to Jihad(جهاد), the rules are strict.

It's a military order.

It's different than the rule in Madinah(مَدِينَه).

I'll give you an example.

In the Battle of Tabook(تبوك); Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Only one with strong transportation should follow us.

Because the Battle of Tabook(تبوك); in that battle, they're going to be crossing the long deserts of Arabia.

They're going to go all the way until the North passing Sahara An-Nufud(انّفود), which is a very rigid and tough environment and it's a long way.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Nobody should come with us unless their camel is strong.

If your camel is weak, don't come.

Because you're putting yourself in danger.

One of the soldiers of the army really wanted to go out and fight in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; he disobeyed the order and he came on a very weak camel.

And he followed Rasool Allah ﷺ on that weak camel.

Rasool Allah ﷺ has given clear orders; Don't come if you have a weak camel.

That man disobeyed the order; What happened is; his camel fell down and the man died.

Because the camel was weak; It couldn't withhold this difficult situation.

So the camel fell down and this soldier fell off the camel and died.

The Sahabahرضى الله عنهم were saying; Ash-Shaheed(اَلشَّهِيد) ! Ash-Shaheed(اَلشَّهِيد)!

They said; Ash-Shaheed(اَلشَّهِيد); He became a Shaheed(شَهِيد); He died in the sake of Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Don't say he's Shaheed(شَهِيد); he has disobeyed my orders.

He is not a Shaheed(شَهِيد) because he disobeyed the order Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Let's look at a similar situation in Madinah(مَدِينَه); the mother of Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) brought her son, Anas(أنس) to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said;

I'm giving you away my son to be your servant.

The Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ; they wanted to serve Rasool Allah ﷺ with their own life.

They would give their lives for Rasool Allah ﷺ.

This mother; she came and she brought her son Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) and said; Take my son to be your servant.

So he would serve Rasool Allah ﷺ.

One day, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; go out and buy me something, and he gave Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) some money.

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) went to the market, he was still young.

On the way he saw some children playing.

So he took a turn and went to play with the kids and forgot about the order of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And time was dragging and he was playing.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ was waiting, Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) didn't come back; Rasool Allah ﷺ went out looking for him; he found him playing with the kids.

He told him what happened?

Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك) remembered the order of Rasool Allah ﷺ; he was checking his pockets, he found that he lost the money.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; continue playing, continue playing.

Rasool Allah ﷺ forgive Anas Ibn Malik(أنس إبن مالك).

He lost the money; he didn't bring what Rasool Allah ﷺ told him to bring.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; continue to play.

The more severe the situation; the stricter the rules are going to be.

Because in a military situation, in an army; it is more severe situation so the rules are stricter.
