And we find that the Muslims lost in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) because of one rule that was broken.

But the hoopoe stayed not long.

The hoopoe; the bird came back, and it came back with news.

I have grasped knowledge which you have not grasped.

This bird is telling Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام, that I have grasped knowledge; I came over knowledge that you don't have.

A statement like this, cannot be said to many kings in the world today; If you say that; you're dead.

If you say that I have knowledge that you don't have; you could be dead.

But Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام; a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; with the humbleness of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) was willing to listen and to learn, even if it's coming from a bird.

I have brought you from Saba'(سَبَإٍ); true news.

Saba'(سَبَإٍ) is in Yemen, in an area called Ma'rib(معرب) that's the center or the capital of the Kingdom of Saba'(سَبَإٍ).

And the Kingdom of Saba'(سَبَإٍ) was in a very fertile land and valley.

But that area does not receive a lot of rain.

The land is very fertile but the area does not receive a lot of rain.

It only receives rain in two seasons and in very scarce amounts.

Because the rain is received in two seasons.

It is called in Arabic; Al-Antar Al-Mawsimiyyah(الانتار الموسميه).

Mawsim(موسم) means, season; seasonal rain.

The word Mawsim(موسم) was taken into English, and what is it called now; What do they call that type of rain?

Monsoon rain.

So the word monsoon comes from the Arabic word, Mawsim(موسم), which is seasonal rain.

Because that area does not receive a lot of rain; the people of Saba'(سَبَإٍ) invented a dam.

They built a dam in Ma'rib(معرب).

And this dam was holding a lot of water that was coming down from the valleys and from the mountains, and they made an irrigation network that spread through areas, which are now in the Rub Al-Khali(ربع الخالى); in the empty quarter.

And that was all gardens and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Qur'an; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given the people of Saba'(سَبَإٍ) in their land; an Ayah(آية); a sign, gardens from the right and left.

Even though, the land is desert but because of that dam, it turn into gardens.

This bird visited the kingdom of Saba'(سَبَإٍ).

It went all the way from Jerusalem to Yemen; Pretty long distance.

And it came back with news to Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام.

The bird said; I found the woman ruling over them.

And the name of this woman is; Al-Malika Bilqees(الملكه بلقيس); Her name is Bilqees(بلقيس).

And she was given from everything.

Ibn Al-Jawzi(ابن الجوزى) says; This woman was given from everything that the king would want, or a queen would want.

She had everything; wealth, power.

And she has a great throne.

Now Notice here that, the bird said; She has everything.

But then the bird singled out her throne.

Why?

Because that throne was a sign for the kingdom of Saba'(سَبَإٍ).

It was something that used to be a miracle of the world in its time; the throne of the queen of Saba'(سَبَإٍ).

She has a great thrown.

Up to this moment, it is praise of this huge and great civilization.

She has everything; she has a great throne; it's a huge kingdom.

These are the standards that the people of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) use to classify nations.

If the nation is rich, advanced, wealthy, we view that nation as civilized and advanced, and we try to imitate such nations.

That is the standard that the people of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) have.

But the bird was a Muslim.

Even though, the bird said that, she has everything and she has a great throne.

She said; I found her and her nation making Sujood(سجود) to the sun, instead of Allah.

And Satan has made their deeds fair seeming to them.

And has barred them from Allah's way; so they have no guidance.

The end result, of this surveillance of the bird is that; these are people who are misguided.

The wealth, the power, the fact that they have everything, did not take the bird away from stating the fact that; this nation is a misguided nation.

And this is the standard that we should view nations in.

It is belief or Kuffr(كفر).

It is either believing or non believing.

And that is what counts on the day of judgment.

And nation that could be heavy and strong in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), could be very light on the scale on the Day of Judgment.

And then the bird said; Satan has barred them, so they do not worship Allah; Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth,

and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

The bird said; Allah! None has the right to be worshipped but He; The Lord of the supreme throne.

Because, the bird in the beginning said that, she has a great throne; then the bird said; Allah is the One, Who Has a supreme throne.

Even though, her throne is big but Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who Has the supreme throne.

This is an Ayah(آية) of Sujood At-Tilawah(سجود تلاوة) so we will make Sujood(سجود).

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام said; Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام said; I will see if you are telling the truth or are you lying?

So Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام said; We will see, are you telling the truth or are you lying?

Go you with this letter of mine and deliver it to them; then draw back from them and see; what answer they return.

Sayidina Sulaimanعليه السلام wrote a letter.

And the Hudhud(هدهد) delivered this letter to the queen of Saba'(سَبَإٍ), in English; Sheba.

Her name is Bilqees(بلقيس).

So the Hudhud(هدهد) carried this letter and the story says that, the Hudhud(هدهد) delivered the letter on her lap.

And then the Hudhud(هدهد) withdrew; so they didn't know where this letter came from.

She just saw that this letter fell down on her lap.

And Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان) said; See what they're going to do.

So the Hudhud(هدهد); even though, it withdrew from their sights, but it was monitoring their actions.

The Hudhud(هدهد) was monitoring their actions to see; what their response will be.

So the Queen opened the letter and she read it.

The letter was very brief, and the contents were revealed to us in Qur'an.

She said; She said: Oh chiefs! Verily, here is delivered to me a noble letter.

She said; The letter is noble.

Why did she call it noble?

It could be because some of the Mufassireen(مفسرين) said; the way it looked, and the seal; it looked very noble.

Some of them say; because of the contents of the letter which were noble.

Some of them say; because of the source of the letter which is Sayidina Sulaiman(سيدنا سليمان); who is the noblest of his time.

She said; A noble letter has been sent to me.

Or actually, Means; it fell on me.

She doesn't even know who delivered it.

And then she read the contents of this letter.

It's very brief and listen to the contents.

It is from Sulaiman(سليمان); That's the source; That's the one who's sending the letter.

And keep in mind that Sulaiman(سليمان) is a king.

He's a prophet; but he's also a king.

And he's sending a letter to who?

To a queen.

If we don't know what the contents are, and we would be quizzed, to guess what the contents would be.

I think it would be very difficult for us to reach to the right answer.

If we're basing our opinion on the perception that we have, of what politics is, and how rulers, rule; we would assume that the letter would have contents which we hear regularly in the letters that are sent between kings and presidents all over the world.

But if we are basing our opinion on the comprehensivity of Islam, and that Islam includes everything in life, and that the Shar'(شرء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى dominates everything that we do;

then we would understand the contents of this letter.

The letter is; The letter starts with what?

We start our actions in the name of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We start eating by immensely the name of Allah.

When we start As-Surah(السورة); we start by the name of Allah.

When we ride our cars; we say; Bismillah(بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ); When we go on the airplane, we say Bismillah(بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ).

Everything that we do, we should start it in the name of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And this is how, we would be following the Sunnah(سنة) of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Verily, it is from Sulaiman(سليمان) and verily it reads In the Name of Allah; The Most Gracious, The Most Merciful.

And then, what did he say?

He said; Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims; submit to me.

And that's the end of the letter.

Don't be exalted over me.

Don't view yourself in a better position, or in a higher position, or in a position of arrogance.

And Sulaiman(سليمان) is not saying that to satisfy a personal desire; but he's saying that because he's the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We have sent every messenger to be obeyed.

The messengers; we obey them.

They are the ones who are in the high level, and they are the ones who issued orders to us.

So he is telling her don't think that since you are in the same political rank; I'm the king and you're the queen, that we are on the same level.

you don't see me as a king; Now, see me as the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; Don't be exalted against me.

And come to me; it is translated here as Muslims, but many of the Mufassireen(مفسرين) say; it means, submission; come to me in the form of submission.

Submit to me and then, he's going to give them Da'wah(دعوة).

So over here Muslimeen(مُسْلِمِينَ) does not mean the religion; come to me as Muslims.

It means; come to me in the form of submission.

Because that's what Islam means.

It means submit to my orders and commands to you.
parts.urdu: یلبس علیہ قراۃ القرآن صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسلیما کثیرا
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ أفْضَلَ الصَّوْمِ صَوْمُ اَخِى دَاوُدَ كانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمًا وَيُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا

ولا يَفِرُّ إذا لاقَى أَحَبَّ الصِّيَامِ إلى اللهِ، صِيَامُ دَاوُدَ، وَأَحَبَّ الصَّلَاةِ إلى اللهِ، صَلَاةُ دَاوُدَ، كانَ يَنَامُ نِصْفَهُ، ويقومُ ثُلُثَهُ، وَيَنَامُ سُدُسَهُ،

وَكانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمًا، وَيُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا هيهات هيهات انا نوم ،ان انمت بالنهار زيأت حق العباد، وان انمت باليل زیات حق الله والله لنفتضحن بداود

انا الذي لا هاب الملوك ، ولا يمتنع منى شئى Dawoodعليه السلام said; والله إذا ملك الموت . مرحبا بأمر الله مرحبا بأمر الله مرحبا بأمر الله Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ۝

فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ۝

رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ۝

قاتل هم الله او لعنهم الله شغلونا عن الصلاة وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ۝

قالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بنُ دَاوُدَ: لَأَطُوفَنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ علَى سَبْعِينَ امْرَأَةً، تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ فَارِسًا يُجَاهِدُ في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ،

فَقالَ له صَاحِبُهُ: إنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَلَمْ يَقُلْ، ولَمْ تَحْمِلْ شيئًا إلَّا واحِدًا، سَاقِطًا أَحَدُ شِقَّيْهِ، فَقالَ النبيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّمَ: لو قالَهَا لَجَاهَدُوا في سَبيلِ اللَّهِ

وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ۝

ثُمَّ أَنَابَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ۝

فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ۝

وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ۝

وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ۝

وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِييرِ۝

يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍۢ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓاْ ءَالَ دَااوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; ٱعْمَلُوٓاْ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓاْ ٱعْمَلُوٓاْ شُكْرًا ۚ عَمَل ٱعْمَلُوٓاْ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ۝

وبينهما اربعون سنه يقول صلى الله عليه وسلم: إن سليمان بن داود عليهما السلام ، سأل الله ثلاثا فأعطاه اثنتين ، ونحن نرجو أن تكون له الثالثة ؛ فسأله حكما يصادف حكمه ، فأعطاه إياه ،

يصادف حكمه فأعطاه إياه ، وسأله ملكا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعده ، فأعطاه إياه ، وسأله أيَّما رجلٍ خرج من بيته لا يريد إلا الصلاة في هذا المسجد خرج من خطيئته مثل يوم ولدته أمه

فنحن نرجو أن يكون الله عز وجل قد أعطاه إياه Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُيُوزَعُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَحُشِرَ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ۝

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ۝

فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ قِفوا على مشاعِرِكُم فإنَّكم على إرثٍ من إرثِ أبيكم إبراهيمَ

Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله)!

فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰللِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا

وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ  وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ۝

وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ اللْغَائِبِينَ۝

فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ۝

مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ۝

لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَاْذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ۝

عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَاْذْبَحَنَّهُۥ لا يلحقن بنا الا مقوى فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ۝

لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ آيَةٌ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ

وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

أُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ۝

أَلَّا يَسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ۝

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ۝

قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ۝

سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ۝

ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ۝

فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ۝

قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ۝

كِتَٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ۝

Allah-u-Aalam(اللَّهُ أَعْلمَ)!

أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ۝

أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ۝

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ۝

إِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ۝

أَلَّا تَعْلُواْ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ۝

أَلَّا تَعْلُواْ عَلَىَّ and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ I am the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى;

أَلَّا تَعْلُواْ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ۝

وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ۝

parts.english:
When Musa(موسى) passed away; the leadership was handed down to Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون); Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) who is mentioned in Qur'an as a servant;

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) was a servant with Musa(موسى).

Being a servant with Musa(موسى), he was close to the revelation; close to the teacher, and he was a righteous student of this teacher.

So when Musaعليه السلام passed away; the leadership was handed down to, Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), and Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is Nabi(نَبِي);

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is a Nabi(نَبِي), but he is not mentioned in Qur'an; he is mentioned in the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The name of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) is not in Qur'an, but it is from Hadith(حديث), and it is in the Sahih Hadith(صحيح حديث).

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), in English; Joshua.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) became the leader of the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

The children of Israel(اسرائيل) were delivered to the Holy Land, and they were victorious; under his leadership.

this did not happen with Musaعليه السلام and it did not happen with Haroon(هارون).

Rather, it happened in the time of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون).

Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون); they passed away when Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were in the wilderness.

Rasool Allah ﷺ tells us a clue of the reason, why this victory was delayed.

The children of Israel(اسرائيل) who came out from Egypt, were raised up in servitude and slavery.

So, they were weak, and they were not fit for victory.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made them stay in the wilderness for 40 years.

Until, all of that generation passed away, and a new generation who was raised up in freedom under the leadership and the teaching of Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون);

These are the ones who were given the victory to enter Jerusalem.

The ones who were raised up by Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون) in a free environment.

Because, the environment in Egypt was not suitable to raise up a generation of victory.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Ullah says; None of the ones; who worship the calf, entered into Jerusalem.

All of that old generation who worshipped the calf; were dead, a new generation was raised up in the desert; in that harsh environment; under the teachings of Torah(تورة); under the hands of Musa(موسى) and Haroon(هارون);

these are the ones who were qualified for leadership.

We learned something interesting for them.

There's no doubt; that Musa(موسى) is the greatest Nabi(نَبِي) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

How come did the victory happened in the time of Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون)?

And it tells us, there is not enough to have a leader.

Musa(موسى); is the best that Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) have seen, and he is the founder of this nation.

Nevertheless, victory did not happen on his hands even though he desired it so greatly.

He wanted to enter into the Holy Land.

And we know how much he desired that, that when the angel of death came to take his soul, he hit him, and then; when he knew that this is his appointed time, he said, I will die now

but, oh Allah! Make me die as close to Jerusalem as possible.

Throw of a stone.

He said; If I cannot enter into Jerusalem alive, at least bury me as close as possible to Jerusalem.

But that did not happen in the time of Musa(موسى), because the generation which were with Musa(موسى) did not deserve it.

So now when we keep on thinking that, I mean; we're waiting for Al-Mahdi(ال مهدى); everyone is waiting for Al-Mahdi(المهدى).

It's not an issue of a Al-Mahdi(المهدى); If you're not ready; Al-Mahdi(المهدى) cannot do you anything.

The generation has to be ready and prepared for victory.

It's not an issue of a leader; the generation have to be ready and prepared.

And that's why, Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were not able to enter into Jerusalem until, there was a suitable generation for victory.

And these are the ones who entered with Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), and we will see the miracle which Allahسُبحانه وتعالى performed for them.

When you have Allah on your side; don't worry! Allah will do everything for you.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) was fighting with Al-Jababirah(الجبابره).

Al-Jababirah(الجبابره) were the people who were living in Jerusalem.

They were giants, powerful, tyrants.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) led the children of Israel(اسرائيل) in that battle.

The fighting was furious.

The sun was about to set.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) knew, that he would need more time; it's not enough for him.

He cannot win, except if the day is longer.

If they wait for the next day, the army will regroup and attack again.

So he needs the more time.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) pointed to the sun and said; You are receiving orders, and I'm receiving orders.

Both of us are receiving orders from Allah; so stop!

He told the sun stop.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى made the sun stop for Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون).

Until he finished, and destroyed the enemy, then the sun started moving again.

If you have Allahسُبحانه وتعالى on your side; don't worry! Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will take care of you.

It's not a matter of numbers, or weapons, or air force, or artillery, or battalions.

If you have Allah with you; Allah will help you.

He pointed to the sun; to stop! It stopped.

And this Hadith(حديث) is narrated by Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; One of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) went into war, and he told his army; if any one of you just got married, you did not sleep with your wife yet, and you want to; then don't come with me.

And then he said; And if anybody is building a house, and he did not build the roof yet, then don't come with me.

What is the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) telling his people; If you got married to a woman, and you did not sleep with her yet, don't come with me.

If you are building a house, and you did not build the roof yet, don't come with me.

If you have bought some pregnant goats or pregnant camels, and you're waiting for them to deliver, don't come with me.

Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون) does not want anybody to come with him; if their hearts are attached to something else.

If your heart is with your wife, don't come with me.

If your heart is with your house, don't come with me.

If your heart is with the camels and goats, don't come with me.

He's not looking for numbers; he could gather a crowd and take them to war.

He said; No! I don't want you.

This battle needs people who have, Ikhlas(اِخْلَاص); who have sincerity.

If you're coming, and doing this half-heartedly; stay home.

And then, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; He fought; until it was time of Asr(عصر), and then he told the sun; you are receiving orders, and I'm receiving orders, oh Allah! Stop the sun.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى stop the sun, until he achieved victory, and he won.

This is the story of Sayidina Yusha Bin Noon(سيدنا يوشع بن نون).

They won, and they entered into Jerusalem, and they started expanding their nation; under the banner of; Time past; few generations, maybe a few centuries, and then the enemies were regrouping and attacking again.

And there was a continuous Jihad(جهاد) with Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

Under the leadership of one of their Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) came to their Nabi(نَبِي), and they told him; Send us a king; so that we can fight under his leadership.

Have you not thought about the group of the children of Israel(اسرائيل) after the time of Musa(موسى), when they said to a prophet of theirs; appoint for us a king and we will fight in Allah's way?

They came to their Nabi(نَبِي), and they told them; We want to fight in the sake of Allah.

Their Nabi(نَبِي) was very wise.

He said; Would you then refrain from fighting, when fighting was prescribed for you?

He said; You're asking for fighting; but when fighting is prescribed on you, will you fight?

Because it's easy to claim, that you're willing to fight.

And people talk, but rarely do we find anybody walking the talk?

People say that; We're willing to fight in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and they're giving out these sermons, and everybody is motivated and encouraged.

But then, when it comes to the real situation; people back out.

And the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told them, he said; Now you're asking for fighting; what if it is prescribed on you, Will you then fight?

They said; Definitely!

Why shouldn't we fight in the sake of Allah, when we have been driven out of our homes and our children.

They have kicked us out of our land; how come we will not fight?

And we will fight in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And they gave their promises, and they said; We will fight in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; Don't worry! We will fight.

But when fighting was ordered for them, they turned away; all except a few of them.

We should never be fooled by the claims that we hear, and the talk.

Because talk is free, It doesn't cost you anything to talk; but fighting in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى cost you a lot.

You can make a claim that you will open Jerusalem if you want.

Talking big is easy, but the sacrifice and especially long term sacrifice which he had needs, that is difficult.

Jihad(جهاد) is not only sacrifice, but it's a long term sacrifice and that is, where people fail.

If you are asked to sacrifice in one time; you could be fired up with a speech and then you would give out your money for example; and you would sacrifice, that could happen.

Because, it's a solid plate of iron; steel.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى taught Dawood(داؤد); how to make armoury out of rings of iron?

So, he would make the iron into rings, and attach the rings together, and attach rings to those rings until, he would make an armory that would cover the body.

And this prevents, and this eliminates the two downsides of the other armoury.

Because, it's very light in weight; rings are very light, and it's very flexible.

Because, it's rings you could move freely.

But it offers the same protection; because it is from iron.

We taught him; the making of metal coats.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى taught him; how to make these metal coats?

So that, it will protect you in your fighting.

Allah is the one who taught him, how to do this.

In the other Ayah(آية) Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Saying; Make you perfect coats of male; balancing well the rings of chain armour, and work human righteously, truly I am also aware of what you do.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling Dawoodعليه السلام; Make the rings proportionate! Don't make them too large.

Because if they're too large; they could be penetrated.

And if they are too small; there could be some other negative aspects to it.

Make them the right size!

In modern terms; we would call this a new technological invention.

Even though, it will happen through a miracle with Dawoodعليه السلام.

But I'm getting to another point.

In modern terms; we call this a modern invention, just like a car, or a computer, or an airplane, or whatever.

Even though, we all believe that; everything is created by Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Somehow subconsciously, we attribute these things to the human beings who made them.

So we're always impressed with the manufacturer, whether it be IBM, or Intel, or Toyota, or Sony, whatever manufacturer is making for us these new inventions.

And we always hold the scientists in high esteem, whether it is Isaac Newton, or Edison, or others, or Bell, or whoever, Einstein.

We rarely thank Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for these things.

Rarely do you find somebody saying; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) for the car, or Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) who made communication easy,

or Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) who made transportation easier for us, Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) who provided us with the telephone, or the car, or the airplane, or whatever.

Whenever we attribute the credit; we give the credit to the human being.

Now it's true, that this happened through the human being.

That is true!

But in the end, who is the one who made it possible for the human being to do it?

When Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is talking about Dawoodعليه السلام particularly, making these shields.

What did  Allahسُبحانه وتعالى say?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We taught him how to make armoury for you, so are you going to be grateful?

Allah is telling the human beings; it is Dawood(داؤد) who made this for you.

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not say; Be grateful to Dawood(داؤد).

Because, that is where the credit belongs.

So, whatever technological accessories we have; credit should go to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; The One, Who created everything.

It is from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and it is a blessing from Allah.

And it is a test for the ones, who made these things.

And it's a test for the nations, who are producing these things for us; who are they giving credit to?

In France, there was a Muslim PhD student, who did an excellent research.

And then he wrote on the cover page of that PhD dissertation, he said; And all credit goes to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and if there is any mistake in this research; it is because of me.

His professor who happens to be an atheist, he said; You worked for years on this research, and then you give credit to someone who didn't do anything for you.

And you; the one who worked for four years; you say that, all mistakes belong to you.

What's wrong with you; Can't you think straight?

Now you're going to be a PhD student; I'm going to give you a PhD.

And you're still thinking in this backward mentality, the credit doesn't go to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We should say, Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) for everything.

Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) for everything; every tool; or every instrument; or every machine; or anything that we have around us, it came to us from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى through mankind.

You find that, many of these inventions were invented in what seems to be a random way.

I mean; the scientist was sitting down a tree, and then the apple fall down.

This might be a story, but with penicillin; we know for a fact that it came from a random observation.

They were studying something else and somehow, they discovered penicillin.

And with many other things, the scientists would be studying something, and then this thing comes along on the side, and they found out about it and it turns out to be a greater invention, or a greater study; than the what they were studying before?

Who is turning their attention to these directions?

It's Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they say; It happened randomly!

It's not random, everything is with the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

It is Qadar(قَدَر) from Allah; Taqdeer(تقدير) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

There is nothing that is haphazard and random in the universe.

We made his kingdom strong, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given him a strong kingdom, and we said that; this was the golden age of the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

The time of Dawood(داؤد) and Sulaimanعليه السلام.

That is, when their kingdom reached to its peak.

And that is when it was the kingdom of Tawheed(تؤحيد); the unity of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and the Kingdom of Islam.

After that, the religion was changing and children of Israel(اسرائيل) were going down.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given him strength in his Kingdom; his kingdom was strong.

And Allah has given him wisdom, and the good judgment.

Allah has given him decisiveness.

Being decisive is important for somebody; who is in the position of Dawoodعليه السلام.

Dawood(داؤد) was a king.

And he had to deal with enemies, he had to deal with internal problems, he had to deal with many difficult conflicting situations.

Therefore, decisiveness is important in such a situation.

It is a quality that is needed for somebody in such a position.

When you're dealing with militaries, and you're dealing with enemies, and you're dealing with huge nations around you, and strong enemies; the issue of decisiveness is important.

And decisiveness also is needed in court.

See, there are some places where you need decisiveness, some places where it's not needed that much.

In court; it's also needed, you have to have the decisive judgment.

You can't go back and forth.

You can't have one foot to the left one foot to the right.

You have to have a clear understanding of the situation and then a clear judgment.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد); the decisiveness.

He had the ability to study the situation, and take a final judgment, and go ahead with it.

And then he would not retreat and not hesitate.

Dawoodعليه السلام reached to this stage, after he went through training.

See, people don't suddenly come out of nowhere with all of these qualities.

We learn things through our knowledge and life experiences.

Two sources; knowledge in one side and life experiences from the other side.

That is how we learn.

And that is why, we need to understand the importance of the concept of Tarbiyyah(تربيه).

Tarbiyyah(تربيه) is important in Islam.

Tarbiyyah(تربيه); training and raising up a person from one stage to another.

You cannot have a revolutionary sudden change.

Things have to go step by step.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى put the Sahabah(صحابه) in the furnace.

He put them through the tests, for years and years.

So, in the end, when they graduated; they graduated with the highest certificates.

Put the Sahabi(صحابي) in any situation; he will never fail.

Because, they went through trial after trial; test after test; in the School of Muhammadﷺ.

When they graduated in the end; Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that, he has left behind men, who can carry the message.

But they went through experiences, and they learned from their mistakes.

We're not born with all of the qualities.

The same with the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), and with Rasool Allah ﷺ; Allah put him through 40 years of preparation.

He didn't become a prophet when he was born.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى planned the life of Muhammadﷺ day by day.

Everything in the life of Muhammadﷺ for the 40 years before Prophet-hood was, for a purpose.

And the same thing with Musaعليه السلام, we already talked about this; when he was raised in the palace of Firaun(فرعون).

That was an experience for him; and Yusufعليه السلام.

With Dawoodعليه السلام; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى also prepared him through some tests.

We're going to talk about one of these tests; a sample.

Dawood(داؤد) used to have a Mihrab(محراب); a place of worship, where he would stay in seclusion; in solitude, and worship Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; away from everything; away from all distractions.

And he will not allow anyone to come in.

Suddenly, out of nowhere, two men appeared in front of Dawood(داؤد).

They jumped over; they climbed over, and suddenly, Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) saw two men in front of him.

So you can see that, there was an element of shock and surprise in this, right?

Suddenly, out of nowhere, you're in the depths of your Tasbeeh(تسبيح) and Dhikr(ذكر), and now you find two men standing in front of you; inside your house.

Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) was in a state of shock and surprise.

And they saw that he was worried, they said; Don't worry!

They said; We are too litigants; one of whom has wronged the other, therefore a judge between us with truth, and treat us; not with unjustice, and guide us to the right way.

So, Davidعليه السلام was presented with the case.

These two men said, that we have a dispute, and we want you to judge upon us with justice and truth.

The case is as follows; Verily this; my brother has 99 ewes; sheep, while I have only one sheep, and he says, hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech.

One man is saying that, this; other person standing in front of you; has 99 ewes; sheep; female sheep.

And I have only one.

And he took away from me that one single sheep that I have, and he didn't give it back to me.

There are many stories about this Ayah(آية), but all of them are Israiliyat(اسرائيليات).

We're going to stay away from them, and we're going to stick with the Qur'an; with the Authentic.

So this man said; He has 99 sheep.

So he has much more than I do.

He's wealthier than me.

And I only have one and he overpowered me, he fooled me, he took me over with his beautiful words.

And I handed over to him my single sheep.

And now he doesn't want to give it back to me.

Dawoodعليه السلام give his judgment.

He said; David said; He has wronged you in demanding your ewe, in addition to his ewes.

And verily, many partners oppress one another except those who believe and do righteous good deeds; and they are few.

Dawoodعليه السلام said; that he has wronged you.

He shouldn't have taken away from you, your sheep.

And then, Dawood(داؤد) said; And partners; they always wrong each other, except the few believers.

Dawoodعليه السلام is telling us; this is thousands of years ago, that most of the time partners, they wrong each other.

Partnership usually find that, every partner is trying to take over the other.

And every partner is trying to outwit, or try to outsmart the other one.

And everyone is trying to work out the best deal for himself.

And that always happens between partners, and there is an exception to that, and these are the ones who believe.

And this is a warning to us, that whenever you have a partnership, have it very clear.

Have the terms clear written down.

That is very important in partnerships to have clear agreements.

When Dawood(داؤد) said that, the two men standing in front of him disappeared and vanished.

Without saying anything, they suddenly disappeared.

Dawood(داؤد) immediately knew that, this was a test from Allah, and that, he has committed a mistake.

He knew; he didn't need anybody to tell him.

What was the mistake of Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد)?

He didn't listen to the other side.

He heard one side of the story, it sounded very appealing.

99 sheep, and you have only one, and he took it away from you?

Clear oppression.

He stole; I mean, this man has 99 sheep and you have only one, and he took it away from you.

And he gave his judgment.

He didn't hear from the other side.

And this was a test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; Allah wants to test him.

Why?

Because Dawood(داؤد) is going to assume a very important responsibility and he needs to have patience and giving out his judgment.

And that's why they surprised him.

That element of surprise and shock was to knock Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) off his guard and suddenly present the case to him very fast.

So Sayidina Dawoodعليه السلام also gave his answer very fast.

So the whole setup was in a way, push Dawood(داؤد) to give fast or a hasty judgment.

And that is what happened.

It was a test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, but Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد) immediately realized that, it was a test from Allah and that, he has committed a mistake.

What was his reaction?

He made Sujood(سجود) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And David guessed that, We have tried him, and sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate, and turn to Allah in repentance.

We forgave him.

And for him is a near access to us, and a good place of final return.

After that, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Oh Dawood(داؤد)! We are appointing you as a Khalifah(خليفه); as a successor over mankind.

When did this happen?

After Dawood(داؤد) went through the test.

So the scholars say something interesting.

They say that, Dawood(داؤد) after the mistake, was better than Dawood(داؤد) before the mistake.

Even though, he committed a mistake; but Dawoodعليه السلام after the mistake was better than Dawoodعليه السلام before the mistake.

If we learn from our mistakes; we improve through our mistakes.

Because now, Dawood(داؤد) learn the right way to judge, and to be patient, and to listen from both sides, and not to be hasty in his judgment.

And that qualified him, to be king over mankind. Tawbah(توبة); repentance to Allah can make us better.

Why?

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; The ones who make repentance, and believe in Allah, and do good deeds; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will change their bad deeds into good ones.

Not only, will Allah clear your account and you will start with a zero balance.

Not only that, but your previous sins will turn into good deeds.

So the evil, imagine it! This dirt; that you have in your past; will turn into pure gold.

Tawbah(توبة); that is Tawbah(توبة); learning from mistakes, but we need to repent.

Sayidina Dawood(سيدناداؤد); he asked Allah for forgiveness, Allah forgave him and he became better.

Same thing with Adamعليه السلام.

He became a prophet; when did he become a prophet?

Before the mistake or after?

He became a prophet after he committed his mistake; brought us down from Paradise.

He became a prophet after that.

So we learned from our mistakes.

But if we continue doing mistakes, and we don't get the lesson, and we don't get the point, and we fail from test to test, we don't benefit anything and we become worse.

The point is to learn, and to benefit from the experiences that we have.

And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Rule among people with truth and; don't follow your desires.

Do not follow your desires; why?

For it will mislead you from the path of Allah.

Those who wander in stray from the path of Allah; will have a severe tournament.

Again, Allah is telling Dawood(داؤد); to judge among the people, and to rule among them, and to govern among them with?

Truth.

And do not follow your desire.

The most dangerous thing on the Islamic judicial system is following desires.

The most dangerous thing in our relations with one another; is when we base it on our own desires and not on the law of Allah.

And as we say, in Arabic, and I think this saying is also in English; Justice is in the heart of the judge.

The law can be on paper.

But if the judge does not want to apply it, he can find ways around it.

You can.

Therefore justice is in the heart of the judge.

And that is why, we can only have justice through true Islamic system.

Why?

Because you either have good laws and a corrupt judge, or you have a good judge and corrupt laws.

In the Muslim world; now, in most of the places, we have a corrupt law with a corrupt judge.

We have them both.

Here in America; you have a corrupt law, but sometimes you have a good judge, sometimes you don't.

The combination that we want, is a good law and the good judge.

And that could only happen when the law is Islamic, and when the heart of the judge is Islamic.

But if the heart of the judge is not Islamic, no matter how good the law is.

If it is Quran sitting on his desk; it wouldn't do anything.

If the heart of the judge is not in line with the law; it won't do anything.

Because we have in some Muslim countries; Islamic law on paper, we do!

In many Muslim countries, for example; the laws relating to the family are Islamic.

Divorce and marriage, and their children rights, and all that and women, the divorced and the widow, most of that is Islamic.

But the problem is with the heart of the judge.

Bribery and all those other problems.

When we talk about Shariah(شريعة); unfortunately, this is another problem that we have.

Now, we all say we want Shariah(شريعة)! We want Shariah(شريعة)!

But then, when we look at it; we find that what the people are looking for; isn't really Shariah(شريعة).

I mean; you find many people say, ask them; What is your definition of Shariah(شريعة)?

Why are you asking for Shariah(شريعة)?

He says; We want them to cut the hand of the one who steals, and to kill the killer, and to stone the adulterer.

Is that Shariah(شريعة)?

Is that all, what Shariah(شريعة) is about?

And then they would say; This certain country or that place is applying Shariah(شريعة), why?

Because they would cut the hand of the one who steals, and they would kill the killer.

This is only part of a section of the Islamic law; which is the criminal code, the criminal law; that's it.

I mean; do you think that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has sent all of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), and all of the religions; just to cut the hand of the one who steals, and to stone the adulterer, and to kill the killer?

And then also what segment of the society do these people make; the thieves, and the killers, and the rapists, and the adulterers?

What proportion do they make?

It's a minority of the society.

So all what Islam does is; deal with these people, and the rest of us; we don't have any law to apply to us?

Is that the Islamic law?

Is that Shariah(شريعة)?

That's not Shariah(شريعة); that is only part of the Islamic law which is relating to the criminal code, or the criminal section of law.

The Islamic Shariah(شريعة); that we are searching for is; based on one important pillar and that is; justice!

Justice for everyone!

If you're going to court; you will get a fair trial; the judge will treat you justly; preserving the rights of others.

Justice is an important pillar.

And then the Shariah(شريعة)!

The Shariah(شريعة); is to apply the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى completely.

Now let's look at the four Khulafa(خُلَفَاء); which are our standard that we look at.

Take Abu Bakr(ابوبكر); the first Khalifah(خليفه).

During all the time of Abu Bakr(ابوبكر); we don't know in history, that he has stoned any adulterer.

Does it mean that, Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق) was not applying Shariah(شريعة)?

This case never showed up in his time.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) was busy with applying Shariah(شريعة) day and night.

What was he doing?

The establishment of Islam, by fighting the Murtaddeen(مرتدين), and establishing a strong Islamic government.

That was applying the Shariah(شريعة).

So he was dealing with this project, and that is Shariah(شريعة).

And then, in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب); he came and found stability, that was left behind from Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق).

The Islamic Khilafah(خِلَافَه) was already stable; Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) did not have to do anything.

It was stabilized by Abu Bakr As-Siddique(أبوبكرالصديق).

Now, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) has to establish the institutions.

Because you already have stability; now you are establishing institutions.

So he made Ad-Deewan(الديوان), which is the Treasury; to take care of the salaries of the government employees and the army.

And then he establish new ways and laws to divide the land among Muslims.

And then he started; paving the roads and making these infrastructure services for the Muslim ummah(امة).

And then, he worked on a some other projects which were dealing with the very, very important rule of the Khalifah(خليفه), and that is the issue of Jihad(جهاد).

And he is the one, who took care of the Jihad(جهاد) with the Persian Empire.

By the time, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) died; Persian Empire was dead; It was over with.

Because the Persian Empire was the stumbling block; between Islam and the east.

The Persian Empire was that wall, that was preventing Islam from getting into the east.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) eliminated that wall.

So by the time of Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان); Islam was spreading all over Central Asia.

And then, Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان); what was his Shariah(شريعة)?

What was the establishing of Shariah(شريعة) in the time of Uthman(عثمان)?

He worked on a very important project, and that is; the preservation of Qur'an.

That is Shariah(شريعة).

And also spreading towards the east and continuing with the Futuhat(فتوحات) towards the north.

And then, the time of Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب); he had to deal with internal conflicts; which were in the Muslim Ummah(امۃ).

So, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) devoted his time of Khalifah(خليفه), which was four years; to solve this internal conflict, that was caused by the death of Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) by the assassination of Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان).

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) had to deal with that problem for four years.

And then, in the time of Muawiya Ibn Abu-Sufyan(معاويه ابن ابو سفيان); he came to deal with other problems.

So, he is the first one to establish the Islamic Navy.

Because, now the Muslims need to go in the sea, and they need to spread towards the north and the Roman Empire.

So he is the first one to establish the Islamic Navy; that is Shariah(شريعة); that is the establishment of Shariah(شريعة); to work on these projects which would serve the Muslim Ummah(امة).

So, the Muslims in the time of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) or in the times of these Khulafa(خُلَفَاء); they would live with peace and security.

They would travel from the east to the west, and the Muslim ummah(امة) fearing no one, but Allah; safety and security.

They would do their business and they would not worry.

They would leave their stores open, and go to Salah(صلوة); this is the establishment of Shariah(شريعة).

And this is what, we are looking for.

It's not an issue of just establishing this issue of Shariah(شريعة), which is important obviously the criminal law.

Because you cannot have security; unless the criminals are put on check.

But Shariah(شريعة) is larger than that.

Shariah(شريعة) encompasses everything that is Islamic.

Establishment of the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And the very, very, very important thing for the leader.

Don't follow your desires.

Our problem; our problem now, with Islamic work; is that we always deal with others based on our desires.

I have a certain problem with you.

I continue with that problem, to justify it from an Islamic point of view.

So it's not Islam that is instigating my dealing with you.

It is my hatred towards you and then I'm using Islam to fulfill it.

No, we should instigate our actions based on Islam.

And then we push our desires to follow the direction of the Shariah(شريعة).

Wherever Islam goes; that is where, we push our desire.

And this is the Jihad(جهاد) of the Nafs(نفس).

You don't do things according to what you want.

You do things according to what Allah wants.

You do it Allah's way, not your way.

And that is a very difficult discipline.

And that is a very difficult and important Jihad(جهاد); the Jihad(جهاد) of your soul to fight these internal conflicts that are going in your heart;

to follow the law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and to follow what Allah wants from you, and that is the meaning of the word; Islam; to submit to Allah.

That is what it means; submission.

So you submit your will to Allah.

You follow what Allah wants from you.

We listen and we obey.
parts.urdu: صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسلیما کثیرہ
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ اَفَتَاهُ’ وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ

لم یبقی معه احد ممن عبدالعجل رمي حجر أنت مأمورةٌ وأنا مأمورٌ غزا نبيٌّ من الأنبياءِ ، فقال لقومِه : لا يتبعُني رجلٌ قد ملك بُضعَ امرأةٍ ، وهو يُريدُ أن يبنيَ بها ولم يبْنِ

ولا آخرُ قد بنَى بنيانًا ولمَّا يرفَعْ سقفَها فغزا ، فأدنَى من لقريةِ حين صلاةِ العصرِ ، أو قريبًا من ذلك ، فقال للشَّمسِ : أنت مأمورةٌ وأنا مأمورٌ ،

اللَّهمَّ احبِسْها عليَّ شيئًا ، فحُبِست عليه ، حتَّى فتح اللهُ عليه ، لا إلهَ إلاَّ اللَّه Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ مِن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ إِذْ قَالُوا لِنَبِيٍّ لَّهُمُ ابْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًا

قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَاتِلُوا ۖ وَمَا لَنَا أَلَّا نُقَاتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ أُخْرِجْنَا مِن دِيَارِنَا وَأَبْنَائِنَا ۖ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ ۗ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًا ۚ

قَالُوا أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالْمُلْكِ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ سَعَةً مِّنَ الْمَالِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاهُ عَلَيْكُمْ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَزَادَهُ بَسْطَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْجِسْمِ ۖ وَزَادَهُ بَسْطَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْجسْد وَاللَّهُ يُؤْتِي مُلْكَهُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ

وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ءَايَةَ مُلْكِهِۦٓ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلتَّابُوتُ فِيهِ سَكِينَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَبَقِيَّةٌ وَبَقِيَّةٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ ءَالُ مُوسَىٰ وَءَالُ هَٰرُونَ تَحْمِلُهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ۚ

إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ۝

فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً

لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ اقْعُدُوا مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ۝

لَوْ خَرَجُواْ فِيكُم مَّا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا فَثَبَّطَهُمْ خَبَالًا لن نغلب الیوم القلۃ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ مَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي

وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي إِلَّا مَنِ اغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةً بِيَدِهِ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُ هُوَ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ قَالُوا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا الْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ ۚ

قَالَ الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو اللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ ثلاثمائة وعشرة وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ

جَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا

وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ۝

فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ وَالطَّالُوت Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُودُ جَالُوتَ وَآتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ

وَعَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ عَلَّمَهُ مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ۗ لقد أوتيت مزمارا من مزامير آل داود Suhuf Ibrahim(صُحُف اِبْراهِيْم); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ ۖ وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ

يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ أَنِ اعْمَلْ سَابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ

وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling Dawoodعليه السلام; وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ It's Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Be grateful to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ۝

تصورٌمحراب لا تخف وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ۝

إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُواْ لَا  تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ

فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ۝

إِنَّ هَٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ۝

قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ۝

يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ

فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ۝

العدل في قلب القاضي اقامت الدين وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا

parts.english:
Musa(موسى) was very shy and that is, how the mu'min(مؤمن); the believer should be.

He was always covering up his body.

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) said; Musa(موسى) is not showing us his body because, he's suffering from some kind of disease.

And they accused him of leprosy, and they accused him of; they said that, syphilis; the expansion of the testicles.

They said; That's why, he's always covering himself up.

Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); they used to bath together.

They would go out in a river or in a pool, and they would all take their clothes, and they would just go in, and bath in front of each other.

Musa(موسى) would go alone, and would bath alone, and would not let anyone see him.

So, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wanted Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) to see that, this is not true.

So, Musa(موسى) went to bath.

So, he put his clothes on a rock; on a stone.

And then when he look back; he didn't find the stone, the stone was running away with his clothes.

So, Musa(موسى) is running after the stone, and this in Bukhari(بخاريْ); we'll read the Hadith.

So Musa(موسى) is running after the stone, and he's saying; Bring me my clothes back, stone! Bring me my clothes back!

And he's running after the stone.

And the stone took him around Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) so, they could take a look at Musa(موسى); without any clothes.

They saw the best creation of Allah.

And then, when the issue was done, the stone stopped, by the order of Allah.

So Musa(موسى) had a stick which he would carry with him always, and he started beating the rock; beating the stone.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And he left on it marks, that could be seen.

He hit it so hard that it left behind marks.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Oh you, who Believe! Be not; like those who annoyed Musa(موسى), but Allah cleared him of that which they alleged, and he was honorable before Allah.

Syedina Musaعليه السلام was with the children of Israel(اسرائيل) in the wilderness.

They got lost in the desert.

And Syedina Musaعليه السلام had to spend his life and his efforts dealing with his people.

And Musa(موسى) wanted good for them.

Nevertheless, they were causing him difficulties, and they were being stubborn and difficult to deal with.

So Musaعليه السلام told his people; Oh my people! Why do you harm me?

When you know that, I am a messenger sent by Allah to you; why do you harm me?

But Musa(موسى) had to endure all of this difficulty with his people.

And then, his brother; Haroon عليه السلام; the prophet of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; the right hand of Musa(موسى); his advisor; wazeer(وزير); his supporter; his helper throughout this period;

His brother Haroon عليه السلام passed away.

Now, Musaعليه السلام is alone to deal with his nation.

With this huge nation of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); Musa(موسى) was alone.

He lost his close associates, and brother, and advisor; Haroon عليه السلام.

And then Musa(موسى) received a visit from the Angel of Death in the form of a man, and this Hadith(حديث) is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

The Angel of Death presented himself to Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى); in the form of a human being; a man.

And he came, and he told Musaعليه السلام; Are you ready to die?

Because we know that, the Angel of Death takes our lives without announcement.

But he does not take the life of a Nabi(نَبِي) until, they take permission, and they let them know.

The Angel of Death told Musa(موسى); Are you ready to die?

Musaعليه السلام slapped the angel of death in his face, and he knocked his eye out.

He slapped him in his face, and he knocked his eye out.

So, the Angel of Death went to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and said; Oh Allah! You have sent me to a man who doesn't wanna die.

And then the Angel of Death says in another Hadith(حديث); this is not in Bukhari(بخاريْ), I think this Hadith(حديث) was narrated by Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

He says; And if it is not because, I know that Musa(موسى) is love to you, I would have made his death difficult.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told the Angel of Death; Go back to Musa(موسی) and tell him to put his hand on the back of an ox and tell him that, every hair that is under his hand; I will give him one year in his life; for every hair under his hand.

The Angel of Death went to Musa(موسى) and said; Oh Musa(موسى)! Allah is telling you put your hand on the back of an ox, and Allah will give you for every hair under your hand; one year to live.

Musa(موسى) by now had chance to think about it.

So, he asked the Angel of Death and then what, and then What will happen?

Then the Angel of Death said; Then you will die.

Musa(موسى) said; Then let me die now.

If in the end; I'm gonna die; let me die now.

We don't know exactly, why Musa(موسى) rejected the angel of death in the beginning?

But Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says; Maybe it was because Musa(موسى) had a desire in his heart that wasn't fulfilled yet.

And Musa(موسى) wanted that desire; wanted that hope and aspiration to be fulfilled.

And that desire, is a desire that Musa(موسى) has been living for, and awaiting for a long time in his life.

And that is the promise of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to enter into the Holy Land; Jerusalem.

So Musa(موسى) wanted to have the honour of leading his people into the Holy Land and establishing the Islamic nation.

He wanted to have the honour of leading his people into Jerusalem.

But this was the will of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and when Musa(موسى) realized that it wasn't ordained for him.

He said; Then, let me die.

But he said; I have a request.

He told the Angel of death; I have one request.

And that is, that you take me as close as you can, to Jerusalem; take me as close as you can, distance of throwing a stone, and let me die over there.

If I'm not able to enter into Jerusalem alive, at least take me as close as possible to Jerusalem so that, I can die next to it.

I can die next to the walls of Jerusalem.

So Musaعليه السلام was living with the hope that one day, he will enter into the Holy Land.

And the only reason; why he didn't, is because of who?

They were on the Gates of Jerusalem, they were on the gates.

Musa(موسى) told them; Let's go and fight.

They said; Go and fight with your Lord, we're gonna stay right here.

Then two men; Two men; who fear Allahسُبحانه وتعالى whom, Allah has bestowed his blessing; they came to Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) and they told them;

Just walk through the gates and if you do so, you will win, and they refused.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not give Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل), the honour of entering into Jerusalem because they don't deserve it; they're not ready yet.

And because of that, Musa(موسى) was not able to enter into Jerusalem neither was his brother Haroon(هارون).

And Musaعليه السلام died in Al-Tih(تیح); died in the wilderness.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ has seen the grave of Musa(موسى) and Rasool Ullah says, in the Hadith(حديث) of Al-Isra(اَلْاِسْرى); Rasool Allah ﷺ says that; Indeed, in Al-Isra(اَلْاِسْرى), when Rasool Allah ﷺ travelled to Jerusalem;

he passed next to the grave of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى), and he saw him praying in his grave to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We'll move on to a story; an interesting story; an amazing story, that occurred with Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

And the reason why I delayed it until now, is because we don't know exactly where the story fits, in terms of the chronological order of events.

And this is the story of Musa(موسى) and Al-Khadr(الخضر).

It is a story of Ajaa'ib(عجائب) of astonishing events from the beginning till the end.

And the way this event happened, is that, Musa(موسى) stood one day on the minbar(منبر); on the pulpit, and was speaking to Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

So, one of the men of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); the children of Israel(اسرائيل) stood up and said; Oh Musa(موسى)! Who is the most knowledgeable man, who's the most knowledgeable person?

So Musa(موسى) said; I am.

Because, he was the Prophet of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; he was the Nabi(نَبِي); he is the one who's receiving revelation from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

According to his knowledge, he is the most knowledgeable person.

Because, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; On the Day of Judgment everybody will go through As-Sa'aq(صائق), that is the shock.

Everyone will go through that shock, and everyone will be unconscious and dead.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ says; And I will be the first one to rise up, but I will find out that Musa(موسى) is already grabbing the throne of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And I don't know whether, he was excluded from the shock or whether, he did not go through the shock because, he has already went through it when he asked to see Allah.

You remember, when we talked about Musa(موسى) asking to see Allah; He went through a shock and he fell unconscious.

So Muhammadﷺ said; Maybe Allah did not put him through the shock on the day of judgment because he has already been through a Shock in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا); that's enough.

Once is enough.

So, Musaعليه السلام will be excluded from that shock on the Day of Judgment.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ once was distributing Al-Ghanaam(الغنام); the spoils of war; he was giving out.

So one man came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; He said; The way you're dividing this wealth, you're not doing it for the sake of Allah.

A man comes to Rasool Allah ﷺ and tells him; You are not doing it, for the sake of Allah.

Imagine this! You're speaking to the Messenger of Allah, whom Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to chose, and you accuse him of being unfair and unjust.

Obviously, Rasool Ullah was upset.

And the Sahabah(صحابه) said; We could see anger on his face.

But then Rasool Allah ﷺ said; May Allah have mercy on Musa(موسى)! He was harmed more than this, and he was patient.

Musa(موسى) went through a lot.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says, about Musa(موسى); Oh my people! Why do you harm me, when you know that I'm the Messenger of Allah to you.

So he went through a lot of harm.

Nevertheless, he was patient, and Rasool Allah ﷺ said; May Allah have mercy on him! He went through more than this, and he was patient.

Another one of the Fadha'il(فضائل) of Musaعليه السلام; Rasool Allah ﷺ mentioned one fadhilah(فضيله) for Musa(موسى) in Al-Asra(الاسراء) and one in Al-Mairaj(المعراج).

When Rasool Allah ﷺ went to Al-Asra(الاسراء); Al-Asra(الاسراء) is a trip from Makkah(مكه) to Jerusalem, and Mairaj(معراج) is from Jerusalem to meet with Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was going in Al-Asra(الاسراء) from Makkah(مكه) to Jerusalem; Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I passed next to the grave of Musa(موسى), and I saw him praying in his grave.

And then, when Rasool Allah ﷺ went in Al-Mairaj(المعراج); Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I met with Musa(موسى) in; As-Sama as-Sadisah(السماء السادسة); in the sixth heaven.

Nobody was higher than Musa(موسى) except, Sayidina Ibrahimعليه السلام, in the seventh heaven.

Musa(موسى) was the highest in the sixth heaven.

That is one of the Faza'il(فضائل) of Syedina Musaعليه السلام.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The umam(امم); the nations of the world were presented to me.

I saw some prophets, they had a small group.

Some of the prophets had a man or two, following them on the Day of Judgment.

Imagine a Nabi(نَبِي) comes with one or two men with him, that's it.

All of his life; he was making Da'wah(دعوة), and the result was one or two men, that's it.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And I saw some of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) and no one was with them.

There were some Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); they have no followers whatsoever.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; And then I saw a huge nation.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I desired; I wished that this would be my ummah(امة).

Rasool Ullah asked the two angels who are with him, Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) and Mikail(ميكائيل).

This is a dream, which Rasool Allah ﷺ was seeing.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) came and took his right hand; Mikail(ميكائل) his left hand and they took him in this trip.

So, Rasool Ullah said; Is this my ummah(امة)?

Rasool Ullah wanted this to be his ummah(امة); because this was huge.

They said; No!

These are Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

These are the ummah(امة) of Musa(موسى); Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

But look to the right side!

I look to the right side, and I saw a nation that is filling the horizon.

And then, they told me; Look to the other side!

So, I looked in the other side, and I saw a nation that is filling the horizon.

They said this is your ummah(امة), and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will include with them 70,000 of your ummah(امة) will enter into Jannah(جنة) without going through Hisaab(حساب);

without going through the regular accounting of everyone else.

70,000 of this ummah(امة) will enter into paradise without going through the accountability stage that everyone else has to go through.

This is a Karamah(كرامه) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to this ummah(امة).

But we also learned from the Hadith(حديث) that, the second largest nation is the nation of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

Another Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ); Rasool Allah ﷺ when he went to Hajj(حَجْ); he passed through a valley, he asked; what is the name of this valley?

The name of this valley is the Azraq(ازرق) valley.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Rasool Allah ﷺ says; As if I can see Musa(موسى) coming down from this hill, making Hajj(حَجْ) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and making Talbiyah(تلبيه).

So, Musaعليه السلام made Hajj(حَجْ); He made Hajj(حَجْ) to the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Yunus Ibn matta(يونس ابن مطّه) made Hajj(حَجْ), and another Ahadith(احاديث); we have narrations of other Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) making Hajj(حَجْ) like, Hud(هود) and Saleh(صالح).

So the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they made Hajj(حَجْ) to the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and Allah was making Muhammadﷺ see them, as if it was in front of his eyes.

He saw Musa(موسى), when he was coming down that hill, and he saw Yunus ibn Matta(يونس ابن مطّه) coming down that hill, wearing wool clothes, over a red camel.

These are some of the Fadha'il(فضائل) of Musaعليه السلام.
parts.urdu: واجدو موسی باتشا بقائمۃ العرش فلا ادری فصعق فافاق قبلی ام جوزی بصعق الطور رواہ البخاری و مسلم صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسلیما کثیرا
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ ثوبي يا حجر، ثوبي يا حجر فَرَأَوْهُ أَحْسَنَ ما خَلَقَ اللَّهُ

وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ يا ربِّ أرسَلْتَني إلى عبدٍ لا يُريدُ الموتَ

ولولا كرامتُه عليك لشققتُ عليه فالآنَ اَذِن Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

فَاذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ۝

أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا اُدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَالِبُونَ ۚ فلمَّا جاءَهُ صَكَّهُ ففقأَ فرجعَ إلى ربِّهِ فقالَ أرسَلتني إلى عبدٍ لا يريدُ الموتَ

فردَّ اللَّهُ إليْهِ عينَهُ قالَ ارجِع فقل لَهُ يضعُ يدَهُ على متنِ ثورٍ فلَهُ بِكلِّ ما غطَّت يدُهُ بِكلِّ شعرةٍ سنةٌ قالَ أي ربِّ ثمَّ مَه قالَ الموتُ

قالَ فالآنَ فسألَ اللَّهَ أن يدنيَهُ منَ الأرضِ المقدَّسةِ رميةً بحجرٍ قالَ رسولُ اللَّهِ صلَّى اللَّهُ عليْهِ وسلَّمَ فلو كنتُ ثَمَّ لأريتُكم قبرَهُ إلى جانبِ الطَّريقِ تحتَ الْكثيبِ الأحمرِ

مررتُ بموسَى فاذا هو قائمٌ يُصلِّي في قبرِه وَإِذْ قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا۝

السربة Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًا۝

قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ

قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا۝

أَنَّى بأرضِكَ السَّلامُ Musaعليه السلام told Al-Khadr(الخضر); أَتَّبِعُكَ وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًا۝

قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِي عَن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا۝

فحملوهما بغير نَوْلٍ Musaعليه السلام said; فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًا۝

قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا۝

وَكانَتِ الأُولَى مِن مُوسَى نِسْيانًا قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًا۝

فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُّكْرًا۝

قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا۝

قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا۝

فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا۝

قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا۝

أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا۝

يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا

يابنئى انى لاستكثر من الاعمال الصالحة حتى يحفظك الله احفظ الله يحفظك وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ

وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ۚ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مُوسَى ، لَوَكَانَ صَبَرَ يُقَصَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ أَمْرِهِمَا وَكَانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا۝

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا۝

مُخْلَصًا لا تفضلوني على موسى فإن الناس يصعقون يوم القيامة، فأكون أول من يفيق، لا تفضلونا على موسى وَخَرَّصَعِقًا إن هذهِ لقسمةٌ ما يُرادُ بها وجهُ اللهِ

رَحِمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى قدْ أُوذِيَ بأَكْثَرَ مِن هذا فَصَبَرَ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ

عُرِضَتْ عليَّ الأُممُ ، فرأيتُ النبيَّ ومَعهُ الرَّهْطُ ، والنبيَّ ومعهُ الرجُلَ والرَّجُلانِ ، والنبيَّ وليسَ مَعهُ أحَدٌ ، ثم عرض لِي سَوادٌ عظيمٌ ،

أُمَّتي هذِه هذِه اُمَّتِ مُوسى فَإِذَا بِسَوَادٌ عَظِيم يَمْلَأُ الأُفُقَ قالو هذا وادي الازرق كأني أنظر إلى موسى وهو هابطاً من الثنية، وله جؤار إلى الله عزوجل بالتلبية

parts.english:
Musa(موسى) was told by Allah, that your people have worship the calf.

Musa(موسى) went back to his people; angry and upset, and sorry.

He is so sad.

How could this happen in my absence; my people commit Shirk(شرك), and they worship another god besides Allah?

So angry and upset.

So he went there to meet his people.

What did Musa(موسى) do, as soon as he saw his people worshipping the calf?

He threw the tablets.

Allah has given to Musa(موسى); Al-Alwah(الالواح); the tablets; that had the Huda(هدى) of Allah in them; he had the Awamir(اوامر); the commandments of Allah.

When Musa(موسى) saw, Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) making Sujood(سجود) to the calf; he threw the tablets from his hand.

What would you do if you see somebody throwing the Qur'an?

Something that, it's unacceptable!

But Musa(موسى); when he saw this in front of his eyes, he was in a state of shock.

So those tablets fell from his hand.

Musa(موسى) already knew about it, didn't he?

He already knew about it, because Allah told him.

How come his reaction was different, when he saw it?

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; When you hear something, it's not like seeing it.

Hearing about something is different than seeing it.

When you see something, it's a completely different thing then; when you hear about it.

Musa(موسى) heard about it from Allah, but when he saw it; it was something different and, he was in the state of shock; he threw the tablets from his hand.

And he said; Oh my people! Did not your Lord promise you a fair promise.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has promised you with victory; Allah has promised you with the Holy Land; Allah has promised you with Jannah(جنة); Allah has promised you with Tamkeen(تَمْكِين); establishment on the earth, if you are believers.

How could you leave all of these promises and commit Shirk(شرك)?

Did then the promise seem too long in coming?

Do you feel that it's too long in coming, so you gave up?

Or did you desire that wrath should descend from your Lord on you, that you broke your promise to Me.

You have broken your promise to Me.

They said; They said; We did not break the promise of our own will.

It is not our own will.

They refuse to admit their guilt.

They said; We broke not the promise to you of our own will.

But we were made to carry the weight of the ornaments of the people of Firaun(فرعون); then we cast them into the fire and that was, what As-Samiri(السَّامِرِيُّ) suggested.

Then he took out of the fire for them; a statue of a calf, which seemed too low.

Let's analyze; what Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) said?

Musa(موسى) told them; You're broke your promise with me.

They said; No! We did not break our promise with our own will, but we were carrying with us ornaments and this is the suggestion of As-Samiri(السَّامِرِيُّ).

There are two problems with this; Number one; they had guilt in their hearts because of this gold.

First of all, this gold is Halal(حلال) for them now, because the people of Firaun(فرعون) are the enemies of Allah, and Allah destroy them.

And that Ghanaam(غَنَام) should go to them.

So the gold; they should take it.

They had guilt for carrying that gold with them, but they did not feel any guilt committing Shirk(شرك) against Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So the scale of Taqwa(تقوى) is upside down.

Taqwa(تقوى) is very small things but no Taqwa(تقوى) in the major issues.

So Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) are feeling the guilt of carrying with them, the gold that belongs to the people of Egypt; and they have no guilt whatsoever, when they are worshipping a calf besides Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Did they not see that, it could not return them a word and that, it had no power either to harm them or to do them any good?

And Haroon عليه السلام; he advise them; And Haroon(هارون) indeed, had said to them beforehand; Oh my people! You are being tried in this, and verily your Lord is Allah the Most Gracious, so follow me and obey my order.

Did they not see, that it could not return them a word, and that it had no power either to harm them or to do them good?

Sayidina Haroon عليه السلام was appointed to be the leader over Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) in the absence of Musa(موسى).

And Haroon(هارون) indeed, had said to his people beforehand; Oh my people! You are being tried in this.

This is a Fitnah(فِتْنَه); it's a test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.
