Look at this a blunt lie.

He said; this is a conspiracy.

You were conspiring with Musa(موسى) before you came here.

In Surat-u-Shu'ara(سورةالشعراء); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says that, when the magicians came and had their first meeting with Firaun(فرعون).

The magicians were gathered from all over Egypt.

When they were brought to Egypt and they had their first meeting with Firaun(فرعون), what did they say?

What is the first thing the magician's told Firaun(فرعون), when they met with him?

In the first meeting with Firaun(فرعون), they said; Are you going to reward us, if we win?

So, they were in it for the money.

That is why, they came; they want the reward.

What did Firaun(فرعون) say?

Yes, and you will also be close to me.

So Firaun(فرعون), not only is going to give them wealth but he's going to give them power and position.

They came for small worldly gain.

And when they went into the field, it is said; Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says that, these magicians stood up and they threw their sticks and their ropes and they were chanting;

In the name of Firaun(فرعون); We are going to win.

In the name of Firaun(فرعون); We're going to win.

And they were chanting these words.

These magicians now became believers.

And Firaun(فرعون) told them; I will kill you and I will crucify you.

He will kill them in a cruel way.

He's going to chop out; their arms and their legs and he's going to crucify them on palm trees.

What was the response of the magicians now?

They said; We prefer you not over the clear signs that have came to us and to him, Allah who created us.

So decree whatever you desire to decree, for you can only decree regarding the life of this world.

Verily, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our faults and the magic to which you have compelled us to do.

And Allah is better as regards reward in comparison to yours.

The reward of Allah is better than yours.

Look at, what Eeman(ايمان) does.

The same people who came and were asking for money, are now saying; We are not only willing to give our wealth; We're willing to give our life for the sake of Allah because the reward of a Allah is better.

That is what Eeman(ايمان) does.

And if our Eeman(ايمان) is not carrying us to that level than that means, our Eeman(ايمان) is very weak.

Because  with the magicians; their Eeman(ايمان) transformed them from people who came to beg from Firaun(فرعون); to people who are willing to give their lives in the sake of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

That is Eeman(ايمان).

If our Eeman(ايمان) is not transforming us in that way, then we have a problem with our Eeman(ايمان).

If we're not willing to give in the sake of Allah and to provide and to sacrifice, what Eeman(ايمان) do we have?

Because the Deen(دِيْن) is; It's to sacrifice.

And they died on Eeman(ايمان) and they were Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء).

They died in the sake of Allah.

These magicians, who were committing one of the major crimes and sins; magic, Eeman(ايمان) transformed them.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى accepts the Tawbah(توبة) of anyone and then they became Shuhadaa(شُهَدآء) in the end.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَغَرَّب عَنِ الأَوطانِ في طَلَبِ العُلا وَسافِر فَفي الأَسفارِ خَمسُ فَوائِدِ

تَفَرُّجُ هَمٍّ وَاِكتِسابُ مَعيشَةٍ وَعِلمٌ وَآدابٌ وَصُحبَةُ ماجِدِ راعي الغنم ما من نبي الا ورعى الغنم خُلِقَ الْإِنْسَانُ ضَعِيفًا۝

أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَى۝

وَمَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرِي اذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِ آنَسَ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا۝

لَعَلِّيْ أَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى۝

لَّعَلِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى۝

لَّعَلِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ مِن شَٰطِئِ ٱلْوَادِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ فِى ٱلْبُقْعَةِ ٱلْمُبَٰرَكَةِ مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ أَن يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; اِنِّیْۤ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَیْكَۚ-اِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى۝

اِنَّنِیْۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى); اِنَّنِیْۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِیْۙ-وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكْرِیْ۝

إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا تَسْعَى۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told him; إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ۝

السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَى۝

So, Musa(موسى) told Allahسُبحانه وتعالى قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَى غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَآرِبُ أُخْرَى۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى); أَلْقِهَا يَا مُوسَى۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ For Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; it is Kun-Fayakun(كُنْ فَيَكُونُ).

رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ فَوَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ فَوَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى);

يَا مُوسَىٰ أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ۝

وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لنريك من اياتنا الكبرى۝

اِذْهَبْ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِذْهَبْ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰى۝

قَوْلًا ثَقِيلً Allahسُبحانه وتعالى يَجْتَبِي So, he told Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي۝

قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي۝

وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي۝

وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي۝

وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي۝

من امن الناس على أخى؟

وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِي۝

هَارُونَ أَخِى۝

اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي۝

إنما يأكل الذئب الغنم القاصية اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي۝

كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا۝

وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا۝

إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ۝

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ۝

قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ۝

وَأَخِى هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ۝

قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَٰنًا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا ۚ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ۝

اذْهَبَا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَى۝

فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَيِّنًا لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَى۝

قَوْلًا لَيِّنًا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَى۝

إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ۝

بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا قَالَا رَبَّنَاۤ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن یَفۡرُطَ عَلَیۡنَاۤ أَوۡ أَن یَطۡغَىٰ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ۝

وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ۝

وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ۝

He Musa عليه السلام said; قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ۝

فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ۝

قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ۝

قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ۝

قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ۝

قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ۝

قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ۝

قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ۝

فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ۝

وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ۝

قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ۝

قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ۝

لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى۝

فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى۝

قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى۝

فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ۝

قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ

قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ۝

قَالُوٓاْ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ۝

فَأَجْمِعُواْ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُواْ صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ۝

قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ۝

قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُواْ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ۝

قَالَ أَلْقُواْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْاْ سَحَرُوٓاْ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُو بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍۢ۝

وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُو بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍۢ۝

سَحَرُوٓاْ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا۝

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ فَوَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ۝

قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ۝

وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ۝

وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ

فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ۝

قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَّكَرْتُمُوهُ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُواْ مِنْهَآ أَهْلَهَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ۝

اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ۝

بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ۝

قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ۝

إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ۝

تضحية صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْتسليما كثيرا

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets Part 2; The next story; is the longest story of a Nabi(نَبِي) in Qur'an.

It is the story of Al-Kaleem(ألكليم) Musa عليه الصلواة والسّلام.

Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى) was mentioned in more than 30 positions or Su'ar(سورة) in Qur'an and he was mentioned 124 times.

One of the scholars said; Qur'an was almost going to become the story of Musa(موسى).

The story of Musa(موسى) was mentioned so many times in Qur'an that this scholar said; Qur'an was almost going to be the story of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى); A Hundred and 24 times

There's no other Nabi(نَبِي) in Qur'an; who's mentioned more than Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

And there is no story that takes a longer space and span of Qur'an discussed in elaborate details, in many positions of Qur'an, like the story of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

Why?

Is it because he's one of the greatest Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); he's one of Uulul Azam(أولو العزم); the five strongest prophets; which are Muhammadﷺ, Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), Musa(موسى), Eesa(عيسى) and Nuh(نوح), these are the five.

Is it because of that?

Well, Ibrahim عليه السّلام is also one of Uulul Azam(أولو العزم); Infact Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says that the opinion of the scholars is; that the best Nabi(نَبِي) after Muhammadﷺ is Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم)

but the story of Ibrahim عليه السّلام is not mentioned as frequently, it comes nowhere close to the details of the story of Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى).

So how come this story was mentioned in so much details in Qur'an?

There's a few reasonsl; Let's go through them.

Number one; The Ummah(امة) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) are the last Muslim Ummah(امة), before the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

You know that there are many Muslim nations throughout history.

The Ummah(امة) of Nuh(نوح), the Ummah(امة)  of Adam(آدَم), the Ummah(امة) of Hud(هود), the Ummah(امة) of Saleh(صالح) the last Ummah(امة) is the Ummah(امة) of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

So they are the closest in proximity to the Ummah(امة)  of Muhammadﷺ.

And since this Ummah(امة) of  Muhammadﷺ, are the inheritors of all of the former and previous messages; it is important for us to know the Ummah(امة) that was right before us; the ones who are proceeding us.

Number two; The history of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) is extremely rich with experiences.

It is an Ummah(امة) that lived for a long time lasted for a while, they went through a lot.

They committed a lot of mistakes.

There was a lot of misguidance there was a lot of conflicts.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wanted us to have all of this experience in front of our eyes; so that we could use it in our, Da'wah(دعوة) in our long history as the Muslim Ummah(امة).

The Ummah(امة) of Musa(موسى) went through experiences; Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل), they went through experiences and they committed mistakes.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى knew that Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ would fall in the same particular mistakes that Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) fell into, and that's why it's important for us to have a history to look back to.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ said; You would follow the footsteps of the nations before you; Step by step, inch by inch, foot by foot, even if they are going to enter into a hole of a lizard, you would follow them and do it.

The Sahabah(صحابه) said; Are you talking about the Jews and Christians.?

Rasool Ullah said; Who else.

We are going to follow the tracks.

We're going to follow their tracks, we're going to do the same thing as they did.

We're going to commit the same mistakes.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given us this wealth of information and experience so that it could be light for us; the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

Number three; The nature of the conflict of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) is similar to the nature of the conflict of the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ.

With the people of Hud(هود); How were they destroyed?

Violent wind.

The people of Saleh(صالح); How were they destroyed?

By the Sieha(صيحا).

The people of Lut(لوط); How were they destroyed?

By the shaking of the earth and lifting them up and throwing them down.

So did, Hud عليه السّلام and his followers fight in Jihad(جهاد) against their people?

No.

Did Saleh(صالح) fight in Jihad(جهاد) against his people actual war?

No.

What about with Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل)?

Did they fight against their enemies?

Yes.

And that's why; one of the scholar said; Since the Torah(توراة) was revealed, it was Jihad(جهاد).

It wasn't special punishments coming from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى but it was punishing the enemy through the hands of the believers instead of Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), destroying them or a violent wind.

Now since the Torah(توراة) was revealed; It is Allahسُبحانه وتعالى destroying the enemy with the hands of the believers.

And that is Al-Qital Fee Sabil Lillah(القتال فى سبيل الله) and that is why the nature of the conflict between the Ummah(امة) of Musa(موسى) and their enemies is similar to the nature of the conflict between the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ and his enemies.

With the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ, we didn't have a violent wind destroying them or earthquake even though sometimes Allah would send these miracles but overall, it is through the hands of the believers, the enemy is destroyed.

So there is a similarity in the nature of the conflict.

Number four; There are two halves of the story of Musa(موسى); one half is Musa(موسى) and Firaon(فرعون) and the other half is Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

There are two parts; Both of these are very, very important for us to know.

The part of the conflict between Musa(موسى) and Firaon(فرعون) is very, very important to us because Firaon(فرعون) is the symbol of tyranny, dictatorship and oppression.

And Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله) we find that, that is the problem that the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ is suffering through.

We have suffered from oppression and tyranny and dictatorship for a very, very long time.

And that's why it is very helpful for us to know the story of Firaon(فرعون).

Because that is something that this Ummah(امة) has suffered from; for a long time; for centuries; we have suffered oppression and the symbol of oppression and Qur'an is Firaon(فرعون).

So, how can we deal with that oppression?

It is the way that Musa(موسى) have dealt with it.

We learn a lot of experiences from that.

And also Firaon(فرعون) is a king, power through kingdom.

And that is, how Islam is being fought against.

It is through the governments and powers of the throne.

And Dajjal(دجال) is only an extension of that.

Dajjal(دجال) is a king on a throne who will rule over the world.

So that is why the story of Firaon(فرعون) would have a lot of similarities between it and the story of Al-Dajjal(الدجال) .

And then we have the other half of the story of Musa(موسى) is; Musa(موسى) dealing with his people.

How Musa(موسى) dealt with the Muslim Ummah(امة) of this time; Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).?

When you see the faults and the problems of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) even though they were the Ummah(امة) of Tawheed(تؤحيد), the Ummah(امة) of oneness of Allah.

And you see the faults that we are falling into and getting into.

You see how important it is to know the story of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

In Qur'an su'ar Al-Maida(مائدة); there are Ayaat(آيات), where Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; The ones who did not rule according to the book of Allah are the unbelievers;

In other places, it says the corrupt and in other places says the oppressors.

Hudhaifa-bin-Al-Yaman(حديفه بن اليمان) heard some of the tabaein(تابعين) speaking about this and they said; These Ayaat(آيات) were revealed speaking about Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

He said; Allahu Akbar(الله اكبر), what better cousins to you are the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

Whenever there is something bad in Qur'an; You say; it's speaking about them, and wherever there's something good in Quran; You say; it's speaking about you.

He wants to teach them a lesson that these Ayaat(آيات) even though they are speaking about Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل), but whoever is similar to that; from this Ummah(امة) would receive the same punishment.

That is why Allah mentioned it in Qur'an.

If you do not rule over the book of Allah, whether you are from Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) or from any other nation, that is considered to be kufr(كفر) and it's considered to be dhulm(ظلم) and it's considered to be to fisq(فسق).

Finally, the last reason that I have listed and there are many others.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has talked a lot about Al-Yahood(اليهود).

Because it was in the knowledge of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, who knows everything (Al-Aleem العليم), that this band of people would be the enemies of the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى from day one, until the Day of Judgment.

Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله); the Jews are a very small nation and they have been a very small nation for a very long time.

For centuries, the numbers of the Jews is very limited.

Why didn't Allahسُبحانه وتعالى talk about the Hindus or the Buddhist or the Confucius, even though there are much more in numbers like He has talked about Al-Yahood(ال يهود)?

Numbers is not the issue; Al-Yahood(اليهود) from day one, until this day, are the ones who are leading the war and the battle against Islam.

They are the ones who are making the plans and the plots against this religion.

The Yahood(يهود) are the ones, who supported the Munafiqeen(مُنافقين) in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ and they are the ones who are supporting the Munafiqeen(مُنافقين) today.

Al-Yahood(اليهود) are the ones who planed together and brought the Ahzaab(احزاب); the Arab tribes together to fight against Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Jews are the ones who are bringing today the nations of the world against the Muslims.

The Yahood(يهود) are the ones who we're taking care of the word propaganda against Islam.

And the Jews today are the ones, who are taking the lead in the media warfare against Islam.

From day one, they have been the enemies of the religion of Muhammadﷺ, and they will continue to be the enemies until the last generation of Al-Yahood(اليهود) will be the soldiers and the supporters of the Al- Dajjal(الدجال).

And then it will be the end.

And that's why Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has talked about this nation so that we would know; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; He is knows best who your enemies are.

The story of Musa(موسى) is very long.

It's a very detailed story, these Ayaat(آيات), or a summary of the story of Musa(موسى).

We recite to you some of the news.

This is News, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is conveying to you news, of Musa(موسى) and Firaon(فرعون).

The difference between this news and other news that you hear; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says that, this news Bil-Haqq(حَقّ); in truth.

Every other piece of news that you hear can be true and can be false.

But this news Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tells you; Bil-Haqq(حَقّ), it is the true news.

And, who is this directed to?

For the believers.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says, and this Ayah(آية) is describing the political and social situation in the time of Musa(موسى).

Firaon(فرعون) exalted himself in the land.

This is the political situation in that time.

Firaon(فرعون) was the only power figure.

And he was so strong and powerful; and he had so much influence over the lives of people, that he thought that he is God.

And he said; I am your Lord.

And then he said; I don't know that you have any other God but me.

He has so much power; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given him so much power, that he could get away with this claim and nobody would protest it.

When he said, I am your Lord and I am your God.

Nobody said you're wrong.

He got away with it, because he had so much influence and power over the lives of people.

He divided the people into parties, and that is how you rule.

Farriq Tasud(فرق تسد); Divide and Conquer.

He divided the people in Egypt; into different classes, into different tribes.

That is how you dominate by class conflict and by these conflicts in society; That is how the Kings rule.

And Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were placed on the lowest level; lowest class.

And then he place these other groups from Egypt above them and over them.

So Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) were taking as slaves and servants.

He oppressed a group of them which are the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

The children of Israel(اسرائيل) have multiplied a lot.

They started by who?

By Yusuf(يوسف) and his brothers.

But by now, they were already a huge nation; It says; they were about 600,000 at the time, when Musa(موسى) left with them out of Egypt.

Anyway, Firaon(فرعون) saw a dream; it says that Firaon(فرعون) saw a dream.

In this dream, It was interpreted that there's a child who will be born among the children of Israel(اسرائيل), who will take away your kingdom.

When Firaon(فرعون) heard that interpretation, he said; it's easy, we'll take care of that.

Any child who is born kill him.

So he would kill all of the male children, and he would take the woman as slaves and servants.

So, he kills the sons and he lets the females live.

He was of those who commit great sins and crimes.

And then Allah says; And We wish to do a favor to those who are weak in the land and to make them rulers and to make them the inheritors.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى wants and Firaon(فرعون) wants, but whatever Allah wills will pass.

Allah wanted to give his favourite to the weak nation.

Allah wanted to bring that weak nation from the bottom and put them on the top.

And to establish them in the land, And We let Firaon(فرعون) and Haman(هامان) their hosts receive from them that which they feared.

Some of the Sahabah رضى الله عنهم said that, Firaon(فرعون) saw a dream.

He saw a dream where there is a light coming out from the Holy Land, Jerusalem(يروشلم) and this light or fire والله اعلم swept through Egypt and it destroyed everyone except for the Houses of the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

So he asked for the interpretation of this dream.

He was told that it means that there will be a man from the children of Israel(اسرائيل) who will take away your kingdom from you; and will destroy your army and your people.

This was the interpretation of the dream.

So, he said for Firaon(فرعون) it was easy, simple.

He gave his orders to kill every child who was born in the houses Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل).

And it says that he would send out spies, his security agents, to go and find out any woman of the children of Israel who's pregnant and they would put her under surveillance before she even gives birth.

And they would put her under surveillance and as soon as she delivers; if it's a boy, they would slaughter him.

And if it's a girl, they would let her live.

He kills the males and he allows the females live.

The mother of Musa(موسى) became pregnant, but she concealed her pregnancy.

No matter how strong the security forces and the spying agency is, they are always going to miss something.

There is some information they're going to overlook.

So, in this particular case, in the situation of the mother of Musa(موسى), they did not notice her pregnancy.

So she was able to conceal her pregnancy until she delivered and when she delivered Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى) now it's even more difficult to hide the fact.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told the mother of Musa عليه السلام.

Now this is not Wahi(وحى) of Nabuwah(نبوة).

The word Wahi(وحى) could mean either inspiration or it could mean revelation to a Nabi(نَبِي).

In this particular situation, it is inspiration; Ilham(الهام).

It is not revelation to a Nabi(نَبِي).

Because when the word Wahi(وحى) is mentioned in Qur'an doesn't necessarily have to mean, revelation of a Nabi(نَبِي) because, we have a place in Qur'an where Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in surat-ul-Nahl(سورة النحل);

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We revealed to the bees, so are the bees prophets.?

So this revelation over here means inspiration.

It's the strongest inspiration in the heart of the mother of Musa(موسى).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling her; And We inspired the mother of Musa(موسى) saying; Suckle him breastfeed him.

But when you fear for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grief.

Now, this is a strong inspiration, because no mother would throw her child in a flowing river.

And for any of you have seen the Nile River, it's a very, very powerful and strong River.

I mean, people who swim there put themselves at risk of drowning; strong swimmers.

Because it's a very violent and strong moving current.

So this is a very strong inspiration; because no mother would do this; unless, she has a very strong feeling that this is a command from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told her to breastfeed him; breastfeed him as usual.

But whenever you feel danger on him, throw him in what seems to be the biggest danger; the river.

Putting the child in the age of Musa(موسى) might be a few days old; a baby who can barely see; cannot do himself any good.

And you put him in a river in a wooden box.

That would seem to our limited minds and rational and thinking that, that is throwing him to death.

But because it's an order from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, this righteous mother was able to suppress her strong feelings of motherhood and care for the child

and to trust the child in the hands of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and to believe that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will take care of the child more than her.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in this verse is telling her; Do not fear nor grief; Don't have fear and don't have grief.

We shall bring him back to you and We will make him one of our messengers.

By the way, this Ayah(آية) it has two do's and don'ts and two pieces of good news.

In this Ayah(آية) there are two orders.

Breastfeed him; and if you have fear on him, then throw him in the river.

And, this shows you the Bulagha(بلاغه) the beauty of the Qur'an, how in one verse you could have all of these different aspects of language.

So these are two orders; Breastfeed and throw him or put him in the river.

And then there are two don'ts where it says, Don't have any fear and don't have any sorrow.

And then it has two promises in it.

We will return him unto you.

And we will make him of the messengers.

So it has two promises to the mother of Musa(موسى); we are going to bring him back to you; Don't worry and he's going to be of the messengers.

This is a very strong test from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for this righteous mother.

If you care for your child throw him in the river.

So, she breastfed Musa(موسى), she put him in a wooden casket; in a wooden box and she put him in the Nile River and she let her child go in front of her eyes.

Just to fulfill this inspiration and promise of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, where Allah is telling her; We are going to return him to you and we are going to make him of the messengers.

This mother fulfill the two promises of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى or fulfill the commandment of Allah to receive these promises.

How many promises do we have?

Nevertheless, we're not acting upon the orders of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We are told that if we're going to strive and struggle in Jihad(جهاد) in the sake of Allah, Allah is going to give us victory.

We're not doing that.

Musa(موسى) did not have any time to prepare his belongings and his luggage; He had to immediately flee out of Egypt.

And he immediately rushed out of Egypt.

There was no time to do anything, because the warrant for his arrest was already out.

So he had to leave immediately.

So he left out of Egypt to the direction of the east.

And then he was walking on his barefoot, until his skin peeled out.

And he would eat whatever he would find.

He was eating the leaves of the trees until, the surrounding his lips was a green layer; Because of the dryness and the harshness of the leaves of trees; It came out from his mouth.

Because he doesn't know; how far he needs to move to get out of Egypt.

Musa(موسى) is continuing out, he's just marching out of Egypt.

The skin of his feet is peeled out; It is not time to intervene and help anyone.

He wanted to see why these two women are not drinking?

So he walked up to them; And he said; What is the matter with you?

They said; We cannot drink until these men leave.

How can these two women go and fight with them?

Now Musa(موسى); who's exhausted and tired; can barely walk.

He went in and he fought with these men and he pushed them aside and he brought out a few buckets of water.

And then Musa(موسى) could not handle it any further, he went and he laid down under a tree; completely exhausted.

So he went down under a tree.

And he said; He said; Oh Allah, I am in need of any good that you can send down on me.

Musa(موسى) was broke, he had nothing.

So, he's telling Allahسُبحانه وتعالى anything, anything that you can give me, I need it, in this moment.

Oh Allah, whatever you're going to bestow on me; I need it.
