What does strength mean? Quwwah(قوة); Qawi(قوى); he's strong.

This is relevant to the kind of job that will be done.

If it is a physically demanding job, then the strength means strong in his physical body.

If it's an intellectual kind of job, then you need to be strong in your mind.

To summarize it; you need to be very strong in your field.

That is what is meant by Qawi(قوى); strong.

Al-Amin(الامين); Trustworthy.

It's not enough to be strong.

Because you could be strong but you're using your strengths against your organization.

You could be using it for your own benefit and harming the others.

So you have to be trustworthy too.

And that's why Abu Bakrرضى الله عنه, when he appointed Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) to be the Khalifah(خليفه); he told the Muslims, why he appointed him?

He said; The best man to appoint on you is Al-Qawwi(القوى), Al-Amin(الامين); The strong and The trustworthy.

They learn their rules from Qur'an.

Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) did not go through any political science classes or degrees.

He learned the politics of Islam from Qur'an.

So when he wanted to hire somebody or to appoint somebody to the position of Khilafah(خِلَافَه); He has a whole generation of Sahaba(صحابه) in front of his eyes; All of them are righteous.

Righteousness is common among all of the Sahabah(صحابه).

So, how can you choose among them?

He looked for these two qualities: Quwwah(قوة) and Amanah(امانه); Strength and Trustworthiness.

So, the father offered the job to Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى), but he went a little further; he took another step.

He also offered Musa(موسى) one of his daughters.

He said; I intend to wed you one of these two daughters of mine; on condition that you serve me for eight years, but if you complete 10; it would be a favor from you.

But I intend not to place you under a difficulty; If Allah will; you will find me one of the righteous.

So, he said; I will marry you one of my daughters; what is the Maher(مهر) that you will pay me?

You work for me for eight years.

And if you want to complete 10 years, that's up to you; It's not part of our agreement.

But I would suggest it; if you want to work for 10 years, that will be better.

But the bottom line is you have to work for minimum of eight.

Syedina Musa(سيدنا موسى) to make it clear, he said; Musa(موسى) wanted to be clear about this agreement.

He said, that is a settled deal between me and you, whichever of the two terms I fulfill, there will be no injustice to me, and Allah is surety over what we say.

Musa(موسى) is saying; If I work for eight years; Don't blame me; Don't commit any injustice to me.

The agreement is that, I work for eight years with you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ asked Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل); which of the two terms that Musa(موسى) fulfill?

Did he work for eight or did he work for ten?

Jibreelعليه السلام  told Muhammadﷺ ; That he worked for the best and the most complete, and that is ten years.

This is the Ihsaan(احسان) and Itqan(اتقان) perfection of your work, even though the agreement was clear that, I have to work for eight years.

But he completed it and he worked for ten.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ كاد القران ان يكون موسى لتتبعن سنن من كان قبلكم،

ومن لم يحكم بما أنزل الله فأولئك هم الكافرون۝

فأولئك هم الفاسقون۝

فأولئك هم الظالمون۝

وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَعْدَائِكُمْ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; طسم ۝

تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ ۝

نَتْلُو عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ۝

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ۝

ان فرعون على فلارض انا ربكم الاعلى وما علمتلكم من اله غيره وجعل أهلها شيعا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ

وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ۝

وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوَارِثِينَ۝

Allahعَزَّوَجَلْ says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَحْذَرُونَ۝

يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ

فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحْزَنِي ۖ إِنَّا رَادُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; أَرْضِعِيهِ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ۝

وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحْزَنِي ۖ إِنَّا رَادُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has a plan.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَالْتَقَطَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has a plan.

وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِّي وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ إِن تَنصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِّي وَلَكَ قرة عين لك وليس قرة عين لى

لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰ أَن يَنفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا ۖ فَارِغًاۖ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لَوْلَا أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ نَاصِحُونَ۝

وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا۝

وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ فَرَدَدْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ أُمِّهِ فَرَدَدْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ أُمِّهِ

كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ۝

حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ۝

عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنَّ الْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِيٌّ مُّبِينٌ۝

رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ۝

إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِير۝

فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ شعبه من شعب الايمان تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ۝

فَلَمَّا قَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

قَالَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا يَا أَبَتِ اسْتَأْجِرْهُ ۖ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَأْجَرْتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ٱبْنَتَىَّ هَٰتَيْنِ عَلَىٰٓ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأْجُرَنِى ثَمَٰنِىَ حِجَجٍۢ ۖ

فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِندِكَ ۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ ۚ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ۝

قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ ۖ أَيَّمَا الْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَانَ عَلَيَّ ۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ۝

اتمها واكملها صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تسليما كثيرا

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets; Part 1 Syedina Yaqub عليه السّلام requested his sons; to go look for Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother Binyamin(بنيامين);

Because he never lost hope in Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And the next year they went to Egypt to receive the ration.

And they carried with them their merchandise that was sent back with them from the year before.

They went to SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام and they met with him and they said; Then when they entered unto him, they said; Oh ruler of the land; A hard time has hit us and our family, difficult moments.

It was famine and it was continuing from year to year, and it's becoming more difficult throughout time; and things were becoming more constrained and more severe.

So they went to SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) and they were begging him.

Harm has befalled us with our families.

And we have came with poor capital.

Bidhaa Muzjaa(بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ) means some merchandise that is not very good quality.

Something that is not worth a lot.

So they're telling Al-Aziz(ألعزيز); Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) which is SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) and that's the name of this position.

Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) and the word Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) itself means; the honored.

And they're telling him; really we want you to help us because this merchandise that we brought with us is not worth a lot; It's not even worth presenting to you;

so they're apologizing before they even present it because they know that it's worthless.

So pay us full measure.

And then they said; And be charitable to us.

They're asking for Sadaqah(صدقة).

They're asking for charity.

When SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام saw his brothers begging; When he saw that they reached to the level of begging; Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله) look at this; These brothers who made the conspiracy to get rid of him and kill him.

So they reached to the level of weakness where they are begging their brother whom they don't know.

And they're telling him; Give us charity.

And they said; Truly Allah does reward charitable.

At that point, when Yusuf(يوسُف) saw his brothers begging, he didn't want it to go any further.

He didn't want them to go under that level.

I mean, that's it when you beg, that's the lowest it could get and the weakest.

And he did not want to see his brothers in that position.

Even though they harmed him and they caused them all of this trouble and they throw him in the well.

And they tried to kill him and he's their brother.

But I didn't want to see them in that position of beggars.

So he said; He said; Do you know; What you have done to Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother.

When you were ignorant.

Do you know what you have done to Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother.?

Who can say this except Yusuf(يوسُف) himself?

Who knows about Yusuf(يوسُف).

How Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) know about that?

So immediately when he said that they realize that they're speaking to Yusuf(يوسُف).

When he asked them, What have you done with Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother?

They knew that the man who's standing in front of them is Yusuf عليه السّلام.

They said; They said; Are you indeed Yusuf(يوسُف), I am Yusuf(يوسُف) and this is my brother.

Allah has indeed been gracious to us.

I want you to pay attention to the following segments of the Ayah(آية).

If you would forget everything that we said in the story of Yusuf(يوسُف); make sure that you don't forget this.

Because this is the essence of the story of Yusuf(يوسُف).

This is the essence of the story of Yusuf(يوسُف).

And keep in mind that this story was revealed to Rasool Allah ﷺ when?

When was Surah(سورة) Yusuf(يوسُف) revealed?

In Makkah; When in Makkah?

In the Aam Il Huzn(عام الهزن); In the Aam Il Huzn(عام الهزن); When Abu Talib(ابو طالب) passed away; and Khadijah رضي الله عنها  passed away;

and Rasool Allah ﷺ found no one to support him with strength like his Uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب); and no one to support him financially like his wife Khadijah(خديجه),

that was the year of sorrow.

It's not only sorrow and sadness on Rasool Allah ﷺ because he lost his uncle and he lost his beloved wife.

But because the Da'wah(دعوة) was limited and now barriers were being erected in the face of Rasool Allah ﷺ; before that Rasool Allah ﷺ had strength;

His uncle was providing him with an umbrella and his wife was comforting him at home.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ has lost these two supporters and the heart of Rasool Allah ﷺ was filled with sadness and sorrow.

Those moments that Rasool Allah ﷺ was going through are unbearable.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ is receiving Surat Yusuf(سورة يوسُف); In this particular situation because that is what Qur'an; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى when he said will reveal in Quran; Why?

So that We would strengthen your heart.

So Quran was being revealed on Rasool Allah ﷺ in the appropriate times; for the appropriate situations to serve the appropriate purpose.

So in that specific period of Aam Il Huzn(عام الهزن); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى reveals to Rasool Allah ﷺ the story of Yusuf(يوسُف); it is the story of someone; who went through difficulty, trials, Misery, sorrow and sadness.

But then in the end; Allah has bestowed His blessing on me.

Why?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in this segment of the Ayah(آية); The essence of the Surah(سورة) of Yusuf(يوسُف); Verily, He who has Taqwa(تقوى) and is patient, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will not waste the deeds of  Al-Muhsineen(محسنين), the right doers.

If you have Taqwa(تقوى) and patience; Eventually you will win; even after a while.

If you have Taqwa(تقوى) and patience, no matter what, in the end, you will be victorious and you should have no doubt in that.

SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) was victorious in the end; In Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and in Akhirah(آخرة).

It's not only in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا); It's In Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and in Akhirah(آخرة).

But it happened after a while it took a while.

It wasn't swiftly in the same day; It took a while.

Therefore, it needs patience.

If you do not have patience, you will not be able to survive the long road.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling Rasool Allah ﷺ; There's a lot of struggling; There's a lot of striving; But if you have patience and you have Taqwa(تقوى), Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will establish you on the land.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says about Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; We have made the children of Israel(اسرائيل), Aimma(أئمَّة); leaders,

leaders whom you follow in righteousness.

They guide to our path; When?

When were the children of Israel(اسرائيل) leaders for mankind?

When they had patience; And they had Yaqeen(يقين).

There is no victory without Sabr(صبر).

It is mentioned in a Hadith(حديث); Victory comes with patience.

And in general, today; We are very emotional.

We are fired up fast.

There could be a very hot Khutba(خطبه) of Jumu'ah(جُمعه) talking about Jihad(جهاد) for example.

During that Khutba(خطبة) everyone feels that he is like Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد).

He's ready to go in the battlefield.

The Salah(صلاة) is over; a few moments just by the time you step your foot out of the Masjid(مسجد); You leave all of that emotions behind you, and you're back to Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) again.

Very easily fired up; and very easily we cool down.

That is not Sabr(صبر); that is not Sabr(صبر).

We are reactionary.

We act to situations; But then after a while, we'll calm down, and it's back to usual.

But with Sahabah رضي الله عنهم; they had a plan.

And they implemented that plan steadily.

And they worked on it, and eventually they were victorious.

Not only does this work with the believers, this is a law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; that can even be applied to the Non-believer.

Antara Bin Shaddad(أنترة بن شداد) is a famous figure in the Arab tales.

As somebody who was very courageous, that's the personality of Antara(أنترة) in the Arabic literature.

They say that Antara Bin Shaddad(أنترة بن شداد); A very strong well built powerful man came to him and said; Antara(أنترة), how come, you are famous as being powerful and strong when your body is smaller than mine;

And your strength is less than my strength; Nevertheless, everyone uses you as the example of courage and strength.

He said; I'll tell you why.?

Stick your finger in my mouth and I'll stick my finger in your mouth and let's bite.

I'll bite your finger and you bite mine.

Both of them; they stick their fingers in each other's mouth, and they counted to three and they started biting and they're crushing on the fingers of each other.

After a few moments; the other guy screamed, and he lost.

Antara(أنترة) told him: That's why.?

If you would have just waited for one more moment, one more second, I would have screamed.

It's just a matter of outdoing you; I was able to have patience for just one more moment and that's why I won.

As I say in English; Who blinks first, Now they realize their loss and they said; By Allah; Indeed Allah has preferred you above us and we certainly have been sinners.

These brothers who were jealous of Yusuf(يوسُف), so jealous they tried to kill him.

Now they're saying you're better than us.

You are better than us; In the end they had to admit it.

See how Allah made him victorious in every aspect.

They even reach to the level where his brothers said; You are better than us; Now we admit.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ went into Makkah.

He went into Makkah victorious without any parades; without any national anthem; without any red carpet; without any motorcade; without any pride;

Rasool Allah ﷺ instead of riding on his horse or camel with his chest forward, carrying his spear.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went into Makkah, making Sujood(سجود) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى on his camel; Until his beard was touching the back of the camel;

Tawadhua(تواضع) humbleness with Sakeena(سكينة) calmness.

Until he reached to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), and he climbed on the door of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه); while the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are surrounding him.

His enemy for years and years are now under the sword of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ asked them; What Do you think I will do with you?

They said; A noble brother and the son of a noble brother.

Today I will tell you, like what Yusuf(يوسُف) told his brother; I'm gonna tell you just what Yusuf(يوسُف) told his brother; Today; there's no punishment or no blame on you.

Go; You are free.

He said; No reproach on you this day; May Allah forgive you; And He is the Most Merciful of those who showed mercy.

So he forgave his brothers, and he allowed them to leave.

But he gave them something.

And this is a miracle of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

He gave them his shirt.

And he said; Throw it on my father, and he will see; Because his father was blind.

Why was he blind, crying on SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

And this is a miracle of SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

Go with this shirt of mine and cast it over the face of my father; He will become clear sighted and bring to me all your family.

When the caravan was leaving out of Egypt; Yaqoob(يعقوب) was in Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) very far away a few hundred miles away; When the caravan just started moving out of Egypt;

Syedina(سيدنا) Yaqoob(يعقوب) smelled SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

He was smelling his shirt.

And it was still in Egypt and this is another miracle of Syedina Yaqoob عليه السّلام.

And when the caravan departed, their father said; I do indeed feel the smell of Yusuf(يوسُف); If only you think me not a dotard; A person who has weakness of mind because of old age.

They said; This is something that one of the Mufassireen(مفسرين) of Qur'an said; They have said something inappropriate to their father.

They said oh our father; By Allah certainly you are in your old error.

They told him; You had became old; You're starting to lose your mind.

Then when the bearer of the glad tidings arrived, he cast it over his face and he became clear sighted; He said; Did I not say to you I know from Allah that which you know not.

And now they realize their mistake again they said; O; our father asked for forgiveness from Allah for our sins; Indeed we have been sinners.

He said; I will ask my Lord for forgiveness for you.

Verily He only is the One, Who's oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

Now all of them moved, they took their belongings, everything with them and they started moving towards Egypt.

To fulfill the invitation of SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام.

As soon as they came in, SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) has prepared to meet his family.

Then when they entered onto Yusuf(يوسُف), he took his parents to himself and said; Enter Egypt if Allah will; in security.

And he had the throne; SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) was sitting on a high throne.

So he elevated his father and his mother to sit with him on the throne.

And then all of them the father and the mother, and the 11 brothers made Sujood(سجود) to SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام; To fulfill the dream, which he saw when he was a child.

So the end of the Surah(سورة) of Yusuf(يوسُف) fulfills the dream, which was in the beginning of the Surah(سورة) of Yusuf(يوسُف) between them; very long lifespan, the scholars have given it 30 years, some of them 25, some of them 80 years;

Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم).

This is the fulfillment of the dream of SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

I see 11 planets making Sujood(سجود) to me and the sun and the moon.

So these 11 planets were his brothers, and the sun is his father and the moon is his mother.

O my father; This is the interpretation of my dream of old, my Lord has made it come true.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; These are the words of Yusuf(يوسُف); He was indeed good to me; When He took me out of the prison, and brought me here out of the bedouin life;

After Satan has sown enmity between me and my brothers; Certainly in my Lord is the Most courteous and kind unto whom He will.

Truly He only He is the All Knowing, the All Wise.

My Lord, you have indeed bestowed on me the sovereignty, and taught me the interpretation of dreams, the only Creator of the heavens and the earth;

You are my Wali(ولي) in this world and the hereafter.

SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) had everything a seeker of this world wants.

I mean; No matter how hard we work, you can't get anything better than what Yusuf(يوسُف) had; In terms of the standards of this world.

He had power and authority.

He was combined with his parents and family again, and the dispute among them was solved.

He had wealth.

He had control over the kingdom of Egypt, which was the greatest kingdom of the time.

He had it all.

If somebody had; what Yousuf عليه السّلام had; He would hold it, with his teeth and nails.

And not want to leave it.

You remember; When Suleman Ibn Malik(سليمان إبن عبدالملك) asked Abu Hazim(أبوحازم); Why do we hate death?

What did Abu Hazim(أبوحازم) say? He said; He said; You have built this world and you have destroyed Aakhirah(آخِرة).

So you hate to go from what is built, to what is destroyed.

SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام had everything that a person would want in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

But this for SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) is nothing.

He's not a seeker of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

He would say; Alhamdulillah(ألحمدلله) for what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given me; but he's doing it as a Ibadah(عبادة) for Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So Yusuf(يوسُف) when he is in the pinnacle and the peak of his power and fame and wealth and dominance on the face of the earth; Look at the Dua(دُعَا) of SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

Look at the Dua(دُعَا), that SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) is saying; He said; SadyinaYusuf عليه السّلام said; Cause me to die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

You have Kingdom; you have power; you have fame; you have wealth; you have love in the hearts of everyone; Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) in his eyes is nothing.

Subhan Allah Hil Azeem(سُبْحان الله العظيم) and we have a few dollars and we're clinging to it; And we're afraid of death; for Mataa Qalil(متاع قليل);

Mataa An-Zail(متاع زائل) for something that is going to leave.

And we're holding tight to it.

SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) has all of this and he is saying; Make me die as a Muslim and be with the righteous.

These are the hearts who were attached to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and attached to Aakhirah(آخِرة).

This is of the news of the unseen, which we reveal by inspiration to you; you were not present with them; when they raised their plan together and also while they were plotting.

And most of mankind will not believe even if you desire, eagerly.

We'll start now with a story of a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; who was not mentioned in reference to Da'wah(دعوة).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى when He talked about Noah(نوح), it was the Da'wah(دعوة) of Noah(نوح).

When He talked about Hood(هود); it was the Da'wah(دعوة) of Hood(هود).

Salih(صالح); it was the Da'wah(دعوة) of Salih(صالح).

Noah(نوح); it was the Da'wah(دعوة) of Noah(نوح).

But with this particular Nabi(نَبِي); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not talk about his Da'wah(دعوة) at all.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; when he talked about Syedina Ayub(سيدنا ايوب); He did not mention his Da'wah(دعوة) to his people.

But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى mentioned the story of his Sabr(صبر), his patience.

And that alone deserved his story to be mentioned twice and Qur'an; In reference of his patience, so it became later proverb; Sabr Ayub(صبرايوب).

Whenever we want to describe patience, we say patience of Ayub(أيوب); He became the symbol of Sabr(صبر); patience.

And remember Our slave; Job; when he invoked his Lord saying; Verily, Satan has touched me with distress and torment.

And remember Ayub(أيوب); when he cried to his Lord; Verily distress has seized me and you are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) says that Syedina Ayub عليه السلام was very wealthy and he had a large family and he was very healthy and strong.

So he had health, wealth and family.

And then suddenly; Syedina Ayub عليه السّلام lost his family somehow; lost his wealth and he lost his health.

And this did not happen; gradually; It happened suddenly. He lost everything.

He lost everything that a person loves in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Children and wealth are the adornment of this life.

Whether you are Muslim or non Muslim, this is something that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has put the love in your heart; Your wealth and your family.

It's something that we love in this world, and that is the Zeenah(زينة); that is the adornment of this world.

Ayub(أيوب) lost these two and in addition to that, he lost his health and his health situation became so bad; that he was not able to move, he was not able to work

and then the particular type of disease that he had was a disease that the people used to view in a form of Tashaum(تشاعم); they used to have a bad omen or evil Omen from this and they used to despise that particular disease.

And anybody who's inflicted with it, they will stay away from him.

So he became an outcast in the society.

And it is said that they even forced him out of the village; So he was living outside of his town.

He had no source of income.

So it is said that his wife started to work.

She would cook for people serve them in their homes, but then the people did not want to interact with her because they were afraid that she could also infect them.

So nobody wants to hire her.

So the situation of Syedina Ayub(سيِّدنا أيوب) was deteriorating.

And this was over a span of years; It was not a matter of a few weeks or months.

And it said that even the close ones around him his wife and his brothers and his family were saying; If Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has any love for him, this wouldn't have happened to him.

That was difficult for Syedina Ayub(سيِّدنا أيوب) to hear and that is when Syedina Ayub(سيِّدنا أيوب) made his Dua(دُعَا) to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and said;

Harm has inflicted me and you are the Most Merciful.

And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We responded to his Dua(دُعَا).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى accepted the Dua(دُعَا) of Syedina Ayub عليه السّلام.

How did it happen?

Strike the ground with your foot; This is a spring of water to wash in cool and refreshing to drink.

So he was commanded to hit the ground with his foot.

So water came out; He was ordered by Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to wash his body with that water; So it would heal him and purify him from the outside and to drink it and it will heal him from the inside.

So that replace the health of Syedina Ayub(سيِّدنا أيوب).

And the Ayah(آية) says; And We have given him a replacement of his family like them and better; Mercy from Us.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى gave him back his family, whether it was reviving the dead or providing him with new members of family; Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم);

But he had equal to what he had before and even better.

So now his family was replaced.

What about his wealth?

We find that in a Hadith(حديث) narrated by Bukhari(بخاريْ); Rasool Allah ﷺ says; When Ayub(أيوب) was taking a shower naked; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى sent on him grasshoppers made of gold that were falling over him.

Syedina Ayub(سيِّدنا أيوب) was gathering them and collecting them.

Isn't it Me; Who will provide for you; So why are you gathering all of this?

He said; O Allah, this is Your mercy and I want to have more of it.

It's a miracle Allahسُبحانه وتعالى provided him with grasshoppers made of gold; As a reward for the patience of His servant Ayub عليه السّلام.

And in another Ayah(آية) Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Notice this; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; So we answered his call, we removed his distress and we restored his family to him

and the like there off along with them as a mercy from Ourselves and a reminder for who?

The story of Ayub(أيوب); Allah is saying that it is a reminder for Al-Aabideen(ألعابدين); the worshipers of Allah.

Notice the word Al-Aabideen(ألعابدين), when you are worshiping Allahسُبحانه وتعالى you need to have a lot of patience.

Because worshipping Allahسُبحانه وتعالى needs commitment and discipline and persistence.

This is very easy to suddenly go into an emotional outburst and pray and read Qur'an and follow the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

It's very easy to do that; Sometimes we find that people crash into the religion and they start practicing; but it's not easy to persist and continue with it.

And that is why Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Hud(هود) has made my hair turn gray.

What is the Ayah(آية) in Syedina Hud(سيدنا هود) Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Stay on the straight path.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling Muhammadﷺ to stick on the straight path for all of your life.

And that is Rasool Allah ﷺ is saying; It made my hair turned gray because it is easy to worship Allahسُبحانه وتعالى for a few days and night

but to discipline yourself to do it continuously it needs patience.

To pray Witr(وتر) continuously; it need patience; to fast; it needs patience; to pray in Jama'ah(جماعة) it needs patience; to make Zikr(ذكر) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى it needs patience;

that's why Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has closed the Ayah(آية) of the story of Ayub(أيوب) with this final comment, It's a reminder for those, who are worshipping Allah.

And this is a form of Bala(بلى); This is a form of testing that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى puts on the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tests the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) with the most severe tests.

And then As-Saliheen(الصالحين); And then the best of you.

The more strong you are and firm in your Deen(دِيْن); the more difficult the test of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى on you; will be.

Just like in school; The professors when they write tests, or the teachers when they write test, they write a group of easy questions, the average difficulty questions

and then they put a few tough questions here and there to separate between the high segment of the class.

So you have a group of questions which are easy those will be answered by the majority.

And then you have another group of questions that will be answered by a lesser group.

And that is separate between, the D and the C.

And then you have questions that will separate between the B and the C.

And then you have questions that will separate between the A and the B.

And then you have one or two questions that will separate between the A Plus and the A Minus.

So, everyone is receiving questions according to his level.

And that is to put them through this ranking; If you made all of the questions easy, everyone will get 100% the full score and everyone will pass.

So you have to put the questions in a gradual step by step level of difficulty to separate between these students.

The same thing with the test that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى puts on us in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا).

If your Eeman(ايمان)  is weak, Allah will give you a simple exam.

If your level of Eeman(ايمان) is strong, then you would receive a more difficult exam.

And these tests that the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى go through are more severe.

Not only, are they severe in their tests and Da'wah(دعوة), even in their illness it's more difficult.

Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله ابن مسعود) was visiting Rasool Allah ﷺ his death; illness.

So Abdullah Ibn Masood(عبدالله ابن مسعود) put his hand over Rasool Allah ﷺ; temperature was so high.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Rasool Ullah said; I go through fever that two of you would go through.

The fever on Rasool Allah ﷺ was double.

Why?

Because of the level of Rasool Allah ﷺ he had to go through more difficult tests from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The next story is the story of Zan-Noon(ذا النون); Sahib Al-Hoot(صاحب الحوت); Syedina Yunus عليه السّلام.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has called him; Zan-Noon(ذا النون) and Noon(نون) is the big fish or whale; Sahib Al-Hoot(صاحب الحوت) is the same thing.

And verily Jonah was one of His messengers.

Syedina Yunus عليه السّلام was sent to a town in Iraq.

He made Da'wah(دعوة) to his people calling them to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

As usual, they did not respond.

And they were harsh on him; Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس) was irritated by their response and agitated.

His people provoked him because of their persistence and animosity towards the religion of Allah.

Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس) said; If this is the situation with these people, they don't deserve this, I will leave and I'll go somewhere else.

I'll go and make Da'wah(دعوة) in other parts of the world, I will leave these people alone.

They don't deserve this; Look at their response.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And Zan-Noon(ذا النون), he left angry; He left his people in a state of anger.

They did not respond; They don't want to listen; I'm going to leave and go somewhere else.

So he left them, and he wants to get as far as possible; So he went in the sea.

And he took a boat to go in the sea; so it take him as far as possible from these people; who he despised.

Wind picked up, waves were getting higher and higher; It was a storm.

The people were in that boat, they decided that in order for us to survive, we have to get rid of our luggage.

They threw all of their luggage; to make the book lighter.

That wasn't enough.

So now they have to throw in; one of the passengers.

They have to throw out; one of the passengers; they have to sacrifice one of the men onboard.

So they cast lots like what we say today; throw a dice.

So they cast the lot it came on who; Yunus(يونس).

They said; No, No, No. We're not gonna get rid of Yunus(يونس); This is our Barakah(بركة); This is our blessing on the boat.

He's the best man; we have on board; We're not going to get rid of him.

Let's try again; They throw it another time.

It came on who?

Yunus(يونس); Another time; They did it a third time; it came on Yunus(يونس).

And these people; they didn't want to get rid of Yunus(يونس).

They saw how righteous he was; They don't want to get rid of him.

Syedina Yunus(يونس) knew that this is not random.

These casting of the lots is not random; This is by the will of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and Allah is telling him something.

So he jumped in the sea.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى commanded one of His creation; the whale or the big fish to swallow him.

So it swallowed Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس).

They say; the Mufasireen(مفسرين); some of the commentators on Qur'an; they say that Yunus(يونس) was unconscious.

And then he woke up in the stomach of Al-Hoot(ألحوت); the whale.

And he looked around him, and he thought that he is where?

In the grave.

He thought he's dead; for a while; but that impression did not last long.

Because he started touching around him and he found out that this is not a grave, this is the stomach of a whale.

Now obviously, a stomach of a whale is not a five star hotel, it's not a comfortable place to be.

Stomach of whale is intended to do what?

To digest food.

And some of the most powerful enzymes and digesting fluids are in the stomachs of fish.

Because if you notice fish do not chew their food; they swallow it whole.

If you dissect the stomach of a fish, you would find the whole fish in there; And they have disintegrated and melted because of the power of the enzymes; It just breaks apart the flesh.

So Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس), his flesh, his skin was peeling off; his flesh his skin was falling out.

The stomach did not know this is Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس); a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allah; it was digesting him just like any other meal.

So his skin was peeling out.

Syedina Yunus عليه السّلام in this moment of difficulty, he ran to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; And he made Sujood(سجود) and he told Allahسُبحانه وتعالى;

O Allah I am making Sujood(سجود) to you in a place; where no one made Sujood(سجود) to you before; in the stomach of whale.

And then he made his famous Dua(دُعَا) which was recorded in Qur'an.

He said; And he called in the darkness.

He said; None has the right to be worshipped but You glorified and exalted be You; Truly I have been of the wrongdoers.

An admission of guilt, and witness of the oneness of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

He cried in the darkness.

This was the darkness of the stomach of the whale; In the darkness of the sea; In the darkness of the night; three darknesses.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; The angels see Hilkah Az-Zikr(حلقه الذكر) the meetings of remembrance of Allah; like stars, which you see in the sky.

We use the stars to navigate; The angels use these stars on earth to know where Allah is being remembered.

Whenever a group of Muslims come together, and we hope to be one of those.

This appears to the creation of the heavens; Like a star, and they see it and they come to it, so that they can witness the circles of remembering Allah and make Dua(دُعَا) for the ones; who are in it.

So we ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to surround us with the angels of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and to accept their Dua(دُعَا) and to make us of those who are forgiven.

So even though this was in the depths of the ocean; In the middle of the stomach of the whale; in the darkness of the night; the weak voice of Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس) was heard by the angels in the utmost heavens.

These angels went to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and said; O Allah; Isn't this the sound of your righteous servant?

Isn't this the sound of your righteous servant whom used to do good night and day?

They used to say; We would see his good deeds going up in the sky in the night and in the day.

So this sound was familiar to them.

They knew who he was.

Why?

Because they would see pillars of light going up in the sky because of his good deeds that he used to do every day and every night.

They knew; who he was; This sound was familiar to them.

They knew him; because the good deeds are like pillars of light that traveling in the sky and reach to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and passed by the angels.

They said; O Allah; Aren't you gonna have mercy on him?

And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى tells us in Qur'an, the reason why?

If it was not for the fact that he used to remember Us before; he would have remained in the stomach of the whale; until the day of judgment.

Because he remembered Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in moments of ease; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى took care of him in moments of difficulty.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Remember Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in moments of ease, Allah will remember you in moments of difficulty.

We need to remember Allah in our young age; So that Allah will remember us in our old age.

Remember Allah; when you're healthy, so Allah remember you when you are ill; Remember Allah when you have free time; So Allah will remember you, when you become busy.

Remember Allahسُبحانه وتعالى  when you are alive, so Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will remember you; when you're dead.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى took care of Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس) in the depths of the darkness of the sea because of this Dua(دُعَا).

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى freed him; So we answered his call and delivered him from the distress.

One of the companions came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; Is this Dua(دُعَا) only applicable to Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس)?

Or would it apply to any one of us?

Meaning Can we make the use of the same Dua(دُعَا) and it will be accepted?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Yes; didn't you see Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; And thus we saved the believers.

Because Allah says; We saved Yunus(يونس) and thus we save the believers.

Therefore Rasool Allah ﷺ says; This is the Dua(دُعَا) of the distress.

If you ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى using this Dua(دُعَا); Allah will deliver you from your distress.

The Dua(دُعَا) again is; Yunus(يونس) was delivered out of the stomach of the whale and he was delivered to safety on the shore.

But he did not have skin to protect him from the sunrays; He did not have skin to protect him from wind.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى delivered him to the shore; And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى commanded a tree to go grow over Syedina Yunus(سيدنا يونس); so that it would provide cover and shade for him and it will also provide him with food.

Allah planted over him a tree of Yaqteen(يقطين).

But now Yunus(يونس) has to finish his job.

So last time, come back to his town; Go back.

So he went back to his people.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We sent him to 100,000 people or even more.

What happened?

They believed in him?

All of them accepted Islam.

So we gave them enjoyment for a while.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says that the people of Yunus(يونس) are an exception.

Because before the other nations of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) were being destroyed.

But with the people of Yunus عليه السّلام; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Was there any town that believed after seeing the punishment and its faith saved it from the punishment?

The answer is; None except the people of Yunus(يونس) when they believed; We removed from them the torment and disgrace in their life and we gave them enjoyment in this world for a while.

It is said that when Yunus(يونس) left the punishment was hovering over them.

That's it; I mean the punishment was about to strike.

But because Yunus(يونس) left immaturely.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى held away that punishment, and then when Yunus(يونس) came, they responded, and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى saved them from a punishment that was already hovering over their heads.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in Surat Al-Qalam(سورة ألقلم) tells Rasool Allah ﷺ about this story.

And this was revealed in the period in Makkah.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was receiving the same response of the people of Yunus(يونس); Rejection.

So to keep Rasool Allah ﷺ from doing the same thing that Yunus(يونس) did.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Muhammadﷺ about the story of Yunus(يونس) and the first word that was used before the narration of the story is; Fasbir(فصبر).

Have Patience.

So wait with patience for the decision of your Lord; and be not like the Companion of the fish; When he cried out to us while he was in deep sorrow;

Had not the grace from his Lord reached him; He would indeed have been left in the stomach of the fish.

So he was cast off on the naked shore; while he was to be blamed; but his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى chose him and made him of the righteous.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا

إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ۝

مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا

إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ۝

قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ۝

إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ۝

قَالُوا أَإِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَا أَخِي ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَا أَخِي قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا

لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ۝

وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ ۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ۝

أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ ۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ۝

إنَّ نَصَر مع الصبر إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ۝

قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَٰطِـِٔينَ۝

قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ يَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ۝

أَخٌ كَرِيمٌ، وَابْنُ أَخٍ كَرِيمٍ، لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ اذهبوا فأنتم الطلقاء ٱذۡهَبُواْ بِقَمِيصِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِ أَبِي يَأۡتِ بَصِيرٗا وَأۡتُونِي بِأَهۡلِكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ۝

وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلۡعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمۡ إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَۖ لَوۡلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ۝

قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِي ضَلَٰلِكَ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ۝

لقد قال الذي كلمة العظيمة فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلۡبَشِيرُ أَلۡقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ فَٱرۡتَدَّ بَصِيرٗاۖ قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ۝

قَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَٰطِـِٔينَ۝

قَالَ سَوۡفَ أَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكُمۡ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ۝

فَلَمَّا دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَبَوَيۡهِ وَقَالَ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مِصۡرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ۝

إِذۡ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَيۡتُهُمۡ لِي سَٰجِدِينَ۝

وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأۡوِيلُ رُءۡيَٰيَ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقّٗاۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ بِيٓ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَنِي مِنَ ٱلسِّجۡنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡبَدۡوِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَ إِخۡوَتِيٓۚ

رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ۝

عمرتم دنياكم وخربتم آخرتكم فتكرهون ان تخرجومن العمران الى الخراب تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ۝

تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ أَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَمۡكُرُونَ۝

وَمَآ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ۝

Syedina Ayub عليه السّلام.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Surat Al-Ambiyaa(سورة الأنبِيَاء).

وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ۝

المال والبنون زينة الحياة الدنيا فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told him; ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ۝

وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Ayub(أيوب); Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا

رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَابِدِينَ۝

وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَابِدِينَ۝

شَيَّبَتْنِي هودٌ فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَابِدِينَ۝

فالأمثل فالأمثل نعم إني أُوعَك كما يوعك رجلان منك Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝

وَذَا النُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ اليس هذا الصوت عبدك صالح فلان الذي ما ذال يصعد له العمل الصالح في اليل والنهار

يصعد له العمل الصالح Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Yes.

فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ ۝ لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; تعرف على الله في الرخاء يعرفك في الشدة And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ وَنَجَّيناهُ مِنَ الغَمِ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُنجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

هذا دعا الكرب لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ۝

وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ ۝ فَآمَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ۝

فَآمَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ۝

فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ آمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا آمَنُوا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ۝

فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ۝

لَّوْلَا أَن تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ۝

فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets Part 1; And then after this introduction of Da'wah(دعوة); after he has fulfilled his part in conveying to them the message,

now he gets to the answer of the question.

But he held them back until they finished delivering the message of truth to them.

And now he's going to tell them the answer.

Why?

Because they need him.

And because they need him, they're willing to, to listen.

So he took advantage of that and he started giving them these important concepts, and now he's gonna give them the interpretation of the dream.

He said; Oh two companions of the prison; As for one of you, he will pour out wine for his Lord, to drink, and as for the other; he will be crucified and birds will eat from his head.

Thus is the case judged concerning what you both did inquire.

One of you will be very close to the king.

One of you is going to leave from this prison and jail and he is going to be one of the close associates of the king and he will be pouring wine for the king.

This is the one who saw that he's pressing wine.

And the other one of you will be taken out of jail and will be crucified and he will be left on the cross until birds will come and eat from his head.

And that is the one who saw that he has bread and birds are eating from it.

And then he said; The issue which you're asking about is judged; that's it.

That's the judgment of Allah; it's done.

And then SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) went to the one who he thought would be saved, and will be close to the king and SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) told him;

Please remember my name in front of the king.

Yusuf(يوسُف) was thrown in jail, they oppressed him, so he appeal because the one who put him in jail was Al-Aziz(ألعزيز), and that was the second highest authority after the king.

So there is no one; whom Yusuf(يوسُف) could appeal to; except the king, he is the next higher authority.

So Yusuf(يوسُف) wanted his case to be presented in front of the king, so that the king would look into that case, and maybe, he would free him.

And he said to the one whom he knew to be saved, mentioned me to your Lord Your Lord means your king.

There are two interpretations given to the next part.

Satan made him forget to mention it to His Lord.

There are two interpretations given; One interpretation is that this man he left jail and he went to work with the king; but when he got in the palace and he gotten close to the king and all of the luxury of life, he forgot about Yusuf عليه السّلام.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) made him forget, that's one meaning.

The other meaning is that; Sayidina Yusuf عليه السلام, forgot to ask Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and he asked this man to ask the king.

Instead of asking Allah, he asked the king to help him.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) made him forget.

And they say in the books of Tafseer(تفسير), some Mufasireen(مفسرين) say; that Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) came to see the Sadyina Yusuf عليه السّلام and told him;

Who is the one, who freed you from the well.?

He said: Allah; Who is the one, who delivered you to safety in Egypt.?

He said: Allah; Who is the one, who put you in the right place to be raised up and honored you?

He said: Allah; Who is the one who saved you from the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) of the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز)?

He said: Allah; He said: If Allah is the One, Who saved you throughout all of this.

How come instead of asking Allah; you're asking the king to save you out of jail.

And because of that mistake, he paid a price.

He spent a few more years in jail.

This mistake that seems to be small, he paid the price for it and he spent a few more years in jail.

His grandmother; they say, this is the story of Tafseer(تفسير), Allah Ho Alam(ألله أعلم); This could be valid or it could be not.

It says that his grandmother had a small idle and Yusuf(يوسُف) stole it from her and he destroyed it.

So they use this and they said, he stole before.

Even though this is not really stealing, this is Da'wah(دعوة) destroying a false god.

Anyway they said; Let me read these Ayaat(آيات) that we just covered now.

So when he had furnished them forth with their provisions he put the golden bowl into their brothers bag; then a crier cried, O you in the caravan surely you are thieves.

Then they turn toward them and said: What is it that you have missed?

They said: We have missed the golden bowl of the king and for him, who produces it, the reward of a camel load; I will be bound by it.

They said: By Allah Indeed you know that we came not to make mischeif in the land, and we are no thieves.

They, Joseph's men said; What then shall be the penalty of him, if you are proved to be liars.

They said; The brothers of Yusuf(يوسُف); The penalty should be that; in whose bag it is found should be held for the punishment of the crime thus we punish the wrongdoers.

So he began the search in their bags before the bag of his brother.

Then he brought it out of his brother's bag.

Thus did we plan for Joseph; He could not take his brother by the law of the king.

Except that Allah willed it.

We raise the degrees whom He please.

But over all those endowed with knowledge is the all knowing Allah.

I want to comment on one word here, Allah says: He could not take his brother according to the religion of the king.

Deen(دِيْن); Allah used the word Deen(دِيْن).

Allah is calling this law Deen(دِيْن); It is religion.

Laws are part of religion.

This is a law; we call it criminal law here in the United States criminal law.

It has nothing to do with religion.

And that mentality is being engraved in our minds unfortunately, that laws have nothing to do with religion.

Allah in Qur'an is calling the law of the king; Deen(دِيْن); religion, that is the religion of the king.

And this is the religion of Allah; Laws are part of religion.

Allah did not say in the Qanoon(قانون) of Malik(ملك) - in the law of the Malik(ملك).

Allah say in the Deen(دِيْن), the religion of the Malik(ملك) the king.

They said; If he steals there was a brother of his who did steal before him.

SayidinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) held those emotions in his heart and he didn't speak.

But these things did Joseph keeping himself revealing not the secrets to them.

He did not respond to this.

And then he said also silently.

He said: Within himself; you are in worst case and Allah knows best the truth of what you are saying.

They're speaking to Yusuf(يوسُف) and this they're telling him that Yusuf(يوسُف) stole before.

Yusuf(يوسُف) knows the truth.

He said: Allah Ho Alam(ألله أعلم); Allah knows better but he did not show that to them.

Now the brothers are trying to free Binyamin(بنيامين) because they have given their father a promise that we'll come back with him.

They said: Oh ruler of the land, Verily he has a father who is old.

So take one of us in his place; Indeed we think you are one of the good doers.

He said: No! that will be oppression; that is wrong.

How can we take an innocent one?

He is guilty; We're going to keep him.

When they gave up; they went on the side.

Their elder brother, they say his name is Robeel(روبيل).

He said; The eldest among them said; Know you not that your father did take an oath from you in Allah's name?

And before this, you did fail in your duty with Yusuf(يوسُف).

Therefore I will not leave this land, until my father permit me or Allah decides my case.

And he is the best of the judges.

He said: I am not going to leave Egypt, I'm not going to go and face my father after this.

We have betrayed Yusuf(يوسُف) before.

And now we're going to go to our father and say that our brother is taken as a prisoner; I'm not going to leave.

So he stayed there, and the other brothers went back to Egypt.

So they went back and they told their father what happened.

The father didn't believe this.

How could it happen that before you betrayed Yusuf(يوسُف) and you come and lie, and now you betray his other brother and you lie, so he told them;

Nay but your own selves have be guilted you to do something.

They said; This time; they are telling the truth.

They said: Ask the people in Egypt and ask the caravan of them or witness that we're telling the truth.

But this is like they say that there was one Shepherd of sheep.

And once he started saying the wolf was attacking, the wolf was attacking; so everybody came to help him.

They found that there's no wolf he was lying.

In the next day; He said the wolf is attacking the wolf as attacking, they all came to help him.

Nobody came to help him.

The third day the wolf did show up.

And he started saying the wolf is attacking, the wolf is attacking; Nobody came to help him because they thought he is lying.

So the brothers of Yusuf(يوسُف); they lied before, they lied about Yusuf(يوسُف).

Now, they're telling the truth, but their fathers cannot believe it.

And they're trying to convince him and they're telling them ask the witnesses.

But he said: No.

You have made the plot He said: I will have patience.

And then he said; He did not lose hope.

He said: May Allah bring them all back to me.

Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother.

He did not even lose hope in Yusuf(يوسُف) because he remembers the dream of Yusuf(يوسُف) and he knows that one day Yusuf(يوسُف) will be victorious; he knew.

The father; Now his sorrow; his injury was brought up again.

And he remembered Yusuf(يوسُف) and now it's Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother Binyamin(بنيامين).

So the father started to cry and weep; until he turned blind.

He kept on crying and weeping.

Until his eyes lost vision because of sorrow.

He was suppressing that sorrow.

The brothers tried to reduce this pain on their father and they said; By Allah, you will never cease remembering Yusuf(يوسُف) until you become weak with old age or until you be of the dead.

They felt sorry for their father.

They saw that he's gonna destroy his health, by this sorrow that he's suppressing in his heart.

He said; I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah and I know from Allah that which you know not.

I am not complaining to you I'm not complaining to mankind.

I am asking Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to help me.

I seek assistance from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And then he said; Oh my son's go you and inquire about Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother.

The father is telling these other brothers go and look Yusuf(يوسُف) and his brother.

But Sayidina Yaqub عليه السلام did not lose hope and he said; And never give up hope of Allah's  mercy; certainly no one despair is of Allah's mercy except people who disbelief.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ يا صاحِبَيِ السِّجنِ أَمّا أَحَدُكُما فَيَسقي رَبَّهُ خَمرًا ۖ وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَيُصلَبُ فَتَأكُلُ الطَّيرُ مِن رَأسِهِ ۚ

قُضِيَ الأَمرُ الَّذي فيهِ تَستَفتِيانِ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقالَ لِلَّذي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ناجٍ مِنهُمَا اذكُرني عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنساهُ الشَّيطانُ ذِكرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجنِ بِضعَ سِنينَ۝

فَأَنساهُ الشَّيطانُ ذِكرَ رَبِّهِ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجنِ بِضعَ سِنينَ۝

فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجنِ بِضعَ سِنينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقالَ المَلِكُ إِنّي أَرىٰ سَبعَ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأكُلُهُنَّ سَبعٌ عِجافٌ وَسَبعَ سُنبُلاتٍ خُضرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ ۖ

يا أَيُّهَا المَلَأُ أَفتوني في رُؤيايَ إِن كُنتُم لِلرُّؤيا تَعبُرونَ۝

قالوا أَضغاثُ أَحلامٍ ۖ وَما نَحنُ بِتَأويلِ الأَحلامِ بِعالِمينَ۝

وَما نَحنُ بِتَأويلِ الأَحلامِ بِعالِمينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقالَ الَّذي نَجا مِنهُما وَادَّكَرَ بَعدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنا أُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَأويلِهِ فَأَرسِلونِ۝

يوسف أيها الصديق يوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدّيقُ أَفتِنا في سَبعِ بَقَراتٍ سِمانٍ يَأكُلُهُنَّ سَبعٌ عِجافٌ وَسَبعِ سُنبُلاتٍ خُضرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ

وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ لَعَلّي أَرجِعُ إِلَى النّاسِ لَعَلَّهُم يَعلَمونَ۝

قالَ تَزرَعونَ سَبعَ سِنينَ دَأَبًا فَما حَصَدتُم فَذَروهُ في سُنبُلِهِ إِلّا قَليلًا مِمّا تَأكُلونَ۝

فَما حَصَدتُم فَذَروهُ في سُنبُلِهِ إِلّا قَليلًا مِمّا تَأكُلونَ۝

ثُمَّ يَأتي مِن بَعدِ ذٰلِكَ سَبعٌ شِدادٌ يَأكُلنَ ما قَدَّمتُم لَهُنَّ إِلّا قَليلًا مِمّا تُحصِنونَ۝

ثُمَّ يَأتي مِن بَعدِ ذٰلِكَ عامٌ فيهِ يُغاثُ النّاسُ وَفيهِ يَعصِرونَ۝

وَقالَ المَلِكُ ائتوني بِهِ ۖ فَلَمّا جاءَهُ الرَّسولُ قالَ ارجِع إِلىٰ رَبِّكَ فَاسأَلهُ ما بالُ النِّسوَةِ اللّاتي قَطَّعنَ أَيدِيَهُنَّ ۚ

رحم الله يوسف لو كنت أنا لبعدرت الباب او لعجبت الداعي قالَ ما خَطبُكُنَّ إِذ راوَدتُنَّ يوسُفَ عَن نَفسِهِ ۚ قُلنَ حاشَ لِلَّهِ ما عَلِمنا عَلَيهِ مِن سوءٍ ۚ

قالَتِ امرَأَتُ العَزيزِ الآنَ حَصحَصَ الحَقُّ أَنا راوَدتُهُ عَن نَفسِهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصّادِقينَ۝

أَنا راوَدتُهُ عَن نَفسِهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصّادِقينَ۝

ذٰلِكَ لِيَعلَمَ أَنّي لَم أَخُنهُ بِالغَيبِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدي كَيدَ الخائِنينَ۝

وَقالَ المَلِكُ ائتوني بِهِ أَستَخلِصهُ لِنَفسي ۖ فَلَمّا كَلَّمَهُ قالَ إِنَّكَ اليَومَ لَدَينا مَكينٌ أَمينٌ۝

قالَ اجعَلني عَلىٰ خَزائِنِ الأَرضِ ۖ إِنّي حَفيظٌ عَليمٌ۝

إنَّا وَاللَّهِ لا نُوَلِّي علَى هذا العَمَلِ أَحَدًا سَأَلَهُ، إِنّي حَفيظٌ عَليمٌ۝

ولا تزكو أنفسكم أنا حفيظ و عليم وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنّا لِيوسُفَ فِي الأَرضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنها حَيثُ يَشاءُ ۚ نُصيبُ بِرَحمَتِنا مَن نَشاءُ ۖ وَلا نُضيعُ أَجرَ المُحسِنينَ۝

يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنها حَيثُ يَشاءُ ۚ But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَأَجرُ الآخِرَةِ خَيرٌ لِلَّذينَ آمَنوا وَكانوا يَتَّقونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَجاءَ إِخوَةُ يوسُفَ فَدَخَلوا عَلَيهِ فَعَرَفَهُم وَهُم لَهُ مُنكِرونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَمّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهازِهِم قالَ ائتوني بِأَخٍ لَكُم مِن أَبيكُم ۚ أَلا تَرَونَ أَنّي أوفِي الكَيلَ وَأَنا خَيرُ المُنزِلينَ۝

فَإِن لَم تَأتوني بِهِ فَلا كَيلَ لَكُم عِندي وَلا تَقرَبونِ۝

قالوا سَنُراوِدُ عَنهُ أَباهُ وَإِنّا لَفاعِلونَ۝

فَلَمّا رَجَعوا إِلىٰ أَبيهِم قالوا يا أَبانا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الكَيلُ قالوا يا أَبانا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الكَيلُ فَأَرسِل مَعَنا أَخانا نَكتَل وَإِنّا لَهُ لَحافِظونَ۝

قالَ هَل آمَنُكُم عَلَيهِ إِلّا كَما أَمِنتُكُم عَلىٰ أَخيهِ مِن قَبلُ ۖ فَاللَّهُ خَيرٌ حافِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرحَمُ الرّاحِمينَ۝

وَلَمّا فَتَحوا مَتاعَهُم وَجَدوا بِضاعَتَهُم رُدَّت إِلَيهِم ۖ قالوا يا أَبانا ما نَبغي ۖ هٰذِهِ بِضاعَتُنا رُدَّت إِلَينا ۖ هٰذِهِ بِضاعَتُنا رُدَّت إِلَينا ۖ وَنَميرُ أَهلَنا وَنَحفَظُ أَخانا وَنَزدادُ كَيلَ بَعيرٍ ۖ ذٰلِكَ كَيلٌ يَسيرٌ۝

قالَ لَن أُرسِلَهُ مَعَكُم حَتّىٰ تُؤتونِ مَوثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ لَتَأتُنَّني بِهِ إِلّا أَن يُحاطَ بِكُم ۖ ألعين حقَ وَقالَ يا بَنِيَّ لا تَدخُلوا مِن بابٍ واحِدٍ وَادخُلوا مِن أَبوابٍ مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ ۖ

وَما أُغني عَنكُم مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ ۖ إِنِ الحُكمُ إِلّا لِلَّهِ ۖ إِنِ الحُكمُ إِلّا لِلَّهِ ۖ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ ۖ وَعَلَيهِ فَليَتَوَكَّلِ المُتَوَكِّلونَ۝

وَلَمّا دَخَلوا مِن حَيثُ أَمَرَهُم أَبوهُم ما كانَ يُغني عَنهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ إِلّا حاجَةً في نَفسِ يَعقوبَ قَضاها ۚ قالَ إِنّي أَنا أَخوكَ فَلا تَبتَئِس بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ۝

ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا العيرُ إِنَّكُم لَسارِقونَ۝

قالوا إِن يَسرِق فَقَد سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِن قَبلُ ۚ إِن يَسرِق فَقَد سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِن قَبلُ ۚ فَلَمّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهازِهِم جَعَلَ السِّقايَةَ في رَحلِ أَخيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ

ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا العيرُ إِنَّكُم لَسارِقونَ۝

قالوا وَأَقبَلوا عَلَيهِم ماذا تَفقِدونَ۝

قالوا نَفقِدُ صُواعَ المَلِكِ وَلِمَن جاءَ بِهِ حِملُ بَعيرٍ وَأَنا بِهِ زَعيمٌ۝

قالوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَد عَلِمتُم ما جِئنا لِنُفسِدَ فِي الأَرضِ وَما كُنّا سارِقينَ۝

قالوا فَما جَزاؤُهُ إِن كُنتُم كاذِبينَ۝

قالوا جَزاؤُهُ مَن وُجِدَ في رَحلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزاؤُهُ ۚ فَبَدَأَ بِأَوعِيَتِهِم قَبلَ وِعاءِ أَخيهِ ثُمَّ استَخرَجَها مِن وِعاءِ أَخيهِ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ كِدنا لِيوسُفَ ۖ

ما كانَ لِيَأخُذَ أَخاهُ في دينِ المَلِكِ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ نَرفَعُ دَرَجاتٍ مَن نَشاءُ ۗ وَفَوقَ كُلِّ ذي عِلمٍ عَليمٌ۝

ما كانَ لِيَأخُذَ أَخاهُ في دينِ المَلِكِ في دينِ المَلِكِ قالوا إِن يَسرِق فَقَد سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِن قَبلُ فَأَسَرَّها يوسُفُ في نَفسِهِ وَلَم يُبدِها لَهُم ۚ

قالَ أَنتُم شَرٌّ مَكانًا ۖ وَاللَّهُ أَعلَمُ بِما تَصِفونَ۝

قالوا يا أَيُّهَا العَزيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيخًا كَبيرًا فَخُذ أَحَدَنا مَكانَهُ ۖ إِنّا نَراكَ مِنَ المُحسِنينَ۝

خَلَصوا نَجِيًّا ۖ قالَ كَبيرُهُم أَلَم تَعلَموا أَنَّ أَباكُم قَد أَخَذَ عَلَيكُم مَوثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمِن قَبلُ ما فَرَّطتُم في يوسُفَ ۖ

فَلَن أَبرَحَ الأَرضَ حَتّىٰ يَأذَنَ لي أَبي أَو يَحكُمَ اللَّهُ لي ۖ وَهُوَ خَيرُ الحاكِمينَ۝

قالَ بَل سَوَّلَت لَكُم أَنفُسُكُم أَمرًا ۖ فَصَبرٌ جَميلٌ ۖ وَاسأَلِ القَريَةَ الَّتي كُنّا فيها وَالعيرَ الَّتي أَقبَلنا فيها ۖ وَإِنّا لَصادِقونَ۝

فَصَبرٌ جَميلٌ ۖ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَأتِيَني بِهِم جَميعًا وَابيَضَّت عَيناهُ مِنَ الحُزنِ فَهُوَ كَظيمٌ۝

قالَ إِنَّما أَشكو بَثّي وَحُزني إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ما لا تَعلَمونَ۝

أشكو إلى الله يا بَنِيَّ اذهَبوا فَتَحَسَّسوا مِن يوسُفَ وَأَخيهِ وَلا تَيأَسوا مِن رَوحِ اللَّهِ ۖ صلى الله عليه وسلم على سيدنا محمد وعلى آله وصحبه وسلم

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets Part 1; And then he told his son; And all of these things he's deriving from this dream.
