And they knew that the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) has love to her slave; so they started speaking about that.

And women in the city said: The wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) is seeking to seduce her slave, young man.

Indeed she loves him violently.

We see her in plain error.

I mean how good she desires slave and gossip was going around and the news is spreading from one meeting and club to another.

So the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) wanted to teach them a lesson.

She invited this woman and then she gave them some fruits.

She gave them knives.

And then she told them to start eating so they would cut the fruits with the knives and she had already prepared her slave Yusuf(يوسُف) and Rasool Allah ﷺ says that Yusuf(يوسُف) of had one half of the beauty.

Yusuf(يوسُف), there was no one more handsome than him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: I saw him in As-Samah(ألسماوة), when Rasool Allah ﷺ made the trip of Al-Miraj(ألمعراج).

Rasool Ullah said; I saw Yusuf(يوسُف) and he had half of the beauty.

Ibn Masood(إبن مسعود) later would say that whenever Yusuf(يوسُف) would deal with any woman he would cover his face.

The interpreters of this Hadith(حديث) they say it could either mean that Yusuf(يوسُف) of had half of the beauty of the world or it could mean that Yusuf(يوسُف) of had half of the beauty of who?

Adam عليه السّلام because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has created Adam(آدَم) with his own hands and the scholar said that was the best form of human beings.

So Yusuf(يوسُف) of had half of the beauty of Adam(آدَم).

So they started eating and she made Yusuf(يوسُف) walk in front of them.

Yusuf(يوسُف) walked in front of these women.

They were cutting these fruits and they looked up and they saw Yusuf(يوسُف) walking and they kept on staring at Yusuf(يوسُف) and the knife is moving, until it started cutting through their flesh

and cutting their fingers and when Yusuf(يوسُف) have passed away, they realize that they have cut their own hands.

And they said; Then when they saw him, they exalted him at his beauty.

And in their astonishment cut their hands.

They said: How perfect is Allah ?

No man is this; this is none other than a noble Angel.

So this cannot be a man, this is an angel.

Now they understood what the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) is going through.

So she told them; She said: This is he; the young man about whom you did blame me for his love.

And I did seek to seduce him, but he refused.

And now if he refuses to obey my order, he shall certainly be cast into prison, and he will be one of those who are disgraced.

She's still running after him and threatening him.

And the woman who saw him now we're all encouraging him to obey his master.

They were telling him, she's your master, you have to obey her.

So now the pressure is not only from the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز), but the pressure is from all these other women who saw him.

Now things are becoming very, very difficult and painful and distressful and SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف).

He's going through Fitnah(فِتْنَه) and his life is distressful.

He's living in a big prison, a prison of Fitnah(فِتْنَه); all around him his Fitnah(فِتْنَه), seduction is surrounding him from every side.

So Yusuf(يوسف) said; He said: O my lord, prison is more to my liking than that which they invite me to.

Now for Yusuf(يوسُف), living in prison is easier than living out of prison.

What he's going through out of prison outside of prison is worse.

He said: O Allah take me to jail.

At least I will be away from this Fitnah(فِتْنَه); it's better for me.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Yusuf(يوسُف) is doing all of this to keep away from one of the most powerful seducing things that could affect a man.

Not only is it the beauty and the and the lust and the encouragement of the woman and the society and the environment that Yusuf(يوسُف) is living in,

but he's also being coerced and forced to commit Zina(زنا).

Yusuf(يوسُف) said: O Allah take me to jail going to jail is better for me than responding to what they want me to do.

And then he said; Unless You turn away their plot from me, I will feel inclined towards them and be one of those who commit the sin and one of those who are ignorant.

He said: O Allah, if you do not take away this from me, I am weak; I am weak and I'm going to fall into this.

An admission from SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) of his weakness, we are weak.

We should never think that we're strong.

Our strength comes from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and this is the Dua(دُعَا) that we should say, in environments like this, which are similar to the environment of Yusuf عليه السّلام.

O Allah unless you turn away their plot from me; I will feel inclined towards them and be one of the ignorance.

So his Lord answered his invocation and turn away from him, their plot.

Verily He is the All Hearer and the All Knower.

Then it appeared to them after they had seen the proofs of his innocence to imprison him for a time.

Now the news is spread; it's a scandal now.

How can they solve the problem by taking the innocent to jail.

Instead of stopping, the wife of Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) they took the Nabi(نَبِي) of Allah Yusuf(يوسُف) and they put him in jail.

He was oppressed, and put in jail even though he was innocent.

There were two men who were with him in jail.

And these two men saw a dream; one of them saw a dream in which he is pressing wine and the other one saw a dream in which he is carrying on his head some bread

and there are some birds who are eating from that bread.

They said: Because we see that you are of those, who are righteous.

We want you to tell us the interpretation of this dream.

Yusuf عليه السّلام told them; No food will come to you, but I will inform you it's interpretation before it comes.

The Mufassireen(مفسرين) have different opinions about this one of them is that Sayidina Yusuf عليه السّلام told them I will tell you the interpretation of the dream before your next meal is served.

Before your next meal is served, you will have the interpretation of the dream.

And then notice the personality of the Daiyah(داعية), the preacher to Islam.

They asked him a question about an interpretation of a dream.

He said; Now this is number two.

Number one; He told them.

Before you receive your next meal, but he said; Turzaqanihi(ترزقانه) it is Rizq(رزق) from Allah.

So he's driving some concepts to them.

So number one is telling them that this food that you will receive is from Allah.

That is of the knowledge that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has taught me.

Meaning I'm not gonna tell you the interpretation of the dream from my own knowledge and skills.

This is knowledge that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has taught me.

So he's giving credit to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Number three; I have abandoned the religion of a people that believe not in Allah.

Now what does this have to do with interpretation of the dreams?

This is pure Da'wah(دعوة), that he is delivering to these people.

He said: I have left the religion of the people, who disbelieve in Allah.

He is talking about the religion that they're following.

He said: I have abandoned that religion, And they disbelieve in the Akhirah(آخرة).

So he is establishing in them the belief in Allah and the belief in Akhirah(آخرة) because there is no religion that was revealed to Nabi(نَبِي), except that it has in it; a pillar of faith, which is Akhirah(آخرة).

And then number five, he said; And I followed the religion of my father's Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), Is'haq(إسحاق) and Yaqoob(يعقوب).

Why did he tell them that I followed the religion of my fathers.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام was the caller of truth of Tawheed(توحيد) in that time.

He was the believer.

And the belief in Allahسُبحانه وتعالى was among his children, it wasn't widespread.

So the family of Ibrahim عليه السّلام were famous that they were the families of Islam.

The people in Egypt have heard about the news of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and this Is'haq(إسحاق) and Yaqoob(يعقوب) and the religion of Tawheed(توحيد).

So Yusuf(يوسُف) is telling them about it; He's telling them this is the religion that I follow.

So he's telling them: I'm following the religion of my father's Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Is'haq(إسحاق) and Yaqoob(يعقوب) because they were the representations after Tawheed(توحيد).

They were the representations of the oneness of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى .

It was among this blessed family of Ibrahim عليه السلام.

Number six; And never could we attribute any partners whatsoever to Allah.

The people in Egypt at that time knew the concept of Allah but they knew it in a form of Shirk(شرك); because we'll find throughout the story of Yusuf(يوسُف) that they knew about Allah;

because we talked about Al-Aziz(ألعزيز) is telling his wife; Ask Allah to forgive your sin.

So they knew about Allahسُبحانه وتعالى but they were attributing, other gods with him like the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they knew about Allahسُبحانه وتعالى;

But they used to believe in other idols and gods and then he said; Number seven; this is from the grace of Allah to us and to mankind.

But most of mankind do not thank.

Yusuf(يوسُف) is saying that this message of Tawheed(توحيد) is a blessing of Allah on us and it's a blessing of Allah on all mankind.

Because the Ibrahim عليه السّلام was calling everyone to Islam, so it's a blessing on everyone.

The religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is a blessing for everyone.

This is an introduction and then he came to interpret the dream.

But he gave them another introduction before he interpreted the dream.

They asked him a straight question; Tell us the interpretation of this dream.

What was his answer?

He said; O companions of the prison and look at the choice of words.

O companions; he's taking them as companions and friends.

He is having a social relation with them some closeness?

A very soft way of speaking to them; O companions of jail, you're my companions.

And then he sends a question to them; Are many different gods better or Allah, the One that irresistible?

He's not telling them straightly Allah is better; He's asking them a question; to make them use their mind.

It is obvious because why is he asking this particular question?

Because it is obvious to the human intellect and the human mind and the human heart, that there's only one God.

Allah is Al-Qahhaar(ألقهار) Al-Qahhaar(ألقهار) means He is the one, who is overwhelming and dominant over everything.

So all of these other gods that you are establishing, besides Allah, they have no power whatsoever.

So he ask them this question.

And then he's giving them the answer.

He gave them the question so that they would think, and he's preparing them to receive the next piece of information that he will give them.

He told them; You do not worship besides Him but only names which you have forged - you and your father's for which Allah has sent down no authority.

Asmaa(أسماء) names, what is the name?

A name is an abstract thing, the name itself has no value, the substance which are naming that has the value.

Yusuf(يوسُف) is telling them that these gods have no substance, they don't even exist.

There's nothing behind it; it's just a name; it's just a label; there's nothing behind it.

These are names you forged with your father's before.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not instruct or commanded us to do this.

Then he said; The command is for none but Allah; Al-Hukm(ألحكم); the governance and the rule and the command belongs to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى in all of our affairs in everything,

we need to realize that we are following an incomplete form of Islam today.

We're following the brand of Islam that is missing the Shariah(شريعة).

The Shariah(شريعة) is left out.

We are following a certain aspect of Islam which is the daily rituals of Ibadah(عبادة) and some things that we do in the Masjid(مسجد) and some very little Akhlaq(أخلاق) that we have and that's it.

But we're missing the Shariah(شريعة); the law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى we're missing the important Akhlaq(أخلاق), we're missing the way of dealing in business, we're missing all of this.

And if we do not have the intention to bring it back, and if we do not strive and struggle to do so, then we are guilty of following an incomplete form of Islam.

And the only excuse we would have in front of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is; if we strive and struggle to bring back the complete form of Islam.

If we do that, then we hope that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will forgive us for this shortcoming.

Yusuf(يوسُف) is saying; All Command belongs to Allah.

Do we follow the commandments of Allah in business?

Do we follow the commandments of Allah in criminal law.?

Do we follow the commandments of Allah in international law?

Do you follow the commandments of Allah in politics?

Do you follow the commandments of Allah in economics?

Do you follow the commandments of Allah in social laws?

If we are leaving all of this out, what are we following?

And then Yusuf(يوسُف) is telling them, the justification, why the rules should belong to Allah because he says; He has ordered you to worship none but Him; so this is part of worship.

The reason why, Hukum(حكم) should belong to Allah; is because it is part of worship.

And if we are not worshiping Allah in the laws of social life and politics and economics, that means we are taking other gods besides Allah.

And that's why when Odae Bin Hatim(عدئ بن حاتم) walked in; Rasool Allah ﷺ saw a cross hanging on his chest?

And Rasool Allah ﷺ said; They have taken their priests and the rabbi's Gods besides Allah.

Odae Bin Hatim(عدئ بن حاتم) said: No; We do not worship our priests.

He was a Christian who had the cross hanging on his chest.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Didn't your priests make the Halal(حلال); Haram(حرام) and the Haram(حرام); Halal(حلال)?

He said: Yes! He said that is worshipping them.

If you give a human being the authority to say that the Halal(حلال) is Haram(حرام) and the Haram(حرام) is Halal(حلال), you have taken him as a god besides Allah.

And that is what we have done in a lot of aspects of our life.

Actually the major portion of our life, we have given the authority to man and we have taken it from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So Yusuf(يوسُف) is telling them; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى the commandment belongs to Him and Allah has instructed you to worship none but Him.

That is the true religion; If you want the true religion that is the true religion.

But most men know not.

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجتَبيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأويلِ الأَحاديثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعمَتَهُ عَلَيكَ وَعَلىٰ آلِ يَعقوبَ

وَيُتِمُّ نِعمَتَهُ عَلَيكَ وَعَلىٰ آلِ يَعقوبَ كَما أَتَمَّها عَلىٰ أَبَوَيكَ مِن قَبلُ إِبراهيمَ وَإِسحاقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ۝

من أكرم الناس يوسُف الْكَرِيمُ ابنُ الكَرِيمِ ابْنِ الكَرِيمِ ابْنِ الكَرِيمِ يُوسُفُ إبنُ يَعْقُوبَ إبنِ إسْحاقَ إبنِ إبْراهِيمَ، عليهمُ السَّلاَمُ

لَقَد كانَ في يوسُفَ وَإِخوَتِهِ آياتٌ لِلسّائِلينَ۝

إِنَّ أَبانا لَفي ضَلالٍ مُبينٍ۝

وَنَحنُ عُصبَةٌ اقتُلوا يوسُفَ أَوِ اطرَحوهُ أَرضًا يَخلُ لَكُم وَجهُ أَبيكُم وَتَكونوا مِن بَعدِهِ قَومًا صالِحينَ۝

قالَ قائِلٌ مِنهُم لا تَقتُلوا يوسُفَ وَأَلقوهُ في غَيابَتِ الجُبِّ يَلتَقِطهُ بَعضُ السَّيّارَةِ إِن كُنتُم فاعِلينَ۝

قالوا يا أَبانا ما لَكَ لا تَأمَنّا عَلىٰ يوسُفَ وَإِنّا لَهُ لَناصِحونَ۝

قالَ إِنّي لَيَحزُنُني أَن تَذهَبوا بِهِ وَأَخافُ أَن يَأكُلَهُ الذِّئبُ وَأَنتُم عَنهُ غافِلونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمّا ذَهَبوا بِهِ وَأَجمَعوا أَن يَجعَلوهُ في غَيابَتِ الجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوحَينا إِلَيهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمرِهِم هٰذا وَهُم لا يَشعُرونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Yusuf(يوسُف); وَجاءوا أَباهُم عِشاءً يَبكونَ۝

قالوا يا أَبانا إِنّا ذَهَبنا نَستَبِقُ وَتَرَكنا يوسُفَ عِندَ مَتاعِنا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئبُ ۖ وَما أَنتَ بِمُؤمِنٍ لَنا وَلَو كُنّا صادِقينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَجاءوا عَلىٰ قَميصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قالَ بَل سَوَّلَت لَكُم أَنفُسُكُم أَمرًا ۖ فَصَبرٌ جَميلٌ ۖ وَاللَّهُ المُستَعانُ عَلىٰ ما تَصِفونَ۝

صبرٌ جميل الله المستعان فَاَرسِلو واردهم يا بُشرىٰ هٰذا غُلامٌ But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَشَرَوهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخسٍ دَراهِمَ مَعدودَةٍ وَكانوا فيهِ مِنَ الزّاهِدينَ۝

وَكانوا فيهِ مِنَ الزّاهِدينَ۝

وَقالَ الَّذِي اشتَراهُ مِن مِصرَ لِامرَأَتِهِ أَكرِمي مَثواهُ عَسىٰ أَن يَنفَعَنا أَو نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا ۚ ٱسْتَـْٔجِرْهُ ۖ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ ٱسْتَـْٔجَرْتَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْأَمِينُ

Musa(موسى).

وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنّا لِيوسُفَ فِي الأَرضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِن تَأويلِ الأَحاديثِ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنّا لِيوسُفَ فِي الأَرضِ

وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِن تَأويلِ الأَحاديثِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غالِبٌ عَلىٰ أَمرِهِ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَمّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيناهُ حُكمًا وَعِلمًا ۚ وربَّ حاملِ فِقهٍ إلى من هوَ أفقَهُ منهُ بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَغَلَّقَتِ الأَبوابَ

وَقالَت هَيتَ لَكَ ۚ قالَ مَعاذَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ رَبّي أَحسَنَ مَثوايَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لا يُفلِحُ الظّالِمونَ۝

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله).

قالَ مَعاذَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ رَبّي أَحسَنَ مَثوايَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لا يُفلِحُ الظّالِمونَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَلَقَد هَمَّت بِهِ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِها لَولا أَن رَأىٰ بُرهانَ رَبِّهِ ۚ وَلَقَد هَمَّت بِهِ ۖ وَرَجُلٌ دَعَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وَجَمَالٍ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ

دات حصبٍ وَجَمَالٍ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصرِفَ عَنهُ السّوءَ وَالفَحشاءَ ۚ إِنَّهُ مِن عِبادِنَا المُخلَصينَ۝

وَاستَبَقَا البابَ وَقَدَّت قَميصَهُ مِن دُبُرٍ وَأَلفَيا سَيِّدَها لَدَى البابِ ۚ قالَت ما جَزاءُ مَن أَرادَ بِأَهلِكَ سوءًا إِلّا أَن يُسجَنَ أَو عَذابٌ أَليمٌ۝

قالَ هِيَ راوَدَتني عَن نَفسي ۚ فَلَمّا رَأىٰ قَميصَهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ قالَ إِنَّهُ مِن كَيدِكُنَّ ۖ إِنَّ كَيدَكُنَّ عَظيمٌ۝

يوسُفُ أَعرِض عَن هٰذا ۚ وَاستَغفِري لِذَنبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ الخاطِئينَ۝

إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ الخاطِئينَ۝

وَاستَغفِري لِذَنبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ الخاطِئينَ۝

وَقالَ نِسوَةٌ فِي المَدينَةِ امرَأَتُ العَزيزِ تُراوِدُ فَتاها عَن نَفسِهِ ۖ قَد شَغَفَها حُبًّا ۖ قَد شَغَفَها حُبًّا ۖ إِنّا لَنَراها في ضَلالٍ مُبينٍ۝

فَمَرَرْتُ بِيُوسُفَ وَإِذَا هُوَ قَدْ أُعْطِيَ شَطْرَ الْحُسْنِ Adam(آدَم).

فَلَمّا رَأَينَهُ أَكبَرنَهُ وَقَطَّعنَ أَيدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلنَ حاشَ لِلَّهِ ما هٰذا بَشَرًا إِن هٰذا إِلّا مَلَكٌ كَريمٌ۝

قالَت فَذٰلِكُنَّ الَّذي لُمتُنَّني فيهِ ۖ وَلَقَد راوَدتُهُ عَن نَفسِهِ فَاستَعصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَم يَفعَل ما آمُرُهُ لَيُسجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكونًا مِنَ الصّاغِرينَ۝

قالَ رَبِّ السِّجنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمّا يَدعونَني إِلَيهِ ۖ وَإِلّا تَصرِف عَنّي كَيدَهُنَّ أَصبُ إِلَيهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِنَ الجاهِلينَ۝

وَإِلّا تَصرِف عَنّي كَيدَهُنَّ أَصبُ إِلَيهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِنَ الجاهِلينَ۝

فَاستَجابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ فَصَرَفَ عَنهُ كَيدَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ۝

ثُمَّ بَدا لَهُم مِن بَعدِ ما رَأَوُا الآياتِ لَيَسجُنُنَّهُ حَتّىٰ حينٍ۝

وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجنَ فَتَيانِ ۖ قالَ أَحَدُهُما إِنّي أَراني أَعصِرُ خَمرًا ۖ وَقالَ الآخَرُ إِنّي أَراني أَحمِلُ فَوقَ رَأسي خُبزًا تَأكُلُ الطَّيرُ مِنهُ ۖ نَبِّئنا بِتَأويلِهِ ۖ

إِنّا نَراكَ مِنَ المُحسِنينَ۝

قالَ لا يَأتيكُما طَعامٌ تُرزَقانِهِ إِلّا نَبَّأتُكُما بِتَأويلِهِ قَبلَ أَن يَأتِيَكُما ۚ ذٰلِكُما مِمّا عَلَّمَني رَبّي ۚ طَعامٌ تُرزَقانِهِ

ذٰلِكُما مِمّا عَلَّمَني رَبّي ۚ إِنّي تَرَكتُ مِلَّةَ قَومٍ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَهُم بِالآخِرَةِ هُم كافِرونَ۝

وَهُم بِالآخِرَةِ هُم كافِرونَ۝

وَاتَّبَعتُ مِلَّةَ آبائي إِبراهيمَ وَإِسحاقَ وَيَعقوبَ ۚ ما كانَ لَنا أَن نُشرِكَ بِاللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ فاستغفري لذنبك ذٰلِكَ مِن فَضلِ اللَّهِ عَلَينا وَعَلَى النّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَشكُرونَ۝

وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَشكُرونَ۝

يا صاحِبَيِ السِّجنِ يا صاحِبَيِ السِّجنِ يا صاحِبَيِ السِّجنِ يا صاحِبَيِ السِّجنِ أَأَربابٌ مُتَفَرِّقونَ خَيرٌ أَمِ اللَّهُ الواحِدُ القَهّارُ۝

ما تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِهِ إِلّا أَسماءً سَمَّيتُموها أَنتُم وَآباؤُكُم سَمَّيتُموها أَنتُم وَآباؤُكُم ما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِها مِن سُلطانٍ ۚ أَسماءً سَمَّيتُموها

ما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِها مِن سُلطانٍ ۚ إِنِ الحُكمُ إِلّا لِلَّهِ ۚ إِنِ الحُكمُ إِلّا لِلَّهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلّا تَعبُدوا إِلّا إِيّاهُ ۚ اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا من دون الله

إِنِ الحُكمُ إِلّا لِلَّهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلّا تَعبُدوا إِلّا إِيّاهُ ۚ ذٰلِكَ الدّينُ القَيِّمُ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ۝

وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
The Lives of Prophets Part 1; In sha Allah Ho Tala(إن شاء الله تعالى), we'll talk tonight about Khateeb Ul Ambiyaa(خطيب الأنبِيَاء) the Speaker of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), the orator of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given him eloquence in speech.

He had beautiful words of wisdom and advice, Naseeha(نَصيحة) that he delivered to his people.

His story is short but it is full of meanings for all of us and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not mention to us the story of any Nabi(نَبِي), except because there are lessons for us to learn.

Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام, we do not know exactly where he lies in terms of the chronological order.

He is from the descendants of Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

There are some scholars who say that Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) is the one, whom Qur'an talks about that Musa(موسى) married his daughter

but Qur'an does not specifically stated, it was Shoaib(شُعَيب).

It just says that Musa(موسى) went to Madyan(مدين) and he got married, to his wife in Madyan(مدين).

So some of the Ulama(علماء) concluded that it might be Shoaib(شُعَيب) because Shoaib(شُعَيب) was the Nabi(نَبِي) of Madyan(مدين).

So that's why I'll talk about Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) tonight after Saydina Ibrahim(سيِدنَااِبْراهِيْم) being from the descendants of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم),

but we don't know where exactly it comes in terms of the time order, but that's not a problem.

It wouldn't do us any benefit to know the timeline of these events and it won't do us any harm not to know when it happened because the essence of the lessons are there.

Whether it happened long time before Musa(موسى) or it happened in the time Musa(موسى) it doesn't make a difference and Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام made Da'wah(دعوة) to his people in Madyan(مدين).

Madyan(مدين) is the town, the area.

And to the people of Madyan(مدين), their brother Shoaib(شُعَيب).

What does brother here mean?

It means he is part of them, he's from those people.

But in another Ayah(آية), Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; The people of the Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ) disbelieved in the messengers, when Shoaib(شُعَيب) was sent to them.

Over here in this Ayah(آية) it didn't say Brother, even though in Surat-Ash'Shuara(سورة الشعراء) and this is from Surat-Ash'Shuara(سورة الشعراء)

when it talks about Aad(عاد) it says; their brother Hud(هود), when it talks about Thamud(ثمود) it says; there brother Saleh(صالح), when it talks about Lut(لوط),

brother Lut(لوط) but it didn't say their brother Shoaib(شُعَيب).

Why?

Because in that Ayah(آية) Allah was saying the people of Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ).

Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ) is a large tree, which they used to worship.

So Allah said: The people of Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ) and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى did not want to attribute Brotherhood to the people of Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ)

because Aikah(لْـَٔيْكَةِ) is a God that is taken besides Allah.

So Allah said: Shoaib(شُعَيب) without saying their brother, but when Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; when we sent to Madyan(مدين), Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said: Their brother, Shoaib(شُعَيب)

and this is a small note in terms of the difference in the Ayaat(آيات).

Worship Allah you have no other God but Him.

You have a clear sign from Allah.

So give full measure and full weight and wrong not men in their things.

Madyan(مَدْيَن) was on the trade route of Hijaz(حجاز) and Ash-Sham(ألشَّام).

It was a financial centre and the people of Madyan(مَدْيَن) were rich.

Their job was their work, or their trade was business.

But they were unfair in their business dealings.

And they used to cheat and they would not give full measure.

Give full measure and full weight, And do not cause corruption in the land.

The people of Shoaib(شُعَيب) even though they were wealthy, they were still cheating thinking that this is their source of Rizq(رزق) and that is Tadfeef Al-Mizan(تدفيف الميزان)

so you would put a weight and tell the person this is one pound but it's not it's less than that.

And they would also cheat in transactions.

We find that every Nabi(نَبِي) came with the same message and that is; There is no God but Allah but then the details of the message were different according to the situation of the people.

Last night when we talked about the people of Lut(لوط), their disease and illness was their lust.

So we find that Lut(لوط) was dealing with that problem.

The people of Madyan(مَدْيَن) their problem was in their business transactions, in their Muamalat(معاملات), they were cheating when it comes to money; they did not follow the law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And with the people of Aad(عاد) they had certain diseases with the people of Thamood(ثمود) they had certain diseases with Musa(موسى) and the story of Musa عليه السّلام we find that he was dealing with the dictatorship

and the oppression of Firaun(فرعون) on one side, and then he was dealing with the problems of his own Ummah(امة), the Muslims of that time Banu Israel(بنواسرائيل) on the other hand.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى mentions to us these stories in Qur'an because we are going to need every one of them because we are going to run into similar situations.

That's why Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is mentioning the stories in Qur'an.

So we are going to deal with problems similar to the problems that Lut(لوط) faced and these are the lust and the sexual desire put in places where it shouldn't be.

We are going to run into situations where people are cheating in business.

We are going to run into situations of oppressive governments like Firaun(فرعون).

We are going to run into the problem of dealing with our own Muslim brothers, who are not keeping the rule of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى just like Musa(موسى) was dealing with Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل)

and we are going to run into problems similar to every other story of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) mentioned  in Qur'an.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is mentioning for us, these stories for us to learn the lessons of how to deal with these particular situations.

The issue of business is a very, very important part of religion.

That we are taking very, very, very lightly because we find that there are some people who are the best in terms of their attendance to Salah(صلاة)

and their attachment to the Faraid(فرائض) of Islam and their application to many of the Sunnan(سنن) of Rasool Allah ﷺ they are the best in that

and on the other side they're the best in cheating, and Tadfeef Al-Mizan(تدفيف الميزان) and wronging others in business.

How could these two sides exist in the same person?

In the Masjid(مسجد), we could be in that state of devotion to worship, and just as we cross our feet outside of the door of the Masjid(مسجد), a completely different personality.

Inside the Masjid(مسجد) the Lord is Allah outside the Masjid(مسجد) the Lord is the dollar.

Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) was dealing with this problem and then we will find something interesting.

The response of his people was similar to the response of the people you will speak to today, when they are not keeping the right business transaction, so we'll get into that.

They also used to tax anybody who's passing through.

As-Sidi(ألسِّدِّي), one of the Mufassireen(مفسرين), he says these are the first people to start taxation and tariffs, Customs.

Whenever somebody is passing through Madyan(مَدْيَن), you have to pay customs.

As-Sidi(ألسِّدِّي) says these are the first people to start that before you would travel in and out and nobody would tax you and take from you customs.

Anybody who's passing going to Al-Hijaz(حجاز) going from Ash-Sham(ألشَّام) to Hijaz(حجاز) has to pay a tax if you're going from al Hijaz(حجاز) to Ash-Sham(ألشَّام), you have to pay them a tax.

In addition to that, they would rob sometimes some of these caravans that are going on the way and they would also prevent the people from becoming Muslim and listening to the message of Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب),

And O my people give full measure and weigh in injustice and reduce not the things that are due to the people and do not commit mischief in the land causing corruption;

that which is left by Allah for you is better for you.

Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) is telling them: Do not cheat and give full measure.

He is telling them give full measure and then give the Zaka'at(زكوة) and give the Sadaqah(صدقة) and what will remain of that is better for you.

Because people without Eeman(ايمان) tend to think that if I cheat I will be able to make more money.

That's the logic that we think with, when we don't have Eeman(ايمان).

Shoaib(شُعَيب) was telling them: No! That's wrong.

When you cheat and you make more money, you're not really making more money; you are losing.

If you give full measure you give the people what is due to them and then you give out for your money the obligations that you have towards the poor.

What will remain to you even though it seems less, but it is better for you.

Then the bigger amount that you can make through cheating.

What will remain for you is better for you and we find that this is approved through Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an and through Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Riba(رباء) interest is one of the things that increases your money.

If you are getting interest, you're taking interest; you're making more money, when you're dealing with interest, this is talking about the one who's taking interest.

When you take interest you're making more money; when you're giving Sadaqah(صدقة) you're losing money but the Ayah(آية) says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى destroys and decreases interest

and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى increases and expands Sadaqah(صدقة); charity.

It's the exact opposite of what we think.

Why?

Because we're missing a very, very important element in wealth and that is the issue of Barakah(بركة).

We think always in terms of numbers, exact numbers $200 is more than 100.

We are not including in the calculation, the concept of Barakah(بركة).

Barakah(بركة) is a secret that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى puts in the money.

So, the $100 could not only be more than 200, it could be more than 1000 because it has that secret element in it; called Barakah(بركة), blessing.

So $1 that has Barakah(بركة) could go a long way and $1 that does not have Barakah(بركة) could cause you  destruction.

And we see that a lot; you see that some people, they're living off a small amount of money, but they're having a very blessed and pleasant life, they're happy and they are content from an inside.

And you see that somebody else has a lot, but they're living a life of misery.

Why?

Because Barakah(بركة) is missing.

So Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) is telling his people, That which is left by Allah for you is better for you; if you are believers, and I'm not set over you as a guardian.

I'm not the Guardian over you; you are responsible for your own dealings and transactions.

What did the people of Shoaib(شُعَيب) say?

And this is you will find something similar in this and what the people would say today when you discuss such an issue with them.

They said; O Shoaib(شُعَيب) does your prayer command that we leave off what our fathers used to worship, or that we leave off doing, what we like to do with our money.

They're stating two things in this response.

First of all, they're saying, O Shoaib(شُعَيب); Your Salah(صلاة), they're talking about the Salah(صلاة) of Shoaib(شُعَيب) they are telling Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام what does prayer have to do with the religion of our fathers

and what does prayer have to do with business?

The explanation of this is; Number one, what does Salah(صلاة) have to do with the religion of our fathers?

In fact, they to be specific, they said: Does your prayer command that we leave off what our fathers used to worship?

They’re telling Shoaib(شُعَيب), go and pray in your room or in your office and close your office.

What does your prayer have to do with our religion?

Why do you pray and then come and tell us don't worship the religion of our fathers?

What does your prayer have to do with this?

You have your religion, we have ours; your Salah(صلاة) should not involve in this.

They want to separate between the religion of Shoaib(شُعَيب) and their religion.

So they're telling him, to stay and do whatever you want in your religion, but don't bother us.

Don't come and tell us that we're wrong?

What does Salah(صلاة) have to do with the religion of our fathers?

In your Salah(صلاة), your Salah(صلاة) is telling you that we should give up our religion?

And we find this similar in the response given by the Non-believers.

They would say that, keep your religion but don't try to propagate it on us and don't tell us about your religion.

You keep your religion and we'll keep ours and we'll be friends and we'll get along.

Now on the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى we have to give out the message of Risala(رسالة), the message of Islam.

The second thing that they stated, they said what does your Salah(صلاة) have to do with business?

What does your Salah(صلاة) have to do with business?

What do we call this today?

What do we call this concept today?

Secularism; This is secularism; separation between the religion and the aspects of life.

They said: Your Salah(صلاة), this is a ritual this is Ibadah(عبادة), what does it have to do with business?

This is a worship between you and your God but this business is something that has to do with this Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and this world.

We should separate between the two things leave what is for God for God and what is for Caesar for Caesar.

So, the concept of secularism is not new that people of Shoaib(شُعَيب) knew it a long time ago, and the Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) of today, the ignorance of today is not any different than the ignorance, a few 1000 years ago.

It's is the same thing.

So, they said that your Salah(صلاة) shouldn't tell us what to do in our business.

This is up to us and that is the problem with mankind when they don't want to follow the law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is not something that you keep in the Masjid(مسجد), or you keep as an individual, the law of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى applies to every aspect of our life.

All our lives should fall within the Hukum(حكم) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى controls everything in our livelihood; in the day and in the night whether it is politics, or it is economics or trade or banking, these other aspects of economics,

whether it is the civil law, whether it is the social relations, whether it is international law and the relations between nations, the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى controls all of this.

Now we're living at a time when there is an attempt to separate between the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and all of these aspects and to turn it into an issue of individual application inside that has no presentation in the outside

that has no manifestation in our actual life.

So if you want to keep your religion between you and yourself, that's fine but if you want to apply the religion and it's gonna affect the people around you and affect your family and affect the society,

No; that's unacceptable and that is secularism and that is what Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) tried to fight.

Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام insisted on these points and kept on making Da'wah(دعوة) to them because they didn't want to understand what he's saying and they didn't attempt to learn it.

They said; O Shoaib(شُعَيب)! We do not understand a lot of what you're saying, we don't understand.

This is not because Shoaib(شُعَيب) wasn't clear.

Syedina Shoaib(سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْب) was Khateeb Ul-Ambiyaa(خطيب الأنبِيَاء), he was the Speaker of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), the prophets.

He was very clear and very eloquent and he would drive the information to them as clear as possible but they didn't want to understand so they didn't understand.

They did not want to because they were shutting their ears.

They said; We don't understand what you're saying.

And then they said; And we see you as a weak man.

They only understand the language of force.

You're weak man.

We see you as weak, Daef(ضعيف) and the only reason, they're not getting rid of him, by killing him is; Were it not or for your family, we should certainly have stoned you and you are not powerful against us.

Shoaib عليه السّلام was from a noble strong family.

Why?

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ says; After Saydina Lut(سيدنالوط), Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has sent every messenger in a strong family.

We talked about Lut(لوط) last night when he said: I wish that I could lean on a source of power because Saydina Lut(سيدنالوط) didn't have any family members with him.

He was alone in Sadum(سدوم).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Any prophet that was sent after Lut(لوط) was sent in a strong family.

So Shoaib(شُعَيب) was sent in a strong family.

So, the people of Shoaib(شُعَيب) are saying; If it wasn't for your family, we would kill you and stone you and get rid of you and you can't do anything.

We have no respect for you as an individual and if it's not for the sake of your family, we would kill you.

The message is clear, we don't respect you, you're worthless in our eyes.

It's only for the sake of your family that we're sparing your life.

Look at the response of Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام.

He said; O my people, is my family have more weight to you than Allah?

You say that you don't want to kill me for my family?

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى you're not afraid of Him at all?

So you're keeping me alive not for the sake of Allah just because of my family.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى you're not including him in the equation at all.

He's telling them why should you respect me for my family, respect me for Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Fear Allah.

And you have cast Allah away behind your backs.

the things that were done by the brothers of Yusuf(يوسف) are not appropriate for the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

So he says that they are not Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) only Yusuf(يوسف) was a Nabi(نَبِي) and Yusuf(يوسف) is the only one out of them who specifically mentioned by name in Qur'an as a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The story of SadyinaYusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف) is unique in Qur'an because the whole story from the beginning to the end was mentioned in one Surah(سورة)

and it takes almost all of the Surah(سورة) with the exception of a few verses in the beginning and a few verses in the end the whole Surah(سورة) is talking about Sadyina Yusuf(سَيِّدنا يوسُف)

to give us a complete story and experience of a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى from the beginning till the end.

And the story of Yusuf(يوسُف) one of the Salaf(سلف), he says; Anybody who is going through trouble and problems and is feeling sorrow; If he reads the Surah(سورة) of Yusuf(يوسُف) it will eliminate it

because it's a story of someone who went through difficulty, but because he armed himself with Taqwa(تقوى) and Sabr(صبر) righteousness and patience, eventually he was victorious.

We relate unto Muhammad(محمد) the best of stories through our revelation on to have this Qur'an and before this, you were among those who knew nothing about it.

Yusuf( يوسُف) said; And Yusuf(يوسُف) in English Joseph.

O my father; Verily I saw in a dream 11 stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating themselves for me.

Yusuf(يوسُف) was very young at the time he was a child.

He saw this dream 11 planets and the Sun and the Moon are making Sujood(سجود), prostration to him.

So he told his father about this Dream.

His father told him; Oh my son relate not this vision of yours to your brothers.

He said: Don't tell your brothers about this vision.

Why?

Lest they arrange a plot against you.

The father knew that this dream means that Yusuf(يوسُف) will attain very high levels and that everyone in his family will be under him and the father knew that this is something the brothers will not accept

because they were already jealous of Yusuf(يوسُف) and we'll see how bad their jealousy was and then he said; Verily Satan is an enemy to humans.

Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is the one, who places these disputes among us; it is from Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).

Tell my servants to say a good word between themselves, say a good word because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) causes problems amongst you because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is your enemy.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is telling us, “say good words”.

The good word is a weapon against Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) because Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ) is using your words against you.

He's using your words to bring problems.

If we look at problems, most of them are caused because of what we say.

Say the best always speak the best and that will keep away from you a big part of the plot of Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ).
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ This Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى This Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is Syedina(سيدنا) Shoaib عليه السّلام.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِلىٰ مَديَنَ أَخاهُم شُعَيبًا ۚ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ۝إِذ قالَ لَهُم شُعَيبٌ أخاهم هودَا

أخاهم صالح أخاهم لوط Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says; إلى مدين قالَ يا قَومِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُم مِن إِلٰهٍ غَيرُهُ ۖ قَد جاءَتكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِن رَبِّكُم ۖ

قَد جاءَتكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِن رَبِّكُم ۖ فَأَوفُوا الكَيلَ وَالميزانَ وَلا تَبخَسُوا النّاسَ أَشياءَهُم Syedina(سَيِّدِنَا) Shoaib عليه السلام said;

فَأَوفُوا الكَيلَ وَالميزانَ وَلا تُفسِدوا فِي الأَرضِ لا اله إلَّا الله Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَيا قَومِ أَوفُوا المِكيالَ وَالميزانَ بِالقِسطِ ۖ وَلا تَبخَسُوا النّاسَ أَشياءَهُم وَلا تَعثَوا فِي الأَرضِ مُفسِدينَ۝

بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم مُؤمِنينَ ۚ بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيرٌ لَكُم Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; يَمْحَقُ اللّهُ الْرِّبَا but Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

يَمْحَقُ اللّهُ الْرِّبَا وَيُرْبِي الصَّدَقَاتِ Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) يَمْحَقُ اللّهُ الْرِّبَا وَيُرْبِي الصَّدَقَاتِ بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم مُؤمِنينَ ۚ

قالوا يا شُعَيبُ أَصَلاتُكَ تَأمُرُكَ أَن نَترُكَ ما يَعبُدُ آباؤُنا أَو أَن نَفعَلَ في أَموالِنا ما نَشاءُ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ الحَليمُ الرَّشيدُ۝

قالوا يا شُعَيبُ ما نَفقَهُ كَثيرًا مِمّا تَقولُ وَإِنّا لَنَراكَ فينا ضَعيفًا ۖ وَإِنّا لَنَراكَ فينا ضَعيفًا ۖ وَإِنّا لَنَراكَ فينا ضَعيفًا ۖ

وَإِنّا لَنَراكَ فينا ضَعيفًا ۖ وَلَولا رَهطُكَ لَرَجَمناكَ ۖ وَما أَنتَ عَلَينا بِعَزيزٍ۝

أما بعث الله النبي بعد لوط إلَّا في منعتٍ مِن قومه قالَ يا قَومِ أَرَهطي أَعَزُّ عَلَيكُم مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذتُموهُ وَراءَكُم ظِهرِيًّا ۖ

وَاتَّخَذتُموهُ وَراءَكُم ظِهرِيًّا ۖ أو غنن متغيَّ قالَ يا قَومِ أَرَأَيتُم إِن كُنتُ عَلىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِن رَبّي وَرَزَقَني مِنهُ رِزقًا حَسَنًا ۚ

وَما أُريدُ أَن أُخالِفَكُم إِلىٰ ما أَنهاكُم عَنهُ ۚ إِن أُريدُ إِلَّا الإِصلاحَ مَا استَطَعتُ ۚ وَما تَوفيقي إِلّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَإِلَيهِ أُنيبُ۝

وَيا قَومِ لا يَجرِمَنَّكُم شِقاقي أَن يُصيبَكُم مِثلُ ما أَصابَ قَومَ نوحٍ أَو قَومَ هودٍ أَو قَومَ صالِحٍ ۚ وَما قَومُ لوطٍ مِنكُم بِبَعيدٍ۝

وَاستَغفِروا رَبَّكُم ثُمَّ توبوا إِلَيهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبّي رَحيمٌ وَدودٌ۝

وَما أُريدُ أَن أُخالِفَكُم إِلىٰ ما أَنهاكُم عَنهُ ۚ أمر بالمعروف ونهي عن المنكر وَما أُريدُ أَن أُخالِفَكُم إِلىٰ ما أَنهاكُم عَنهُ ۚ إِن أُريدُ إِلَّا الإِصلاحَ مَا استَطَعتُ ۚ

ما لا يدرك كل لا يترك جُلُّ مفاتح ألشر إِن أُريدُ إِلَّا الإِصلاحَ مَا استَطَعتُ ۚ وَما تَوفيقي إِلّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ وَما تَوفيقي إِلّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ

عليه توكلت نحن متوكلون إِذا نودِيَ لِلصَّلاةِ مِن يَومِ الجُمُعَةِ فَاسعَوا إِلىٰ ذِكرِ اللَّهِ عقلها وتوكل أَنَّكُمْ تَوَكَّلْتُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ، تَغْدُوا خِمَاصاً وَتَرُوْحُ بِطَاناً

وَيا قَومِ لا يَجرِمَنَّكُم شِقاقي أَن يُصيبَكُم مِثلُ ما أَصابَ قَومَ نوحٍ أَو قَومَ هودٍ أَو قَومَ صالِحٍ ۚ وَما قَومُ لوطٍ مِنكُم بِبَعيدٍ۝

وَما قَومُ لوطٍ مِنكُم بِبَعيدٍ۝

وَما قَومُ لوطٍ مِنكُم بِبَعيدٍ۝

وَاستَغفِروا رَبَّكُم ثُمَّ توبوا إِلَيهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبّي رَحيمٌ وَدودٌ۝

نستغفرالله العظيم وَقالَ المَلَأُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن قَومِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعتُم شُعَيبًا إِنَّكُم إِذًا لَخاسِرونَ۝

فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الرَّجفَةُ فَأَصبَحوا في دارِهِم جاثِمينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا شُعَيبًا كَأَن لَم يَغنَوا فيهَا ۚ الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا شُعَيبًا كانوا هُمُ الخاسِرينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَتَوَلّىٰ عَنهُم وَقالَ يا قَومِ لَقَد أَبلَغتُكُم رِسالاتِ رَبّي وَنَصَحتُ لَكُم ۖ فَكَيفَ آسىٰ عَلىٰ قَومٍ كافِرينَ۝

فَكَيفَ آسىٰ عَلىٰ قَومٍ كافِرينَ۝

وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ۝

and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ۝

and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; كان نبيًا إِلّا ما حَرَّمَ إِسرائيلُ عَلىٰ نَفسِهِ مِن قَبلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ التَّوراةُ ۗ Who is a Nabi(نَبِي) of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

قُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ

لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ۝

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), Is'haq(إسحاق), Yaqoob(يعقوب) and Al-Asbat(ألأسباط) Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; نَحنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيكَ أَحسَنَ القَصَصِ بِما أَوحَينا إِلَيكَ هٰذَا القُرآنَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبلِهِ لَمِنَ الغافِلينَ۝

إِذ قالَ يوسُفُ لِأَبيهِ يا أَبَتِ إِنّي رَأَيتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوكَبًا وَالشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ رَأَيتُهُم لي ساجِدينَ۝

قالَ يا بُنَيَّ لا تَقصُص رُؤياكَ عَلىٰ إِخوَتِكَ فَيَكيدوا لَكَ كَيدًا ۖ إِنَّ الشَّيطانَ لِلإِنسانِ عَدُوٌّ مُبينٌ۝

من عمل الشيطان And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَانِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا۝

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
The Lives Of The Prophets Part 1, by the way, Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) made many visits to Makkah.

One of these visits in a Hadith(حديث) narrated by Bukhari(بخاريْ); Ibrahim عليه السّلام comes to Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) and tell him, we have been commanded to build the house of Allah.

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) started building the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

The spot of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), the spot itself is sacred and holy since the earth was created.

It's a sacred land since the time of Adam(آدَم).

And that spot was known and Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) used to make Hajj(حَجْ) to that area, the spot itself.

But there is a dispute and difference among the Ulama(علماء) whether Adam(آدَم) has built anything over there or not.

Most likely, the first one who established the house is Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

But the spot itself was holy from before.

It didn't become holy, the moment in which Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه)  was built on it.

No! That spot itself is, is holy and sacred, just like Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(ألمسجد ألأقصي), when Rasool Allah ﷺ visited the Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(ألمسجد ألأقصي) in the trip of Al-Isra(ألأسراء), there wasn't anything built there.

In fact, when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) opened Jerusalem it was used as a dumpster there was garbage in that spot.

But still that was Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa(ألمسجد ألأقصي)  that was the holy sacred mosque.

And then the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم and in the time of Abdul Malik Bin Marwan(عبدالملك بن مروان) they built the two mosques that are enclosed in that Haram(حرم),

but before it was a piece of land.

What makes it special, it's a piece of land.?

What makes Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) the land under it special, when it's a desert and nothing grows there.

It's desert what makes it special?

Allah  creates everything He wants, and He chooses out of them.

Allah chooses the best, Allah chooses the worst, Allah chooses what is in between, it's up to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allah is the One, Who created the days and Allah is the One, Who chose the best of them to be Friday.

Allah is the One, Who created the days of the year and chose Eid- Al-Ad'haa(عيدالأضحى) and Eid-Ul-Fitr(عيدالفطر) to be the best.

Allah created the month and chose Ramadan(رمضان) to be the holy month of fasting.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who created the days and gave the most reward for the 10 days of Dhul-Hijjah(ذوالحجة).

Allah is the One, Who created the nights and Allah has given the special rewards and the nights of Ramadan(رمضان).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى also created the nights and He has made the special night Lailat-Ul-Qadr(ليلة القدر).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى created the earth and He chose Makkah and Madina and Bat-Ul-Maqsad(بيت المقدس) to be special.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who created human beings and they chose Muhammadﷺ to be the best among them.

Allah creates whatever He wants and then He chooses of them.

So that area, it doesn't have to be a certain dimension and certain physical characteristics and certain shape and certain plants for it, to be special.

These are not the conditions and requirements that apply to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى because Allah is free of all of these rules and regulations, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is the creator.

So that spot was holy sacred from the beginning of the creation of the earth.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) started building the house, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; And remember when Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and his son Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) were raising the foundations of the house.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Ismail عليه السّلام, when they were building the house of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى they had Dua(دُعَا).

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says and remember when Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and his son Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), were raising the foundations of the house saying;

Our Lord accept the service from us verily You are the All Hearer, the All Knower, O Allah accept this from us.

Our Lord, and make us submissive unto You, and of our offspring and nation submissive unto You, and show us our Manasic(مناسك), the Hajj(حَجْ), how to do Hajj(حَجْ)?

Our Lord, send amongst them a messenger of their own, who shall recite unto them Your verses and instruct them in the book and Sanctify them, verily you are Almighty and All Wise.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), they asked Allah to accept it from them.

And they asked Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to make them submissive to Allah; Muslimeen(مسلمين) and they asked Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, to make their descendants submissive to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And then they asked Allah to send among these people a Nabi(نَبِي).

Who's that Nabi(نَبِي) ?

Muhammadﷺ Allah accepted the Dua(دُعَا).

They asked Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to give this Nabi(نَبِي) three things.

He recites unto them Your verses, He teaches them, the book and wisdom, what is wisdom?

Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Sanctify them and purify them.

So Muhammadﷺ  purifies us.

Tazkia(تزكية) purifies us.

Following the way of Muhammadﷺ is the purification for us.

Because if you look at the Da'wah(دعوة) of Muhammadﷺ, you see that he has started out with men that had hearts like rock.

And then look at how Rasool Allah ﷺ carried them from this state and He elevated them to Make them the best generation that lived on the face of the earth.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى accepted the Dua(دُعَا) of Ibrahim عليه السّلام and sent to this Ummah(امة) Muhammadﷺ.

We'll finish up with the story of Ibrahim عليه السّلام by mentioning some of his qualities.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام is from Ulul Azm-e-Min-Ar-Rusul(اولي العزم من الرسل).

Ulul Azm-e-Min-Ar-Rusul(اولي العزم من الرسل) I can't find an exact translation of it.

But they are five Ulul Azm(اولي العزم) and these are the greatest of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah.

They are five; Muhammadﷺ, Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), Musa(موسى), Eesa(عيسى) and Nuh(نوح).

They said; we don't have any need in your daughter's; You know what we want?

You know what we want; We want your guests.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى describes this difficult critical situation; crowds celebrating outside and writing outside the house of Lut(لوط), pushing the door to come in.

Lut(لوط) said; This is a distressful difficult day.

What a difficult day.

The pressure was building on Lut(لوط) building and building and building he is carrying all of this pressure on his shoulders.

He then said; This is a distressful day.

He's trying his best, but he's losing grounds.

And when he felt that this is a hopeless case, and that he's losing this battle, he wanted help.

But Lut(لوط) did not belong to that town, so he didn't have any family to help him.

He didn't have a tribal support; to support him.

And Lut(لوط) didn't have any sons, he had daughters.

He didn't have any men to fight with him; he was alone.

In that moment of difficulty in that critical moment and extreme moments of distress on Sayedina Lut(سيدنالوط).

He said the following statement; If only I had a source of power to lean on.

I wish that I have a source of power to lean on; So, that I can fight you.

family or tribe or men or sons.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; May Allah have mercy on Lut(لوط), he had the strongest source of power with him; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

In that particular moment when Lut(لوط) said that statement; I wish that I can kneel on some source of power.

In that moment, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says that the angel said; Oh Lut(لوط), we are the messengers of Allah, they will not reach you and harm you.

These three men finally spoke out in that moment, just one second before the defeat of Lut(لوط) because that's what these men were crowding and were breaking in.

And in that moment in which Lut(لوط) said: I wish that I have a source of power to lean on.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He had the strongest power with him.

He had Allahسُبحانه وتعالى on his side.

The angel then spoke up and said; Oh, Lut(لوط), we are the messengers of Allah; Do not fear and they will not reach you.

And then they said; Leave with your family in the darkness of the night.

And nobody of you look back; when you leave do not look back.

Except your wife.

There are two interpretations on this.

One interpretation is that do not take your wife with you, leave her in town.

The other interpretation is that she would leave with you but then she would look back and she would be killed.

She would be punished with the same punishment they are punished.

And then they said; Their appointed time is morning; Isn't morning soon.?

Lut(لوط) left, under darkness of night with his daughters and his family.

Early in the morning with sunrise when Lut(لوط) is already away from Sedoon(سدون); he walked away.

Suddenly; أصيحة ; the awful cry attacked the people of Lut(لوط) and then the angel Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) transformed out of this human form into his original angelic form.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), which was in the form of a man came out in his angelic form to fill the horizon with 700 wings.

And then Jibreel عليه السّلام with the tip of his wing, with the tip of his wings; not with all wing; with the tip of his wing; scraped up, the whole town of the people of Lut(لوط)

and raised them up in the sky, and then flip them upside down and smash them back to Earth.

And then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى sent on them stones, everyone received the stone with his name.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has never ever combined such a punishment on any people in history.

They were afflicted with the awful cry and then they were raised up and turned upside down.

And then they received missiles from the sky to destroy them all and to exterminate them from the face of the earth.

The awful cry overtook them at the time of sunrise, and we turn them upside down and rain down on them stones of baked clay.

Surely, in this our science for those who see.

I want to close with this verse.

But before that, let's look at the conditions we're living in.

We're living now in a society that is starting to recognize homosexuals as a minority group that deserves special status and deserves special rights.

We are living in a society that now is publicly promoting this in media, TV movies.

We're living in a society that is now officially in some places marrying them.

We are living in a society that regards them as a group that needs to be defended.

These things that exist in America and the West today, we need to understand and realize according to my information, according to my knowledge,

never ever in the history of mankind, since Lut(لوط) until now, whether we're talking about pagans, or Muslims, or Christians, or Jews or any other religion,

never has this sin, been promoted publicly as it is being promoted today in the West.

And look at all of the societies of the world; I'm not talking about Muslims only.

This is something that is not viewed with any respect in any religion.

In every culture and society, whether we're talking about Asia, India or China, Japan, Africa, Europe up to this time, nobody in the world since the time of Lut(لوط), until now;

allowed such a sin to be promoted publicly, and to be sanctified by the law, except the societies of the West that we are living in today.

And we need to realize that if this sin is promoted and becomes public, and is protected by law, then Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will bring down his punishment

because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى after this Ayaat(آيات) of Lut(لوط), says; And this punishment is not far away from the evildoers,

this punishment will come down on any society that promotes such a sin.

This sin does exist in every society of the world, but it's underground, and that people despise it, and that people dislike it, and they make fun of anybody who commits it and they are outcasts of this society.

In any place in the world, Muslim or non Muslim, except in the West today, it is looked upon right now, and we could get to that stage in the future, where for some people, they view it as an honor.

That is how evil things became.

This is the perception we need to have about this sin, that this is something that Allahسُبحانه وتعالى will not allow to happen.

And this is something that will draw the punishment of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and we make our voice clear, and we say; We disapprove the sin, we disapprove it severely.

We view that this is Haram(حرام) and then it should be punished.

And we do not approve of any public promotion of such a sin.

And we'll make it a statement that we say aloud and clearly to everyone and we're not afraid and we say, even if they accuse us of discrimination, or accuse us of extremism or fundamentalism, this is our religion.

This is the religion of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

We severely disapproved this.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ Abrahim عليه السّلام came to Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل)

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ وَإِذ يَرفَعُ إِبراهيمُ القَواعِدَ مِنَ البَيتِ وَإِسماعيلُ رَبَّنا تَقَبَّل مِنّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ۝

رَبَّنا وَاجعَلنا مُسلِمَينِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنا أُمَّةً مُسلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنا مَناسِكَنا وَتُب عَلَينا ۖ وَتُب عَلَينا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوّابُ الرَّحيمُ۝

رَبَّنا وَابعَث فيهِم رَسولًا مِنهُم يَتلو عَلَيهِم آياتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الكِتابَ وَالحِكمَةَ وَيُزَكّيهِم ۚ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الكِتابَ وَالحِكمَةَ وَيُزَكّيهِم ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ۝

يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الكِتابَ وَالحِكمَةَ وَيُزَكّيهِم كان أمة كان أمة Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said: Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was an Ummah(امة)

حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ۝

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِذِ ابتَلىٰ إِبراهيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِماتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ

وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ قالَ إِنّي جاعِلُكَ لِلنّاسِ إِمامًا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; Touheed(توحيد);

لا إله إلَّا الله لا إله إلَّا الله لا إله إلَّا الله أَتَأتونَ الذُّكرانَ مِنَ العالَمينَ۝

وَتَذَرونَ ما خَلَقَ لَكُم رَبُّكُم مِن أَزواجِكُم ۚ بَل أَنتُم قَومٌ عادونَ۝

وَلوطًا إِذ قالَ لِقَومِهِ أَتَأتونَ الفاحِشَةَ وَأَنتُم تُبصِرونَ۝

وَلوطًا إِذ قالَ لِقَومِهِ إِنَّكُم لَتَأتونَ الفاحِشَةَ ما سَبَقَكُم بِها مِن أَحَدٍ مِنَ العالَمينَ۝

أَئِنَّكُم لَتَأتونَ الرِّجالَ وَتَقطَعونَ السَّبيلَ وَتَأتونَ في ناديكُمُ المُنكَرَ ۖ وَتَقطَعونَ السَّبيلَ وَتَأتونَ في ناديكُمُ المُنكَرَ ۖ

وَما كانَ جَوابَ قَومِهِ إِلّا أَن قالوا أَخرِجوهُم مِن قَريَتِكُم ۖ إِنَّهُم أُناسٌ يَتَطَهَّرونَ۝

إِنَّهُم أُناسٌ يَتَطَهَّرونَ قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ الْقَالِينَ۝

رَبِّ نَجِّني وَأَهلي مِمّا يَعمَلونَ۝

فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ قالوا لا تَخَف قالوا لا تَخَف إِنّا أُرسِلنا إِلىٰ قَومِ لوطٍ۝

فضحك وَامرَأَتُهُ قائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَت فَبَشَّرناها بِإِسحاقَ وَمِن وَراءِ إِسحاقَ يَعقوبَ۝

وَمِن وَراءِ إِسحاقَ يَعقوبَ۝

فسكت وجه إِنَّ هٰذا لَشَيءٌ عَجيبٌ هذا امرٌ عجيب ، هٰذا لَشَيءٌ عَجيبٌ أَتَعجَبينَ مِن أَمرِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَٰهَا بِإِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ۝

رحمة الله وبركاته عليكم اهل البيت فَلَمّا ذَهَبَ عَن إِبراهيمَ الرَّوعُ وَجاءَتهُ البُشرىٰ يُجادِلُنا في قَومِ لوطٍ۝

إِنَّ إِبراهيمَ لَحَليمٌ أَوّاهٌ مُنيبٌ۝

يا إِبراهيمُ أَعرِض عَن هٰذا ۖ إِنَّهُ قَد جاءَ أَمرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُم آتيهِم عَذابٌ غَيرُ مَردودٍ۝

إِنَّهُ قَد جاءَ أَمرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُم آتيهِم عَذابٌ غَيرُ مَردودٍ۝

ولله ما أعلم على وجه الأرض أحد أفسد نهاية من هذه القرية وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ۝

ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذينَ كَفَرُوا امرَأَتَ نوحٍ وَامرَأَتَ لوطٍ ۖ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ۝

يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لَعمرك لَعمرك لَعَمرُكَ إِنَّهُم لَفي سَكرَتِهِم يَعمَهونَ۝

أعمل بصيرة Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَجاءَهُ قَومُهُ يُهرَعونَ إِلَيهِ وَمِن قَبلُ كانوا يَعمَلونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ قال إن هؤلاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون ۝

واتقوا الله ولا تخزون ۝

فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلا تُخزونِ۝

قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

قالَ هٰؤُلاءِ بَناتي إِن كُنتُم فاعِلينَ۝

ما لنا إنك لا تعلم ما نريد هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ۝

يرحم الله لوط قالوا يا لوطُ إِنّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلوا إِلَيكَ ۖ فَأَسرِ بِأَهلِكَ بِقِطعٍ مِنَ اللَّيلِ وَلا يَلتَفِت مِنكُم أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امرَأَتَكَ ۖ

إِلَّا امرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ مُصيبُها ما أَصابَهُم ۚ إِنَّ مَوعِدَهُمُ الصُّبحُ ۚ أَلَيسَ الصُّبحُ بِقَريبٍ۝

وَلا يَلتَفِت مِنكُم أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ مُصيبُها ما أَصابَهُم ۚ إِنَّ مَوعِدَهُمُ الصُّبحُ ۚ أَلَيسَ الصُّبحُ بِقَريبٍ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ مُشرِقينَ۝

فَجَعَلنا عالِيَها سافِلَها وَأَمطَرنا عَلَيهِم حِجارَةً مِن سِجّيلٍ۝

إِنَّ في ذٰلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِلمُتَوَسِّمينَ۝

وَما هِيَ مِنَ الظّالِمينَ بِبَعيدٍ۝

قالَ إِنّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِنَ القالينَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّم

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets, Part 1 They lost in the Battle of dialogue.

They lost up till that moment it was a dialogue between Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and them.

Whenever the Kuffar(كفار) lose in the battle of dialogue, they don't admit and they go to the next level and that is actual fighting and physical fighting.

They did that with Muhammadﷺ Muhammadﷺ had a dialogue with them.

And they were arguing in the beginning and they obviously definitely lost, you cannot stand against the Hujjah(حجة) of Allah سبحانه تعالى the evidence of Qur'an you can't stand against it.

So when they lost in the field of dialogue, then they resulted to force.

Burn him.

We can't deal with him, we can't debate with him with our minds, burn him.

They said burn him and help your Gods, if you will be doing.

Burn him.

This is an admission of failure.

When they said: Burn him! This is an admission of failure.

It's an admission from their side that they're not able to have a dialogue with him.

They lost, they resulted to force.

It says in the books of Tafseer(تفسير) that they set up a fire it took them days and days to gather the wood for it.

And they set up this trench and they filled it with logs and they set fire to it and the flames are so high that a bird would fly over it and fall down dead, huge fire.

And they had to throw Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) with a catapult, Manjneeq(منجنيق).

So they put Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) in this catapult and they threw him, in the fire.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) landed in the fire.

Fire, which we know burns.

But who's the One, Who created fire?

and Who is the One, Who made fire burn?

Are the laws of nature mandatory on Allah سبحانه وتعالى Allah has to follow them.?

Allah is the One, Who created these laws to start with.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى, who created the fire to burn, can make the fire and air condition.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام landed in this fire, that burns.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى ordered the fire because the fire is a servant of Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

Oh fire! Be cool and peace, tranquility on Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

It is said that Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) later, would say that the most pleasant moments that I had in my life were those moments when I was sitting in the fire.

The best moments that he had in his life the most peaceful moments, were those moments when Allah سبحانه وتعالى told the burning fire; Oh fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

Allah سبحانه وتعالى can change everything for you.

Allah made the sun stop, for Yusha Bin Noon(يوشع بن نون), Allah سبحانه وتعالى made the sea split for Musa(موسى), Allah سبحانه وتعالى made all diseases vanish under the hand of Syedina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى),

Allah سبحانه وتعالى made the moon split, for Muhammadﷺ, Allah سبحانه وتعالى made the fire wholeness and safety for Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى can do whatever He wants for the believer, we have to have trust in Allah سبحانه وتعالى and Tawakkul(توكل) that Allah will give you victory, if you follow the orders of Allah.

You don't need anything else, you don't need anything.

All what we need is Allah سبحانه وتعالى, all what you need is Allah سبحانه وتعالى, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), and what was the Dua(دُعَا) of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), when he was thrown in the fire?

Allah is sufficient for me, Allah is enough, I do not need the help of anyone.

Allah is sufficient for me and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

I do not need anyone but Allah سبحانه وتعالى, it says in the Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al-Bukhari(بخاريْ), Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) said; Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) says;

Allah is sufficient for us and the best disposal of our affairs.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) said it, when he was thrown in the fire and Muhammadﷺ said it, when he was threatened and told that the enemies are gathering for you so fear them

that made them increase in their Eeman(ايمان).

And they said Allah sufficient for us and is the best Disposer of affairs.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was threatened, that the enemies are mobilizing and gathering to fight you, so fear them the people were telling Muhammadﷺ to fear the enemy.

that made their Eeman(ايمان) increase.

And they wanted to harm him, but we made them the worst losers, Allah سبحانه وتعالى says: And we saved him and Lut(لوط) to the land which we blessed,

and we'll get to that in the Hijrah(هجرة) of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), later.

After this event happened, the king of Babylon at the time was An-Namrood(ألنمرود).

So An-Namrood(ألنمرود) heard about this young man, who performed this miracle.

Who is he?

Bring him forward.

So they brought Ibrahim عليه السّلام, this young man to debate with the king, An-Namrood(ألنمرود), the powerful dictator tyrant, An-Namrood(ألنمرود).

So, An-Namrood(ألنمرود) have this debate or dialogue with Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) told the king, Allah سبحانه وتعالى is the One, Who gives life and the One, Who takes it away.

Can you do that?

And An-Namrood(ألنمرود) said: Yes.

I can give life and I can take it away.

How?

He said: Call two people from jail, call two men from jail.

So they brought these two men from jail.

He commanded his soldiers to execute one of them.

And he told the second one, you're free.
