And he left to them some water.

Hajar(هَاجَر) couldn't believe what's happening.

How could we be left over here in the middle of nowhere desert?

So, she followed Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

Are you going to leave us here?

Who are you going to leave us with?

There's no plants, there's no people, there's nothing.

Who are you going to leave us with?

And Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was not answering, and he's walking away, he didn't even look back.

And she repeated the question Who are you going to leave us with?

He's walking away.

She's following him.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), how are you going to leave us here, there's nothing here there's no people.

And Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was completely ignoring her and not even looking back.

Then finally she asked him a question.

She said: Is this a commandment from Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

Finally, Ibrahim عليه السّلام responded and said: Yes.

Sayidit'na Hajar(سيدتنا هاجر) said; Then Allah سبحانه وتعالى will not neglect us.

That's it.

She didn't talk with him further.

Allah told you to do this? Yes.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى will take care of us, He will not neglect us.

This is the Eeman(ايمان) of this mother - Hajar(هَاجَر) - the mother of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

This is her Eeman(ايمان).

She's in the desert, dry desert, no one is there.

She doesn't even have enough food.

All what she have is dates and water, something that we would complain about.

If we're told to live on for one day not to make a living off water on dates.

And her husband is leaving her alone, a helpless mother.

Hajar(هَاجَر) sat down, she would breastfeed him and she would eat from that dates.

Drink from the water, until she ran out of dates and ran out of water and ran out of milk.

Now Syedina Ismail عليه السّلام is crying and weeping and Rasool Allah ﷺ described him and said; He was curling.

Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) was curling on himself because of the hunger.

And he was hitting the ground with his feet.

And he was crying as if he was dying.

At that moment, Hajar(هَاجَر) could not sit down any further.

Even though there's nowhere to go, but she couldn't handle seeing her child dying in front of her eyes.

So she went on top of a mountain that was close to her, she climbed that mountain.

And that mountain was As-Suffa(ألصفاء) and she looks on top of the mountain if she can see anyone.

She saw no one.

She walk down the mountain, and then she ran through the valley.

And then she climbed another mountain.

The name of that mountain is Al-Marwa(ألمروة).

She got to the top of the mountain, looking around if she can see anyone she saw no one.

So she was down the mountain ran through the valley climbed on As-Suffa(ألصفاء) again.

And she kept on doing that for seven times.

And that is the Sunnah(سنة) of Sayiditna Hajar(سيدتناهَاجَر) that we are doing today in Hajj(حَجْ).

Every one of us is making that site.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Sayiditna Hajar(سيدتناهَاجَر) at that moment, was afraid, had fear in her heart, she was running with worry.

If she knew what will happen, she would be climbing those mountains with a big smile on her face.

If she knew that the nations of the world, millions and millions of them are going to follow her tracks and follow her Sunnah(سنة) and follow her way, she would be making that trip with a big smile on her face.

And this is the Rizq(رزق) that Allah سبحانه وتعالى gives to you from the doors that you don't expect.

If you have Taqwa(تقوى) of Allah سبحانه وتعالى, Allah سبحانه وتعالى will provide for you Rizq(رزق) from places you never expect.

When she got on top of Al-Marwa(ألمروة), and that's the end of the seventh showed, the seventh climbing.

She heard the voice.

She said - ساة - quite, who she's speaking to.

She's speaking to herself out of confusion.

She's telling herself, Be quiet.

And then is trying to listen.

She heard the voice again, she said; If you have any help, I'm able to hear you. Where are you?

And then she looked around to see in the spot where Ismael عليه السّلام was laying down.

The child, the two year old child, the helpless child, the child that is crying, helpless.

She saw an angel, leader of the angels, Jibreel عليه السّلام descended, especially to that spot where Ismael عليه السّلام was laying down and Angel started picking up, the dirt with his wink or with his foot, until water started flowing from the ground.

Rizq(رزق) of Allah that came for a helpless child.

So she came down, Sayiditna Hajar(سيدتناهَاجَر).

This water of Zam-Zam(زمزم) came out through divine will of Allah سبحانه وتعالى a commandment to the angel Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), when the water was coming out with the will of Allah سبحانه وتعالى

Sayiditna Hajar(سيدتناهَاجَر) intervene by making a pool around the water.

Because this water was coming out in a desert, so she thought that this water is gonna flow on the sand and go into Earth and she's not gonna see it.

She intervenes and she started saying them Zam-Zam(زمزم), Zam-Zam(زمزم) and she's collecting dirt around it to make a pool.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: If Hajar(هَاجَر) would have left it alone, it would have been a flowing river.

She intervened in it, if she would have left alone it would have been a flowing river, but she intervene and it became the well of Zam-Zam(زمزم).

Now Sayiditna Hajar(سيدتناهَاجَر) has water, but she doesn't have food, and she doesn't have company.

So she still needs the social needs and psychological needs.

There was a tribe called Jurhum(جرهم), an Arab tribe, Bedouins traveling in that area.

They saw in the sky, birds hovering, birds in the desert means water.

They said: We know that there's no water over there. So what are these birds doing?

All of this that I'm mentioning to you is from long Hadith(حديث) in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

So they sent one or two men to go and investigate.

So the men went rushing.

They came back with the good news that there's water in the middle of the desert, this group of Jurhum(جرهم), they moved towards the source of water.

And they came there, they arrived there to find this woman and her child.

So they asked a strange question and they got an even stranger answer.

Their question was, would you allow us to camp here?

Would you allow us to camp here?

What is strange about this?

These are a group of men, fighters in the middle of the desert, taking permission from a woman and her child.

If they wanted, they could have eliminated her with a move of a hand.

With a strike of a sword, she could have been over with.

But they were very noble.

So they came and asked her that strange question, would you give us permission to stay here?

Because in the desert, if you have water, that's where you want to be.

And they got a strange answer.

She said; Yes! But you have no rights in the water, the water belongs to us.

And what's strange about that answer, the strange thing about it, is that she is in no position to negotiate and bargain.

And nevertheless she is saying; You have no right in the water, if you want to stay here, you have to stay on our terms, the water belongs to us.

But they accepted, they said: Yes, we agree.

And that is how Jurhum(جرهم) came to stay in that area.

And this is the beginning of the settlement.

Now let me go back when Ibrahim عليه السّلام left Hajar(هَاجَر) and her son in that spot.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) walked away, until he got to As-Saniya(ألثنية).

And he made Dua(دُعَا) for them.

It's not easy for a father, very old to leave his only son and his wife in the middle of nowhere, it's not easy.

We do not feel safe leaving our families alone in settled, established secure areas.

It wasn't easy for Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) to leave.

So he stopped and made Dua(دُعَا) to Allah because that is who we seek help from.

We seek help from no-one but Allah.

And he made a Dua(دُعَا).

What was the Dua(دُعَا) of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

He said; O Allah; I have left my descendant, my family in a valley that is barren and dry in fertile no rain, no trees can grow in that place.

Why?

so that they may establish prayer.

In that moment of difficulty, in that moment which we would naturally think about the safety and the food and the drink of my child and my wife,

Ibrahim عليه السّلام is thinking about Salah(صلاة).

Something similar to it because the Sahabah(صحابه) are trained under the head of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) Muhammadﷺ.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ was talking about Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) and Rasool Ullah said that the Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) will remain among you for 40 days.

One day is equal to a year, one day is equal to a month and then, one day is equal to week, and the rest of the days are like your regular days.

So one day is equal to a year, the Sahabah(صحابه) had a question about that.

One day is equal to a year what do you think their question was?

I mean, Rasool Ullah was talking about the big Fitnah(فِتْنَه) of Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) and he's talking about a day that is equal to a year.

What is the thought that came on the minds of the Sahabah(صحابه) they said; Is it enough for us to pray in that day like this prayer of one day.

The Sahabah(صحابه) are thinking about Salah(صلاة) in the time of Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال).

Rasool Ullah is talking about Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) and the Fitnah(فِتْنَه) of Ad-Dajjal(ألدجال) and the Sahabah(صحابه) are thinking about Salah(صلاة).

Anyway Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) said; so that they would establish prayer and then he made the Dua(دُعَا) of the other needs.

We're not saying we don't seek assistance from Allah, to give us Rizq(رزق). No; We don't say that we don't seek assistance from Allah to provide for us in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا). No;

We ask Allah for that.

But we have to give right proportion, We asked Allah for Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) and we ask Allah for Aakhirah(آخِرة).

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) mentioned the duty of Islam and that is the establishment of Salah(صلاة) and then he said; So make flocks of people love them and come to them and provide from them fruits.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) that Dua(دُعَا) that was done in the desert, in the empty desert.

Look at the fulfillment of the Dua(دُعَا) of Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

People are coming from all over the world to that place.

There is no place in the world that is more loved than Makkah.

Because of the attraction that Allah سبحانه وتعالى put in that house.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى has given an amazing description to the house of Allah.

Allah says; Masaba(مَثَابَةً), when the young camel goes to play after it plays for a while it has to go back and see its mother.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says that the house of Allah is Masaba(مَثَابَةً) you go there, you get stuck.

The love of the house of Allah enters your heart and then when you leave from Makkah, you're always homesick.

You want to go back and see Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) again.

And that is something that many people describe.

They say that when we see Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) for the first time, then that's it, we're hooked to it and we can't leave it for a long time.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى puts the love of this house in the hearts of men, a fulfillment of the Dua(دُعَا) of Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

So the people of Jurhum(جرهم) they stayed there.

And they raised up Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) and they taught him the Arabic language.

Because Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was not an Arab neither was Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), they were from Mesopotamia - in Iraq - the Caledonians.

Jurhum(جرهم), they taught Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) the Arabic language because he grew up with them.

So he learned the Arabic language, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: They adored him, they loved him so much.

They married him one of their daughters, and he lived with them.

The mother passed away Hajar(هَاجَر).

And then Ibrahim عليه السّلام would make some visits.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام is traveling always.

So he visited Makkah and he came to the house of Ismail عليه السّلام and he knocked the door.

So, his wife opened the door.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) said: Where's your husband?

She said: He's, he's not here.

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) asked her: How is your living?

She said: Miserable.

We're having a miserable life, and she complained.

Our food is not good our water is murky and thick and dirty, salty.

So Ibrahim عليه السّلام said; Deliver my Salaams to him, he didn't even tell her, who he is.

He said: Deliver my Salam to him and tell him to change his doorstep.

Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) came home and Rasool Allah ﷺ says: As if he felt something.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) he felt that his father was there.

He didn't see him and his wife, she didn't even say anything, and he asked his wife, did anybody visit us?

She said: Yes. An old man came and he asked about you.

And he told me to deliver Salaam to you and to tell you to change your doorstep.

Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) said that was my father and he's ordering me to separate from you, you're the doorstep.

So go back home! And he divorced her.

People of Jurhum(جرهم) they loved Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) so much, they married him another wife.

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) made another trip.

A while later, knocked the door Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) wasn't there.

So he asked the same questions to the wife.

He said; Tell me about your living.

She said: Al-hamdulillah(ألحمدلله), the best living.

and she praised the lifestyle that they're leading, this simple lifestyle that they were leading, she praised it.

She was happy and content; righteous woman.

So Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) wanted to get more details.

He said: What food do you eat?

She said: We eat meat.

What do you drink? Water.

That's all what they used to have meat and water, no desserts, no appetizers, no side dish, meat and water only.

So he made Dua(دُعَا) for them and said Allah gives them blessing in their food.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says they did not have grains at that time they did not know wheat and barley.

If they had it, he would have made Dua(دُعَا) for them, to bless it for them, but he didn't have it at that time.

But he may Dua(دُعَا) to Allah to bless for them, their food.

And then he said: When your husband, comes back, deliver my salaam to him, and tell him to keep the doorstep.

So Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) came back.

He said: Did anybody visit us?

He said: Yes, an old man came and he's delivering your salaam(سلام) and he is saying; keep your doorstep.

He said that's my father. You are the doorstep and my father is telling me, to keep you.

This is a Dua(دُعَا) that's Sayidina Ibrahim(سيدنا اِبْراهِيْم) made.

O Allah سبحانه وتعالى give me an a righteous offspring.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام reached to over 80 years old and he didn't have any offspring, he didn't have any children.

And he didn't ask Allah سبحانه وتعالى to provide him with children per say but he said: Minas Saliheen(من الصالحين) he has to be righteous.

O Allah سبحانه وتعالى give me an a righteous offspring.

We gave him the glad tidings of a child, which is Haleem(حليم).

And Haleem(حليم) is gentle and mild and forbearing.

These are the Akhlaq(أخلاق) of Syedina Ismael عليه السّلام and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) grew up away from his father, in Makkah as we mentioned.

And then when Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) reached to the age in which he can go out with his father in the age in which he became an adult, and is able to take responsibilities for himself.

This age which Allah سبحانه وتعالى mentions in Qur'an.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says and when his son was old enough to walk with him.

Means that Ismail عليه السّلام has grew up and now is able to take care of himself and he's able to take responsibilities.

And that is when the father starts seeing himself in his son.

When your son is a child, you raised him up, but when your son is an adult, then you see the continuation of your life in him and that is the age which is Ismael عليه السّلام reached.

When Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) started to go out with his father.

Sayidina Ibrahim عليه السّلام saw dream.

Sayidina Ibrahim(سيدنااِبْراهِيْم) saw a dream and we know that the dreams of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) are Wahii(وحي).

In that dream Sayidina Ibrahim(سيدنااِبْراهِيْم) was slaughtering his own son.

Oh my son I see in my dream that I am sacrificing you.

What do you think, what is your response?

Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) he will fulfill the order of Allah سبحانه وتعالى no doubt, but he didn't go and Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) is in his Sleep and suddenly sacrifices his son.

No, he told Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), he said; This is the dream that I saw telling me what do you think?

The answer of Sayidina Ismael عليه السّلام should be studied deeply and taken seriously, by the society that we live in.

This society that gives no rights to the parents in which the children have no morals in the way they deal with their parents and in the society that would give rights to everyone even to the perverted

but it would give no rights to the parents.

In a society where the state has more authority over your children than you do.

This response of Sayidina Ismail(سيدنااِسْماعِيْل) needs to be studied very carefully.

Sayidina Ismael عليه السّلام said; O my father, do what you are commanded to do.

If a parent will tell his child to provide for him, the son or the daughter won't.

And in the end of their life, they're dumped in an elderly house and Sayidina Ismael عليه السّلام is giving the most valuable thing that he has and that is his life.

It's not a matter of providing for his father material provisions or taking care of some needs of his father.

He's giving his father his life, he's giving away his life.

And again, I say that's important to study by us, the Muslims, because we are living in a society that gives no rights to parents.

The only group that have no rights are the parents.

They have no rights whatsoever.

They're disposable thing, they just raise up the children, they bear them and they take care of them and they work for them and they sacrifice for them, and then when the children reach the age of 18,

they have no obligation whatsoever towards these parents, and that is by law.

The parent cannot take anything from their children after they reach the age of 18, by law, nothing.

The child does not have to obey, does not have to provide does not have to take care because it's an individualistic society.

And it's affecting the Muslims, it's affecting us because we borrow from the environment we live in.

Sayidina Ismail(سيدنااِسْماعِيْل) said do whatever you are commanded to do.

Do whatever you're told to do, whatever Allah commanded you to do; Do it.

And then he said; You will find me of those, who are patient In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

He didn’t say you will find me patient because we cannot guarantee our actions, we have no guarantee over what we're going to do this moment, let alone in the future.

Everything that we do we need to realize that it's Taufeeq(توفيق) from Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

Allah is the One, Who made it accessible for us.

And that is why we don't say that we're going to do it and put an end to it that way.

No, we said: We're going to do it In Sha Allah(إنْ شاءالله).

And we asked Allah سبحانه وتعالى to assist us in doing so.

And that is why in every Salah(صلاة) we say; Guide us to the straight path, it's You, Who will guide us.

Without Your help, we cannot do anything, without Your help, we cannot worship You.

And that's why we need to thank Allah سبحانه وتعالى for every good deed that we do, and then we need to thank Allah سبحانه وتعالى because he allowed us to thank Him.

And then Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; Then, when they both submitted themselves and he had laid him on his forehead, the position Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) was in, he was laying on the ground, and his father was holding the knife over his neck.

When they were in that position, Allah سبحانه وتعالى described it as follows, When they both submitted and the word Aslama(أسلما) and Islam(إسلام) comes from the same root,

the root of the word Aslama(أسلما) and Islam(إسلام) is the same thing.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى is saying that the Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) and Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), they submitted when they were in that position they were submitting to Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

And that is Islam because Islam is submission to Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

You fulfill the commandments of Allah, even if it's against your will, even if it's against your desires, even if it's against what you like.

Nobody would want to slaughter his son.

And no son would want his life to be taken away.

But they're doing it as a form of worship Ibadah(عبادة) and that is Islam; submission.

This is the meaning of Islam.

When they were in that position, Ibrahim عليه السّلام had the knife on the neck of Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل) and he started to pass the knife over is neck.

And then Allah سبحانه وتعالى called Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

You have fulfilled the dream.

You have fulfilled it, the dream is fulfilled.

And Allah سبحانه وتعالى told him; Verily that indeed was a manifest trial.

It was a test for you and you have passed the test.

Does Allah سبحانه وتعالى need the blood of Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل).

Does need the flesh of Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), does Allah need the life of Ismail(اِسْماعِيْل), Allah doesn't need it.

Verily that indeed was a manifest trial and we ransomed him with a great sacrifice.

It was a test from Allah, Allah does not need the blood.

Allah does not need the flesh, Allah does not need to take away the life of Ismael عليه السّلام this was a test and they both passed in the test.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى rewarded Ibrahim عليه السّلام with the sacrifice, A ram.

Look at the results of Taqwa(تقوى) it was an action of Taqwa(تقوى) that Ibrahim عليه السّلام did.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى rewarded him for it.

And now we sacrifice in Eid Al-Ad'ha(عيدالأضحى) and Al-Hadie(ألهدي) in Al-Hajj(ألحَجْ), every year following the Sunnah(سنة) Syedina Ibrahim عليه السّلام.

Ibrahim عليه السّلام was told by Allah سبحانه وتعالى or actually the Ayaat(آيات) say; And we left for him among generations in later times, Salam(سلام).

After this event happened, Allah سبحانه وتعالى says and we left Salam(سلام) for Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) in the generations to come, and then and what is the representation of that?

What is the representation of the Salam(سلام) Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم)?

How is that manifested?

It is in the Tsgahud(تشاهد), that we do in every Salah(صلاة).

We make Salah(صلاة) and Salaam(سلام) on Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and Muhammadﷺ in every Salah(صلاة).

And we left for him in the generations to come; Peace on Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

We're asking Allah سبحانه وتعالى  to grant Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) peace and every Salah(صلاة).

Millions and millions of believers all over the world, throughout generations, five times a day and more are asking Allah سبحانه وتعالى to grant Ibrahim عليه السّلام peace.

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ قالوا حَرِّقوهُ قالوا حَرِّقوهُ وَانصُروا آلِهَتَكُم إِن كُنتُم فاعِلينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى Allah سبحانه وتعالى.

قُلنا يا نارُ كوني بَردًا وَسَلامًا عَلىٰ إِبراهيمَ۝

قُلنا يا نارُ كوني بَردًا وَسَلامًا عَلىٰ إِبراهيمَ۝

حسبي الله ونعم الوكيل حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ ونِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ، قالَهَا إبْرَاهِيمُ عليه السَّلَامُ حِينَ أُلْقِيَ في النَّارِ، وقالَهَا مُحَمَّدٌ صلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّم

حِينَ قالوا: إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ حسبي الله ونعم الوكيل

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا Allah سبحانه تعالى says; وَأَرادوا بِهِ كَيدًا فَجَعَلناهُمُ الأَخسَرينَ۝

وَنَجَّيناهُ وَلوطًا إِلَى الأَرضِ الَّتي بارَكنا فيها لِلعالَمينَ۝

فَبُهِتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ فَبُهِتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

أَلَم تَرَ إِلَى الَّذي حاجَّ إِبراهيمَ في رَبِّهِ أَن آتاهُ اللَّهُ المُلكَ إِذ قالَ إِبراهيمُ رَبِّيَ الَّذي يُحيي وَيُميتُ قالَ أَنا أُحيي وَأُميتُ ۖ

قالَ إِبراهيمُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأتي بِالشَّمسِ مِنَ المَشرِقِ فَأتِ بِها مِنَ المَغرِبِ فَبُهِتَ الَّذي كَفَرَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِي القَومَ الظّالِمينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِذ قالَ إِبراهيمُ رَبِّ أَرِني كَيفَ تُحيِي المَوتىٰ ۖ Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; قالَ أَوَلَم تُؤمِن ۖ Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) said;

قالَ بَلىٰ وَلٰكِن لِيَطمَئِنَّ قَلبي ۖ Allah سبحانه تعالى says; وَإِذ قالَ إِبراهيمُ رَبِّ أَرِني كَيفَ تُحيِي المَوتىٰ ۖ قالَ أَوَلَم تُؤمِن ۖ

قالَ بَلىٰ وَلٰكِن لِيَطمَئِنَّ قَلبي ۖ قالَ فَخُذ أَربَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيرِ فَصُرهُنَّ إِلَيكَ ثُمَّ اجعَل عَلىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِنهُنَّ جُزءًا

ثُمَّ ادعُهُنَّ يَأتينَكَ سَعيًا ۚ وَاعلَم أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزيزٌ حَكيمٌ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌ ۘ Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وَقالَ إِنّي مُهاجِرٌ إِلىٰ رَبّي ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيم۝

Allah سبحانه تعالى says; وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمّا جَنَّ عَلَيهِ اللَّيلُ رَأىٰ كَوكَبًا ۖ قالَ هٰذا رَبّي ۖ فَلَمّا أَفَلَ قالَ لا أُحِبُّ الآفِلينَ۝

فَلَمّا رَأَى القَمَرَ بازِغًا قالَ هٰذا رَبّي ۖ فَلَمّا أَفَلَ قالَ لَئِن لَم يَهدِني رَبّي لَأَكونَنَّ مِنَ القَومِ الضّالّينَ۝

فَلَمّا رَأَى الشَّمسَ بازِغَةً قالَ هٰذا رَبّي هٰذا أَكبَرُ ۖ فَلَمّا أَفَلَت قالَ يا قَومِ إِنّي بَريءٌ مِمّا تُشرِكونَ۝

إِنّي وَجَّهتُ وَجهِيَ لِلَّذي فَطَرَ السَّماواتِ وَالأَرضَ حَنيفًا ۖ وَما أَنا مِنَ المُشرِكينَ۝

وَكَذٰلِكَ نُري إِبراهيمَ مَلَكوتَ السَّماواتِ وَالأَرضِ وَلِيَكونَ مِنَ الموقِنينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وَحاجَّهُ قَومُهُ ۚ قالَ أَتُحاجّونّي فِي اللَّهِ وَقَد هَدانِ ۚ وَلا أَخافُ ما تُشرِكونَ بِهِ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ رَبّي شَيئًا ۗ

وَسِعَ رَبّي كُلَّ شَيءٍ عِلمًا ۗ أَفَلا تَتَذَكَّرونَ۝

وَكَيفَ أَخافُ ما أَشرَكتُم وَلا تَخافونَ أَنَّكُم أَشرَكتُم بِاللَّهِ ما لَم يُنَزِّل بِهِ عَلَيكُم سُلطانًا ۚ فَأَيُّ الفَريقَينِ أَحَقُّ بِالأَمنِ ۖ إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; الَّذينَ آمَنوا وَلَم يَلبِسوا إيمانَهُم بِظُلمٍ أُولٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الأَمنُ وَهُم مُهتَدونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وأنزل سكينته وَتِلكَ حُجَّتُنا آتَيناها إِبراهيمَ عَلىٰ قَومِهِ ۚ نَرفَعُ دَرَجاتٍ مَن نَشاءُ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكيمٌ عَليمٌ۝

إثناني منها في ذات الله إني ثقيم بل فعلهم كبيرهم هذا إنَّما جئتموني بشيطان إذن لن يضيعن الله يتلوَّأ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجعَل لَهُ مَخرَجًا۝وَيَرزُقهُ مِن حَيثُ لا يَحتَسِبُ ۚ

لقد أسمعت إن كان لديك غواة فارسلو جريً أو جريين إِيّاكَ نَعبُدُ وَإِيّاكَ نَستَعينُ۝

رَبَّنا إِنّي أَسكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتي بِوادٍ بِوادٍ غَيرِ ذي زَرعٍ عِندَ بَيتِكَ المُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنا لِيُقيمُوا الصَّلاةَ فَاجعَل أَفئِدَةً مِنَ النّاسِ تَهوي إِلَيهِم

فَاجعَل أَفئِدَةً مِنَ النّاسِ تَهوي إِلَيهِم وَارزُقهُم مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ لَعَلَّهُم يَشكُرونَ۝

لِيُقيمُوا الصَّلاةَ هل تكفينا فيه صلاة اليوم لِيُقيمُوا الصَّلاةَ "رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً" فَاجعَل أَفئِدَةً مِنَ النّاسِ تَهوي إِلَيهِم وَارزُقهُم مِنَ الثَّمَراتِ لَعَلَّهُم يَشكُرونَ۝

وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِلنَّاسِ فاَنفسهم فأقرئي منِّي السلام، وقولي له: يغير عتبة باب أمراة صالحة Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ۝

رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; فَبَشَّرناهُ بِغُلامٍ حَليمٍ۝

فَلَمّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعيَ فَلَمّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعيَ قالَ يا بُنَيَّ إِنّي أَرىٰ فِي المَنامِ أَنّي أَذبَحُكَ فَانظُر ماذا تَرىٰ ۚ فَانظُر ماذا تَرىٰ ۚ

قالَ يا أَبَتِ افعَل ما تُؤمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُني إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصّابِرينَ۝

افعَل ما تُؤمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُني إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصّابِرينَ۝

أهدنا الصراط المستقيم سَتَجِدُني إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصّابِرينَ۝

فَلَمّا أَسلَما وَتَلَّهُ لِلجَبينِ۝

فَلَمّا أَسلَما وَتَلَّهُ لِلجَبينِ۝

فَلَمّا أَسلَما وَتَلَّهُ لِلجَبينِ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وَنادَيناهُ أَن يا إِبراهيمُ۝قَد صَدَّقتَ الرُّؤيا ۚ إِنَّ هٰذا لَهُوَ البَلاءُ المُبينُ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; وَفَدَيناهُ بِذِبحٍ عَظيمٍ۝

وَتَرَكنا عَلَيهِ فِي الآخِرينَ۝ سَلامٌ عَلىٰ إِبراهيمَ۝

Allah سبحانه تعالى says; وَتَرَكنا عَلَيهِ فِي الآخِرينَ۝ سَلامٌ عَلىٰ إِبراهيمَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّم

parts.english:
The Lives of the Prophets, Part 1 They said: “Have you come to turn us away from our gods?

Then bring us that which you threaten us, if you are one of the truthful.

Now they challenged him.

They told him: Bring us the punishment if you are telling the truth.

And they were arrogant and proud because of their strength and their power and their so-called civilization.

By the way, we’re using this word “civilization” just because it’s commonly used, but we’re not using it in the positive sense of the word because always this word is used, or most of the time it’s used, to refer to Jahiliyyah(جاهلية).

It is used to refer to ignorance, nations that disbelieved in Allah and the only reason why they are looked up at is because of their materialistic achievements.

They thought that this civilization of theirs and this wealth of theirs and this strength will save them from the punishment of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

And we see that trait - we see that trend, similar in all strong and powerful civilizations that disbelieve in Allah.

The great empire, Great Britain when they constructed a ship that was the biggest and the most powerful in the world, they thought that they can conquer the sea and they named it the “Titanic”.

Look at the name they chose; the “Titanic”.

And they thought that they can challenge Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ and the strength of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

But whenever you try to challenge Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎, what will happen?

This Titanic, this ship, that is supposed to conquer the sea and it’s supposed to be the most powerful and greatest achievement of mankind, Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ sank it on its first trip.

And then the next civilization and powerful nation of the world, the United States; When they were building their spacecraft that will challenge the creation of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎,

they called it the “Challenger” to challenge the strength of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎, and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ blew it up, but nobody learns the lessons.

And the people of ʿAd(عاد) thought that their power and strength can avail them.

As for ʿAd(عاد), they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said; Who is mightier than us in strength?

Who is stronger than us?

Who are you threatening us with Hud(هود)?

Who are you threatening us with?

You say that Allah can do anything against us?

Do whatever you want.

Who is more powerful than us?

See they not that Allah, Who created them, was Mightier in strength than them?

And they used to deny Our Ayaat(آيات).

Don’t they realize, don’t they understand that Allah, the One, Who created them, is mightier than them?

Allah’s the One who created them; Whatever strength they had is created by Allah.

So Hud (هود), at that point, made Duʿa(دعاء), and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ said, Hud(هود) is saying; He said: O my Lord, help me because they denied me.

And the Duʿa(دعاء) of Hud(هود) reached to Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ - Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ said; And Allah said: In a little while, they are sure to be regretful.

In a little while, they will be regretful.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ was taking the people of ʿAd(عاد) through a test to remind them.

See, Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ is giving them chances.

So, Allah did not bring the punishment at once.

Allah has made them go through a period of drought to remind them with their weakness as human beings so that they may turn to Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ in Tawbah(توبة) and repentance.

So they went through a period of drought, they were receiving no rain, their crops were drying, they were going through this difficult time.

But that wasn’t sufficient to turn their attention to the truth and to ask Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ for forgiveness.

So now Hud(هود) made the Duʿa(دعاء), and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ accepted the Duʿa(دعاء).

Clouds started approaching in the horizon dark clouds and there’s a story that is mentioned that they went to Al-Kaʿbah(ٱلكعبة) to ask Allah for rain,

and then they heard a voice that told them; Choose whichever cloud you want: the red or the white or the black.

They said: We want the black cloud.

Anyway, so these clouds were approaching their nation, and they saw these clouds in the horizon.

Then when they saw it as dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said; This is a cloud bringing us rain.

Because this was very dark, and a dark cloud means what?

A lot of rain.

So, they were looking forward and happy and pleased that we are finally receiving rain.

Nay, but it is a torment which you were asking for, this is the torment you were asking for, a wind wherein is a painful torment.

destroying everything by the command of its Lord.

They thought it was rain, it was the punishment of Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he would see clouds approaching Madina(مدينة), his face would change.

You can see that he’s worried, and ʿAishah(عائشة) would notice that, and she asked Rasool Allah ﷺ - she said; O Rasul Ullah, when people see the clouds, they’re happy,

especially in Arabia because they don’t receive a lot of rain when people see the clouds coming, they’re happy, they’re very pleased.

So ʿAishah(عائشة) said; When people see the clouds approaching, they’re happy, but you look anxious.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Because a nation before us saw these clouds, and thought that they had mercy.

They didn’t know that it had the punishment of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ in them.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had the fear in his heart, and we, unfortunately, in the world today in general, are exactly like the people of ʿAd(عاد).

Exactly! you know, when the earthquake that happened few weeks ago and we felt it here in San Diego?

The next day, I watched some of the interviews they made with people.

They brought this lady; this lady said it was cool.

Another guy said it was fun.

Somebody else said it was an adventure.

Others said it was interesting.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Allah is sending you these as a reminder.

Allah’s sending you these Ayaat(آيات) as a reminder, and you’re saying that they’re cool and fun and interesting and an adventure?

Look at the state of the hearts of people, exactly like the people of ʿAd(عاد), because they are keeping Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ out of the equation.

And that is the situation of the people today; they only think in terms of natural phenomena and natural laws as if Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ does not exist.

So We sent upon them furious wind in days of evil omen for them.

Sarsar(صرصر) is explained as cold, severely cold and very ringing and loud voice, and very furious.

This is the wind Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ sent on them.

The closest thing that we have today similar to that is what?

The tornado.

Because the tornado, if you have seen it, it is very fast wind and it has a very loud voice.

I mean, if you heard, if you saw it on TV, it has an unbelievably loud sound.

And it could be very cold.

In evil omen days on them.

Tornados, it starts as a funnel in the cloud and then it makes a touchdown and it starts moving, and it would stay in one place only for a few minutes

and then it would keep on moving.

It doesn’t stay for long in the same place just a few minutes and it keeps on moving.

But, it’s leaving behind it a trail of destruction.

In those few moments in those few minutes, it destroys everything that it passes over.

It just rolls over everything and it destroys it.

And we’ve seen that, in a few minutes, a tornado can make a touchdown and travel for a few miles and destroy everything.

This wind that Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ sent on the people of ʿAd(عاد) Allah besieged them, so imagine a tornado coming down and besieging the whole nation, surrounding it from every side.

And it did not stay there for a few minutes, but it stayed there slamming them for 7 nights and 8 days.

Imagine a tornado besieging the whole nation of ʿAd(عاد), surrounding them from every side, and this wind is violently turning with high speed,

slamming their bodies against walls and against trees and against their homes, and destroying everything.

And Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ put them under that siege for 8 days and 7 nights, and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; Husuma(حسوما) means continuously without giving them a break, giving them no break, no chance to even breathe.

And as for ʿAd(عاد), they were destroyed with a furious violent wind which Allah imposed on them for 7 nights and 8 days in succession, with persistence and giving them no break.

That’s the punishment of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ is Shadid ul-ʿIqab(شديد العقاب), His punishment is severe, it is serious.

Allah says: That We might give them a taste of disgracing torment in this present world, but surely the torment of the Hereafter will be more disgracing, and they will never be helped.

This is the punishment of this world, but the punishment of the Akhirah(آخرة) is even more severe.

What was the result?

When the dust settled down and you walk into the nation of ʿAd(عاد), what do you see?

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says: So that you could see men lying over throne as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

These were very tall men, so Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ said they are like palm trees that are knocked down, upside down, lying dead.

And then Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ asks us this question, and this would go back to what I said before.

If Allah did not tell us about the people of ʿAd(عاد) and where the people of ʿAd(عاد) lived, we wouldn’t have known.

Do you see any remnants of the people of ʿAd(عاد)?

We have remnants from the people of Firʿawn(فرعون), Al-Ahram Al-Awtad(الأهرام الأوتاد), the pyramids; we have remnants from Thamud(ثمود), Diyar Thamud(ديار ثمود), the dwellings of Thamud(ثمود);

we have remnants from the Greek Empire; we have remnants from the Roman Empire; but from the empire of ʿAd(عاد), we have nothing.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ completely destroyed them because they were the most powerful.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ completely erased them from the face of the earth, and now it is a land called Al-Ahqaf (الأحقاف), sand dunes.

You don’t even see nothing, nobody even lives there.

It’s a desert now in Hadramaut(حضرموت), known Al-Ahqaf(الأحقاف), it’s a desert, empty.

This is the nation which Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ said; Iram(إرم), the land of pillars which no other land was similar to.

Nothing remained, they were destroyed completely.

Allah says: And when Our Commandment came, We saved Hud(هود) and those who believed with him by a Mercy from Us, and We saved them from a severe torment.

Such were ʿAd(عاد); they rejected the Signs of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ and disobeyed His Messengers and followed the command of every proud obstinate.

And they were pursued by a curse in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection, no doubt; verily, ʿAd(عاد) disbelieved in their Lord, so away with ʿAd(عاد), the people of Hud(هود).

Their wealth didn’t help them.

Their power didn’t do them any good.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ completely destroyed them, destroyed them completely, and whoever follows the tracts of ʿAd(عاد), the same thing will happen to them.

And I would like to close with this saying of Sayyidina Abu ad-Darda(سيدنا أبو الدرداء).

Sayyidina Abu ad-Darda(سيدنا أبو الدرداء) was in Damascus, the capital of the Islamic Khilafah(خلافة) at the time, and he saw the extravagance of the Muslim Ummah(أمة).

The Muslims were so wealthy at that time and the lifestyle of the Muslims was changing, now they had so much wealth, so their lifestyle was changing.

Abu ad-Darda(أبو الدرداء) was on the strict ways that he was living on in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ; he did not change and he did not want the people to change.

So, he stood up in Damascus and he said; Abu ad-Darda(أبو الدرداء) said: “O people of Damascus! O people of Damascus, don’t you have any shame?

He is, unto me, ever most Gracious.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) is making istighfar(ٱستغفار) for someone who is a nonbeliever.

Is that allowed in Islam?

No.

Obviously, at that time, Ibrahim عليه السلام did not know that.

He promised his father that he will do Istighfar(ٱستغفار) for him, and he did Istighfar(ٱستغفار).

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said: O Allah, forgive my father because he’s one of those misguided.

But then Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ taught Ibrahim(إبراهيم) the truth, and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; And Ibrahim’s invoking of Allah for his father’s forgiveness

was only because of a promise he, Ibrahim, has made to his father.

But when it became clear to him that he is an enemy of Allah, he disassociated himself from him.

Verily, Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) was Awwah(أوَّاة) and was haleem(حليم).

Awwah(أَوَّاهٌ) is someone who always is in a state of khushoo(خشوع) and asking Allah سبحانه وتعالى and making Duʿa(دعاء) continuously, and Haleem(حَلِيمٌ) is someone who is forbearing.

So Ibrahim(إبراهيم) only made Istighfar(ٱستغفار) for his father because of the promise, but when Ibrahim(إبراهيم) knew that his father is one of the nonbelievers and died on kufr (كفر), Ibrahim(إبراهيم) stopped.

There is a hadith(حديث) mentioned in Bukhari(بخاري) that on the Day of Judgment, Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ will tell Ibrahim(إبراهيم) that I will fulfill My Promises on you and I will not dishonor you because Ibrahim(إبراهيم) has made a Duʿa(دعاء);

O Allah, do not dishonor me on the Day of Resurrection.

And Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ accepted the Duʿa(دعاء) of Ibrahim(إبراهيم), so He will not dishonor Ibrahim(إبراهيم) on the Day of Judgement.

So Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said; What is a greater dishonor than punishing my father?

Because the father of Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will come to him on the Day of Judgement and this is mentioned in Bukhari(بخاري) the father of Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will come to Ibrahim(إبراهيم) on the Day of Judgement and tell him;

Today, I will not disobey you, today, I will follow you.

On the Day of Judgement, the father of Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will come and say; On this day, I will do whatever you want.

At that moment, Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will tell Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎; How come my father could be punished?

This is a dishonor to me.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ will tell Ibrahim(إبراهيم); Look at your father.

So Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will look at his father and will find him in the form of Deeh(ضيح), Daba(الضبع) hyena.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) was talking with his father and then he made Duʿa(دعاء) to Allah.

Allah told him: Look at your father, so Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will look at his father and find him in the form of a hyena.

And then Ibrahim(إبراهيم) will walk away from him and the father will be thrown in Hellfire.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم), when he was seeing his father in his physical form, it was difficult for him to have his father go to Hellfire.

But, when the veils were lifted and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ showed him the truth that this man is not your father, this man does not belong to you, this man is different,

and his father even came in a different physical form, at that moment, Ibrahim(إبراهيم) walked away from his father and disassociated himself from him.

And then Ibrahim(إبراهيم) told his father, after he told him: “I will ask Allah to forgive you,” he said; And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allah.

Aatizilukum(أَعْتَزِلُكُمْ) Means “I will disassociate myself from you, I will separate myself from you,I will be in seclusion from you, a very important principle for your survival as a Muslim.

You have to have what is called ʿUzlah Shaʿuriyyah(عزلة الشعورية), psychological separation, from the environment of kufr(كفر) that is around you.

Ibrahim عليه السلام immediately when his father chose kufr(كفر) Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said that I will disassociate myself from you, the society of the nonbelievers.

I will be separated from you.

We, as Muslims, have an identity that we have to protect and we cannot blend in with the society and be a sheep among the sheep, and follow the stream, and follow what everybody else is doing, and follow the crowd.

We have an identity that we need to preserve and we need to be separate and different.

But that doesn’t mean we have to separate ourselves physically from the society and live on monasteries on top of mountains or in the forests or in the deserts.

No; we could be part of the society and be within the society, intermingling with the society, but in our hearts, we are separate.

So, physically, we are actively participating in active participation with the society, but in our hearts we have this psychological barrier and separation

where we always are carrying with us the understanding that we have an identity of being a Muslim.

So, if you are able to be a part of this society but preserving your Muslim identity that is better than separating yourself physically from it

because then you can be an agent of change and affecting others and Daʿwah(دعوة).

But when you’re secluded and alone, you’re only benefiting yourself and nobody’s benefiting from the good that you have.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) made Daʿwah(دعوة) to his people also; He said: What are these images to which you are devoted?

What are these idols?

And then he also told them in other Ayaat(آيات); Do they hear you when you call on them or do they benefit you or harm you?

Do they respond to your Duʿa(دعاء)?

I mean, a god that does not respond to your Duʿa(دعاء), what god is he?

And do they harm you or benefit you?” They said: Nay, but we found our fathers doing so.

They did not disapprove what Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said, they did not say; Yes, they do accept our duʿa, and yes, they do benefit us.

No; they didn’t argue with that.

Their response was; We’re doing this because our fathers were doing it.

Just like when you talk to somebody: What’s your religion and why’re you doing this?

He said: I was born a Christian, I was born Catholic. Don’t argue with me, I was born like that.

This is Taqlid(تقليد) of Al-aba(الآباء), following the forefathers which Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ has mentioned in Qur'an; They found their fathers misguided and they’re following their tracks.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said; Indeed you and your fathers have been in manifest error.

Clear statements, he said that you are in error.

This was a shock to the people; they couldn’t believe this statement, so they said; Are you bringing us the truth, or are you one of those who are playing around?

They thought that he’s playing around.

I mean, bluntly he’s saying that “you are wrong and your fathers are wrong, and these idols cannot do you any good and they’re false.” They said: “Are you joking?

He said: Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and of that I am one of the witnesses.

And he said; The One who created me so He will guide me.

And the One, Who feeds me and provides me with drink.

And if I become ill, He is the One who cures me.

The One who will make me die and the One who will give me life.

This is the God that I worship, this is Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

So Ibrahim(إبراهيم) told them that, I worship Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎, and Allah is your Lord and the Lord of the worlds, and then Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said silently to himself, he was speaking to himself;

By Allah, I shall plot a plan to destroy your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs.

He made a plan; he said: I am gonna destroy your gods.

Somebody heard Ibrahim(إبراهيم) making that threat, but maybe they didn’t take it seriously.

These people, they had a day in which they would go out of the town and they would celebrate.

All of them would go out in their Jahiliyyah(جاهلية), ignorance, and they would go out in celebrations of Shayateen(شياطين).

So they would go out of their town, all of them would go together.

So they came to Ibrahim(إبراهيم) and told him: Come on, let’s go.

He said: I am ill.

He wasn’t physically ill.

What he meant is that I am sick of what you’re doing.

I am sick, he’s not physically sick, he said: I am sick of what you’re doing.

They understood that he means that he is physically ill, so they allowed him to stay.

But what he had in mind was that I’m sick of this worship that you are doing.

So they left him alone thinking that he’s ill, and they all went out of town.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) followed through his plan; he took his axe and he went to the temple, he destroyed all of their idols except for the large, big one

the humongous one, the biggest one, he left him intact, he destroyed all of the rest and then he hanged the axe on the shoulder of this large idol.

He left this axe on his shoulder.

They came back. Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; So he broke them to pieces, all except the biggest of them that they might turn to it.

So they came back; they looked at these idols, they said; Who is the one who did this with our gods?

He must be indeed one of the wrongdoers.

Who’s the one who did this?

The one who heard Ibrahim(إبراهيم) speak, he came and said, actually it was more than one who heard Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم), They said: We heard a young man talking against them who is called Ibrahim.

Two things I want to turn your attention in this Ayah(آية); First of all, a young man, Fata(فتى), young man.

He was young.

This is the responsibility that the youth need to realize that major changes and Daʿwah(دعوة) that was done, were done by the young.

The second thing; When, for example, I’m speaking with you and I’m telling you: Muhammad(محمد) called you, it’s different than if I say: A guy named Muhammad(محمد) called you.

What’s the difference between the two?

If I tell you: Muhammad(محمد) called you, or I tell you: A guy named Muhammad(محمد), he called you?

If I tell you: Muhammad(محمد) called you, both of us know who Muhammad(محمد) is.

When I tell you that a guy named Muhammad(محمد) called you, it’s either both of us or one of us doesn’t know who Muhammad(محمد) is.

Over here, they said: We heard a young man called Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم).

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) wasn’t even known to the society.

He was a young boy; he wasn’t even known to the society and he’s coming up with this change that will bring down a whole society, carrying all of this load on his shoulders.

A young boy, carrying all of this load on his shoulder, going against the whole society.

They said: Then bring them before the eyes of the people that they may testify.

They gathered all of the people, and they wanted to bring Ibrahim(اِبْراهِيْم) and put him in court in front of everyone.

So they brought everyone, and they said; Are you the one who did this against our gods?

He said: No.

No, it’s not me. It’s the big idol who did it, so go and ask him.

That was the point of the lesson, that’s the point that Ibrahim(إبراهيم) wants to drive home.

Go and inquire from your gods.

Let them tell you what happened.

If you believe that your gods can do anything, then maybe the big one did it.

If you believe that your gods cannot do anything, then why are you worshipping them?

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said: Nay, this one, the biggest of them did it.

Ask them, if they can speak.

Ask them, if they can speak, this is the whole point.

So they turned to themselves, and said; Verily, you are the wrongdoers.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) woke them up.

This was a shock to them, so for a moment, they woke up and realized their insanity and their mistake and their foolishness.

So, they started to think about their position, but then Shaytan(شيطان) came in with his influence and his waswasah(وسوسة), so he made them override that thought, and they went back to their ignorance again.

They woke up for a while, but then they lost the opportunity, and they said; Then they turned on their heads, meaning, they were going on the right way, they were starting to think, but then they fell down on their heads upside down.

And they said: You know that they cannot speak.

They said: You know that they cannot speak.

Ibrahim(إبراهيم) said; Do you then worship besides Allah things that can neither profit you nor harm you?

Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allah.

Have you then no sense?

You have no understanding, no thinking.

You’re worshipping gods that cannot speak, cannot do you any harm, cannot even defend themselves how can they defend you when they’re not able to defend themselves?

These gods are lying dead on the ground, they can’t even help themselves.
parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ

فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً

قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ۝

قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ۝

تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ

وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ۝

رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ حُسُومًا Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ۝

إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ ۝ ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ saved Hud(هود); وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ ۝

وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ ۖ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ ۝

وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ۝

يا أهل دمشق ! يا أهل دمشق، ألا تستحيون ؟

تجمعون ما لا تأكلون وتبنون ما لا تسكنون، وتأملون ما لا تطيلون، وإن من كان قبلكم كانوا يجمعون فيوعون، ويبنون فيوثقون، ويعملون فيطيلون، فأصبح جمعهم بورا، ومساكنهم قبورا، وأملهم غرورا،

الا ان عاد ملكت ما بين عدن وعمان، خيل وركبانا فمن يشتري مني نير ثعاد بدرهمين ؟

وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ۝

وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ۝

أَفَأَمِنُوا۟ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ ۝

فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝

وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ ۝

وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِن سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا

تَتَّخِذُونَ مِن سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ ٱلْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ۝

وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ۝

وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَـٰذَآ ۖ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ۝

إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ۝

وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ۝

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ۝

مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ۝

كُنْ فَيَكُونُ قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ ۝ إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا۝

إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَعَقَرُوه فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ۝

تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ۝

فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ ۝ كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ

أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ۝

With Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎, it’s; كُنْ فَيَكُونُ Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ۝

مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ۝

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ۝

فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّى وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُحِبُّونَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ۝

يا أهل القليب، هل وجدتم ما وعدكم ربكم حقا ؟

فإني قد وجدت ما وعدني ربي حقا يا رسول الله ما أنتم بأسمع لما أقول منهم إلا أن تكونوا باكين وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا ۝

إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا۝

يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا۝

قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ۝

فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا۝

قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا۝

قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا ۝

وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا۝

إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ۝

وَمَا كَانَ ٱسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَن مَّوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَهَآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥٓ أَنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّ لِّلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ ۚ

إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَأَوَّٰهٌ حَلِيمٌ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا۝

وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ۝

قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ ۝ أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ۝

قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ۝

إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ ۝

فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ۝

قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ۝

قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ۝

قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ۝

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ۝

وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ۝

وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ۝

وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ۝

وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ۝

فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ۝

فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ۝

قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ۝

قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ۝

قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ۝

قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ۝

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ۝

قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ ۝

أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّم

parts.english:
The Lives Of The Prophets, Part 1 Adam(آدم), when he was created, Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ stroke his back, so all of the descendants of Adam(آدم) came out from the back of Adam(آدم).

We don’t know in which form they came out, but they all fell down from his back, all of them.

And Allah سبحانه وتعالى put some light between their eyes.

Adam(آدم) said: “Who are they?” Allah سبحانه وتعالى said: “These are your descendants.” So Adam(آدم) looked at one of them and he saw some bright shining light between his eyes, and he liked him.

So Adam(آدم) said: “Who is this?” “This is one of your descendants who’s gonna come in the end of time, his name is Dawud(داؤد).” Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) Allah’s telling Adam(آدم): “This is Dawud(داؤد),” it’s towards the end of time.

Where are we living then?

Adam(آدم) said; “What’s his age?” Allah سبحانه وتعالى said: “60 years old.” Adam(آدم) loved him.

This is one of his children, one of his descendants.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) all of us are the children of Adam(آدم).

He views us all as his children, his descendants.

Even though there’s thousands of years between Adam(آدم) and Dawud(داود), but he loved him.

So he told Allah سبحانه وتعالى: “O Allah, give him 40 years from my life.” He said: “O Allah, give him 40 years from my life.” “Then it would be written down and sealed.”

In other words: “Are you sure?” Adam(آدم) said: “Yes.” So it was prescribed and sealed, that’s it.

This happened when Adam(آدم) was created, very early in time.

Adam(آدم) was supposed to live 1000 years, that’s the time Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ told Adam(آدم): “you would live.” So now Adam(آدم) is living in Duniya(دنيا‎) and years and years are passing by.

Then, when he was 960 years old, the Angel of Death came to Adam(آدم) and told him: “Are you ready to die?” because the Angel of Death takes permission from the Ambiya(أنبياء).

Are you ready to die?

Adam(آدم) said: “I still have 40 years to live.

Allah told me that I’m gonna live 1000 years, I still have 40 years to live.” The Angel of Death said: “Didn’t you give 40 years of your life to your son, Dawud(داؤد)?”

Adam(آدم) denied.

This Hadith(حديث) is Sahih(صحيح). Adam(آدم) denied.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; “Adam(آدَم) denied, so the children of Adam(آدَم), they deny.” “And Adam(آدَم) forgot, and his children forget.” “And Adam(آدَم) made mistakes, and his children make mistakes.”

Adam(آدم) forgot.

See, sometimes we forget and that is human nature.

And it is said that the name Insan(إنسان) - Insan(إنسان) comes from Nisyan(نسيان); Insan(إنسان) in Arabic comes from Nisyan(نسيان) which is forgetting.

It’s a human nature; we forget, and when we forget, we reject.

Adam(آدم) denied - denied that he gave 40 years because he forgot.

He wasn’t lying, we need to understand that, Adam(آدم) forgot.

Adam(آدم) is a Nabi(نبي‎) of Allah سبحانه وتعالى, and the Ambiya(أنبياء) of Allah, Allah سبحانه وتعالى made them infallible from falling in the sins,

so Adam(آدم) - he forgot that he gave this promise.

Adam(آدم) forgot, and Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ forgave him, this was a mistake from Adam(آدم).

And this is a Nabi(نبي‎) of Allah.

Always in agreements that we have with each other and things that we say in our daily conversations, this thing happens again and again.

I would say something today, you would come to me after a month and you would say: “You promised me so and so.” I tell you: “No, I didn’t.” You accuse me of lying. I’m not lying, I forgot, I did not lie.

We forget and that happens, and give excuse for your brothers.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says: “Find 70 excuses for your brother.” No, we don’t find any excuses.

“You’re lying, I’m sure that I told you so. You are a liar!” And you brand him as a liar for the rest of his life.

Adam(آدم), and this is something big, this is something really big; I mean, you promised 40 years of your life, this is a big thing - Adam(آدم) forgot.

It’s human nature, you could forget major things.

And on small details, if somebody forgets, it’s a big problem and a big deal.

You know, let’s use these stories to learn some Akhlaq(أخلاق‎) also because we are in great need of Akhlaq(أخلاق‎).

You don’t know Al-Ghaib(الغيب), you don't know, maybe there was a miscommunication, maybe they didn’t understand you, they forgot, they made a mistake, they misinterpreted.

You can find, easily if you want, 70 excuses or more, if you want to.

Adam(آدم) then submitted to the Will of Allah سبحانه وتعالى and he gave away his soul.

And humans did not learn, these things are new for them, so the angels descended and they washed Sayyidina Adam(سيدنا آدم) SAW - witran(وترًا) - an odd number of times

and they dug the grave for Adam(آدم) the Mala’ikah(ملائكة) and they made it in the form of a Lahat(لهت) and they buried Sayyidina Adam عليه السّلام.

The angels washed him and the angels buried him.

This is our father Adam عليه السّلام.

This is the end of his story.

We ask Allah سبحانه وتعالى to bring us together with our father, In Jannah(جنة‎).

Sayyidina Sheeth(سيدنا شيث‎), Sheeth(شيث‎) is one of the Ambiya(أنبياء) that are not mentioned in Qur'an.

He’s a Nabi(نبي‎) that we know of from Sunnah(سنة‎).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says: “Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ has revealed the 104 scrolls, 50 of them on Sheeth(شيث).” Sayyidina Sheeth(سيدنا شيث) received revelation from Allah,

and it is mentioned by some of the scholars that he is the son of Adam(آدم) and that Adam(آدم) gave him the responsibility of leading when he was passing away.

So Adam(آدم) gave Wasiyyah(وصية) to Sheeth(شيث‎) to take care of the affairs of mankind.

Sheeth(شيث‎) assumed responsibility after his father Adam(آدم).

That’s almost all what we know about Sheeth(شيث‎).

Following Sheeth(شيث‎) is Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس).

Idris(إدريس), most of the scholars say, is a Nabi(نبي‎) that came between Sheeth(شيث‎) and Nuh(نوح).

But there’s an opinion of Sayyidina Ibn Masʿud رضي الله عنه that Idris(إدريس) is the same Nabi(نبي‎) as Ilyas(إلياس‎), but that’s a lonely opinion of Sayyidina Ibn Masʿud(سيدنا ٱبن مسعود).

The rest say that Idris(إدريس) is between Sayyidina Sheeth(سيدنا شيث) and Nuh(نوح).

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ did mention about Idris(إدريس) in Qur'an.

And remember in the book Idris(إدريس). He was a Siddeeq(صديق), truthful, and he was a Nabi(نَبِي).

And We elevated him to a high level.

That’s the extent of the knowledge, the accurate and sure knowledge that we have about Idris(إدريس).

But, we have some stories about him from Al-Israʼiliyyat(الاسرائیلیات).

And let me tell you what an Israʼiliyyat(اسرائیلیات‎) is as a definition that you will remember throughout this series.

Israʼiliyyat(اسرائیلیات‎) are the stories of the People of the Book.

We learn them through some of the Christians and the Jews who became Muslim.

Some of the Christians and the Jews who became Muslim and they were scholars before, when they became Muslim, they brought some of these stories with them in Islam.

Rasool Allah ﷺ has said in the beginning: “Do not speak about the stories of Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل),” Al-Israʼiliyyat(الاسرائیلیات) these stories that come from the old scripture.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: “Don’t speak about them.” But then after that, towards the end of the life of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he said; “Speak about Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل),” but then he said;

“Do not believe them and do not disapprove.” Do not approve those stories and do not disapprove them.

What does this mean?

It means we could use them sometimes, but we should not take it as certain knowledge.

And in the same time, if it does not contradict anything in Islam, we shouldn’t completely reject it.

That’s why many of the scholars say it is safe to stay away from many of these stories.

And that is what I’m gonna try to do, and whenever I do mention one of these stories, I’ll mention it and mention to you that this is from Al-Israʼiliyyat(الاسرائیلیات) so that you know.

And Ibn Taymiyah(اِبْنِ تَيْمِيَّه) did mention that we could use Al-Israʼiliyyat(الاسرائیلیات) as supplementary evidence, but not as primary evidence.

You cannot use it as a Daleel(دليل), as a primary evidence, but we could use it as Isti’nas(استئناس), you bring it along under an established thing in Islam, an established evidence, you could then use some of these stories.

There is a story about the death of Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس) from Al-Israʼiliyyat(الاسرائیلیات).

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ revealed to Idris(إدريس) and told him that “everyday, your deeds are equivalent to the good deeds of everybody else on the face of the earth.”

With simple calculation, Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس) said; “If that is the case, then if I ask Allah سبحانه وتعالى to give me a longer life, I would be able to accumulate more good deeds.”

So he told one of his friends - an angel who was a friend of his, he told him; “Why don’t we go and speak to the Angel of Death and see if we can go to Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ and ask him to give me a longer life?”

So the angel said: “Okay, ride on my wings.” So Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس) went on the wings of this angel, and the angel carried him up in the Samawat(سماوات).

So they passed the first heaven, As-Sama’ Al-Ula(السماء الأولى); and then the second heaven, As-Sama’ Ath-Thaniyah(السماء الثانية); the third heaven, As-Sama’ Ath-Thalithah(السماء الثالثة);

the fourth heaven, As-Sama’ Ar-Rabiʿah(السماء الرابعة), and when they were going up, the Angel of Death was coming down.

The Angel of Death said: “Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), I just received an order from Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ to take the soul of Idris(إدريس) in the fourth heaven

and I had no idea how I was gonna do it when he’s on Earth.” This angel speaking, with the Angel of Death looked on his back and saw that Idris(إدريس) has already passed away.

They use this as an explanation of the Ayah(آية) where Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; We elevated him to a very high level.

So Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ took his soul in the As-Sama’ Ar-Rabiʿ(سماء الرابع), in the fourth heaven, and elevated him to a very high level.

Nobody passed away in that level except Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس), and that’s why Allah سبحانه وتعالى specifically said in Qur'an; We have elevated him to a very high level.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ, in the authentic Hadith(حديث), did meet with Sayyidina Idris(سيدنا إدريس) in the fourth Sama(سماء), in the fourth heaven, in the Isra’ Wal-Miʿraj(إسراء والمعراج‎‎).

In the Miʿraj(معراج‎‎), Rasool Allah ﷺ met with Idris(إدريس) in As-Sama’ Ar-Rabiʿah(السماء الرابعة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in Al-Bukhari(بخاريْ); Rasool Ullah says in Al-Bukhari(البخاري); “Between Adam(آدَم) and Nuh(نوح), there were ten generations; all of them were Muslim.”

Qarn(قرن) in Arabic means either century, a 100 years or generation.

If it means ten centuries, that’s a Millenium, 1000 years.

If it means 10 generations, it could be more than 1000 because we know that people used to live longer lives in those times.

Between Adam(آدم) and Nuh(نوح), there were many generations, not 10, but ten of them were Muslim.

So, out of the many generations between Adam(آدم) and Nuh(نوح), ten were Muslim, and then disbelief and Shirk(شرك‎) slowly started to creep in.

How did it happen?

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) says, and this is the opinion of Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) mentioned in Al-Bukhari(البخاري), he says the descendants of Adam(آدم), they started slowly losing their religion and committing sins

but they still believed in Tawheed (توحيد‎), the unity of Allah, but they were committing many sins and ignorance was spreading among them and the righteous men among them were few.

Shaytan(شيطان) came to them and told them; “When these righteous men pass away, you will have no one to remind you about Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ and about Ibadah(عبادة),

you will have nobody to give you Naseeha(نَصيحة) and advice.

So how about when they pass away, you erect some statues in their memorial to remind you about Ibadah(عبادة)?” Because these righteous men used to remind the people, they used to give them naseeha(نصيحة) and advice;

when they’re gonna pass away, who’s gonna give the people advice?

So Shaytan(شيطان) told them: “How about when they pass away, you erect some statues so that whenever you would see the statue, you would remember good deeds and you would remember the righteous men?”

They followed the advice of Shaytan(شيطان) thinking it was a good one, and they erected these idols.

And then Shaytan(شيطان) left them alone. Shaytan(شيطان) is very, very patient.

He left them alone for a while, until they forgot the reason why these idols were built.

Generation after generation came and these statues were there, people forgot why these were built, why these were erected.

Shaytan(شيطان) came to them and told them; “Why don’t you worship these statues?” And that is how Shirk(شرك‎) started.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ talks about these five idols; five names of five idols.

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) says these were righteous men whom the people of Nuh(نوح) started worshipping their idols, their statues.

So this is how Shirk(شرك‎) started.

So Nuh(نوح) was the first Messenger of Allah to the people of the world, and that is mentioned in the authentic hadith(حديث‎) of Ash-Shafaʿah(الشفاعة‎),

when the people on the Day of Judgement will go to Nuh(نوح), what will they tell him?

“You are the first Messenger of Allah to the people of the world.” So Sayyidina Nuh(سيدنا نوح) is the first Messenger to the people of the earth,

and he is one of the five ‘Ulul-ʿAzm(أولو العزم).

‘Ulul-ʿAzm(أولو العزم) are the greatest five of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎, Nuh(نوح) is one of them.

The other 4 are Sayyidina(سيدنا) Muhammadﷺ, Ibrahim(إبراهيم‎), Musa(موسی), and ʿIsa(عيسى‎).

Muhammad ﷺ, Ibrahim(إبراهيم‎), Nuh(نوح), Musa(موسی), and ʿIsa(عيسى‎), these 5 ‘Ulul-ʿAzmi Min Ar-Rusul(أولو العزم من الرسل).

The greatest of them is Muhammad ﷺ.

What was the message of Nuh(نوح)?

And indeed We sent Noah to his people and he said: “I have come to you as a plain warner that you worship none but Allah.

This is the message that every Nabi(نبي‎) has presented to the world; Do not worship anyone but Allah - Tawheed(توحيد‎), the unity of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

That is the message of every Nabi(نبي‎).

And he tells them; That you should worship Allah, be dutiful to Him, and obey me.

So the Nabi(نبي‎) told them to “worship Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ and to have Taqwa(تقوى) and to obey me.” Every Messenger that We sent, We sent him to be obeyed.

The Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah don't just come and deliver a message and leave.

They deliver the message and they tell the people that they have to obey them, and this is Tahkeem Ash-Shariʿah(تحكيم الشريعة‎) - this is the establishment of the Law of Allah.

They came to be followed and to be obeyed.

What were the methods of the Daʿwah(دعوة‎) of Nuh(نوح), what methods did he use, how did he perform his Daʿwah(دعوة‎)?

He said: “O my Lord, verily, I have called my people night and day.” So he used to make Daʿwah(دعوة‎) to them in the night and day, and he said;

“Then verily, I called to them openly, then verily, I proclaimed to them in public and I have appealed to them in private.” So he used Jahar(جهر), which is announcing to everyone.

And then he used Aʿlantu Lahum(أعلنت لهم), I would speak to them, and also, I would speak to them publicly and privately.

So he used Daʿwah(دعوة‎) at night, he used Daʿwah(دعوة‎) at day, he used public and he used private.

He varied his methods, he tried every way possible.

So in our Daʿwah(دعوة‎), we should take advantage of every resource that we have.

Everything, take advantage of everything; telephone, CDs, audio cassettes, Internet, speeches, Daʿwah(دعوة‎) on the individual level, visitations, through your Akhlaq(أخلاق‎), pamphlets, books, don't think that anything will not work.

Use whatever you can because Sayyidina Nuh(سيدنا نوح) used whatever was possible to him.

Any method, use it for the sake of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

But all my calling added nothing but to their flight from the truth.

Allah Ho Akbar(الله أكبر).

Nuh(نوح) is making Daʿwah(دعوة‎) to them, and the more Daʿwah(دعوة‎) he gives them, the further away they become, the further away they go.

The more Daʿwah(دعوة‎) he makes, the more they fly away from him.

The more Daʿwah(دعوة‎) he gives them, the worse the situation becomes, Difficult, Very difficult.

And not only that, Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ says; And verily, everytime I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears,

covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted in their refusal, and magnified themselves in pride.

He would give them Daʿwah(دعوة‎), he would be speaking to them, and they would put their fingers in their ears, or they would cover themselves with their clothes, and they would be arrogant and proud.

If you are speaking to someone, and he starts putting his fingers in his ear, and he covers himself up, and he acts arrogantly towards you, will you be able to continue to talk to him?

It’s very difficult, you would barely be able to do it for half an hour or an hour, and then you would be fed up and then you would leave and you would hate him for the rest of your life.

Nuh(نوح) did this for 950 years.

Nuh(نوح) was doing this for 950 years.

950 years - he’s making Daʿwah(دعوة‎) night and day, publicly and privately, and the more Daʿwah(دعوة‎) he gives, the worse the situation would become

and the more animosity would become between him and his people, and the people are not listening to start with.

He’s speaking to closed ears, but he had patience.

He had patience for 950 years.

Sayyidina Nuh(سيدنا نوح) told his people about the value of istighfar(ٱستغفار‎).

I said to them: Ask forgiveness from your Lord; verily, He is Oft-Forgiving.

And listen to the benefits of Istighfar(ٱستغفار‎).

Nuh(نوح) is telling his people the benefits of Istighfar(ٱستغفار‎).

If you make Istighfar(ٱستغفار‎), this is what will happen; He will send rain to you in abundance.

And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens, and bestow on you rivers.

All of these are results of Istighfar(ٱستغفار‎).

And he also turned their attention to creation of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎ around them because the creation of Allah is a mirror of the Attributes of Allah سبحانه وتعالى‎.

He told them; See you not how Allah has created seven heavens, one above the other?

And has made the moon a light therein and made the sun a lamp?

And Allah has brought you forth from the dust of the earth, afterwards He would return you into the earth and bring you forth again on the Day of Resurrection.
