parts.english:
The Life Of Muhammad ﷺ Madinan Period Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki; Dear Brothers and Sisters, This is our second session of the Madina series, Part Two.

We're talking about the last five years of Rasool Allah ﷺ in Madina.

We talked last session about some events that occurred between Al-Khandaq(ألخندق) and Ghazwa-Tul-Hudaybiyyah(غزوةالحديبيه).

So we carry on now we're in the six year of Hijrah(هجرة) and Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) starts this year with mentioning Ghazwat Zee Qarad(غزوة زي قَرَد) or Ghazwat Al-Ghabaa(غزوة الغابه).

This story has been mentioned by Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ), Muslim(مسلم) Al-Imam Ahmad(الاِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) and also Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) mentioned it, so there's various narrations for this story

and I'll read you the one by Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) which is here in Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) and I'll translate it as I read it.

Al-Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) narrates from Salamah Ibn Akwah(سَلَمَهْ بِنْ اَكْوَعْ) that, he along with one of the slaves of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Rabbah(رباح),

they went out of Madina for the camels to graze and it mentions in, another narration by, I think it's by Al-Waqidee(الواقدي) that they used to take them first to a place called Bay'yaaz(بياض),

and then that area ran out of pasture.

So, they had to move further on to a place called the Al-Ghaabah(ألغابه), in order, for the camels to graze.

And Salamah(سلمه), he wasn't with the camels of Rasool Allahﷺ, I mean he wasn't appointed as shepherd, it was Rabbah(رباح), who was the shepherd but Salamah(سلمه), he went out

because he had the horse of Talha Bin Obaid-Ellah(طلحه بن عبيدالله), Talha Bin Obaid-Ellah(طلحه بن عبيدالله) is one of Al-Muhajireen(المهاجرين)

one of the 10 who are given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

And Salamah Ibn Akwah(سَلَمَهْ بِنْ اَكْوَعْ) is also a Muhajir(مهاجر), although he's not from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

See you have Muhajireen(المهاجرين) and Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).

Who are Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).?

Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) are Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألأوس ولخزرج) that's it.

There's no other Ansaar(ألأنصار), Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) are two tribes, two tribes make up Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار), it's only these two tribes.

It is Al-Aos(إلأوس) and Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) and these, two tribes our brethren in terms of genealogy, Ya'ani(يعني) they are from the same descendents of Al-Azd(ألأزد)

and Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) are everyone else who made Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina the most important group of Al-Muhajireen(ألمهاجرين), obviously are Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

the tribe of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), Umar(عُمَر), Talha Bin Obaid-Ellah(طلحه بن عبيدالله), Saad Ibn Abi Waqas(سعدبن ابي وقاص), Abu Obaidah Amr Bin Jarrah(ابوعبيدةعمروبن جرَّاح), Saeed Bin Zaid(سعيدبن زيد),

all of these are from the Al-Muhajireen(ألمهاجرين) from Makkah.

But then you had Muhajireen(ألمهاجرين) from other tribes also you had from Bannu Sulaim(بنو سُلَيْم), you had from Ghaffar(غِفار) for example Abu Dhar Al-Ghaffari(أبو ذر إلغفاري).

Ghifaar(غفار) are Bedouin tribes in Hijaaz(حجاز), and Abu Dhar Al-Ghaffari(أبو ذر الغفاري) was Muhajir(مهاجر) from there, then you have Abu Musa Al-Ashari(أبو موسى ألأشعري) is also considered the Mohajer(مهاجر), he came from Yemen.

So, all of these people who came from outside Madina are called Muhajireen(مهاجرين).

So, Salamah Ibn Akwah(سَلَمَهْ بِنْ اَكْوَعْ), he is a Mohajer(مهاجر) but he's not from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

He was serving some of the other Sahabah رضي الله عنهم he was working for Talha Bin Obaid-Ellah(طلحه بن عبيدالله), he would take out his horse for it, to go out and graze on, the pasture outside of Al-Madina.

And they had to leave early in the day, another narration it says, that they left before Fajar(فجر) before the first Aadhan(آذان), so very early on, in the day they had to go out.

Regarding the camels of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they would leave early in the day and they would come back at the time of Maghrib(مغرب) and then they would milk them and have their dinner.

When it was Ghalas(غلس), Ghalas(غلس) is the time of Fajar(فجر) but it's still dark Abdur Rahman Ibn Uyaynah(عبدالرحمن إبن عيينه) and these are from the tribe of Ghatafaan(غطافان)

they attacked and they stole the camels of Rasool Allah ﷺ and they killed, the shepherd.

Salama(سلمه) said: So, I told Rabbah(رباح) take this horse and go back to Madina and deliver to Talha Bin Obaid-Ellah(طلحه بن عبيدالله) and let Rasool Allah ﷺ know that his camels have been taken away.

Salama رضي الله عنه, rather than taking the horse himself, he gave it to Rabbah(رباح), in order to take it back to Madina, and he depended on his own legs,

he was a very fast runner.

So, he wanted the news to get back to Madina very fast.

So, he sent Rabbah(رباح) with his horse, but he, himself he climbed over a small mountain or on top of the hill and then he cried three times Wa-Subhaa(وَصُبْاحَاه) is the call of emergency

it's like 911 there's something urgent and there's an emergency that is, what you say and it's especially said, when an army has attacked, you say Wa-Subhaa(وَصُبْاحَاه)

and that is the call that Rasool Allah ﷺ, made when he wanted to announce to the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) the message.

So when a person calls Wa-Subhaa(وَصُبْاحَاه) people are definitely going to come and listen to him.

Salamah Ibn Akwah(سَلَمَهْ بِنْ اَكْوَعْ) he stood on the mountain on this hill and he called Wa-Subhaa(وَصُبْاحَاه) and his voice was heard in Madina

and that is when the men were calling and saying when they heard his call, they were saying, And this was the first time this slogan was used.

O, horses of Allah  ride on.

And the Sahabah(صحابه) responded to the call very fast and they came rushing towards Rasool Allahﷺ, when they heard the call of Salamah(سلمه).

Now Salamah(سلمه) himself after that he followed Abdur Rahman Ibn Uyaynah(عبدالرحمن إبن عيينه), and he said; I had with me my sword, and my bow and arrow.

And I would shoot at them and, Means I would kill their horses, he would target the horses and kill the horses And I would do that when there would be a lot of trees because he could ambush them.

And he could also take a position of hiding that to protect him.

He said: I would shoot them, when I would be in between trees.

And whenever, one of their horsemen would come back to me I would hide for him, behind the tree, and I would shoot at him, while I would call out to them, the Battle Cry of

This is a line of poetry that he made.

It says; Take it!

I am Ibn-Al-Aqwa(ابن الاكوع), I'm the son of Al-Aqwa(اكوع), today the wicked will die.

Means today the wicked will die and he would repeat on this battle cry again and again.

He said: When I would be in the trees, I would burn them with my arrows.

And if we come through mountain passes narrow trails in the mountain, I would climb on top of them and throw them with rocks.

So, Salama Ibn Al-Akwa رضي الله عنه was driving these men crazy.

I mean, he's alone and he's fighting this entire group of men.

So, first of all, he's alone and they are a large group.

Number two, he was on foot and they were on horseback.

But Salamah(سلمه) was courageous and he was fast, and he was a good Archer.

And, the most important of all, he was a Mo'min(مؤمن).

He said: Everything that they have taken away, I left it behind my back.

These men were running away from Salamah(سلمه) and to make themselves light and faster in running away from him.

They left behind the camels and then they started in fact, leaving behind some of their own belongings.

It says in one narration that they left behind them 30 spears and 30 cloaks, Burad(بُرد) they had to leave all this behind them, to lighten their weight

and whenever, Salamah(سلمه) would come across something, they would leave he would put some stones on top of it to mark its location.

And then, they received reinforcements from Uyayena Bin Badar Al-Fizaari(عيينة بن بدر ألفزاري) he came to them and they were in a narrow mountain pass.

So, I climbed on top of them.

And then Uyeyena(عيينة) said: What is this that I see?

They said, We have seen such a difficult time from this man.

And then they said: He has not left us since early in the day, until this moment and he has taken everything away from us, Uyeyena(عيينة) told them, if this man sees that you are pursuing him, he would not follow you.

Meaning why are you leaving them alone?

You are the ones who are giving him, that chance but pursue him and he will leave you alone.

So, four of them at the command of Uyeyena(عيينة) started climbing up the mountain to go up to Salamahرضي الله عنه.

So, they started climbing the mountain, until they were in his voice range, he said, When they were in his voice, he said: You know who I am?

They said: No. He said: I am the son of Al-Aqwa(الأكوع), in the name of the one, who has honored the face of Muhammadﷺ none of you would follow me and reach me

and none of you, whom I follow will escape me, if you try to chase me.

If you try to get me, you won't be able to but if I pursue you I would hunt you down.

One of them said: I think he's right.

And then they descended.

At that time I started seeing the Knights of Rasool Allah ﷺ approaching.

I could see them between the trees.

The first among them was Akhram Al-Asdi(اَلأخْرم الأسدي) and following him was Abu Qatada(ابوقتادة), the Faris(فارس) of Rasool Allah ﷺ the knight of Rasool Ullah.

and after Abu Qatada(ابوقتادة) was Al-Miqdad Ibn Al-Aswad(ألمقداد إبن الأسود).

When the polytheist saw that, they ran away.

The first as we said was Akhram Al-Asdi(اَلأخْرم الأسدي), so I came down and I held on to the reins of his horse and I told him: O Akhram( أخرم) Be careful from them!

Because I fear that they will cut you off, because Al-Akhram( الأخرم) was ahead of the rest and he was alone.

And Salamah(سلمه) wanted to warn him that, if you carry on pursuing the Kuffar(كفار) alone and you don't wait for the rest of the Muslims to follow they would cut you off and surround you.

What was the response of Akhram Al-Asdi(اَلأخْرم الأسدي) he said, He said: O Salamah(سلمه), if you believe in Allah and the last day and you believe that Jannah(جنة) is true, and Naar(النار) is true

then don't stand between me and martyrdom, Allah-Ho-Akbar(الله اكبر).

Look at the love that Al-Akhram( الأخرم) had for meeting Allahعَزّوجَلّ he wanted to meet Allahعَزّوجَلّ as a Shaheed(شهيد).

Salamah(سلمه) said; I let him go.

So, he pursued Abdur Rahman Ibn Uyeyena(عبدالرحمن إبن عيينه), and Uyeyena(عيينه) turned around, to face him.

each one of them stab the other Al-Akhram(الأخرم) stabbed the horse of Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) but Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) stabbed him and killed him,

so now the horse of Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) was killed and Al-Akhram( الأخرم) was killed.

So Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) now took over the horse of Al-Akhram( الأخرم).

Now, the opposite happened Abu Qatadah(ابوقتادة) attacked, Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) and in this case it was Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن), who killed the horse, stabbed at the horse of Abu Qatadah(ابوقتادة) and killed it.

While the Abu Qatadah(ابوقتادة) stabbed Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) and killed him so now he took over the horse that Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) had which is originally the horse of Al-Akhram( الأخرم).

This is amazing here, Salamah(سلمه) said; And now I started running after the enemies of Allah until, I could not see from the dust of the companions of Rasool Ullah a thing.

All of the horsemen of Rasool Allah ﷺ were now behind Salamah(سلمه) while Salamah(سلمه) was running on foot.

So, now it was almost Maghrib(مغرب) time, sunset and they reached to a valley that had some water in it.

It's called Zou Qarad(ذوقرد) and they wanted to drink from that water but when they saw me running after them, pursuing them they left it and they started running up the hills.

And now the sun has set, so I followed one of them and I struck him, with an arrow and I told him, So, he repeated, his battle cry, take it, I am the son of Al-Aqwa(الأكوع),

today the wicked will die, whay did that man say?

He said: Woe to your mother, are you the Aqwa(أكوع) of this morning.?

I mean are you the same man who has been following us since the beginning of the day.?

I said yes, You enemy of yourself!

And this happened to be a man whom I have already struck with an arrow in the morning, so now he had two arrows sticking out of him.

He said: They left behind them two horses, so I took them over and now I went back to Rasool Allah ﷺ and I found them sitting on the same well or water

that was in this valley which the Mushrikeen(مشركين) wanted to drink from and I found Rasool Allah ﷺ with 500 men and Bilal(بلال) was slaughtering for them one of the camels that I have left behind me

and he was roasting part of its liver and it's meaning And he was roasting for them from this camel and I came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and told him.

O Rasool Ullah, let me choose 100 from amongst your men and I would pursue with them, the Kuffar(كفار), until we'll leave none of them alive.

would you do so, O Salamah(سلمه).

I said: Yes.

In the name of Allah, who has honored you, Rasool Allah ﷺ laughed, until I saw his teeth from the light of the fire.

Now, they are already being fed in the land of Ghatafaan(غطفان).

A man came from Ghatafaan(غطفان) and said: They passed by certain men from Ghatafaan(غطفان), so he slaughtered for them a camel And when they started skinning the camel,

they saw some dust, so they left it and ran away they thought that this is Rasool Allah ﷺ and his companions so they didn't even enjoy their meal.

When it was morning of the next day, Rasool Allah ﷺ said, The best of our horseman today, is Abu Qatadah(ابوقتادة) and the best of our foot soldiers is Salamah(سلمه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ gave me spoils of war equal to that of a knight and a foot soldier together.

And he had me ride with him on his Camel, Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء), until when we were going back to Madina.

When we were close to Al-Madina.

When we were close to Al-Madina and Dhahwa(ضَحْوَةْ) is something like around half a day distance or something like that.

And amongst us, was a man from an Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), who was not defeated in racing He would call out, Is there anyone who would race me.?

This was the best among Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), fast runner.

Is there anyone who would race me, to Madina?

And we kept on repeating that again and again, while I am behind Rasool Allah ﷺ so I told him.

Don't you honor, the honorable and Don't you fear the noble.

He said: No except Rasool Allah ﷺ, What's Salamah(سلمه) meant by that is I mean, you've been challenging us too much.

Don't you have respect for anyone, obviously he was joking with this Ansaari(اَنصاري) and saying don't you respect the noble or fear the powerful

so this man said: No, except Rasool Allahﷺ this is the only one, whom I would not challenge.

Tayyab(طيب), when he said that and Salama Ibn Aqwaرضي الله عنه has been running the entire day before but this challenge was too much for him, to pass on

because this man has been repeating it again and again.

So, he said; So I said O Messenger of Allah May my father and mother be sacrifice for you.

Let me race this man.

If you want.

So, he said: I'll come to you and at this, he jumped off his mount and I bent my leg and jumped down from the camel and then Salama رضي الله عنه let the man get the head of him,

while he was holding himself back because he said He wanted to preserve his breath, so he was allowing this man to be ahead of him for a particular distance,

until we got close to Madina, then I ran hard and when I was behind him, I slapped him between his shoulders with my hand and told him; I beat you in the name of Allah,

the man laughed and said: I agreed, so he went into Madina.

So, for the entire race this Ansari(اَنصاري) was ahead of Salamah(سلمه) but when they were close to Madina, Salamah(سلمه) picked up speed and then when he was passing next to the Ansari(اَنصاري)

he patted him between his shoulders and told him I beat you by the name of Allah, the man said; You are right.

And this was the fastest runner among Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) but nobody can beat Salama Ibn Aqwa رضي الله عنه.

This is the story of Ghazwat Zee Qarad(غزوة زي قَرَد) or what is called also Ghazwat Al-Ghabaa(غزوة الغابه).

And then Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) talks here about the camel of Rasool Allah ﷺ Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) and the story of the Camel Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) because here we mentioned

that Rasool Allah ﷺ was riding on Al-Adbaa(ألعضباء) and he had Salama رضي الله عنه ride with him.

So, what's the story of Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء)?

Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) was a very fast Camel and it belongs to a man from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل) so how did it end up in the hands of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

This Hadith(حديث) is narrated by Imam Ahmad Bin Hanbal رضي الله عنه, it says that; Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) belong to a man from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل) and it was a racing camel

It was very fast Camel, it was Hajj(حج) racing camel.

This man was taken captive by the Muslims along with his camel.

Rasool Allah ﷺ passed by him, when he was tied up and Rasool Allah ﷺ was riding on a donkey then so the man called out to Muhammadﷺ and said;

Why did you take me and take the Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء), the racing camel of Hajj(حَجْ).

This man from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل) it is protesting, Why was he arrested?

Why was he taken captive?

He was traveling somewhere in Arabia and the Sahabah(صحابه) saw him and they captured him, and brought him to Madina and they tie him up.

So, now when he saw Muhammadﷺ passing by him, he said: Why have you taken me?

Rasool Allah ﷺ responded back and this man, the reason why, he was protesting is because his particular tribe were not in a state of war with the Muslims,

they were not fighting the Muslims, there was no battle between them and the Muslim.

So, why was I taken.

Rasool Allah ﷺ answered back and told him, We take you because of the fault of your allies Thaqeef(ثقيف).

Now Thaqeef(ثقيف) were in war with Rasool Allah ﷺ, up until that moment there were no battles between the Muslims and Thaqeef(ثقيف) but Thaqeef(ثقيف) were supportive of Quraish(قريش) in their efforts and they were against Islam in general

and we know the story of Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he went to At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف) because Thaqeef(ثقيف) are the tribe that lives in At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف)

and we know what happened to Rasool Allah ﷺ in that journey.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ said: We have taken captive because of the actions of your allies Thaqeef(ثقيف).

At that particular moment, Thaqeef(ثقيف) have taken two Muslims as captives, you see.

So, now Rasool Allah ﷺ has taken this man as captive as a revenge against Thaqeef(ثقيف) even though, this man himself was not from Thaqeef(ثقيف)

but he was from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل), the allies of Thaqeef(ثقيف).

So, what did the man say, he said: I'm a Muslim.

You see, he said, I'm a Muslim.

What did Rasool Allah tell him.

He told them, if you said it.

When you had the authority over yourself, then you would have been very successful.

Meaning if you have said so when you were free now you are a captive and you're trying to claim that you are Muslim, this would have benefited you before.

The man said: He said: O Muhammad(محمد) I am hungry so feed me and I'm thirsty, so quench my thirst.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; This is your need.

In this regard, there are rights for the prisoner he's fed and he's provided for.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ told him this is your need, to take, what you need.

Back we have stories in the Battle of Badr(بدر)  that the Ansaarرضي الله عنهم, when Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Treat the prisoners well.

The Ansaar(انصار) would give the prisoners who are Mushrikeen(مشركين) from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) who came out to fight against Rasool Allah ﷺ they would give them the wheat bread

and they, the Ansaar(أنْصَار) would eat the dates and it's considered that wheat bread is a better quality food.

So, they would give them the bread and they would keep the dates for themselves.

So now Rasool Allah ﷺ told him this is your need, we're not going to prevent you from eating and drinking.

What happened next.

He was used as a ransom for the two Muslims, who were taken prisoner.

However he was not given his Camel back.

Rasool Allah ﷺ took that camel for himself.

So this man from Bannu Aqeel(بنوعقيل) was used in this prisoner exchange.

He was exchanged for the two Muslim prisoners and Rasool Allah took Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) for himself and it was a very fast and good camel.

Now, when the Mushrikeen(مشركين) have taken over camels of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they have also taken with them a Muslim woman from Bannu Ghaffar(بنوغفار)

and whenever they would rest at night they would leave their camels.

In their and this area with them.

So this woman, one night while they were asleep she started walking towards each camel in order to take it and run away on its back to Madina

but the camel would refuse, Ragha(رغا) it would make this sound, that the camel makes and until she came to Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) and Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء) was silent and when she rode on Al-Adhba'a(ألعضباء).

It was a very it was very well domesticated and very simple to lead.

So, she made Nadhar(نذر) a promise to Allah(عَزّوجَلّ), if Allah saves her on the back of this camel.

She would slaughter this camel for the sake of Allah.

So look at what her promise is.

That this camel that will save her, if she arrives safely to Madina, she would slaughter this camel for the sake of Allah.

Now she did arrive to Madina and she told Rasool Allah ﷺ about her promise.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told her.

What a bad reward you are rewarding this camel.

This camel has saved you and brought you to Madina, now you want to slaughter it, and then Rasool Allah ﷺ told her.

You do not have to fulfill a promise that includes a sin and you do not have to fulfill a promise and we're talking about Nadhar(نذر) here not promise with a human being.

If you make Nadhar(نذر) to Allah, promise to Allah also if you don't own a thing and because he didn't own this camel, this camel belong to Rasool Allah ﷺ

Rasool Ullah told her: Not to sacrifice the camel.

Tayyab(طيب).

Some lessons from these stories that we mentioned so far First of all in the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Zee Qarad(زي قرد)  we can see the fitness of Salama Bin Aqwa رضي الله عنه

and we can see some of the activities that the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم would practice such as running, Salamah(سلمه) and this man from Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) they had the competition in running

and that was approved by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So the Sahaba رضي الله عنهم were fit and they were strong and this is part of Edaad(ألعِدَاد) which the Muslims were commanded to do.

The Muslims were told to prepare for the sake of Allahعَزّوجَلّ Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

We can see here that Salama Bin Aqwa رضي الله عنه was pursuing this enemy for an entire day, without tiring out.

In fact, they were getting tired and their beasts were getting tired because as we mentioned it, in the end of the Hadith(حديث) that they have left behind them two horses.

Why did they leave behind those two horses?

Do you think about that?

Why would they leave behind them two horses and a horse is a very valuable thing in those days, really expensive.

Why would they leave behind a horse, unless they had to?

Because the horse was tired, the horse was tired out.

So they had to leave these two horses behind them.

Salama Bin Aqwa(سلمه ابن اَلْاَكوع) was a very fit Sahabi رضي الله عنه.

From the story of the woman, there's a lesson mentioned by An-Nawwawi(النووي) and this is regarding the traveling of a woman alone.

He says in this Hadith(حديث), we can derive the ruling that it is allowed for a Muslim woman, to travel alone without her husband or without a guardian and without anyone else.

If, it is a necessary travel and this is an important point that he mentions such as Hijrah(هجرة) from the land of war to the land of Islam.

And such as running away from those who want to sin with her and similar situations and a Muslim woman is prohibited from traveling alone when there is no necessity in her travel.

So, this would clarify some issues, here the statement by Imam An-Nawwawi رضي الله عنه clarifies this issue of the traveling a woman.

Sometimes a Muslim woman is in great need of traveling alone and it's a necessity for her.

In this case she is allowed to and he mentions as an example, making Hijrah(هجرة).

Tayyab(طيب) it's also probably beneficial here to talk about the rulings regarding POW's in general because we have covered a few cases up until this moment of how Muslims treat the POW's.

So we'll summarize it all now because we are already talking about prisoners that were taken in Al-Badr(البدر) and here we talked about this man from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل).

What is the ruling regarding prisoners of war?

Can they be executed, can they be ransomed or should they be released, what is it exactly?

Because we have seen that they were treated differently in different situations.

To summarize this point, Ash-Shoukani(الشوكاني) says, He said, That the Mad'hab(مذهب) of the majority of scholars is that the issue of disbelieving prisoners of war is up to the Imam(اِمَام).

The men, who are Kuffar(كفار) who are prisoners of war, it is up to the Imam(امام) to do with them what is the most beneficial for the Muslims.

So, what does this mean?

It means that Number one.

They could be released without any compensation and the example of this is what Rasool Allah ﷺ did with Abu Azzah(ابوعزة) in the Battle of Badr(بدر).

Abu Azzah(ابوعزة) was one of the captives the 70 captives that were taken in the battle of Badr(بدر).

Abu Azzah(ابوعزة), he pleaded to the Messenger of Allah and told him that I have daughters that are left alone and I don't have any wealth to ransom myself.

So for the sake of my daughters release me and Rasool Allah ﷺ released him, without asking him for any compensation whatsoever.

He was only released on condition that he doesn't fight against the Muslims again and he consented to that.

The second option is to ransom them.

And this is what happened with the rest of the prisoners in the Battle of Badr(بدر) such as Al-Abbas(العباس) they had to pay for their ransom and they were released.

The third option they could be exchanged for Muslim prisoners.

And the example of that is what we just talked about with this man from Banni Aqeel(بني عقيل) he was exchanged for two Muslim prisoners.

The next option is to be executed and this is what Rasool Allah ﷺ did with An-Nazr Bin Haris(النضربن الحارث) and Uqba Bin Abi Moayeet(عقبةبن ابي معيت) in the Battle of Badr(بدر)

and Abu Azzah(ابوعزة) when he was arrested again in the battle of Uhud(أحَد).

When he was captured again in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) he has already promised that is not going to fight against Rasool Allah ﷺ and now he was caught fighting against the Muslims, so he was executed.

And also the entire fighting force of Bannu Quraizah(بنوقريظة), the Jewish tribe Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered, that they be put to death.

So these are the different options that the Imam(اِمَام) has regarding the Prisoners of War.

Next اِنْ شاءالله تعالى we'll talk about the important event of Al-Hudaybiya(الحديبيه), so we'll leave that until our next session.
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

وَقَالَ اِمَامُ اَحْمَدْ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمْ اِبْنِ القَاسِمْ حَدَّثّنا عِكْرِمَة بِنْ عَمَّارْ حَدَّ ثَّنِيْ اِيَّاس بِنْ سَلَمَهْ بِنْ اَكْوَعْ عَنْ اَبِيْهِ قَالْ

قَدِّمْنَا الْمَدِيْنَةَ فِيْ زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةْ مَعَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجْتُ اَنَا وَرَبَاْح غُلَامً النَّبِيْ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِظَهْرِ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

وَخَرَجْتُ بِفَرَسِ لِّطَلْحَةَ بِنْ عُبَيْدِ الله ، كُنْتُ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ اُنَدِّيَّه’ مَعَ الْاِبِلْ فِي شجرة النسب فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِغَلَسٍ اَغَارَ عَبْدالرحمن بن عُيَيْنَهْ عَلى اِبِلِ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

فَقَتَلَ رَاعِيْهَا وَخَرَجَ   يَطْرُدُهَا هُوَ وَاُنَاْس مَعَه’ فِيْ الْخَيْلَ وَخَرَجَ   يَطْرُدُهَا هُوَ وَاُنَاْس مَعَه’ فِيْ الْخَيْلَ فَقُلْتُ: يَا رباح

اُقْعُدْ عَلى هَذَا الْفَرَسْ فَالْحِقْه’ بِطَلْحَه، وَاَخْبِرْ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم اَنَّه’ قَدْ اُغِيْرَ عَلى سَرْحِهْ قَال: وَقُمْتُ عَلى تَلٍّ فَجَعَلْتُ اوَجْهِيْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَدِيْنَةْ ،

ثُمَّ نَادَيْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتْ: يَا صُبْاحَاهْ قال: ثُمَّ اَتْبَعْتُ الْقَوْمَ مَعِيْ سَيْفِيْ وَنَبْلِيْ فَجَعَلْتُ اَرْمِيْهِمْ وَاَعْقَرْبِهِمْ،وَذَالِكَ حِيْنَ يَكْثُرُ الشَّجَرَ

وَصُبْاحَاهْ، وَصُبْاحَاهْ، وَصُبْاحَاهْ يَا خَيْلَ اللهِ الرْكَبِيْ يَا خَيْلَ اللهِ الرْكَبِيْ فَجَعَلْتُ اَرْمِيْهِمْ وَاَعْقَرْبِهِمْ وَاَعْقَرْبِهِمْ،

وَذَالِكَ حِيْنَ يَكْثُرُ الشَّجَرَ فَاِذَا رَجَعَ اِلَيَّ فَارِسٌ جَلَسْتُ لَه’ فِيْ اَصْلِ شَّجَرَةْ، ثُمَّ رَمَيْتَ فَلَا يُقْبِلْ عَلَيَّ فَارِسٌ اِلَّا عَقَرْتُ بِهْ

فَجَعَلْتُ اَرْمِيْهِمْ، وَاَنَا اَقُوْلْ : اَنَا اِبْنِ الْاَكْوَعْ، وَالْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ خُذْهَا وَاَنَا اِبْنِ الْاَكْوَعْ وَالْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ

اَلْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ فَاِذَا كُنْتُ فِيْ الشَّجَرْ اَحْرَقْتُهُمْ بِالْنَبَلْ ، فَاِذَا تَضَايَقَتِ الثَّنَايَا عَلَوْتُ الْجَبَلَ فَرَدَيْتُهُمْ بِالْحِجَارَةْ

فَمَا زَالَ ذَالِكَ شَاْنِيْ وَشَاْنُهُمْ اَتَّبِعُهُمْ وَارْتَجِزْ، حَتَّى مَا خَلَقَ اللهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ ظَهَرِ رسول االه صلى الله عليه وسلم اِلَّا خَلَّفْتَه’ وَرَاَءْ ظَهْرِيْ

اَحْرَقْتُهُمْ بِالْنَبَلْ حَتَّى إِذَا امْتَدْ الضُّحَى أَتَاهُمْ عُيَيْنَة بِنْ بَدْر اَلْفَزَارِيْ مَدَدَا لَّهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْ ثَنِيَّةٍ ضَيِّقَةْ ، ثُمَّ عَلَوْتُ الْجَبَلْ ، فَأَنَا فَوْقَهُمْ

فَقَالَ عُيَيْنَةْ : مَا هَذَا الَّذِيْ أَرَى ؟

قَالُوْا : لَقِيْنَا مِنْ هَذَا الْبَرْحْ مَا فَارَقَنَا بِسَحَرٍ حَتَّى الْآنْ ، وَأَخَذَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فِيْ أَيْدِيْنَا وَجَعَلَه’ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهْ

فَقَالَ عُيَيْنَةْ : لَوْلَا أَنَّ هَذَا يَرَى أَنَّ وَرَاَءَهْ طَلَبَا لَّقَدْ تَرَكَكُمْ ، لِيَقُمْ إِلَيْهِ نَفَرُ مِّنْكُمْ فَلَمَّا أَسْمَعْتَهُمْ الصَوْتَ قُلْتَ : أَتَعْرِفُوْنَنِيْ ؟

قَالُوْا : وَمَنْ أَنْت ؟ قُلْتُ : أَنَا اِبْنُ الْأَكْوَعْ وَالَّذِيْ كَرَّمَ وَجْهِ محمد لَا يَطْلُبْنِيْ رَجُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ فَيُدْرِكْنِيْ وَلَا أَطْلُبُهْ فَيَفُوْتَنِيْ

فَقَالَ رَجُلُ مِّنْهُمْ  اَنَ أَظُنْ قَالَ : فَمَا بَرِحْتُ مَقْعَدِيْ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى فَوَارِسَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَّخَلَّلُوْنَ الشَّجَرَ

وَإِذَا أَوَّلُهُمْ اَلْأَخْرَمْ اَلْأَسْدِيْ وَعَلى أِثْرِ أَبِيْ قَتَادَةْ اَلْمِقْدَادْ بِنْ اَلْأَسْوَدْ فَوَلَّى الْمُشْرِكُوْنَ  مُدْبِرِيْنَ

وَأَنْزِلُ مِنَّ الْجَبَلِ فَآخَذُ عَنَانَ فَرَسِهْ ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَخْرَمْ اَنْذِرِ الْقَوْمْ يَعْنِيْ اِحْذَرْهُمْ - فَإِنِّيْ لَا آمَنْ مِنْ أَنْ يَقْتَطِعُوْكَ ،

فَاتَّئِدْ حتَىَّ يَلْحِقَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهْ قَالَ يَا سَلَمة ، إِنْ كُنْتَ تُؤْمِنْ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرْ وَتَعْلَمْ أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ حَقّْ وَالنَّارْ حَقّْ فَلَا تَحُلْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ الشَّهَادَةْ

فَخَلَّيْتُ عَنَّانَ فَرَسِهْ فَيَلْحِقْ بِعَبْدُ الرحمن بن عيينة وَيَعْطِفُ عَلَيْهِ عبد الرحمن فَاخْتَلَفَا طَعْنَتَيْنَ فَعَقْرَ الْأخرم بِعَبْدُ الرحمن

فَتَحَوَّلَ عَبْد الرحمن عَلَى فَرَسِ الْأَخْرَم ، فَيَلْحَقْ أَبُوْ قَتَادَةْ بِعَبْدُ الرحمن فَاخْتَلَفَا طَعْنَتَيْنَ فَعُقِرَة بِي اَبِي قَتَادَة وَقَتَلَه أَبُوْ قَتَاَدَةْ ، وَتَحَوَّلَ أَبُوْ قَتَادَةْ عَلَى فَرَسِ الْأَخْرَمْ

ثُمَّ إِنِّيْ خَرَجْتُ أَعْدُوْ فِيْ أَثْرِ الْقَوْمَ حَتَّى مَا أَرَى مِنْ غُبَارِ صَحَابَةِ النَّبِيْ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئَا وَيُعْرِضُوْنَ قَبْلَ غَيْبُوْبَةِ الشَّمْسَ إِلَى شِعْبٍ فِيْهِ مَاءْ يُقَالُ لَه ذُوْ قَرَدْ

فَأَرَادُوْا أَنْ يَشْرَبُوْا مِنْه’ ، فَأَبْصَرُوْنِيْ أَعْدُوْ وَرَاءَهُمْ فَعَطَفُوْا عَنْه’ وَغَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسَ ، وَأَلْحَقُ رَجُلْ فَأَرْمِيْهَ

خُذْهَا وَاَنَا اِبْنِ الْاَكْوَعْ وَالْيَوْم يَوْمُ الرُّضَّعْ فَقَالَ : يَا ثَكْلَ أُمَّ أَكْوَعْ بُكْرَةْ فَقُلْتَ : نَعْمَ أَيّ عَدُّوَّ نَفْسَهْ

وَكَانَ الَّذِيْ رَمَيْتَه’ بُكْرَةْ وَأَتْبَعْتَه’ سَهْمًا آخَرْ فَعَلِقَ بِهْ سَهْمَانْ وَيَخْلُفُوْنَ فَرَسَيْنَ فَجِئْتُ بِهِمَا أَسُوْقَهُمَا

إِلَى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَاءْ اَلَّذِيْ أَجْلَيْتُهُمْ عَنْه ذُوْ قَرَدْ - وَإِذَا بِنَبِيُ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيْ خَمْس مِائَةْ

وَإِذَا بِلَالْ قَدْ نَحَرَ جَزُوْرَا مِمَّا خَلَّفْتَ ، فَهُوَ يَشْوِيْ لِرَسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ كَبدِهَا وَسَنَامِهَا كَبدِهَا وَسَنَامِهَا

يا رسول الله ، خَلِّنِيْ فَأَنْتَخِبُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ مِائَةْ ، فَآخَذْ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ بِالْعَشْوَةْ ، فَلَا يَبْقَى مِنْهُمْ مُخْبِرْ إِلَّا قَتَلْتَه

فَقَالَ : " أَكُنْتَ فَاعِلٍا ذَلِكَ يَا سَلَمْةَ ؟

قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ وَالَّذِيْ أَكْرَمَكْ ثُمَّ قَالْ : إِنَّهُمْ يَقْرَوْنَ الْآنْ بِأَرْضِ غَطَفَان مَرُّوْا عَلَى فُلَانْ الغطفاني، فَنَحْرَ لَهُمْ جَزُوْرًا

فَلَمَّا أَخَذُوْا يَكْشَطُوْنَ جِلْدَهَا رَأَوْا غَبَرَةْ ، فَتَرَكُوْهَا وَخَرَجُوْا هِرَابًا خَيْرُ فُرْسَانِنَا الْيَوْم أبو قتادة ، وَخَيْرُ رَجَّالَتِنَا سَلَمَة

فَأَعْطَانِيْ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سَهْمٌ الفَارِسْ وَالرَاجُلْ جَمِيْعَا ثُمَّ أَرْدَفَنِيْ وَرَاءَهُ عَلَى الْعَضْبَاءْ رَاجِعِيْنَ إِلَى الْمَدِيْنَةَ

فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ قَرِيْبَ مِنْ ضَحْوَةْ وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ اَلْأَنْصَارْ كَانَ لَا يُسْبَقْ جَعَلَ يُنَادِيْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ قَرِيْبَ مِنْ ضَحْوَةْ

وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ اَلْأَنْصَارْ كَانَ لَا يُسْبَقْ فَجَعَلَ يُنَادِيْ : هَلْ مِنْ مُسَابِقْ أَلَا رَجُلٌ يُسَابِقْ إِلَى الْمَدِيْنَةْ

أَمَّا تُكْرِمُ كَرِيْمًا وَلَا تَهَابُ شَرِيْفًا يا رسول الله ، بِأَبِيْ أَنْتَ وَأُمِّيْ ، خَلِّنِيْ فَلَأُسَابِقَ الرَّجُلْ . قَالَ : إِنْ شِئْتَ

قَالَ : إِنْ شِئْتَ قُلْتَ : اَذْهَبْ إِلَيْكَ . فَطَفَرَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهْ وَثَنَيْتُ رِجْلِيْ فَطَفَرْتُ عَنْ النَّاقَةْ ثُمَّ إِنِّيْ رَبَطْتُّ عَلَيْهِ شَرَفًا أَوْ شَرْفَيْنَ ، يَعْنِيْ اِسْتَبْقَيْتَ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ

ثُمَّ إِنِّيْ عَدَوْتُ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَّهْ ، فَأَصُكْ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ بِيَدِيْ ، قُلْتَ : سَبَقْتُكَ وَالله أَوْ كَلِمَةْ نَحْوَهَا . قَالَ : فَضَحِكْ وَقَالَ : إِنْ أَظُنْ . حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِيْنَةْ

اِسْتَبْقَيْ نَفْسِيْ إِنْ أَظُنْ كَانَتِ الْعَضْبَاءْ :لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِيْ عَقِيْلْ ، وَكَانَتْ مِنْ سَوَابِقِ الْحَاج مِنْ سَوَابِقِ الْحَاج

يَا محمد ، عَلَامَ تَأْخُذُوْنِيْ وَتَأْخُذُوْنِ سَابِقَةِ الْحَاجْ نَأْخُذُكَ بِجَرِيْرَةِ حُلَفَائِكَ ثَقِيْفَ قَالَ :لَوْ قُلْتَهَا وَأَنْتَ تَمْلِكُ أَمْرَكْ ، أَفْلَحْتَ كُلَّ الفَلَاحْ

وَأَنْتَ تَمْلِكُ أَمْرَكْ يا محمد ، إِنِّيْ جَائِعٌ فَأَطْعِمْنِيْ وَإِنِّيْ ظَمْآنٌ فَاسْقِنِيْ هَذِه حَاجَتِكْ فِيْ اَفْنِيَتِهِمْ فَكَانَتْ نَاقَةْ ذَلُوْل

بِئْسِ مَا جَزِتِهَا " لَا وَفَاءْ لِنَذْرٍ فِيْ مَعْصِيَةِ الله ، وَلَا فِيْمَا لِا يَمْلِكْ اِبْنِ آدَمْ " يَقُوْلُ اَلنَّوَوِيْ فِيْ هَذَالْحَدِيْثْ

جَوَازُ سَفَرِ الْمرأْة وَحْدَهَا بِلَا زَوْجَ وَلَا مَحْرَمْ وَلَا غَيْرَهُمَا اِذَا كَا نَ السَفَرَ ضَرُوْرة اِذَا كَانَ السَفَرَ ضَرُوْرَة، كَلْ هِجْرَهْ دَارِالحَرْبِ اِلَى دَارِ الْاِسْلَامْ

وَ كَا الحَرَبِ مِمَّنْ يُرِيْدُ مِنْهَا فَاحِشَةً وَ نَحْوِيْ ذَالِكْ وَالنَّهِيْ عَنْ سَفَرِهَا وَحْدَهَا مَحْمُوْلٌ عَلَى غَيْرِ الضَّرُوْرَة

مَذْهَبُ الْجَمْهُوْرْ اَنَّ الْاَمْرَ فِى الْاَسَارَى اَلْكَفَرة مِنْ الرِّجَالْ اِلَى الْاِمَامْ يَفْعَلُ مَاهُوَ أحظ لِلاِسْلَامِ وَ المُسْلِمِيْنْ

بِاِذْنِ الله عَزُّوجَل صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

assets.title: #35. Events Between Battle Of Trench & Hudaybiyyah

parts.english:
The Life Of Muhammad ﷺ Madinan Period Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki; When the Armies disbanded, after the Battle of the trench, The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Now, we will attack them, they will not attack us.

This marked the turning point in the Islamic history, of the new founded state for the past five years the Muslims were engaged in a defensive battle with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

defensive battle for survival.

Now, the tables are turned, it is Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), that will be struggling to survive, it will be Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) who will, now be on the defensive.

Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are the ones who attack the Muslims in Badr(بدر), it was Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), who attacked in Uhud(أحَد), it was Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) who attacked in Al-Khandaq(الخندق)

and that was their last attempt.

That was not because they were having a change of heart or because they were now, somehow becoming more sympathetic of the Muslims, it was simply because they were exhausted

they couldn't carry on this fight, any further.

The Muslims have out done them in patience, and perseverance and they couldn't keep up with them.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ  would say a year from now as we will see when we're talking about Al-Hudaybiyya(ألحديبية).

Woe to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), war has exhausted them.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Surat Al-Imran(سورة العمران), in the last Ayah(آية), Isbiroo(إِصْبِرُوْا) means, be patient, Sabiroo (صَابِرُوْا) in Sarf(صرف) in Arabic in the science of, what is called Sarf(صرف),

looks at the components of the word or the makeup of the word, you see in the Ayah(آية) it says: Isbiroo(إصْبِرُوْا) Wa-Sabiroo(وَصَابِرُوْا),

Isbiroo(إصْبِرُوْا) Wa-Sabiroo(وَصَابِرُواْ) they both come from the same root word which is Sabr(صَبْر) but (إصْبِرُوْا) is a command to be patient.

So, what is Sabiroo (صَابِرُوْا)?

Sabiroo( صَابِرُوْ) is in the Wazan(وَزَنْ) what they call the Wazan(وَزَنْ) of Mufaela(مفاعلة), it is patience between two parties.

So, in Arabic for example, you have Musaria(مسارعه), Mudhariba(مضاربه), Muqatila(مقاتله) here the Fael(فعل) the verb is not done by individual but it's between two parties.

So, as if Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling us that even though you might be patient but what if your enemy is more patient then you, you have to outdo them and patience,

so you have in the Ayah(آية) two commands from Allah, one of them is to be patient and the other one is to outdo your enemy in patience, And that is what the Muslims did and it paid off, now.

After Badr(بدر) and Uhud(أحَد) and Al-Khandaq(ألخندق), now it is Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) who will be on the defensive because the Muslims wore them out, the Muslims tired them.

And now Rasool Allah ﷺ  is saying; Now, we will conquer them, they will not conquer us, we will not attack them, they will not attack us.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) was never again, able to bring together an army to invade Madina that's it, he has done his best, to the extent that he was able,

same with his people, his followers in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), that was the best they could pull off.

The 10,000 strong army of Al-Khandaq(ألخندق).

It was a failure in the end because of the supernatural events that occurred, the wind and the soldiers of Allah.

Only Allah knows His soldiers, we don't know the soldiers of Allah, anything can be a soldier of Allah.

Sometimes things that are blessings, things that they are the reasons for life, could be a soldier of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, like water for example was a soldier of Allah, it killed Firaoun(فرعون),

a mosquito killed Namrood(نمرود), the earth swallowed up Qaroon(قارون), wind is a soldier of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, it destroyed nations, thunderbolts.

So, anything in this universe can be a soldier of Allah, we don't know soldiers of Allah that are around us.

With this the Muslims ended a very difficult period of defending their mere existence and holding on to their base.

The Muslims even though we say that the establishment of the Islamic State was with Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, but those were very, very difficult days the initial years in Madina were years of fear, were years of hiding, were years of insecurity.

We shouldn't think that this was a flourishing strong Islamic State, it was in a very difficult, predicament, Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) from one side the Yahood(يهود) from the other,

the Bedouins from the third, very difficult time on the Muslims.

Sahabah(صحابه) used to say we would sleep with our arms next to us, we wouldn't feel security.

So, these first five years were very difficult, but the Muslims held on strong, they have Sabr(صبر) in Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

But now the Muslims will move on to occupy new positions.

The next five years are going to be years of expansion, the move from the defensive Jihad(جهاد) to the offensive one has taken place.

In these next five years, dear brothers and sisters, we will see an exponential growth of Islam and some important events occurring.

The key events which we will talk about In sha Allah Ta'ala(اِنْشاءالله تعالى), we ask Allah to give us the ability to go through the remainder of the five years of Seerah(سيرة), and to make this beneficial.

We ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to give us beneficial knowledge.

These key events are going to be the, Truce of Al-Hudaybiyya(ألحديبية) and the sixth year of Hijrah(هجرة), the Battle of Khaybar(خيبر) and the seventh year of his Hijrah(هجرة).

The Battle of Maota(موته), the opening of Makkah, The Battle of Hunain(حنين) and At-At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف) in the eighth year, and then the Battle of Tabook(تبوك) and the farewell Hajj(حَجْ), in the ninth year.

And finally, the greatest event of all, the greatest, calamity that has ever befell, the Muslim Ummah(امة) and that's the death of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And then we'll cover various other smaller events in between.

We'll start with some events that happened between Al-Khandaq(ألخندق) and Al-Hudaybiyya(الحديبية) within the fifth year of Hijrah(هجرة).

We talked in the previous set of lectures, about the assassination of Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف) and we said that Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف) was a Jewish leader,

very rich man held an important position, among the people in Hijaz(حجاز), and he was a very eloquent poet and he used to use this poetry, and poetry we talked about the importance of it,

in the days of Jahilliyah(جاهلية), it was the media of the day and Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف) would use this poetry of his, to defame the Muslims and talk against Rasool Allah ﷺ.

If one would read in the history of the Jahilliyah(جاهلية) in Arabia, one would see that a particular line of history would bring a ruin to a tribe, it would ruin their reputation.

Just like a documentary or, or a particular article in The Big newspaper would do today.

In fact, probably even the effect of poetry was greater.

So, Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف), one of the things he was doing he was even talking about the Muslim women and Muslims then, and this should be the case with the Muslims all the time,

should stand up, for the rights of Al-Muslimaat(ألمسلمات) and defend Al-Muslimaat(ألمسلمات), and we know of many, stories in our history of that occurring

for example the Battle of Bannu Qainuqah(بنوقينقاع), against the Jewish tribe of Bannu Qainuqah(بنوقينقاع) in Madina was because of their attack on a Muslim woman, when they uncovered her

and we know what happened with Al-Motasim(ألمعتصم), the Muslim Khalifah(خليفه) in Daulat-Al-Abbasia(ألدولة العباسيهِ), when the woman called to him Wa-Motasimah(وا معتصماہ) when the Romans attacked.

Then he mobilize an entire army to go and defend her.

So, Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف) was speaking against Muslim women and it's said that he has spoken about Umm Al-Fadhal(أم الفضل), the wife of Al-Abbas Bin Abdul-Muttalib(ألعباس بن عبدالمطلب), the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ .

Anyway, Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Who will get rid of Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف) because he has harmed Allah and His messenger.

Muhammad Ibn Maslima رضي الله عنه volunteered, for this special operation along with some other members of his tribe.

What tribe was this?

This tribe was Al-Aos(ألأوس).

So, it was a Al-Aos(ألأوس) who killed Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف).

Now, as one of Al-Ansaar(ألانصار) or the one of the descendants of Al-Ansaar(ألانصار) said: In a narration mentioned by Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر)

that Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(اَلْأوس وَالْخزْرج) were like two stallions, competing in front of Rasool Allah ﷺ .

Whenever, one clan would do something in service of Rasool Allah ﷺ , the other clan would not want them to take that advantage alone, and would try to do something similar.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), we see that they had competition, they had this spirit of competition, but it wasn't in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), it wasn't and who would be more successful in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا),

who would make more money, who would hold a higher position, as we see competition now, in the material world in the materialistic, capitalistic world

and way of life that the West is promoting.

You know, the success philosophy, in the West today and the competition for success that the West is presenting to the world today, is a materialistic one.

And it holds no value in the Islamic view of things.

Because success in the West is defined in, purely materialistic terms.

But the success in Islam is how close to Allahعَزّوجَلّ you are?

So, a person could be totally unknown in Duniya(دنيا), he could be very poor, nevertheless, he is very successful because he's close to Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And a classical example that one could give of that is Al-Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني).

I mean Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني) , was a person that was ambiguous, people didn't know him.

And when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) ask the delegation that came from the tribe of Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني) the name of his tribe was Muraad(مراد), it's a tribe in Yemen.

And when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) asked about him, they said (I mean, the way they talked about him is, as if they were surprised, why the Ameer-Ul-Momineen(امير المؤمنين),

why the Khalifah(خليفه) would ask about such a simple person.) I mean, who is he, who is Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني)?

Nobody knew him, except his relatives and the people who lived with him.

And they saw him as simple, normal human being.

He wasn't a leader of a Muslim army.

He wasn't an Ameer(امير) of a Jama'at(جماعة), he wasn't a famous scholar or a Imam(امام), he was just a simple human being.

But there was something in his heart that made him special, in fact, he was so special that Rasool Allah ﷺ told the Sahabah(صحابه), that when a delegation comes from Yemen from the tribe of Muraad(مراد).

There will be man with them, his name is Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني), if you see him than ask him, to ask Allah to forgive you, this man is, so special that you should ask him for Dua(دُعَا),

he was one of the Saliheen(صالحين) one of the Aouliyaa(أولياء) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, and whose Rasool Allah ﷺ telling it to?

He is telling it to the Sahaba(صحابه) the greatest generation that ever lived.

And Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني) is not a Sahabi(صحابي), he is a Taba'ee(تابعي) because he never saw Rasool Allah ﷺ, he wanted to make Hijrah(هجرة) to Rasool Ullah but because his mother was alone and ill,

he stayed behind with her and Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

So, he never had a chance to meet him, but Rasool Allah ﷺ knew him and talked about him.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) when he met with Owais Al-Qarni(إويس ألقرني) he told him, ask Allah to forgive me.

Back to this competition, so Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(اَلْأوس وَالْخزْرج) would compete with each other.

What was their competition about, it was about Al-Aakhira(آخرة), who would serve Rasool Allah ﷺ better, and in this case, it was because Al-Aos(ألأوس) had the honor of assassinating Ka'ab Ibn Ashraf(كعب إبن أشرف),

who would defame Rasool Allah ﷺ, Al-Khazraj(اَلْخَزرج), didn't want to be left out on this.

They wanted to do something similar.

So, they had a meeting and they discussed the issue amongst themselves and they came up with the name of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) as a good candidate or performing such an operation against,

and they presented the idea to Rasool Allah ﷺ and Rasool Ullah approved it.

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) was the man appointed to lead this special operations group, one of Al-Khazraj(اَلْخَزرج) and they set out to infiltrate deep into the land of Khaybar(خيبر).

This is before the Battle of Khaybar(خيبر) and Khaybar(خيبر) was the stronghold of the Jews.

Nevertheless, the courage of the Sahabah(صحابه) was to lead them, deep into the land of Khaybar(خيبر) and Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) lived in a fortress of his.

He wasn't living in a normal house, he was living in a palace and it was a fortress.

So, they marched out and they arrived at the gates of the fortress of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) .

Now, how would they get in?

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) played a trick against the Yahood(يهود).

In a narration and there are two narrations of this in Al-Bukhari(البخاري).

In one narration it says that, these Yahood(يهود), they lost a donkey, so they opened the gates and some men came out to fetch out this donkey,

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) stood next to the wall.

And then he sat down and covered himself, as if he was responding to the call of nature, pretended this in front of Al-Yahood(اليهود).

So what they thought is that he came out from the fortress.

Because in those days, they didn't have the restrooms inside their dwellings, they would go outside and they would go, far away from their houses to respond to the call of nature.

So, they thought that he came out of the fortress to respond to the call of nature, so when they went in they said; o servant of Allah, if you want to come in, then now is the time.

So, he walked in, normally, the trick that he played on them worked.

So, now he was inside the fortress, while all of his companions were outside.

He told them to wait outside for him.

So, now he was in.

He hide in a donkey stall, and he was observing the gatekeeper and was able to see where he would hide the keys.!

In one narration it says: They were hung on a wooden peg and another narration, it says they were in a niche, in the wall.

Anyway Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said, that the men went on to have dinner with Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع), so he remained in hiding, until all of these men left and the lights were turned off.

It was a very dark night, Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) went and fetched out the keys and Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) all  of the keys were together, all of the keys for the fortress,

the gate of the fortress and the keys for the Palace of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع), they were all there, so now he had the keys with him.

So, he would open the doors and then he would lock them from inside.

Therefore, if anyone came in, to help Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع), he would find that the gates are closed and the keys are not there, so he would open every door and lock it.

Now, this is a double edged sword, yes it would prevent people from coming in to help him, but it would also hinder the escape of Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق)

but anyway, this is what he did.

until he made it into the inner chambers of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع).

Now, he is with Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) in the same room and Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) is asleep, and the lights are turned off.

Tayyeb(طيب), How is he going to find out his location?

He can see nothing.

Now, what did Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) do?

He just called out, he said: Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع).

It takes a lot of courage to do such a thing, it's a terrifying thing, to call out for someone, in such a situation, but also on the other hand it's more terrifying for Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) to hear this man calling him, inside his own bedroom.

So, Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) is calling Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع).

Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) woke up and said: Who are you?

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said; So I struck with my sword at the source of the voice, he can't see anything he just called him and the reason he did so he wanted the man to speak, so he can recognize the source of the voice and attack it,

so he struck with his sword at the source of the voice, he said: He said: My blow was futile, yes he did hit him but it wasn't accurate enough strike and obviously, there's confusion in such a circumstance,

so it didn't kill him.

Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع), yelled out for help, he screamed out.

What did Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) do?

Ya'ani Masha Allah(يعني ماشاءالله) Abdullah Bin Ateeq رضي الله عنه, he had very good response and intelligence on the spot, thinking on his feet,

when Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) called out for help, Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق), he retreated and then he came back changing his voice and said:  Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) what do you need?

Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) said: Woe on to your mother, there's a man right here and he struck me with his sword.

So, Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) he struck him again, again at the source of the voice.

Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) called out for help again, Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق), retreated another time came in changing his voice and said: Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) what do you need?

He said: Woe on to your mother, there's a man in here, trying to kill me.

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said: This time, I came to him and he was lying on his back.

Now he was already struck with a sword two times, now he was laying on his back still alive, but laying on his back.

Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said; This time, I thrust my sword into his stomach, until I found out the bone and then I cracked it.

What bone are we talking about?

He struck the spinal cord.

So, that's it. He said: I heard the bone crack, meaning that the man is dead.

If the spine is broken, then it's certain death.

So, now Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) said; I retreated.

Now, the inner chambers, his bedroom of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) was in the upper level and there was a wooden ladder that would lead up to it.

When Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) was coming down, in this ladder or stairs.

He said: I came down and in my confusion, I thought that I have hit the last step of the ladder, when there was one more left, so he fell down and he broke his leg.

He said and then I made it out to my companions and told them that, I have killed Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع).

But Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) Subhaan Allah, he still wanted to make sure definitely that he is dead, so he told his companions, to go back and deliver the good news to Rasool Allah ﷺ

and I'm going to hang behind and wait, until I hear the announcement of his death, keep in mind that he broke his leg, so he stayed behind and he heard the news of, the death of Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع).

In the narration of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) he said: I heard his wife come to Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) and say; He is dead in the name of the God of the Jews.

What did Abdullah Bin Ateeq(عبدالله بن عتيق) say?

And I want you to pay attention to his words. He said; And I swear, I never heard words sweeter to my ears than those.

And we'll get back to this statement.

Why was Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) killed?

Ibn Hajar(إبن حجر) says; Ibn Hajar(إبن حجر) says: Abu Rafiaa(ابورافع) used to harm Rasool Allah ﷺ  and assist against him and Ibn Aaiz(إبن عائذ) said, that he was one of those,

who supported the Ghatafaan(غطفان) and other polytheistic Arabs, with money to fight Rasool Allah ﷺ .

So, his support was financial support and also by word.

Another event that happened within this period is the assassination of Khalid Ibn Sufiyan Ibn Nubih Al-Hudhali(خالد إبن سفيان إبن نُبَيح الهذلي),

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; I have been informed that Khalid(خالد) is gathering a force of men to attack me, he is at Urana(عرانة) go to him, and kill him.

Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) was an outstanding leader of his people, he was one of those charismatic figures who have the ability to mobilize men

and to make out of nothing, something.

He was successful leader, he belong to the tribe Hudhail(هذيل), Hudhail(هذيل) are Bedouins in Hijaaz(حجاز) and they're famous as being very eloquent.

They were the best poets of the Arabs and they lived on the outskirts of Makkah.

Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) was mobilizing men to fight Rasool Allah ﷺ, here we were in a situation, where the people were in need of a leader and the leader was Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not see the need, to fight his army but to preemptively attack and get rid of Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) because if he does so, he would avoid a lot of bloodshed.

If Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) is out of the arena, Hudhail(هذيل) are not going to fight him, unlike with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), the fight with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) did not depend on leadership.

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were going to fight regardless, when Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was there, they fought and after he was killed they carried on the fight in fact the fight only became worse, after Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was killed.

But here at the situation was different, so we find that Rasool Allah ﷺ never targeted the leadership of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) with special operations to assassinate them

but he did this with some of the leaders of Al-Yahood(اليهود) and he did it also with Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) because this is going to avoid killing other people,

it's gonna prevent, a larger battle escalating, and more war happening.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Go and get rid of Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان), Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس), never met, Khalid Ibn Sufiyan Al-Hudhali(خالد إبن سفيان الهذلي) in his life,

so he told Rasool Allah ﷺ: How can I recognize him, give me a sign.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; When you see him, you will shiver.

Now, Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم) was this shiver because Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) had such a great presence or was is going to be a special sign, just then, for Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) to recognize him,  Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم).

But regardless Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) was a special individual.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) moved out, he was alone, an army of his own.

This is the courage that Sahaba رضي الله عنهم had, and he's gonna travel deep into enemy territory, in Urana(عرانة) next to Makkah, so he made it there and he found out the location of the army camp,

where Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) is gathering the men.

He saw him and he felt shiver, the sign that Rasool Allah ﷺ mentioned and Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said: I never shivered from anyone in my life.

This was the first time that he ever felt such a shiver.

It was time for As-Salaat-Ul-Asr(الصلاة العصر) and Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said; He said: I feared that there might be a conflict between me and him that would prevent me from Salah(صلاة).

Meaning this conflict could take time and wouldn't be able to pray, so what did he do he prayed while he was walking towards his target.

And I would make Sujood(سجود) and Rakooh(ركوع) by movements of my head.

So, he walked up to him and greeted him, Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) said; Who is the man.?

I am a Bedouin, I'm a man from amongst the Arabs who heard about you and you're gathering a force for this man, he said; That's what I'm doing, he said: I came to follow you,

so then he held the conversation with him to break the ice and when Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) was comfortable with Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس)

and the opportune moment arrived, Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) struck, Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) and killed him.

He walked away and he said: Tarakat-Hoo(تَرَكَتْه’) , I left him with his woman crouched over him, Rasool Allah ﷺ greeted Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) by saying,

May your face be successful.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said; May your face be successful too.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ took him in to his house and gave him a stick.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) walked out without saying a word.

And what was the stick for?

Why did Rasool Allah ﷺ  give it to him?

What is he gonna do with it?

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس)  dare not to ask.

They were very shy, in dealing with Rasool Allah ﷺ, so he just walked out without saying a word.

This was the gift that Rasool Ullah gave him, a stick.

So, his people told him, what is the stick.?

He said: Rasool Ullah gave it to me.

Why did they give it to you?

He said: I don't know?

They said: Go back and ask him!

He went back to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; O Rasool Ullah, Why did you give me the stick?

He said; He said this is a sign between me and you on the Day of Judgment, there will be very few that day, with something, to lean upon.

Rasool Ullah gave him the stick as a gift, so that on the Day of Judgment it will be a sign between him and Rasool Ullah.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) coupled that stick with his sword, he kept it with his sword, and then in his will, he asked that, the stick be buried with him.

So, it was put inside his coffin with him, so that on the Day of Judgment, when he's resurrected, he will pick up that stick and go to Rasool Allah ﷺ

and it will be a sign between him and Rasool Ullah, on that very difficult day, when there will be very few people with something to lean upon.

And this Rawayah(رواية) is in Masnad Imam Ahmad(مسند اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ).

One important lesson, brothers and sisters from this story, The importance of Salah(صلاة), the thing that concerned, Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس), when he was walking towards Khalid Ibn Sufiyan(خالد إبن سفيان) was Salaat-Ul-Asr(صلاةالعصر).

And the thing that concerned, the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم, when Rasool Ullah, was talking to them about the signs of the end of time, when he was talking about Ad-Dajjal(الدجال)

and that one day of Ad-Dajjal(الدجال), will be like a year, what did the Sahabah(صحابه) say?

How is that explained, physically?

Can you give us the astronomy explanation of how that is possible?

What did they say? They said; Is it's enough for us to pray in that day, the five daily prayers, prayers of one day?

They were thinking about Salah(صلاة), and Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) in this life and death situation, in this confusing situation, a person in that situation would be perplexed,

and as we just said, that his body shivered when he saw this man, but, Salah(صلاة), Salah(صلاة), Salah(صلاة) he prayed, walking towards him.

Brothers and Sisters, there's no excuse in leaving Salah(صلاة) if you don't have money, you're excused from paying Zakat(زكواة).

If you're ill, you're excused from fasting and you can play a Fidyah(فدية) instead.

If you don't have the financial ability and the road to Hajj(حَجْ) is not safe you don't have to make Hajj(حَجْ), but there is no situation in which a Muslim is excused from Salah(صلاة).

Even in the battlefield, we have to pray and we're given the Fiqh(فقه) of it, in Salaat-Ul-Khauf(صلاة الخوف).

In fact, the Sahabah(صحابه) considered Salah(صلاة) to be so important.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) used to say; that if a Muslim leaves one Salah(صلاة) intentionally then he has disbelieved.

We know that after that Ulema(علماء) discussed the issue of the Kuffr(كفر) of Taarik-Us-Salah(تارك الصلاة), whether the one who leaves Salah(صلاة) is Kafir(كافر) or not

and one can go back to the books Fiqh(فقه) to see, what they said about that?

It's the opinion of Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ) that if the person leaves it out of laziness, than he is a Kafir(كافر), while the other Ulema(علماء) said;

that Muslims Kafir(كافر) only, if he leaves it intentionally.

Anyway this is not the place to discuss this issue but, it's very important, it's the most important Ibadah(عبادة), so we should never dismiss our Salah(صلاة)

and for those Muslims because of their employment, leave for example Salat-Ul-Jum'ah(صلاةالجمعه), or they leave some Salawaat(صلوات), we say to them, It'taqillah(إتقى الله), Fear Allahعَزّوجَلّ,

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن أنيس), in this situation that is more important than your employment, more dangerous than your situation, and he did not leave Salah(صلاة), so we should never leave Salah(صلاة).

Next event that happened within this period is regarding Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش).

Zainab Bint Jahash رضي الله عنها, Al-Assadiyyah(ألاَسَدِيْةَ) from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

She was the sister of Abdullah Bin Jahash(عبدالله بن جحش), and we talked about his story in the earlier lectures and her mother is Umaimah Bint Abdul-Muttalib(عميمه بنت عبدالمطلب), the sister of Hamza(حمزه),

so her mother is the aunt of Rasool Ullah, which makes her, his cousin.

Zainab Bint Jahash رضي الله عنها, Rasool Allah ﷺ visited her and he proposed to her marriage to his adopted son, Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه).

Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was a slave.

And he's asking, Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش), who comes from the nobility of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) to marry a slave.

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to break the barriers of discrimination and racism that existed and he wanted to start among his own family and ask that Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) marry his own cousin Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش).

She said: No, He(ﷺ) said: Yes, you will marry her.

She said: O Messenger of Allah, let me think about it and while they were talking, the Ayah(آية) was revealed, "It is not fitting for a believer, man or woman when a matter has been decided by Allah

and His Messenger to have any option about their decision, if anyone disobeys Allah and His Messenger, he is indeed on a clearly wrong path.

If our desires are contrary to something that Rasool Allah ﷺ wants us to do, we still do what Rasool Allah ﷺ wants us to do.

And it's important that we don't follow our whims and desires but we follow the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, what excuse do we have in not following His Sunnah(سنة).

What excuse, Do we have in not following the law of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, just because we don't like it, just because it didn't suit our Ahwa'a(اَهْوَاء), our whims and desires.

We are slaves of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and we are followers of Muhammadﷺ and whatever, we are told to do, we do it's not up to us, so Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش), when this Ayah(آية) was revealed,

she said: I accept him as a husband.

I will not disobey Rasool Allah ﷺ and I marry him myself.

But Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) things didn't work out, there was no compatibility, after a year they were divorced.

Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was coming to Rasool Allah ﷺ and complaining about his wife.

He wasn't happy with her and she wasn't happy with him.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ would told him; He said: Fear Allah and keep your wife, but things just couldn't continue on.

So, divorce was a must and the marriage was ended after a year.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ married her and that caused the storm of talk against Rasool Allah ﷺ.

In Arabia It was a no-no for a man to marry the wife of his adopted son.

Adoption was serious than, this before it was made Haram(حرام) in Islam.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ adopted Zaid(زيد) and he was called Zaid Ibn Muhammad(زيد ابن محمد).

So, now, all of the rules of Sharia(شريعة) that apply between a son and his father applied between Muhammadﷺ and his son Zaid(زيد).

And one of the rules that existed in those days is that a man can never married the wife of his adopted son.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ wanted to break this tradition among the Arabs and what better way to do so, than Rasool Allah ﷺ breaking that rule himself.

It carries more weight, when Rasool Allah ﷺ does it, then when he speaks about it.

So, now Rasool Allah ﷺ married Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش).

There were two rulings here, the first ruling is that there's no more adoption and second ruling is that a man can marry the wife of his formerly adopted son.

"Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his body, nor has He made your wives whom you divorce by the Izhaar(إظهار), Your mother's nor has He made your adopted sons your son's, such is only your manner of speech by your mouth

but Allah tells you, the truth and he shows the right way.

"Call them by the names of their fathers This is just her in the sight of Allah but if you know not their fathers names, call them your brothers in faith, or your Moula's

but there is no blame on you, if you make a mistake there in.

What counts is the intention of your hearts and Allah is oft-forgiving most merciful." Now just want to make a clarification here, what is meant by adoption here is not the meaning that we know of adoption today,

when you adopt an orphan, no that's something very good to do it's very reward able.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says, that I will be a neighbor of the one, who sponsors the orphan.

The adoption that is not allowed in Islam is where the adopted son or daughter, carries the family name of, the ones who adopt them.

In Islam we must carry the names of our ancestors and not carry the names of the ones, who have adopted us.

So, this is just a clarification because the word adoption in English might carry different meaning.

Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش) was a very righteous woman. In fact, she among the wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ, she held the very important status with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

None of the wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ used to compete with me, in my status with Rasool Allah ﷺ but Zainab(زينب) and Rasool Allah ﷺ said, about her.

The fastest among you to die after me, will be the one of you with the longest arm, so Ayesha(عائشه) used to say; We the wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ, would measure our arms

to see who has the longest arm but they didn't understand, what Rasool Allah ﷺ meant?

What he meant by this, by longest arm, is not literally but it means the one who gives out Sadaqah(صدقه) the most and that was Zainab Bint Jahash(زينب بنت جحش) and she was the one who died,

the fastest among the wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ, after Rasool Allah ﷺ passed away.

Ayesha(عائشه) said about her; She said: I never seen a woman better than her in her religion, and more fearful of Allah than her, and more truthful in her speech,

and more attentive to the family relationships than her and I've never seen a woman who used to give more Sadaqah(صدقه) than her and she would give herself totally to the deed that she would be doing.

And the only thing with her is that she had a temper, but she would very soon come back to her normal state, رضي الله عنها.

This marriage of Rasool Allah ﷺ to Zainab(زينب) has been a point of controversy with the Kuffar(كفار).

They try to use it, as an attacking point against Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And it's interesting to see that there are two particular marriages that, the Kuffar(كفار) speak about the most and that is the marriage to Ayesha(عائشه) because of her young age and the marriage to Zainab(زينب)

because they surrounded it with many tales and legends.

And it's interesting to see that these are the particular two marriages that were commanded by Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Because Zainab bint Jahash(زينب بن جحش) would say, to the other wives of Rasool Allah ﷺ you are married by your parents, while I was married by Allah from on top seven Heavens.

Because Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Qur'an; We married we married her, to you.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ when he was married to Ayesha(عائشه) there was no Aqad(عقد) or anything, he just walked in, to her room because the marriage was performed by Allahعَزّوجَلّ

and with Ayesha رضي الله عنها, it happened because he has seen her in a dream and we know that the dreams of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) are Wahii(وحي).

So, that is the marriage of Rasool Allah ﷺ to Zainab(زينب).

Also in this period Rasool Allah ﷺ married to Habibah Bint Abi Sufiyan(حبيبه بنت أبي سفيان) the daughter of Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان).

She was in Al-Habasha(ألحبشه) at that time.

She was with the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) in Abyssinia and her husband Obaidillah Bin Jahash(عبيدالله بن جحش), Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), he was one of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين)

but he had a change of heart, he was deceived by Shaytaan(شيطان), he became a Murtadd(مرتد) and became a Christian and he used to make fun of the Muslims and say you are looking with half of your eyes open, while I have seen the light.

He is referring to Christianity, he died as a Murtadd(مرتد).

After he passed away, Rasool Allah ﷺ sent Amr Bin Umayyah Ad-Dhamri(عمرو بن أمية أضَّمْرِيْ) to An-Najjashi(ألنجاشي) to marry him to Habibah Bint Abi Sufiyaan(حبيبه بنت إبي سفيان) and the marriage was performed

the Walli(وَلِّي) of Habiba(حبيبه) was her cousin, Khalid Bin Saeed Al-Aas(خالد بن سعيد بن العاص) and the representative of Rasool Allah ﷺ in performing the contract was An-Najjashi(ألنجاشي)

and by this, Umm Habibah(أم حبيبه) became Umm Ul-Mo'mineen(أم المؤمنين) and Muawiyah رضي الله عنه became the uncle of Al-Mo'mineen(ألمؤمنين) because he is her brother,
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْم۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا اَلْحَمْدُلِلَّهِ اَوَّلاً وَآخِرًا

اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنَّ نَحْمَدُكَ حَتَّى تَرْضَى وَ نَحْمَدُكَ عِنْدَ الرِّضَى وَ نَحْمَدُكَ بَعْدَ الرِّضَى وَنُصَلِّيْ وَنُصَّلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْآخِرِيْنَ وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا

اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُه اَلْآنَ نَغْزُوهُمْ وَلاَ يَغْزُونَنَا يَا وَيْحَ قُرَيْشٍ لَقَدْ أنهكتهم الْحَرْبَ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا

وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ۝

Isbiroo(إصْبِرُوْا) Wa-Sabiroo(وَصَابِرُوْا).

اَلْآنَ نَغْزُوهُمْ وَلاَ يَغْزُونَنَا وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ اَلَّهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْالُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعَ وَ نَعَوْذُبِكَ مِنَّ عِلْمِ لَّايَنْفَعُ

مَنْ لِّيْ بِكَعْب اِبْنِ اَشْرَفْ فَاِنَّه’قَدْ آذَّى اللهَ وَ رَسُوْله ياعبدالله فَلَمْ اُغْنِ عَنْه’ شَيْئَا فَاضَ وَ اِلَهَ يَهُوْدْ وَكَانَ اَبُوْ رَفِعَ يُؤذِيْ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيُعِيْنُ عَلَيْهِ،

وَذكَرَ اَبْنُ عَائِذ مِنْ طَرِيْقِ الْاَسْوَدْ عَنْ عُرْوَةْ اَنَّه’ كَانَ مِمَّنْ اَعَانَ غَطَفَانَ و غَيْرَهُمْ مِنْ مُشْرِكِي الْعَرَبْ مِنْ الّمَالِ الْكَثِيْرُ، عَلَى رَسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

اِنَّه’ قَدْ بَلَغَنِيْ اَنَّ خالد بن سفيان بن نُبَيح الهذلي يَجْمَعَ لِي الْنَّاسِ لِيَغْزُونِيْ وَهُوَ بِعُرَنَة فَأتِهِ فَاقْتُلْه قَالُوْ هُدَيْل اَشْعَرَالْعَرَبْ

اِذَا رَاَيْتَه’شَعَرْتَ(وَجَدْتُ) لَه’قَشَعِرَيْرَةَ وَخشِيْتُ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُ مُّجَاوَلَهْ تَشْغَلْنِيْ عَنِّ(تَمْنَعْنِيْ مِنَّ) الصَّلاةْ

وَكُنْتُ اُوْمِىءُ لِلرَّكُوْعِ وَالسُّجُوْدْ بِرَأسِي مَنِ الرَّجُلْ قَالَ: اَنَا رَجُلٌ مِّنَّ الْعَرَبْ سَمِعَ بِكَ وَ بِجَمْعِكَ لِهَذَالرَّجُلْ

اَنَا فِيْ ذَالِكْ أَفْلَحَ الْوَجْه أَفْلَحَ الْوَجْهُكَ يَا رَسُول الله آيَةً تَكُوْنُ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةْ اِنَّا اَقَلَّ النَّاسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ اَلْمُتَخَصِّرُوْنَ

هَلْ تَكْفِيْنَا فِيْهِ صَلَاةَ يَوْمْ وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ

وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا۝

لَا اَعْصِيْ رَسُوْل الله وَقَدْ زَوَجْتَه’ نَفْسِيْ اِتَّقِ اللهَ وَ اَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ ۚ

وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ ۖ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ۝

اُدْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ۚ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَٰكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ

وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا۝

أنا وكافل اليتيم كهاتين في الجنة Ayesha رضي الله عنها says; أسرعكن لحاقاً بي أطولكن يداً لم أر امرأة قط خيراً في الدين من زينب، وأتقى لله، وأصدق حديثاً، وأوصل للرحم، وأعظم صدقة، وأشد ابتذالاً لنفسها في العمل الذي تصدق به وتقربه إلى الله تعالى

ما عدا سورة من حدة كانت فيها، تسرع منها الفيئة فَزَوَّجْنَاكَهَا رضي الله عنه وعنها والارض الله عزوجل جَميع الصحابه وَ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا
