That's the reason, why O Rasool Ullah, I didn't marry a young virgin woman.

That's why I didn't marry a girl, I married an older woman because of this reason.

My father fought alongside you in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) and he died as a Shaheed(شهيد) and he left behind seven daughters and I'm responsible for them.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; You did well, let's hope to Allah.

Then Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And when we get to Sarar(سرار) we'll slaughter camel, and stay there and she will hear about us coming, and she will dust off her cushions for us.

Rasool Allah ﷺ before he would enter Madina, he would stay outside of Madina and let his family know that he's coming in, it wouldn't surprise them.

That's not appropriate he would let them know so that they would get ready and prepare themselves to meet him.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said; We're gonna stay in Sarar(سرار) slaughter camels, eat there, and then we're going to enter Madina and your wife is gonna hear about that and she'll dudt off the cushions for you.

Jabir Bin Abdullah(جابر بن عبدالله) said: We don't have cushions.

So, the situation was tough with Jabir Bin Abdullah رضي الله عنه, large family, very poor.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: You will have some.

and when you get back act wisely.

Now they get back to Madina, and Rasool Allah ﷺ comes out of the Masjid(مسجد) and we see this camel tied up, he said: What is this?

They said Jabir(جابر) brought it to you.

This is the camel that Rasool Allah ﷺ bought.

So, Rasool Ullah called Jabir(جابر), he said: Go and bring me Jabir(جابر), they brought him Jabir(جابر).

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; Cousin, lead your camel away, it is yours.

And then he called Bilal(بلال) and told him take Jabir(جابر) away and give him an ounce of gold.

So, Jabir(جابر) said, I went with Bilal(بلال) and he gave me an ounce and a little more as well.

And by Allah my financial affairs, improved constantly thereafter, until they suffered recently in what befell us.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ was negotiating that deal with Jabir(جابر) about buying the camel and he didn't really want to buy it.

He just wanted to give Jabir(جابر) money because of his condition or probably when Rasool Allah ﷺ knew about the difficult situation of Jabir(جابر),

he decided to give him the price of the camel and the camel as well.

And when he told him that she would dust off the cushions for you and he said: We don't have any cushions, Rasool Allah said, you will have some.

Yes, Rasool Allah gave Jabir(جابر) money, and that money was invested and it kept on growing constantly.

Jabir(جابر) says: Until we suffered recently and what he was referring to in that recent suffering, was the Youm Al-Harrah(يوم الحرة), which was the worst day on the people of Madina.

Many of them were massacred that was during the Khilafah Al-Amwiyyah(خلافة الاموية).

This was a civil war that occurred in during the Khilafah Al-Amwiyyah(خلافة الاموية) and it was against the people of Madina and many of them died

and Jabir(جابر) is saying that is when we suffered financially.

Badr Al-Mua'adh(بدر المعد), the Muslim won in the Battle of Badr(بدر) and the kuffar(كفار) won in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد), so they agreed that they're going to meet the following year, same time, same place for the third battle,

because they were even.

It was tie one, one, so now they agreed that they're going to meet again.

And that was called Badr(بدر) Al-Mua'ed(بدر الموعد), the appointed Badr(بدر).

the appointed Badr(بدر).

So, Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) and with a 2000 strong army left from Makkah.

But when they left Makkah and traveled for a while.

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) said; Men of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), it is right for you to make such an expedition, only in a fruitful year, when you can pass your on trees and drink milk.

This year it is barren, I'm going back, you do the same.

So, Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) bailed out along with his army, they were too afraid to meet the Muslims and they walked away, and the excuse he used is that it's a barren year, its infertile,

and we're going to suffer along the way so let's just go back.

Rasool Allah ﷺ shows up appointed time appointed place.

The kuffar(كفار) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) don't show up, so he stays there for a few days and then leaves.

While he was there, he met with Mukhshie Bin Aamir Adh-Dhamri(مَخْشِيْ بِن عَامر الضَّمْريْ), from the tribe of Bannu Dhamrah(بنو ضمرى).

And these men had a peace agreement with Rasool Allah ﷺ or we could call it, an alliance.

So, he comes to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; Muhammad(محمد), have you come here to this will, to meet with Quraish(قريش).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes brother from Bannu Dhamrah(بنو ضمرى), but if you want, we will release you from your agreement with us and we will battle you, until Allah decides between us.

He said: No, by Allah Muhammad(محمد) there is no need for that.

Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling this man, that if you want us to end this agreement between us, we wouldn't have any problem with that, and we're ready to fight you.

And this shows you something about the personality of Rasool Allah ﷺ and what he projected, to people.

If Rasool Allah ﷺ entered into a truce or a peace agreement with anyone.

And it's more proper by the way to call it a truce because that's what it really is, or an alliance.

If Rasool Allah ﷺ enters in a truce, or an alliance with any people.

It is because they needed that, not because he needed it.

Not because of a point of weakness, not because Rasool Allah ﷺ was weak and eager to make a truce.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was strong and he made that very clear to the people.

If you want to end the agreement we'd be happy to do so.

And this is important for Muslims to realize that as Muslims, our religion is strong and we need to be strong and when we enter into a truce or an agreement with disbelievers

it has to be from that point of strength and not due to weakness.

Another Ghazwa(غزوة) is Ghazwat-Doumat-Al-Jandal(غزوة دومة الجندل), Doumat-Al-Jandal(دومة الجندل) is about 450 kilometers north of Madina.

Al-Waqa'die(الواقعدي) states.

He therefore referring to Muhammadﷺ, he therefore organized his men, and left with a force of 1000 Muslims.

They traveled by night keeping undercover by day, he had the guide with him from Bannu Udhra(بنو عزرة), named Mazkoor(مزكور), who was a skilled tracker.

Rasool Allah ﷺ travels, this long distance of 450 kilometers to go and meet with the people of Doumat-Al-Jandal(دومة الجندل).

Whom he heard, were gathering a force to advance towards Madina and attack him.

So, we can see again and again that Rasool Allah ﷺ doesn't even give them a chance to march towards him, he would go and meet them on their own territory

and fight with them in their own territory, he wouldn't even allow them to come close to Madina and that is again to show the strength of the Muslims.

This happened in the fifth year of Hijrah(هجرة), and it was against the tribe of Qudha'a(قضاعه), and they ran away, when they heard that Rasool Allah ﷺ approached,

and because the movement of Rasool Allah ﷺ was stealth, he was traveling at night and sleeping during the day, he surprised them, when they were unaware.

He took over some of their cattle and they just ran away from him, and he stayed there for a few days and none of them showed up, to fight.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ comes back victorious.

And the Ghazawaat(غزوات) served a lot of different objectives.

You know, it was surveillance of new territory, the Muslims would learn about this new territory, they would travel through it and learn about the topography and the paths

and the people who are along the way, the different tribes.

It was physical training for them, these Ghazawaat(غزوات) represented lessons and discipline.

They were also, they served the purpose of bonding of this Ummah(أمة) outside the realm of family and tribe, I mean that was everything for the Arab, family and tribe.

Now there was this new bond developing between an Ummah(امة) and such journeys, were an opportunity, for this bonding to develop because they spend more time together.

As we have seen, for example, Rasool Allah ﷺ was talking with Jabir Bin Abdullah رضي الله عنه having that conversation with him during the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Zaat Ar-Riqaah(ذات الرقاع).

Also, he was establishing political presence, making agreements with different tribes along the way.

It was an expression of strength.

People would hear about that, the news would spread all over that Rasool Allah ﷺ traveled this long distance to go and meet an enemy 450 kilometers away from Madina.

And it's also shows that Rasool Allah ﷺ was very daring and willing to take risk, in these Ghazawaat(غزوات) but in the same time, they were very well planned and executed,

so there's a difference between being daring and willing to take risk and being rash.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ would plan out very elaborately, these Ghazawaat(غزوات), and would take the necessary risk.

I mean, he's traveling long distance, and he's getting away, far away from Madina.

So, if an enemy heard about that they could attack Madina, but the thing is that Rasool Allah ﷺ planned it out very well, so it was very stealth and quiet,

and even his enemy didn't even hear about it, let alone the other people in Arabia.

Another famous or well known Ghazwa(غزوة), is Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق).

Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق) are tribe from Khuza'a(خزاعه) and Rasool Allah ﷺ attacked them for the same reason, they were planning on attacking Madina.

So, he attacks them and it was such a surprise.

It was such a surprise that he attacked them and he took over their wealth and their women and children as slaves.

And they didn't even have a chance to fight back, it was that fast.

So, he ended up taking their cattle, all of their livestock and their women and children as slaves.

Now, the his army constituted of 700 Muslims, a lot of things happen during this Ghazwah(غزوة), and we'll talk about them.

And there are also many lessons to learn.

The first lesson.

It is allowed to attack a people without advance notice, if Da'wah(دعوة) has already reached them.

So they don't have to tell them, give them a chance to become Muslim.

Usually the Muslim armies would give the enemy three days.

And they will give them three choices.

If they are people of the book and two choices if they're not, the three choices of the People of the Book is to become Muslim, that's number one.

If you refuse, then you pay Jizya(جزية), if you'll refuse than we'll fight.

if they are Mushrikeen(مشركين) then.

Number one, you become Muslim, if you refuse than we'll fight.

And they're given three days to make up their mind, not giving years and years of continuous Da'wah(دعوة), and it's only three days that is the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ

and that was the way of the Khulafaa(خلفآء) after him.

But here they weren't even given a moment to think about it.

Why? Because Da'wah(دعوة) has already reached them.

They live in the Arabia, they already know about Islam, they heard about Rasool Allah ﷺ too, so it's not something new.

So, they were ambushed.

Abdullah Bin Umar(عبد الله بن عمر) said and this is in Bukhari(البخاري) He attacked them, while they were unaware, while their livestock were drinking water,

so he killed some of their men and he has taken their families as slaves, this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

They would use the battle cries.

So, in this battle, their battle cry was, which means, O conquer Kill, kill.

That was their battle cry.

Also, alot of Fiqh(فقه) was learned during the Ghazawaat(غزوات).

So, this is another objective that was served by traveling with Rasool Allah ﷺ, they learned the Fiqh(فقه) from him.

So, during the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Bannu Mustallaq(بنو مصطلق), the ruling of Tayammum(تيمم) was revealed in Qur'an.

And the Fiqh(فقه) of it was learned from Rasool Allah ﷺ, right then and there.

Also another, for example, show you how they would learn Fiqh(فقه) in this Ghazwa(غزوة), in Bukhari(بخاري) Abu Saeed Al-Khudri(ابوسعيد الخدري) said;

We went forth with the Messenger of Allah, on the expedition to Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق), we took many of the Bedouin captive.

And we desired the women because celibacy was very hard on us.

We like the practice of Azal(عزل), Azal(عزل) is the interruption of sexual intercourse by the male withdrawal before ejaculation, so we can say that it's a form of contraceptive.

So, he says: We liked the practice of Azal(عزل) but wondered whether we should do this without asking the Messenger of Allah.

So, we asked them about it, he said; There is no difference in you doing that, for any soul that is going to exist till Judgment Day, will so exist.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said that it wouldn't make a difference.

If you do that or not because Allah has already made Qadar(قدر), has already ordained every soul that will be created.

Now some Ulema(علماء), use this Hadith(حديث) as evidence that contraceptives are allowed.

Now I'm not going to get into the Fiqh(فقه) of it.

I mean, for example the among our classical scholars there's a difference of opinion on whether it is Mubah(مباح) or Makrooh(مكروه) or Haram(حرام).

And then it was also, there's a difference of opinion on whether this is relating to a free woman, a wife, or a slave girl.

Now the reason, why they want to practice Azal(عزل) here is because, if a man owns a slave woman, and she becomes pregnant, and has a child from him.

Then he cannot sell her.

So, she remains with him, now because of the children, and she is called Ummo Walad(ام ولد), a mother of children and she's becomes almost like his wife.

However, if they are practicing Azal(عزل).

Then, they would have sexual relations with these women but then they can sell them, so that's why they were asking Rasool Allah ﷺ, about it.

Let me narrate here, what Ayeshaرضي الله عنها said about an event that happened during the Ghazwa(غزوة), of Bannu Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق).

This is by Ibn Is'haaq(ابن اسحاق) but it's also narrated by Al-Hakim(الحاكم) and it is Jayyid(جيد) Sanad(سند), with good, chain of narrators.

When the Messenger of Allah, distributed the captives taken from Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق), Jawairiyyah(جويريه), daughter of Al-Haris(الحارث) was awarded to Thabit Bin Qais Bin Shammas(ثابت بن قيس بن شماس),

there was one woman, who was taken captive and she's the daughter of the head of the tribe, her name is Jawairiyyah(جويريه), and she wrote Mukataba(مكاتبه).

Ayesha(عائشه) said; She made the Mukataba(مكاتبه) with Thabit Bin Qais(ثابت بن قيس بن شماس).

Now Mukataba(مكاتبه) is a contract between the master and the slave, which would allow the slave to be emancipated, to be freed by paying a certain amount of money.

So, Islam does not make slavery, a perpetual thing on a person it's not permanent.

A person who desires to be free, does have that right and can be free.

By the way, and whenever we talk about slavery in Islam.

So, one should not compare the two or consider them equal, it's different.

For example, many of this these slaves became scholars among the Tabieen(تابعين), and some of them even ruled and became kings.

Like with Dulatel Mumalik(دولةالمماليك), this was an entire dynasty that was called the dynasty of the slaves.

So it had nothing to do with ethnicity, it's unlike the western system of slavery, which is nothing more than racism.

So, anyway she made a Mukataba(مكاتبه) and this is something that shows you that if a slave isn't pleased with that profession because that was really what it was, in Islam, it was a profession.

Then they have the right to change it.

And that is what Jawairiyyah(جويريه) wanted to do, she made the Mukataba(مكاتبه) between her and her master.

Ayesha(عائشه) said: She was a very sweet and attractive woman.

Every man who saw her, fell for her.

She came to the messenger of Allah, to ask him help, in preparing the document, and I swear, as soon as I saw her at the door of my room, I disliked her and recognize that he would see in her, what I did.

Ayesha(عائشه) was saying that she felt jealous because Jawairiyyah(جويريه) was beautiful and Ayesha(عائشه) was worried if Rasool Allah ﷺ sees her, he might want to get married to her.

When she went into him, she said; Messenger of Allah, I am Jawairiyyah(جويريه), a daughter of Al-Haris Bin Abu Zarar(الحارث بن ابو ضرار), the leader of his people.

You can see what my plight is now, I have fallen to the lot of Thabit Bin Qais Bin Shammas(ثابت بن قيس بن شماس), and I've prepared the deed, awarding myself to him.

I've come to ask your help in writing it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Would you prefer better.

She said: What is it, O Messenger of Allah?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I will take responsibility for your deed myself and marry you.

She replied; Yes, Messenger of Allah, I agree.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ married Jawairiyyah(جويريه), and he paid her ransom.

Now the news spread that Rasool Allah ﷺ had married Jawairiyyah(جويريه) and the people said; Then they, meaning our captives are relatives of Rasool Allah ﷺ, so they released the captives.

Why.? Because Jawairiyyah(جويريه) is now the wife of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they didn't want her relatives to be slaves, so they freed them.

Ayeshaرضي الله عنها said: And so by his marriage to her, he released 100 of her relatives from Bannu Mustallaq(بنومصطلق), I know, no woman who brought greater blessings to her people than she.

So, Jawairiyyah(جويريه) was a blessing on her people, they were freed, because of her.

Umar Bin Khattab(عمر بن خطاب) had a servant, and his servant was Mohajer(مهاجر), and they were next to this well, fetching water.

And this servant of Umar(عمر), got into a fight with one on of Al-Ansaar(الانصار) because of the crowding at this well.

They got in each other's way and, you know, one word, next word, and then they had a dispute and a fight.

So, the Ansaari(انصاري) said; He was calling the Ansaar(انصار) to come and gang up, against this Mohajeri(مهاجري) and the Mohajeri(مهاجري) did the same.

So, a fight was almost going to break out between the two parties, of Muslims, Al-Muhajiroon(المهاجرون) and Al-Ansaar(الانصار), until Rasool Allah ﷺ came in and mediated between them.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would not allow such things to happen, he would immediately be on the spot, come in and stop such fittan(فتن) and when they're in the bud, he will not allow them to grow.

That's an important aspect of leadership, not to be unaware, and neglectful of Fittan(فتن) that could end up, breaking up the Jama'ah(جماعة).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ steps in immediately and he stops it early, before it gets out of control.

Now the news reaches to Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَي), the head of Al-Munafiqoon(المنافقون).

And he said: Did they really cause this.?

They challenge us, and outnumber us, in our own land.

I swear by Allah, the old Maxim well applies to us on these Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) ruffians, fatten your dog, and you, it will eat.

Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَي) is saying we brought in these Mohajiroon(مهاجرون) into our land and look at what he said about them.

It's like, we fatten them and then they eat us.

I mean, he using this maxim, fatten your dog and it will eat you.

I swear, when we return to Madina, the stronger will drive out the weaker and in Arabic, It is; Al-Azz(العز), the more honorable or the stronger.

Both are correct meaning translations to the word Al-Azz(العز), the stronger or the more honorable will drive out the weaker or the humble.

See what you have done to yourselves, you let them settle among you and shared your property with them.

I swear if you had kept what you owned from them, they would have gone somewhere else.

This Nifaaq(نفاق) is coming out of his mouth, a young Sahabi(صحابي), his name is Zaid Bin Arqam(زيد بن ارقم), he heard what Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَي) said.

So he goes and conveys the news to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Some men from Al-Ansaar(الانصار), who were present told Rasool Allah ﷺ perhaps the lad mistook what was said or did not memorize it correctly.

So, they were defending Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي) they said probably this young boy didn't hear it right.

Umar(عمر) said: Let me go and execute this Munafiq(منافق).

Umar(عمر) doesn't play around, Let me go and execute him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: How would it be Umar(عمر), to have people say, that Muhammad(محمد) kills his own companions.

No, give orders to leave instead.

And we're going to come back to the statement by Rasool Allah ﷺ because there's Hikmah(حكمة) that we can learn from this statement.

Usaid رضي الله عنه Bin Khuzair(بن خضير), one of Al-Ansaar(الانصار), is from the people of Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي).

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: Didn't you hear what your friend said. He said; which friend.?

He said: Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي), what did he say.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: What he said.

Well, I swear by Allah, messenger of Allah you will drive him out, if you wish.

He is certainly the weak one and you are the strong.

And then he said, Be kind to him, O messenger of Allah, I swear Allah brought you to us, while his people were stringing pearls, with which to make a crown for him.

And so he considers that you have robbed him his kingdom.

And this is a problem with the people of authority and the people who have money.

When they feel that Islam would threaten their authority or their wealth, they become Munafiqeen(منافقين).

So it's very important for anybody who is in such situation to be careful and not fall into the traps of Nifaaq(نفاق).

Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي) became a Munafiq(منافق) because he felt that his authority was threatened, because he felt that Islam robbed him something.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says about this incident, They are the ones, who say, Do not spend on those, who are with the Messenger of Allah, until they disband

and to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

They say, if we return to Madina, the more honored will surely expel there from the more humble and to Allah belongs all honor, and to His messenger and to the believers,

but the hypocrites, do not know.

So, honor belongs to Allahعَزّوجَلّ, it belongs to the Messenger of Allah and it belongs to Al-Mumineen(المؤمنين).

Lessons from this event, Rasool Allah ﷺ told the army to leave the wisdom in this action is.

If you don't keep people preoccupied with good, they're going to preoccupy themselves with evil.

Now since this fitna(فتنه) was causing a lot of talk, and rumors, Rasool Allah ﷺ told the army to pack up and leave.

And they march for the entire day.

And then they marched throughout the night, and then they marched in the morning.

So, when Rasool Allah ﷺ told them to stop, they fell asleep immediately, as their heads hit the ground.

As soon as they touched the ground, they were asleep because they were so exhausted.

Rasool Allah ﷺ exhausted them out, so that they would forget about talking about this incident.

And this shows you how Rasool Allah ﷺ solved this problem.

Number two, it's important to protect the reputation of the Muslim community, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: No Umar(عمر) I'm not gonna kill him because then people are going to say that Muhammad(محمد) kills his companions.

I don't want to give people this impression.

We want to bring people closer to Islam, we don't want them to think that if they become Muslim they're going to be killed by their leader, that they're going to be oppressed or wronged,

that Muslims are going to rip them off or take advantage of them or trick them or fool them, No.

You want the non Muslim to feel that by becoming Muslim, they're going to be with their brothers and their leader will be their brother.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ doesn't want the enemies of Allah or the non Muslims to hear about that the Muhammad(محمد) is killing his companions and even though Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي) wasn't the companion of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he was a Munafiq(منافق).

But he's counted as a Muslim, among the non Muslims, I mean, he's part of the community of Madina and people think that he's Muslim because that is what he says, that is what he claims to be.

He professes to being a Muslim, even if that's not true, but people don't know that.

Also in this statement, Rasool Allah ﷺ is thinking long term.

Umar(عمر) said, Let me kill him.

What did Rasool Allah ﷺ say.?

No, I don't want people to say that I'm killing my followers.

And then Ibn Is'haaq(ابن اسحاق) said; There after if anything bad happened, Abdullah(عبدالله)'s people would blame and reproach him.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ having been informed that they were treating him, this way, he said he asked Umar(عمر).

Well, Umar(عمر), what do you think now.

I swear if I had killed him, the day you suggested it, there would have been much resentment.

And probably a better translation than the word resentment would be, because in Arabic it said, Many people would fight for him, out of pride and out of nationalism

because he's one of them, they would fight for him and they would not be happy with, what Rasool Allah ﷺ did, why.?

Because Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبد الله بن ابي) wasn't exposed yet.

But since Rasool Allah ﷺ dealt with it, with such Hikmah(حكمة).

Now his own people, the same people who would have fought for him then.

These people are now against him.

And they are the ones were reproaching him, why.?

Because over time, the character of Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبد الله بن ابي) was showing up.

He was showing his true colors.

So now, people were realizing that he was a Munafiq(منافق) see, don't think that everybody then knew that he was a Munafiq(منافق) like we know now,

this is something that grew over time.

Now we know that Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبد الله بن ابي) was a Munafiq(منافق), so we're assuming that everybody knows that, that's not the case.

His people would think otherwise, but since Rasool Allah ﷺ left him alone, ignored him now his own people were turning against him.

Previously, whenever Rasool Allah ﷺ would walk towards the pulpit to give Khutba Tul Jum'ah(خطبةالجمعه) towards a Al-Mimbar(الممبر), Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبد الله بن ابئي) would stand up

and he would say this is the Messenger of Allah support him and help him, you know, he wants to stand up and speak and he wants to give himself authority that,

as if I'm the one telling you, to support Rasool Allah ﷺ.

But after his Nifaaq(نفاق) was showing up, when he would stand up.

His people would pull him down and say, you sit down, because they know that he's lying.

So, this is the Hikmah(حكمة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: But if I were to order his death today, they would all kill him.

Umar Bin Khattab(عمر بن خطاب) said: Yes Rasool Ullah, I realized that your decision is better than mine.

Also, thinking long term and the benefit of leniency, Rifq(رفق), being lenient with your followers is important, and Allahعَزّوجَلّ said that, if the heart of Rasool Allah ﷺ was harsh and if he was dealing with his people in a rough way,

they wouldn't have followed him.

But because Allahعَزّوجَلّ made his heart soft and his dealing with others lenient.

That is how he established his Ummah صلى الله عليه وسلم.

The next lesson, fighting nationalism, nationalism is an enemy of Islam and the Muslims need to stand against it, this Assbiyyah(عصبية).

Al-Muhajiroon(المهاجرون) are going to fight with Al-Ansaar(الانصار).

Al-Aos(الأوس) were going to fight with Al-Khazraj(الخزرج), but Rasool Allah ﷺ steps in and stops that.

So, this is an enemy that Shaytan(شيطان) is using against us, to sow the seeds of discord among the Ummah(امة).

So, we need to be very aware, be very careful, from this thing of Arabs and Pakistanis and British Muslim or American Muslim versus, they make immigrants,

see all of these titles are labeled tags that Shaytan(شيطان) can use to bring disunity among the Ummah(امة).

We are Muslim, we are one.

And these different nationalities that we belong to or different countries that we belong to because, see, I don't want to use the word nation because that's a nation could be a political thing

that is completely not recognized by Islam, altogether.

But Islam does recognize that we belong to tribes.

See with this thing of current nations, you know these nations were many of them were drawn up by some drunk British and French men, who met after world war one and World War Two and divided the Middle East,

and made it in such a way.

And if you look at the map of the Muslim world you can see some straight lines in there, that were drawn by a ruler.

I mean that's not a natural border.

But we do have tribes, we do belong to tribes.

The reason We created into tribes is for us, to know each other because imagine if we are all carbon copies of one another.

Imagine that everyone is equal to the in the way you look, and from where you belong to.

Then how would we recognize one another.

But see, we look different.

And we have different names, and that is so that every one of us will have an individual personality.

And that is how we can know one another.

Otherwise, who would, how would we know one another, if we're all exactly the same.

Number one, number two, number three, would be numbered and that's it.

Nobody will have this individual personality that we have everyone is unique.

Allah has created everyone unique.

And there are different tribes and every tribe is unique and different ethnic groups and these ethnic groups are unique.

Then the example of the son of Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبد الله بن ابي), and his name is also Abdullah(عبدالله).

Abdullah(عبدالله) when he heard that Rasool Allah ﷺ might kill his father because of what he said.

Abdullah(عبدالله) went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and told him; I heard that you want to kill my father, if you plan to do so, then let me kill him.

Now the people of Khazraj(خزرج) know that I am the most obedient towards my father, and I am the best among them, in obedience and fulfilling the rights of my father.

And I don't want someone else to kill my father and then after that I see this man walking safely.

And Shaytan(شيطان) comes to me and caused me to kill him.

And then I would have killed a believer, for the sake of a disbelievers.

So, if you want to kill him, then order me to do so and I'll do it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, he told him: No, we will not kill him.

And we will accompany him in this life with good company.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ made for Dua(دعا) for Abdullah(عبدالله), the son رضي الله عنه.

Now Abdullah(عبدالله) gives us the example of true, Eeman(ايمان), where your loyalty goes to, to Allah and His Messenger, someone willing to kill his own father,

for the sake of Islam.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ told him, don't do that, we'll be kind towards him.

And this shows you the heart of Rasool Allahﷺ, he had a great heart, صلى الله عليه وسلم.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَّ فَنَقِبَتْ قَدْمَايَ وَسَقِطَتْ اَظْفَارِيْ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ مَعَكَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ مَعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ

فَإِذَا سَجَدُوا فَلْيَكُونُوا مِنْ وَرَائِكُمْ وَلْتَأْتِ طَائِفَةٌ أُخْرَىٰ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا فَلْيُصَلُّوا مَعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا حِذْرَهُمْ وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ ۗ

وَدَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ تَغْفُلُونَ عَنْ أَسْلِحَتِكُمْ وَأَمْتِعَتِكُمْ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِنْ مَطَرٍ أَوْ كُنْتُمْ مَرْضَىٰ أَنْ تَضَعُوا أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ ۖ

وَخُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا ۝

فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ ۚ سبحان الله، هَلْ لَا نَبَّهتَنِيْ كُنْتُ فِيْ سُوْرَةٍ اَقْرَاُهَا فَلَمْ اُحِبْ أنْ اَقْطَعَهَا

فَلَمَّا تَابَعَ الرَّمْيَ رَكَعْتُ فَأُرِيتُكَ، وَأيْمُ اللهِ، لَوْلاَ أَنْ أُضَيِّعَ ثَغْرًا أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِحِفْظِهِ، لَقَطَعَ نَفْسِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أَقْطَعَهَا أَوْ أُنْفِذَهَا

تَغْبُنِّيْ تُلَاعِبُهَا وتُلَاعِبُكَ فَأَغَارَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ غَارُّونَ، وَأَنْعَامُهُمْ تُسْقَى عَلَى المَاءِ فَقَتَلَ مُقَاتِلَتَهُمْ ، وَسَبَى ذَرَارِيَّهُمْ ، وَأَصَابَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جُوَيْرِيَةَ بِنْتِ حَارِثْ

يا منصورامت امت Ayesha رضي الله عنها said; يا لِلْأنْصَارْ Usaid رضي الله عنه said; هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنْفِقُوا عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنْفَضُّوا ۗ

وَلِلَّهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

يَقُولُونَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

وَلَٰكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ۝

اِذْ تَرَبْلَهُ اُنُفْ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا ۚ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا ۚ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

parts.english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, Hassan Bin Thabit رضي الله عنه, as we mentioned previously was, what we could call him the head of the media effort of Rasool Allah ﷺ,

he was the one who would respond back with poetry against the poets of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and the other enemies of Islam.

So, Hassan Bin Thabit رضي الله عنه said a lot of lines of poetry, talking about the treachery and the betrayal of those tribes in Najd(نجد),

who killed the 70 Qurr'ah(قرا), the teachers of Qur'an.

Obviously, translating lines of poetry into different language, you lose the beauty of it but he has some wonderful lines of poetry talking about those events.

Az-Zubair Bin Awwam رضي الله عنه and I also think I mentioned this before, he would name his children after the Shuhadaa(شهداء).

So he named two of his sons, after two of the Shuhadaa(شهداء) in Bier Maoona(بئر ماعونه).

One of them was Urwa(عروة) and the other one was Al-Mundhir(المنذر).

So, two of the sons of Az-Zubair(الزبير) were named after Shuhadaa(شهداء).

It says that Zubair(زبير) and Talha(طلحه) were friends, and both of them belong to the group of 10 who were given the glad tidings of Jannah(جنة).

Talha(طلحه), he would name his sons, after the Ambiyaa(أنبياء), and Zubair(زبير) would name them, after the Shuhadaa(شهداء).

Rasool Allah ﷺ also during that period of time got married to Zainab Bint Khuzaimah(زينب بنت خزيمه) and she is called Umm-Ul-Masakeen(ام المساكين) the mother of the poor.

Why.? Because he used to take care of the poor and give them food, give them money, she was very caring of the poor.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ married her.

She was the wife of Abdullah Bin Jahash(عبدالله بن جحش), who was killed in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد).

And we can see here in the marriages of Rasool Allah ﷺ an element of social welfare Rasool Allah ﷺ taking care of his followers.

So, after Abdullah Bin Jahash(عبدالله بن جحش) died as a Shaheed(شهيد).

Rasool Allah ﷺ marries his wife and takes care of her.

And we can see that throughout the marriages of Rasool Allah ﷺ and also in many of the marriages of the Sahabah(صحابه), they didn't want to leave any woman behind without a husband, without a family.

And that was part of the reason or the Hikmah(حكمة) behind polygamy.

One should not think that it's solely for the purpose of satisfying one desires, there are some other aspects to marriage, bring up a Muslim family, taking care of one another.

As Allahعَزّوجَلّ says.

Rasool Allah ﷺ also got married to Ummo Salamah(ام سلمه).

Ummo Salamah رضي الله عنها is from Quraish(قريش), she's from Bannu Makhzoom(بنو مخزوم), an important family in Quraish(قريش), this is the family of Khalid Bin Waleed(خالد بن وليد), by the way.

And her husband, Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) was one of the early Sahabah(صحابه), he made Hijrah(هجرة) to Al-Habasha(حبشه) and he also made Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina,

so he's one of those who made the two Hijrah(هجرة)'s and he fought in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) and he was injured.

Now his injury was starting to heal, Rasool Allah ﷺ sends him on another mission, and during that mission, his injury starts all over again, and he ends up dying.

Now, before that Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) has a conversation with his wife.

He tells her, if a husband dies and his wife does not get married after him, they would be brought together again in Jannah(جنة).

If both of them are destined to go to Jannah(جنة).

So, Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) told his wife, How about, we make an agreement, If I die, you do not get married, if you die I don't get married.

She said: Fine, I agree.

He then told her: No.

I asked Allahعَزّوجَلّ, If I die then He replaces me with somebody better, who will marry you and will not harm you or hurt you.

Ummo Salamah(أم سلمه) would then say and who is better than Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه).

Who will I find in the world, better than Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه).

So this shows you that they had a very good relationship.

When he died she went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and told him Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) is dead.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Say, O Allah forgive me and forgive him and replace me with somebody better.

Or give me something that is better.

And she made that Dua(دُعَا), Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه proposed marriage, she refused, Umar Bin Khattab(عمر بن خطاب) proposes marriage, she refuses.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ He proposed marriage, she said: Marhaba(مرحبا), Welcome.

But tell Rasool Allah ﷺ Tell Rasool Allah ﷺ that I am a jealous woman, and I have kids, young kids, and none of my Walii(ولي) are present.

So I agree, but let Rasool Allah ﷺ know my condition I'm a very jealous woman and Rasool Allah ﷺ is already married.

And I have kids and these kids are gonna be a burden on him and then none of my Wallii(ولي) are here to marry me to you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; You said that you have children, Allahعَزّوجَلّ will take care of those kids.

You said that you are jealous I'm gonna ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to take that jealousy away.

And the Wallii(ولي)'s who are absent, none of them will refuse to marry you to me, all of them will be happy that you would marry me.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ marries Ummo Salamah(ام سلمه).

In another narration it said that she told him, I mean, I agree, but I'm an old woman, I'm getting old.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; If you are old I'm older than you.

And I think this also shows you, the intention of Rasool Allah ﷺ, in his marriage from Ummo Salamah رضي الله عنها.

And I talked about this, in my series on the life of Rasool Allah ﷺ in Makkah.

We talked about his marriages and the objectives that his marriages would serve.

So, the marriages of Rasool Allah ﷺ were marriages for the sake of the Ummah(امة), for the sake of the religion.

Ummo Salamah رضي الله عنها, narrated 338 Ahadith(احاديث), very important to Ahadith(احاديث), some in Bukhari(بخاريْ), some in Muslim(مسلم).

And she conveyed to us this knowledge from Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, that is one of the reasons, why Allahعَزّوجَلّ destined Rasool Allah ﷺ to marry Ummo Salamahرضي الله عنها because everything happened, according to the destiny of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and His plan for this religion.

So, his marriage to Ayesha(عائشه) was a Barakah(بركة) for us.

His marriage with Zainab(زينب) was a Barakah(بركة) for us.

His marriage to Khadijah(خديجه) was a Barakah(بركة) for us.

His marriage to Ummo Salamah(ام سلمه) was a Barakah(بركة) for us.

All of his marriages served a purpose in Islam, for us.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ married her and he said that I'm going to give you a furniture equal to that which I gave to Zainab(زينب).

So, what was this furniture?

Did they go to what are those famous, furniture places IKEA, whatever and buy new set, furniture, 10's of thousands of dollars worth of furniture for the newly wed couple.

What was the furniture that Rasool Allah ﷺ got for Ummo Salamah(ام سلمه)?

Keep in mind here we're talking about the best of mankind.

The one, who, if he wanted he could have spent on his wives, all the money that he could.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was getting money from all of these Ghazawaat(غزوات) Ghameena(غنيمه) that was coming in, Rasool Allah ﷺ could have spent that lavishly on his wives and nobody would have complained.

I mean he's the Messenger of Allah, he deserves to have his family live the best life, who would have dare to complain about that.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ was setting an example for his Ummah(امة) in Zuhud(زهد), austerity.

He said; I will give you a no less than what I gave so and so.

I gave her two stone Mills, two clay jars and a pillow stuffed with leaf, leaf is palm leaves.

That was the furniture two stone Mills, two clay jars and a pillow, that was it.

That was the furniture that Rasool Allah ﷺ bought for Ummo Salamah رضي الله عنها, very simple life.

And he spent three days with her, when he got married to her.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; For a person who was married to more than one women.

As soon as he gets married to the second wife or the third or the fourth.

If she is a virgin, then he spends seven days with her.

If she is widowed or divorced then he spends three days with her, so since Ummo Salamah(ام سلمه) is a widow Rasool Allah ﷺ spent three days with her.

Also during that year, Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abi Talib(الحسن بن علي بن ابي طالب) was born.

When he was born, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) brought to Rasool Allah ﷺ, the good news Rasool Allah ﷺ said: What did he name him?

He said, we named him Harb(حرب), Harb(حرب) means war.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: No, he is Hassan(حسن).

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not like these harsh names, Harb(حرب) and Stone and you have sakher(صخر) you have Harb(حرب), you've all of these tough names.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not like that and he changed the name from Harb(حرب) to Hassan(حسن).

Hassan(حسن) means nice beautiful, kind.

It has all of these pleasant meanings.

This is the name that he chose for his grandson Al-Hassan Bin Ali رضي الله عنه.

Also we see here that it is he, who named his grandson, Al-Hassan رضي الله عنه.

He made Azaan(آذان) in his ear, according to the Hadith(حديث), he asked his mother Fatima(فاطمه) to shave his head and then weigh it and pay the equivalent weight in silver as Sadaqah(صدقه) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله)

and also he made Aqeeqah(عقيقه) for him, they slaughtered for him two sheep, that was Aqeeqah(عقيقه) of Al-Hassan رضي الله عنه.

We're talking here about various events that happened during the fourth year of Hijrah(هجرى), after the Battle of Uhud(أحَد).

Also during that time Rasool Allah ﷺ calls in, Zaid Bin Thabit رضي الله عنه and he tells him O Zaid(زيد), Learn the Hebrew language because I cannot trust, the Jews.

I don't trust them to read my letters for me, I don't trust them hiring any one of them to be my assistant to read the letters that I received from them or to write back to them.

Since Rasool Allah ﷺ was illiterate, he had to have these assistance to write letters for him and to read the letters that he received.

So, there was some correspondence between Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Jews.

So, he wanted a Muslim to be responsible for writing those letters and reading them for him.

Zaid رضي الله عنه said that I learned the Hebrew language in 15 days.

Subhaan Allah(سبحان الله) learning a new foreign language in 15 days that shows you the persistence and the hard work of the Sahabah رضي الله عنه,

within 15 days, he was ready to go, he learned a foreign language.

So probably for all of those brothers and sisters want to learn Arabic you could learn a lot from the example of Zaid Bin Thabit رضي الله عنه,

Zaid Bin Thabit(زيد بن ثابت) I mean, shouldn't take you years that you just plan to take the first step, It just took Zaid(زيد) fifteen(15) days to learn it the whole thing.

Now, learning Arabic is important very important.

And I would urge my brothers and sisters to take it seriously.

Without the Arabic language there is going to remain a barrier between you and understanding the religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, since the original text of this religion is in Arabic language,

whether we're talking about Qur'an or Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, so it's very important that you put in the effort into learning Arabic.

And if you make the Niyyah(نية) and you're sincere Allah will make a way out for you, Allah will make it easy for you, you will be able to learn it.

But just put in the effort, make the intention put in the effort be willing to sacrifice time and money for it and In Sha Allah(اِنْ شَاءالله عَزّوجَلّ)  Allah will help you.

If Zaid(زيد) learned a foreign language that is not necessary as a Muslim.

What about learning a language that is necessary and that's the Arabic language.

I also want to say here that Muslims are going to need experts in foreign languages, linguists.

The Muslims will need people, who will be able to study the literature of other nations the political situation of other nations, the economical situation of other nations.

And that's why it's important for Muslims to learn foreign languages and to have Muslim experts in each and every language of the world or important language of the world.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, here had Zaid(زيد) learned the Hebrew language because that was the language in which he had correspondence with Al-Yahood(اليهود),

now a days Muslims have correspondence with many nations of the world, so it's important that Muslims learn these foreign languages.

The next important event occurred in the fourth year of Hijrah(هجرة).

We talked about Umayyah Bin Amr Adh-Dhamri(امية بن عمرو الضمري).

Actually I think I didn't mention this.

That's a reflection of the fear.

Subhaan Allah(سبحان الله) that wall is a fulfillment of this Ayah(آية) of Qur'an.

They will not fight except from behind the wall or from a well protected cockpit in a plane or from the bowels of a ship but they do not have a courage to come out and fight like the the children of Al-Intifaadha(الانتفاضة)

out there in the open, fighting for Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: Their violence among themselves is severe.

This is to tell the Muslims that even though they gang up against you they come together and fight you.

But their hearts are different, and they have hatred among themselves.

Look at what the kuffar(كفار) do to each other.

In World War One, you have 10 million killed in World War Two 50 million.

Look at the wars that happened, among the European nations look at the wars in Africa look at wars in all over the world.

So, don't think that the kuffar(كفار) are all one.

No, they have differences among themselves but when it comes to Islam, Yes, they unify and they come and fight together, but we should realize that they have differences among themselves too.

Their violence among themselves is severe.

Again World War One and World War Two are an example of that.

You think they are together but their hearts are diverse.

That is because they are people who do not reason.

There is like the example of those, shortly before them, they tasted the bad consequences of their affair and they will have a painful punishment.

This is talking about Bannu Qainuqah(بنوقينقاع) who were driven out of Madina before Bannu Nadhir(بنونضير), Bannu Nadhir(بنونضير) should have taken heed of what happened to Bannu Qainuqah(بنوقينقاع).

These are some lessons from the Ayaat(آيات) of Surat(سورة) An-Nadhir(النضير).

We have read the Aayat(آيات), up until about verse 16 or 15 if you want to go back and check them.

The Arabs of Madina, in the time of Jahiliyyah(جاهليه) They had the superstition that if they have children and they keep on dying.

So the mother will have a child and then the child will die, she will have the second child and that child will die, they had the superstition that if you make a vow that your next child will be a Jew,

then the child will live, this was some superstition that existed among the people of Madina, before Islam.

Because of this, they had children, who were growing up with Al-Yahood(اليهود) as a fulfillment of those vows.

So now, when the Jews of Bannu Nadhir(بنونضير) are going to be driven out, they came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said; We have some of our sons and some of our brothers are with them.

What should we do?

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not answer back, until an Ayah(آية) in Qur'an was revealed, And that Ayah(آية) was: There is no compulsion in religion and you all know this verse, it's in Surat-Ul-Baqarah(سورة البقرة) there is no compulsion in religion.

Path of good is clear on the path of evil is clear.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ told them, This is a Sahih(صحيح) narration Give these brothers and Sons of yours the choice, if they choose you, then they stay with you, if they choose to be with the Jews, then they leave with them.

In other words, you cannot compel them, you cannot force them to stay behind and become Muslim, even though they are ethnically Arabs even though they are your own children.

These issues are not about ethnicity and we talked about this issue of nationalism, and all of that.

Islam doesn't recognize this, it is what is in your heart that's what counts.

Islam is not against a particular race, whether that race is the Jewish race or the white race or any race.

Islam is not against any particular race Islam is a religion for everyone.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Allahعَزّوجَلّ does not look at your forms or the color of your skin.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ looks at your hearts.

So, these children of yours even though they are part of your families, if they choose you, then they are Muslim if they choose the Yahood(يهود), then they have to leave with them,

and you cannot force them otherwise to become Muslim.

And this is the reason for the revelation of this Ayah(آية) that we all know in Surat-Ul-Baqarah(سورة البقرة), Also alcohol was banned, during the siege of Bannu Nadhir(بنونضير),

that's when the Ayah(آية) prohibiting alcohol was revealed, and you know that the prohibition of alcohol occurred in four stages, this was the final stage.

So, it's pretty late and we were talking about the fourth year of Hijrah(هجرى).

So, Muslims, continue drinking for 17 years.

It wasn't until the last six years of the life of Rasool Allah ﷺ that alcohol was banned.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ

وَاعقُبْنِيْ مِنْهُ عُقْبَهْ حَسَنَهْ اَرْسَلَ إلَيْهَا يَخْطبُهَا اِنِّيْ غَيْرَة وَ اِنِّيْ مَسْبِيَّه وَلَيْسَ اَحَدٌ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآئي شَهَدْ

اَمَّا قَوْلُكِ اِنِيْ مُسْبِيَة فَاِنَّ الله سَيَكفيْكِ صبْيَانَكْ وَاَمَّا قَوْلُكِ اِنَّيْ غَيْرَة فَسَأدعُو الله اَنْ يَذْهَبَ غَيْرَتُكِ

وَاَمَّا الْاَوْلِيَآءْ  فَلَيْسَ اَحَدُ مِّنْهُمْ اِلَّا سَيَرْضَى بِي اَمَا اِنِّيْ لَا اَنْقُصكِ مِمَّا اَعْطَيْتُ فُلَانَ يَحْيَيْنْ وَ جَرَّتَيْنْ وِسادَةٌ مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُها لِيفٌ

لِلْبِكْرِ سَبْعْ وَللثَيِّبْ ثَلَاثْ يَا زَيْدْ تَعَلَّمَ كِتَابَة يَهُوْدْ فَاِنِيْ واللَّهِ ما آمَنُ يَهودَ علَى كتابي لَيَقْتِلْ مُسلِمْ بِكَافِرْ

اِنَّ رَسٌول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم اَرْسَلَنِيْ إلَيْكُمْ اَنْ اخْرِجُوْا من بِلَادِيْ لَقَدْ نَقَضتُّمُ الْعهدَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتُ لَكُمْ مِمَّا هَمَمْتُمْ بِه مِنَّ الْغَدْرْ

وقد أجلتكم عشراً فمن رئي بَعْدُ مِنْكُمْ ضَرَبْتُ عُنُقَهَ تَغَّيَّرَتُ الْقُلُوْبْ وَمَحَى الّاِسْلَامَ الْعهُوْدْ حَارَبَتِ الْيَهُوْد اَنْ اخْرِجُوْ مِن بِلَادِيْ

ولا تقطعوا شجرة كُنْتَ تَنْهَى عَنْ فَسَادِ فِى الاَرضْ هَذَ الَّذِي أعدَدْنَاه لِرَفْعِ الْاَرْضِ وَخَفْضِهَا وَاِنْ كُنَّا تَرَكْنَا نَخْلًا وَفِيْ خَيْبَرً نَخْلَ

يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُمْ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ مَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا

وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ مَانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَأَتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ

يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُمْ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ۝

هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ Allahعَزّوجَلّ said; وَلَوْلَا أَنْ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجَلَاءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابُ النَّارِ۝

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَنْ يُشَاقِّ اللَّهَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ۝

مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ۝

فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ Allah عَزّوجَلّ says; وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ

وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ۝

مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ كَيْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةً بَيْنَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ مِنْكُمْ

وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ۝

جُعِلَ رِزْقِيْ تَحْتَ ظِلْ رُمْحِيْ جُعِلَ رِزْقِيْ تَحْتَ ظِلْ رُمْحِيْ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ

لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِنْ قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنْصُرَنَّكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ۝

لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِنْ قُوتِلُوا لَا يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِنْ نَصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْأَدْبَارَ وَلَئِنْ نَصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ۝

لَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ بَأْسُهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ۝

وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ لَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ ۚ بَأْسُهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ۝

لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَدْ تَبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ ۚ قَدْ خُيِّرَ أَصْحَابكُمْ , فَإِنْ اخْتَارُوكُمْ فَهُمْ مِنْكُمْ , وَإِنْ اخْتَارُوهُمْ فَهُمْ مِنْهُمْ

لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ وَصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

parts.english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, We're carrying on with lessons from Uhud(أحَد).

Why were youth such as Rafiyah Bin Khateej(رافع بن خديج) and Samurah Bin Jundub(سَمُرَةْ بن جندب) and some others like Abdullah Bin Umar(عبدالله بن عمر) and Al-Bara'a Bin Aazib(البراء بن عازب),

why were they so eager to join the fight.

One might argue that the reason is that they belong to a militant society.

I mean, one could say that, well that was the lifestyle of the Arabs, this was a warlike people, all what they did was fight, fight, fight.

So it's not really strange that these kids would want to join in war and battle because that's part of being a man in Arabia.

When one could argue from this point of view.

But one could respond back by saying that, that's not necessarily the case.

Because when youngsters such as Abdullah Bin Umar(عبدالله بن عمر), Al-Bara'a Bin Aazib(البرآء بن عازب) Samoorah(سَمُرَةْ) and Rafiah(رافع) wanted to join the army,

on the other hand, we have about 300, who defected.

So, it's not all about the society and this being a society of warriors that's not really true.

The issue here is Eeman(ايمان), the ones who had Eeman(ايمان) and the ones who didn't have it the ones who had Eeman(ايمان) would so eager to join

and the ones who didn't have it was so eager to run away.

Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن اُبَيئ) and 300 of his men defected, in the day of Uhud(أحَد), withdrew, they refuse to fight.

And this was the case in many of the other battles, they refused to join in Tabook(تبوك), they refused to join in Al-Khandaq(الخندق).

So, they run away in times of fear.

And I use the word defected a lot.

And again, probably in one sense, this is the right word to use, because them withdrawing is really them being on the side of the enemy.

But I don't want it to be understood that they defected to the enemy side, that's not the case, I mean, they withdrew back to Uhud(أحَد), they didn't go and fight to the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

But even though they weren't participating in the fight, but one can say that they were part of the enemy's army because they would support them with information, they would act as spies for them.

So, don't take the word literal, it does have a correct meaning, but not in a literal sense.

It's not that they actually physically defected to the enemy's army.

Next lesson one can see one of the characteristics of the Munafiqeen(منافقين) in this battle.

They refused to fight in Uhud(أحَد), because of fear of death.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ came back, and he wanted to pursue Abu Sufiyaan(ابوسفيان), in what is referred to Ghazwa Hamra'a Al-Asad(غزوة حمراء الاسد).

The Munafiqeen(منافقين) in this time wanted to join but Rasool Allah ﷺ this time refused to allow them to join.

He said only the ones who joined me in Uhud(أحَد), can join me now.

And why did they want to join in Hamra Al-Asad(حمراء الاسد), because they thought there is a good possibility of winning.

So, there could be some booties of war, to get some of those spoils.

So, this is a characteristic of Munafiqeen(منافقين), they want to take the worldly benefits from Islam, but they refuse to pay the demands of Islam.

They want the gains, but they don't want the pains.

They want Ghanimah(غنيمه), but they don't want to fight.

So, this mindset of being a Muslim when it's convenient and giving it up, when I'm demanded sacrifice is a sign of hypocrisy.

And it applies to many situations, and it's very dangerous, and one should try to check up, themselves and see if that's the case do I become enthusiastic to join in Islamic activities

when I feel that there's a worldly benefit for me, in it but when it becomes demanding then I give it up.

For example, you might know some parents, who are very happy about Islam, when it comes to the part of Islam that talks about children being obedient to their parents

and respecting their parents and the rights of the parents being second to Allahعَزّوجَلّ, and all of those Aayaat(آيات) in Qur'an and Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ

that tell them to take care of their moms and dads so they love that part of Islam.

However, when it comes to the part of Islam that tells their son to go and for example, fight Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله عَزّوجَلّ), No, they don't want that part and they don't want their children to hear about that part.

So, I love Islam, when it's gonna tell my sons to be submissive, but I don't like it when it tells them to go and give up their lives.

Or, for example, the husband who loves the Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, He said; If I was going to tell a woman to make Sujood(سجود) to anyone other than Allah,

then I would tell her, to make Sujood(سجود) to her husband.

And if the husband goes to bed and he's upset with his wife, then the angels will curse the wife until the morning and he would repeat all of those Ahadith(احاديث).

But when it comes to the Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, being kind to his wives when it comes to the stories of the Sahabah(صحابه) being kind to their wives

he wants to hide those away.

Some scholars, for example, they love to talk about how you should respect the scholar and how you should obey the scholar and listen to their fatwah(فتوى)

and not disagree with them, and you should honor them.

But then the scholar would shy away from the parts of Islam that tell them that they need to speak the truth, they need to speak the whole truth,

they should hide nothing from it and they should speak the truth even if they're going to have to pay the price with, their own lives.

So this duality, of wanting to be a Muslim, when it's convenient and trying to cover up the other parts is not a good thing.

And as we see here, its the sign of Nifaaq(نفاق), so one needs to be careful and make sure that they don't belong to this category of people.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, you take Islam in its entirety.

You don't take some parts and leave others that's the sign of the People of the Book.

They believed in, part of the book and they rejected others, so we have to accept it all.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he took Baiyah(بيعة) from Al-Ansaar(الانصار) the Baiyah(بيعة) was You obey me in times of ease and in times of difficulty.

It's not when you like it, and then you neglect it when you don't.

You have to take the whole package, as it is.

Next lesson, Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن قيم) says; that one of the benefits of Uhud(أحَد) is So, one of the lessons of Uhud(أحَد) is to show the servitude of the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم,

that they are willing to worship Allahعَزّوجَلّ in times of ease and in times of difficulty.

So, if they are firm and steadfast on the religion on both situations, that's a sign of true servitude, Uboodiyah (عبودية).

And that's unlike people who only worship Allahعَزّوجَلّ on one condition, you know, they're program to only worship Allah, if things are tough

they only program to worship Allah, if things are easy, but they don't have the combination of both.

So, sometimes people only remember Allahعَزّوجَلّ when things get tough then they start making Dua(دُعَا), O Allah, for example all of those Bachelors out there.

And that is when Allahعَزّوجَلّ responds to your Dua(دعا), when you humble yourself in front of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and you show Him true servitude that is when Allahعَزّوجَلّ responds to your Dua(دعا).

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ said about Badr(بدر); Allahعَزّوجَلّ gave you victory in Badr(بدر), when you were weak While in Hunain(حنين) While in Hunain(حنين) because you are dependent on your numbers you lost.

He also says, and this will be our last lesson that we talked about in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) Uhud(أحَد), was a preparation for the most catastrophic event that will ever happen to the Muslims.

Because this event is so great, they needed to be prepared for it.

And that is the death of Rasool Allah ﷺ and since Rasool Allah ﷺ was everything for Sahabah(صحابه) in terms of Islam.

You know, they learned Islam from him, he was their source.

They didn't have any books to go and consult.

They didn't have any scholars to go and talk to, they didn't have any Jama'at(جماعات) to recruit them and teach them about Islam.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was their source and their only source.

So, he was their father, he was everything for them.

So, for them to lose him is not gonna be an easy thing it's going to be a huge setback and it will cause a serious psychological affect on the hearts of the Muslims,

so they need to be prepared for that.

And that preparation was through this false rumor that spread around on the battleground in Uhud(أحَد), that Rasool Allah ﷺ has died and then the Ayah(آية) was revealed,

Muhammad(محمد) is a messenger, He is but a messenger and there have been many messengers before him so if he dies you shouldn't fall back on your heels and retreat

you should carry on, forward with the message, so Allahعَزّوجَلّ prepared them through this Ghazwa(غزوة).

So these are lessons from the Battle of Uhud(أحَد).

We'll talk about events between Al-Uhud(أحَد) and Al-Khandaq(اَلْخَنْدق).

Number one; Rasool Allah ﷺ heard news that Bannu Asad(بنو اسد) are mobilizing forces to attack Madina these are tribes in Najd(نجد) and they were headed by Tulaiha Al-Asdi(طليحة الاسدي).

And this man is this man is quite fascinating.

His story is interesting, he started out by fighting against Rasool Allah ﷺ and then becoming Muslim after that and then after Rasool Allah ﷺ passes away,

he apostates and claims to be a prophet and then after that, he changes his mind and becomes a Muslim again and he fights Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

That was the end of his life, he was Mujahid(مجاهد).

So, he is kind of experienced it at all Tulaiha Al-Asdi(طليحة الاسدي).

Any way he was recruiting men to fight Rasool Allah ﷺ and Rasool Allah ﷺ as we said he would strike them, take them by surprise.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ sent an army led by Abu Salama(ابوسلمه) and Abu Salama(ابوسلمه), by the way, was injured in the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) So he went out in this Sariyyah(سرية)

and the enemy was defeated and he came back with a lot of cattle and but his injury, which was almost going to heal, now erupted again and he died, Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), this is Abu Salama(ابوسلمه).

Another tribe was mobilizing, forced to fight Rasool Allah ﷺ and these were Hudail(هذيل), and their leader was Khalid Bin Sufiaan Al-Hudali( خالد بن سفيان الهذلي)

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, Khalid Bin Sufiaan Al-Hudali( خالد بن سفيان الهذلي) is recruiting an army to fight us.

So, go and kill him.

These orders were delivered to Abdullah Bin Unais رضي الله عنه who was from the tribe of Juhainah(جهينة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him that Hudail(هذيل) are gathering men, under the leadership of Khalid Bin Sufiaan Al-Hudali( خالد بن سفيان الهذلي), so go and kill him.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said; Can you describe him for me, so that I will know him, I will recognize him, because he never saw him before.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him, if you see him, you will tremble.

This man Khalid Bin Sufiaan(خالد بن سفيان), if you see him you would tremble.

Possibly that could be because this man Khalid Bin Sufiaan(خالد بن سفيان) was such a powerful figure that whenever anybody who see him, he would tremble.

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس), said I never trembled for the sight of anyone Rasool Allah ﷺ told him but if you see Khalid Bin Sufiaan(خالد بن سفيان), you would tremble.

So, this tells you that Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) was the right person to choose.

He was a courageous man, he wasn't somebody who would fear others.

So he said, I never trembled because of anyone.

But this was going to be a special sign in which, he would be able to recognize who is Khalid Bin Al-Hudail( خالد بن الهذلي) So, Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said, I carried my sword, and I went out.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ told him that he's gathering the men in Uranah(عرنة) in Arafaat(عرفات).

So, he was gathering them close to Makkah, close to where his tribe lives.

And obviously, that territory is all supportive of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

So, he is recruiting an army so he opens up a camp and he's recruiting men to that camp.

Abdullah Bin Unais رضي الله عنه said, I was walking towards this man and when I saw him, I shivered.

So, I knew that this man is Khalid Bin Sufiaan(خالد بن سفيان).

And he was with some women trying to find a camp ground for them.

These were his women wives, daughters, sisters, whatever, women from his family.

So he was with them trying to find for them a camp.

So, he walked towards him and he said it was time for Asar(عصر).

And I was worried that my fight with him could preoccupy me from Salah(صلاة).

I mean Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم) how long this fight will take.

So, it could preoccupy me from Salah(صلاة), I could be killed.

And since it is already time for Asr(عصر), I need to pray Asr(عصر), but the problem is, how can you pray Asr(عصر) in the presence of this man?

I mean he would recognize that he's a Muslim.

So, he said, I was praying while I was walking towards him and my Sujood(سجود) and Rukooh(ركوع) would be movement of my head.

He would move his head, and that would be his Rukooh(ركوع) and Sujood(سجود).

And he said, when I reached him, he said, and who is the man, who are you?

Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said, I am a Bedouin Arab, who heard about your plans to fight Muhammad(محمد).

So I came to join you.

He said; yes, that is what I'm doing, I'm gathering forces to fight against Muhammadﷺ.

So, Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) said I talked with him, for a while until I felt confident that I can now attack and I attacked him with my sword and killed him.

He said I left him with his women crouched over him, so he killed him.

It was laying on the ground and all of these women came swarming around the dead body.

And Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس) left and he enters Madina Rasool Allah ﷺ saw him and said; May this face succeed, he is making Dua(دعا) for Abdullah Bin Unais(عبدالله بن انيس).

Abdullah(عبدالله) said: I killed him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes, you did.

You are speaking the truth.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ calls him indoors, he calls him into his house and he gives him a stick.

So, Abdullah Bin Unais رضي الله عنه takes the stick and leaves.

His people met him and said, Why did Rasool Allah give you this stick.

He said I don't know, he just gave it to me.

They said go back and ask him.

Why did they give you this stick?

Abdullah Bin Unais رضي الله عنه said, I went back and I asked Rasool Allah ﷺ, Why did you give me this stick.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said this will be a sign between me and you, on the Day of Judgment.

Abdullah Bin Unais رضي الله عنه said; I tied that stick to my sword, meaning it was always with me and when he died, his instructions were to bury that stick with him

And it was wrapped with him, in his shroud and buried with him.

So that on the Day of Judgment, when he is resurrected he can have that stick as a sign between him and Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And by the way, Rasool Allah ﷺ said in the Hadith(حديث).

And on that day, a few people will have something to lean on.

When he told him that I give you the stick to be a sign between me and you on the Day of Judgment.

He also told him, And on that day few people will have something to lean on.

The scholars say that this means few people will have deeds on which to lean on, on the Day of Judgment.

And so, this is the story of the assassination of Khalid Bin Sufiaan Al-Hudali( خالد بن سفيان الهذلي).

And due to his assassination that ended the plan of Hudail(هذيل) to attack Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, it shows you that Rasool Allah did not choose to fight the tribe of Hudail(هذيل) and rather he chose to assassinate Khalid(خالد), because the problem was with Khalid(خالد) and to spare the blood of the people.

Rasool Allah ﷺ assassinated this single man because some people might wonder, I mean, what are these political assassinations that Rasool Allah ﷺ was involved in?

Well, that is to save the people from bloodshed rather than fighting the whole tribe who would not have otherwise fight with Rasool Allah ﷺ if it wasn't for Khalid Bin Hudail( خالد بن الهذيل).

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to take care of this problem by reducing the bloodshed and that is by killing this man, who is the cause of the whole problem.

This was a man with an outstanding personality and ability to lead the people and he was leading them into evil.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ took him out of the way and that spared the Muslims and the people of Hudail(هذيل) from war.

Rasool Allah ﷺ sends a group of 10 men for a mission and their leader was Asim Bin Thabit رضي الله عنه.

They reach to the land of Bannu Lahyaan(بنو لحيان), and they are ambushed by 100 archers so 100 against 10.

So, they fled to a small hill, they climb that hill or a rock, and these hundred archers surrounded them.

The archers told them come down, we guarantee you that we wouldn't kill you.

We pledge that we wouldn't kill you, this is our word.

The Ameer(امير) said; I do not accept the pledges of Mushrikeen(مشركين), I do not accept your word, I do not accept your pledge.

And he chose to fight, this was the Ameer(امير), Asim Bin Thabit(عاصم بن ثابت).

So they fight, seven get killed.

So you have three remaining, they surrendered and they were tied up in ropes.

One of them felt that they would be betrayed and he was able to pull out his hand from the ropes and he drew out his sword and tried to attack these men from Bannu Lahyaan(بنو لحيان).

But they kept a distance from him and kept on pelting him with rocks, until they killed him.

And they took the other two men and sold them to the people of Makkah.

These two men Khabbab(خَبَّاب) and Zaid Bin (الدثنة)Dathinnah رضي الله عنهما.

Now, obviously we would know what the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) would do with these two men, they would kill them.

So, they decide that they're going to kill the two men.

They take them out of Makkah because Makkah is Haram(حرم) and you are not supposed to kill in Makkah.

So they take them outside the boundaries of Makkah and they ask these two men they tell them would you wish that Muahmmad(محمد) is in your place and you are safe with your family.

They respond by saying, we don't wish to be safe with our family while Muhammadﷺ is hurt by a thorn and we would rather die than Rasool Allah ﷺ being hurt.

Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) said; I've never seen a people, who love their leader more than the people of Muahmmad(محمد), love him.

And I want to stop here and bring up this issue of loving Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The love of the Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ was so true and so deep that it was even known to the enemies of Muhammadﷺ.

So, here you have Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) admitting, because it was so compelling, the evidence was so clear, the issue was so impressive that Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان), the leader of the enemies of Rasool Allah ﷺ admits publicly

and says, I've never seen people, who love someone like the Sahabah(صحابه) love Muhmmad(محمد).

And this wasn't because, see, if the Sahabah(صحابه) would claim that they love Muhammadﷺ day and night, that wouldn't have made a difference.

But the love of Muhammadﷺ emanated from their actions it was reflected in their deeds.

Here you have two men facing death and they were asked whether you wish to be safe with your family, with your kids with your wife in the comfort of your home

and have Muhammadﷺ here instead of you, they said, We would rather give our lives, than Muhammadﷺ be pricked by a thorn, be hurt by a thorn.

So, this issue of loving Muhammadﷺ was so well known to everyone.

They are both killed, as far as we know that, Khabbab(خَبَّاب), he was crucified.

And his body remained on that cross until Ummayyah Bin Amr Adh-Dhamri(اُمَيَّةَ بن عَمْرُو اَلضَّمْرِيْ) comes and takes the body and buries it.

Khabbab رضي الله عنه before his death, he asks this woman because he was held captive in the house of this woman, who lost her husband.

And they said that it was Khabbab(خَبَّاب), who killed her husband in the Battle of Badr(بدر).

So, it was this family that was going to take revenge.

So he was in their house, so he tells this woman can you bring me a steel blade so that I can prepare myself for death.

What he wants to do with this blade is, to shave his pubic hair.

So, she sends him the blade with her child, young child.

In one narration it says that she gave it to him but then the child crawled onto the lap of Khabbab(خَبَّاب) anyway doesn't make a difference.

The child ended up, in the hands in the lap of Khabbab(خَبَّاب) When the woman sees child in Khabbab(خَبَّاب)'s lap and he's holding this blade in his hand,

what would she think?

Khabbab(خَبَّاب) saw that she's worried that he might kill this child.

But he told her; That's not something I would do.

In Sha Allah(ان شاءالله), that's not going to be something that I would do And the lesson here to learn is that, even though he was going to be killed by the Kuffar(كفار) that didn't make him take revenge on a child, an innocent child.

And a Muslim is not a traitor, a Muslim would not betray and a Muslim would not take away the life of an innocent human being.

And even though he had a chance, and he already knew that he would be killed he could have taken revenge from that child, but he didn't.

And that woman said, I've never seen a prisoner better than him I would come in and see him eating from a plate full of grapes, when there are no grapes in Makkah whatsoever

and I'm sure that he received those grapes from the angels.

This is what a Mushrik(مشرك) woman, who was saying, Karamaat(كرامات).

Now another lesson also is that, it shows you even though he was facing death, he still wanted to fulfill the Sunnah(سنة), he was going to shave his pubic hair, which is one of the Sunnan(سنن) of Fitrah(فطرة).

He wanted to do that even though you know, you could argue and say, well the Ummah(امة) has more important things to think about then shaving pubic hair.

I mean let's get serious and start taking care of the important things.

Well the Sahabah رضي الله عنه, they will take everything seriously.

Everything in Islam was serious to them, so even though he's facing death, he still wants to follow the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Also before he was crucified, he sought permission from his crucifiers.

He said, allow me to pray.

So, they did grant him time to pray.

He prayed two Rak'ah(ركعة).

When he finished he looked at them and said; If it wasn't for the fear of you, accusing me of being afraid of death, I would have making these two Rak'ah(ركعة) longer.

So, he made the Salah(صلاة) short, so that they wouldn't think that he's afraid of dying.

And he is the first one to start this Sunnah(سنة) of praying two Rak'ah(ركعة) before death.

Later on, it became a Sunnah(سنة) because of his action.

Khubaib رضي الله عنه was killed, and Zaid(زيد) was killed and Abdullah Bin Tariq(عبدالله بن طارق) was killed.

So, now you have the entire group of 10 ended up dead, all of them.

Seven were killed on the spot Abdullah Bin Tariq(عبد الله بن طارق) was killed on the way to Makkah and the other two were killed in Makkah, so all of them were killed.

The Munafiqeen(منافقين) what they said was and this is according to Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) they said, How sad for those misguided people who died that way.

They neither stayed with their families, nor did they carry out their masters mission.

What the Munafiqeen(منافقين) are saying is that these 10 men are a failure.

They ended up dying for nothing, the mission wasn't accomplished and they ended up losing their lives for nothing.

If they stayed home, it would have been better for them.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ revealed the Ayah(آية) saying, And of the people is, he whose speech pleases you in worldly life and he calls Allah to witness as to what is in his heart
