The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 by Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki.

We talked last evening about the covenant, this document that is drawn up by Rasool Allah ﷺ to govern the relationships of the different peoples of Madina.

I've mentioned that you had Arabs who were polytheists and Muslims and then you have the Jewish tribes, of Madina.

A few comments on the covenant, states the It says that the believers are, which is believers are allies to one another, excluding others.

So, here you have the faith based community an Ummah(امة) established on faith, which was a novel concept to the Arabs who used to base everything on the relationship of blood.

So now, Rasool Allah ﷺ is coming up with this concept of, "We are brothers because we are believers".

And not only we are brothers, but we're brothers excluding everyone else, there's a special bond just because of us, being a Muslim.

And that was a statement made in the document.

So, this might be one explanation of the reason, why you find that there were many orders, given by Rasool Allah ﷺ to distinguish the Muslims from the Jews, for example.

Now obviously, everything in Islam was distinguishing it, from the pagan worshipping, religion of Arabia.

But since there are some commonalities between the Muslims and the People of the Scripture, Rasool Allah ﷺ didn't want that to overflow.

He wanted the Muslims to keep a distinct identity.

So, you'd find that there are many Ahadith(احاديث) in which Rasool Allah ﷺ was ordering or instructing the Muslims to be different than the Jews of Madina.

For example, you had the Jews of Madina did not pray in leather socks, so Rasool Allah ﷺ said; The Yahood(يهود) of Madina would not dye with Hinnah(حنا),

so Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Dye your hair with Hinnah(حناء) and this is for men.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ came into Madina, he saw that the Jews would fast on the 10th of Muharram(محرم), Aashoora(عاشوره), so he asked, he inquired for the reason.

The response was that this was the day in which Allahسبحانه وتعالى saved Musa عليه السّلام from Firaun(فرعون).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Musa(موسى) belongs to us more than he belongs to them.

Musa(موسى) was abeliever, so we are part of him and he is part of us.

Therefore, we should fast on this day.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ started the tradition of fasting on the 10th of Muharram(محرم), which is called Aashooraa(عاشوره).

However, before he passed away ﷺ, he said; If I live until next year, I'm also going to fast the ninth of Muharram(محرم).

So, rather than only fast the 10th, he was going to first the ninth and the 10th to distinguish the Muslims from the Jews, who would only fast the tenth.

Second comment on this document.

This document was establishing the authority of Rasool Allah ﷺ, who just walked in as a guest.

Rasool Allah ﷺ came into Madina, he was invited there.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ was there to be followed.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says that, any messenger that we send, We send them to be obeyed and followed.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was to be followed by the people.

And he was establishing, his authority by the will of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, through various means.

One of them was this covenant.

By the way, the four projects that Rasool Allah ﷺ started with in Madina, I don't know, if I mentioned them before, but the four projects were;

Number one, the Masjid(مسجد) that was number one, the first thing Rasool Allah ﷺ did when he wentinto Madina, was build the Masjid(مسجد).

Number two, establishing the Brotherhood between Al-Muhajireen(المهاجرين) and Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

Number three, this covenant.

Number four, the establishment of the Muslim army.

All of these four were consolidating the foundations of this newly formed Islamic State, and it was consolidating the authority of Rasool Allah ﷺ,

the one sent by Allahعَزّوجَلّ to bring the people out of darkness to light.

So in the document, it says; It says; Any matter in which you disagree, must be referred to Allah Al-Mighty and glorious is He and to Muhammadﷺ,

the only name mentioned in this document of an individual is that of Muhammadﷺ.

Any matter of dispute that occurs between the Jews and the Arabs or the Arabs among themselves.

Any matter of dispute that occurs between a citizen of Madina and an outsider, All of these matter, need to be referred to Allah and the Messenger of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, this is establishing the rule of Allahعَزّوجَلّ in Madina, the governance of the book of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, and the Sunnah(سنة) of Muhammadﷺ.

And this was agreed upon by everyone in Madina, the Muslims and the non Muslims, Arabs or Jews alike.

Third comment, the relationship between the Muslims and the Jews.

It is clear from this covenant that Rasool Allah ﷺ was extending ahand of tolerance towards the People of the Book.

You'd find that this document considers the Jews to be citizens of Madina, citizens of the Islamic State.

They were granted religious freedom and state protection.

They were allowed to worship according to their teachings.

And number two, it was responsibility of the Muslim state to protect them.

They were also required, on the other hand to support the Muslims against any enemy that attacke Madina.

They were also required to give sincere counsel to the Muslim state and never conspire against it, or to withhold information which was important to the security of the Muslim state.

And also they were not allowed to leave from Madina without the permission of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And they had to refer to Muhammadﷺ in any dispute that might arise between the Jews and the Muslims.

So, this is how it started.

This is how therelationship between the Muslims and the Jews started.

However, from there on, it was always downhill.

And the reason is, as we will see through these talks was the response of the Jews to the Muslim presence in Madina.

But from the side of Rasool Allah ﷺ, this is how, he approached it, this is how he, dealt with the Yahood(يهود), in the early days of his immigration to Madina,

he considered them to be citizens of the Islamic State, and he offered them protection and he gave them equal rights.

The fourth comment establishing the sanctity of Madina.

Makkah was considered to be Haram(حرم) by the Arabs, Haram(حرم) is a sanctuary, it was Holy.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ is doing the same with Madina.

It says in the document; The center of Yasrib(يثرب) is a sanctuary for everyone, in this covenant.

And this includes not cutting down trees, they're not allowed to hunt, and they're not allowed to fight within the boundaries of this area or carry weapons.

So, these are a few comments regarding this covenant.

Some of the Sahabah, were held back from Hijrah(هجرة), so they came after Rasool Allah ﷺ, the majority made Hijrah(هجرة) before Rasool Allah ﷺ did,

but some of them were held back such as Sohaib Ar-Roomiرضي الله عنه.

Sohaib(صهيب), when he decided that he's going to leave Makkah, he had some wealth.

Sohaib Ar-Roomi(صهيب الرومي) was imprisoned by the Romans in one of the wars between the Romans and the Arabs, they took him as a prisoner and they enslaved him.

So, he grew up among the Romans and he acquired their language.

So, he had this accent when he would talk Arabic.

And then he was sold from one owner to another, from one slavemaster to the next.

And he ended up in the hands of Abdullah Bin Jada'an(عبدالله بن جدعان).

Abdullah Bin Jada'an(عبدالله بن جدعان) was a wealthy man in Makkah.

And he freed Sohaib(صهيب).

Sohaib(صهيب) was bright and intelligent and active.

So, he started the business and he acquired wealth.

When he wanted to make Hijrah(هجرة), he covered his wealth, dig up hole for it and hide it somewhere and he left.

So, some of the men of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) pursued him.

And they told him, You came to us as a poverty stricken beggar.

With us, you grew wealthy and acquired status.

And now you wantto take yourself and your money away, In the name of Allah, By Allah, we will not allow this to happen.

You came to us broke.

And now you're wealthy, you want to take your wealth and leave us.

So, Sohaib(صهيب) said what if I ransom myself and give you my Wealth, they said then we'll allow you to go.

In another narration, when he saw them following him, he drew out 40 arrows, and he said, I'm gonna stick each one of these, in one of you.

And after I run out of arrows, I'm going to draw out my sword and then you'll know that I am a man.

I have left money in this particular place, you can go and take it and let me go.

And they agreed to let him leave.

This story of Sohaib(صهيب) represents an immigrant, who went into Makkah.

He was an immigrant, who went to Makkah, he was a foreigner, he settled there, he gained status and made money.

But when he wanted to leave for the sake of Allah, they didn't allow him to leave.

Probably Muslims living in the West can take heed, of the story of Sohaibرضي الله عنه.

The Muhajireen(مهاجرين), who moved from Makkah to Madina, They were feeling homesick.

And they wanted to go back to Makkah.

Back it says that Bilal(بلال) used to say; May Allah curse Utba Bin Rabiyah(عتبة بن ربيعة) and Shaibah Bin Rabiyah(شيبة بن ربيعة) and Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف) who have driven us out of Makkah to this land of diseases.

Madina had swampy land and because of this, you had a lot of Allah Ho Alam(الله اعلم) it was malaria or what kind of diseases, but they would catch a fever.

And Madina was famous about this.

People who would go there would catch a fever.

Some scholars today say that it might have been malaria because of the stagnant water that was in these swamps.

So, Ayeshaرضي الله عنها said that my father and Bilal(بلال) and Aamir Bin Fuhairah(عامربن فهيره) catch this fever, So I went to visit them.

So I said, Oh my father, How are you?

And he didn't respond back, He was just reciting lines of poetry.

She went to Bilal(بلال) and said; Bilal(بلال), How are you? Same thing.

So, this is one point that I wanted to add regarding the marriage to Ayeshaرضي الله عنها.

We know from the Sunnah(سنة) that Rasool Allah ﷺ used to race Ayesha(عائشه).

When they would travel, they would run and he would compete with her.

Ayesha(عائشه) said that, when we first got married, I would run faster than him.

But then later on, when I was getting heavier, Rasool Allah ﷺ would win against me and he would say; This is a tit for tat, sort of to say.

You won last time, This time I won.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was very strong, very active, very healthy, Allahعَزّوجَلّ has given him the strength that is needed to perform this most important and most difficult duty of all,

and that is being the messenger of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

The next section, we're going to move into, start talking about the Ghazawaat(غزوات) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, The battles.

But before that, I want to make word or state a few issues regarding the issue of Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) in general.

It is important to comment on this issue specifically because during the 10 years of Madina, Rasool Allah ﷺ has participated himself in 19 battles.

And He has sent out in addition to that, over 55, expeditions in which he wasn't part of.

So, if we add all of these together, we come to over 70 battles within the time span of 10 years.

So, we're talking about an average of seven per year.

So, such a thing that took so much time from Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Sahabah, we need to comment on it.

You know, keep in mind that one battle takes some time to prepare, I mean, it take a few months to finance and mobilize and organize the army and then to send it out

and the time, they spend on traveling and the time they spend coming back.

So, this was a huge burden on the newly formed Islamic State.

So, such a thing that took so much time from Rasool Allah ﷺ and was devoted so much energy.

The question is, why?

How come?

The second reason is, because this issue is becoming so controversial today.

And we hear all of these different opinions thrown back and forth on what Jihad(جهاد) really means and what's intended by it.

What are the objectives of it? What is the wisdom behind it?

So, since we'll be talking about the Ghazawaat(غزوات) of Rasool Allah ﷺ for quite a while, since it dominates the books of Seerah, specially in the Madina era.

We need to make some comments on this issue before that.

So, What does it mean and what's the wisdom behind it?

The word Jihad(جهاد) itself means struggle, it comes from the word Juhud(جهد) which is effort, exerting effort.

So, the linguistic meaning of the word is to exert effort, or to struggle.

This word then later on, carried the specific Islamic meaning.

You know, there are words in the Arabic language that had a linguistic meaning, but then Islam gave a new meaning to those words.

For example, the word Salah(صلاة) in Arabic, originally means supplication, but it carried the new meaning, and that is prayer.

So now, when you say Salah(صلاة), let's go and make Salah(صلاة).

I don't think anybody will ask you, Do you mean the literal meaning of the word?

Or do you mean the linguistic meaning of the word? Or do you mean the Islamic meaning of the word.?

That's it. This word now is a terminology in Islam.

Same thing with Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), it carried the new meaning, and that is to fight the enemies of Allahعَزّوجَلّ,

who object to His religion.

And this is the definition given by the four Madhahib(مذاهب) it is to fight in the path of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So it carried on this new meaning.

And this is what it means, if we mentioned the word unqualified.

Dear brothers and sisters, every war, absolutely every war is an act of injustice, and is evil, with the exception of fighting in the path of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, every war, every bloodshed, is evil.

With this exception, the exception is that the only war that is allowed, is fighting in the path of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And the evidence for that is in Ayah(آية) in Qur'an, in Surat Un Nissah(سورة النساء), Verse 76, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, those who believe fight in the cause of Allah,

and those who disbelieve, fight in the cause of Taghoot(طاغوت) So, Allah is saying that there are two types of war, One war is fought for Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And one war is fight for Taghoot(طاغوت) and the meaning of Taghoot(طاغوت) is false objects of worship.

Or it could mean those transgressors, who asserpt the divine right of govern ship.

So, Allah is saying that the believers are fighting for Allah, And that is a reward able act, and it's an acceptable act.

And those who disbelieve fight in the cause of Taghoot(طاغوت), it doesn't matter what did they state the objective of their fighting is, it is evil, Allah says; it is evil.

Whether it is war of aggression, a war of imperialism, a war of colonialism, a war for one race to dominate another, or one ethnic group to dominate another,

whether it is fought under the pretext of spreading democracy, whether it is fought under the pretext of freeing such and such people from oppression, or dictatorship, It is all evil.

And the only war that is designated as righteous is if it is fought under the banner of, that's all.

So, it's important to state this principle first, because you hear some people say that Islam promotes violence, and Islam promotes holy war and Islam promotes war.

That's not true.

Islam is against all types of war, all types of bloodshed, all types of aggression, except if it's done for the sake of Allah, Who created us, the One, Who has the right to tell us what is right and what is wrong.

You see, Allah created everything.

Therefore, He is the only One, Who has the right to designate, what is right and what is wrong.

What carries preference over others.

For example, the days of the week are seven, they're all equal.

There is no difference between Friday and Saturday and Sunday and other days, from a scientific point of view, they're all the same.

However, Allah has told us that Jum'ah(جمعه) is preferred over the rest of the days of the week.

Since Allahعَزّوجَلّ is the One, Who created these days, he has the right to tell us which one is better.

There's no difference between Ramadhan(رمضان) and the rest of the month of the year in terms of the solar system, or the rotation of the moon or the sun doesn't make Ramadhan(رمضان) any different than any other month,

they're all the same, they're all equal.

However, Allahعَزّوجَلّ has designated Ramadhan(رمضان) to be the most preferred month of the year.

Allah has chosen the first 10 days of Dhul Hijjah(ذوالحجة) to be the best days of the year in terms of the reward of the effort of good deeds done within those first 10 days of Dhul Hijjah(ذوالحجة),

just as he has designated the last 10 nights of Ramadhan(رمضان) to be the most reward able nights of the year.

And then out of those 10 nights, he shows the odd nights to be the best.

And out of the odd nights he chose, Laila Tul-Qadr(ليلة القدر) to be the best night of the year.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ creates everything, and then he chooses out of His creation, what is given a preferable status over the rest.

So, it is something that only Allah has a right to do.

Same thing with war, it is all evil except what Allah designates as good.

So, What's the purpose of Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).?

It is to free the people from servitude to one another, to becoming servants of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, rather than us being servants to a creation, whether that creation is a human being or a rock or an idol, or a celestial body.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ wants us to be servants of Him.

So, that's actually freeing us from servitude to others, who are not divine to being servants of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And it is to bring the people under the blessed rule of Islam, whether they become Muslim or not.

Because we know that there is People are not forced to become Muslim.

However, they have more of a chance of becoming Muslim, if they live under the rule of Islam.

And that's why Rasool Allah ﷺ says in the Hadith(حديث) Allahعَزّوجَلّ is amazed by people, who are dragged into Jannah(جنة) in chains.

One of the scholars, who commented on this Hadith(حديث) said, the meaning of this Hadith(حديث) is that these people are dragged into Islam, even though they don't want it,

and that becomes a reason for them to enter into Jannah(جنة).

People are not interested in hearing about religion in general, you know, people want to hear about how to make money.

If you announced that there's going to be a lecture about Islam, you make this announcement to non Muslims, people are not going to show up.

Or if they do show up, you don't really get a huge response But if you make an announcement that everybody who shows up will get a coupon $50 people are going to flood to the lecture hall.

And there's not going to be enough seats for them.

Why because you're offering them $50.

This is not only with non Muslims, I mean, even with Muslims, people don't show up for Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاة الفجر) you know, the Masjid(مسجد) is packed for Jum'ah(جمعه).

But then for Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاة الفجر) you have a fraction of those let's say 10%.

However, if we make an announcement that anybody who shows up for Fajr(فجر) will get a $20 bill, everybody will come.

The neighbors are going to show up, everybody's going to come people from far away are going to show up.

And they're going to crowd the Masajid(مساجد).

Why because you're offering them $20.

So, people are not interested in hearing about religion and that's why, when Rasool Allah ﷺ first made his announcement in Makkah, that he's a prophet and he gathered the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and He made it seem very urgent and it is urgent.

He was calling Wa Subhaa(واصباحا), and this is the call, this is like dialing 911, it's emergency.

That was how Rasool Allah ﷺ gathered the people and then he told them; I'm warning you a severe punishment from Allah.

What did Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) say, May evil befall you, Is this why you gathered us!

Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) was upset because he closed his shop and came to listen to Muhammadﷺ and he thought that it was something serious, according to him.

And it turned out to be preaching about religion and it was very upset about it.

That's when the Ayaat(آيات) were revealed And then Allah says; What will his wealth do for him.

This wealth which was keeping him away from Islam, which was preventing him from listening to the message, which made him upset because Rasool Allah ﷺ, gathered them.

This wealth, what will it do for him on the Day of Judgment, nothing.

In fact, it will be the reason for his demise.

So, when the Sahabah fought في سبيل الله and brought the people under the rule of Islam, then they were listening.

Now they were listening because the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم were ruling over them.

So, they had some authority, to give the people Da'wah(دعوة) and the people were listening very attentively, because now it's coming from the government.

It's not coming from a preacher, preaching on the corner of the street or in the marketplace, holding a loudspeaker and people are just walking by closing their ears.

Now it's coming from a place of authority, and that's when the people entered into Islam in multi folds.

In the beginning, when Rasool Allah ﷺ was giving Da'wah(دعوة) in Makkah, only a few people were interested.

However, when Rasool Allah ﷺ established the Islamic State.

Now the tribes were listening, other nations were listening, and they were taking it serious.

And that's when people started becoming Muslim in thousands.

Rasool Allah ﷺ for 13 years and Makkah.

How many followers did he have 100, 200, 300.?

However, in Madina, they were growing by the thousands every year.

So, when Fath Makkah(فتح مكه), Rasool Allah ﷺ had an army of 12,000 or 10,000, and in Hajjah Tul Widaa(حجة الوداع) Ninety thousand(90,000).

And when he passed away the ones who prayed Salah Tul Janazah(صلاة الجنازه) on him are over 114,000.

So, you can see how the numbers were growing, because now there was authority.

So, what are the stages that Jihad went through?

Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبن القيم) says in Za'ad Al-Ma'ad(ذاد المعاد) Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبن القيم) says; In the beginning, Jihad(جهاد) was not allowed.

It was prohibited, Muslims were not allowed to fight.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says, Be patient because I'm not given permission to fight.

So, In the beginning it was patients which is called Kaff Ul Yadd(كف اليد).

The second stage,  he said, And then it was allowed, merely allowed.

So, it's just allowed it was not instructed not commanded not obligated, it was allowed.

And that is when Allahعَزّوجَلّ reveal the Ayah This is Surat Ul Hajj(سورة الحج) verse 39 Permission to fight has been given to those, who are being fought because they were wronged.

And indeed Allah is competent to give them victory.

So, here you have permission, was given to them.

Now, the following stage, As Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says is; And then they were commanded to fight the ones, who fight them.

So, this was the third stage.

And the Ayah(آية) for that is 190 Surat Tul Baqarah(سورة البقره), Fight in the way of Allah, those who fight you but do not transgress, indeed Allah does not like the transgressors.

So, here you only fight the ones who transgress against you.

And then the final stage and this was the stage that represents the final law of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, which applies to the Ummah(امة).

And that is, as Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says, And then the Messenger of Allah was instructed to fight all the disbelievers.

And fight against the disbelievers collectively, as they fight against you collectively.

And that is you know, also the Hadith(حديث) which is Mutawatir(متواتر).

which is narrated by Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ), Muslim(مسلم) and others and narrated by over 20 Sahabah(صحابى) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

I was instructed to fight the people until they testify that there is no God but Allah, and that I'm the Messenger of Allah, to establish Salah(صلاة), to pay Zakah(زكاة),

if they do that, they have protected their blood and their wealth and Allah will hold them accountable for their actions or deeds.

So, these are the four stages that Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) went through.

So, What are the objectives of it?

Why was Rasool Allah ﷺ fighting.?

Some Ayaat(آيات) in Qur'an give us the, or tell us the objectives of fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

The first is the promotion of Islam.

That's the first objective, the promotion of Islam.

So, until all the religion is for Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

The second objective, the protection of rituals and worship places, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says: Indeed Allah defends those who have believed indeed Allah does not like everyone treacherous, and ungrateful.

Permission to fight has been given to those who are being fought, because they are wronged, and indeed Allah is competent to give them victory.

They are those who have been evicted from their homes without right, only because they say Our Lord is Allah.

And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, There would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, in which the name of Allah is much mentioned.

And Allah will surely support those who support Him, Indeed Allah is powerful and Exalted in Might.

And they are those, who, if we give them authority in the land, establish prayer, and give Zakah(زكواة) and enjoin, what is right and forbid what is wrong.

And to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters.

So notice here Allahعَزّوجَلّ is saying, and were it not that Allah checks the people, some, by means of others.

There would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques.

People are checked by fighting, this is called Sunnat-Ul-Mudafiah(سنت المدافعة).

This is a law of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, that has governed the lives of men.

If it wasn't for this fighting churches would have been demolished, synagogues would have been demolished, and mosques.

We might have the question, Why? Why mentioned synagogues and churches.?

We're talking about Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) The reason is, we are not the first nation to fight in the path of Allah, The First Nation to fight in the path of Allah were the children of Israel(اسرائيل).

fighting the path of Allah was not prescribed on Sayyedina Saleh(سيدنا صالح) and his people, Sayyedina Hood(سيدنا هود) and his people, Nooh(نوح) and his people.

With those Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), Allahعَزّوجَلّ will destroy their enemy through a miraculous act.

And they didn't have to involve in fighting themselves.

The First Nation to fight in the path of Allah, are the children of Israel(اسرائيل), the followers of Musaعليه السّلام.

So, because of them being an Ummah(امة) of Jihad(جهاد), synagogues were protected, and churches were protected and mosques are protected because the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ are also practicing this act of worship.

The third objective, protecting the world from corruption.

So, rather than fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), being a cause of corruption, it is a protection for the world, it prevents corruption.

See the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah straighten out the misconceptions that we have.

It clears them because Shaytan(شيطان) is causing us to misunderstand reality, he makes us think that good is evil and evil is good.

He has that ability of deceiving.

I mean, that's the whole point of him being the devil is, to deceive people and to make Al-Maroof(معروف) Munkar(منكر), and Munkar(منكر) Maroof(معروف).

So, the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an undo the corruption that has caused in our minds because of the Waswash(وسوسه) of Shaytan(شيطان).

The Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, cleanse our hearts from the corruption that is caused by the media, and by the false authority that exists on Earth.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling us that Jihad(جهاد) Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله), actually limits the corruption that exists on land.

And, if it were not for Allah checking some people by means of others, The Earth would have been corrupted, but Allah is full of bounty to the worlds.

The fourth objective is to test for mankind it's a trial.

Our existence in this world, as we have been mentioning, is a test from Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And fighting in His path is part of that test.

That is the command. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them himself.

But he ordered armed struggle to test some of you by means of others.

So, armed struggle is a test for the believers.

And it's a test for the disbelievers.

It's a test for the believers because it tests their patience, it tests their sacrifice.

The ultimate sacrifice that a believer could give to Allahعَزّوجَلّ is to sacrifice his soul and his wealth.

It's a test of whether you fear Allahعَزّوجَلّ more than the creation, or the you fear the creation more than Allah.

So, it tests a lot of what is called Amaal-Al-Quloob(اعمال القلوب), the deeds of the heart.

We might have a lot of diseases in our hearts.

But these diseases don't show up, until we are involved in this act of worship then these diseases show up.

So for example, many of the Munafiqeen(منافقين) blended very well in the society.

They were only exposed in the Battle of Badr(بدر) and in the Battle of Uhud(اُحَد) and the sequence of battles that followed that.

And that's why Allahعَزّوجَلّ says about them.

Don't they see that, they are being tested every year once or twice, because of the average of the Ghazawaat(غزوات) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, per year where one or two.

So, their hypocrisy was showing up, in these battles because that's the ultimate test.

Number five, to punish and humiliate the enemies of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war,

by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know, but whom Allah knows.

And whatever you spend in the cause of Allah, will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.

This is Surat-Ul-Anfaal(أنفال) Verse 60.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ also says in Surat-Tut-Tobah(سورة التوبة), verse 14 and 15 Fight them, Allah will punish them, by your hands and disgrace them and give you victory over them

and satisfy the breasts of believing people and remove the fury in their hearts and Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills, and Allah is knowing and Wise.

And Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Surat-Tul-Anfal(سورة الأنفال) verse 17 and 18, that is so and also that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

So, fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

The beginning of the Ayah(آية) says; and you did not kill them but it was Allah, who kill them.

And you threw not or Muhammad(محمد) when you threw, but it was Allah who threw, that He might test the believers with a good test.

Indeed Allah is hearing and knowing, that is so, and also that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

The sixth objective is the exposing of the hypocrites and we talked about this a bit.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; Allah would not leave the believers in that state you are in presently, until he separates the evil from the good.

So, the way the separation happens is by fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) these Ayaat(آيات) were revealed after Ghawat-Uhud(غزواة احد)

because Abdullah Bin Ubaye(عبدالله بن ابئ), withdrew with one third of the army.

This is verse 179, in Surat-Al-Imran(سورة العمران).

The seventh objective, it is a defense against the aggression of the enemies of Allah, who planned to transgress against the Ummah(أمة).

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; So, fight O Muhammad(محمد) in the cause of Allah, you're not held responsible except for yourself, and encourage the believers to join you,

that perhaps Allah will restrain the military might of those who disbelieve.

And Allah is greater in Might and stronger in punishment.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ did not say that Da'wah(دعوة) will restrain the military might of those, who disbelieve.

He didn't say that involving in dialogue or discourse will weaken the military might of those who disbelieve.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ said that the way to weaken the military might of those who disbelieve is to fight.

parts.arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَامحمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَّ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي۝وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي۝وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِيْ ۝يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِيِ۝

اُمَّهْ وَاحِدَّةْ دُوْنَ النَّاس أمة واحدة دون الناس, صَلُّوْ بِالْخِفَافِ فَاِنَّ الْيَهُوْدَ لَا يُصَلُّوْنَ بِالْخِفَافْ اُصْبُغوْا الشَيْب بالْحِنَّا

نَحْنُ اَوْلَآ بِمُوْسَى مِنْهُمْ لئن عشت إلى قابل لأصومن التاسع وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاِنَّكُمْ مَااخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيْهِ مِنْ شَئٍ فَاِنَّ مَرَدَّه’ اِلَى اللهِ ، وَاِلَى محمد

اَللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إلَيْنَا الْمَدِيْنَّهْ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَهْ اَوْ اَشَدْ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ مُدِّنَا وَصاعِّنَا وانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا إلى الجُحْفَةِ

جِبْرِيْلْ اَخْبَرَنِيْ بِهَا آنِفًا Allahعَزّوجَلّ says لَيْسُوا سَوَاءً ۗ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ

يَتْلُونَ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ۝

يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَيُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ

وَأُولَٰئِكَ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ۝

وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ يُكْفَرُوهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِينَ۝

سَيَقُولُ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَا وَلَّاهُمْ عَنْ قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا ۚ قُلْ لِلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ ۚ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ۝

وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا ۗ

وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الْقِبْلَةَ الَّتِي كُنْتَ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَنْ يَتَّبِعُ الرَّسُولَ مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ ۚ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِينَ هَدَى اللَّهُ ۗ

وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ۝

قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ۖ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَاهَا ۚ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُمْ فَوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُ ۗ

وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ۝

وَلَئِنْ أَتَيْتَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ بِكُلِّ آيَةٍ مَا تَبِعُوا قِبْلَتَكَ ۚ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَتَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا بَعْضُهُمْ بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَةَ بَعْضٍ ۚ

وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۙ إِنَّكَ إِذًا لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ۖ الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْرِفُونَهُ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِنْهُمْ لَيَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ۝

الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ۝

وَلِكُلٍّ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَا ۖ فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْرَاتِ ۚ أَيْنَ مَا تَكُونُوا يَأْتِ بِكُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ۝

وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۖ وَإِنَّهُ لَلْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۗ وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ۝

وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُمْ فَوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ حُجَّةٌ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ

فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَاخْشَوْنِي وَلِأُتِمَّ نِعْمَتِي عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ۝

هَذَا سُوْقُكُمْ فَلَاِ ينتقصن وَلَا يُضْرَبَنَّ عَلَيْهِ خَرَاجْ وَلَا يُضْرَبَنَّ عَلَيْهِ خَرَاجْ اِنَّ الله هوَ الْمُسَعرْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ۝

لَوْ اَخَذْتُّ هَذَالْفَتَى لَاكلْتُ بِه الْعَرَبْ لَاكلْتُ بِهِ الْعَرَبْ وَكَانَ اَبُو بَكْرشَيْخٌ يُعْرَفْ وَكَانَ رَسُوْلْ صَلَى الله عَلَيْه وَسَلم شَابُ لَّا يُعْرَفْ

هَذِهِ بِتِلْكَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ الطَّاغُوتِ لا اله الا الله

يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ عَجِبَ رَبُّنَا مِنْ قَوْمٍ يَقْتَادُوْنَ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ فِى السلاسلْ اِنِّيْ نَذِيْرٌلَّكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمَ

تَبَّ لَّكَ اَلِهَذَا جَمَعْتَنَا تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ۝

مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ۝

وَكَانَ الجِهَادُ مُحَرَّمًا، ثُمَّ مَأذُوْنًا بِهْ، ثُمَّ مَأْمُوْرًا بِهْ لِمَنْ بَدَأَهُمْ بِالقِتَالٍ، ثُمَّ مَأْمُوْرًا بِهِ لِجَمِيْعِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ

اِصْبِرُوْ فَاِنِّيْ لَمْ اُؤمَرْ بِقِتَالْ ثُمَّ مَأذُوْنًا بِهْ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ۝

ثُمَّ مَأْمُوْرًا بِهْ لِمَنْ بَدَأَهُمْ بِقِتَالٍ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوا ۚ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ۝

ثُمَّ مَأْمُوْرًا بِهِ لِجَمِيْعِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَقَاتِلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ كَافَّةً كَمَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ كَافَّةً ۚ

أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوْا أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله وَأَنَّ مُحَمدًا رَّسُوْلَ الله، وَيُقِيْمُوا الصَّلَاةَ، وَيُؤتُوا الزَّكَاةَ، فَإِنْ فَعَلُوْا ذَلِكَ عَصَمُوْا مِنِّيْ دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ

اِلَّابِحَقِّهَا وَحِسَابَهُمْ عَلَى الله Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ ۚ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَفَسَدَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَ بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ ۗ أَوَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ يُفْتَنُونَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ

وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَآخَرِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ۝

قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ َ وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ

وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

فَقَاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَا تُكَلَّفُ إِلَّا نَفْسَكَ ۚ وَحَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكُفَّ بَأْسَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ

وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأْسًا وَأَشَدُّ تَنْكِيلًا۝

وَصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًاَ
