parts.english:
So now, covered Baiyah Tul Aqabal Al-Uolaa(بيعة العقبه الأولى) The first Pledge of Allegiance of Al-Aqabah(العقبه), which were, the terms of it would called the Pledge of Allegiance of the women.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير), has done a outstanding work in spreading the message and by the time the next Hajj(حَجْ) season arrived, the narrator of the Hadith(حديث) says

there was no house in Madina that didn't have a Muslim in it.

Look at the effort of Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير).

So now the appointment to meet Rasool Allah ﷺ, in pilgrimage was approaching.

So, over 70 of the Muslims went with the pilgrims of their people.

So, the delegation that came out of Madina included Muslims and non Muslims.

And the Muslims had a secret appointment with Muhammadﷺ, but they went out with the group that was leaving from Madina.

So there are over 70 men who are Muslim and two women.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), he narrates the following story.

He says; We were among the pilgrims of our people, some were Muslim and some were non Muslim.

And our leader and elder was Al-Baraa Bin Ma'rur(ألبرآء بن معرور) He was the leader among the Muslims.

Ka'ab Ibn Malikرضي الله عنه said; that Al-Baraa Bin Ma'rur(ألبرآء بن معرور) came to us, in a group of the Muslims.

And he said: I have an idea and I want to get your opinion, I don't feel comfortable turning my back towards this building in prayer.

He was referring to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

What was the Qibla(قبله) of the Muslims at the time?

Praying to Al-Aksaa(اَلْاَقْصَى) Jerusalem.

So, the people who are in Madina, they are facing Jerusalem, while their backs are towards Makkah.

So, Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) is saying, I don't feel comfortable doing that.

And I wanted to seek your advice on whether I should pray towards Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said, we responded by saying, Rasool Allah ﷺ is praying towards Jerusalem and we don't want to contradict him.

Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) said: I am gonna pray towards Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

And from that day on, he started pray towards Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

Now the delegation made it to Makkah, Al-Baraa Bin Maroor رضي الله عنه, he said to Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), he said; My nephew let's go off to the Messenger of Allah and asked him about what I've been doing on this journey,

the disapproval I have seen in you has somewhat disturbed me.

Let's go to Rasool Allah ﷺ, if what I did was right a wrong?

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: We asked the man from Makkah, where is Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, the man said: Do you know him?

Have you seen him before?

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: No, we don't know him.

The man responded by saying; Do you know Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب), his uncle.

They said: Yes, we used to see him, in Madina on business trips.

Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) used to frequent Madina, doing business, so they knew him.

The man said: Muhammadﷺ is the man sitting next to Al-Abbas(العباس) in the mosque, you will find him there.

So, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: I went with my uncle Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور).

We went into the Mosque, and we found Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب), and we came and greeted them.

Muhammadﷺ said: O, Uncle, Abul Fazl(أبوالفضل), Do you know who these two men are?

The elder son of Al-Abbas(العباس), his name is Al-Fazl(الفضل).

And it was a tradition of the Arabs to give a name to the Father, the father of so and so, the eldest son.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Abul Fazl(ابوالفضل), Do you know, these two men?

Al-Abbas(العباس) said: Yes.

This is Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(البراء بن معرور), the leader of his people, and this is Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: I swear by Allah, I will never forget the next statement that Rasool Allah ﷺ made, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Do you mean, the poet.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was a poet.

So, when Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) introduced Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) to Muhammadﷺ and said, this is Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Is he the poet?

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says, I can never forget that statement in my whole life.

Why was it such a big deal to Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).?

Because it shows that Rasool Allah ﷺ has heard of him.

And Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was so proud and happy that Rasool Allah ﷺ, his leader, the man who, he meets him for the first time and has been waiting for this moment to meet him,

has heard of him, he might have even heard some of his works.

So, he was so proud and happy that Rasool Allah ﷺ has already heard of him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Is he, the poet?

Al-Abbas said: Yes.

Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) said; O Messenger of Allah, I have come on this journey having been given guidance to Islam by Allah, I had the idea of not facing my back to this building.

So, I prayed towards it, my friends opposed me in this, causing me concern.

What do you think?

Muhammadﷺ said: You already had a Qibla(قبله), a direction for prayer, and you should have kept it.

You should have remained praying to the Qibla(قبله), that you know.

Since then, Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) changed the direction.

Now with Rasool Allah ﷺ at that time, Rasool Allah ﷺ because he was in Makkah.

He wasn't turning his back towards Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

He was facing Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) but in the direction of Jerusalem.

But the people of Madina, Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) didn't like that and Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) when Rasool Allah ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة),

Rasool Allah ﷺ was feeling the same feeling.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said; We then left to the pilgrimage having made an agreement to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه),

in the middle of the Tashreeq(تشريق) period, so they made an appointment to meet at a specific time.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says; We kept this as a secret, none of our people knew about it all of the non Muslims in our group, knew nothing about our meeting with Rasool Allah ﷺ,

it was secret.

Except Abu Jabir(ابوجابر), Abdullah Bin Haraam(عبدالله بن حرام), he was one of our leaders and seniors, we went up to him and we told him; Abu Jabir(ابوجابر), you are one of our noble leaders,

and we would like you to give up your practices, otherwise one day you would end up as fuel for hellfire.

Abu Jabir(ابوجابر) did accept Islam.

So, they told him about the private meeting, and he was one of the people who attended with them.

In fact, he became one of the leaders that were appointed by Rasool Allah ﷺ within this group.

It was the time for the appointment, it was late at night.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: We were going towards Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه) in ones or two's.

They didn't want to attract the attention of the people, if you have a group of 70 going to meet Rasool Allah ﷺ, it would turn the attention of others.

So, they were going in ones and twos, until they all gathered in Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه).

And they were all there, and then Rasool Allah ﷺ showed up.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was the only Muslim from Makkah to show up at that meeting, and he had one person with him and that was the only non Muslim to attend the meeting,

and who was that person?

Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب), the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) was the first person to speak.

He said; Muhammad(محمد) holds with us a position of which you are aware.

We protect him from our people, who think about him as we do.

He's respected among his people and safe in his own town.

But he is determined to join up with you.

If you think you will keep trust with him, in the invitation you have given to him, and will protect him from his opponents, then it's up to you to accept your responsibilities.

But if you think he might deliver him over, and abandon him, after he has joined you, then leave him right now.

He does have respect and protection among his own people and in his town.

Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب), wanted to make sure that this is a commitment from the side of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), Al-Abbas(العباس) is saying that we are going to take care of Muhammadﷺ, we are protecting him.

However, he is insisting on leaving us.

Now are you going to protect him when he leaves to you or not?

How come Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) was there?

I mean, why was he present even though he was a non Muslim?

What is the reason he was there.?

Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) was the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ, and even though he was a non Muslim, but he was one of the senior members of the clan of Bannu Hashim(بنو هاشم).

And even though he was a non Muslim, but he was taking special interest in following and monitoring the activities of Rasool Allah ﷺ, and he was one of the people, who were offering Rasool Allah ﷺ protection in Makkah,

after Abu Talib(ابوطالب) passed away.

And he wanted to make sure that his nephew will be safe when he leaves Makkah.

And that's why Rasool Allah ﷺ allowed him and included him, in this meeting, because even though he was a non Muslim, but this is again, an issue that relates to the tribe of Bannu Hashim(بنوهاشم).

Muhammadﷺ remains as a member of this clan, and his clan have interest in his safety and security.

So, Al-Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) attended as a representative of Bannu Hashim(بنوهاشم), to make sure that their son is well protected.

Now, you might say, well, if Al-Abbas(العباس) was offering protection, how come it's different than the time of Abu Talib(ابو طالب)?

Well, the difference is that Abu Talib(ابو طالب) had respect and power and authority over his people that none of his brothers had.

So, the ability of Al-bbas Bin Abdul Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) to defend Muhammadﷺ was obviously less than the ability of Abu Talib(ابوطالب)

because of the seniority of Abu Talib(ابوطالب), Al-Abbas(العباس) was young.

Nevertheless, they still managed to protect him for that period and they viewed it as responsibility on them.

When Al-Abbas(العباس) finished his statement.

Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) said: We have heard, what you have to say, Now, O Messenger of Allah, ask us what you want?

Go ahead and speak to us about what you want from us and take for yourself and for your Lord, whatever you want.

Rasool Allah ﷺ stood up and said; I ask you to pledge that you will defend me, as you do, your women and children.

So now, this is an upgrade, a step higher than the earlier agreement in Baiyah Tul Aqabal Al-Uolaa(بيعة العقبه الأولى), over there it is for becoming Muslim,

so they pledge allegiance on becoming Muslim.

But now there's an additional term that was added to the contract, and that is offering Muhammadﷺ with protection, and it's a defensive protection.

He also told them, in a different narration, you must pledge to hear and obey at times of both action and inaction, to give whether times are hard or easy, and to advocate goodness and prohibit evil,

you must speak out for Allah and not feel any blame for supporting Allah.

You must help and defend me, if I come to you.

In the same way you helped and defend yourselves, your wives and your children.

You notice here the clarity, in the message of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

I'm not coming to you, just for you to protect me, but I'm to be your leader.

You listen to me, and you obey me.

And then he said, and you fear no one, but Allah, I cannot make this move, if you have any fear in your hearts.

You have to be willing to commit yourselves for this mission.

Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور), he stood up and wanted to give Rasool Allah ﷺ Baiyah(بيعة) and he said; O messenger of Allah, I swear it, we are warriors from father to son over many generations.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I wanted to protect me like you protect your women and children, Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) said: O Messenger of Allah, we are warriors, we have inherited this, from generation to generation.

And this is another thing Allah prepared Al-Aos wal Khazraj(الاوس والخزرج) with, that they were fighters, they were strong, and they had this reputation in Arabia.

And while Al-Baraa Bin Maroor(إلبراء بن معرور) was speaking Abul Haitham(أبو الهيثم), stood up, and he interrupted, and he said, O Messenger of Allah, we have certain ties to others, referring to the Jews,

and if we break these, we are concerned that if God gives you victory, you might return to your people and abandon us.

Abul Haitham(أبولهيثم), is saying that this commitment means that we will have to, we might get into conflict with people whom we have agreements with.

So now, if in case you win, are you going to stay with us, or you going to leave us, see we are willing to enter into this agreement for our whole life.

But are you going to stay with us or are you going to leave us.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ responded after smiling.

He said; "If your blood be sought, our blood shall be sought and your destruction is mine as well.

I am of you and you are of me, I will battle those, who battle you and make peace with those, with whom you make peace." And Rasool Allah ﷺ kept to his agreement.

When Makkah was opened, the hometown of Rasool Allah ﷺ he left it and he went back with the people of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) to Madina, And he remained there until he died.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, stayed with the people of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), until the last moment.

In another narration, there is another interruption, when the Ansaar(أنْصَار) started extending their hands to pledge allegiance to Rasool Allah ﷺ,

As'ad Bin Zurarah(اسعدبن زرارة), the early Muslim among them, stood up and interrupted and said; Slowly now, he's telling his people take it easy, slow down

We only hurried here because we know that he is the Messenger of Allah, bringing him out now, however, would be provocation to all the Arabs

and would cause you to lose your elite and would box you in, with swords raised against you.

If you are able to withstand that, then adopt him, and it will be up to Allah to reward you.

But if you are people who have great fear for yourselves, then leave him and make that fact plain, that coarse would be more forgivable in Allah's sight.

He said: Do you realize what agreement we're entering in, If we take Rasool Allah ﷺ with us, that means that we are going against the whole world

and will be boxed in, with swords surrounding us, we might lose our elites, we might spend our money, we might be killed.

Now we either stand up and commit.

Otherwise, if you have any fear, in your hearts pull out now, when it's not too late.

They pushed As'ad Bin Zararah(أسعد بن زراره) away and said; We will give Pledge of Allegiance.

They said, keep away from us.

We won't renegade on this pledge, we will never deny it.

Allah-Ho-Akbar(الله اكبر) look at the commitment of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) and the courage that they had.

Now, when Rasool Allah ﷺ asked them, to protect him, they said; What will we get in exchange.

We are going to offer you protection even if we lose our lives and our wealth.

What are you going to give us, this is not a one sided agreement.

We are offering you help, what will you give us in exchange.?

What did Rasool Allah ﷺ say; He responded by telling them one word, Al-Jannah(ألجنة), Paradise, nothing else.

I'm not gonna give you kingdom.

I'm not promising you wealth.

I'm not going to give you a few cabinet seats or ministries in my government.

I'm not going to promise you a succession after me.

All what I can promise you is Jannah(ألجنة).

And what was their response, They said; This is such a profitable deal, we will never give up.

They said: what is better than Jannah(ألجنة).

Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) compare this with Bayhara Bin Faraas(بيحره بن فراس).

He said: I'm going to take this young man and eat the Arabs with him.

And then he told Rasool Allah ﷺ; If Allah gives you victory. Will you then transfer power to us.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; No, it's up to Allah.

He said: We don't want to have anything with you.

Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) said, That is the best deal, Jannah(جنة).

Somehow the news reached to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), you know it's not easy to conceal a meeting of 70 plus people, in the crowd of Al-Hajj(حَجْ).

In one narration it states that it was Shaytan(شَيْطَانْ), who announced it to the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

But regardless of how it happened.

The news reached to the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they investigated the matter further and they found out, it led them to the right direction,

it led them to Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

So, next day early in the morning, a group of leaders from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) went and visited the campgrounds of Al-Aos wal Khazraj(الاوس والخزرج).

They went to them and said: We have heard that you have met with Muhammadﷺ, and that you have offered to take him with you and give him protection.

Now, listen people of Yasrib(يثرب), you are the last people on the face of the earth, whom we want to have a fight with.

Because Quraish(قريش) knew that Al-Aos wal Khazraj(الاوس والخزرج) were not an easy opponent.

These are fighters, truly as it was said: We have inherited the skills of war, generation through generation.

So, the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were saying; We don't want to have a fight with you.

So, what have you done.

Did you really meet with Muhammadﷺ?

The Muslims, among them, among the Al-Aos wal Khazraj(الاوس والخزرج) remained silent, and the non believers started speaking, they said; that never happened.

We never met with Muhammadﷺ and they were speaking the truth.

They had no idea of this secret meeting that happened.

Because only the Muslims knew about it and they kept on refuting that and said we never met with Muhammadﷺ, we had nothing to do with him, we wouldn't see him.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: We the Muslims were staring at each other silently and we didn't speak.

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were becoming convinced.

Now, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said that I wanted to change the topic, I wanted to change the subject.

So, there was Al-Haris Bin Hishaam(ألحارث بن هشام), one of the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), who was present.

He was wearing some new sandals, brand new.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said; I told Abu Jabir(ابوجابر), who's one of our seniors I told him: O Abu Jabir(ابوجابر), being one of our leaders, you can't even afford to wear new sandals like this young man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

I mean, what's wrong with you, you're one of our leaders and you wearing this old shoes, while this young man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) is wearing these brand new sandals.

Now this young man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) was quite upset by that statement, I mean, what are you talking about my shoes, so impressed with my shoes.

So, he took them off and threw them to Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

Abu Jabir(ابوجابر) said; Take it easy Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), you have made the young man angry, give him back his sandals.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said; No, I will not give them back to him.

This is a good omen to me, I will take his booty in war.

This is a good omen, I'm gonna take off from him, spoils of war.

And that was the end of the meeting.

This meeting between Rasool Allah ﷺ and Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار), we can fairly say that it is the most important meeting that Rasool Allah ﷺ had so far.

It was a turning point in Islam.

Finally now, Rasool Allah ﷺ has a solid base to start spreading the message from, with protection, and freedom to go out and propagate the message of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

This is Baiyah Tul Aqabah As-Thania(بيعة العقبه الثانيه).

Few lessons, and we'll close, Number one, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), He states that when we left Madina, He said; We have already learned our prayers and understood our religion.

This happened before Rasool Allah ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة).

So, for those brothers and sisters who are delaying their learning.

Until somehow they can travel overseas and go and study with the Shuyukh(شيوخ), or get admission to an Islamic college.

You're just finding excuses for yourself.

You need to study and learn now.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) said: We already learned our prayers and we understood our religion, even though Rasool Allah ﷺ was not there yet.

It's true that, they had a teacher with them Mus'ab Bin Umair(مصعب بن عمير), but this statement has a message in it, that we're ready, we're learning.

Don't put off your learnings study Islam, spend time to learn the religion of Allah.

Try to get the best out of the situation.

If you have a Shaikh(شيخ) to teach you, that's the best, don't have a Shaikh(شيخ), find somebody who's more learned than you, can't find that, take a book and study.

But don't give it up, don't put it off, because you might never get the time, when you're free to do it.

And procrastination is not an excuse, on the day of judgment, Ibn Qayyim(ابن قيم) says; when you go through the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an you'll find that the majority of the screaming of the people of Hellfire in Qur'an,

is because of their procrastination, because they delayed.

They say in Qur'an, the verses the narrate their sayings: O Allah take us back to this world, so that we can believe, O Allah take us back to this world, so that we can give.

O Allah take us back, it's too late.

So, don't put it off.

Number two, When Rasool Allah ﷺ asked the Ansaar(أنصار), his terms of the agreement.

And they said, what will we get back.

What are we getting in an exchange.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told them: Jannah(جنة).

Dear brothers and sisters, in our Islamic work, we should be working for the sake of Jannah(جنة), to please Allahعَزّوجَلّ .

That should be our objective, not to get fame, not to make money, not for the socializing aspect of it.

We should purify our intentions every time consistently, and make sure that we're doing everything for the sake of Allah.

This religion needs sacrifice and if you're waiting for an exchange, if you're waiting for a payback in this world, you might not get it.

This is a religion that demands you to give it everything.

Because you are getting in an exchange Jannah(جنة), which is more valuable than anything that you could give.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says; What Allah is offering you is very expensive, what Allah is offering you is, Jannah(جنة).

We need to pay the price.

Number three, Rasool Allah ﷺ was very clear in what he's asking others in conveying the message.

Rasool Allah ﷺ made it very clear to the Ansaar(أنصار), that what you are getting into is risky, what you're getting into is a struggle.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not promise them wealth, did not promise them power, Rasool Allah ﷺ told them that you need to protect me, you might be attacked.

So, we need to prepare ourselves as Muslims and realized that this is not an easy walk, it's not a walk in the park.

To establish the religion of Allah, it's a struggle and it demands a lot of sacrifice.

And we need to prepare ourselves for that.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; Roughen up, because bounties might not continue forever.

Easy life might not go on for good.

So, we need to be prepared and ready.

Number four, after the second pledge of Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه) remember again, Rasool Allah ﷺ met with 70 plus.

And there were some others maybe that were Muslim, who didn't come.

Rasool Allah ﷺ immediately, after taking the pledge of allegiance, asked them to appoint 12 Nuqabaa(نقبآء), twelve leaders.

So, he divided them into smaller groups and appointed on them leaders.

So, this shows you that this is an organized religion.

And now since there's a group living away from the organization structure of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Rasool Ullah wanted them to have their own organizational structure.

So, immediately divided the 70 into groups and appointed 12 leaders among them, and these are the Nuqabaa(نقبآء), who will report back to Rasool Allah ﷺ, and who, he will give them instructions.

So, this is also another lesson to learn that we need to be organized in a manageable fashion.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I was shown the land of your Hijrah(هجره), it is a land with a lot of palm trees between two rocky tracks, Al-Harrah(ألحرة) is a rocky volcanic track.

So, that was the beginning of the Hijrah(هجرة) towards Al-Madina.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in another Hadith(حديث).

By the way, the Hadith(حديث) that I just mentioned is in Masnad Imam Ahmad (مسند امام احمد).

There's a Hadith(حديث) in Bukhari(بخاريْ), Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says, I have seen in my dream that I am migrating from Makkah to a land rich with palm trees.

I initially thought that it is Yamamah(يمامه) or Hajar(حجر).

But then it turned out to be Yasrib(يثرب), Yasrib(يثرب) is the old name of Madina, which was changed by Rasool Allah ﷺ and Rasool Allah ﷺ banned, the use of the name Yasrib(يثرب).

In fact, Rasool Allah ﷺ says if anybody says Yasrib(يثرب), they should make Istaghfar(إستغفار).

Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to change the identity of this city, Yasrib(يثرب) had a history of rivalry and warfare Rasool Allah ﷺ now is giving it a new identity, it is Madina(مدينه) Madina-Tu-Rasool Allah(مدينةالرسول الله).

What does Madina(مدينه) mean?

It is the town of Rasool Allahﷺ.

Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه), narrates this Hadith(حديث).

She says, we came back from Al-Habashah(الحبشه) and my husband wanted to go, again to Al-Habashah(الحبشه) but then he heard that Madina(مدينه) is a new land of Hijrah(هجرة), and that there's some Muslims there.

So, he decided to take his family and go to Madina.

And that was one year before Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه).

So, he was one of the earliest to go.

So, she said that he mounted me on a camel and he placed my son on my lap and we were ready to leave Makkah.

But my family came to me and said, we're not going to allow you to go with your husband.

We're not going to allow him, to take you with him to that foreign land.

So, they pulled me away, from my husband.

When Bannu Al-Asad(بنو ألأسد) the family of Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) saw that they came in and said, well we're not going to allow you to take the child, so they took the child with them.

So now, you have Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) is separated from Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه) and they're both separated from their son.

The family of Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه) took Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه), the family of Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) took Salamah(سلمه), the child, and now the three were separated.

So, Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه) ended up making Hijrah(هجرة) alone.

While Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه) and Salamah(سلمه), were separated in Makkah.

Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه) said; I would go out of my home every day to the valley and sit on a rock and cry, for hours.

And I would do that on a daily basis.

And that continued for about a year.

Imagine this woman, mother missing her husband, missing her child.

She said: I would go out every day in the morning and just cry.

So, then one of Bannu Mugheera(بنومغيرة), my relatives saw the condition I'm in and said to my family.

This was her uncle, he said to my family, he said, "Aren't you having any mercy and sympathy on this woman, allow her to go and join her husband."

So, they finally agreed and they told Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه), you are free to leave.

When the family of the husband knew that, they gave her, her son and they said now you can join your husband.

So, Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه) picked up her child, Salamah(سلمه) and she went to Madina.

Now she was alone had no one with her.

She mounted on a camel with her son and left towards Madina, traveling alone.

When she reached to At-Tanaeem(تنعيم), which is not far away from Makkah, few kilometers outside of Makkah.

She met with Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه), when he saw her, he said, daughter of Abu Umayyah(ابواميه).

Where are you heading?

She says I'm going to Madina.

He told her, Are you having anybody accompany you?

She said: No, I'm alone.

He said, Well, I would accompany you, it's not appropriate to leave you alone in this travel.

Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه) was a Mushrik(مشرك), he was a non believer.

But he saw this woman, felt sympathy for her and wanted to help her out.

And he was guarding her and protecting her on this journey from between Makkah and Madina.

Ummo Salamahرضي الله عنها , she says, and I swear, I was never in the company of any Arab more honorable than him.

When we made the stop, he would make my camel kneel.

And then he would move away, until I would have dismounted.

And then he would come back and take the camel and tie it.

And then he would leave and go and sleep, under a tree far away from me.

Next day in the morning, he would bring my camel prepare the saddle.

And then he would call me to come and mount and he would leave.

And when I'm on the camel, he would come back, and then he would guide me through this trip.

And she said, he continued doing that until, we reach to the outskirts of Madina.

And we saw Qubaa(قباء) in the distance, he pointed to Qubaa(قباء) and said, See that village over there that's where your husband is.

And he said: Now you're on your own.

Ummo Salamah(امّ سلمه), comments and says, I know of no other family in Islam who suffered like that of Abu Salamah(ابوسلمه).

And I swear I never had a more honorable companion than Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه), she was impressed, she says that Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه) had so much nobility

because keep in mind the animosity between Muslims and non Muslims.

For so far, Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه) to go out of his way and to accompany a woman who's leaving Makkah and that's supposed to be a no-no, you're not supposed to leave Makkah to Madina.

And he went out of his way and supported her and helped her in this honorable fashion.

She liked that, and she appreciated it.

Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه), would later on become Muslim.

After his most of the prominent members of his family were killed in the Battle of Uhud(أحد).

But later on, he did become Muslim, he and Khalid Ibn Walid(خالد ابن وليد) and Amr Bin Al-Aas(عَمْرُو بِن اَلْعَاص) in the same time.

Also Uthman Bin Talha(عثمان بن طلحه) is from the family, which were the keepers of the keys to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and Rasool Allah ﷺ kept the keys with them and the keys are still with them today.

The family of Bannu Abd Ad-Daar(بنو عبد ادار), they are the ones who hold the keys to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), until this day and time.

The next story is the story of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه says, when we decided to make Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina.

I agreed with Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) and Hisham Bin Aas(هشام بن العاص) to be company and to go together to Madina.

We set an appointed time to meet at Saraf(سرف), this is an area outside of Makkah.

We said, if morning comes and any of us is missing that means the person is detained and we should just go ahead and migrate.

Morning came and Hisham Bin Aas(هشام بن العاص) did not show up.

So, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمرابن الخطاب) and Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن ربيعه) were on their own.

They reached to Madina and this was before the Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Ullah was the last one to migrate.

They reached to Madina.

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) was the half brother of Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه), so Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) and his brother Al-Haris Bin Hisham(الحارث بن هشام) went all the way to Madina

to bring back Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) they went to Al-Madina and they told Ayyash(عياش), your mother has made an oath that she will not comb her hair and she will not take shadow, until you come back.

So, she will remain in the heat under the sun of Makkah and she will not comb her hair, until you come back.

The exact statement was, "your mother has warned that she will not allow, a comb to touch her hair, until she sees you, nor will she shelter from the sun.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was listening.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) told Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) these people want to deceive you.

They want to entice you and take you back, it's a trick.

And regarding the oath of your mother, when her hair is filled with lice, she will comb and when she feels a severe heat of Makkah she will take shelter.

So, forget about it and don't go with them.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he says; I'm not a man who tricks others.

Neither do, I allow anybody to trick me.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) told Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) don't go with them.

Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) he was now feeling sorry for his mother and Umar(عُمَر) wasn't able to convince him.

Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) decided that he's gonna go with them.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), told him well, if you insist, then at least take this camel of mine with you.

This is a fast and strong camel.

If you ever feel suspicious, run away.

So, Ayyash Bin Rabiyah(عياش بن ربيعه), Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) and Al-Haris Bin Hisham(الحارث بن هشام) are now on their way back to Makkah.

Everyone has their own camel.

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) started complaining about his camel.

What a horrible camel, it's too difficult, slow.

And then he told Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه).

Can you please switch camels just for a while.

I mean, this camel of mine is causing me trouble.

Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه), beings a nice man, he is, agreed.

So, they now stopped the camels and they had the camels kneel down.

As soon as the camel of Ayyash(عياش) reached the ground, both men attacked him and tied him up.

And they dragged him into Makkah and they enticed him and he apostated.

And the same thing has happened to Hisham Ibn Al-Aas(هشام إبن ألعآص), the third partner who was detained in Makkah.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; We used to say among ourselves, the Muslims, that whoever stayed behind and foot in and was enticed by the non believers, Allahسبحانه وتعالى will never forgive them.

That was the understanding we had.

And Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said and that was also the understanding going around among, the ones who stay behind.

They felt that they have lost hope, that's it.

You have apostated, there is no way Allah can forgive your sins.

And that was their common understanding for a while.

Until Rasool Allah ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina and received the revelation.

Say, O My servants who have harmed themselves, do not despair of God's mercy.

Allah will forgive all sins.

He is the all forgiving, the All Merciful.

Turn back to your Lord and submit to Him before punishment reaches you.

Then you shall not be helped, follow the best that has been revealed to you from your Lord, before punishment comes suddenly to you.

And you are caught unaware.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) wrote this verse and he sent it to Hisham Ibn Al-Aas(هشام إبن ألعآص), Hisham Ibn Al-Aas(هشام إبن ألعآص) was the one, who was detained in Makkah.

Hisham Ibn Al-Aas(هشام إبن ألعآص) said: I received that verse, and I would go up to Tuwaa(طوى) and I would read it, and reread it and I would read it again and again and again,

for a few days I would go out in this area and just keep on reading that verse trying to understand, why Umar(عُمَر) sent it to me? What is the meaning of this verse.?

Until I understood that this verse was revealed talking about us and say that no matter, what you do Allah can still forgive you.

If you seek forgiveness, no matter what happened.

Even if you stayed behind, even if you were enticed by the non believers, you still have a chance you shouldn't give up.

Hisham Ibn Al-Aas(هشام إبن ألعآص) said; I asked Allah for forgiveness, mounted my camel and went towards Al-Madina.

Two lessons to learn from this.

Number one, the forgiveness of Allah, Allah is all forgiving, no matter what you do, never give up.

Ask Allah to forgive you.

The greatest sin which is Shirk(شرك) if a person repents from it, and goes back to Allah, Allah will forgive it.

But one needs to ask Allah for forgiveness before the punishment comes because Allah سبحانه وتعالى says, turn back to your Lord and submit to Him before punishment reaches you.

You need to do it before, it's too late.

Second lesson, Beware of the non believers beware, be careful.

Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه) trusted Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

How can you trust such a person?

Don't let the sweet words and the nice talk of the enemies of Allah sway you.

Some of us are naive.

They hear a good comment here and there, they're nice statement that is coming from this politician or that and they fall in the trap.

Beware somebody who has a long record of fighting Islam, their record should speak for them, so we shouldn't be tricked.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), this plot of Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) did not pass on him, he knew and he told Ayyash Bin Abi Rabiyah(عياش بن أبي ربيعه), don't believe them.

They're lying and your mother her head gets filled with lice, she will have to comb it.

And no one will survive in the heat of Makkah.

That's an oath that she will have to break.

So, we should be careful.

Allah knows your enemies.

And he has told us who our enemies are, we shouldn't fall in the trap, We should be careful and we should beware.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا ألشاعر؟

رَبِح الْبَيْعْ لَا نَقِيْلُ وَلَا نَسْتَقِيْلْ هَذَا فَعْلٌ حَسَنْ سَاصْلُبُه قَدْ صَلَّيْنَا وَ فَقَّهْنَاَ اِخْشَوْشَنُوْ فَاِنَّ النِّعْمَ لَا تَدْعُوْنْ

Rasool Ullah صلوات الله وسلام عليه said; إِنِّي أُرِيتُ دَارَ هِجْرَتِكُمْ أريد سبخة ذَاتَ نَخْلٍ بَيْنَ لَابَتَيْنِ وَهُمَا الْحَرَّتَانِ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أُهَاجِرُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى أَرْضٍ بِهَا نَخْلٌ

فَذَهَبَ وَهَلِي إِلَى أَنَّهَا الْيَمَامَةُ أَوْ هَجَرُ فَإِذَا هِيَ يَثْرِبُ لَسْتُ بِلْ خِبْ وَالْخِبِّ يَخْدَاعْنِيْ Allahسبحانه وتعالى says;

قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ

إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ۝

وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ۝

وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ۝

And Allahسبحانه وتعالى says; وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَعْدَائِكُمْ

parts.english:
The Life Of Muhammad ﷺ, The Makkan Period, By Imam Anwar Al-Awlaki, Lessons from the journey of Rasool Allah ﷺ to At-Taef(ألطائف).

Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was the one protecting Rasool Allah ﷺ from the rocks, that were being thrown at Muhammad صلوات الله وسلام عليه.

So, Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was protecting Rasool Allah ﷺ shielding him with his own body.

In the Battle of Uhud(احد), we have similar stories of Sahabah(صحابہ) using their backs not just to protect Rasool Allah ﷺ from rocks like in this incident,

but to protect him from arrows.

This was the level of sacrifice that the Sahabahرضي الله عنهم had.

Now we might not have a chance to protect Rasool Allah ﷺ with our physical bodies.

So, if we missed that chance, let's make it up, by protecting Rasool Allah ﷺ through defending his message, through protecting his honor, through teaching others about his life, Muslims and non Muslims, let's do our part.

Abu Muslim Al-Khaulaani(ابو مسلم الخولاني) one of the greatest of At-Tabaeen(التابعين), he said; Do the companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ think that

we will let them, have Rasool Allah ﷺ for themselves?

No, we're going to compete with them.

We want to get our share of the Messenger of Allah.

So, even though we're living centuries past the time of Muhammadﷺ so we cannot participate physically, in helping him, in his mission but it's not too late.

There's a lot that we could do.

That would resemble what Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) did on that day.

It might not ever be as great as what Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) did or what Talha(طلحه) did on the day of Uhud(احد) but at least we can try and do something.

And when we study the Seerah(سيرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, and when we developed love for him it needs to encourage us to go through the same footsteps that the students of Rasool Allah ﷺ went through.

The second lesson, when Rasool Allah ﷺ was speaking to the people of At-Taef(ألطائف).

No one responded to him, they all rejected him.

But remember what we said, Do good because you never know what the outcome will be.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was chased out of At-Taef(ألطائف).

So, he might have thought that his words did not really leave an effect on them.

But among the crowds Rasool Allah ﷺ was speaking to, was a child.

His name is Khalid Al-Udwaan(خالدالعدواني), he's a member of the tribe of Thaqeef(ثقيف).

He said: I was standing there listening to the speech of Rasool Allah ﷺ in the fair grounds of At-Taef(ألطائف) and I heard the messenger of Allah recites Surah-At-Tariq(سورة الطارق).

And I remembered it then, when I was still an non believer.

And when I became Muslim, I already knew that Surah(سورة).

So, here we have Rasool Allah ﷺ giving a speech to adults, nobody cared about what Rasool Allah ﷺ said, but there was a child in there who remembered and memorized Surah-At-Tariq(سورة الطارق)

by listening to it, from the mouth of Rasool Allah ﷺ in At-Taef(ألطائف), and years later, Rasool Allah ﷺ is seeing the harvest of the seed that he planted in At-Taef(ألطائف).

So, do good, because you never know what the outcome will be.

Number three, we talked about what happened between Rasool Allah ﷺ and Addaas(عداس), didn't you remember Addaas(عداس), the Christian.

Over here, you have an example of Da'wah(دعوة) through action.

Rasool Allah ﷺ started by saying Bismillah(بسم الله) an Islamic act.

This Islamic act even though it seems simple and small, was the cause of the Islam of Addaas(عداس).

Because Addaas(عداس) never heard this before, in this land of the Arabs.

They don't say Bismillah(بسم الله), they don't start in the name of Allah.

And that opened up a conversation between Rasool Allah ﷺ and Addaas(عداس) that ended up with Addaas(عداس), admitting the Prophet hood of Muhammadﷺ and believing in him.

So, sometimes you might do something without paying attention, but it's attracting the attention of others around you.

And that might open the door for them to have some curiosity, and that will be the beginning of their studying of Islam, which might end with them accepting the religion of Allah.

So, sometimes our Da'wah(دعوة) could be indirectly through our action.

And the reputation of the Sahabahرضي الله عنهم that they developed after Islam had a major role in attracting many of the other Arabs to Islam.

So, it wasn't necessarily their words, but it was their behavior, their character, the way they changed in Islam.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ had to leave At-Taef(ألطائف), he was rejected by the people in At-Taef(ألطائف) and we said earlier that with difficulty comes ease.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went through a difficult time, hardship in At-Taef(ألطائف).

Allahسبحانه وتعالى followed it with a blessing.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was reciting Qur'an in the desert and some Jinn(جن) happened to be in the area.

And the words of Qur'an attracted them.

And they came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and learned from him, verses of Qur'an and ended up becoming Muslim.

What are Jinn(جن)?

Jinn(جن) is a world of creatures that has intelligence, lives with us on earth have quite a similar structure, life structure like we do, they have clans, families, tribes, nations, they speak different dialects, languages follow different religions.

So, they are pretty similar to human beings.

The difference is that they were created from fire, we were created from clay, they see us and we don't see them.

But there are Jinn(جن) who are Christian, there are Muslim Jinn(جن), there are Jewish Jinn(جن) There are Jinn who speak Arabic, Jinn(جن) who speak English, Jinn(جن) who speak Russian.

And they might even follow the customs of the land that they live in.

And many of these supernatural or strange events that people talk about and you see on the front pages of tabloids a sighting of a UFO and all of those interesting things, might easily be explained as Jinn(جن).

There is an intelligent world is living with us on earth.

And these haunted places and all of this can be explained easily by Muslims, it's not a big deal for us.

Ya'ani(يعني) we have all of this mythology that is surrounding, this supernatural events and you have a whole entertainment industry that is based on it and movies and stories and Halloween and all that stuff,

when there's simple thing behind it and that is that there is a world of creatures living with us that we cannot see.

Sometimes we might have sightings of them but most of the time we don't.

While they have access to us and they can see us.

So, these Jinn(جن) came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and became Muslim.

Now there might have been more than one incident in which Jinn(جن) came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and became Muslim because we have the story of Al-Jinn(جن) is mentioned twice in Qur'an

once in Surah Jinn(سورة الجن) and once in Surah Ah'qaaf(سورة الأحقاف) the verses of Surah Ah'qaaf(سورة الأحقاف), And mention, O Muhammad(محمد) when we directed to you a few of the Jinn(جن) listening to the Qur'an.

And when they attended it, they said listen quietly.

And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as Warner's They said: O our people indeed we have heard a recited book revealed after Moses

confirming what was before it, which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

One commentator of Qur'an, who gave Tafseer(تفسير), asks this following question.

He says, How come the Jinn(جن) said that we have heard something that was revealed after Musa(موسى), and they didn't say after Eesa(عيسى), how come the Jinn(جن) brought up the name of Moses and didn't bring up the name of Jesus.

And his explanation was that these Jinn(جن) were Jewish.

And they were following the message of Musa(موسى).

So, when they heard Qur'an.

They said: This is a revelation that is coming after the revelation that was given to Musa(موسى) and this commentator says that these Jinn(جن) actually, were from Yemen, where there were some Jews.

That's one way to look at the verse, it's not necessarily the only view but it's also an indication that the Jinn(جن) would follow the customs of the people in their area.

They said, O our people, indeed we have heard the recited book revealed after Musa(موسى) confirming what was before it and guides to the truth and to a straight path.

O our people respond to the caller of Allah and believe in Him, He, Allah will forgive you, your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.

But he, who does not respond to the caller of Allah will not cause failure to Him upon earth and he will not have besides him any protectors, those are in manifest errors.

So, this was an example of something good that happened to Rasool Allah ﷺ, after something that was difficult.

This is mentioned to happen after At-Taef(ألطائف).

Rasool Allah ﷺ now has to enter into Makkah again.

Now getting in, is not like leaving, you could leave easily, but it's not easy to get into Makkah again especially after the news reached to Makkah,

that Rasool Allah ﷺ, has went to preach his message to the people of At-Taef(ألطائف).

So, now Rasool Allah ﷺ is not able to go into Makkah again.

He has to seek the protection of someone in order to enter into his own town.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is now camping outside of Makkah, trying to find somebody who would sponsor him and give him protection.

He sent a message with a man named Uraiqat(عريقت), to go to a Al-Akhnas Bin Shuraiq(ألأخنس بن شريق).

Now, Al-Akhnas Bin Shuraiq(ألأخنس بن شريق) was living in Makkah.

He was an ally of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), even though he wasn't one of them.

So, when Al-Akhnas(ألأخنس) received the message from Muhammadﷺ, he said; Since I'm an ally of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), I cannot give protection to somebody, who's from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

I'm only an ally, I cannot go over my authority and give protection to somebody who's from the tribe whom, I'm an ally of.

And this religion of yours is something that kings do not like.

So, look at the wisdom that he realized from his meeting with Rasool Allah ﷺ that this is something that kings will not really like.

Because kings want to have authority in their hands to abuse others and this is a religion that is to free people.

He said; We cannot offer you protection from the Persian side but we can offer you protection from the Arab side.

So, the land that is bordering the Arabs, we will promise you that we will protect you from them, but the area that is bordering Persia we cannot promise you anything,

we cannot stand in front of the Persian Empire, it's too much for us.

Rasool Allah ﷺ responded by saying; Your reply is in no way bad for you have spoken eloquently and truthfully you've been honest.

But God's religion can only be engaged in, by those who encompass it, from all sides.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did not want to have half a deal, did not want to have a compromised deal, Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted to have complete protection.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: The religion of Allah needs to be surrounded from every direction.

I want an absolute commitment to protect me, you can say that I'm going to protect you from one side but not from the other.

What we can learn from this is that, in our negotiations and in our deals, we need to keep in mind that the religion of Allah, needs to be held in high esteem.

And we should not bargain and negotiate in it.

And we should not compromise its terms.

And if the agreement does not fulfill the Islamic terms, we don't have to involve in it.

Rasool Allah ﷺ felt no need, in joining an agreement even though he knew his situation in Makkah.

He knew how difficult it was and he knew how badly he needs to leave.

Nevertheless, he did not want to enter into an agreement that was half hearted, halfway through.

And this is where you put your trust in Allahسبحانه وتعالى.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, left it up to Allahعَزّوجَلّ and refused to accept that particular agreement from the people of Bannu Shaibah(بنو شيبه).

Ibn Is'haq(ابن اسحاق) , he goes on with the story of Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).

Now who are Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار)?

Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) when they became Muslim were called Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار).

Which means, the protectors.

Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) were the two Arab tribes that were living in Madina and they are descendants of the branch of Kahtaan(قحطان)

see the Arabs divided into Adnan(عدنان) and Kahtaan(قحطان).

Kahtaan(قحطان) are the Arabs of Yemen and Adnan(عدنان) are the descendants of Ismailعليه السّلام.

So, Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) were from Kahtaan(قحطان) They were neighboring three Jewish tribes, Bannu Quraidha(بنو قريضه), Bannu Qainuqah(بنو قينقاع)

and Bannu Nadhir(بنو نضير).

Al-Madina was unique in that, it offered a protection from three sides.

There were two rocky tracks on the east and west, which are inaccessible for armies to cross and then there were the trees, the farms of Madina towards the south.

So, the only direction where an army can attack Madina is from the north, so it has this natural protection from three sides.

Rasool Allah ﷺ visited the camp of Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج), in Hajj(حَجْ) actually, at the time he visited Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).

Rasool Allah ﷺ when he came in, he asked them, who are you?

They said: We are from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Are you the allies of the Jews?

They said: Yes.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Can I speak to you?

They agreed.

So, they sat down and Rasool Allah ﷺ invited them to Islam.

they were very eager to hear what Rasool Allah ﷺ said.

And they immediately accepted, and they told Rasool Allahﷺ; We have left our own people, for they have such discord and dissension between them, not found in any other.

Perhaps God may unite them through you, we will go forth among them and invite them to you, presenting to them this religion we have accepted from you.

If God should unite them around you, then no one will be dearer to us, then you.

This immediate acceptance of Islam, by the small group of Al-Khazraj(الخزرج), the number was six.

How come it happened that way?

How come Ansaar(أنصار) were not resistant to the message of Islam, like the other Arab tribes?

There are few reasons.

Number one, the people of Madina were in a constant warfare among themselves.

Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) were fighting an age old war between themselves, imagine two tribes living in the same city, and they are fighting with each other,

so they were earning for peace.

And when these men of Al-Khazraj(الخزرج) heard the message of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they said; Maybe Allah will unite us through you, we really need peace,

we've been at each other's throats for so long.

That's one reason.

Second reason, The Aos(أوس) and Khazraj(خزرج) had a natural, monotheism was appealing to them, because they were neighbors of the Jews.

And the Arabs used to see the religion of the Jews being superior to theirs.

Why is that?

The Jews were learned.

They had scripture, they had teachings, they had knowledge, while the religion of the Arabs was merely myths, and idols and killing of their daughters.

So, if it wasn't for the Jewish prejudice and arrogance, towards the Arabs, most likely Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) would have been Jewish.

But the reason why they didn't convert, is because the Jews used to always treat them as if they are a lower class and as if the Jewish religion is only suitable for the elites.

And sometimes there will be conflicts between the Arabs and the Jews.

So, the Jews would say, that this is a time of a prophet that will appear and when he comes out, we will follow him, and we will kill you, like the people of Aad(عاد) were killed.

So, number three, the Arabs also knew that this is a time of a prophet.

So, the Arabs of Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) were prepared for this message.

Allahسبحانه وتعالى has prepared them.

They knew about the monotheistic religion of the Jews, and they knew the value of to Tauheed(توحيد), the oneness of Allah, they knew that the Prophet is coming, and they needed peace.

And number four, a few years before the Hijrah(هجرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, a battle called Buaath(بعاث) occurred between Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج)

this was such a violent war, it ended up killing most of the current leadership of both tribes.

So, imagine having two clans with the majority of their leaders, their seniors killed.

So, now you have a people that are looking for leadership, they do not have an established structure of leadership among them.

So, when they heard the message of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they were looking forward to have him, lead them.

So, all of these were elements when combined together, it made Madina a very fertile ground for the spread of Islam.

And some of these things were mentioned, for example, there's a statement by Ayesha رضي الله عنها, she said that the war of Buaath(بعاث) was preparation by Allahسبحانه وتعالى for the migration of Rasool Allah ﷺ

and she says: Their leaders were killed.

Because remember, we said that the people who tend to me the most resistant to the truth, are who.?

The leaders of a society.

now Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) do not have that hurdle in front of them.

The leaders were killed in the Battle of Buaath(بعاث) And Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ), he says, One way, which God facilitated their acceptance of Islam

was that the Jews were there, with them in their country, these were followers of the Scripture and men of knowledge, though they themselves were polytheists and idol worshippers,

they had previously attacked these Jews in their territories.

And whenever a dispute had arisen the latter had told them a prophet will now be sent, his day is coming we will follow him and give you the same fate as that of the peoples of Aad(عاد) and Iram(إرم).

So, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) you can see how Allah was preparing Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) for this great responsibility.

Now, You might dislike something but in it, is a lot of good for you.

This war that happened between Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) and killed many of them, even though it caused a lot of bloodshed and harm to them.

It was one of the reasons that brought them closer to Islam.

Anyway, so these six men accepted Islam and they told Rasool Allahﷺ, we'll go back to our people and start preaching the message.

And they made an appointment with Rasool Allah ﷺ to meet him next year in the season of Hajj(حَجْ).

So, a year passed by and now the season of Hajj(حَجْ) approached, the six came back as 12.

We had the Original Six, in addition to them six more.

The earlier, six were all from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج) there's one narration that says five were from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج), and one from Al-Aos(الاوس).

Now, in the second year, they were 12, 10 of them were from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج) and 2 from Al-Aos(الاوس) They came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and they gave him Pledge of Allegiance.

And it was called the pledge of the women.

Even though none of them, was a female.

These 12 were males, but the Pledge of Allegiance was called Baiyah-Tun-Nisaa(بيعة النساء), the Pledge of Allegiance of the women.

Why?

Because it did not include within its terms, any pledge of fighting.

The terms of the pledge were.!

We pledge to the Messenger of Allah, on the night of the first meeting, at Aqabah(عقبه) that we would not associate any other God with Allah,

that we would not steal, commit fornication, kill our children, make false accusations, nor disobey him in anything good.

He told us, if you keep to this, you shall have paradise.

But if you give up any of this and you are punished for it in this world, then that will provide the atonement for you.

But if it is overlooked until Judgment Day, it will be up to Allah to decide whether to punish or to forgive you.

So, you can notice here that the pledge includes them, committing themselves to Islam and worshiping as individuals, but it does not include any terms relating to protection or fighting.

And that's why it was called Baiyah-Tun-Nisaa(بيعة النساء).

Why was it given this name?

because this was the pledge of allegiance, that women would give to Muhammadﷺ.

Now there's a Fiqh(فقه) issue to be dealt with here, you notice here that these are major sins, stealing, fornicating, killing children, making false accusations,

these are all major sins.

And there is a hadd(حد) a punishment prescribed.

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ says here, that if the punishment is fulfilled in this world, that will forgive you of the sin.

However, if the punishment is not done in this world, than it is up to Allah, to either forgive or punish.

So, if somebody steals and they are punished for their stealing by the cutting of the hand, then that forgives the sin, that forgives the sin.

The sin is gone.

But if the punishment is not implemented, on the Day of Judgment, it is up to Allah to forgive or to punish for that particular sin.

And that relates to Al-Kabaer(ألكبائر), the major sins.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ appointed Mus'ab Bin Umair(مصعب بن عمير) to go and teach the people of Madina Islam.

You can call him an ambassador, you can call him a teacher, you can call him a scholar, he had all of these roles in one.

Mus'ab Ibn Umairرضي الله عنه came from a wealthy family in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) was the most spoiled young man in Makkah, before Islam.

He he used to wear the most expensive clothes, he would have the best perfume and his mother was taking care of him.

So, she was very wealthy woman and she didn't have many kids.

So, she was taking very good care of them.

And he was very spoiled.

He became Muslim, his mother boycotted him, she stood against him.

And Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير), who was wealthy turns from wealth to poverty from living a spoiled life, to living a tough and harsh life.

And when Mus'ab Ibn Umairرضي الله عنه was killed in the Battle of Uhud(أحد) the witnesses of his burial said: He did not even leave behind enough money to buy a coffin.

And obviously since he's a Shaheed(شهيد), he's not wrapped in any special clothes.

But when he was fighting, he had on himself one piece of cloth that was not sufficient to cover him.

So, they said whenever we would cover his face, his feet would appear.

And whenever we would cover his feet, his face would appear.

So, they went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said: What can we do?

He said, Well cover his face, and then use some tree leaves to cover his feet.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) was given this difficult task and major responsibility of being, the personal representative of Rasool Allah ﷺ in Madina.

So, now Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) left Makkah, and he went to reside in Madina.

Since Al-Aos Wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج) were enemies.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) had to lead them in Salah(صلاة), because none of them would accept praying behind an Imam from the other tribe.

One day, Mus'ab Ibn Umairرضي الله عنه, was with As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), who was his host, As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), was the one, who was hosting Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب إبن عمير).

So, they went to visit some of the Muslims, they went into this farm garden, and they were sitting there, and the Muslims were coming to them to learn.

They would come and meet with Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) and he would teach them, he would hold Halaqaat(حلقات), sessions for them, in this place.

They happen to go to a neighborhood of Madina that was part of Al-Aos(الاوس)'s territory.

And remember that, the majority of the Muslims were from which tribe Al-Aos(الاوس) or Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).?

From Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).!

So, Islam now was spreading with speed among Al-Khazraj(الخزرج), but it wasn't catching up with Al-Aos(الاوس).

So, now Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) is trying to make inroads within Al-Aos(الاوس).

So, they went to an area that is in the land of Al-Aos(الاوس), and they sat there.

The leaders of Al-Aos(الاوس) were close by.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) and Usaid Bin Khudhair(أسيد بن خضير).

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) spotted Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) and As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره).

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) told Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), I want you to go to those two men and tell them that, we don't want them around misguiding the weak and foolish among us.

And if it wasn't for the fact that As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) was my relative, I would have done that myself As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), was in a position

that Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Allah prepared him to carry this role of hosting Mus'ab(مصعب).

As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) was from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).

But he was a cousin of the head of Al-Aos(الاوس).

So, on the mother's side, he was a relative of Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ).

So, he had ties to both tribes both to Al-Aos(الاوس) and Al-Khazraj(الخزرج).

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) told Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), I want you to go and kick them out.

And if it wasn't for the fact that As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) is my relative, I would have done that myself.

So now, Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), went up carrying his spear towards Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) and As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره).

As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), saw him coming, and he told Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير); This is a leader of his people, be sincere with him.

Do your best, because if he becomes Muslim, many people will follow him.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) said: If he listens, I would!

So, now Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) came and he stood above them carrying his spear, speaking to them in a very harsh tone.

He said; we don't want you around here, misleading the weak and ignorant among us.

And then he said, and if you care about your lives, you better get out of here.

Otherwise, this is my spear, you could be killed.

So, he threatened them.

And one of the attendees of the Halaqah(حلقه).

He said: Well, you are the one who was misleading us, and he started an argument.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) responded calmly by saying, how about you sit down, and you hear, what I say.

If you like it, you can accept it, if you don't, you can reject it.

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) said: Fair enough.

And he sat down, he stuck his spear in the ground and he sat down.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) started reciting to him Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, giving them Da'wah(دعوة) explaining Islam.

As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) said; even without him speaking a word, We were able to see Islam entering his heart, because of the calmness in his face

and the radiance of light coming out of it.

We could see it on his face.

And when Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) finished with his session with Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) said: What does one have to do to join your religion.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) told him wash yourself and you come and pray.

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), he did that and then he came back, and he said; Now I'm going to send you a man, if he becomes Muslim all of his people will follow him.

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) went to Sa'ad Bin Muadh(سعد بن معاذ).

Now Sa'ad Bin Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), saw Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) and he said; I swear by Allah that he's coming to us with a different face than, the one he left us with.

The Arabs had this Farasah(فراسه) thing, Farasah(فراسه) is the art of reading the face.

And it is reported that Ash-Shafa'i(الشافعي) went to Yemen to learn this art.

So, it was an art that existed.

And a Chinese brother, a Muslim brother said that also in China, some people have this art.

You look at the face of a person and you try to read what is in their hearts, what is what they're thinking about what's going on with them.

There's an incident when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was a Khalifah(خليفه), he saw a man passing by, and he said; This man is either a soothsayer or he has been a soothsayer in the past.

So, they went and asked this man he said: Yes, I used to be a Kahin (كاهن).

I used to be a fortune teller or a soothsayer?

He said; Yes, I was a soothsayer, So Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) just knew it by looking at his face.

So, Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), when he looked at the face of Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), he said; He's coming back to us with a different face

than the face he left us with.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) told him what happened.

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) said; Everything is fine. Don't worry about it.

There's a slight problem, however, and that is that Bannu Harris(بنو الحارث) want to kill As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) because they know that he's your cousin.

In case you don't remember the names, As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن ضراره) is the man with Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) and he's the cousin of Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ).

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) said; Bannu Hariss(بنو الحارث) this is a branch of Al-Khazraj(الخجرج), want to kill As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره),

because he is your relative.

Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير), made up the whole story, that wasn't true.

The whole reason why, he made it up, is he wants Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) to go and meet Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير).

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) stood up angry and he said they want to kill my cousin.

He picked up the spear and he left and he said, you haven't done me any good.

And he went there and he came, and you can see anger on his face.

And he was carrying a spear, Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) saw him coming.

As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), told Mus'ab(مصعب), this is the leader of his people.

Do the best you can.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) came and Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), he just took a look at the meeting.

And he realized that the story that Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) reported was fabricated because it didn't seem that they were terrified,

it didn't seem that there was a plot to kill As'ad Bin Zurarah(أسعد بن زراره).

Otherwise, they would have been acting differently.

So, Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) realized that Usaid Bin Khuzair(أسيد بن خضير) has made up the story because he wants him to come and see what's happening.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ), came and he told As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره), he said; Why are you doing this to me.

Why are you bringing this man to my territory?

You're taking advantage of your relationship with me, you want to mislead the ignorant and the weak among us.

Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير) responded and said; How about you sit down and hear what I have to say?

If you like it, you can accept it, if you don't, you can reject it.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) agreed and he sat down.

Notice here the people of Madina are open minded.

They don't have the sense of hostility that existed in Makkah.

They were willing to listen, so Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) sat down, Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب ابن عمير), the choice of Rasool Allah ﷺ for this mission,

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) he had the Hikmah(حكمة) and the wisdom of a Daiyah(داعيه), somebody who preach Islam.

He started giving Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) a message As'ad Ibn Zurara(أسعد إبن زراره) said, I can read in his face, the fact that he wants to become a Muslim.

And when the conversation finished Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) accepted Islam.

And what was the first action Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) did.?

He went to his people and he said, What is your opinion of me.?

They said, You are the wisest among us, and you are our leader.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد بن معاذ) said: Well, none of you speak to me, and I will speak to none of you, until you become Muslim.

The narrator of the Hadith(حديث) said; By the end of that evening, every house among Bannu-Al-Ash'hal(بنو الإشحل) was Muslim.

The whole clan of Bannu-Al-Ash'hal(بنو الإشحل), which were a branch of Al-Aos(ألاوس).

So, now a huge breakthrough was made within Al-Aos(ألاوس).

So, you have both Al-Aos wal Khazraj(ألاوس ولخزرج).
parts.arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنْصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ۝

قَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ

يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ۝

يَا قَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَآمِنُوا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ۝

وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ۝

اَلْاَرْضُ لِله يُوْرِثُهَا مَنْ يَشَاءْ وَ الْعَاقِبَة لِلْمُتَّقِيْنْ وَكَانَ سَبَّاقً عَلى كُلِّ خَيْرْ أمن هامها أم من لهازمها صَادَفَ دَرْءُ السَّيْلِ دَرْءًا يدفعه فتارة يصدعه و تارة يهضبه

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), قُتِلَتْ ثَرَوَاتُهُمْ وَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ اُصْدُقَ الله فِيْكْ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
