parts.english:
The Life Of Muhammadﷺ, The Makkan Period, by Imam Anwr Al-Awlaki; We covered the story of the Islam of Demaad(ضماد), and Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه).

We move on to the story of Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه.

I'm going to mention to you the Imam Ahmad(امام احمد) version.

Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه stated that me, my brother and my mother left our land of Ghifaar(غفار), because our people used to be disrespectful of the Ash'hur-Ul-Hurum(أشهرالحرم).

Al-Ash'hur Ul Hurum(الاشهرالحرم) are four months, in which the Arabs used to consider sacred and this would give them a break from warfare.

So, they would not allow killing, war during those four months.

And it was a firm tradition among them that you do not break, the sanctity of these four months.

The people of Ghiffar(غفار) were different, these were professional Raiders of caravans, they didn't care about Ash'hur-Ul-Hurum(أشهرالحرم) and all this stuff.

They were Bedouins, who were raid caravans, steal, kill, corrupt, and they didn't follow any rules or customers.

These are the people of Ghiffar(غفار).

And they had a bad reputation in Arabia, I mean people in Arabia knew Ghiffar(غفار).

These people don't abide by the rules, violent.

Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه before Islam, he disagreed with this style of life.

So he, his brother and mother decided to leave Ghiffar(غفار), just go out.

So, they went and they visited an uncle of theirs, he used to be a member of a different tribe.

And they stayed with him and Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) says he was very generous and hospitable to us , very kind.

But his relatives were becoming jealous.

How come he's treating us so well.

So what they did, they went up to the uncle of Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) and they told him; When you are absent, Unais, Abu Dharr(ابو ذر)'s  brother, he goes and visits your wife, and he's interested in her.

The Uncle, quite naively, he went to Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) and Unais(اٌنَيْسْ) and mentioned to them, what he heard.

He said: People are saying that Unais(اٌنَيْسْ) is interested in my wife.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) was very angry and upset, this was false.

He was very angry and he said: All of the good what you have done to us, you have cancelled it.

All of the hospitality, your kindness is gone, after this accusation of yours, and immediately packed up and left.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: My uncle was quite sorry and regretful for what he done and he wrapped himself in a cloth and he was crying.

But Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: We were so angry and we just left.

And now they settled the place close to Makkah.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) says that my brother, Unais(اٌنَيْسْ), he went to do some business in Makkah.

And he met a man who claims to be a Prophet, he met Muhammadﷺ.

So, Unais(اٌنَيْسْ) came back and he said, I found the man who was preaching a new religion, worshipping Allah alone.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: And at that time, I have already worshipped Allah for three years, and revoked all of the worshipping of idols, I renounced it.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), you see these people, their Fitrah(فطرة), guides them and tells them that this is wrong, this is false.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) says: I've been praying to Allah for three years.

So, Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) was asked, how would you praying to Allah, he said: I would pray to whichever direction Allah would points me to, and I would pray in whatever way Allah guide me to,

and I would pray at night until I fall asleep, and only the sun would wake me up in the morning.

So, he would pray, he doesn't know how to pray, but he would pray to Allah سبحانه وتعالى, for three years.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) asked, his brother Unais(اٌنَيْسْ), he said: what does he teach?

So, Unais(اٌنَيْسْ) mentioned some of the teachings of Islam that he learned from Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And then he asked him, What are the people saying about him?

Unais(اٌنَيْسْ) said: They're claiming that he's a sorcerer, and magician, a liar, and he went down the list.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: You haven't satisfied my hunger.

I want to go and investigate the matter myself.

What the people say might not necessarily be right.

The media of Makkah, the CNN of the day, or the ABC or whatever you call it, had all of these labels that they would brand Rasool Allahﷺ with

but Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) did not have trust in what the people are saying, he would have to go and meet Rasool Allahﷺ and hear it from the messenger himself.

And that is what the Muslim is required to do.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says; when you receive some information verify it, Tabayyanoo(تَبَيَّنُوْا).

And that's where our scholars learn the science of Hadith(حديث).

They would verify.

It's not just enough to hear a Hadith(حديث) narrated from someone.

The scholars used to say: Whenever they would hear a Hadith(حديث), they would say mention, the names of your men.

Where did you hear this from?

Tell us the names, we want to know who you got this information from?

We just don't follow any hearsay.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), he said: I went into Makkah and I asked the first man I saw in front of me.

I told them Can you please guide me towards Muhammadﷺ.

He said that man immediately started calling the men is Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and they started pelting me with stones, rocks, whatever they could get their hands on, until I fell unconscious.

He said: By the time I woke up, I was like Nusub(نصب) the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they used to have these stones idols which, they would slaughter and sacrifice their animals over.

So, they would be soaked with blood.

That's the description Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) gave of himself like a red pole, soaked with blood from head to toe.

He said: So I went to the well of Zam-Zam(زمزم), I drank water and I washed the blood of my body.

And then I went next to the Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

In the narration of Imam Ahmad(اِمَامْ اَحْمَدْ), it says that he stayed there for 30 days, not knowing where to meet Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: I did not have any food for the entire period, except for drinking the water of Zam-Zam(زمزم).

Now, I think physicians can tell us that a person can survive by drinking water for quite a while.

So, maybe that's not such a surprise.

But the surprising thing is what comes next, Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: And I started picking up weight, until I was getting folds on my stomach.

You know for them the Bedouins, they would have flat tummies, they were very fit.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: I was gaining weight and now the flesh on my stomach was folding.

You know when you sit down and the flesh on the stomach folds.!

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) states that he then saw two women, making Tawaf(طواف) and they would touch Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله) on every turn.

What's the story of Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله)?

Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله) are a man and a woman, who were in love and they couldn't get married.

And they had an appointment, a date to meet next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), and they intended to fornicate next to the house of Allah.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى turned them into stones, on the spot.

After the passage of sometime the Mushrikeen(مشركين) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), started worshipping them, started worshipping these two stones, Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله).

To show you how, when you open the floodgates for Shaytaan(شيطان), you can't close it, he just throws you in dungeons of darkness, can never get out of it, it's spiral, if you get in, you'll never come out, darkness over darkness, one veil after another.

Now, the story of idol worshipping actually started as erecting statues after righteous men die.

Shaytaan(شيطان) came to the people of Noah(نوح) and told them after the righteous men have passed away.

Why don't you erect statues of these righteous men?

So, that they would remind you about Allah.

He came to teach them good.

He said: They would remind you about Allah سبحانه وتعالى, so they did that.

And then after a few generations, he started telling them, worship them.

That's how the idol worshipping grew.

So, here you have Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله) been worshiped, and these two women would make Tawaf(طواف) and they would touch Isaaf(إساف) and Naila(نائله) on every turn.

Now Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), he despised idol worshipping.

So, he threw out a comment.

He said: Why don't you make one of them have intercourse with the other?

Either the woman did not understand, what he said or they didn't believe what they heard.

They continued.

When Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) saw that his words, did not deter them.

He threw out and even cruder comment, and I'm not gonna mention it.

Now the woman were sure of what they heard, they immediately just started running and screaming, wailing down the streets of Makkah and who did they run into?

Muhammadﷺ and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) Muhammadﷺ and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) are seeing these two women running in the streets, screaming.

What's wrong with you?

They said that heretic over there, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: What's the matter with him?

They said: He spoke a word that fills the mouth.

In other words something that is unspeakable, very bad words.

Rasool Allah ﷺ and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), they went to meet this man, Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه and they started the conversation.

Rasool Allah ﷺ asked Abu Dharr(ابو ذر): Where are you from?

He said: I am from Ghifaar(غفار).

Rasool Allah ﷺ placed his hands on his forehead.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: Rasool Allah ﷺ was surprised and amazed to see somebody from Ghifaar(غفار) coming to Makkah, in search of the truth, from Ghifaar(غفار)!

These people who raid caravans, the ones who do not follow any rules or any customs, and he is searching for the truth in Makkah and the people of Makkah, the ones who are considered to be the religious authority of Arabia, are rejecting my message.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: I felt that he might have disliked that I mentioned that I'm from Ghifaar(غفار).

So, I extended my hand to pull his hand from his forehead.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) slammed my hand and told me, put your hand down.

And then the conversation continued and Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) ended up embracing Islam.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Dharr(ابو ذر): Keep your Eeman(ايمان) secret.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), he went out the next day rather than keeping his Eeman(ايمان) secret, he went in front of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and said:

He doesn't care about the consequences.

He said: They gathered around me and they beat me up, so bad, I was gonna die.

Until, Al-Abbas Bin Abdul-Muttalib(العباس بن عبدالمطلب) came in and said, Do you know where this man is from?

Just one question, he is from Ghifaar(غفار).

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) said: Immediately they just ran away.

All what you would see is them fleeing, running away from him.

But he did the same thing next day, and he did the same thing third day, and every day the same thing would happen they would come and beat him up,

until Al-Abbas(العباس) comes and tells this new group of people who are hitting him that the man is from Ghifaar(غفار).

Al-Abbas(العباس) said: And you know if this man gets killed by you, that none of your trade will make it safely to Syria.

They gonna take revenge of you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ then told Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), Go back to your people and convey the message to them.

And when you hear that I prevailed, come to me.

How long did Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) stay with Rasool Allah ﷺ.?

Quite a short time.

How much did he learn from him?

Probably not a lot.

Few verses, a few Ahadith(احاديث) here and there and that was it.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), he went back to his people, Ghifaar(غفار).

And he started giving them Da'wah(دعوة), slowly and slowly, people were accepting Islam, among the people of Ghifaar(غفار).

He said, by the time Rasool Allah ﷺ made Hijrah(هجرة) almost half of my tribe were Muslim, the whole tribe of Ghifaar(غفار).

He said, and then we decided to go and visit Rasool Allah ﷺ and the rest of the tribe have said, when Rasool Allah ﷺ arrives and when we go and meet him, we will become Muslim.

So now, the whole tribe is Muslim.

All of them are Muslim, the other half just said we're going to wait, it's a matter of time but then it will become Muslim and they did.

So one day when Rasool Allah ﷺ was in Madina, they see in the horizon, this dust cloud, sign of an army approaching, large group of people.

So, some of the Sahabah(صحابه) have a rushed to their weapons thinking that maybe an army is approaching us.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ said: And the prophecy of Rasool Allah ﷺ was true.

It was Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) and all of his tribe of Ghifaar(غفار), coming to pledge their allegiance to Rasool Allah ﷺ, the entire tribe.

Now there was rivalry between two tribes Ghifaar(غفار) and Aslam(اسلم).

When Aslam(اسلم) heard that Ghifaar(غفار) became Muslim and they went and pledged allegiance to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

They immediately went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said, we also want to become Muslim, two tribes.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, Ghifaar(غفار), may Allah forgive them.

And Aslam(اسلم) may Allah, give them peace.

All of it started by the work of one man.

And how much did this man, know?

Was he a scholar at the time? No, He just knew a few Ayaat(آيات), later on, Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) came to learn a lot.

But at that stage, he just spent a few days with Rasool Allah ﷺ and that was it All of Ghifaar(غفار) became Muslim.

The last people in the desert that you would expect to accept Islam, they did become Muslim.

What can we learn from the story of Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) Number one, again, the same lessons coming up.

The ones, who search for guidance, Allah will give it to them.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) investigated the matter and Allah showed him the light, showed him the truth.

Number two, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Convey even one verse from me.

Whatever you have, convey it, share it, teach it, don't keep it to yourself.

Number three, courage.

Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) is an example of a person, who has courage, he wasn't intimidated by the fact that he's a foreigner in Makkah.

He stood and, he said: I'm a Muslim, and he was proud, and he paid for it dearly.

And then he went to his people, and he preached the message to them.

So, this shows you the courage of the personality of Abu Dharr(ابو ذر), which is shown again and again and again, by the Sahabah of Rasool Allah ﷺ and this reveals to us the inherent qualities that they had.

And this is also one of the reasons why Allah سبحانه وتعالى chose them, to be the bearers of the message.

Because they had simplicity, and they had courage, and they had honesty, and they had commitment to a cause when they believe in something they commit their lives to it.

Number four, verifying the truth, Just because the people say that he is a sorcerer a liar, a magician, doesn't mean anything.

You have to go to the source and verify the information yourself.

Allah has given you a mind, Allah has given you intelligence, use it, don't just follow what the people are saying, Rasool Allah ﷺ says that don't be an Imma'a(اِمَّعْ)

and when he was asked, What is the meaning of Imma'a(اِمَّعْ)?

He said; Whenever the people say, yes, you say, yes and wherever they say no, you say, no.

Don't just follow.

Number five, Rasool Allah ﷺ says in this Hadith(حديث), do not belittle any good deed.

Even if it is as small, as smiling in the face of your brother.

Don't belittle anything, whatever good there is, don't consider it to be insignificant because everything good is significant.

And maybe that small thing, will make a difference on the Day of Judgment for you.

And it will be the criteria between Hellfire and paradise.

Maybe one small deed that you would do, which you don't pay any attention to, with tilt the scale to your side, for your favor.

And how do we deduct this lesson from the story of Abu Dharr(ابو ذر).

Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه he learned very little, and all what he did was propagate the message.

And maybe he never expected that this small effort of his would end up causing the whole tribe of Ghifaar(غفار) and the whole tribe of Aslam(اسلم) to become Muslim.

Maybe he only felt that he could convince a few group of people, maybe a few of his relatives.

But for this work, to end up bearing the fruits of two major tribes becoming Muslim, may've Abu Dharr(ابو ذر) never thought about that.

But you throw the seed and Allah سبحانه وتعالى will make it grow.

And I'll mention to some contemporary examples about how sometimes you would do something very small, and you will never pay attention to it, but it will make a big difference.

And there's a Hadith(حديث) by the way that says that a person might speak a word that would please Allah and they don't pay attention to it,

but Allah سبحانه وتعالى will raise them up levels because of that.

And a person might speak a word that will anger Allah, and because of that they will be thrown in hellfire.

It's a matter of a word, here or there.

There's a brother from Canada, He said that he started having interest in learning religion at a very early age, around the age of nine.

He started studying religion, that's quite early.

He said, but he was turned away from Islam because of a lesson that he was taught in school about Islam.

He was shown some images that turned him away from Islam.

And then he said, he was going through some problems in his family his father left, and his mother was on drugs.

So, he said, he completely forgot about this issue of religion, even though he had some early interest in it.

He said, and then he became a drug user and then he was promoted to being a drug dealer.

And he went to jail at the age of 14 So, he had a turbulent life He said: Later on, towards my later teenage years.

After I came out of jail.

He said: I used to go to this park, in Canada, it's in the center of the city.

And that's where the drug addicts would usually congregate.

And we would all smoke and use our drugs and you'd find needles all over, that's where we all come together and get high.

He said: So I went there, and I was sitting next to this guy who looked foreign, and I was smoking my dope and I saw something interesting.

He said: The way that this guy next to me used to wrap is marijuana or hashish or whatever it was.

I am not very familiar with their specific terms.

He said: The way he used to wrap it, was different.

So, that caught my eye, I asked him, I see that the way you wrap your hashish or hash is different.

Where are you from? He said: I'm from Morocco.

He said: So you must be a Muslim. He said, Yes, I'm a Muslim.

He said: Can you tell me something about Islam?

Now he's remembering his early years of studying about religion.

He said: Tell me about Islam.

He said: So, this Moroccan guy was going through the tenants of Islam, and we're all smoking, and we're very high and, I mean, he's speaking,

and I'm just receiving all of that information and absorbing it, and we were both high.

He is speaking very well and I'm understanding very well.

He said, for two hours continuously, we were talking about Islam.

He said, until we ran out of drugs we had nothing left.

He said and then we continued the conversation for another two hours, four hours in total.

And he said, that Allah سبحانه وتعالى sent another person to sit next to us.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) it was Qadar(قدر) of Allah, an Algerian person, who wasn't on drugs or anything, he was just there, he happened to be there.

He said: He sent us to us, to correct whatever mistakes that, that person would make, you know, people have different understanding of Islam, so they will correct each other.

And whenever one of them would mention, something wrong, the other person would correct the false information.

He said: We continued the conversation for four hours.

After that I became Muslim.

He said: Now, neither did the Algerian or Moroccan person know that I became Muslim because I left and then became Muslim on my own.

And I stopped using drugs, and I actually met him and he was during Da'wah(دعوة) at that time.

When he was telling us his story, there was a group of us.

So, one of the brothers who was sitting and hearing the story said a bad word about that Moroccan person, because of using drugs.

This Canadian Muslim brother his face turned red and he became very upset and angry.

And he said, Don't speak about him, because I became Muslim through him.

And every single thing that I do my Salah(صلاة), my Sayyam(صيام), my Zakaat(زكواة), my Zikr(زكر) every single thing that I do, a copy of it will be deposited in his account.

Now, only Allah knows where that person is, he might still be in the park using drugs, he might be lost.

And he never knows that in his account, is Salah(صلاة) and Sayyam(صيام) and Zakaat(زكواة), they're all deposited, and he knows no idea about it.

He'll come on the day of judgment and see all of this and not know where it came from?

I was in those parks using drugs, where did all of these good deeds come from?

It all happened because of a few words that he said to a drug addict, like himself.

Now, maybe he never knew that this person would become Muslim, maybe he never intended it, he just was conversing, talking.

But he threw something good out there and these are the fruits of it.

So, never belittle anything, maybe there's a small thing that you would do here and there.

And this would be the cause of your salvation on the Day of Judgment.

While the big things that you're doing, the big projects, the things that you're spending a lot of time on, wouldn't bear such an harvest.

And this is something that is in the hands of Allah.

So, you never know, therefore, you should do whatever good you can.

And leave it all there, just throw the seeds and Allah سبحانه وتعالى will make them grow.

But do not belittle anything.

Even if it is as much as smiling in the face of your brother.

We'll move on to the Hijrah(هجرة) to Abyssinia, the migrations.

Actually one more story that I was mentioned to you, to illustrate the same point further.

And this story was told to me by the person themselves, both stories were narrated to me by the persons themselves.

This was an African American, who was a student at Berkeley University, University of Berkeley, University of California in Berkeley, and he hear about Islam, but he didn't really know much about it.

African Americans tend to know about Islam, because they would have relatives who are Muslim, or they would have a mosque next to them.

I mean, there's a very old tradition of Islam among African Americans in America.

So, you would usually find that they would have one member of their family or one friend who embraced Islam or is a Muslim.

So, in general, they are more familiar than anybody else in America, about Islam.

So, he knew about Islam but he didn't know the details about it, and he wasn't very interested in it.

He said: one day, in the beginning of the semester, I was walking through campus, and a member of the Muslim Student Association was handing out copies of Qur'an, translations of Qur'an

He said: I picked up a copy, and on my way home on the bus, had nothing to do.

So, I opened up this book that was given to me as a gift, I had no idea what it is And I opened up the first page, which is Al-Fatiha(ألفاتحه).

I saw that this is an introduction to the book and who reads introductions, so I flipped the page.

And I went straight to the body of the book.

Now the first thing that he would see next is, Surah Al-Baqarah(سورة البقرة) He said: I began reading, There is no doubt in this book.

No doubts in this book.

He said, I was shocked by that statement.

Usually, when an author would write a book, they would start by apologizing for their mistakes, apologizing for their shortcomings.

And here you have an Author who was so confident about Himself, He stating that there's no doubt in My book, and that's the first thing that you see in front of your eyes.

So, I was quite amazed and I wanted to know who is the author of this book?

I flipped the front cover didn't see any name, look at the back, didn't see any name.

I didn't know who wrote this book and I kept on reading.

And then eventually, I realized that this wasn't written by man, this comes straight from Allahعَزّ وجَلّ.

The power and the confidence that faces you as soon as you open the book, he said: It made my heart shake.

And he said that was the reason, why I became Muslim Just that verse There's no doubt in this book.

Now, again, that person who was giving out, Qur'an might be thinking, well, nobody's going to read this.

I'm just wasting my time, I'll just do it because they asked me to.

Because of that Qur'an this brother became Muslim.

And he's an Imam and he's very active in Da'wah(دعوة) and many people became Muslim through him, and that was a product of a very small effort.

Alright We'll we move on to Al-Hijrah(الهجرة) to Al-Habasha(الحبشه).

There are two migrations that happened to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه).

The first one happened in the fifth year of Ba'atha(بعثه), following revelation.

And it was composed of a small group 12 men and four women.

The second Hijrah(هجرة), migration was a larger group and it was composed of 83 men and 18 or 19 women.

And this was more of a sporadic migration, maybe they didn't go in one, one group.

Now, how come there are two migrations to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه).

When the first group went to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه), they heard a rumor that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) have became Muslim.

Rasool Allahﷺ received the Ayaat(آيات) of Surah Al-Najam(سورة النجم) and he recited those Ayaat(آيات) and those Ayaat(آيات) were so powerful that it had so much effect on the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

when they heard the last Ayah(آية), which is an Ayah(آية) of Sujood(سجود), Rasool Allahﷺ and the Muslims made Sujood(سجود), the Kuffar(كفار) made Sujood(سجود) with them.

They were so in tune with the Ayaat(آيات) they made Sujood(سجود) with the Muslims.

And this was the origin of that false rumor that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) became Muslim.

So, you had a group of the ones, who made Hijrah(هجرة) comeback to Makkah to find that it was a false rumor.

So now, we had another Hijrah(هجرة), which was a larger group.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he saw the pain and suffering that his companions are going through.

He said: Why don't you go to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه) because therein is a king, who does not oppress anyone.

The king is just and he does not oppress anyone.

So, they went to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه) and the first to leave were Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) and his wife, the daughter of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

There is a narration that says that Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان ابن عفان) and his wife are the first to make Hijrah(هجرة) in the sake of Allah, after Loot(لوط).

They went to Al-Habasha(اَلْحَبَشَه) and the second group came in.

So they left Makkah.

Does that mean that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) would leave them alone?

No.

even though, the Muslims in Abyssinia were no threat to Makkah politically.

They were no threat to the economical interests of Makkah.

Nevertheless, the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) did not want to leave the Muslims alone.

In other words, even if we are left alone, we're not going to leave you alone.

We're going to stay after you until we destroy your religion.

So, the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), assembled the delegation to go and meet with An-Najashi(النجاشي) to ask him to turn over the Muslims.

And who did they choose for this mission.?

Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص) and Abdullah Bin Rabiya(عبدالله بن ربيعة) in one narration and Amir Bin Rabiya(عامر بن ربيعة) in another narration,

but the central figure here is Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص).

Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص) was a diplomat, was a very intelligent man of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), he had wide connections, he was a friend of the kings of the world at that time.

So, he was the right person to choose.

And he was a mastermind in plotting and planning.

And you can see that he was very good in conspiracies, against the Muslims.

That was the personality Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص) before Islam.

Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص), he went to An-Najashi(النجاشي) and the plan was that he's going to go and meet the top officials first.

And he's going to give every one of them gifts, or in other words, bribes.

And he's gonna present to them his case and say that in your land, or some fools who ran away from Makkah, we wanted to turn them over.

So, he wants to work it out with all of the top officials before he meets with An-Najashi(النجاشي).

So, when he talks to An-Najashi(النجاشي) and he consults his officials, they will all give him a unified opinion that you should have them over.

So, he went to everyone of them, he had a meeting with every one of them and gave them gifts.

And then he went to meet An-Najashi(النجاشي).

And he has told the officials that I prefer that you hand us over these people without having them meet An-Najashi(النجاشي).

I don't want them to meet An-Najashi(النجاشي), because their words are very effective.

They feared Qur'an.

So, he worked out the plan and he went to meet An-Najashi(النجاشي).

And he told An-Najashi(النجاشي), that there are some fools among us, who came to your land.

We know them and they left our religion, they didn't follow yours.

And they went on and on and on, and in the end, he said: We want you to hand them over to us.

Now all of the officials were already there and they said yes, hand them over.

An-Najashi(النجاشي) said: No I will not hand over people who sought refuge in my land, until I hear their side of the story.

See the justice that An-Najashi(النجاشي) had.

And the choice of Rasool Allah ﷺ to have, his Sahabah(صحابه) go to the right place.

So, Najashi(النجاشي) called the Muslims to come and meet him.

The Muslims received the message, they were told that Amr Bin Aas(عمرو بن عاص) has met with An-Najashi(النجاشي) and An-Najashi(النجاشي) wants to meet you.

So, they had the Shura'a(شورى), advice.

And Jafar Bin Abi Talib(جعفر إبن أبي طالب) was to be their spokesman the only spokesman and that they're going to speak the truth.

They went in to meet An-Najashi(النجاشي), An-Najashi(النجاشي) asked them, what religion are you following?

You left the religion of your people, you didn't join my religion, you didn't join any of the religions of the world?

Who are you?

There's a Hadith(حديث) narrated by Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها, it narrates this speech that Jafar Bin Abi Talib(جعفرإبن أبي طالب) gave in front of An-Najashi(النجاشي)

and I want to read the exact words of Jafar(جعفر) because there's a lot to learn from this presentation.

Jafar(جعفر) said, and Jafar(جعفر) is the cousin of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he is the brother of Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب).

He said: O king! We were a people of polytheism.

We worshipped idols, ate the meat of animals that had died, offended rules of hospitality and permitted things forbidden, as in the shedding of one another's blood, and so on.

We completely ignored matters of right and wrong And so God sent to us a prophet.

So, notice the opening of the speech is talking about their background, I want you to follow the speech and look at how Jafar Bin Abi Talib(جعفر إبن أبي طالب) arranged speech.

Keep in mind that he is talking to somebody who has no background whatsoever about Islam, he doesn't know anything about it.

He's speaking to someone who's Christian, and he's speaking to a king.

So, he gave him background information of who, we used to be, this was our situation.

"We were people of Shirk(شرك) who used to worship idols we used to eat the meat of dead animals.

We offended rules of hospitality and permitted things forbidden, We used to shed each other's blood, we completely ignored matters of right and wrong.

So, he gave him an impression that we used to live in a chaotic stage.

And then, he said, And so God sent to us a prophet from among ourselves, whose honesty and trustworthiness we knew well.

With this statement, he has established credibility in the Prophet.

So now, An-Najashi(النجاشي) knows that Muhammadﷺ is from among the people, his people know him very well, they know his trustworthiness, and they know his truth.

He summoned us to pray to God alone, and without associate told us to respect rights of kinship, to honor rights of hospitality, to pray to God, the Almighty and glorious

to fast for Him and to worship none other than Him.

Here he gave him issues of Tauheed(توحيد), oneness of Allah, and also the morals that Islam teaches.

He gave him a little bit of both.

And he said: And he, and so he called us to God, to affirm His oneness to worship Him and to tear down all the other stones and idols, we and our forefathers had worshipped apart from Him.

He ordered us to be truthful in our speech, to keep up to our trust, to respect kinship ties, and hospitality rights and to abandon things forbidden and the shedding of blood.

He forbade us to do anything immoral to tell lies, to misuse the fund of orphans, or to make false accusations against women of virtue.

He ordered us to worship God, and to associate no other God with Him.

He told us to pray, to give alms and to fast.

And then he enumerated for him all aspects of Islam.

Can anyone have any disagreement with anything that Jafar(جعفر) said?

Truth, trustworthiness.

So, it's important when you're speaking to somebody who don't know anything about Islam, to illuminate to them the aspects of Islam, the good teachings of Islam.

Sometimes in our Daw'ah(دعوة), we assume that people know that Islam teaches good, many don't and Jafar(جعفر) took that into consideration.

And he went through the morals and the character building that Islam promotes.

In addition to talking about the Ibadaat(عبادات) he spoke about Salah(صلاة), Zakaat(زكواة) and Sayyaam(صيام).

And he also spoke about the Tauheed(توحيد), which is very important to present, the worship of Allah alone, and tearing down the stones and idols.

You can also notice that it was very brief and to the point, he didn't go on and on and on in details, he didn't turn it into an argument or debate.

Because remember, he's dealing with the king You can't argue with such a person if you want to bring them closer to Islam.

So, he made it a very short and brief presentation.

But it's complete, it's comprehensive, there's nothing missing.

And then he said: And so we believed in him and trusted him, following him in the instructions he brought from God, we worship God alone without partner and associating no one with Him.

We forbade what he has forbidden and considered permissible, what he allowed us.

But our people aggressed against us and harmed us seeking to draw us out of our faith to return us to the worship of idols instead of God.

And to have us again, consider permissible the abominations we had previously allowed.

When they treated us with violence and persecution besieged us and prevented us from performing our religion.

We left for your country and chose you above others we desire your hospitality and hoped, we would not be harmed in your domain, O King.

Wonderful ending!!

Let's look at the statements before that.

He said our people aggressed against us, harmed us.

They tried to force us to give up our faith.

They besieged us, they persecuted us.

Don't you think that this will this will strike a chord with An-Najashi(النجاشي), who was coming from a Christian background that stresses the issue of suffering and sacrifice.

So, these words must have brought An-Najashi(النجاشي) closer and would throw in his heart feelings of mercy towards these people and a feeling of something that we have common between us.

This suffering sounds like the suffering Eesa(عيسى) went through, sounds similar to what the prophets went through.

Because this is a man who was steeped in his religion.

And then in the end, Jafar Bin Abi Talib(جعفر إبن أبي طالب) said: the reason why we came here, is because we were looking forward to your hospitality

and we chose you over all other kings of the world.

An-Najashi(النجاشي), the Negus replied, Negus is the translation of An-Najashi(النجاشي).

He said, Did you bring anything with you from what he brought.

An-Najashi(النجاشي) now wants to hear Qur'an.

Jafar Bin Abi Talib(جعفر إبن أبي طالب) recited some Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an.

Which Ayaat(آيات) did he choose.?

There's many Ayaat(آيات) that he could choose, which Ayaat(آيات) did he choose.?

Surah Maryam(سورة مريم)!

Look at the choice of Ayaat(آيات), he recited to him verses from Surah(سورة) Maryam(مريم) Umm Salamah(ام سلمه) says that, I swear, the Negus wept so hard, his beard was soaked.

And all his bishops cried so hard, they wet their Bibles.

So, it must have been an emotional presentation and recitation to cause An-Najashi(النجاشي), the king and his bishops to cry.

An-Najashi(النجاشي) wetted his beard and the bishops wetted their Bibles, which were laying in front of them.

One brother, he was working as a taxi driver in the US.

He said: I was asked to drive a priest from Coronado Island to San Diego.

Coronado Island is an island outside of San Diego, in the US, which was quite a long distance within the city.

And it was very late at night.

So, we had a conversation and he asked me, What are you?

I said: I'm a Muslim.

Who are you? He said, I'm a Catholic priest.

And I'm here for a convention.

So, this brother said, Do you know that our Qur'an has spoken about Jesus?

Would you like me to recite to some verses in Qur'an about Jesus?

He said: Yes, go ahead.

So, the brother said: I went on reciting verses from Surah Maryam(سورة مريم) and translating them and I kept on going on and on and on and the priest was silent, sitting in the back, it was late at night, and he was sitting in the back.

He said, then suddenly the priest tell me to stop this is my destination.

The brother said: When I looked at him, I saw tears running down his cheeks.

That is how strongly influenced he was by the verses of Surah Maryam(سورة المريم).

He said what the good thing after that he gave me a 100 Dollar tip.

So, people who love Eesa(عيسى), who love Jesus, when they hear the story of Jesus in Qur'an it's, it's quite emotional So, it cause An-Najashi(النجاشي) to weep.

docs.title: Seerah of Muhammad Part 11 of 53 VIDEO

parts.english:
Continuing with the response of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) towards the message of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

We talked about a few yesterday, we'll continue with the rest.

Number eight, they would try to put Muhammadﷺ under pressure.

They were persistent, they would never give up, they would keep on trying every method including, using his close uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب) to pressure him.

In this narration, we have over here, Aqeel(عقيل), the son of Abu Talib(ابوطالب), he narrates and says that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), they came to Abu Talib(ابوطالب), and they told him;

This nephew of yours is disrupting and disturbing us in our meetings and in our mosque.

So, they consider the Da'wah(دعوة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ to be disruption.

So, tell him to stay away from us.

Abu Talib(ابوطالب) told Aqeel(عقيل), go and call Muhammad(محمد) for me.

So, Aqeel(عقيل) said: I found him in Qanas(قَنَسْ), Qanas(قَنَسْ) means, a very small room or a tent and it was noon time very hot in Makkah.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ came to meet his uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب).

So, his uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب) told him, that your people are complaining and saying that you are disrupting them, and you are disturbing them in their meetings.

So, why don't you stop.

And Abu Talib(ابوطالب) was not speaking to Muhammadﷺ, in a tone of an order, do this!

But he was telling him as an advice, it's better, you know, so that you would not (harm or) have your people upset, how about if you stop disturbing them or disrupting their meetings, in a very kind way.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told Abu Talib(ابوطالب) Rasool Ullah, he looked at the sky and he pointed it to the sun and told Abu Talib(ابوطالب), O my uncle, Do you see the sun?

He said: Yes.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I am no more capable of stopping that, than you are, of getting me a flame from it.

In other words, it's impossible for me to stop this.

Just like it is impossible for you to get a flame from this sun.

This is part of me, Da'wah(دعوة) is my life, spreading Islam is my mission, I cannot give it up, it's impossible.

And you must have heard of the narration when Rasool Allah ﷺ says: If they put the sun, on my right hand and the moon and my left hand I would not give up this matter, until Allah سبحانه وتعالى judges or I lose my life.

That is a weaker narration.

But we find the same meaning in the strong narration.

That no matter what I will continue with this mission.

His uncle told him, O my nephew, you are telling the truth, I believe you, go ahead and continue.

So, Abu Talib(ابوطالب) was telling Muhammadﷺ, I believe you that you cannot give this up.

Go ahead, I will support you, do what Allah has told you to do.

We see from this, that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are using every method, to try to sway Muhammadﷺ and they would never give up, I mean, even when Rasool Allah ﷺ told the Sahabah(صحابه), and we gonna talk about next.

When the Messenger of Allah told the Sahabah(صحابه) to go to Al-Habasha(ألحبشه), to Abyssinia, so that they could flee from the persecution,

still Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) weren't satisfied with that and they sent a delegation to ask An-Najashi(أنجاشي) to turn the Muslims over, Why.?

Were the Muslims in Abyssinia any threat to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) politically?

No.

Were they, a threat economically? No.

So, what is the reason Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) are so persistent in following the Muslims even though the Muslims left them alone.

So, the issue here, even if Rasool Allah ﷺ would have stopped, they wouldn't have left Rasool Allah ﷺ alone.

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) wanted to stop this message, by all means possible.

And if you would leave them alone, they won't leave you alone.

Number nine:  Jealousy and hatred, Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيره), one of the elders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), he said; If Allah wanted to choose a Prophet, how come he didn't choose me?

I'm more wealthy and wise and older than Muhammadﷺ, and there was a similar claim made by a man in At-Taef(ألطائف), now the two prominent towns of Hijaaz(حجاز) were Makkah and At-At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف).

So, Allah سبحانه وتعالى revealed the Ayah(آية), Why wasn't this Qur'an revealed to a great man from one of the two towns, referring to Makkah and At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف)?

Al-Mugheera Bin Sho'bah(المغيرة بن شعبه), who was from At-Taef(اَلطَّائِف), he was visiting Makkah, and he said, and this Hadith(حديث) is narrated by Al-Bayhaqi(البيهقي).

Al-Mugheera Bin Sho'bah(المغيرة بن شعبه) said: My first contact with Rasool Allah ﷺ happened one day, when I was walking with Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) in the streets of Makkah

and he ran into Muhammadﷺ.

So, he walked up to us, and he spoke to Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) and said: Why don't you follow me, believe in Allah believe in Islam.

He was giving Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) Daw'ah(دعوة).

Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) responded by saying; O Muhammad(محمد), when are you going to stop cursing our gods?

If you want us to testify that you have fulfilled your mission, we will testify for you.

And if I knew that you were telling the truth, I would have already followed you, Muhammadﷺ left.

The meaning of the words of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), if you want us to testify that you have fulfilled the message because Rasool Allah ﷺ was telling them again and again that my role is to convey a message.

It is not my role to convert you, that is up to Allah.

All what I want to do is to fulfill my mission.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was saying if you want us to witness for you, in front of Allah we'll do so.

We'll tell Allah that you have done your job, but just leave us alone.

Because if I knew that you were telling the truth, I would have already followed you.

So, Muhammadﷺ left, AL-Mugheera(المغيره) said: Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) looked at me and said: I know that he's saying the truth, but there's something holding me back.

The descendants of Qusa'e(قُصَئْ) said: We want to have Hijabah(حِجَابَهْ).

Remember, these are the honors of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) the power and the authority of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

We talked about it, when we talked about Qusa'e Bin Kalaab(قصئ بن كلاب), if you remember AL-Hijabah(الحجابه) and Siqayah(سقايه), An-Nadwah(اَلنَّدوَةْ), An-Nadwah(اَلنَّدْوَة) means the assembly of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

AL-Hijabah(الحجابه) is the guardianship of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

Sikayah(سقايه) and Rifadah(رفاده) is providing the pilgrims with food and water, and the Luwaa(اللؤآء) is the banner of war.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) said: I know that this man is telling the truth, but there's something holding me back, the descendants of Qusa'e(قُصَئْ) said, we want the authority of An-Nadwah(اَلنَّدوَةْ),

we gave it to them.

We want the authority of AL-Hijabah(الحجابه), we gave it to them.

We want the authority of Luwaa(اَلُّؤآء), we gave it to them, we want the authority of Rifadah(رفاده) and Siqayah(سقايه), we gave it to them.

And now when we started picking up and competing with them, and we were running neck to neck they came up and say that we have a Prophet among us, how can we compete with that.

By God we never gonna accept this.

Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) is saying that this is a matter of competition, power struggle between us and the family of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

They have been given all of the authorities of Makkah.

And now we want to catch up with them, compete with them.

We can't compete with them and providing for the pilgrims and things like that, but we can't compete in Prophet hood.

None of us can compete with the Qur'an that is been given to Muhammadﷺ.

So, we're never going to admit that that's the truth.

Because if we do, that means they would have won against us.

So it's a matter of power, and authority.

So, you can see the element of jealousy and hatred, and not willing to give up power.

And that's why, you would find again and again in Qur'an, that's usually the ones, who are the most outspoken, and violent in their rejection of the message of the prophets are the ones in authority, the people in power,

Why?

Because they feel that this is a message that will change the status quo and will strip us from our abilities to take advantages of others and to enslave others.

This is a religion that will free people from worshipping people into worshipping Allah.

And these are referred to in Qur'an as Al-Malaa(ألملاء) whenever you would have Al-Malaa(ألملاء) in Qur'an it is referring to the leadership.

And this comes up with Firaoun(فرعون) it comes up with the people of Aad(عاد), Salih(صالح) you'd find that it is Al-Malaa(ألملاء).

Ten(10), persecution: Now, even though Rasool Allah ﷺ was insulted and harmed and false accusations were directed towards him, he was not persecuted.

And that is part of the protection, of the protection of Allah towards Muhammadﷺ.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى has protected Muhammadﷺ in the early years through his uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب).

And later on, they would try to assassinate him and Allah سبحانه وتعالى would protect him, even though his uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب) has passed away.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ wasn't really persecuted, but it was his followers, who were persecuted.

And this was the opinion of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ), he states that he said that Allah has protected Muhammadﷺ because of His love of His messenger.

And Allah has protected him through his uncle Abu Talib(ابوطالب).

These are the words of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ).

But the persecution of the followers of Rasool Allah ﷺ used to hurt the Messenger of Allah a lot, because he cared about them so much.

And pretty much all of them, went through one form of persecution or another.

In one statement of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ), he says that They would wrap them up in shields of iron and leave them in the sun to burn.

So, they would cloth them in shields of iron, steel, and they would leave them in the hot sun of Makkah.

Now, the strongest among the Sahabah(صحابہ), in his response, in fighting the persecution was Bilal Bin Rabbah رضي الله عنه.

The more they would persecute him, the stronger he would become.

He was asked, how come when you were punished, and tortured, you would say Ahad-Ahad(احد احد), Allah is one, Allah is one.

How come you chose that slogan?

Bilal(بلال) said: Because I found out that, when I would say Ahad-Ahad(احد احد) it would make them the angriest.

This statement would anger them the most.

And that is why, I would say Ahad-Ahad(احد احد).

So, Bilal(بلال) wasn't looking for a way to reduce the punishment, he didn't care.

And the statement of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) is That he sold himself to Allah سبحانه وتعالى, he gave up his life to Allah.

He would say Ahad-Ahad(احد احد) and Umayyah Bin Khalaf(اميه بن خلف) would become angry and would add the punishment, and Bilal(بلال) would only say it louder, wouldn't give up.

Now they went through different forms of torture.

And the torture was not only limited to the slaves and servants but even some of the nobility were tortured.

Uthman Ibn Affan(عثمان بن عفان), belonging to one of the noblest families of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), Bannu Umayyah(بَنُو اُمَيَّه), he was wrapped in a carpet and then they would jump over him and crush him inside that carpet.

And you're familiar with some of the stories of persecution that happened to the slaves.

Like what happened to Sumayyah(سميه), and her husband and her son, Yasser(ياسر), and Sumayyah(سميه) were both killed, under the severe tormenting of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

In one narration, it states that Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) struck Sumayyah(سميه) with a spear in her private parts, until he killed her.

And all of this was becoming so much on Sayyedina Ammar رضي الله عنه, it's a combination of psychological pain and physical pain, physical pain because of the tormenting was going through.

Plus seeing his mother and father go through this severe punishment and sad ending.

Ammar Bin Yasir(عمار بن ياسر) buckled under this pressure and he spoke some words against Muhammadﷺ.

Now, when he woke up from the pain, he went to Rasool Allahﷺ, sad and sorry for what has happened and he narrated the incident to Muhammadﷺ.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى revealed an Ayah(آية) dealing with that particular situation, saying that one is excused to speak some words with the tongue, under this torture if the heart is confident with faith,

if the heart is firm on Eeman(ايمان) and has Yaqeen(يقين) it is ok for a person to speak, because Allah سبحانه وتعالى does not overburden a person.

This is unbearable pain that Ammar Bin Yasir(عمار بن ياسر) was going through.

So, this persecution continued with almost all of the Sahabah(صحابہ) with a few exceptions, the ones who had some strong backing of their families and had some sympathy from some of their non believing relatives.

Now the severest in his punishment and the one who would actually mobilize the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), was Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل).

He was their leader in evil, Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) states: "that sinner Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was the one, who incited the men of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) against them.

When he heard of a man of status and influence who had accepted Islam.

He would upbraid and insult him saying, you have abandoned the religion of your father, a man better than you.

We will depreciate your values, deride your opinions and destroy your reputation.

If the Muslim were merchant, he would say we will by God boycott doing business with you, and we will ruin you.

If the Muslim was defenseless Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) would beat him up and incite others against him, may Allah damn and punishment him.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was the spear head of the efforts of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) against the Muslims in Makkah.

Number 11: Forgot to mention Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), he had a slave girl that he would torture,

and sometimes he would stop.

And to show you, his personality, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) when he would stop, he would tell her, don't think that I'm giving you a break because I'm having sympathy on you.

The only reason why I stopped is because I'm tired.

Otherwise I would continue.

But Allah سبحانه وتعالى guides whomever He wills.

11) When the attempts of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) of character assassinations failed.

They attempted to assassinate the character.

They tried to destroy the message by distorting the image of the messenger.

When that didn't work, they tried to eliminate the Messenger.

And these attempts occurred after Abu Talib(ابوطالب) passed away.

They knew that they have no way of assassinating Muhammadﷺ during the life of Abu Talib(ابوطالب).

But when he passed away, they attempted to assassinate him.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says they attempted to drive you out of your land, to imprison you and to kill you.

So, the attempts were made but Allah سبحانه وتعالى would protect him, and we'll talk about one of these attempts when we talk about Hijrah(هجرة).

So, these are the various methods that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) used at one time or another during the era of Makkah.

What was the response of Rasool Allahﷺ, how would he respond to all of this?

In Al-Bukhari(اَلبُخَارِي), Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت), who was one of the Sahabah(صحابہ) who went through a lot.

He went to Rasool Allah ﷺ while the Messenger of Allah was leaning his back towards the Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

And he walked up to Muhammadﷺ and said, O Messenger of Allah, Why don't you make Dua(دُعَا) for us?

That's all what he said.

But the message implies that we are going through a lot.

Why don't you ask Allah to ease the pain that we're going through.

And Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت) was going through a lot himself.

One day later on, when Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) was the Khalifah(خليفه), Umar(عُمَر) was asking all of the people around to talk about their experiences in Makkah.

What did you go through?

So, when the term came on Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت), he didn't speak.

All what he did was, lift his shirt and expose his back. That's it!

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) Said: I have never seen something like this.

What happened to you?

Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت) had deep holes, deep black holes in his back.

He said when I was in Makkah, the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) would bring some rocks and burn them over fire, some small rocks and they would burn them on fire until they turn red.

And then they would lay them on the hot sand in the desert of Makkah, and they would throw me on top of it.

So, these rocks, they would burn through my flesh and I would hear the burning of my flesh and I would smell my fat, grease is burning.

He said: I would smell the smoke coming off from my back.

So, Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت) had something to complain about.

This was severe pain that he was going through, and all what he asked for is O Rasool Ullah, why don't you ask Allah to give us victory?

What was the response of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ he sat straight and his face turned red and that would happen to Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he would become angry.

And then he said, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: A believer among those who were before you, used to be combed with iron combs that would separate the flesh and nerves from their bones.

So, you'd have iron combs, and they would comb the flesh of their bones.

But they would never desert their religion.

And they would bring one of them and place a saw on top of their heads, and they would be cut into two halves.

And yet they would never give up their religion.

In the name of Allah, Allah will give His religion victory, until a traveler will go from Sana'a(صنعاء) all the way to Hazaral Maot(حضرموت), fearing no one but Allah.

What can we learn from this Hadith(حديث).?

Number one, Rasool Allah ﷺ is asking us to be patient.

Be patient, even if you are going through a lot, be patient never give up, All what Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت) was going through, still Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling him be patient.

The second lesson, Allahسبحانه وتعالى has some laws, just like there are laws in nature, there are laws of history, there are laws of sociology, there are laws of psychology,

and there are laws in the establishment of religion.

And you will have to go through the stages and Allahسبحانه وتعالى will not give you an exception you will have to go through what the nation's before you, went through.

This is what they went through.

The same will happen with you and Rasool Allah ﷺ wanted his Ummah(امة) to be the best of nations.

If the people before were patient, I want my Ummah(امة) to be more patient.

If the people before were strong, I want my people to be stronger.

And that's why Rasool Allah ﷺ was angry.

He wants the best to be in his Ummah(امة).

He wants his Ummah(امة) to show the best example.

He wants to be proud with us on the Day of Judgment.

Therefore, dear brothers or sisters, we have to live up to what Rasool Allah ﷺ expects from us.

He wants to meet us on the day of Judgment and see us and he wants to be proud with us.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ has stated this in a few Ahadith(احاديث).

For example, in one Hadith(حديث) Rasool Allah ﷺ says: I want you to get married and to multiply, because I want to be proud with your numbers on the Day of Judgment.

He even wants to be proud with our numbers.

So he's asking us to have a lot of kids, and he's asking us to get married.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ in another Hadith(حديث), I saw a huge nation in front of my eyes.

So, I asked the angels who are accompanying me, Is this my Ummah(امة)?

They said: No, this is not your Ummah(امة); this is the Ummah(امة) of Musa(موسى), these are Banni Israel(بني اسرائيل).

So, Banni Israel(بني اسرائيل) is the second largest Ummah(امة) after the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ, it's a huge numbers.

So, the greatest Ummah(امة) after the Ummah(امة) of Muhammadﷺ is the children of Israel(اسرائيل) And then the Angels told me: Look at your right side.

So, I looked and I saw people filling the horizon.

They told me look at the left side and I looked and I saw people filling the horizon.

The angels told me, this is your Ummah(امة), in addition to them, Allah will give you 70,000, who will enter Paradise without going through reckoning.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said in another narration of the Hadith(حديث), that I was very impressed by their looks.

I was so impressed by their looks, I was proud and the interpreters of the Hadith(حديث), the commentators of the Hadith(حديث) said, Rasool Allah ﷺ was impressed because he saw on them, the signs of Sujood(سجود) and Wudhoo(وضؤ)

and that made light shine out of their faces.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ loves this, he loves to see his Ummah(امة) in the best shape and form.

So, he is telling Khabbab Ibn Arat(خباب ابن ارت), you have to be patient, this is what happened to the people before.

You have to go through that, and you have to show a better example.

Third lesson, to be learned.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Allah will complete His religion until a traveler will leave from Sana'a(صنعاء) all the way to Hazaral Maot(حضر موت) fearing no one but Allah.

How come Rasool Allah ﷺ chose Sana'a(صنعاء) and Hazaral Maot(حضر موت).?

Rasool Allah was in Makkah why didn't he use Makkah as a reference point, since they were insecure.?

How cannot speak about their insecurity, how come Rasool Allah ﷺ is bringing an example from Yemen?

Both Sana'a(صنعاء) and Hazaral Maot(حضر موت) are in Yemen.

Now since this relates to somebody who's going so in security in Makkah, how came Rasool Allah ﷺ didn't say Makkah and Madina, Makkah and Hajar(هَجَر), Makkah and Syria.

Or how come he didn't choose two reference points in another country?

How come Sana'a(صنعاء) and Hazaral Maot(حضر موت)?

There's something interesting in the choice of Rasool Allah ﷺ of these particular two areas in Yemen.

Yemen used to be and still is, a very tribal society.

And in the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ all of that area was covered by armed tribes, who had constant war between them.

And they were in rivalry and it was insecure.

When Islam entered into Yemen, during the time of Rasool Allah ﷺ Islam made the whole area peaceful.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) now, when people are getting away from Islam, and we're missing the Islamic rule, that same area between Sana'a(صنعاء) and Hazaral Maot(حضر موت) today is one of the most insecure areas in Yemen.

And if somebody wants to travel through a particular route that will go through the tribal areas between Sana'a(صنعاء) and Hazaral Maot(حزرالموت) forget about traveling, if you are not armed.

So it's, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) very interesting that Rasool Allah ﷺ chose this area, which is now one of the more insecure areas in the world as a reference, to say that you cannot have peace without Islam.

And this leads to the fifth lesson that there is no comprehensive peace unless Islam reigns.

Under Islam, people will have true peace.

And that's the meaning of the word Islam, peace.

Another example that could reveal to us how Rasool Allah ﷺ used to deal with these situations of people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), met together and said, Let's find somebody who's the most experts in poetry and magic, to go and meet Muhammadﷺ and tell us how to deal with him.

So, they decided that they're going to send Utba Bin Rabiya(عتبة بن ربيعه), who was supposedly an expert in these areas.

Utba Bin Rabiya(عتبة بن ربيعه), he went to Muhammadﷺ and said tell me, O Muhammad(محمد), who is better, you or Abdul Muttalib(عبد المطلب).

These questions are a setup, in the society of Arabia.

They had so much respect and glorification for their ancestry.

And the family of Rasool Allah ﷺ was a lineage of nobility.

So, these were, held in very high esteem, not only among the family of Rasool Allah, but among everyone in Makkah.

Qusa'e Bin Kulaab(قصئ بن كلاب), Hashim(هاشم), Abdul Muttalib(عبدالمطلب), these were people, who were glorified.

And forget about speaking against any one of them.

You just can't do that; It's not allowed, unaccepted, not tolerated.

So Utba(عتبة), who is not a descendant of Bannu Hashim(بنو هاشم) is asking Muhammadﷺ, What do you say about your father Abdullah(عبدالله), tell us what, what's your opinion about him?

What do you say about your grandfather Abdul Muttalib(عبد المطلب)?

These were setup questions.

He asked him about Abdullah(عبدالله).? Rasool Allah ﷺ remained silent, he didn't answer.

He asked him about Abdul Muttalib(عبد المطلب).? Rasool Allah ﷺ did not respond.

So, Utbah(عتبه) said: If you claim those men to be better than you the fact is they worship the gods you have criticized.

If you claim to be better than them, then speak so we can hear what you say.

By God, we've never seen any fool more harmful to his people than you.

You've caused division and dissension among us, criticized our religion and so disgraced us in the eyes of the Arabs, that the rumor is current among them, that there is a magician or a sorcerer, amidst Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Now Utbah(عتبه) is blaming Muhammadﷺ for this rumor, that there is a sorcerer in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Who founded, this rumor start with?

Who is the one, who went around telling the people that there's a sorcerer among us isn't that the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and among them Utbah(عتبة)

and now he's blaming Muhammadﷺ for it, because it affected them, and it was an embarrassment for them.

They are the ones, who told the Arabs that he's a sorcerer and now it's an embarrassment for them.

Everyone among the other tribes are speaking about the sorcerer among Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Then he said; By God, fellow it seems all we have to await, is the cry of a pregnant woman for us all to be at one another with swords, till we wipe ourselves out.

What he meant by this is, we're waiting for the cry of a pregnant woman meaning, in a very short time, we might be fighting each other in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), because of what you have brought?

You have caused disunity among us, we are about to jump at each other's throats.

And then he offered him similar offers.

What do you want status or wealth, whatever you want, we'll give it to you just tell us so that we can bring an end to this.

Rasool Allah ﷺ allowed Utbah(عتبة) to go on, with this nonsense, without interrupting him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was a very good listener.

Even though all of this was stuff that didn't make any sense.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was calmly listening.

And when Utbah(عتبة) finished, Rasool Allah ﷺ asked him: O Utbah(عتبة), are you done?

Very kindly, are you done? He said: Yes.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, did not respond to what he was saying by his own words.

But he started reciting Ayaat(آيات) from Surah Al-Fusilat(سورة الفصلت).

In the beginning, In the Name of God, the Most Merciful and beneficent Ha(ح), Meem(م), A revelation from the Most Merciful and Beneficent, a book whose verses have been detailed in an Arabic Qur'an for people who are aware,

and he went on going on and on it's about the page, quite a few Ayaat(آيات).

And he kept on reciting until he reached to a verse that states, I warn you of a terrible punishment like that which destroyed Aad(عاد) and Thamood(ثمود).

In one narration, it says that when Rasool Allah ﷺ, mentioned this Ayah(آية).

Utbah(عتبة) placed his hand over the mouth of Rasool Allah ﷺ and urged him to stop.

Because this Ayah(آية) is threatening them with punishment.

And Utbah(عتبة) knew deep in his heart that Muhammadﷺ is truthful, he never said, anything that did not come to happen and if he is threatening us with punishment, it might come to happen.

So, I need to stop him and he said, I asked you in the name of the relationship between us to stop.

And in this other narration, it states that Utbah(عتبة), went back to the people and they told them what happened.

He said, he recited to me Qur'an and I did not understand anything he was saying, except that he threatened us with a punishment like the punishment of Aad(عاد) and Thamood(ثمود),

they told him; Woe to you, he's speaking to you in Arabic and you don't understand him.

He said; In the name of Allah I did not understand, what he was talking about.

Well, the same Ayaat(آيات) say that some people have a seal over their heart, they will not understand it.

The lesson to learn from this is that Rasool Allah ﷺ dealt with different situations, different ways.

And many times he would use Qur'an to respond to what they were saying.

So, let's use Qur'an, let's use the concepts of Qur'an in our Da'wah(دعوة).

What is better to use, than the words of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ.

I'll talk about the story of the Dimaadh(ضماد), Dimaadh Al-Asdi(ضماد الازدي) was a man from Azd-Shinwaa( أَزْدِ شَنُوءَةَ ) from Southern Arabia, he came into Makkah.

And he heard some of the people in Makkah saying that there is a man among us, who was obsessed with Jin(جن).

They were referring to Muhammadﷺ.

Dimaadh Al-Asdi(ضماد الازدي) used to be a man, who would heal people, who are obsessed with demons.

So, with the right intentions, Dimaadh Al-Asdi(ضماد الازدي) went to Rasool Allah ﷺ to offer his help.

He didn't mean anything bad, I mean, he never met Rasool Allah ﷺ, he doesn't know him.

Since he was an expert healer, he went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said: I heard that you are obsessed with Jin(جن) and I'm offering my service, if you want I can help you.

Which is a quite an insulting statement, but Rasool Allahﷺ, was a very compassionate and he understood that this man might have heard some wrong information.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ started by mentioning the words of Khut'ba-Tul-Haajah(خطبة الحاجة) These are the words Rasool Allah ﷺ would usually start with, he would use these words as an opening of his speech.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ just started with these words.

Let me translate them, Praise be to God, we praise Him and seek His help whomever God leads a right! No one can lead astray.

Whomever God leads astray! No one can lead a right.

I bear testimony that there is no God but Allah alone, who has no associates.

The words in Arabic obviously have a rhyme to them and are quite eloquent, you lose that in translation.

But anyway, Dimaadh(ضماد) interrupted Rasool Allah ﷺ, he stopped him.

And he said: O, Muhammad(محمد), can you please repeat those words again.

Rasool Allah ﷺ repeated them again.

Dimaadh(ضماد) said; I have never heard something like this.

These words are so wonderful, they are going to reach the depths of the ocean, meaning these words are going to have influence.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, then pledge allegiance to me, Become a Muslim.

He immediately extended his hand and said: Rasool Allah ﷺ said: How about you also pledged for your people, your tribe.

He said: and I will pledge for my people.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) here you have a man, coming with one objective, meeting Rasool Allah ﷺ for a few minutes, leaving as a Muslim.

He came to heal Rasool Allah ﷺ, Rasool Allah ﷺ healed him.

He went and left after this short meeting as a Muslim.

That was the personality that Rasool Allah ﷺ had, he had so much presence, so much influence on people that within a short meeting it completely changes their lives.

I mean, this is a life changing event for Dimaadh(ضماد), becoming a Muslim.

It occurred within one meeting.

And this is a leadership quality that Allah سبحانه وتعالى has given Muhammadﷺ, he had this ability to influence others.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) years later, Rasool Allah ﷺ sent an army that passed next to the village of Dimaadh(ضماد).

The leader of the army, asked them did you take anything from these people.

So, one soldier in the army said: Yes, I have taken away from them, a strong camel.

The leader of the army said: Give it back because these are the people of Dimaadh(ضماد).

And Rasool Allah ﷺ has given them protection, give them back what belongs to them.

Another story with is a man called Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه), Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه) was a man from Arabia, he wasn't from Makkah, Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه) speaks about himself.

He mentions his story, it's in Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم).

He says, In the time of Jahilliyah(جاهليه), in the time of ignorance, I had belief in my heart, that the religion of my people is false.

And I had no trust or belief in worshipping idols, I knew deep in my heart that this is wrong.

And then one day I came to know, that there was a man in Makkah, preaching a new religion.

So, I immediately went on my camel to meet him.

So, I came in, and Watalaftu(وَتَلَطَّفْتُ)  He said: I had to sneak in and secretly meet him.

That was how difficult the conditions were in Makkah, that a person from outside Makkah cannot meet Rasool Allah ﷺ publicly.

You can't even meet him, he said, Watalaftu(وَتَلَطَّفْتُ) I had to do it secretly.

And then I came to meet Rasool Allah ﷺ, I told him, What are you.?

He said, I'm a Prophet.

He said: What does that mean?

He said: I was sent by Allah.

What did he send you with?

And you can notice the simplicity of the Bedouin.

The mind is not complicated with philosophy and arguments and very simple.

What are you? I'm a Prophet.

What does that mean?

It means that I was sent by Allah.

What did He send you with.?

He said: He sent me with a message of worshipping Him alone, associating no Gods with Him.

and to destroy idols.

He said: Can I follow you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: You cannot follow me now; Don't you see my situation.

But go back to your people and when you hear that I prevail then come and see me.

Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that he will prevail one day.

He said: When you hear that I have prevailed, come and meet me.

So, Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه) said: I left and I would constantly ask about news, anything that relates to Muhammadﷺ.

The travelers, I was always asked them, what is happening with Muhammadﷺ.

Until one day I heard that Muhammadﷺ has migrated to Madina and he has been victorious.

So, I went to meet him in Madina.

He said; I approached Rasool Allah ﷺ and I asked him, "Do you know me?".

This meeting now is years after he met with Rasool Allah ﷺ and he only met with Rasool Allah ﷺ for a very short time.

So, he went into Rasool Allah ﷺ and said: Do you know who I am?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes.

You are the man, who came and met me in Makkah.

And see that's another leadership quality.

You know your followers.

You remember them you remember their names, you know about them.

Sayyedina Sulaiman عليه السّلام was inspecting the army.

And his army was composed of humans, Jin(جن), birds.

So, it wasn't only restricted to one form of life, he had humans, Jin(جن), his Air Force was birds.

And he noticed the absence of one soldier, Al-Hud-Hud(ألهدهد).

One soldier was absent.

And only Allah knows the number of his army, but he noticed his absence.

Where is he.? He asked where's the Hud-Hud(هد هد).?

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ remembered Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه), years after he met him.

And he said: Yes, you are the man who came and met me Makkah.

Amr Bin Absaa(عمرو بن عبسه) said: O Messenger of Allah, teach me of that knowledge which Allah has taught you, tell me about Salah( صلاة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ described how to pray.

And then he said, teach me about Wudhoo(وضؤ), and Rasool Allah ﷺ taught him Wudhoo(وضؤ).

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۞

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۞

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ۝

وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِه اَلْبَسُوْهُمْ اَدْرَعَلْ حَدِيْدْ وَسَحَرُهُمْ فِيْ الشَّمْسَ باعُ نَفْسَه لله لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ

الله سبحانه وتعالى يَهْدِيْ مَنْ يَشَاءْ Allah سبحانه وتعالى says, وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ

وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ۝

يَا رَسُوْل الله اَلَا تَدْعُ لَنَا ، اَلَا تَسْتَنْصِرُلَنَا يَا رَسُوْل الله ، اَلَا تَسْتَنْصِرُلَنَا كَانَ يُؤتى بِمَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ فَيُنْشَرْ الْمِنْشَارُ الْحَدِيدِ مَا بَيْنَ لَحْمِهِ أَوْ عَصَبِهِ وَ عَظَمِهِ،

فَلَا يَرُدَّه’ ذَلِكَ عَنْ دِينِهِ، فَكَانَ يوتى بِاَحَدٍ فَيُوضَعُ الْمِنْشَارُ عَلَى مَفْرِقِ رَأْسِهِ فَيُشَقُّ بنصفين، فَلَا يَدَعُ دِينَه

وَلَيُتِمَّنَّ اللَّهُ هَذَا الأَمْرَ حَتَّى يَسِيرَ الرَّاكِبُ مِنْ صَنْعَاءَ إِلَى حَضْرَمَوْتَ،لَا يَخَافُ إِلاَّ اللَّهَ وَالذِّئْبَ عَلَى غَنَمِهِ

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ۝

حم ۝

تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝

كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ۝

إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلهِ، نَحْمدُهُ ونَسْتَعينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَسْتَهْدِيْ، وَنَعُوذُ باللهِ مِنْ شرورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وسَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا،

مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ اُمدِدْ يَدَكَ اُبَايعكْ اشهد ان لا إله إلا الله وأشهد ان محمد رسول الله

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا
