parts.english:
The first verses revealed to Rasool Allah ﷺ were, the verses of Surah Al-Alaq(سورة العلق), the first verses of Surah Al-Alaq(سورة العلق).

These are the first Ayaat(آيات) that were revealed.

After that the revelation stopped for a while.

And the whole initial encounter of Rasool Allah ﷺ with revelation plus the waiting period that followed it, was to make Rasool Allah ﷺ love the revelation and miss it.

And it is to leave permanent marks on him, or a permanent impression on him ﷺ.

Because we mentioned that the manner in which the revelation occurred.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was squeezed, and the same command was repeated three times.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ had to wait and he was missing the revelation so much.

There's a narration Bukhari(بخاريْ) that Rasool Allah ﷺ, he missed the revelation so much that he would go to a top of a mountain and attempt suicide.

The first Ayaat(آيات) that were revealed after Al-Alaq(ألعلق), were the Ayaat(آيات) from Surah(سورة) Al-Muzzammil(المزمل) and Sura Al-Mudassir(سورت المدثر).

Now there's a difference of opinion on which was the first but there is an agreement that these were the second and third set of Ayaat(آيات)

even though we don't know, which one of them was second or third.

So, you have the Ayaat(آيات) of Surah Al-Alaq(سورة العلق), and then you have the Al-Ayaat(آيات) of Al-Muzammil(المزمل), and Ayaat(آيات) of Al-Muddassir(المدثر).

These Ayaat(آيات), one can say that they form manual book for the Dai'yah(داعيه), the one, who was calling to Islam.

And we can summarize it in Iqra'a(إقْرَاء), Qumm(قُمْ), Qumm(قُمْ).

And you can remember this, Iqra'a(إقْرَاء), Qumm(قُمْ), Qumm(قُمْ), These were the first Ayaat(آيات) to train the early Muslims in Da'wah(دعوة).

And then other Qumm: (قُمْ) is: So, you have Iqra'a(إقْرَاء) which is command to recite and learn.

And then you have: Pray at night, and then you have: Stand up and warn.

So, the first thing is you learn and this is something that you can apply in yourself.

The first thing is you learn, you study, you gain knowledge in religion.

And then the next step is you apply this in yourself and you start preaching it to others.

Warn, so what you learn you have to teach.

Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says that, you don't attain complete Eeman(ايمان) until you go through the stages of learning and teaching and propagating the message of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

So, you have the first stage is Iqra'a(إقْرَاء) learning and then after that you start by teaching Stand up and warn Now, learning and warning or teaching, need something else to go along with it.

And that is Ibadah(عباده), forms of Nawafil(نوافل) that you do, like Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل).

And Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل) was mandatory on the early Muslims.

Allahسبحانه وتعالى made it mandatory on the early Muslims for a few years and then that was abrogated.

And however with the situation of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he had to pray Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل) it was mandatory for him, until he passed away, until he died,

Rasool Allah ﷺ was praying Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل) and it was mandatory on him.

So, here we have a complete program.

You have a program of learning, knowledge and then a program of Daw'ah(دعوة), and a program of rituals of Ibadah(عبادة).

And they all complement each other and they all assist in building a complete Muslim personality.

The work of propagating and teaching could be draining on the heart and without this element of Ibadah(عبادة), one standing up and praying to Allah سبحانه وتعالى, in the middle of the night

the heart could harshen and become rough.

So, this Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل) softens the heart and it prepares the person for the rest of the day.

Such thing can also be said about Zikr(زكر), Ibn Qayyim(ابن القيم), he talks about his Shaikh Ibn Taymiyyah(شيخ ابن تيميه).

He says that every day after Salaat-Ul-Fajr(صلاة الفجر), he would go out to the fields in the outskirts of Damascus.

And he would just sit there mentioning the name of Allah making Zikr(زكر) until sunrise.

So, we once told him, why do you do this on a daily basis.

Ibn Taymiyyah(ابن تيميه) said: This is my breakfast, if I don't have it, my body will fail me.

This is food for my soul, it gives me energy for the rest of the day.

If I don't have this meal in the morning, I'm going to be weak for the rest of my day.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was strengthened by this Ibadah(عبادة) of the Qiyaam-Ul-Lail(قيام اليل).

And it is also something that Allah made mandatory on the early Muslims, because of the unique circumstances they went through, the difficulties that they had to go through are more than anything else that the Ummah(امة) would face afterwards.

That's why they had to go through this intensive training.

Plus, they are the core group, they are the foundation of Islam.

Sahabah رضي الله عنهم are the generation, which Islam was built on, they are the ones who spread it, and if you have like a tent, there's this pillar in the middle that holds the whole tent,

that is the Sahabah(صحابہ) for this religion, they were the foundation of this religion.

So, they had to be very strong, and that strength came from this intensive training program that they went through in the early years of Makkah.

So, you had this core group which is small in number, we could say less than 100, who went through this training.

But then these people became so strong that wherever you could put them you could immediately see the influence they have on the people surrounding them.

I mean, Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), for example, are late comers to Islam, Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار) only became Muslim, in the last half of the Da'wah(دعوة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ .

But because the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) came and lived with them, and mixed with them and in the initial stage, Rasool Allah ﷺ made the Brotherhood.

you would have one Ansaari(أنصاري) and one Muhajir(مهاجر), and they were brothers.

This gave a chance for the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) to help the Ansaar(أنصار) in the religious aspect and the Ansaar(أنصار) helped the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) in the financial support and the social support that they needed.

But the Sahabah رضي الله عنهم the early Sahabah(صحابہ), the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) had this light in them that would emanate and affect the whole surrounding, around them.

So, we have Iqra'a(إقْرَاء), Qumm(قُمْ), Qumm(قُمْ), and remember these three words.

What was the response of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) to the Da'wah(دعوة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

They responded in various different ways.

And some of them were at different times, and some of them might have been stages.

But these are the different responses that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), showed towards the message of Muhammadﷺ.

And there's a list of them we'll start talking about them right now but I'll just go through the list.

And Number one, mockery, Number two, insulting and harming the Messenger, Number three, accusations or character assassination.

Number four, deforming or defaming the message.

Number five, bargaining and negotiating with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Number six, allurements and temptations, Number seven, setting challenges, Number eight, putting Muhammadﷺ under pressure.

Number nine, jealousy and hatred, Number ten, persecution, and Eleven assassination attempts.

So, In Sha Allah(إن شاءالله) we'll start with, Number one: Mockery.

When they see you they ridicule you and say Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a Messenger.

They were saying, didn't Allah find anyone else to send, I mean, there was no one better to send except you?

So, they would make fun of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they would mock at him.

Now even though, Rasool Allah ﷺ belong to the noblest family, he had the most outstanding character in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

But because he wasn't the wealthiest, because he wasn't the most powerful, they made fun of him.

People are attracted to the ones, who have wealth, and the ones, who have power.

And there's precedence in this, when the Banni Israel(بني إسرائيل) and the stories mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah(سورة البقره), when Banni Israel(بني إسرائيل) went to their Prophet and they said:

We want you to appoint a king over us so that we could fight in Jihad(جهاد).

The King appointed Talut(طالوت), the Nabi(نبي) appointed Talut(طالوت) to be a king and their leader.

They refused, even though they are the ones, who asked the Nabi(نبي) to appoint for them when the Nabi(نبي) appointed, they rejected and refused to accept, the leadership of Talut(طالوت).

Why?

They said, that he doesn't have a lot of money, he's not wealthy, Two things, they said: he is not wealthy.

And there are people more prominent among us to be kings.

And when Rasool Allah ﷺ went to At-Taef(ألطائف) and we'll talk about his story in At-Taef(ألطائف) one of the men of At-Taef(ألطائف) told Muhammadﷺ,

didn't Allah find anyone better than you to send as a Prophet.

So, they would mock at Muhammadﷺ and they would make fun of him.

The second form or the second response, that the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) showed, was insulting and harming Muhammadﷺ.

In Sahih Muslim(صحيح مسلم) Abu Hurairahرضي الله عنه narrates the story: Abu Jahal(ابوجهل), he came to some of the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), who were sitting next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and he told them,

are you allowing Muhammad(محمد) to rub his face in the dirt?

That was his evil way of saying Sujood(سجود).

Are you allowing Muhammad(محمد) to rub his face in the dirt?

If I see him do that, I will trample his neck.

If I see him do that I will trample over his neck and I will rub his face in the dirt.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ did come and he started to pray and Rasool Allah ﷺ would pray publicly in front of anyone.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was praying right there in front of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) and his friends saw this.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) stood up to go and fulfill his threat.

So, he walked up to Muhammadﷺ and Muhammadﷺ was in Sujood(سجود) and suddenly they saw Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) falling back and he was waving with his hands,

like someone who's trying to repulse a danger that is about to befall him.

So, Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) came back and they told him, what happened to you, what was wrong?

He says; What do you mean what happened.! Didn't you see what happened?

They said, no we didn't, there was nothing, all what we saw is, you falling on your back and, waving your hands.

Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) said: There was a trench in front of me, and there was fire and wings and terror.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Those were the angels, if he would have came any closer to me, they would have torn him into pieces.

So, he saw that but everybody else didn't.

All what they saw was, Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) retreating.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ said: those were the angels they would have torn him into pieces, if he came any closer.

Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت), one day came to Rasool Allah ﷺ next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

And you would notice that most of these events occur next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) because that is where Rasool Allah ﷺ would pray publicly.

And they would always try to stop him from doing that.

So, Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت) walked up to Muhammadﷺ and he grabbed his clothes and he started wrapping them around the neck of Rasool Allah ﷺ, trying to choke him

until, Abu Bakrرضي الله عنه stepped in and pushed Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت) away.

And he said: Do you want to kill a man just because he says my lord is Allah.

The reason why you want to kill him is because he's saying my lord is Allah and he pushed Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت) away.

Now for some people, they don't mind being hurt, or cursed or humiliated.

Some people naturally have thick skin, I mean, they're not sensitive at all.

But the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah صلوات الله وسلام عليه, they were very sensitive, and they had a lot of dignity.

So, such things hurt them and harm them a lot.

And the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) of Allah, they all had very respectable personalities.

So, when such things happened, I mean, these are very, very insulting events to them.

And this was hurting Rasool Allah ﷺ a lot, but he would continue with his Da'wah(دعوة) and go on, and he would follow, what Allahسبحانه وتعالى told him.

Just ignore the ignorant, ignore them.

Rasool Ullah would not respond to them, would not fight with them, he would go on with his work.

Another incident that was narrated by Al-Bukhari(اَلْبُخَارِيْ), Rasool Allah ﷺ again was praying next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) came to the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ),

who would always meet and sit, next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

And he told them, so and so has slaughtered a camel, who will go and pick up the contents of the abdomen of the camel, and dump it on Rasool Allah ﷺ in Salah(صلاة).

So, the most evil among them, Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت), he picked up the challenge and he went and grabbed all of the insides of the abdomen, the intestines and the stomach, and he carried it.

And he waited until Rasool Allah ﷺ was in the position of Sujood(سجود), and he dumped it over him.

Rasool Allah ﷺ continued with his Sujood(سجود) as if nothing happened.

And then his daughter Fatima رضي الله عنها, saw what happened to her father.

And by the way, it's very hurting to children to see their parents being humiliated, And psychiatrists in Falastein(فلسطين), they say that this is affecting the psychology of the children in Falastein(فلسطين),

when they see their fathers and their mothers abused and kicked and hit by Israeli soldiers.

So, you have an entire generation of children, who are growing up seeing their parents going through all of this abuse.

And the psychiatrist was saying that it leaves some very dangerous marks and scars on their personalities.

I mean, especially for children, it's very detrimental for them to see their parents go through humiliation.

So, Fatima رضي الله عنها she saw this happening to her father, and her father continued in Sujood(سجود), so she ran up to him and she started taking all of that dirt from the shoulders of her father.

Rasool Allah ﷺ when he finished his Salaah(صلاة).

He made a Dua(دُعَا) and he did Dua(دُعَا) publicly in front of the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

He said: O Allah punish Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) and Utba Bin Rabiya(عتبة بن ربيعه) and Shaybah Bin Rabiya(شيبة بن ربيعه), Al-Waleed Bin Utbah(الوليد بن عتبة),

Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف) and Uqba Bin Abi Moyait(عقبة بن ابي معيت).

He made Dua(دُعَا) against seven I counted six.

The seventh Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود), the narrator of the Hadith(حديث) said I forgot, who was the seventh.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ made Dua(دُعَا) against them, and this was a very rare thing that Rasool Allah ﷺ would make Dua(دُعَا) against some people.

But it's got so bad that Rasool Allah ﷺ was so hurt he made Dua(دُعَا) against them, and he made Dua(دُعَا) in front of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

Abdullah Bin Masood(عبدالله بن مسعود) said, I have seen with my own eyes, all of these men killed in the Battle of Badr(بدر), all of them.

That was the fulfillment of the Dua(دُعَا) of Rasool Allah ﷺ , they all died on Kufr(كفر).

Now, I just gave a few examples, but there are many other examples that one could go through that illuminate this point further.

Number three, Accusing the Prophet ﷺ, or what we could refer to as character assassination.

They would try to attack the character of the messenger to destroy the message.

So, they would accuse Rasool Allah ﷺ of being a magician, They said: O you who is receiving the revelation, you are insane.

They said: He's a magician, and a liar and they said he's a soothsayer, Kahin(كاهن).

They used whatever slandering terms they could use.

They'd just throw them at Rasool Allah ﷺ, in order to assassinate the character of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And the purpose of that is to destroy the message itself, because Allahسبحانه وتعالى says, They do not disbelieve you, but they are rejecting the signs of Allah.

Allahسبحانه وتعالى is saying that they don't really have a problem with you.

They do not disbelieve you, deep in their hearts, they know that you are the truthful and the honest.

But it is because they want to reject the message, they are attacking you.

So, all of these attacks that you are receiving is not because of your character, it is because of the religion.

And this will take us back to the words of Warqah Bin Nofal(ورقه بن نوفل), in the early days he told Muhammadﷺ, you will be driven out of your land.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Me, they will drive me out of my land.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that he was so admired and loved by the people of Makkah, he couldn't imagine how one day they will drive him out of his land.

But then Warqah Bin Nofal(ورقه بن نوفل) said: Anyone who would present his people with a message similar to yours, would be fought he will have enemies.

So, it's not you it is the message.

So, now they were accusing Muhammadﷺ, in order to block the message.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would go into the marketplace and the marketplaces in Makkah served not only as a place for doing business, but that's where they would hold their fairs, I'll just give the meaning of it.

They would have competitions in poetry, and they would have competitions in speeches, they would hold those competitions in these marketplaces.

So, the marketplace wasn't strictly for business but it was also the cultural center.

That's where the speakers would come, it's sort of like Hyde Park speakers from all over the world would go, and just congregate there.

Although it was a difference, I mean in Hyde park you don't necessarily get the best but in Souq Akaaz(سوق اعكاظ) you will get the best, the best speakers of Arabia would go to Souq Akaaz(سوق اعكاظ)

and they would present their works, their poetry and their speeches.

And the best of these poems will be hang on the wall of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه), they are called Al-Muallaqaat(ألمعلقات), the hanged poems.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would enter these marketplaces and speak to the masses.

In this Hadith(حديث) narrated by Imam Al-Ahmad(امام الاحمد).

Rabiya Bin Haddad(ربيعه بن حداد), he says that I saw the Messenger of Allah in the Market of Zul-Majaaz(ذوالمجاز) or the fair of Zul-Majaaz(ذوالمجاز).

And he was saying, O, you people say there is no God but Allah and you would prosper.

That was his message to the people say: Say there is no God but Allah and you would be successful.

And he would repeat that message again and again and walk and meet different people.

Now, Rabiyyah(ربيعة) said: There was a man following him.

And whoever Rasool Allah ﷺ would speak to, this man would go and speak to, and say; "Don't believe him, he's a liar" So, Rasool Allah ﷺ would go and speak to a group of people and tell them say;

you would succeed.

When Rasool Allah leaves Abu Lahab(أبو لهب) would come in, and tell the same people, "Don't believe him, he's a liar." Now, Rabiya Bin Haddad(ربيعه بن حداد) said: I asked who that man was.

They said, this is his Uncle Abu Lahab(أبو لهب).

Rabiya Bin Haddad(ربيعه بن حداد) wasn't from Makkah.

He said, I asked who that man was?

They said; This is his uncle.

Imagine how difficult this is, Abu Lahab(أبو لهب) is unwinding whatever was been winded, by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Whatever Rasool Allah ﷺ would do, Abu Lahab(أبو لهب) would go behind him and destroy it.

We gain encouragement, by seeing the fruits of our efforts.

We have to be rewarded one way or another otherwise, we wouldn't have motivation to go on.

In our work, unless there's some kind of reward, it would be impossible for us to work.

And we are rewarded in different forms, one of them is financial you're being paid for what you do.

Other forms of reward is recognition.

Third form of reward is support that you would get from workers or your leaders.

But it will be impossible to go on, if everything is against you at your work.

And what keeps you going is seeing the fruits of your efforts.

I mean, imagine that we arrange this course and it doesn't work out.

And then we try to arrange it again a month later and it doesn't work out, nobody shows up.

Imagine just they try it again next month, no one shows up.

They try it again, third time no one shows up do you think they will have the spirit to continue doing this again and again, it becomes really difficult.

Rasool Allah ﷺ and some of the many of the other Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء) they would continue doing the same thing again and again and nothing would happen.

And Noahعليه السّلام for example.

He's giving his people Da'wah(دعوة) day and night publicly and privately with no response, no response, whatsoever.

He's seeing no fruits of his efforts at all.

That's very difficult, especially when we're talking about 950 years.

Rasool Allah ﷺ in Makkah is going and speaking to these people who don't know him.

He's speaking to foreigners, and this fair of Zul Majaz(ذوالمجاز) and Aakaaz(أعكاظ).

And as soon as he speaks to the people, someone comes and distorts his reputation by saying, he's a liar.

Nevertheless, Rasool Allah ﷺ, had the encouragement to continue and speak to the people and go on and on, neglecting what his uncle was doing to him,

especially in the society of Arabia, where there's seniority.

I mean, what can Rasool Allah ﷺ do to stop his uncle.

So, he would just leave him alone and continue with his Da'wah(دعوة).

And in another narration it says that Abu Lahab(أبو لهب) would go on and tell the people.

O people, let not this man, entice you away from your religion, the religion of your forefathers.

And this was narrated by Al-Bayhaqi(ألبيهقي).

Another example narrated by Al-Bayhaqi(ألبيهقي) and Al-Hakim(الحاكم); Right before the season of Hajj(حج), Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيره), who was the elder of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) at that time,

he addressed a meeting of the leaders of the community.

And he told them, that the season of Hajj(حَجْ) is approaching, pilgrimage.

And the delegations of the Arabs are going to start pouring in.

Let's unify our opinion regarding disassociate of yours and let's not contradict each other.

What Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيره) is referring to here?

Is that the season of pilgrimage is coming and the Arabs are going to start coming to Makkah, and Muhammadﷺ will be visiting them and speaking to them.

We don't want to contradict each other in our opinion regarding him.

So, we don't want some people saying that he is a liar, some people saying is a magician, some people saying is this soothsayer we have to have a unified opinion in order to go to the people and warn them from this man.

So, the people said, you tell us what you think, we'll abide by it.

Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيره) said: I want to hear from you.

They said: We'll claim that he's a soothsayer.

He responded, No! He is no soothsayer, I have seen soothsayers and he doesn't engage in the rhymed mumbling Doug rail they use.

People are not going to believe you, if you say that he's a soothsayer.

They said: Well, let's say that he is crazy, possessed by spirits.

He said: He is not crazy.

We have seen and known those, who are crazy.

And he has none of their choking, erratic movement and mumbling.

He doesn't show the signs of people who are insane or obsessed by Jinn(جن).

They said: Well, let's claim that he is a poet.

He said: No, he's no poet.

We know poetry, in all its symmetrical forms and what he speaks is not poetry.

Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيره) in another narration says, I am the most expert among you, in poetry, I know all of its forms, and Qur'an is not poetry.

They said: Let's claim that he is a sorcerer.

He said: No! He is no sorcerer, we've seen sorcerers and their magic, and he doesn't do any of their tying and untying.

So, basically, they mentioned all, what they have and Al-Waleed Bin Mugheera(الوليد بن مغيرة) is saying that this won't make sense.

Eventually, they said; Well, what are we gonna say.

So, he thought about it for a while and then he came back and said, well, let's just say that he's a sorcerer.

Before that he said: By God, there is splendor in what he speaks in essence, he is like a palm tree, whose branches give much fruit.

All you have been saying will not be believed.

The closest thing is for you, to say, This man is a sorcerer, who comes between a man and his religion, a man and his father, a man and his wife,

a man and his brother, and a man and his tribe.

That's the closest that we can come to agree on that he's a sorcerer.

That is when Allah سبحانه وتعالى revealed the Ayaat(آيات) Verily, he thought and plotted.

So, let him be cursed, how he plotted.

And once more, let him be cursed how he plotted.

Then he thought, then he fround and he looked in a bad tempered way.

Then he turned back and was proud.

Then he said, this is nothing but magic from that of old.

This is nothing but the word of a human being.

These Ayaat(آيات) are in Surah Al-Mudassir(سورة ألمدثر).

Number four: Deforming the message.

An-Nadhar Bin Hariss(النضر بن حارث), he went to Persia, specifically to learn stories.

He went all the way to Persia to learn stories.

He came back and whenever he would see Rasool Allah ﷺ sitting with a group of people.

He would call the people and call others and say: Come to me, I have better stories to tell.

My stories are better.

And he was saying it's all about stories, what Muhammadﷺ is speaking about the past all of this, these are just fables, tales.

I have something better to offer.

They claim that these are stories or Tales of the past.

So, they wanted to say that this is just storytelling, tales that are fabricated, untrue.

Who knows what happened to Musaعليه السّلام, who knows what happened to Eesa(عيسى), who knows what happened to the other Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

He's just telling you stories.

There is no basis of what he is narrating to you.

Number five: Bargaining and negotiations; The people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) came to Muhammadﷺ and said; Let's make a deal.

We will agree to worship Allah for one day and you worship our gods for another day.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told them, I would never agree to do such a thing.

They came back to him sometime later, and they said: We have a better offer to make.

We will worship Allah for a week, and you worship our gods for one day.

He said: No.

Came back again, we have a better offer to make.

We will worship Allah for a month and you just give us one day.

Rasool Ullah said: No Allah سبحانه وتعالى revealed the Ayah(آية).

They would wish that you would compromise, so that they can compromise with you.

Their religion is manmade, they could compromise in it, they can change it.

It's okay for them to worship Allah for a day and their gods for another day.

It's fine, it's a man made religion, there's no control on it.

But Rasool Allah ﷺ is receiving Wahee(وحي) from Allah, he cannot change it.

So, he cannot compromise in the message.

The message doesn't change.

Even if you worship Allah for a year, I'm not going to give you one day.

I'm not going to give you a day in my whole life.

O you, disbelievers, I am not gonna worship what you worship, neither are you going to worship, what I worship.

You have your way and I have mine And they tried all different ways of bargaining, it would never work with Muhammadﷺ.

Now they would become upset because this is something that, they could afford to do and they were wondering how come Rasool Allah ﷺ can't do it.

Why do we have to always keep on compromising and bargaining and he is not reciprocating.

And that was a cause of obviously that aggravated them further.

But Muhammad ﷺ was telling them that I am just a conveyor of a message.

It is not from myself, it is from Allah.

6; Allurements and temptations, and Number Seven, Setting Challenges, This following narration points out to both number six and seven.

It's a narration by Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ), Ibn Abbasرضي الله عنه said that the leaders from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) met and they were next to Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and they said let's send for Muhammad(محمد) and speak with him.

And we want to exhaust all different ways and we don't want to give him any excuse.

Let's try everything with him.

So, they sent someone to call Muhammadﷺ.

Ibn Abbas(ابن عباس) says; that Muhammadﷺ came rushing, he was eager to come and meet with the leaders because he thought there might be a change of heart.

Maybe now they want to respond, maybe they're willing to soften their stance.

So, he came to them in a hurry.

When he arrived there, Utba(عتبه) started speaking to Muhammadﷺ, actually Utba(عتبه) was one of them, but there were many around all of the leaders.

O Muhammad(محمد), we sent for you to reconcile with you.

So, it started with this very nice statement.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was getting an impression that finally they're softening.

They said: O Muhammad, we sent for you to reconcile with you, by God, we know of no Arab man who has ever brought his people as much trouble as you have.

You have reviled the forbearers, criticize the religion, ridiculed the values, cursed the gods, and divided our community.

Every unpleasant thing possible you have done to make a rift, between you and us.

In another narration, they said: We have never seen a person, who has brought so much evil on his people like you have.

And now they're starting to throw out the temptations to Muhammadﷺ.

They said: O Muhammad(محمد) if you are presenting us with this message, because you are in need of money, we will collect for you money, until we make you the wealthiest among us.

O Muhammad(محمد), If you are coming up with this religion, because you are seeking power, we will appoint you as a king over us.

O Muhammad(محمد), If you are presenting us with this religion, because you are desiring women, we will choose for you the best 10 women in Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and marry them all to you.

O Muhammad(محمد), if you are presenting us with this message, because you are obsessed with devils, demons; We will spend whatever is needed to cure you, even if we have to exhaust all of our wealth in the process.

Tell us what you want?

Rasool Allah ﷺ responded and said, what you have said, does not apply to me.

I have not brought to you my message seeking your money, nor honor among you, nor sovereignty over you.

God has sent me to you as a messenger He has revealed the document to me and has ordered me to bring you good news and warn you.

I have brought you a message from my Lord, and I've given you counsel.

If you accept what I've brought to you, then that is for your good on earth, and in the hereafter, if you reject it, I will await God's decision, until he decides between myself and you.

These are the approximate words of Muhammadﷺ.

They said: Alright, if you are turning down all of our offers then, you know how narrow our land is.

You know, for those of you have seen Makkah.

Makkah is very narrow valleys surrounded by mountains you know, mountains all over.

And it's a very rough environment, the weather of it and all of these mountains, and it is very narrow.

So, they said: O Muhammad(محمد), you know how narrow our land is, and how poor we are, and how difficult our life is.

So, how about you go to your Lord, who has sent you, and you tell him to move these mountains away, just level them and give us more space and land.

And then why don't you ask him to make some rivers flow in Makkah, like the rivers of Syria and Iraq.

We want to have some rivers like other people have.

And then we want you also to go to your Lord and to tell Him to bring back to life, some of our forefathers.

And we want you to bring back to life Qusa'e Bin Kulaab(قصئ بن كلاب) because he was a truth telling Shaikh(شيخ).

And we want to ask him, if what you are saying is true or not.

And then Muhammad(محمد) if you do that, and our forefathers, agree to what you say, then will follow you.

Muhammadﷺ responded and said, this is not why I have been sent.

I have only brought you from God what He has sent me with, I have informed you of what I was sent to convey to you, If you accept it then that is your good fortune on earth, and in the hereafter.

If you reject it, I must wait patiently for God's decree and for him to judge between us.

They continued and they said: Well, how about if you then, ask your Lord to send down an angel, who will witness to your truth and also we want you to ask him to give us some castles, gardens, treasures of gold and silver.

And then how about you do this?

Why don't you tell Him to fulfill your needs because we see that you are seeking a livelihood just like we are, you doing business.

Now, if you are so close to your God why don't you tell him to give you some wealth, so that we'll know how prestigious you are, in His eyes.

That is if you're claiming to be a messenger, how come you're just like every one of us, you going and working.

Tell your Lord if He loves you to give you some Wealth.

Again, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I'm not going to do so, I am not the one to ask such things of His Lord.

That is not why I have been sent to you God has sent me to announce and warn.

If you accept my message then that is your good fortune here on Earth and in the Afterlife.

If you reject it then I must be patient and leave the matter up to God, until He decides between myself and you.

They said: Well, then fine.

Ask your Lord to bring down the punishment that you have been promising us.

Come on! Let him bring the sky upon our heads right now.

Show us if you can.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: That is up to God, if, He wishes, He will do that to you.

They commented and said: O Muhammad(محمد), doesn't your Lord know these questions that we're going to ask you?

How come is not helping you and giving you an answer.

We know who's teaching you all of this.

You are being taught this Qur'an of yours, by a man in Yamamah(يمامه) called Ar-Rahman(الرحمن).

And we're never gonna believe in that man called Ar-Rahman(الرحمن).

All of it, just fabricating lies one over another, this man in Yamamah(يمامه) called Ar-Rahman(الرحمن), something they made up and fabricated.

One of them said: We worship the angels who are God's daughters, another said: we will not believe you till you bring us God and the angels beforehand.

It's all mockery and insults, and then they left.

One of them came back, to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, one might think that this man, Abdullah Bin Umayyah(عبدالله بن أمية) felt sorry for what happened.

And maybe you wanted to come and apologize Or maybe he wanted to come and become Muslim.

Specially that he is a cousin of Rasool Allah ﷺ, his mother is Rasool Ullah's aunt.

Well, Abdullah Bin Umayyah(عبدالله بن أميه) came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and said: O Muhammad(محمد), your people have offered you the best offers, and you turned them down.

And then they asked you to perform miracles for them, and you refused.

They asked you to bring down punishment on them, and you didn't.

Now I'll tell you what?

I'm not gonna believe in you, until you bring a ladder that goes all the way up to the heaven.

And then you climb it, while I'm watching you, and you go up to God, to Allah, and you asked him to write down for you a letter, stating that you are His Prophet, and have Him sign it,

and then we want that document to come down accompanied by four angels, to be witnesses that you are a messenger from God.

And then you know what, even if you do that I think I'm not gonna believe in you, Dead End!!!

Nothing is going to work with these people.

If they see every sign they won't believe.

This was the environment Rasool Allah ﷺ was working in, dealing with these type of people.

It's a Dead End you can go any further, whatever you're going to do, I'm telling you beforehand, I'm not gonna believe.

Even if Allah sends down a message from Him personally with four angels to witness it, it's not going to be enough.

Rasool Allah ﷺ went back home, he was regretful, at the failure to achieve what he had expected from his people because he went with all of his good expectation, that now my people have changed.

That was the impression he got when they invited him.

And then suddenly he was turned down in this ruthless fashion.

parts.english:
Rasool Allah ﷺ used to spend long periods of time in Ghaar-e-Hiraa(غار حرا), in the cave of Hiraa(حرا).

One day, he was visited by the angel Jibreel عليه السّلام, Jibreel عليه السّلام came to Muhammadﷺ in his original form.

So, Muhammadﷺ saw Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) in his angelic form and not in the form of a man, which he would sometimes see him in.

In the Hadith(حديث) of Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), the well known Hadith(حديث) of Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) narrated by Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب).

Jibreel عليه السّلام came in the form of a man.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) says: A man with very dark hair and very bright white clothes and we don't see any traces of travel on him.

So, he came in the form of a man but in this particular situation Jibreel عليه السّلام appeared in his original form and that happened twice.

Jibreel عليه السّلام came to Muhammadﷺ and told him Iqra(إقراء), recite!

Now the word Iqra(إقراء) has two meanings, one of them is read and the other is recite, in the situation of Muhammadﷺ, it means recite.

Jibreel عليه السّلام told Muhammadﷺ, Iqra(إقراء), Muhammad صلوات الله وسلام عليه responded and said: I cannot read Jibreel عليه السّلام grabbed Muhammadﷺ and squeezed him, crushed him

and then he released Muhammadﷺ and told him: Iqra(إقراء), recite!.

Muhammadﷺ responded again and said: I cannot read.

So, Jibreel عليه السّلام held him a second time and pressed him hard, and then released him again and told him: Iqra(إقراء)!.

And this happened three times.

Until, Jibreel عليه السّلام eventually recited the first verses of Qur'an.

Recite in the name of Your Lord, The One, Who created, created man from clot, recite.

Recite in the name of Your noble Lord, The One, Who taught the pen.

THe taught him, what he knew not.

This was the first encounter between Rasool Allah ﷺ and the angel Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل).

The Messenger of Allah, Muhammadﷺ was terrified by that incident.

He went back home and he entered, and he immediately went to his wife Khadijah رضي الله عنها and said: Wrap me in a garment! wrap me in a garment!.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was shivering, he was feeling cold.

And he was asking his wife to wrap him up.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, was terrified and afraid because of this incident that happened to him.

Plus, Rasool Allah ﷺ had a dislike to anything that had to do with Jin(جن), and spirits, and sorcery, and he was afraid that, what happened to him might be similar to what is happening to sorcerers.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ explained the incident to his wife Khadijah رضي الله عنها.

Khadijah(خديجه) she responded and said: No, Allah سبحانه وتعالى will never forsake you because of your righteousness, She said, that you support the needy, you help the poor, you are generous towards the guests.

So, because of the prior conduct of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Khadijah رضي الله عنه knew that such a person cannot be forsaken by God.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى will protect you don't worry, what happened to you cannot be from Satan.

And then she offered to take Muhammadﷺ to her uncle, or in some narrations, it is her cousin, Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل).

So, he went to Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) and we mentioned that Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) was a man, who became Christian and he was lettered and he had scrolls from the Bible which he would study.

Khadijah(خديجه) took Muhammadﷺ to Waraqah(ورقه) and Waraqah(ورقه) asked Muhammadﷺ to explain exactly what happened.

Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) responded and said: that this is An-Namoos Al-Akbar(ألناموس الأكبر), An-Namoos Al-Akbar(ألناموس الأكبر) is the greatest Angel Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل),

who descended on Musa(موسى) Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) immediately knew that this is the angel Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) and he is revealing to Muhammadﷺ a revelation similar to that, that was given to Musa عليه السّلام

and you can see Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) that Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) here made the correlation between Muhammadﷺ and Musa(موسى) back to what we were saying.

He said this is similar to what was given to Musa عليه السّلام and then Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) said something interesting, he said:

And I wish that I was young, when your people will drive you out of your land.

This was a surprise, to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, Rasool Allah question Waraqah(ورقه) and said: They will drive me out of my land.

How could that happen?

And Rasool Allah ﷺ had every right to question what Waraqah(ورقه) was saying because Muhammadﷺ was the most beloved man, he was the most admired man in Makkah.

How could they drive me out?

Muhammadﷺ belong to the noblest family in Makkah, Bannu Hashim(بنو هاشم).

Muhammadﷺ was someone, who had no quarrels with the people, for them to drive him out of his land.

Plus, they were living in the environment, and the culture, which it was unacceptable to drive somebody out of their homeland.

In the tribal society, the only way they could survive in the harsh environment of the desert is for them to hold together.

So, you had extreme loyalty to the tribe, every member of a tribe considered that their total loyalty goes to the tribe, and the same thing the tribe is loyal to the member of the tribe.

Anything else would mean death, in that harsh environment, so they used to stick together, and their family relationships were very strong.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was asking, Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) would they drive me out of my land.?

Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) said: "Anyone who has presented his people with something similar to this, would be driven out of their land, they will take him as an enemy."

Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) was a wise man, who studied history.

And he knows the nature of the conflict between truth and falsehood.

He knew that even though Muhammadﷺ was admired by his people, even though he belonged to the most noble family, even though he had no conflicts with the members of his community.

But because he is calling them to Islam, this is what will happen to him.

He will go through these trials and tribulations and what Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) said, came to fruition.

It happened exactly as he stated.

And the words of Waraqah Bin Nofal(ورقة بن نوفل) were an early warning for Muhammadﷺ to tell him, what was coming ahead, that it's going to be difficult, and it won't be easy for you.

We talked about the revelation, the beginning of the revelation, Al-Wahee(ألوحى).

And the first words that were given to Rasool Allah ﷺ were Iqraa(إقراء), recite.

What does that mean for us? Iqraa(إقراء), these words, Iqraa(إقراء), what they mean to us, the Muslims is that we are an Ummah(امة) that reads,

an Ummah(امة) that studies and Ummah(امة) that learns.

These words had the powerful effect on an illiterate nation, that made them the scholars of the world.

When Qur'an was revealed, the followers of Rasool Allah ﷺ were mostly illiterate.

But these words inspired them to learn.

And within a very short time, the Muslim Ummah(امة) was the most educated, the most scholarly nation on the face of the earth.

And the number of scholars that this Ummah(امة) has produced, is unsurpassed.

And when you look at the qualities of the scholars of this Ummah(امة), you see their uniqueness and the fact that they don't have any resemblance in any other nation.

Take, for example, the memory of Al-Bukhari(ألبخاري), his ability to memorize over a quarter of a million Hadith(حديث) or Shafi(الشافعي), who said that when I open a book, I have to cover one page,

because I would memorize everything, I don't want the information on the two pages to mix, photographic memory.

Or the scholar Al-Wafaa Bin Aqeel(أبوالوفاء بن عقيل), who wrote an encyclopedia of 300 volumes unfortunately, it didn't survive, the original copies of it were

in the library of Baghdad(بغداد), which was sacked by the Tataar(تتار), only I think a volume or two survived.

It was the power of these words, Iqraa(إقراء) that made this Sudden change in the Ummah(امة).

Now, with Rasool Allah ﷺ the situation is different with Rasool Allah ﷺ he did not learn how to read and write.

With Rasool Allah ﷺ the word meant, recite.

For us it means that we have to learn how to read and write.

But for Rasool Allah ﷺ, it has a different meaning, it has the meaning of reciting and repeating what Allahسبحانه وتعالى has revealed to him...

Why.?

Because with Rasool Allah ﷺ, Allah wanted him to be illiterate it was part of the plan, the decree of Allahعَزّ وجَلّ, If you had known scripture before this,

or were able to write, then this would cause doubts in the ones, who want to make doubts.

So, Allahسبحانه وتعالى says that Muhammadﷺ, first of all, he did not learn any scripture before Qur'an and he had not learned the ability to read and write,

so he was illiterate.

Now why would Rasool Allah ﷺ after Islam have to learn to read and write What purpose would that serve him, what good would that do for him?

When he is receiving the knowledge fresh from Allah سبحانه وتعالى through Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل).

What purpose would it be for Rasool Allah ﷺ to learn how to read and write.

For us, reading is our key to knowledge that's how we can learn knowledge but for Rasool Allah ﷺ he was been taught by Jibreel عليه السّلام.

And there's nothing that books will do for Rasool Allah ﷺ, there is no knowledge that the books can offer to Rasool Allah ﷺ when, he is receiving the knowledge directly from Allah.

So, Iqraa(اِقراء)  has a different meaning for Muhammadﷺ.

It means recite in his case, but for us, it means read.

And this is how the early Muslims understood the first word that was revealed in Qur'an.

And notice that in the fourth Ayah(آية): The One who taught with the pen.

So, that was an indication for us that it is Allah, Who taught the pen, and it is a bounty and blessing from Him, and Allah سبحانه وتعالى makes an oath in Surah Al-Qalam(سورة القلم).

And when Allah سبحانه وتعالى makes an oath in something it is to give an importance.

So, Allah made an oath in the name of the pen.

And it is mentioned that in the Battle of Badr(بدر), the non believers, who are prisoners of war, were offered freedom, if they can teach 10 Muslims how to read and write.

So, that is the importance that Islam gave to knowledge.

We are an Ummah(امة) of knowledge, we are an Ummah(امة) of scholarship, and unfortunately, today, we are lagging behind in our duties, this is an Ummah(امة) that should be the top in fields of scholarship.

And dear brothers and sisters!

If we have lost the interest in learning at least, let's fix the problem with the next generation.

I mean, if you happen to be a person who is having difficulty encouraging yourself to learn and to study do your best but at least make sure that this problem does not become an inherited problem from you, to your children

We want to make sure that the next generation is a generation that will love reading, that will love knowledge, that will love to study and learn.

There was study done on childern, who love to read and children who don't have the same interest.

And they try to find what is the difference in their upbringing, how come some children love reading, and some don't.

They found out the common traits or some common characteristics among the children, who love to read.

Number one, they found out that their parents are people, who love reading.

So, the child will grow up always seeing one of their parents or both holding a book.

And in the early years of our development, it is a process of imitation.

So, when the child grows up in their young age, seeing one or two of their parents always holding a book and reading.

They associate reading with something good because they always try to be like their parents, so they grow up loving, playing with magazines and books,

you'd find that the child isn't even able to read yet.

And nevertheless, they're flipping pages of a magazine.

And since they are unable to read, they would usually look for photos or pictures.

But they're doing it because they see their parents do it.

So, the more they see their parents reading or flipping through pages, the more they would love to imitate them.

So, in your house in front of your children read, give them this good example.

Second quality, they grow up in a print rich environment.

They grow up in houses that have books that have a library, they have a lot of books around them.

So, they're surrounded with books in their young age, so they have access to books.

Number three, they own libraries.

It is something good to encourage your child to own a library and to build their own library.

Because it is you know, as a human being, we have this love of ownership, especially with kids, you can see it, this is mine, that's the word that you'll always hear it, it belongs to me, it's mine.

So, have them feel that they own a book that they have their own library, it has some special meaning to them.

Their parents would take them out, to bookstores to libraries, when the parents want to entertain their children from once in a while they would take them to a public library

or they would take them to a bookstore.

So, all of this is part of encouraging them.

And finally, number five, these are children who watch little or no TV.

TV is one of the greatest distractions from learning If you give child a choice between TV and a book, they will choose TV.

So, restricting their TV viewing would encourage them to read.

So again, these are kids who either don't watch TV at all, or their viewing time is controlled.

So, these are some steps that we as parents can take to ensure that our children will grow up loving reading.

Now, even though I've been talking about reading and encouraging reading, and that we should read a lot but I need to qualify that statement.

This doesn't mean that we read anything.

At particular stages, there are some things that could be dangerous to a development of a person.

Rasool Allah ﷺ in the early years of Madina, he saw with Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), some scrolls of At-Torah(التوراة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ became very angry and his face was red.

And he criticized Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) for reading from the Torah(توراة) But that wasn't a permanent ban, it was only in the early years,

until the Muslims developed solid foundation.

And then later on, that order was abrogated, and Rasool Allah ﷺ said, I have prohibited you from reading the stories of Banni Israel(بني اسرائيل), children of Israel, meaning their Scripture

but now I am allowing you to read it.

However, don't believe it and don't disbelieve in it.

In other words, you are going to be faced with statements, that have no reference in Qur'an, so don't take it as the truth but in the same time, don't reject it, because it possibly could be true,

or it possibly could be some later insertion.

So, we can see that Rasool Allah ﷺ didn't want them to be exposed to material at the early stage of development that could be detrimental for their education process.

And in any curriculum in an institution, it is a development process.

So, you need to feed the student what the student is capable of absorbing.

And Ibn Masood(ابن مسعود) Razi Allah Anho says, If you speak to the people, things that their minds are unable to comprehend, it might be a Fitnah(فِتْنَه), for some of them, it might turn them away.

Therefore, one needs to be careful what material they are reading and what material that children are reading.

So, I'm not just saying read anything comics and the other nonsense books that exists out there, or people just wasting their time, you would find that people are always holding books, in trains and on planes,

most of the time is going to be a fiction book.

A novel, it's just a way to pass their time, there's no real knowledge in it.

And in Islam, we know that there's knowledge that benefits and knowledge that doesn't.

Rasool Allah ﷺ used to make Dua(دُعَا): O Allah, I ask You to give me knowledge that benefits and I seek refuge in You from knowledge that doesn't.

So, there is some good knowledge, and there's some bad knowledge And we know that for a fact it is in Surah Al-Baqarah(سورة البقره).

The two angels, who came down to teach the people magic.

That, they are teaching people knowledge that is evil, and they are telling the people that this is not good for you.

So, even though it is knowledge, but it's knowledge that doesn't benefit, it is knowledge of sorcery, magic.

So, these are the first verses revealed to Muhammadﷺ.

Ibn Qayyim(ابن القيم), He talks about the different types of Revelation.

The first and this is from his book, Za'ad Al-Ma'ad(زاد المعاد), Ibn Qayyim(ابن القيم) is a fascinating scholar.

He was the most prominent of the students of Ibn Taymiyaa(ابن تيميه).

And he was a prolific writer, I mean, he wrote so many books, in so many different subjects.

This particular book is called Za'ad Al-Ma'ad(زاد المعاد) and in this book, he writes about the Sunnah(سنة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, he writes about the prophetic medicine, actually, the book, the medicine of the Prophet, is one volume of Za'ad Al-Ma'ad(زاد المعاد).

The book is everything surrounding Rasool Allah ﷺ everything that had to do with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, he would write about the different forms of transportation that Rasool Allah ﷺ had, all of his weapons, his wives, his children, his family life,

what would the Messenger of Allah do when he was in Hajj(حج), what he did in a Salah(صلاة), so it is everything about the life of Muhammadﷺ.

The amazing thing about this book is Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says in the introduction to the book, He said, I wrote this book when I was traveling

not when I was residing in my house therefore, I did not have my references and books with me.

So, it's amazing how you could write about such as topic without having references and books with you.

And write such a book when you're traveling, and it is pretty much the best book written on the subject.

Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says in the book, he talks about the stages or the different categories of Revelation, he says The first is the period of True Vision.

It was the starting point of the revelation to the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him, for six months before receiving the revelation.

Rasool Allah ﷺ used to frequently see dreams.

He would see a dream at night time, and he would see the fulfillment of the dream during the daytime.

And this continued for six months, whatever he sees at night would happen the next day.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says about dreams, that the true dream is one out of 46 parts of Prophet hood.

The true dreams are one part out of 46 parts of Prophet hood.

And this number is interesting because for how long was Rasool Allah ﷺ seeing dreams, six months, and how long was the Prophet hood of Rasool Allah ﷺ 23 years,

what is the ratio of six months to 23 years, one to 46, according to the Hadith(حديث).

Dreams are something that the believer can see, it is not restricted to the Prophets.

But the difference is, in the situation of the Prophets, a dream is a form of Revelation.

With us, we have three categories of dreams which were stated Rasool Allah ﷺ.

1) Number one, a true dream and this is a dream that will occur as it was seen, or it has a meaning that needs to be interpreted.

This is the first dream.

2) Second type of dreams is a dream from Shaytaan(شيطان): Rasool Allah ﷺ says this is a dream from Shaytaan(شيطان) and he wants to inflict harm on you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says if you ever see such a dream, then seek refuge in Allah from Shaytaan(شيطان).

And don't tell that dream to anyone.

Why?

Because that's what Shaytaan(شيطان) wants to happen.

He wants to see you miserable, going around complaining to people about that horrible dream that you've seen.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ is telling you, to forget about it.

Don't tell anybody about it, if it seems to be a bad dream.

3) The third type of dreams is Rasool Allah ﷺ says, you think about something in the daytime, and you dream about it at night.

So, it's something on your mind something that you think about frequently.

You see it at night, Rasool Allah ﷺ says this is a meaningless dream, it doesn't have any meaning.

So, these are the three different types of dreams that we could have.

So, one of them is true, one is false, and one is meaningless.

2) The second type of Revelation, it is when the angel inspires to Rasool Allah ﷺ but he does not appear to Muhammadﷺ, it is just a form of inspiration.

An example of this is.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: the noble spirit meaning Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) revealed to me, no soul will perish until it exhausts its due course.

So, fear Allah and gently request him, never get so impatient to the verge of disobedience of Allah, what Allah has can never be acquired, but through obedience to Him.

So, this is not Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) speaking to Muhammadﷺ it's an inspiration.

3) The third type is, the angel appearing to Muhammadﷺ in the physical form of human beings.

And an example of that would Hadith(حديث) Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل), Jibreel عليه السّلام came in the form of a man and he was seen by Rasool Allah ﷺ and by the other companions.

4) The fourth, the angel came to him, like the toll of a bell.

And this was the most difficult form because the angel used to seize him tightly and sweat would stream from his forehead even on the coldest day.

This was the most difficult form, Jibreel عليه السّلام would descend on Muhammadﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah would feel the weight, and he would hear like the voice of a ringing bell

And that might be the vibration of the wings of the angel because there's another Hadith(حديث) that says that when Allah سبحانه وتعالى reveals His command

the angels have so much Khusho'oo(خشوع).

They start shaking their wings and the sound of the movement of their wings is like dragging a chain over a rock bed.

So, it's like dragging steel over rocks, it has that violent ringing sound that's the sound of the vibration of the wings of the angels.

When Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) would come to Rasool Allah ﷺ in this form the weight of Rasool Allah ﷺ would increase and if he is on top of his camel,

the camel would be forced to get down on his knees because of the extreme weight and the and the back of the camel would bend.

Once Rasool Allah ﷺ had his knee over the thigh of Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) and Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) descended on Muhammadﷺ, Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) said:

I felt the weight of the knee of Rasool Allah ﷺ and it was almost going to crush my thigh.

And again what seems to be very heavy is because the words of Qur'an are heavy.

The words of Allah are heavy, it's heavy burden.

Number five, the Prophet ﷺ would see Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) in his actual form, and this occurred twice and it's mentioned in Surah An-Najam(سورة النجم).

He saw him another time.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ saw Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) in his original form twice.

And Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) in his original form, had wings that would cover the horizon, huge, he would cover the horizon, in fact Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Wherever he would look, he would see the wings of the angel of Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) in front of him,

covering the horizon in every direction.

Finally, the six Allah سبحانه وتعالى would speak to Muhammadﷺ directly without any intermediary, and this occurred in Al-Miraaj(ألمعراج).

Rasool Allah ﷺ spoke directly to Allah سبحانه وتعالى and Allah spoke directly to Muhammadﷺ, and this form actually also occurred to Musa عليه السّلام.

So, these are the seven(six) different forms of Revelation.

She was suffering hard work, serving in her house.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was told by Ayesha(عائشه), so he went to the house of Ali(علي) and Fatima(فاطمه).

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) is narrating this Hadith(حديث), he says; that Rasool Allah ﷺ came in and we were already ready to go to bed.

We're already in our bed.

As soon as we saw Rasool Allah ﷺ we stood up, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Remain where you are.

So, they were laying in their beds.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said: Rasool Allah ﷺ came and he sat between me and Fatima(فاطمه).

So, he was touching both of us, he came and sat between us in our bed.

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ he loves his daughter so much he once said that Fatima(فاطمه) is part of me.

What hurts her, hurts me and what pleases her, pleases me.

This was his only surviving child and he loved her dearly.

He loved her so much.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ would want to do for his daughter what is best for her, he would want his daughter to have the best life.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had the ability to give them a servant.

But did he do that?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I have something better for you, than a servant Before you go to bed say, Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله) Thirty three(33) times

Alhamdolillah(ألحمدلله) Thirty Three(33) times and Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر) Thirty Three(33) times, that is better for you, than a servant.

Now Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that his daughter the daughter of the best and she is, of the best.

Rasool Allah ﷺ knew that she was serving in a household until her hands became harsh, the skin on her hand was thick.

Nevertheless, Rasool Allah ﷺ advised her to continue with what she's doing.

And he told her instead of getting a servant, I would give you this gift Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), Alhamdolillah(ألحمدلله) and Allah Ho Akbar(الله اكبر).

Now, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) later on, he said that Fatima(فاطمه) was working so hard.

He said that she was using the stone mill, until her hands became harsh and rough.

She was drawing water out of the well, until it left marks on her neck.

She was cleaning the house until, her clothes became dirty.

And she was cooking until, it affected her face.

Now this was the daughter of the greatest man that ever lived Muhammadﷺ.

and she was his only daughter and Rasool Allah ﷺ knew what she was going through.

And that is what made Fatima رضي الله عنها among the four best women that ever lived.

In terms of knowledge Ayesha(عائشه) is more knowledgeable than Fatima(فاطمه) and Khadijah(خديجه).

Nevertheless, Ayesha رضي الله عنها did not have the same level as Fatima(فاطمه) and Khadijah(خديجه).

So, sisters, think about your future and think about your priorities.

This is not to say that we should not learn and we should not be Islamicly active but we want to know where the Ajr(أجر) is, where the greatest Ajr(أجْر) is.

We're all encouraged to fulfill our roles and to be the best and to learn the most.

But there are things that are more rewardable than others.

So let's optimize our Ibadah(عبادة).

So, Khadijah رضي الله عنها was the first to believe, and she stood besides Rasool Allah ﷺ until she died.

She was the first believer.

The first slave to become Muslim was Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه), the first child to become Muslim was Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب).

And the first free man to become Muslim was Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

Now there's an old discussion between our scholars on who was the first man to become Muslim?

Some would say Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), and then some would say Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), we know the first woman was Khadijah(خديجه), and she was first among everyone.

But among men, who was the first was it Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), or Ali(علي).

And this is an old discussion between our scholars.

Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalaani(ابن حجر العسقلاني) tries to resolve the dispute.

He says that, the first to accept Islam was Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) because Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) was never a non Muslim, to become a Muslim.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) never was in his life, a non Muslim for him to embrace Islam, because Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) became a Muslim at a very young age.

And he never worshiped idols in his life and he never embraced the religion of the people of Makkah, and he was brought up in the household of Prophet hood.

Therefore he was brought up on Islam from day one.

Because again, he was adopted by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Therefore, we would say that the first man to become Muslim was Abu Bakr As-Siddiqueرضي الله عنه.

Now let's continue with the quotation from Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر), he says, combining these accounts, we see that Khadijah(خديجه) was the first woman to accept Islam,

the leader of the pack, as it were, and also she proceeded the men.

Among the slaves, the first to accept Islam was Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه), by the way Zaid Bin Harissa(زيد بن حارثه) was also in the household of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And the first boy to accept Islam was Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب), he was young then, and had not reached the age of puberty, as generally believed.

These were the family of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

The first free man to accept Islam was Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), the trusting, his conversion was more beneficial than that of those mentioned before,

because he was highly a respected leader, and honored chief of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and the man of wealth.

He became a missionary for Islam, and was very much liked and admired for spending his wealth in the service of Allah and His messenger.

So, it's an interesting note from Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر), that Abu Bakr(ابو بكر) was the most beneficial.

Why?

Because he was a wealthy, prominent member of the society, who brought in, all of his resources for the service of Islam.

See, when you say wealthy and respected member of the society, it would mean nothing.

if a person does not bring in, what Allah has endowed them with, to serve Islam but Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, he put everything on the line.

All of his wealth, all of his business, his connections, his knowledge, he used it all for Islam.

He put everything under the service of Rasool Allah ﷺ, it's all yours.

And that's why it was called Siddique(الصديق) because it was the first Siddique(الصديق) is the one, who believes people rejected Rasool Allah ﷺ Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) accepted him.

There was a saying that everyone hesitated in accepting Islam, except Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), as soon as this was presented to him, he accepted it

Everyone else thought about it, gave it a second thought with Abu Bakr(ابو بكر), it was an immediate response.

And he would never have second thoughts about serving Islam he would, he was the one, who came with all of his wealth, he was the one, who first believed in Rasool Allah ﷺ in Makkah,

he was the one, who first believed in Al-Israa Wal Miraj(الاسراء والمعراج) He was the one or accompanied Rasool Allah ﷺ in difficult journey of Al-Hijrah(هجرة

That was the status of Abu Bakr As-Siddique رضي الله عنه.

We talked earlier about the loyalty of Rasool Allah ﷺ to the ones, who stood with him, in the early days.

Here we have a Hadith(حديث) in Bukhari(بخاريْ): Abu Darda(ابو درداء) narrates that feud happened between Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر) , now these were the two advisors of Rasool Allah ﷺ, they're very close to him.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) said: I would see Rasool Allah ﷺ enter with Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر), he would leave with Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر),

he would sit with Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر) where ever you would see Rasool Allah ﷺ you would see Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) on one side and Umar(عُمَر) on the other,

these were his two advisors.

But still Rasool Allah ﷺ had this special loyalty to the ones, who were with him from the early days.

So, this dispute happened between Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) and Umar(عُمَر), Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Allah sent me to you and all of you said, You lie, except Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), who said, he spoke the truth.

And he dedicated himself and his fortune to me.

Will you then leave this friend of mine to me, he said that twice.

He said leave my friend alone.

Don't harm him, leave him alone.

The early stage of Da'wah(دعوة); the secret stage was over, with the revelation of the verse.

Warn your nearest Kindred.

This is in Surah Ash-Shua'raa(سورة الشعرآء) it was revealed to Rasool Allah ﷺ, Rasool Allah ﷺ went out and stood on the mountain of As-Saffah(ألصفاء).

And he called; Wa'Sub-haa(وا صَبَاحَاهْ) is like, sounding the alarm, the sirens.

You don't say Wa'Sub-haa(وا صَبَاحَاهْ), unless there's an emergency going on, there's something very critical.

So, everyone who heard Rasool Allah ﷺ ran towards the source of the voice.

And the ones, who could not go with send someone to report back to them.

So, Wa'Sub-haa(وا صَبَاحَاهْ) is something that you don't say unless it's something very important.

So, all of the people gathered, Rasool Allah ﷺ asked them, if I tell you that there is an army behind this mountain that is about to ambush you, attack you.

Would you believe me?, They said: we have never heard you lie.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I am here to warn you a severe punishment.

I came to warn you, Allah سبحانه وتعالى sent me as a Warner to you, and I'm warning you as severe punishment that will befall you if you don't believe.

These were the words Rasool Allah ﷺ chose to deliver in his first public speech to the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

I am here to warn you.

So, you can see that it was very straightforward.

Without much introduction, straight to the point.

I am warning you a severe punishment.

Rasool Allah ﷺ did that because the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), Allah سبحانه وتعالى tells them that your duty is Balaagh Mubeen(بلاغ مبين), your duty is to convey the message plainly.

So, when you convey the message, it should not be confusing.

It should not be obscure, it should not be sugar coated, it should not be altered, it should be straightforward.

Because you don't want to leave any doubts in the mind of the listener, you don't want to confuse them.

Now unfortunately, many times when we make Da'wah(دعوة) we confuse the listener the listener comes out not knowing what's going on.

What are we talking about?

What are the consequences of belief?

And what are the consequences of disbelief?

But Rasool Allah ﷺ would leave no doubt in the mind of the listener.

The listener would know that if they believe they will be a promised Jannah(جنة).

And if they don't, they're risking hellfire.

They know that the consequences of disbelief would be hellfire.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ would make his warnings very straightforward.

Now, Rasool Allah ﷺ called the people and the people assumed that, this is something urgent and important, and it was.!!

Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) responded and said: May evil befall you the rest of your day.

Is this why you called us.?

Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) was upset, he was angry.

Why?

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ called for an urgent gathering during the official business hours, and he took me from my work and my business, and I came here not to hear something serious, according to Abu Lahab(ابو لهب).

He was talking about afterlife, he's talking about religion, he's talking about spirituality.

He's talking about things that are not tangible He's wasting my time, I could have made money, during those valuable minutes that I spent listening to him.

So, Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) was upset.

Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) is thinking that this is the material world, this is real world And if you don't have a deal to discuss some business, some money to make, don't waste my time.

And he said, may evil befall you the rest of the day, you wasted my time.

Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) is not alone, in that he's speaking on behalf of a lot of people.

People don't want to listen about religion, don't waste my time talking about this religious stuff.

If you can promise me some money, if they can promise me something that will do me good in this world, otherwise, don't waste my time.

Excuse me, sir, can I talk to you about religion for half an hour?

No, I'm busy.

I can't afford half an hour.

And then what is that man in a rush to do?

Maybe is going to buy a refrigerator or a car or something you know, you're asking the person to give you half an hour from their time to talk about their salvation and they would refuse,

nevertheless, they willing to spend hours and hours before buying your refrigerator or an oven.

They would look at all of the deals, they would visit all of the department stores.

Before a person would buy a used car, they would spend days and days of research they would go and consult the blue book.

So, I would consult the blue book then I would go and read all of the classified ads days and days of my valuable life, I'm spending just to save a few hundred dollars.

and I'm not willing to give half an hour of my time to learn about what will save me, in my eternal life.

So, Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) was representing lots of people when they said: Allah سبحانه وتعالى revealed the Surah(سورة).

The hands of Abu Lahab(ابواهب) will perish and perish he and then the Ayah(آية) says: His wealth will not do him any good.

What was keeping Abu Lahab(ابو لهب) away from the truth, business, his wealth.

Allah سبحانه وتعالى is saying that his wealth will do him no good.

The people who are rushing after Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) will do the no good.

If they don't have Islam in their heart.

This Surah(سورة) is a miracle of Qur'an because it says that Abu Lahab(ابولهب) and his wife are in hellfire.

And this Ayah(آية) was revealed while Abu Lahab(ابولهب) and his wife were still alive.

If Abu Lahab(ابولهب) and his wife wanted to prove Qur'an wrong, they could have said we are Muslims.

But they remained disbelievers until, the day they died.

So, this is a miracle of Qur'an.

It is speaking about an event that did not happen yet.

It is saying that Abu Lahab(ابولهب) and his wife are in Hellfire, while they're still alive.

And they could have embraced Islam if they wanted to prove Qur'an wrong.

But they didn't do it.

اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۞

بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۞

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعْرِ، شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ، لا يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ،

مَا اَنَا بِقَارِيْ مَا اَنَا بِقَارِيْ اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ۝ خَلَقَ الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ۝

اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ۝ الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ۝ عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ۝

اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ۝

اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ۝ خَلَقَ الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ۝ اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ۝

الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ۝

عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ۝

زَمِّلُوْنِي زَمِّلُوْنِيْ، دَثِّرُوْنِيْ دَثِّرُوْنِيْ كَلَّا لَنْ يُخْزِيْكَ اللهُ أَبَدَا إِنَّكَ تَحْمِلُ الْكَلَّ ، وَتُعِيْنُ عَلى نَوَائِبِ الْحَقَّ

وَ يَالَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ فِيْهَا جَدْعًا حِيْنَ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ مِنْ اَرْضِكْ أَوَ مُخْرِجِيَ هُمْ ؟

Allahسبحانه وتعالى says: وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُو مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ۝

اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ۝ خَلَقَ الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ۝ اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ۝ الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ۝

ن ۚ وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ۝

مَا حَدَّثْتَ النَّاسْ بِمَا لَمْ تَبْلُغُ اَكُوْلُهُمْ اِلَّا كَانَ لِبَعْضِهِمْ فِتْنَهْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اَسْئَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ

هَارُوتَ وَمَارُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ ۚ وَمَا هُمْ بِضَارِّينَ بِهِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ

عَلَّقْتُه’ فِيْ السَّفَرْ لَا فِيْ الْاِقَامَهْ رُؤيَا تَحزِيْنْ مِنَّ الشَّيْطَانْ يَقُوْلُ صلى الله عليه وسلم  نَفَثَ رَوْحُ الْقُدُسْ فِيْ رَوْعِيْ اَنَّه’ لَنْ تَمُوْتَ نَفْسٌ حَتَّى تَسْتَكْمِلَ اَجَلَهَا وَرِزْقَهَا

Allah سبحانه وتعالى says إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا۝

وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۝ عِنْدَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَىٰ۝

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ

وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ۝

وا صَبَاحَاه مَا عَهِدْنَا عَلَيْكَ كَذِبَا فَاِنِّيْ نَذِيْرُلَّكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمْ تَبَّنْ الَّكَ اَلِى هَذَا جَمَاعْتَنَا

تَبَّاً الَّكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمْ تَبَّاً الَّكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمْ تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ۝ مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ۝

مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ

parts.english:
We'll move on to the next subject, and we're going to talk about some of the glad tidings of the coming of Muhammadﷺ the glad tidings that came before his Prophet hood.

This Hadith(حديث) which is mentioned by Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ).

He says; the one who was stating this Hadith(حديث) is Salamah Bin Salam Bin Waqsh(سلمه بن سلام بن وقش).

He said: We had a Jewish neighbor from Bannu Abd-Al-Ash'hal(بنوعبدالأشهل), and he came out of his house one day to us, at that time, I was the youngest of my household.

I was wearing a fur gown, a fur gown, I had that I was lying in it, in the courtyard of my family's house.

The Jew talked about the resurrection, the day of judgment, the reckoning, the scales, paradise and hellfire.

This he told to Polytheists idolaters, who did not believe in any life after death.

They replied, come on now, you really think people can be sent after their death, to some place where there's a paradise and a fire, where they will be punished for their deeds.

Yes, indeed, he replied.

And by Him, by Whom oaths are sworn.

Anyone going into that fire would prefer being placed in the hottest oven in the house, and having it covered over him, and he being let out of it only next day.

Then they said: "Good gracious, what proof is there?

They asked!

He said; A Prophet is being sent from the hereabouts, in these lands.

And he gestured over towards Makkah and Yemen.

When will we see him?

They inquired!

He looked over at me, I being the youngest one there and he said if this lad lives a normal lifespan he'll live to this time.

Salamah(سلمه) said: And a day and a night had scarcely passed thereafter, until God send the Messenger of Allah, who lived among us, and so we believed in him,

but he the Jew disbelieved in him out of evil and envy.

So, this Jewish man, who has studied, he learned from his books, learned from the old scripture, that there is a Prophet, who will be sent from the direction of Makkah,

and that there is Hellfire and paradise and he knew that the time was approaching and it was very near.
